## 🏗️ Architecture

<div align="center">
  <img src="docs/architecture.svg" alt="Menyoo DX12 Architecture Diagram" width="100%"/>
</div>

- **Zero External UI Dependencies:** Custom anti-aliased GDI text + premultiplied-BGRA vector rasterizer (`render.rs`) with auto-fitting section headers, animated glare, rank-globe toggle orbs, and color swatches.
- **0.00 ms Closed Overhead:** `has_overlay_to_draw()` checks a single relaxed `AtomicBool` (~0.5 ns) before touching any DirectX 12 command list.
- **External Cleanroom Schema (`rvas.json`):** Zero hardcoded binary offsets in Rust. All 190 runtime globals, offsets, and functions load from an external JSON schema ([`config/rvas.example.json`](config/rvas.example.json)) with **`Ctrl + F7` live hot-reload** and O(1) pool liveness validation (`is_entity_live_in_pool`).

---

## 🚀 Quick Install

### Prerequisites
- **Windows 10 / 11 (x64)** with DirectX 12 GPU
- **Rust `1.88+`** ([rustup.rs](https://rustup.rs/))

### Option 1 — Standalone Interactive Preview Window

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/joeplenty/menyoo-dx12.git
cd menyoo-dx12
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\install.ps1 -LaunchPreview
```

Stages `menyooStuff/` (`Outfits/`, `Vehicles/`, `Spooner/`, `menyooConfig.ini`, `rvas.example.json`), builds the release binary (`menyoo-preview.exe`), and launches the live desktop preview window so you can explore every submenu, theme, and sound cue immediately.

### Option 2 — Integrate into a DirectX 12 Swapchain Host

```toml
[dependencies]
menyoo-dx12 = { git = "https://github.com/joeplenty/menyoo-dx12.git" }
```

```rust
use menyoo_dx12::host_bridge::{HostPerfSnapshot, update_perf};

// 1. Optional: push host telemetry for the non-overlapping top-right HUD
update_perf(HostPerfSnapshot {
    fps, frame_ms, gpu_ms, draws, vram_used_mb, vram_budget_mb,
    ..Default::default()
});

// 2. ~0.5 ns atomic fast-path when menu & HUD are hidden
if menyoo_dx12::has_overlay_to_draw() {
    menyoo_dx12::record_present_overlay(
        &device,
        &command_list,
        &backbuffer,
        backbuffer_format,
        (width, height),
    );
}
```

> 📖 See **[docs/INSTALL.md](docs/INSTALL.md)** for environment variables (`MENYOO_DX12`, `MENYOO_DX12_DIR`, `MENYOO_DX12_LIVE_HOOKS`), custom `.wav` sounds, and Schema v11.0 hot-reload instructions.

## 🎮 Controls & Keybinds

| Action | Keyboard | Controller (XInput) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Open / Close Menu** | `F7` *(customizable in Settings)* | `RB + D-Pad Left` |
| **Navigate Up / Down** | `↑` / `↓` or `Numpad 8` / `2` | `D-Pad Up` / `Down` |
| **Adjust Sliders / Values** | `←` / `→` or `Numpad 4` / `6` | `D-Pad Left` / `Right` |
| **Select / Toggle** | `Enter` or `Numpad 5` | `A` |
| **Back / Close** | `Backspace` or `Numpad 0` | `B` |
| **Hot-Reload `rvas.json`** | `Ctrl + F7` | — |
| **Free-Cam / No-Clip Flight** | `W A S D` + `Space` / `Ctrl` + `Shift` | Left Stick + Triggers |
| **Fun Gun / Gravity Gun** | `Left Mouse Button` *(hold for Gravity Gun)* | `RT` |

## 🧪 Verification & Tests

```powershell
cargo test
```

- `hook::tests::five_byte_callsite_hook_executes_and_restores_cleanly` — Live x64 executable callsite trampoline install, execution & byte-exact restore
- `trainer::tests::custom_vehicle_and_spooner_scene_roundtrip` — Full Schema v11.0 vehicle & attached 3D Spooner JSON persistence
- `trainer::tests::weapon_categories_and_balanced_loadout` — Multi-class weapon classification & balanced wheel loadout
- `tests::renders_menyoo_main_postfx_banners_and_mouse_cleanly` — Full 1080p UI rasterization, banners, Post-FX & mouse hit-testing
- `previews::tests::png_encode_decode_and_preview_cache_roundtrip` — Pure-Rust `zlib-rs` PNG codec
- `sound::tests::all_synthesized_cues_are_nonempty_and_bounded` — Procedural WinMM PCM cue bounds

`docs/INSTALL.md`:

```md
# Installation & Configuration Guide — Menyoo DX12

This guide covers building **Menyoo DX12**, staging the `menyooStuff/` runtime folder, integrating the overlay into a DirectX 12 host, and configuring an external `rvas.json` schema.

---

## 1. Quick Windows Setup

### Requirements
- Windows 10/11 (64-bit) with a DirectX 12 capable GPU
- Rust `1.88+` (`winget install Rustlang.Rustup` or https://rustup.rs/)
- Visual Studio Build Tools (Desktop development with C++ workload, for MSVC linker)

### Automated Installer

Run from the repository root:

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\install.ps1 -LaunchPreview
```

Available flags:
- `-InstallDir "D:\MyGame\menyooStuff"` — stage config & preset folders into a custom directory.
- `-SkipBuild` — only stage default `.ini` / `.json` config files.
- `-LaunchPreview` — immediately open the standalone interactive Win32 preview window after building.

---

## 2. Directory Layout (`menyooStuff/`)

```text
menyooStuff/
├── menyooConfig.ini            # Persisted theme, HUD, sound & hotkey preferences
├── rvas.json                   # (User-supplied) External target offset/function schema
├── Sounds/                     # (Optional) Drop custom PCM .wav files to override synth audio
├── Previews/                   # (Optional, OFF by default) User-supplied 320×180 PNG thumbnails
├── Outfits/                    # Saved wardrobe presets (*.json)
├── Vehicles/                   # Saved custom vehicle builds (*.json)
└── Spooner/                    # Saved 3D Object Spooner scenes (*.json)
```

---

## 3. Environment Variables

| Variable | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `MENYOO_DX12` | `0` | Set to `1` to enable the DirectX 12 overlay in a host runtime. |
| `MENYOO_DX12_DIR` | `./menyooStuff` | Explicit path to the `menyooStuff` folder (`menyooConfig.ini`, `rvas.json`, saves). |
| `MENYOO_DX12_LIVE_HOOKS` | `0` | Set to `1` to auto-install the external-schema main-thread callsite hook on startup. |

---

## 4. External Schema (`rvas.json`) & Live Hot-Reload

By design, `menyoo-dx12` contains **zero hardcoded target binary offsets**. All runtime memory globals, component offsets, and callable addresses are read from `menyooStuff/rvas.json` (see [`config/rvas.example.json`](../config/rvas.example.json) for the full Schema v11.0 template with 190 external entries).

- Any field left as `"0x0"` or omitted is safely skipped — all UI menus, Post-FX shaders, Sound synthesis, and HUD elements continue working with zero crashes.
- Edit `rvas.json` while running and press **`Ctrl + F7`** to reload the schema live.

---

## 5. DirectX 12 Host Integration

When integrating `menyoo_dx12` into a DX12 application or swapchain wrapper:

1. Ensure the target backbuffer is transitioned into `D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET` prior to calling `menyoo_dx12::record_present_overlay(...)`.
2. `menyoo_dx12::has_overlay_to_draw()` checks a single `AtomicBool` (~0.5 ns), guaranteeing **0.00 ms GPU overhead** whenever the menu and HUD counters are hidden.
3. `d3d12_quad.rs` lazily compiles a minimal `vs_5_0` / `ps_5_0` fullscreen triangle PSO matching the swapchain's exact `DXGI_FORMAT` (`B8G8R8A8_UNORM`, `R8G8B8A8_UNORM`, `R10G10B10A2_UNORM`, etc.).

```

`scripts/install.ps1`:

```ps1
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    One-command Windows installer for Menyoo DX12 (`menyoo-dx12`).
.DESCRIPTION
    Stages the `menyooStuff` config & save directory (default INI settings and cleanroom
    `rvas.example.json`), builds the release `menyoo-preview.exe` binary, and optionally
    launches the interactive Win32 preview window.
#>
param(
    [string]$InstallDir = "$PSScriptRoot\..\menyooStuff",
    [switch]$SkipBuild,
    [switch]$LaunchPreview
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$RepoRoot = (Resolve-Path "$PSScriptRoot\..").Path
$TargetDir = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($InstallDir)

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "  ==============================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "    MENYOO DX12 — DirectX 12 Overlay Installer" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "  ==============================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host ""

$folders = @(
    $TargetDir,
    "$TargetDir\Outfits",
    "$TargetDir\Vehicles",
    "$TargetDir\Spooner",
    "$TargetDir\Sounds"
)
foreach ($f in $folders) {
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f)) {
        New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $f -Force | Out-Null
    }
}

$cfgDst = "$TargetDir\menyooConfig.ini"
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $cfgDst)) {
    Copy-Item -LiteralPath "$RepoRoot\config\menyooConfig.example.ini" -Destination $cfgDst -Force
    Write-Host "[1/2] Created default config: $cfgDst" -ForegroundColor Green
} else {
    Write-Host "[1/2] Preserved existing config: $cfgDst" -ForegroundColor Yellow
}

Copy-Item -LiteralPath "$RepoRoot\config\rvas.example.json" -Destination "$TargetDir\rvas.example.json" -Force

if (-not $SkipBuild) {
    Write-Host "[2/2] Building release binary (`cargo build --release`)..." -ForegroundColor Green
    Push-Location $RepoRoot
    try {
        & cargo build --release
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "cargo build failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE" }
    } finally {
        Pop-Location
    }
} else {
    Write-Host "[2/2] Skipped cargo build (-SkipBuild)." -ForegroundColor Yellow
}

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "  Installation complete!" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "  Config directory : $TargetDir" -ForegroundColor White
Write-Host "  Preview launcher : $RepoRoot\target\release\menyoo-preview.exe" -ForegroundColor White
Write-Host "  Env variable     : `$env:MENYOO_DX12_DIR = '$TargetDir'" -ForegroundColor DarkGray
Write-Host ""

if ($LaunchPreview) {
    $env:MENYOO_DX12_DIR = $TargetDir
    Start-Process -FilePath "$RepoRoot\target\release\menyoo-preview.exe"
}

```

`src/config.rs`:

```rs
//! Menyoo PC themes, typography presets, RGBA colors, and `menyooStuff/menyooConfig.ini`
//! persistence (matching MAFINS's original MenyooSP `Settings.cpp` & `MenuConfig.cpp`).
//!
//! Includes all 12 official MAFINS themes plus 4 GTA / DirectX 12 revamp themes.

use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Rgba {
    pub r: u8,
    pub g: u8,
    pub b: u8,
    pub a: u8,
}

impl Rgba {
    pub const fn new(r: u8, g: u8, b: u8, a: u8) -> Self {
        Self { r, g, b, a }
    }
}

/// GTA V / Menyoo font identifiers (`GTAfont` in `MenyooSP/Scripting/enums.h`).
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[repr(u8)]
pub enum MenuFont {
    /// GTA Font 0 (`ChaletLondon` / "Normalish")
    Arial = 0,
    /// GTA Font 1 (`HouseScript` / "Italic")
    Italic = 1,
    /// GTA Font 2 (`Monospace` / "Caps")
    Caps = 2,
    /// GTA Font 4 (`ChaletComprimeCologne` / "Impactish")
    Impact = 4,
    /// GTA Font 7 (`Pricedown` — classic GTA heavy display font)
    Pricedown = 7,
}

impl MenuFont {
    pub const ALL: [MenuFont; 5] = [
        MenuFont::Arial,
        MenuFont::Impact,
        MenuFont::Italic,
        MenuFont::Pricedown,
        MenuFont::Caps,
    ];

    pub const fn name(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            Self::Arial => "Normalish (Chalet)",
            Self::Impact => "Impactish (Comprime)",
            Self::Italic => "Italic (HouseScript)",
            Self::Pricedown => "Pricedown (GTA)",
            Self::Caps => "Caps (Display)",
        }
    }

    pub fn from_id(id: u8) -> Self {
        match id {
            0 => Self::Arial,
            1 => Self::Italic,
            2 => Self::Caps,
            7 => Self::Pricedown,
            _ => Self::Impact,
        }
    }
}

/// Persistent Menyoo configuration saved to `menyooStuff/menyooConfig.ini`.
#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct MenyooConfig {

            optiontext: t.optiontext,

            accent: t.accent,
            font_title: t.font_title,
            font_options: t.font_options,
            font_selection: t.font_selection,
            font_breaks: t.font_breaks,
            sound_enabled: true,
            sound_volume: 75,
            display_fps: false,
            display_telemetry: false,
            display_clock: false,
            display_analogue_clock: false,
            display_speedo: false,
            speedo_kph: false,
            display_compass: false,
            display_xyzh: false,
            keep_spawned_vehicles: true,
            spawn_inside_vehicle: false,
            clock_24h: true,
            cinematic_bars: false,
            crosshair_style: 0,
            show_notifications: true,
            show_instructional: true,
            show_description_bar: false,
            uptime_badge: false,
            quick_hotkeys: true,
            vision_preset: 0,
            vision_strength: 0.75,

            vision_saturation: 1.0,
            mouse_support: true,
            category_banners: true,
            show_previews: false,
            fps_cap_idx: 0,
        }
    }
}

impl MenyooConfig {
    pub fn apply_theme(&mut self, theme: &MenyooTheme) {
        self.gradients = theme.gradients;
        self.rainbow_mode = theme.rainbow;
        self.thin_line_over_footer = theme.thin_line_over_footer;
        self.titlebox = theme.titlebox;
        self.bg = theme.bg;
        self.titletext = theme.titletext;
        self.optiontext = theme.optiontext;
        self.selectedtext = theme.selectedtext;
        self.optionbreaks = theme.optionbreaks;
        self.optioncount = theme.optioncount;
        self.selectionhi = theme.selectionhi;
        self.accent = theme.accent;
        self.font_title = theme.font_title;
        self.font_options = theme.font_options;
        self.font_selection = theme.font_selection;
        self.font_breaks = theme.font_breaks;
    }

    pub fn matches_theme(&self, theme: &MenyooTheme) -> bool {
        self.gradients == theme.gradients
            && self.rainbow_mode == theme.rainbow
            && self.thin_line_over_footer == theme.thin_line_over_footer
            && self.titlebox == theme.titlebox
            && self.bg == theme.bg
            && self.titletext == theme.titletext
            && self.optiontext == theme.optiontext
            && self.selectedtext == theme.selectedtext
            && self.optionbreaks == theme.optionbreaks
            && self.optioncount == theme.optioncount
            && self.selectionhi == theme.selectionhi
            && self.font_title == theme.font_title
            && self.font_options == theme.font_options
    }

    pub fn open_key_label(&self) -> &'static str {
        OPEN_KEYS
            .iter()
            .find(|&&(_, vk)| vk == self.open_key_vk)
            .map_or("F7", |&(label, _)| label)
    }

    pub fn open_key_short(&self) -> &'static str {
        match self.open_key_vk {
            0x73 => "F4",
            0x74 => "F5",
            0x75 => "F6",
            0x76 => "F7",
            0x77 => "F8",
            0x2D => "INS",
            0x6A => "NUM*",
            _ => "F7",
        }
    }

    pub fn load(dir: &Path) -> Self {
        let mut cfg = Self::default();
        let path = dir.join("menyooConfig.ini");
        let Ok(text) = std::fs::read_to_string(&path) else {
            return cfg;
        };
        let mut section = String::new();
        for raw in text.lines() {
            let line = raw.trim();
            if line.is_empty() || line.starts_with(';') || line.starts_with('#') {
                continue;
            }
            if let Some(s) = line.strip_prefix('[').and_then(|s| s.strip_suffix(']')) {
                section = s.trim().to_ascii_lowercase();
                continue;
            }
            let Some((k, v)) = line.split_once('=') else {
                continue;
            };
            let k = k.trim();
            let v = v.trim();
            let b = || matches!(v, "1" | "true" | "True" | "TRUE");
            match (section.as_str(), k) {
                ("settings", "sync_with_config_at_intervals") => cfg.sync_with_config = b(),
                ("settings", "open_key") => {
                    if let Ok(vk) = v.parse::<u8>() {
                        cfg.open_key_vk = vk;
                    }
                }
                ("settings", "menuPosX") => {
                    if let Ok(x) = v.parse::<f32>() {
                        cfg.menu_pos_x = x.clamp(-0.055, 0.72);
                    }
                }
                ("settings", "menuPosY") => {
                    if let Ok(y) = v.parse::<f32>() {
                        cfg.menu_pos_y = y.clamp(-0.065, 0.55);
                    }
                }
                ("settings", "Titlebox_Globe") => cfg.titlebox_globe = b(),
                ("settings", "centre_title") => cfg.centre_title = b(),
                ("settings", "centre_options") => cfg.centre_options = b(),
                ("settings", "centre_breaks") => cfg.centre_breaks = b(),
                ("settings", "mouse_support") => cfg.mouse_support = b(),
                ("settings", "category_banners") => cfg.category_banners = b(),
                ("settings", "show_previews") => cfg.show_previews = b(),
                ("colours", "gradients") => cfg.gradients = b(),
                ("colours", "rainbow_mode") => cfg.rainbow_mode = b(),
                ("colours", "thin_line_over_footer") => cfg.thin_line_over_footer = b(),
                ("colours", "titlebox_R") => parse_u8(v, &mut cfg.titlebox.r),
                ("colours", "titlebox_G") => parse_u8(v, &mut cfg.titlebox.g),
                ("colours", "titlebox_B") => parse_u8(v, &mut cfg.titlebox.b),
                ("colours", "titlebox_A") => parse_u8(v, &mut cfg.titlebox.a),
                ("colours", "BG_R") => parse_u8(v, &mut cfg.bg.r),
                ("colours", "BG_G") => parse_u8(v, &mut cfg.bg.g),
                ("colours", "BG_B") => parse_u8(v, &mut cfg.bg.b),
                ("colours", "BG_A") => parse_u8(v, &mut cfg.bg.a),
                ("colours", "titletext_R") => parse_u8(v, &mut cfg.titletext.r),
                ("colours", "titletext_G") => parse_u8(v, &mut cfg.titletext.g),
                ("colours", "titletext_B") => parse_u8(v, &mut cfg.titletext.b),
                ("colours", "titletext_A") => parse_u8(v, &mut cfg.titletext.a),
                ("colours", "optiontext_R") => parse_u8(v, &mut cfg.optiontext.r),
                ("colours", "optiontext_G") => parse_u8(v, &mut cfg.optiontext.g),
                ("colours", "optiontext_B") => parse_u8(v, &mut cfg.optiontext.b),
                ("colours", "optiontext_A") => parse_u8(v, &mut cfg.optiontext.a),
                ("colours", "selectedtext_R") => parse_u8(v, &mut cfg.selectedtext.r),
                ("colours", "selectedtext_G") => parse_u8(v, &mut cfg.selectedtext.g),
                ("colours", "selectedtext_B") => parse_u8(v, &mut cfg.selectedtext.b),
                ("colours", "selectedtext_A") => parse_u8(v, &mut cfg.selectedtext.a),
                ("colours", "optionbreaks_R") => parse_u8(v, &mut cfg.optionbreaks.r),
                ("colours", "optionbreaks_G") => parse_u8(v, &mut cfg.optionbreaks.g),
                ("colours", "optionbreaks_B") => parse_u8(v, &mut cfg.optionbreaks.b),
                ("colours", "optionbreaks_A") => parse_u8(v, &mut cfg.optionbreaks.a),
                ("colours", "optioncount_R") => parse_u8(v, &mut cfg.optioncount.r),
                ("colours", "optioncount_G") => parse_u8(v, &mut cfg.optioncount.g),
                ("colours", "optioncount_B") => parse_u8(v, &mut cfg.optioncount.b),
                ("colours", "optioncount_A") => parse_u8(v, &mut cfg.optioncount.a),
                ("colours", "selectionhi_R") => parse_u8(v, &mut cfg.selectionhi.r),
                ("colours", "selectionhi_G") => parse_u8(v, &mut cfg.selectionhi.g),
                ("colours", "selectionhi_B") => parse_u8(v, &mut cfg.selectionhi.b),
                ("colours", "selectionhi_A") => parse_u8(v, &mut cfg.selectionhi.a),
                ("colours", "accent_R") => parse_u8(v, &mut cfg.accent.r),
                ("colours", "accent_G") => parse_u8(v, &mut cfg.accent.g),
                ("colours", "accent_B") => parse_u8(v, &mut cfg.accent.b),
                ("fonts", "title") => {
                    if let Ok(id) = v.parse::<u8>() {
                        cfg.font_title = MenuFont::from_id(id);
                    }
                }
                ("fonts", "options") => {
                    if let Ok(id) = v.parse::<u8>() {
                        cfg.font_options = MenuFont::from_id(id);
                    }
                }
                ("fonts", "selection") => {
                    if let Ok(id) = v.parse::<u8>() {
                        cfg.font_selection = MenuFont::from_id(id);
                    }
                }
                ("fonts", "breaks") => {
                    if let Ok(id) = v.parse::<u8>() {
                        cfg.font_breaks = MenuFont::from_id(id);
                    }
                }
                ("audio", "enabled") => cfg.sound_enabled = b(),
                ("audio", "volume") => {
                    if let Ok(vol) = v.parse::<u32>() {
                        cfg.sound_volume = vol.min(100);
                    }
                }
                ("hud", "display_fps") => cfg.display_fps = b(),
                ("hud", "display_telemetry") => cfg.display_telemetry = b(),
                ("hud", "display_clock") => cfg.display_clock = b(),
                ("hud", "display_analogue_clock") => cfg.display_analogue_clock = b(),
                ("hud", "display_speedo") => cfg.display_speedo = b(),
                ("hud", "speedo_kph") => cfg.speedo_kph = b(),
                ("hud", "display_compass") => cfg.display_compass = b(),
                ("hud", "display_xyzh") => cfg.display_xyzh = b(),
                ("settings", "keep_spawned_vehicles") => cfg.keep_spawned_vehicles = b(),
                ("settings", "spawn_inside_vehicle") => cfg.spawn_inside_vehicle = b(),
                ("hud", "clock_24h") => cfg.clock_24h = b(),
                ("hud", "cinematic_bars") => cfg.cinematic_bars = b(),
                ("hud", "crosshair_style") => {
                    if let Ok(idx) = v.parse::<usize>() {
                        cfg.crosshair_style = idx.min(3);
                    }
                }
                ("hud", "show_notifications") => cfg.show_notifications = b(),
                ("hud", "show_instructional") => cfg.show_instructional = b(),
                ("hud", "show_description_bar") => cfg.show_description_bar = b(),
                ("hud", "uptime_badge") => cfg.uptime_badge = b(),
                ("settings", "quick_hotkeys") => cfg.quick_hotkeys = b(),
                _ => {}
            }
        }
        cfg
    }

fn parse_u8(v: &str, out: &mut u8) {
    if let Ok(n) = v.parse::<u8>() {
        *out = n;
    }
}

/// Resolves the `menyooStuff` directory beside the configured data dir or exe.
pub fn resolve_stuff_dir() -> PathBuf {
    if let Some(dir) = std::env::var_os("VICTORY_MENYOO_DIR").filter(|v| !v.is_empty()) {
        return PathBuf::from(dir);
    }
    if let Some(data) = std::env::var_os("VICTORY_DATA_DIR").filter(|v| !v.is_empty()) {
        return PathBuf::from(data).join("menyooStuff");
    }
    std::env::current_exe()
        .ok()
        .and_then(|p| p.parent().map(|d| d.join("menyooStuff")))
        .unwrap_or_else(|| PathBuf::from("menyooStuff"))
}

`src/d3d12_quad.rs`:

```rs
//! Self-contained DirectX 12 fullscreen alpha-blended RGBA overlay pass.
//!
//! Draws a `DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM` or `R8G8B8A8_UNORM` overlay texture over
//! any host swapchain backbuffer already in `D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET` state
//! using a single root descriptor table + 3-vertex fullscreen triangle (`DrawInstanced(3, 1, 0, 0)`).

#[cfg(windows)]
use std::sync::Mutex;

#[cfg(windows)]
use windows::Win32::Graphics::Direct3D::{
    D3D_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLELIST, ID3DBlob,
};
#[cfg(windows)]
use windows::Win32::Graphics::Direct3D::Fxc::D3DCompile;
#[cfg(windows)]
use windows::Win32::Graphics::Direct3D12::*;
#[cfg(windows)]
use windows::Win32::Graphics::Dxgi::Common::*;
#[cfg(windows)]
use windows::core::{PCSTR, s};

#[cfg(windows)]
const SHADER_SRC: &str = r#"
Texture2D<float4> gOverlay : register(t0);
SamplerState gSamp : register(s0);

struct VSOut {
    float4 pos : SV_Position;
    float2 uv  : TEXCOORD0;
};

VSOut VSMain(uint id : SV_VertexID) {
    VSOut o;
    float2 p = float2((id == 1) ? 3.0 : -1.0, (id == 2) ? -3.0 : 1.0);
    o.pos = float4(p, 0.0, 1.0);
    o.uv  = float2((p.x + 1.0) * 0.5, (1.0 - p.y) * 0.5);
    return o;
}

float4 PSMain(VSOut i) : SV_Target {
    return gOverlay.Sample(gSamp, i.uv);
}
"#;

#[cfg(windows)]
struct QuadPipeline {
    root_sig: ID3D12RootSignature,
    pso: ID3D12PipelineState,
    rtv_format: DXGI_FORMAT,
    srv_heap: ID3D12DescriptorHeap,
    rtv_heap: ID3D12DescriptorHeap,
    device_ptr: usize,
}

#[cfg(windows)]
unsafe impl Send for QuadPipeline {}

#[cfg(windows)]
static PIPELINE: Mutex<Option<QuadPipeline>> = Mutex::new(None);

#[cfg(windows)]
fn compile_hlsl(entry: PCSTR, target: PCSTR) -> Option<ID3DBlob> {
    let mut blob: Option<ID3DBlob> = None;
    let mut err: Option<ID3DBlob> = None;
    unsafe {
        if D3DCompile(
            SHADER_SRC.as_ptr().cast(),
            SHADER_SRC.len(),
            None,
            None,
            None,
            entry,
            target,
            0,
            0,
            &mut blob,
            Some(&mut err),
        )
        .is_ok()
        {
            blob
        } else {
            None
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(windows)]
fn create_pipeline(device: &ID3D12Device, format: DXGI_FORMAT) -> Option<QuadPipeline> {
    let vs = compile_hlsl(s!("VSMain"), s!("vs_5_0"))?;
    let ps = compile_hlsl(s!("PSMain"), s!("ps_5_0"))?;

    let range = D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE {
        RangeType: D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV,
        NumDescriptors: 1,
        BaseShaderRegister: 0,
        RegisterSpace: 0,
        OffsetInDescriptorsFromTableStart: 0,
    };
    let param = D3D12_ROOT_PARAMETER {
        ParameterType: D3D12_ROOT_PARAMETER_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_TABLE,
        Anonymous: D3D12_ROOT_PARAMETER_0 {
            DescriptorTable: D3D12_ROOT_DESCRIPTOR_TABLE {
                NumDescriptorRanges: 1,
                pDescriptorRanges: &range,
            },
        },
        ShaderVisibility: D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL,
    };
    let sampler = D3D12_STATIC_SAMPLER_DESC {
        Filter: D3D12_FILTER_MIN_MAG_MIP_LINEAR,
        AddressU: D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP,
        AddressV: D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP,
        AddressW: D3D12_TEXTURE_ADDRESS_MODE_CLAMP,
        ShaderVisibility: D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL,
        MaxLOD: f32::MAX,
        ..Default::default()
    };
    let rs_desc = D3D12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_DESC {
        NumParameters: 1,
        pParameters: &param,
        NumStaticSamplers: 1,
        pStaticSamplers: &sampler,
        Flags: D3D12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_FLAG_NONE,
    };

    unsafe {
        let mut rs_blob: Option<ID3DBlob> = None;
        D3D12SerializeRootSignature(
            &rs_desc,
            D3D_ROOT_SIGNATURE_VERSION_1,
            &mut rs_blob,
            None,
        )
        .ok()?;
        let rs_blob = rs_blob?;
        let rs_slice = std::slice::from_raw_parts(
            rs_blob.GetBufferPointer().cast::<u8>(),
            rs_blob.GetBufferSize(),
        );
        let root_sig: ID3D12RootSignature = device.CreateRootSignature(0, rs_slice).ok()?;

        let mut pso_desc = D3D12_GRAPHICS_PIPELINE_STATE_DESC {
            pRootSignature: std::mem::ManuallyDrop::new(Some(root_sig.clone())),
            VS: D3D12_SHADER_BYTECODE {
                pShaderBytecode: vs.GetBufferPointer(),
                BytecodeLength: vs.GetBufferSize(),
            },
            PS: D3D12_SHADER_BYTECODE {
                pShaderBytecode: ps.GetBufferPointer(),
                BytecodeLength: ps.GetBufferSize(),
            },
            SampleMask: u32::MAX,
            RasterizerState: D3D12_RASTERIZER_DESC {
                FillMode: D3D12_FILL_MODE_SOLID,
                CullMode: D3D12_CULL_MODE_NONE,
                ..Default::default()
            },
            PrimitiveTopologyType: D3D12_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TYPE_TRIANGLE,
            NumRenderTargets: 1,
            SampleDesc: DXGI_SAMPLE_DESC { Count: 1, Quality: 0 },
            ..Default::default()
        };
        pso_desc.RTVFormats[0] = format;
        pso_desc.BlendState.RenderTarget[0] = D3D12_RENDER_TARGET_BLEND_DESC {
            BlendEnable: true.into(),
            SrcBlend: D3D12_BLEND_SRC_ALPHA,
            DestBlend: D3D12_BLEND_INV_SRC_ALPHA,
            BlendOp: D3D12_BLEND_OP_ADD,
            SrcBlendAlpha: D3D12_BLEND_ONE,
            DestBlendAlpha: D3D12_BLEND_INV_SRC_ALPHA,
            BlendOpAlpha: D3D12_BLEND_OP_ADD,
            RenderTargetWriteMask: D3D12_COLOR_WRITE_ENABLE_ALL.0 as u8,
            ..Default::default()
        };
        let pso_res: windows::core::Result<ID3D12PipelineState> =
            device.CreateGraphicsPipelineState(&pso_desc);
        std::mem::ManuallyDrop::drop(&mut pso_desc.pRootSignature);
        let pso = pso_res.ok()?;

        let srv_heap: ID3D12DescriptorHeap = device
            .CreateDescriptorHeap(&D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_DESC {
                Type: D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_CBV_SRV_UAV,
                NumDescriptors: 1,
                Flags: D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_FLAG_SHADER_VISIBLE,
                ..Default::default()
            })
            .ok()?;
        let rtv_heap: ID3D12DescriptorHeap = device
            .CreateDescriptorHeap(&D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_DESC {
                Type: D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_RTV,
                NumDescriptors: 1,
                Flags: D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_FLAG_NONE,
                ..Default::default()
            })
            .ok()?;

        Some(QuadPipeline {
            root_sig,
            pso,
            rtv_format: format,
            srv_heap,
            rtv_heap,
            device_ptr: windows::core::Interface::as_raw(device) as usize,
        })
    }
}

/// Alpha-blends `texture` fullscreen onto `back` (`D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET`).
#[cfg(windows)]
pub fn record_fullscreen_quad(
    device: &ID3D12Device,
    list: &ID3D12GraphicsCommandList,
    back: &ID3D12Resource,
    texture: &ID3D12Resource,
    tex_format: DXGI_FORMAT,
) -> bool {
    let dev_ptr = windows::core::Interface::as_raw(device) as usize;
    let back_desc = unsafe { back.GetDesc() };
    let mut guard = PIPELINE.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    let need_rebuild = guard
        .as_ref()
        .is_none_or(|p| p.device_ptr != dev_ptr || p.rtv_format != back_desc.Format);
    if need_rebuild {
        *guard = create_pipeline(device, back_desc.Format);
    }
    let Some(pipe) = guard.as_ref() else {
        return false;
    };

    unsafe {
        let srv_desc = D3D12_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC {
            Format: tex_format,
            ViewDimension: D3D12_SRV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D,
            Shader4ComponentMapping: D3D12_DEFAULT_SHADER_4_COMPONENT_MAPPING,
            Anonymous: D3D12_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC_0 {
                Texture2D: D3D12_TEX2D_SRV {
                    MipLevels: 1,
                    ..Default::default()
                },
            },
        };
        device.CreateShaderResourceView(
            texture,
            Some(&srv_desc),
            pipe.srv_heap.GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(),
        );
        let rtv_cpu = pipe.rtv_heap.GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart();
        device.CreateRenderTargetView(back, None, rtv_cpu);

        let vp = D3D12_VIEWPORT {
            TopLeftX: 0.0,
            TopLeftY: 0.0,
            Width: back_desc.Width as f32,
            Height: back_desc.Height as f32,
            MinDepth: 0.0,
            MaxDepth: 1.0,
        };
        let sc = windows::Win32::Foundation::RECT {
            left: 0,
            top: 0,
            right: back_desc.Width as i32,
            bottom: back_desc.Height as i32,
        };
        list.OMSetRenderTargets(1, Some(&rtv_cpu), false, None);
        list.RSSetViewports(&[vp]);
        list.RSSetScissorRects(&[sc]);
        list.SetGraphicsRootSignature(&pipe.root_sig);
        list.SetPipelineState(&pipe.pso);
        let heaps = [Some(pipe.srv_heap.clone())];
        list.SetDescriptorHeaps(&heaps);
        list.SetGraphicsRootDescriptorTable(0, pipe.srv_heap.GetGPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart());
        list.IASetPrimitiveTopology(D3D_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLELIST);
        list.DrawInstanced(3, 1, 0, 0);
    }
    true
}

```

`src/gpu.rs`:

```rs
//! D3D12 swapchain overlay uploader for Menyoo DX12 — Universal DirectX 12 Overlay,
//! plus a standalone interactive Win32 preview window (`menyoo-preview`).

use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::sync::Mutex;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering};

use windows::Win32::Graphics::Direct3D12::*;
use windows::Win32::Graphics::Dxgi::Common::{
    DXGI_FORMAT, DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM, DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM_SRGB,
    DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM, DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM_SRGB, DXGI_FORMAT_R10G10B10A2_UNORM,
    DXGI_SAMPLE_DESC,
};

use super::menu::BRIDGE;
use super::render::{CANVAS_H, CANVAS_W};

struct InflightSnap {
    buffer: ID3D12Resource,
    footprint: D3D12_PLACED_SUBRESOURCE_FOOTPRINT,
    path: PathBuf,
    ready_at_frame: u64,
    crop_preview: bool,
}

// SAFETY: accessed solely under `SNAP_STATE` mutex on the present path.
unsafe impl Send for InflightSnap {}

struct SnapState {
    requested: Option<(PathBuf, bool)>,
    inflight: Option<InflightSnap>,
}

static SNAP_ACTIVE: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);
static PREVIEW_CACHE_STALE: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);
static SNAP_STATE: Mutex<SnapState> = Mutex::new(SnapState {
    requested: None,
    inflight: None,
});

/// Queues a one-shot GPU readback of the fully composited swapchain backbuffer
/// (3D title + Post-FX + Menyoo overlay) saved to `path` as a full-resolution PNG.
pub fn request_composited_png(path: PathBuf) {
    let mut g = SNAP_STATE.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    g.requested = Some((path, false));
    SNAP_ACTIVE.store(true, Ordering::Release);
}

/// Queues a one-shot cropped `320x180` live in-game preview PNG snapshot saved into
/// `menyooStuff/Previews/.../*.png`, then invalidates `PreviewCache` immediately!
pub(crate) fn request_preview_snap(path: PathBuf) {
    let mut g = SNAP_STATE.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    g.requested = Some((path, true));
    SNAP_ACTIVE.store(true, Ordering::Release);
}

pub(crate) fn take_preview_cache_stale() -> bool {
    PREVIEW_CACHE_STALE.swap(false, Ordering::AcqRel)
}

pub fn composited_png_pending() -> bool {
    SNAP_ACTIVE.load(Ordering::Acquire)
}

fn png_chunk(png: &mut Vec<u8>, kind: &[u8; 4], data: &[u8]) {
    png.extend((data.len() as u32).to_be_bytes());
    let start = png.len();
    png.extend(kind);
    png.extend(data);
    let mut crc = !0u32;
    for &b in &png[start..] {
        crc ^= u32::from(b);
        for _ in 0..8 {
            crc = (crc >> 1) ^ (0xedb8_8320 & (crc & 1).wrapping_neg());
        }
    }
    png.extend((!crc).to_be_bytes());
}

fn save_inflight_png(snap: &InflightSnap) {
    let fp = snap.footprint.Footprint;
    let (w, h, pitch) = (fp.Width as usize, fp.Height as usize, fp.RowPitch as usize);
    let mut data = std::ptr::null_mut();
    // SAFETY: `ready_at_frame` waited >=4 presents so the GPU copy is retired.
    unsafe {
        if snap.buffer.Map(0, None, Some(&mut data)).is_err() {
            tracing::warn!(path = %snap.path.display(), "Menyoo composited PNG Map failed");
            return;
        }
        let rows = std::slice::from_raw_parts(data.cast::<u8>(), pitch * h);
        if snap.crop_preview {
            // Crop clean 16:9 center-right 3D viewport (clear of left menu panel) -> 320x180 RGBA PNG!
            let dst_w = super::previews::PREVIEW_W;
            let dst_h = super::previews::PREVIEW_H;
            let crop_w = ((w * 66) / 100).max(16).min(w);
            let crop_h = ((crop_w * dst_h) / dst_w).max(16).min(h);
            let crop_w = ((crop_h * dst_w) / dst_h).max(16).min(w);
            let x0 = ((w * 30) / 100).min(w.saturating_sub(crop_w));
            let y0 = (h.saturating_sub(crop_h)) / 2;
            let mut rgba = vec![0u8; dst_w * dst_h * 4];
            let read_rgb = |sx: usize, sy: usize| -> Option<[u8; 3]> {
                let row = &rows[sy * pitch..];
                match fp.Format {
                    DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM | DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM_SRGB => {
                        let p = &row[sx * 4..sx * 4 + 3];
                        Some([p[2], p[1], p[0]])
                    }
                    DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM | DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM_SRGB => {
                        let p = &row[sx * 4..sx * 4 + 3];
                        Some([p[0], p[1], p[2]])
                    }
                    DXGI_FORMAT_R10G10B10A2_UNORM => {
                        let px = u32::from_le_bytes([
                            row[sx * 4],
                            row[sx * 4 + 1],
                            row[sx * 4 + 2],
                            row[sx * 4 + 3],
                        ]);
                        Some([
                            (((px & 0x3FF) * 255 + 511) / 1023) as u8,
                            ((((px >> 10) & 0x3FF) * 255 + 511) / 1023) as u8,
                            ((((px >> 20) & 0x3FF) * 255 + 511) / 1023) as u8,
                        ])
                    }
                    _ => None,
                }
            };
            let mut ok = true;
            for dy in 0..dst_h {
                let sy = y0 + (dy * crop_h) / dst_h;
                let sy2 = (sy + 1).min(h - 1);
                for dx in 0..dst_w {
                    let sx = x0 + (dx * crop_w) / dst_w;
                    let sx2 = (sx + 1).min(w - 1);
                    let (Some(a), Some(b), Some(c), Some(d)) = (
                        read_rgb(sx, sy),
                        read_rgb(sx2, sy),
                        read_rgb(sx, sy2),
                        read_rgb(sx2, sy2),
                    ) else {
                        ok = false;
                        break;
                    };
                    let idx = (dy * dst_w + dx) * 4;
                    rgba[idx] = ((u16::from(a[0]) + u16::from(b[0]) + u16::from(c[0]) + u16::from(d[0])) >> 2) as u8;
                    rgba[idx + 1] = ((u16::from(a[1]) + u16::from(b[1]) + u16::from(c[1]) + u16::from(d[1])) >> 2) as u8;
                    rgba[idx + 2] = ((u16::from(a[2]) + u16::from(b[2]) + u16::from(c[2]) + u16::from(d[2])) >> 2) as u8;
                    rgba[idx + 3] = 255;
                }
                if !ok {
                    break;
                }
            }
            snap.buffer.Unmap(0, None);
            if ok {
                if let Err(e) = super::previews::write_rgba_png(
                    &snap.path,
                    dst_w as u32,
                    dst_h as u32,
                    &rgba,
                ) {
                    tracing::warn!(error = %e, path = %snap.path.display(), "Menyoo live preview PNG write failed");
                } else {
                    PREVIEW_CACHE_STALE.store(true, Ordering::Release);
                }
            }
            return;
        }
        let mut raw = Vec::with_capacity((w * 3 + 1) * h);
        for y in 0..h {
            raw.push(0); // PNG filter byte: None
            let row = &rows[y * pitch..];
            match fp.Format {
                DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM | DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM_SRGB => {
                    for x in 0..w {
                        let p = &row[x * 4..x * 4 + 3];
                        raw.extend_from_slice(&[p[2], p[1], p[0]]);
                    }
                }
                DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM | DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM_SRGB => {
                    for x in 0..w {
                        raw.extend_from_slice(&row[x * 4..x * 4 + 3]);
                    }
                }
                DXGI_FORMAT_R10G10B10A2_UNORM => {
                    for x in 0..w {
                        let px = u32::from_le_bytes([
                            row[x * 4],
                            row[x * 4 + 1],
                            row[x * 4 + 2],
                            row[x * 4 + 3],
                        ]);
                        let r = (((px & 0x3FF) * 255 + 511) / 1023) as u8;
                        let g = ((((px >> 10) & 0x3FF) * 255 + 511) / 1023) as u8;
                        let b = ((((px >> 20) & 0x3FF) * 255 + 511) / 1023) as u8;
                        raw.extend_from_slice(&[r, g, b]);
                    }
                }
                other => {
                    tracing::warn!(format = other.0, "Menyoo composited PNG unsupported format");
                    snap.buffer.Unmap(0, None);
                    return;
                }
            }
        }
        snap.buffer.Unmap(0, None);

        let mut png = b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n".to_vec();
        let mut hdr = Vec::with_capacity(13);
        hdr.extend((w as u32).to_be_bytes());
        hdr.extend((h as u32).to_be_bytes());
        hdr.extend([8, 2, 0, 0, 0]);
        png_chunk(&mut png, b"IHDR", &hdr);
        let mut comp = vec![0u8; zlib_rs::compress_bound(raw.len())];
        let (idat, _rc) = zlib_rs::compress_slice(&mut comp, &raw, zlib_rs::DeflateConfig::new(1));
        png_chunk(&mut png, b"IDAT", idat);
        png_chunk(&mut png, b"IEND", &[]);
        if let Some(parent) = snap.path.parent() {
            let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(parent);
        }
        if let Err(e) = std::fs::write(&snap.path, png) {
            tracing::warn!(error = %e, path = %snap.path.display(), "Menyoo composited PNG write failed");
        }
    }
}

fn step_composited_snapshot(
    device: &ID3D12Device,
    list: &ID3D12GraphicsCommandList,
    back: &ID3D12Resource,
) {
    if !SNAP_ACTIVE.load(Ordering::Acquire) {
        return;
    }
    let cur_frame = BRIDGE.frame_count.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
    let mut g = SNAP_STATE.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());

    // 1. Finish any retired readback (4+ frames later -> GPU copy guaranteed complete).
    if g.inflight
        .as_ref()
        .is_some_and(|s| cur_frame >= s.ready_at_frame)
    {
        if let Some(done) = g.inflight.take() {
            save_inflight_png(&done);
        }
    }

    // 2. Kick off a newly requested backbuffer readback while `back` is in RENDER_TARGET state!
    if g.inflight.is_none()
        && let Some((path, crop_preview)) = g.requested.take()
    {
        let mut footprint = D3D12_PLACED_SUBRESOURCE_FOOTPRINT::default();
        let mut total = 0u64;
        // SAFETY: `back` is a live swapchain backbuffer in `RENDER_TARGET` state.
        unsafe {
            let desc = back.GetDesc();
            device.GetCopyableFootprints(
                &desc,
                0,
                1,
                0,
                Some(&mut footprint),
                None,
                None,
                Some(&mut total),
            );
            let heap = D3D12_HEAP_PROPERTIES {
                Type: D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_READBACK,
                ..Default::default()
            };
            let rb_desc = D3D12_RESOURCE_DESC {
                Dimension: D3D12_RESOURCE_DIMENSION_BUFFER,
                Width: total,
                Height: 1,
                DepthOrArraySize: 1,
                MipLevels: 1,
                SampleDesc: DXGI_SAMPLE_DESC { Count: 1, Quality: 0 },
                Layout: D3D12_TEXTURE_LAYOUT_ROW_MAJOR,
                ..Default::default()
            };
            let mut rb: Option<ID3D12Resource> = None;
            if device
                .CreateCommittedResource(
                    &heap,
                    D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE,
                    &rb_desc,
                    D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST,
                    None,
                    &mut rb,
                )
                .is_ok()
                && let Some(buffer) = rb
            {
                let mut to_src = barrier(
                    back,
                    D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET,
                    D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_SOURCE,
                );
                list.ResourceBarrier(std::slice::from_ref(&to_src));
                std::mem::ManuallyDrop::drop(&mut (*to_src.Anonymous.Transition).pResource);

                let mut dst = D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_LOCATION {
                    pResource: std::mem::ManuallyDrop::new(Some(buffer.clone())),
                    Type: D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_TYPE_PLACED_FOOTPRINT,
                    Anonymous: D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_LOCATION_0 {
                        PlacedFootprint: footprint,
                    },
                };
                let mut src = D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_LOCATION {
                    pResource: std::mem::ManuallyDrop::new(Some(back.clone())),
                    Type: D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_TYPE_SUBRESOURCE_INDEX,
                    Anonymous: D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_LOCATION_0 { SubresourceIndex: 0 },
                };
                list.CopyTextureRegion(&dst, 0, 0, 0, &src, None);
                std::mem::ManuallyDrop::drop(&mut dst.pResource);
                std::mem::ManuallyDrop::drop(&mut src.pResource);

                let mut to_rt = barrier(
                    back,
                    D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_SOURCE,
                    D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET,
                );
                list.ResourceBarrier(std::slice::from_ref(&to_rt));
                std::mem::ManuallyDrop::drop(&mut (*to_rt.Anonymous.Transition).pResource);

                g.inflight = Some(InflightSnap {
                    buffer,
                    footprint,
                    path,
                    ready_at_frame: cur_frame.saturating_add(4),
                    crop_preview,
                });
            }
        }
    }

    if g.requested.is_none() && g.inflight.is_none() {
        SNAP_ACTIVE.store(false, Ordering::Release);
    }
}

#[allow(dead_code)]
fn _keep_path_import(_: &Path) {}

struct GpuSurface {
    texture: ID3D12Resource,
    upload: ID3D12Resource,
    mapped: *mut u8,
    row_pitch: u32,
}

// SAFETY: D3D12 resources and persistently mapped upload buffer are accessed only
// under `SURFACE`'s mutex on the present path.
unsafe impl Send for GpuSurface {}

static SURFACE: Mutex<Option<GpuSurface>> = Mutex::new(None);

impl GpuSurface {
    fn create(device: &ID3D12Device) -> windows::core::Result<Self> {
        let row_pitch = ((CANVAS_W as u32 * 4).div_ceil(D3D12_TEXTURE_DATA_PITCH_ALIGNMENT))
            * D3D12_TEXTURE_DATA_PITCH_ALIGNMENT;
        let upload_bytes = u64::from(row_pitch) * CANVAS_H as u64;

        let default_heap = D3D12_HEAP_PROPERTIES {
            Type: D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT,
            ..Default::default()
        };
        let upload_heap = D3D12_HEAP_PROPERTIES {
            Type: D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD,
            ..Default::default()
        };
        let tex_desc = D3D12_RESOURCE_DESC {
            Dimension: D3D12_RESOURCE_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D,
            Width: CANVAS_W as u64,
            Height: CANVAS_H as u32,
            DepthOrArraySize: 1,
            MipLevels: 1,
            Format: DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM,
            SampleDesc: DXGI_SAMPLE_DESC {
                Count: 1,
                Quality: 0,
            },
            Layout: D3D12_TEXTURE_LAYOUT_UNKNOWN,
            Flags: D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_NONE,
            ..Default::default()
        };
        let buf_desc = D3D12_RESOURCE_DESC {
            Dimension: D3D12_RESOURCE_DIMENSION_BUFFER,
            Width: upload_bytes,
            Height: 1,
            DepthOrArraySize: 1,
            MipLevels: 1,
            Format: windows::Win32::Graphics::Dxgi::Common::DXGI_FORMAT_UNKNOWN,
            SampleDesc: DXGI_SAMPLE_DESC {
                Count: 1,
                Quality: 0,
            },
            Layout: D3D12_TEXTURE_LAYOUT_ROW_MAJOR,
            Flags: D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_NONE,
            ..Default::default()
        };

        let mut texture: Option<ID3D12Resource> = None;
        let mut upload: Option<ID3D12Resource> = None;
        let mut mapped: *mut std::ffi::c_void = std::ptr::null_mut();

        // SAFETY: valid D3D12 committed resource creations and persistent upload Map.
        unsafe {
            device.CreateCommittedResource(
                &default_heap,
                D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE,
                &tex_desc,
                D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE,
                None,
                &mut texture,
            )?;
            device.CreateCommittedResource(
                &upload_heap,
                D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE,
                &buf_desc,
                D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ,
                None,
                &mut upload,
            )?;
            let upload = upload.ok_or_else(windows::core::Error::empty)?;
            let range = D3D12_RANGE { Begin: 0, End: 0 };
            upload.Map(0, Some(&range), Some(&mut mapped))?;
            Ok(Self {
                texture: texture.ok_or_else(windows::core::Error::empty)?,
                upload,
                mapped: mapped.cast::<u8>(),
                row_pitch,
            })
        }
    }
}

fn barrier(
    resource: &ID3D12Resource,
    before: D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES,
    after: D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES,
) -> D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER {
    D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER {
        Type: D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER_TYPE_TRANSITION,
        Flags: D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER_FLAG_NONE,
        Anonymous: D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER_0 {
            Transition: std::mem::ManuallyDrop::new(D3D12_RESOURCE_TRANSITION_BARRIER {
                pResource: std::mem::ManuallyDrop::new(Some(resource.clone())),
                Subresource: D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER_ALL_SUBRESOURCES,
                StateBefore: before,
                StateAfter: after,
            }),
        },
    }
}

/// Uploads the Menyoo overlay texture (only when `dirty_pixels` is `Some`) and
/// alpha-blends it over `back` (which MUST already be in `RENDER_TARGET` state)
/// using `crate::d3d12_quad::record_fullscreen_quad`.
pub(crate) fn record_overlay(
    device: &ID3D12Device,
    list: &ID3D12GraphicsCommandList,
    back: &ID3D12Resource,
    format: DXGI_FORMAT,
    size: (u32, u32),
    dirty_pixels: Option<&[u32]>,
) -> bool {
    let mut guard = SURFACE.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    if guard.is_none() {
        *guard = match GpuSurface::create(device) {
            Ok(s) => Some(s),
            Err(e) => {
                static ONCE: std::sync::Once = std::sync::Once::new();
                ONCE.call_once(|| {
                    tracing::warn!(error = %e, "Menyoo GPU overlay surface creation failed");
                });
                return false;
            }
        };
    }
    let Some(s) = guard.as_mut() else {
        return false;
    };

    if let Some(pixels) = dirty_pixels {
        let src_row_bytes = CANVAS_W * 4;
        let dst_pitch = s.row_pitch as usize;
        // SAFETY: persistently mapped upload buffer sized for `row_pitch * CANVAS_H`.
        unsafe {
            let src_bytes = std::slice::from_raw_parts(pixels.as_ptr().cast::<u8>(), pixels.len() * 4);
            for y in 0..CANVAS_H {
                std::ptr::copy_nonoverlapping(
                    src_bytes.as_ptr().add(y * src_row_bytes),
                    s.mapped.add(y * dst_pitch),
                    src_row_bytes,
                );
            }

            let mut to_copy = barrier(
                &s.texture,
                D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE,
                D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST,
            );
            list.ResourceBarrier(std::slice::from_ref(&to_copy));
            std::mem::ManuallyDrop::drop(&mut (*to_copy.Anonymous.Transition).pResource);

            let dst = D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_LOCATION {
                pResource: std::mem::ManuallyDrop::new(Some(s.texture.clone())),
                Type: D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_TYPE_SUBRESOURCE_INDEX,
                Anonymous: D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_LOCATION_0 { SubresourceIndex: 0 },
            };
            let src = D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_LOCATION {
                pResource: std::mem::ManuallyDrop::new(Some(s.upload.clone())),
                Type: D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_TYPE_PLACED_FOOTPRINT,
                Anonymous: D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_LOCATION_0 {
                    PlacedFootprint: D3D12_PLACED_SUBRESOURCE_FOOTPRINT {
                        Offset: 0,
                        Footprint: D3D12_SUBRESOURCE_FOOTPRINT {
                            Format: DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM,
                            Width: CANVAS_W as u32,
                            Height: CANVAS_H as u32,
                            Depth: 1,
                            RowPitch: s.row_pitch,
                        },
                    },
                },
            };
            list.CopyTextureRegion(&dst, 0, 0, 0, &src, None);
            let mut dst = dst;
            let mut src = src;
            std::mem::ManuallyDrop::drop(&mut dst.pResource);
            std::mem::ManuallyDrop::drop(&mut src.pResource);

            let mut to_srv = barrier(
                &s.texture,
                D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST,
                D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE,
            );
            list.ResourceBarrier(std::slice::from_ref(&to_srv));
            std::mem::ManuallyDrop::drop(&mut (*to_srv.Anonymous.Transition).pResource);
        }
    }

    let _ = (format, size);
    let drawn = crate::d3d12_quad::record_fullscreen_quad(
        device,
        list,
        back,
        &s.texture,
        DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM,
    );
    step_composited_snapshot(device, list, back);
    drawn
}

/// Interactive standalone preview window (`menyoo-preview`) to test
/// Menyoo DX12 — Universal DirectX 12 Overlay UI, sounds, themes & controls in 1 second!
pub fn run_interactive_preview() {
    use windows::Win32::Foundation::{HWND, LPARAM, LRESULT, RECT, WPARAM};
    use windows::Win32::Graphics::Gdi::{
        BI_RGB, BITMAPINFO, BITMAPINFOHEADER, BeginPaint, DIB_RGB_COLORS, EndPaint,
        PAINTSTRUCT, SRCCOPY, StretchDIBits,
    };
    use windows::Win32::System::LibraryLoader::GetModuleHandleW;
    use windows::Win32::UI::WindowsAndMessaging::{
        CreateWindowExW, DefWindowProcW, DispatchMessageW, GetClientRect, PeekMessageW,
        PostQuitMessage, RegisterClassW, ShowWindow, TranslateMessage, CW_USEDEFAULT, MSG,
        PM_REMOVE, SW_SHOW, WM_DESTROY, WM_MOUSEWHEEL, WM_PAINT, WNDCLASSW, WS_EX_APPWINDOW,
        WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW,
    };
    use windows::core::PCWSTR;

    static PREVIEW_BUF: Mutex<Vec<u32>> = Mutex::new(Vec::new());

    unsafe extern "system" fn proc(
        hwnd: HWND,
        msg: u32,
        wparam: WPARAM,
        lparam: LPARAM,
    ) -> LRESULT {
        if msg == WM_DESTROY {
            unsafe { PostQuitMessage(0) };
            return LRESULT(0);
        }
        if msg == WM_MOUSEWHEEL {
            let delta = ((wparam.0 >> 16) as u16) as i16;
            super::push_mouse_wheel(i32::from(delta));
            return LRESULT(0);
        }
        if msg == WM_PAINT {
            let mut ps = PAINTSTRUCT::default();
            let hdc = unsafe { BeginPaint(hwnd, &mut ps) };
            if !hdc.is_invalid() {
                let mut rc = RECT::default();
                let _ = unsafe { GetClientRect(hwnd, &mut rc) };
                let buf = PREVIEW_BUF.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
                if buf.len() == CANVAS_W * CANVAS_H {
                    let bmi = BITMAPINFO {
                        bmiHeader: BITMAPINFOHEADER {
                            biSize: size_of::<BITMAPINFOHEADER>() as u32,
                            biWidth: CANVAS_W as i32,
                            biHeight: -(CANVAS_H as i32),
                            biPlanes: 1,
                            biBitCount: 32,
                            biCompression: BI_RGB.0,
                            ..Default::default()
                        },
                        ..Default::default()
                    };
                    unsafe {
                        StretchDIBits(
                            hdc,
                            0,
                            0,
                            rc.right - rc.left,
                            rc.bottom - rc.top,
                            0,
                            0,
                            CANVAS_W as i32,
                            CANVAS_H as i32,
                            Some(buf.as_ptr().cast()),
                            &bmi,
                            DIB_RGB_COLORS,
                            SRCCOPY,
                        );
                    }
                }
                let _ = unsafe { EndPaint(hwnd, &ps) };
            }
            return LRESULT(0);
        }
        unsafe { DefWindowProcW(hwnd, msg, wparam, lparam) }
    }

    super::force_enable_for_preview();
    let class: Vec<u16> = "MenyooDX12Preview\0".encode_utf16().collect();
    let title: Vec<u16> =
        "Menyoo DX12 — Universal DirectX 12 Overlay [Live UI & Sound Preview | F7 = Toggle | Arrows/Enter/Bksp]\0"
            .encode_utf16()
            .collect();

    let hwnd = unsafe {
        let hinst = GetModuleHandleW(PCWSTR::null()).unwrap_or_default();
        let wc = WNDCLASSW {
            lpfnWndProc: Some(proc),
            hInstance: hinst.into(),
            lpszClassName: PCWSTR(class.as_ptr()),
            ..Default::default()
        };
        RegisterClassW(&wc);
        let Ok(hwnd) = CreateWindowExW(
            WS_EX_APPWINDOW,
            PCWSTR(class.as_ptr()),
            PCWSTR(title.as_ptr()),
            WS_OVERLAPPEDWINDOW,
            CW_USEDEFAULT,
            CW_USEDEFAULT,
            1280,
            720,
            None,
            None,
            Some(hinst.into()),
            None,
        ) else {
            return;
        };
        let _ = ShowWindow(hwnd, SW_SHOW);
        hwnd
    };

    let mut msg = MSG::default();
    let mut running = true;
    while running {
        unsafe {
            while PeekMessageW(&mut msg, None, 0, 0, PM_REMOVE).as_bool() {
                if msg.message == windows::Win32::UI::WindowsAndMessaging::WM_QUIT {
                    running = false;
                }
                let _ = TranslateMessage(&msg);
                DispatchMessageW(&msg);
            }
        }
        if let Some(comp) = super::render_preview_frame() {
            *PREVIEW_BUF.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()) = comp;
            unsafe {
                let _ = windows::Win32::Graphics::Gdi::InvalidateRect(Some(hwnd), None, false);
            }
        }
        std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(16));
    }
}

```

`src/hook.rs`:

//! Cleanroom, self-validating 5-byte `CALL rel32` main-thread tick dispatcher for Menyoo PC.
//!
//! Why a call-site hook instead of a 14-byte prologue detour?
//! - ZERO stolen instructions & ZERO RIP-relative instruction relocation bugs!
//! - Verifies the exact `0xE8` opcode + original `rel32` target before patching.
//! - Allocates a tiny 33-byte Win64-aligned executable stub within ±1.8 GB of the call site:
//!     `sub rsp, 0x28; mov rax, orig; call rax; mov rax, rust_tick; call rax; add rsp, 0x28; ret`
//! - Drains Menyoo's thread-safe command queue directly on the title's own main simulation
//!   thread (with valid engine TLS), handles async model-streaming vehicle spawn retries,
//!   and runs all active trainer loops with ~10 ns idle overhead.

    SpoonerSetSelectedAlpha(u8),
    SpoonerSetSelectedScale(f32),
    SpoonerToggleSelectedCollision,
    SpoonerDropPortal(u8),
    SpoonerStartPedTaskSequence(u8),
    /// Opt-in photo-booth staging helper: poses last spawned vehicle/ped/prop or player in front of live 3D camera.
    PhotoBoothStage { kind: u8, dist: f32, z_off: f32, yaw_deg: f32, freeze: bool },
    /// Refreshes read-only live component pointers & inventory/weapon diagnostics for probe audit.
    ProbeRefreshDiag { check_weapon_hash: u32 },
}

/// Live Object Spooner HUD telemetry read by `render.rs` without stalling gameplay.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default)]
pub struct SpoonerHudInfo {
    pub total_count: usize,
    pub selected_idx: usize,
    pub selected_ptr: u64,
    pub selected_hash64: u64,
    pub selected_pos: [f32; 3],
    pub frozen: bool,
    pub invincible: bool,
    pub attached: bool,
    pub pending_spawn: bool,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
struct SpoonerEntity {
    kind: u8, // 0=Prop, 1=Vehicle, 2=Ped
    ptr: u64,
    hash64: u64,
    frozen: bool,
    invincible: bool,
    attached: bool,
    attach_target: u32,
    attach_bone: u8,
    attach_offset: [f32; 3],
    attach_rot: [f32; 3],
    alpha: u8,
    scale: f32,
    collision: bool,
}

#[derive(Default)]
struct SpoonerState {
    entities: Vec<SpoonerEntity>,
    selected: usize,
    hud: SpoonerHudInfo,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
struct PendingPropSpawn {
    hash64: u64,
    token: u32,
    dynamic: bool,
    invincible: bool,
    retries_left: u32,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
struct PendingPropLocate {
    hash64: u64,
    spawn_pos: [f32; 3],
    dynamic: bool,
    invincible: bool,
    retries_left: u32,
}

struct ActiveHook {
    callsite: usize,
    orig_rel32: i32,
    stub_mem: *mut u8,
    base: u64,
    rvas: RvaTable,
}

// SAFETY: `stub_mem` is process-wide executable memory managed solely under `HOOK_STATE`.
unsafe impl Send for ActiveHook {}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
struct PendingSpawn {
    hash64: u64,
    token: u32,
    prev_handle: u32,
    keep_prev: bool,
    warp_inside: bool,
    retries_left: u32,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
struct PendingVehDrop {
    prev_handle: u32,
    keep_prev: bool,
    warp_inside: bool,
    ticks_left: u32,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
struct PendingPedSpawn {
    hash64: u64,
    token: u32,
    role: u8,
    weapon_hash32: u32,
    invincible: bool,
    add_to_spooner: bool,
    offset_override: Option<[f32; 3]>,
    escort_seat: Option<(u64, i32)>,
    retries_left: u32,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
struct QueuedPedSpawn {
    hash64: u64,
    role: u8,
    weapon_hash32: u32,
    invincible: bool,
    add_to_spooner: bool,
    offset_override: Option<[f32; 3]>,
    escort_seat: Option<(u64, i32)>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
struct PendingEscortConvoy {
    prev_veh_ptr: u64,
    ped_hash64: u64,
    weapon_hash32: u32,
    ticks_left: u32,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
struct PendingWeaponEquip {
    hashes: [u32; 8],
    count: usize,
    ticks_left: u32,
}

struct TextResolveRequest {
    hashes: Vec<u32>,
    reply: mpsc::SyncSender<HashMap<u32, String>>,
}

pub fn live_diag_snapshot() -> LiveDiagSnapshot {
    LiveDiagSnapshot {
        damage_comp: DIAG_DAMAGE_COMP.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
        config_flags_comp: DIAG_CONFIG_FLAGS_COMP.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
        net_player: DIAG_NET_PLAYER.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
        wanted_comp: DIAG_WANTED_COMP.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
        player_info: DIAG_PLAYER_INFO.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
        ragdoll_comp: DIAG_RAGDOLL_COMP.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
        inv_ptr: DIAG_INV_PTR.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
        inv_item_count: DIAG_INV_ITEM_COUNT.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
        has_wep_hits: DIAG_HAS_WEP_HITS.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
        wep_mgr: DIAG_WEP_MGR.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
        cur_wep: DIAG_CUR_WEP.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
        cur_clip: DIAG_CUR_CLIP.load(Ordering::Relaxed) as i32,
        max_clip: DIAG_MAX_CLIP.load(Ordering::Relaxed) as i32,
        ammo_comp: DIAG_AMMO_COMP.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
        last_give_tx: DIAG_LAST_GIVE_TX.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
        last_prop_req: DIAG_LAST_PROP_REQ.load(Ordering::Relaxed) as i32,
        last_prop_model_id: DIAG_LAST_PROP_MODEL_ID.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
        last_prop_loaded: DIAG_LAST_PROP_LOADED.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
        last_veh_loaded: DIAG_LAST_VEH_LOADED.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
        last_veh_model_id: DIAG_LAST_VEH_MODEL_ID.load(Ordering::Relaxed),

/// Opt-in auto-install flag: `MENYOO_DX12_LIVE_HOOKS=1` (also installable live from Menyoo UI).
pub fn auto_install_env() -> bool {
    std::env::var("MENYOO_DX12_LIVE_HOOKS")
        .ok()
        .is_some_and(|v| {
            let t = v.trim();
            t == "1" || t.eq_ignore_ascii_case("true") || t.eq_ignore_ascii_case("yes")
        })
}

/// Read-only snapshot of all entities tracked in the Object Spooner Database:
/// `(idx, kind /* 0=Prop,1=Veh,2=Ped */, ptr, hash64, frozen, invincible, attached)`.
pub fn spooner_database_snapshot() -> Vec<(usize, u8, u64, u64, bool, bool, bool)> {
    SPOONER_STATE
        .try_lock()
        .map(|s| {
            s.entities
                .iter()
                .enumerate()
                .map(|(i, e)| (i, e.kind, e.ptr, e.hash64, e.frozen, e.invincible, e.attached))
                .collect()
        })
        .unwrap_or_default()
}

/// Captures all currently tracked Spooner entities into a saveable `SavedSpoonerScene`.
pub fn export_spooner_scene(name: &str, rvas: &RvaTable) -> trainer::SavedSpoonerScene {
    let mut entities = Vec::new();
    if let Ok(s) = SPOONER_STATE.lock() {
        for e in &s.entities {
            if let Some((right, forward, up, pos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(e.ptr, rvas)
            {
                let h = if e.hash64 != 0 {
                    e.hash64
                } else if let Some(mi) = trainer::safe_read::<u64>((e.ptr + 0x20) as usize)
                    && mi > 0x10000
                {
                    trainer::safe_read::<u64>((mi + 0x60) as usize).unwrap_or(0)
                } else {
                    0
                };
                if h != 0 {
                    entities.push(trainer::SavedSpoonerEntity {
                        kind: e.kind,
                        hash64: h,
                        pos,
                        right,
                        forward,
                        up,
                        frozen: e.frozen,
                        invincible: e.invincible,
                        attach_target: if e.attached { e.attach_target } else { 0 },
                        attach_bone: e.attach_bone,
                        attach_offset: e.attach_offset,
                        attach_rot: e.attach_rot,
                        alpha: e.alpha,
                        scale: e.scale,
                        collision: e.collision,
                    });
                }
            }
        }
    }
    trainer::SavedSpoonerScene {
        name: name.to_owned(),
        entities,
    }
}
