/// Queues a batch of `(weapon_hash32, award_hash32, ammo_award_hash32)` triples to be granted smoothly (4 per main-thread tick).
pub fn enqueue_give_weapon_list(items: &[(u32, u32, u32)]) -> bool {
    if !is_installed() || items.is_empty() {
        return false;
    }
    let mut q = WEAPON_GIVE_QUEUE.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    for &(h, aw, ammo_aw) in items.iter().take(160) {
        if h != 0 && q.len() < 200 {
            q.push_back((h, aw, ammo_aw));
        }
    }
    if !q.is_empty() {
        HAS_WEAPON_QUEUE.store(true, Ordering::Release);
    }
    true
}

/// Refreshes the cached `RvaTable` inside the active hook (e.g. after `Ctrl+F7` hot-reload).
pub fn refresh_rvas(rvas: &RvaTable) {
    if let Ok(mut g) = HOOK_STATE.lock()
        && let Some(h) = g.as_mut()
    {
        h.rvas = rvas.clone();
    }
}

/// Pushes a command to execute on the very next main-thread game tick.
/// Returns `true` if the hook is installed (will execute immediately on next frame).
pub fn enqueue(cmd: MainThreadCmd) -> bool {
    if !is_installed() {
        return false;
    }
    let mut q = CMD_QUEUE.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    if q.len() < 64 {
        q.push_back(cmd);
    }
    true
}

/// Safely resolves a batch of 32-bit localization text hashes on the title's main simulation
/// thread via `theText::GetByHash(hash, 0)` (zero TLS risk, capped at 4096 hashes/call).
pub fn resolve_text_hashes_blocking(hashes: &[u32]) -> HashMap<u32, String> {
    if !is_installed() || hashes.is_empty() {
        return HashMap::new();
    }
    let mut dedup: Vec<u32> = Vec::with_capacity(hashes.len().min(4096));
    let mut seen = std::collections::HashSet::<u32>::with_capacity(hashes.len().min(4096));
    for &h in hashes {
        if h != 0 && seen.insert(h) {
            dedup.push(h);
            if dedup.len() >= 4096 {
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    if dedup.is_empty() {
        return HashMap::new();
    }
    let (tx, rx) = mpsc::sync_channel::<HashMap<u32, String>>(1);
    if let Ok(mut slot) = TEXT_RESOLVE_REQ.lock() {
        *slot = Some(TextResolveRequest {
            hashes: dedup,
            reply: tx,
        });
        HAS_TEXT_RESOLVE.store(true, Ordering::Release);
    } else {
        return HashMap::new();
    }
    rx.recv_timeout(Duration::from_millis(1500))
        .unwrap_or_default()
}

fn process_pending_text_resolve(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let req = match TEXT_RESOLVE_REQ.try_lock() {
        Ok(mut g) => {
            HAS_TEXT_RESOLVE.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
            g.take()
        }
        Err(_) => return,
    };
    let Some(req) = req else {
        return;
    };
    let mut out = HashMap::<u32, String>::new();
    if rvas.fn_get_text_by_hash != 0 {
        // SAFETY: verified 2-arg mutex-guarded `theText::GetByHash(u32 hash, u8 allow_fallback=0) -> *const u8`
        // returning NULL on miss, executed strictly on the main simulation thread.
        let get_text: extern "system" fn(u32, u8) -> u64 =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_text_by_hash) as usize) };
        for h in req.hashes {
            let ptr = get_text(h, 0);
            if ptr > 0x10000
                && let Some(clean) = trainer::read_clean_cstr_name(ptr)
            {
                out.insert(h, clean);
            }
        }
    }
    let _ = req.reply.send(out);
}

/// Allocates a 4 KiB RWX page within signed 32-bit RIP-relative reach of `anchor`.
fn alloc_near(anchor: usize) -> Option<*mut u8> {
    const STEP: usize = 0x10_0000; // 1 MiB strides
    const MAX_DIST: usize = 0x7000_0000; // 1.75 GiB (safely within ±2 GiB)
    let aligned = anchor & !0xFFFF;
    let mut dist = STEP;
    while dist <= MAX_DIST {
        for cand in [aligned.saturating_sub(dist), aligned.saturating_add(dist)] {
            if cand < 0x10000 {
                continue;
            }
            // SAFETY: requesting a new uncommitted executable page at hint `cand`.
            let ptr = unsafe {
                VirtualAlloc(
                    cand as *const _,
                    4096,
                    MEM_COMMIT | MEM_RESERVE,
                    PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE,
                )
            };
            if !ptr.is_null() {
                let p = ptr as usize;
                let rel = (p as isize) - ((anchor + 5) as isize);
                if i32::try_from(rel).is_ok() {
                    return Some(ptr.cast::<u8>());
                }
                // Too far after OS rounding; release and keep probing.
                unsafe {
                    let _ = VirtualFree(ptr, 0, MEM_RELEASE);
                }
            }
        }
        dist += STEP;
    }
    None
}

/// Writes the 33-byte Win64-aligned stub:
/// ```asm
/// sub rsp, 0x28
/// mov rax, orig_target
/// call rax
/// mov rax, callback
/// call rax
/// add rsp, 0x28
/// ret
/// ```
fn write_stub(dst: *mut u8, orig_target: usize, callback: usize) {
    let mut code = [0u8; 33];
    // sub rsp, 0x28
    code[0..4].copy_from_slice(&[0x48, 0x83, 0xEC, 0x28]);
    // mov rax, orig_target
    code[4..6].copy_from_slice(&[0x48, 0xB8]);
    code[6..14].copy_from_slice(&(orig_target as u64).to_le_bytes());
    // call rax
    code[14..16].copy_from_slice(&[0xFF, 0xD0]);
    // mov rax, callback
    code[16..18].copy_from_slice(&[0x48, 0xB8]);
    code[18..26].copy_from_slice(&(callback as u64).to_le_bytes());
    // call rax
    code[26..28].copy_from_slice(&[0xFF, 0xD0]);
    // add rsp, 0x28
    code[28..32].copy_from_slice(&[0x48, 0x83, 0xC4, 0x28]);
    // ret
    code[32] = 0xC3;

    // SAFETY: `dst` points to a fresh 4 KiB RWX page from `VirtualAlloc`.
    unsafe {
        std::ptr::copy_nonoverlapping(code.as_ptr(), dst, code.len());
        let _ = FlushInstructionCache(GetCurrentProcess(), dst.cast(), code.len());
    }
}

/// Installs the self-validating 5-byte `CALL rel32` main-thread hook using RVAs from `rvas.json`.
pub fn install(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
    if base == 0 {
        return Err("Offline preview mode (launch title to install hook)");
    }
    if !rvas.loaded || rvas.main_tick_callsite == 0 || rvas.main_tick_orig_target == 0 {
        return Err("main_tick_callsite / main_tick_orig_target missing in rvas.json");
    }
    let mut guard = HOOK_STATE.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    if guard.is_some() {
        return Ok(());
    }

    let callsite = (base + rvas.main_tick_callsite) as usize;
    let expected_target = (base + rvas.main_tick_orig_target) as usize;

    // 1. Validate exact 5-byte `E8 rel32` instruction before touching anything!
    let opcode = trainer::safe_read::<u8>(callsite).ok_or("Callsite page unreadable")?;
    if opcode != 0xE8 {
        return Err("Callsite byte is not CALL rel32 (0xE8) — build mismatch");
    }
    let orig_rel32 = trainer::safe_read::<i32>(callsite + 1).ok_or("Callsite rel32 unreadable")?;
    let actual_target = ((callsite + 5) as isize + orig_rel32 as isize) as usize;
    if actual_target != expected_target {
        return Err("Callsite target does not match rvas.json — aborted for safety");
    }

    install_raw_callsite(
        callsite,
        orig_rel32,
        expected_target,
        base,
        rvas.clone(),
        menyoo_main_tick_trampoline as *const () as usize,
        &mut guard,
    )
}

fn install_raw_callsite(
    callsite: usize,
    orig_rel32: i32,
    orig_target: usize,
    base: u64,
    rvas: RvaTable,
    callback: usize,
    guard: &mut Option<ActiveHook>,
) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
    let stub_mem = alloc_near(callsite).ok_or("Failed to allocate near ±2 GB executable stub")?;
    write_stub(stub_mem, orig_target, callback);

    let new_rel = (stub_mem as isize) - ((callsite + 5) as isize);
    let Ok(new_rel32) = i32::try_from(new_rel) else {
        unsafe {
            let _ = VirtualFree(stub_mem.cast(), 0, MEM_RELEASE);
        }
        return Err("Stub out of rel32 range");
    };

    let mut old_prot = 0u32;
    // SAFETY: temporarily making the 5-byte callsite page RWX to atomically patch `rel32`.
    let patched = unsafe {
        if VirtualProtect(callsite as *const _, 5, PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE, &mut old_prot) == 0 {
            false
        } else {
            std::ptr::write_unaligned((callsite + 1) as *mut i32, new_rel32);
            let mut tmp = 0u32;
            let _ = VirtualProtect(callsite as *const _, 5, old_prot, &mut tmp);
            let _ = FlushInstructionCache(GetCurrentProcess(), callsite as *const _, 5);
            true
        }
    };
    if !patched {
        unsafe {
            let _ = VirtualFree(stub_mem.cast(), 0, MEM_RELEASE);
        }
        return Err("VirtualProtect on callsite failed");
    }

    *guard = Some(ActiveHook {
        callsite,
        orig_rel32,
        stub_mem,
        base,
        rvas,
    });
    HOOK_INSTALLED.store(true, Ordering::Release);
    Ok(())
}

/// Restores the exact original 4-byte `rel32` displacement cleanly.
pub fn uninstall() -> Result<(), &'static str> {
    let mut guard = HOOK_STATE.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    let Some(h) = guard.take() else {
        return Ok(());
    };
    HOOK_INSTALLED.store(false, Ordering::Release);
    HAS_PENDING_SPAWN.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
    HAS_PENDING_VEH_DROP.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
    HAS_PENDING_WEP_EQUIP.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
    HAS_PENDING_PROP.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
    HAS_PENDING_PROP_LOCATE.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
    HAS_PENDING_PED.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
    HAS_WEAPON_QUEUE.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
    HAS_TEXT_RESOLVE.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
    if let Ok(mut p) = PENDING_SPAWN.lock() {
        *p = None;
    }
    if let Ok(mut p) = PENDING_VEH_DROP.lock() {
        *p = None;
    }
    if let Ok(mut p) = PENDING_WEP_EQUIP.lock() {
        *p = None;
    }
    if let Ok(mut p) = PENDING_PROP_SPAWN.lock() {
        *p = None;
    }
    if let Ok(mut p) = PENDING_PROP_LOCATE.lock() {
        *p = None;
    }
    if let Ok(mut p) = PENDING_PED_SPAWN.lock() {
        *p = None;
    }
    if let Ok(mut q) = PED_SPAWN_QUEUE.lock() {
        q.clear();
        HAS_PED_SPAWN_QUEUE.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
    if let Ok(mut e) = PENDING_ESCORT.lock() {
        *e = None;
        HAS_PENDING_ESCORT.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
    if let Ok(mut q) = WEAPON_GIVE_QUEUE.lock() {
        q.clear();
    }
    if let Ok(mut c) = WEAPON_EQUIP_CANDS.lock() {
        c.clear();
    }
    if let Ok(mut t) = TEXT_RESOLVE_REQ.lock() {
        *t = None;
    }
    let mut old_prot = 0u32;
    // SAFETY: restoring the exact original 4-byte displacement saved at install time.
    unsafe {
        if VirtualProtect(h.callsite as *const _, 5, PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE, &mut old_prot) != 0 {
            std::ptr::write_unaligned((h.callsite + 1) as *mut i32, h.orig_rel32);
            let mut tmp = 0u32;
            let _ = VirtualProtect(h.callsite as *const _, 5, old_prot, &mut tmp);
            let _ = FlushInstructionCache(GetCurrentProcess(), h.callsite as *const _, 5);
        }
        let _ = h.stub_mem;
    }
    Ok(())
}

#[inline]
fn key_down(vk: i32) -> bool {
    // SAFETY: plain Win32 async key state query.
    unsafe { GetAsyncKeyState(vk) < 0 }
}

/// Executes directly on the title's main simulation thread once per unpaused gameplay frame!
extern "system" fn menyoo_main_tick_trampoline() {
    let tick = MAIN_TICKS.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed) + 1;

    let loops = LOOP_MASK.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
    let pending_spawn = HAS_PENDING_SPAWN.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
    let pending_veh_drop = HAS_PENDING_VEH_DROP.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
    let pending_wep_equip = HAS_PENDING_WEP_EQUIP.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
    let pending_prop = HAS_PENDING_PROP.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
    let pending_locate = HAS_PENDING_PROP_LOCATE.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
    let pending_ped = HAS_PENDING_PED.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
    let pending_ped_q = HAS_PED_SPAWN_QUEUE.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
    let pending_escort = HAS_PENDING_ESCORT.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
    let pending_weps = HAS_WEAPON_QUEUE.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
    let pending_text = HAS_TEXT_RESOLVE.load(Ordering::Relaxed);

    let mut batch: Vec<MainThreadCmd> = Vec::new();
    if let Ok(mut q) = CMD_QUEUE.try_lock() {
        while let Some(c) = q.pop_front() {
            batch.push(c);
        }
    }

    const PER_TICK_MASK: u64 = LOOP_EXPLOSIVE_AMMO
        | LOOP_FIRE_AMMO
        | LOOP_EXPLOSIVE_MELEE
        | LOOP_SUPER_JUMP
        | LOOP_FREECAM_NOCLIP
        | LOOP_SUPER_RUN
        | LOOP_VEH_HORN_BOOST
        | LOOP_VEH_FLY
        | LOOP_SPOONER_MODE
        | LOOP_VEH_WEAPONS
        | LOOP_VEH_POWER
        | LOOP_FUN_GUN
        | LOOP_SPOONER_ATTACH
        | LOOP_VEH_CAR_JUMP
        | LOOP_VEH_SUPER_BRAKE
        | LOOP_VEH_STICKY_TIRES
        | LOOP_BLACK_HOLE
        | LOOP_VEH_DRIVE_ON_WATER
        | LOOP_VEH_SUPER_DOWNFORCE
        | LOOP_VEH_RAMP_PLOW
        | LOOP_AIMBOT
        | LOOP_DRUNK_MODE
        | LOOP_SUPER_SWIM;
    const TWO_TICK_MASK: u64 = LOOP_VEH_RAINBOW | LOOP_VEH_RAINBOW_NEON;
    const FOUR_TICK_MASK: u64 = LOOP_NO_RELOAD | LOOP_ANTI_GRAV_TRAFFIC | LOOP_RAINBOW_TRAFFIC;
    const PERIODIC_MASK: u64 = LOOP_PLAYER_GOD
        | LOOP_NEVER_WANTED
        | LOOP_VEH_AUTO_REPAIR
        | LOOP_VEH_GOD
        | LOOP_NO_RAGDOLL
        | LOOP_AUTO_CLEAN
        | LOOP_JUMP_AROUND
        | LOOP_INVISIBLE
        | LOOP_SEATBELT
        | LOOP_IGNORED_BY_ALL
        | LOOP_INF_AMMO
        | LOOP_ONE_HIT_KILL
        | LOOP_DAMAGE_MULT
        | LOOP_SPOONER_MODE
        | LOOP_INF_STAMINA
        | LOOP_BODYGUARD_FOLLOW
        | LOOP_INF_CORES_SPECIAL
        | LOOP_VEH_INF_FUEL
        | LOOP_NO_WITNESSES
        | LOOP_ONE_SHOT_NPCS
        | LOOP_NO_WEP_DEGRADATION
        | LOOP_NEVER_DROWN
        | LOOP_BULLETPROOF_IN_VEH
        | LOOP_VEH_AUTO_FLIP
        | LOOP_VEH_INVISIBLE
        | LOOP_PED_SQUAD_AI
        | LOOP_PED_RIOT
        | LOOP_SUPER_SWIM;

    let ped_dens_bits = PED_DENSITY_BITS.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
    let veh_dens_bits = VEH_DENSITY_BITS.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
    let one_bits = 1.0f32.to_bits();
    let need_density = ped_dens_bits != one_bits || veh_dens_bits != one_bits;
    let loops_ex = LOOP_MASK_EX.load(Ordering::Acquire);
    let need_ex = loops_ex != 0;
    let need_custom_grip = VEH_GRIP_MULT_OVERRIDE_BITS.load(Ordering::Relaxed) != 0;

    let need_per_tick = (loops & PER_TICK_MASK) != 0 || need_density || need_ex || need_custom_grip;
    let need_two_tick = (loops & TWO_TICK_MASK) != 0 && (tick % 2 == 0);
    let need_four_tick = (loops & FOUR_TICK_MASK) != 0 && (tick % 4 == 0);
    let need_periodic = (loops & PERIODIC_MASK) != 0 && (tick % 15 == 0);
    let need_meteor = (loops & LOOP_METEOR_SHOWER) != 0 && (tick % 22 == 0);
    let need_spawn_retry = pending_spawn && (tick % 5 == 0);
    let need_veh_drop = pending_veh_drop;
    let need_wep_equip = pending_wep_equip && (tick % 2 == 0);
    let need_prop_retry = pending_prop && (tick % 5 == 0);
    let need_prop_locate = pending_locate && (tick % 4 == 0);
    let need_ped_retry = pending_ped && (tick % 5 == 0);
    let need_ped_queue = pending_ped_q && !pending_ped && (tick % 6 == 0);
    let need_escort = pending_escort && (tick % 4 == 0);

    // Ultra-fast idle path (~10 ns) when no commands, no pending spawns, and no active loops.
    if batch.is_empty()
        && !need_per_tick
        && !need_two_tick
        && !need_four_tick
        && !need_periodic
        && !need_meteor
        && !need_spawn_retry
        && !need_veh_drop
        && !need_wep_equip
        && !need_prop_retry
        && !need_prop_locate
        && !need_ped_retry
        && !need_ped_queue
        && !need_escort
        && !pending_weps
        && !pending_text
    {
        return;
    }

    let (base, rvas) = match HOOK_STATE.try_lock() {
        Ok(g) => match g.as_ref() {
            Some(h) => (h.base, h.rvas.clone()),
            None => return,
        },
        Err(_) => return,
    };

    // 0a. Main-thread batch localization lookup (`theText::GetByHash`, 100% TLS-safe!).
    if pending_text {
        process_pending_text_resolve(base, &rvas);
    }

    // 0. Per-tick population density enforcement (GTA resets ped density globals every frame!).
    if ped_dens_bits != one_bits {
        let _ = trainer::direct_set_ped_density(base, &rvas, f32::from_bits(ped_dens_bits));
    }
    if veh_dens_bits != one_bits {
        let _ = trainer::direct_set_veh_density(base, &rvas, f32::from_bits(veh_dens_bits));
    }

    // 1. Drain one-shot queued commands first.
    for cmd in batch {
        run_cmd_on_main_thread(base, &rvas, cmd);
        CMDS_EXECUTED.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
    // Reload loop masks AFTER one-shot commands (e.g. `WipeAllCrimeHeat` clearing `LOOP_EX_SIX_STAR_LOCK`)
    // so a cleared lock NEVER runs with a stale mask on the very same tick!
    let loops = LOOP_MASK.load(Ordering::Acquire);
    let loops_ex = LOOP_MASK_EX.load(Ordering::Acquire);

    // 1b. Drain batched Give All Weapons queue smoothly (4 weapons/tick = zero frame hitch!).
    if pending_weps {
        step_weapon_give_queue(base, &rvas);
    }
    if need_wep_equip {
        step_pending_weapon_equip(base, &rvas);
    }

    // 2. Async streaming vehicle & prop spawner retries + ground-drop vehicle placement.
    if need_spawn_retry {
        step_pending_vehicle_spawn(base, &rvas);
    }
    if need_veh_drop {
        step_pending_veh_drop(base, &rvas);
    }
    if need_prop_retry {
        step_pending_prop_spawn(base, &rvas);
    }
    if need_prop_locate {
        step_pending_prop_locate(base, &rvas);
    }
    if need_ped_retry {
        step_pending_ped_spawn(base, &rvas);
    }
    if need_ped_queue {
        step_ped_spawn_queue(base, &rvas);
    }
    if need_escort {
        step_pending_escort_convoy(base, &rvas);
    }

    // 3. Per-tick `CPlayerInfo + 0x14` reset flags (Explosive Ammo / Fire Ammo / Explosive Melee / Super Jump).
    let mut reset_bits = 0u8;
    if (loops & LOOP_EXPLOSIVE_AMMO) != 0 {
        reset_bits |= 0x01; // PLAYER_RESET_FLAG_EXPLOSIVE_AMMO_ON
    }
    if (loops & LOOP_FIRE_AMMO) != 0 {
        reset_bits |= 0x02; // PLAYER_RESET_FLAG_FIRE_AMMO_ON
    }
    if (loops & LOOP_EXPLOSIVE_MELEE) != 0 {
        reset_bits |= 0x04; // PLAYER_RESET_FLAG_EXPLOSIVE_MELEE_ON
    }
    if (loops & LOOP_SUPER_JUMP) != 0 {
        reset_bits |= 0x08; // PLAYER_RESET_FLAG_SUPER_JUMP_ON
    }
    if reset_bits != 0 {
        apply_player_reset_flags(base, &rvas, reset_bits);
    }

    // 4. Per-tick 3D physics, movement & Spooner keyboard manipulation (only when menu closed!).
    let menu_open = BRIDGE.menu_open.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
    if (loops & LOOP_FREECAM_NOCLIP) != 0 {
        step_noclip_flight(base, &rvas, menu_open);
    } else if !menu_open {
        if (loops & LOOP_SUPER_RUN) != 0 {
            step_super_run(base, &rvas);
        }
        if (loops & LOOP_VEH_HORN_BOOST) != 0 {
            step_veh_horn_boost(base, &rvas);
        }
        if (loops & LOOP_VEH_FLY) != 0 {
            step_veh_fly(base, &rvas);
        }
        if (loops & LOOP_VEH_POWER) != 0 {
            step_veh_power_boost(base, &rvas);
        }
        if (loops & LOOP_VEH_WEAPONS) != 0 {
            step_veh_weapons(base, &rvas);
        }
        if (loops & LOOP_FUN_GUN) != 0 {
            step_fun_gun(base, &rvas);
        }
        if (loops & LOOP_VEH_CAR_JUMP) != 0 {
            step_veh_car_jump(base, &rvas);
        }
        if (loops & LOOP_VEH_SUPER_BRAKE) != 0 {
            step_veh_super_brake(base, &rvas);
        }
        if (loops & LOOP_VEH_STICKY_TIRES) != 0 {
            step_veh_sticky_tires(base, &rvas);
        }
        if (loops & LOOP_VEH_SUPER_DOWNFORCE) != 0 {
            step_veh_super_downforce(base, &rvas);
        }
        if (loops & LOOP_AIMBOT) != 0 {
            step_soft_aimbot(base, &rvas);
        }
        if (loops & LOOP_DRUNK_MODE) != 0 && tick % 4 == 0 {
            step_drunk_mode(base, &rvas, tick);
        }
        if (loops & LOOP_SUPER_SWIM) != 0 {
            step_super_swim(base, &rvas);
        }
    }
    if (loops & LOOP_VEH_DRIVE_ON_WATER) != 0 {
        step_veh_drive_on_water(base, &rvas);
    }
    if (loops & LOOP_VEH_RAMP_PLOW) != 0 && tick % 2 == 0 {
        step_veh_ramp_plow(base, &rvas);
    }
    if (loops & LOOP_BLACK_HOLE) != 0 && tick % 2 == 0 {
        step_black_hole_vortex(base, &rvas, tick);
    }
    if (loops & LOOP_SPOONER_ATTACH) != 0 {
        step_spooner_attached(base, &rvas);
    }
    if (loops & LOOP_SPOONER_MODE) != 0 && !menu_open {
        step_spooner_hotkeys(base, &rvas);
    }

    // 4b. Native No-Reload & 4-tick Traffic Chaos loops.
    if need_four_tick && (loops & LOOP_NO_RELOAD) != 0 {
        apply_weapon_no_reload(base, &rvas, true);
    }
    if need_four_tick && (loops & LOOP_ANTI_GRAV_TRAFFIC) != 0 {
        step_anti_grav_traffic(base, &rvas);
    }
    if need_four_tick && (loops & LOOP_RAINBOW_TRAFFIC) != 0 {
        step_rainbow_traffic(base, &rvas);
    }

    // 5. Smooth 30 Hz Rainbow Vehicle Paint & Rainbow Underglow Neon cycles!
    if need_two_tick && (loops & LOOP_VEH_RAINBOW) != 0 {
        let mut hue = f32::from_bits(RAINBOW_HUE_BITS.load(Ordering::Relaxed));
        hue = (hue + 2.8) % 360.0;
        RAINBOW_HUE_BITS.store(hue.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
        let rgb = trainer::hsv_to_rgb_f32(hue, 1.0, 1.0);
        apply_vehicle_rgb_f32(base, &rvas, rgb);
    }
    if need_two_tick && (loops & LOOP_VEH_RAINBOW_NEON) != 0 {
        let mut hue = f32::from_bits(RAINBOW_NEON_HUE_BITS.load(Ordering::Relaxed));
        hue = (hue + 3.4) % 360.0;
        RAINBOW_NEON_HUE_BITS.store(hue.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
        let rgb = trainer::hsv_to_rgb_f32(hue, 1.0, 1.0);
        apply_vehicle_neon_rgb(base, &rvas, rgb);
    }

    // 5b. Live Meteor Shower fireball rain!
    if need_meteor {
        step_meteor_shower(base, &rvas, tick);
    }

    // 5c. Schema v11.0 Extended Loops (Player Powers, Eagle Eye, Animal Ride, Carry, Tow, Slam, Triggerbot,
    //     Tranq Rounds, PTFX Flame/Wheel Trails, Teleporter Portals, Live FOV Lock, Rope Tether, Task Seq)!
    if loops_ex != 0 {
        step_extended_loops_v11(base, &rvas, loops_ex, tick, menu_open);
    }
    // 5d. Maintain custom vehicle tire grip multiplier across physics ticks when active (`!= 1.0x`)!
    // Uses pure SEH-safe `CVehicleWheelComp` axle writes (never resolves script handles on every tick).
    let custom_grip_bits = VEH_GRIP_MULT_OVERRIDE_BITS.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
    if custom_grip_bits != 0
        && let Some(veh) = active_or_last_vehicle(base, &rvas)
    {
        let mult = f32::from_bits(custom_grip_bits);
        let wc = record_veh_wheel_comp(base, &rvas, veh);
        write_vehicle_axle_grip(wc, mult);
    }

    // 6. Periodic (~0.25s) protection, weapon & maintenance loops.
    if need_periodic {
        if (loops & LOOP_PLAYER_GOD) != 0 {
            apply_player_god_mode(base, &rvas, true);
        }
        if (loops & LOOP_NEVER_WANTED) != 0 {
            run_cmd_on_main_thread(base, &rvas, MainThreadCmd::SetWantedLevel(0));
        }
        if (loops & LOOP_VEH_GOD) != 0 {
            apply_vehicle_god_mode(base, &rvas, true);
        }
        if (loops & LOOP_VEH_AUTO_REPAIR) != 0 || ((loops & LOOP_AUTO_CLEAN) != 0 && tick % 30 == 0) {
            run_cmd_on_main_thread(base, &rvas, MainThreadCmd::VehicleRepairSilent);
        }
        if (loops & LOOP_AUTO_CLEAN) != 0 && tick % 30 == 0 {
            apply_ped_clean_damage(base, &rvas);
        }
        if (loops & LOOP_NO_RAGDOLL) != 0 {
            apply_ped_no_ragdoll(base, &rvas, true);
        }
        if (loops & LOOP_INVISIBLE) != 0 {
            apply_player_invisible(base, &rvas, true);
        }
        if (loops & LOOP_SEATBELT) != 0 {
            apply_seatbelt(base, &rvas, true, loops);
        }
        if (loops & LOOP_IGNORED_BY_ALL) != 0 {
            apply_ignored_by_all(base, &rvas, true);
        }
        if (loops & LOOP_INF_AMMO) != 0 {
            apply_weapon_inf_ammo(base, &rvas, true);
        }
        if (loops & LOOP_ONE_HIT_KILL) != 0 {
            apply_weapon_damage_mult(base, &rvas, 100.0);
        } else if (loops & LOOP_DAMAGE_MULT) != 0 {
            let m = f32::from_bits(WEP_DAMAGE_MULT_BITS.load(Ordering::Relaxed));
            apply_weapon_damage_mult(base, &rvas, m);
        }
        if (loops & LOOP_SPOONER_MODE) != 0 {
            refresh_spooner_hud(rvas.ped_pos_packed);
        }
        if (loops & LOOP_JUMP_AROUND) != 0 && tick % 30 == 0 {
            step_jump_around(base, &rvas);
        }
        if (loops & LOOP_INF_STAMINA) != 0 {
            apply_ped_replenish_stamina_only(base, &rvas);
        }
        if (loops & LOOP_INF_CORES_SPECIAL) != 0 {
            apply_ped_replenish_all_cores(base, &rvas);
        }
        if (loops & LOOP_VEH_INF_FUEL) != 0 {
            apply_refill_vehicle_fuel(base, &rvas);
        }
        if (loops & LOOP_NO_WITNESSES) != 0 && tick % 30 == 0 {
            step_no_witnesses(base, &rvas);
        }
        if (loops & LOOP_ONE_SHOT_NPCS) != 0 && tick % 30 == 0 {
            step_one_shot_npcs(base, &rvas);
        }
        if (loops & LOOP_NO_WEP_DEGRADATION) != 0 {
            if let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, &rvas) {
                set_ped_config_flag(base, &rvas, ped, 294, true);
            }
            if tick % 45 == 0 {
                apply_clean_active_weapon(base, &rvas);
            }
        }
        if ((loops & LOOP_NEVER_DROWN) != 0 || (loops & LOOP_SUPER_SWIM) != 0)
            && let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, &rvas)
        {
            set_ped_config_flag(base, &rvas, ped, 211, false);
            set_ped_config_flag(base, &rvas, ped, 213, false);
        }
        if (loops & LOOP_BULLETPROOF_IN_VEH) != 0
            && let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, &rvas)
        {
            set_ped_config_flag(base, &rvas, ped, 216, false);
        }
        if (loops & LOOP_BODYGUARD_FOLLOW) != 0 && tick % 45 == 0 {
            step_bodyguards_follow(base, &rvas);
        }
        if (loops & LOOP_PED_SQUAD_AI) != 0 && tick % 90 == 0 {
            step_ped_squad_ai(base, &rvas, (loops & LOOP_BODYGUARD_FOLLOW) != 0);
        }
        if (loops & LOOP_PED_RIOT) != 0 && tick % 90 == 0 {
            step_ped_riot(base, &rvas);
        }
        if (loops & LOOP_VEH_AUTO_FLIP) != 0 && tick % 30 == 0 {
            step_veh_auto_flip(base, &rvas);
        }
        if (loops & LOOP_VEH_INVISIBLE) != 0 && tick % 30 == 0 {
            apply_vehicle_invisible(base, &rvas, true);
        }
    }
}

fn read_local_ped(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) -> Option<u64> {
    if rvas.local_player_ped == 0 {
        return None;
    }
    let ped = trainer::safe_read::<u64>((base + rvas.local_player_ped) as usize)?;
    (ped > 0x10000).then_some(ped)
}

fn read_current_vehicle(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) -> Option<u64> {
    if rvas.current_vehicle == 0 {
        return None;
    }
    let veh = trainer::safe_read::<u64>((base + rvas.current_vehicle) as usize)?;
    (veh > 0x10000).then_some(veh)
}

/// Universal ECS `CDamageProofComponent` setter — works safely on `CPed*`, `CVehicle*`, AND `CObject*`.
/// Lazily allocates the entity's DamageProof component when enabling, null-checks it before writing,
/// and toggles the 6 core `eDamageProofFlags` bits (Bullets=0, Flames=1, Collisions=2, Melee=3,
/// NotDamagedByAnything=4, IgnoresExplosions=6) at `[comp + 0x10]`.
fn call_damage_proof(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, entity: u64, enable: bool) -> u64 {
    if entity < 0x10000 {
        return 0;
    }
    const GOD_PROOF_FLAGS: [u32; 6] = [0, 1, 2, 3, DPF_NOT_DAMAGED_BY_ANYTHING, 6];
    if rvas.fn_set_damage_proof_comp_flag != 0
        && rvas.fn_get_damage_proof_comp != 0
        && rvas.fn_get_or_create_damage_proof_comp != 0
    {
        let comp = if enable {
            // SAFETY: verified 1-arg `GetOrCreateDamageProofComp(CEntity*) -> CDamageProofComponent*`.
            let get_or_create: extern "system" fn(u64) -> u64 = unsafe {
                std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_or_create_damage_proof_comp) as usize)
            };
            get_or_create(entity)
        } else {
            let Some(ent_id) = trainer::safe_read::<u32>((entity + rvas.ped_entity_id) as usize)
            else {
                return 0;
            };
            // SAFETY: verified 1-arg `GetDamageProofComp(u32 ent_id) -> CDamageProofComponent*`.
            let get_existing: extern "system" fn(u32) -> u64 =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_damage_proof_comp) as usize) };
            get_existing(ent_id)
        };
        if comp > 0x10000 {
            // SAFETY: verified 3-arg `CDamageProofComponent::SetFlag(comp, flag_idx, enable)`.
            let set_flag: extern "system" fn(u64, u32, u8) =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_set_damage_proof_comp_flag) as usize) };
            for flag in GOD_PROOF_FLAGS {
                set_flag(comp, flag, u8::from(enable));
            }
            return comp;
        }
        return 0;
    }
    if rvas.fn_set_entity_damage_proof != 0 {
        // Fallback: verified 3-arg `CEntity::SetDamageProofFlag(CEntity*, eDamageProofFlags, bool)`.
        let f: extern "system" fn(u64, u32, u8) =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_set_entity_damage_proof) as usize) };
        for flag in GOD_PROOF_FLAGS {
            f(entity, flag, u8::from(enable));
        }
    }
    0
}

fn apply_player_god_mode(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, enable: bool) {
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let comp = call_damage_proof(base, rvas, ped, enable);
    if comp > 0x10000 {
        DIAG_PED_PROOF_COMP.store(comp, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
    if enable {
        if rvas.fn_ped_replenish_silent != 0 {
            let f: extern "system" fn(u64) =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_ped_replenish_silent) as usize) };
            f(ped);
        }
        if rvas.fn_ped_replenish_armor != 0 {
            let f: extern "system" fn(u64) =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_ped_replenish_armor) as usize) };
            f(ped);
        }
    }
}

fn apply_vehicle_god_mode(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, enable: bool) {
    let Some(veh) = active_or_last_vehicle(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let comp = call_damage_proof(base, rvas, veh, enable);
    if comp > 0x10000 {
        DIAG_VEH_PROOF_COMP.store(comp, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
    if enable && rvas.fn_vehicle_repair_silent != 0 {
        let f: extern "system" fn(u64) =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_vehicle_repair_silent) as usize) };
        f(veh);
    }
}

fn apply_vehicle_rgb_f32(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, rgb: [f32; 3]) {
    apply_vehicle_rgb_slot_f32(base, rvas, rgb, false);
}

fn apply_player_reset_flags(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, mask: u8) {
    if rvas.fn_get_player_info == 0 {
        return;
    }
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let get_pi: extern "system" fn(u64) -> u64 =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_player_info) as usize) };
    let pi = get_pi(ped);
    if pi < 0x10000 {
        return;
    }
    DIAG_PLAYER_INFO.store(pi, Ordering::Relaxed);
    let addr = (pi + rvas.player_info_reset_flags) as usize;
    if let Some(cur) = trainer::safe_read::<u8>(addr) {
        let _ = trainer::safe_write::<u8>(addr, cur | mask);
    }
}

fn apply_ped_no_ragdoll(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, no_ragdoll: bool) {
    if rvas.fn_get_ped_ragdoll_comp == 0 {
        return;
    }
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some(ent_id) = trainer::safe_read::<u32>((ped + rvas.ped_entity_id) as usize) else {
        return;
    };
    let get_comp: extern "system" fn(u32) -> u64 =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_ped_ragdoll_comp) as usize) };
    let comp = get_comp(ent_id);
    if comp < 0x10000 {
        return;
    }
    DIAG_RAGDOLL_COMP.store(comp, Ordering::Relaxed);
    let addr = (comp + 0x238) as usize;
    if let Some(cur) = trainer::safe_read::<u32>(addr) {
        // Bit 29 = `can_ragdoll` flag on ped ragdoll component.
        let next = if no_ragdoll {
            cur & !(1u32 << 29)
        } else {
            cur | (1u32 << 29)
        };
        let _ = trainer::safe_write::<u32>(addr, next);
    }
}

fn apply_entity_freeze(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, freeze: bool) {
    let fn_rva = if freeze {
        rvas.fn_phys_freeze
    } else {
        rvas.fn_phys_unfreeze
    };
    if fn_rva == 0 {
        return;
    }
    let f: extern "system" fn(u64) = unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + fn_rva) as usize) };
    if let Some(veh) = read_current_vehicle(base, rvas) {
        f(veh);
    }
    if let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) {
        f(ped);
    }
}

/// Sets an entity's 3D physics velocity via `CPhysical::SetVelocity`.
fn set_entity_velocity_native(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, ent: u64, vel: [f32; 3]) {
    if rvas.fn_set_entity_velocity == 0 || ent < 0x10000 {
        return;
    }
    let Some(ph_inst) = trainer::safe_read::<u64>((ent + rvas.entity_ph_inst) as usize) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some(ent_id) = trainer::safe_read::<u32>((ent + rvas.ped_entity_id) as usize) else {
        return;
    };
    if ph_inst < 0x10000 {
        return;
    }
    let v = trainer::Vec4A([vel[0], vel[1], vel[2], 0.0]);
    // SAFETY: verified 4-arg `SetEntityVelocity(ph_inst, ent_id, &Vec4A, 1)` on main simulation thread.
    let f: extern "system" fn(u64, u32, *const trainer::Vec4A, u8) =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_set_entity_velocity) as usize) };
    f(ph_inst, ent_id, &v, 1);
}

/// Teleports any `CEntity*` (`CPed*`, `CVehicle*`, `CObject*`) cleanly via the engine's own
/// virtual `CEntity::SetMatrix(ent, &Mat34V, bUpdatePhysics=1, bWarp=1, 0)`
/// + `CEntity::UpdateWorldPosition` so physics & portals stay 100% synced (no snap-back!).
fn teleport_entity_native(
    base: u64,
    rvas: &RvaTable,
    ent: u64,
    pos: [f32; 3],
    basis_override: Option<([f32; 3], [f32; 3])>,
    reset_vel: bool,
) -> bool {
    if ent < 0x10000 || !pos.iter().all(|v| v.is_finite() && v.abs() < 100_000.0) {
        return false;
    }
    let Some((orig_r, orig_f, orig_u, _)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ent, rvas) else {
        return false;
    };
    let (r, f, u) = if let Some((br, bf)) = basis_override {
        let cu = [
            br[1] * bf[2] - br[2] * bf[1],
            br[2] * bf[0] - br[0] * bf[2],
            br[0] * bf[1] - br[1] * bf[0],
        ];
        let ulen = (cu[0] * cu[0] + cu[1] * cu[1] + cu[2] * cu[2]).sqrt();
        if ulen > 0.001 {
            (br, bf, [cu[0] / ulen, cu[1] / ulen, cu[2] / ulen])
        } else {
            (br, bf, orig_u)
        }
    } else {
        (orig_r, orig_f, orig_u)
    };
    let mat = trainer::Mat34V {
        right: [r[0], r[1], r[2], 0.0],
        forward: [f[0], f[1], f[2], 0.0],
        up: [u[0], u[1], u[2], 0.0],
        pos_packed: trainer::pack_sector_pos(pos),
    };
    let ent_type = trainer::safe_read::<u8>((ent + rvas.entity_type) as usize).unwrap_or(0);
    let mut called_vtable = false;
    let mut used_ped_teleport = false;
    if ent_type == 3 && rvas.fn_ped_teleport != 0 {
        // Native `CPed::TeleportInner(ped, &Vec4A, heading_rad, set_heading, bWarp=1, bFlag6=1, bResetCamPortal=1)`:
        // clears ped motion/IK/ragdoll/task anchors, updates matrix + heading + SetPosition + portal tracker
        // so on-foot peds move immediately and never snap back!
        let world_pos = trainer::Vec4A([pos[0], pos[1], pos[2], 0.0]);
        let (heading_rad, set_heading) = if let Some((_, fwd_ov)) = basis_override {
            ((-fwd_ov[0]).atan2(fwd_ov[1]), 1u8)
        } else {
            (0.0f32, 0u8)
        };
        // SAFETY: verified 7-arg `CPed::TeleportInner(CPed*, &Vec4A, f32, u8, u8, u8, u8)` on main thread.
        let ped_tp: extern "system" fn(u64, *const trainer::Vec4A, f32, u8, u8, u8, u8) =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_ped_teleport) as usize) };
        ped_tp(ent, &world_pos, heading_rad, set_heading, 1, 1, 1);
        called_vtable = true;
        used_ped_teleport = true;
    } else if let Some(vtable) = trainer::safe_read::<u64>(ent as usize)
        && vtable > 0x10000
    {
        if ent_type == 3 {
            if basis_override.is_some()
                && let Some(set_mat_addr) = trainer::safe_read::<u64>((vtable + 0x170) as usize)
                && set_mat_addr > 0x10000
            {
                let set_mat: extern "system" fn(u64, *const trainer::Mat34V, u8, u8, u8) =
                    unsafe { std::mem::transmute(set_mat_addr as usize) };
                set_mat(ent, &mat, 1, 1, 1);
            }
            if let Some(set_pos_addr) = trainer::safe_read::<u64>((vtable + 0x178) as usize)
                && set_pos_addr > 0x10000
            {
                let world_pos = trainer::Vec4A([pos[0], pos[1], pos[2], 0.0]);
                // SAFETY: verified 5-arg virtual `CEntity::SetPosition(ent, &Vec4A, bUpdatePhys=1, bUpdateWorld=1, bWarp=1)`.
                let set_pos: extern "system" fn(u64, *const trainer::Vec4A, u8, u8, u8) =
                    unsafe { std::mem::transmute(set_pos_addr as usize) };
                set_pos(ent, &world_pos, 1, 1, 1);
                called_vtable = true;
            }
        } else if let Some(set_mat_addr) = trainer::safe_read::<u64>((vtable + 0x170) as usize)
            && set_mat_addr > 0x10000
        {
            // SAFETY: verified virtual `CEntity::SetMatrix(ent, &Mat34V, bUpdatePhys=1, bWarp=1, bClearTasks=1)`.
            let set_mat: extern "system" fn(u64, *const trainer::Mat34V, u8, u8, u8) =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute(set_mat_addr as usize) };
            set_mat(ent, &mat, 1, 1, 1);
            called_vtable = true;
        }
    }
    if !called_vtable {
        let _ = trainer::safe_write::<[u32; 4]>((ent + rvas.ped_pos_packed) as usize, mat.pos_packed);
    }
    if ent_type == 3
        && let Some(raw_now) = trainer::safe_read::<[u32; 4]>((ent + rvas.ped_pos_packed) as usize)
    {
        let imm = trainer::unpack_sector_pos(raw_now);
        DIAG_TP_IMM_X.store(imm[0].to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
        DIAG_TP_IMM_Y.store(imm[1].to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
        DIAG_TP_IMM_Z.store(imm[2].to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
    // Match native `SET_ENTITY_*`: sync physics capsule/collider for `CVehicle=2, CObject=4` (and CPed fallback).
    if !used_ped_teleport
        && (2..=4).contains(&ent_type)
        && rvas.fn_get_phys_sync_comp != 0
        && rvas.fn_commit_phys_sync != 0
        && let Some(ent_id) = trainer::safe_read::<u32>((ent + rvas.ped_entity_id) as usize)
    {
        let get_sync: extern "system" fn(u32) -> u64 =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_phys_sync_comp) as usize) };
        let sync_comp = get_sync(ent_id);
        if sync_comp > 0x10000 {
            let commit: extern "system" fn(u64) =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_commit_phys_sync) as usize) };
            commit(sync_comp);
        }
    }
    if reset_vel && !used_ped_teleport {
        set_entity_velocity_native(base, rvas, ent, [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]);
    }
    called_vtable
}

fn write_entity_pos(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, pos: [f32; 3], reset_vel: bool) {
    if let Some(veh) = read_current_vehicle(base, rvas) {
        let _ = teleport_entity_native(base, rvas, veh, pos, None, false);
        let freecam = (LOOP_MASK.load(Ordering::Relaxed) & LOOP_FREECAM_NOCLIP) != 0;
        if !freecam {
            if rvas.fn_phys_unfreeze != 0 {
                let unfreeze: extern "system" fn(u64) =
                    unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_phys_unfreeze) as usize) };
                unfreeze(veh);
            }
            // Gentle downward settle velocity ensures vehicles drop smoothly onto ground instead of floating!
            if reset_vel {
                set_entity_velocity_native(base, rvas, veh, [0.0, 0.0, -0.8]);
            }
        } else if reset_vel {
            set_entity_velocity_native(base, rvas, veh, [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]);
        }
    } else if let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) {
        let _ = teleport_entity_native(base, rvas, ped, pos, None, reset_vel);
    }
}

fn step_noclip_flight(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, menu_open: bool) {
    let target = read_current_vehicle(base, rvas).or_else(|| read_local_ped(base, rvas));
    let Some(ent) = target else { return };
    let Some((ent_r, ent_f, _up, mut pos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ent, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    // Prefer full 3D rendered camera look vectors (`cam_mat_base`) for classic Free-Cam flight!
    let (right, fwd, cam_3d) = if let Some((cr, cf, _cu, _cp)) = trainer::read_camera_mat34(base, rvas) {
        (cr, cf, true)
    } else {
        (ent_r, ent_f, false)
    };
    // Always kill gravity velocity while floating in No-Clip!
    set_entity_velocity_native(base, rvas, ent, [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]);
    if !menu_open {
        let mut speed = 0.65 * f32::from_bits(NOCLIP_SPEED_BITS.load(Ordering::Relaxed));
        if key_down(0x10) {
            // Shift = 4x turbo flight
            speed *= 4.0;
        }
        let mut dx = 0.0f32;
        let mut dy = 0.0f32;
        let mut dz = 0.0f32;
        if key_down(0x57) {
            // W = forward along 3D camera aim
            dx += fwd[0] * speed;
            dy += fwd[1] * speed;
            if cam_3d {
                dz += fwd[2] * speed;
            }
        }
        if key_down(0x53) {
            // S = backward along 3D camera aim
            dx -= fwd[0] * speed;
            dy -= fwd[1] * speed;
            if cam_3d {
                dz -= fwd[2] * speed;
            }
        }
        if key_down(0x44) {
            // D = right
            dx += right[0] * speed;
            dy += right[1] * speed;
        }
        if key_down(0x41) {
            // A = left
            dx -= right[0] * speed;
            dy -= right[1] * speed;
        }
        if key_down(0x20) || key_down(0x45) {
            // Space / E = ascend
            dz += speed * 0.75;
        }
        if key_down(0x11) || key_down(0x51) {
            // Ctrl / Q = descend
            dz -= speed * 0.75;
        }
        if dx != 0.0 || dy != 0.0 || dz != 0.0 {
            pos[0] += dx;
            pos[1] += dy;
            pos[2] += dz;
            let _ = teleport_entity_native(base, rvas, ent, pos, None, true);
        }
    }
}

fn step_super_run(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    if read_current_vehicle(base, rvas).is_some() {
        return;
    }
    if !(key_down(0x57) && key_down(0x10)) {
        return; // Requires W + Shift held
    }
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some((_right, fwd, _up, mut pos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ped, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let len = fwd[0].hypot(fwd[1]);
    if len > 0.1 {
        let nx = fwd[0] / len;
        let ny = fwd[1] / len;
        pos[0] += nx * 0.34;
        pos[1] += ny * 0.34;
        let _ = teleport_entity_native(base, rvas, ped, pos, None, false);
        set_entity_velocity_native(base, rvas, ped, [nx * 14.0, ny * 14.0, 0.0]);
    }
}

fn step_veh_horn_boost(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let pad = BRIDGE.pad_buttons.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
    let horn = key_down(0x45) || (pad & 0x2000 != 0); // E key or Gamepad L3
    if !horn {
        return;
    }
    let Some(veh) = read_current_vehicle(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some((_right, fwd, _up, mut pos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(veh, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let len = fwd[0].hypot(fwd[1]);
    if len > 0.1 {
        let nx = fwd[0] / len;
        let ny = fwd[1] / len;
        let nz = fwd[2].clamp(-0.35, 0.35);
        pos[0] += nx * 0.9;
        pos[1] += ny * 0.9;
        pos[2] += nz * 0.9;
        let _ = teleport_entity_native(base, rvas, veh, pos, None, false);
        set_entity_velocity_native(base, rvas, veh, [nx * 55.0, ny * 55.0, nz * 25.0]);
    }
}

fn step_veh_fly(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let Some(veh) = read_current_vehicle(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some((_right, fwd, _up, mut pos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(veh, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let mut speed = 0.85f32;
    if key_down(0x10) {
        speed *= 2.5;
    }
    let mut moved = false;
    if key_down(0x57) {
        pos[0] += fwd[0] * speed;
        pos[1] += fwd[1] * speed;
        moved = true;
    }
    if key_down(0x53) {
        pos[0] -= fwd[0] * speed * 0.6;
        pos[1] -= fwd[1] * speed * 0.6;
        moved = true;
    }
    if key_down(0x20) {
        pos[2] += speed * 0.65;
        moved = true;
    }
    if key_down(0x11) {
        pos[2] -= speed * 0.65;
        moved = true;
    }
    if moved {
        let _ = teleport_entity_native(base, rvas, veh, pos, None, true);
    }
}

fn step_jump_around(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let Some(veh) = read_current_vehicle(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some((_r, _f, _u, mut pos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(veh, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    pos[2] += 0.45;
    let _ = teleport_entity_native(base, rvas, veh, pos, None, false);
    set_entity_velocity_native(base, rvas, veh, [0.0, 0.0, 5.5]);
}

/// Releases an active `strRequest` streaming handle cleanly via `release_model_request`.
fn release_str_request(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, token: &mut u32) {
    if (*token & 0x3FFF) != 0 && rvas.fn_release_model_request != 0 {
        let rel: extern "system" fn(*mut u32) =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_release_model_request) as usize) };
        rel(token);
        *token = 0;
    }
}

/// Resolves a 64-bit model hash to its `fwModelId` (retries with filter bypass flag `1` if needed).
fn resolve_model_id_any(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, hash64: u64) -> u32 {
    if rvas.fn_get_model_id_from_hash64 == 0 || hash64 == 0 {
        return 0x3F_FFFF;
    }
    let get_id: extern "system" fn(u64, *mut u32, u32) =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_model_id_from_hash64) as usize) };
    let mut model_id: u32 = 0x3F_FFFF;
    get_id(hash64, &mut model_id, 0);
    if (model_id & 0x3F_FFFF) == 0x3F_FFFF {
        get_id(hash64, &mut model_id, 1);
    }
    model_id
}

/// Drops a newly spawned `CVehicle*` cleanly right in front of the player (unfrozen + gentle
/// downward settle velocity so its tires land solidly on the street instead of floating in midair!).
fn drop_vehicle_in_front_of_player(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, veh: u64) {
    if veh < 0x10000 {
        return;
    }
    if let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas)
        && let Some((right, fwd, _up, pos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ped, rvas)
    {
        let len = fwd[0].hypot(fwd[1]).max(0.001);
        let fx = fwd[0] / len;
        let fy = fwd[1] / len;
        let rlen = right[0].hypot(right[1]).max(0.001);
        let rx = right[0] / rlen;
        let ry = right[1] / rlen;
        // Place 5.8m right in front of player at ground-drop height (+0.55m above ped feet)
        // instead of the engine cheat's +2.0m floating sky offset!
        let drop_pos = [pos[0] + fx * 5.8, pos[1] + fy * 5.8, pos[2] + 0.55];
        let _ = teleport_entity_native(
            base,
            rvas,
            veh,
            drop_pos,
            Some(([rx, ry, 0.0], [fx, fy, 0.0])),
            false,
        );
    }
    if rvas.fn_phys_unfreeze != 0 {
        let unfreeze: extern "system" fn(u64) =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_phys_unfreeze) as usize) };
        unfreeze(veh);
    }
    // Gentle downward settle impulse ensures immediate ground contact with zero hovering.
    set_entity_velocity_native(base, rvas, veh, [0.0, 0.0, -1.5]);
}

/// Checks if the async cheat-vehicle callback has written a new valid handle; if so, resolves
/// `CVehicle*` and drops it right in front of the player!
fn try_complete_veh_drop(
    base: u64,
    rvas: &RvaTable,
    prev_handle: u32,
    keep_prev: bool,
    warp_inside: bool,
) -> bool {
    if rvas.cheat_vehicle_handle == 0 {
        return false;
    }
    let handle_addr = (base + rvas.cheat_vehicle_handle) as usize;
    let after_handle = trainer::safe_read::<u32>(handle_addr).unwrap_or(0x1_FFFF);
    let spawned =
        (after_handle & 0x1_FFFF) != 0x1_FFFF && (keep_prev || after_handle != prev_handle);
    if !spawned {
        return false;
    }
    if rvas.fn_get_entity_from_handle != 0 {
        let get_ent: extern "system" fn(u32) -> u64 =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_entity_from_handle) as usize) };
        let veh = get_ent(after_handle);
        if veh > 0x10000 {
            DIAG_LAST_SPAWNED_VEH.store(veh, Ordering::Relaxed);
            drop_vehicle_in_front_of_player(base, rvas, veh);
            if warp_inside {
                let _ = warp_local_ped_into_vehicle(base, rvas, veh, 0);
            }
        }
    }
    SPAWN_SUCCESSES.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
    true
}

fn finish_vehicle_spawn_now(
    base: u64,
    rvas: &RvaTable,
    hash64: u64,
    prev_handle: u32,
    keep_prev: bool,
    warp_inside: bool,
) -> bool {
    if keep_prev {
        let _ = trainer::detach_last_spawned_vehicle(base, rvas);
    }
    DIAG_LAST_SPAWNED_VEH.store(0, Ordering::Relaxed);
    let f: extern "system" fn(u64) =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_spawn_cheat_vehicle) as usize) };
    f(hash64);
    if rvas.cheat_vehicle_handle == 0 {
        SPAWN_SUCCESSES.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
        return true;
    }
    if try_complete_veh_drop(base, rvas, prev_handle, keep_prev, warp_inside) {
        return true;
    }
    // `spawn_cheat_vehicle` spawns asynchronously via completion callback; poll up to 60 ticks
    // so we catch the spawned `CVehicle*` as soon as it materializes and drop it cleanly ahead!
    if let Ok(mut d) = PENDING_VEH_DROP.try_lock() {
        *d = Some(PendingVehDrop {
            prev_handle,
            keep_prev,
            warp_inside,
            ticks_left: 60,
        });
        HAS_PENDING_VEH_DROP.store(true, Ordering::Release);
    }
    false
}

fn step_pending_veh_drop(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let mut job = match PENDING_VEH_DROP.try_lock() {
        Ok(mut g) => match g.take() {
            Some(j) => j,
            None => {
                HAS_PENDING_VEH_DROP.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
                return;
            }
        },
        Err(_) => return,
    };
    if try_complete_veh_drop(base, rvas, job.prev_handle, job.keep_prev, job.warp_inside) {
        HAS_PENDING_VEH_DROP.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
        return;
    }
    if job.ticks_left > 1 {
        job.ticks_left -= 1;
        if let Ok(mut g) = PENDING_VEH_DROP.try_lock() {
            *g = Some(job);
        } else {
            HAS_PENDING_VEH_DROP.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
        }
    } else {
        HAS_PENDING_VEH_DROP.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
}

fn start_vehicle_spawn(
    base: u64,
    rvas: &RvaTable,
    hash64: u64,
    keep_prev: bool,
    warp_inside: bool,
) {
    if rvas.fn_spawn_cheat_vehicle == 0 || hash64 == 0 {
        return;
    }
    // Release any prior pending streaming request token before starting a new one!
    if let Ok(mut p) = PENDING_SPAWN.try_lock()
        && let Some(mut old) = p.take()
    {
        release_str_request(base, rvas, &mut old.token);
        HAS_PENDING_SPAWN.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
    if let Ok(mut d) = PENDING_VEH_DROP.try_lock() {
        *d = None;
        HAS_PENDING_VEH_DROP.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }

    let handle_addr = if rvas.cheat_vehicle_handle != 0 {
        (base + rvas.cheat_vehicle_handle) as usize
    } else {
        0
    };
    let prev_handle = if handle_addr != 0 {
        trainer::safe_read::<u32>(handle_addr).unwrap_or(0x1_FFFF)
    } else {
        0x1_FFFF
    };

    // Pin the vehicle model with a persistent `strRequest` token so it finishes streaming before spawn
    // (`spawn_cheat_vehicle` aborts immediately if the model isn't already resident in memory).
    let model_id = resolve_model_id_any(base, rvas, hash64);
    DIAG_LAST_VEH_MODEL_ID.store(model_id, Ordering::Relaxed);
    if (model_id & 0x3F_FFFF) == 0x3F_FFFF
        || rvas.fn_request_model_by_id == 0
        || rvas.fn_has_model_loaded == 0
    {
        let _ = finish_vehicle_spawn_now(base, rvas, hash64, prev_handle, keep_prev, warp_inside);
        return;
    }

    let mut token: u32 = 0;
    let req: extern "system" fn(*mut u32, u32) -> *mut u32 =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_request_model_by_id) as usize) };
    req(&mut token, model_id);

    let has_loaded: extern "system" fn(*const u32) -> u8 =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_has_model_loaded) as usize) };
    let loaded = has_loaded(&token);
    DIAG_LAST_VEH_LOADED.store(u32::from(loaded), Ordering::Relaxed);
    if loaded != 0 {
        let _ = finish_vehicle_spawn_now(base, rvas, hash64, prev_handle, keep_prev, warp_inside);
        release_str_request(base, rvas, &mut token);
    } else if let Ok(mut p) = PENDING_SPAWN.try_lock() {
        *p = Some(PendingSpawn {
            hash64,
            token,
            prev_handle,
            keep_prev,
            warp_inside,
            retries_left: 80,
        });
        HAS_PENDING_SPAWN.store(true, Ordering::Release);
    } else {
        release_str_request(base, rvas, &mut token);
    }
}

fn step_pending_vehicle_spawn(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let mut job = match PENDING_SPAWN.try_lock() {
        Ok(mut g) => match g.take() {
            Some(j) => j,
            None => {
                HAS_PENDING_SPAWN.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
                return;
            }
        },
        Err(_) => return,
    };
    if rvas.fn_spawn_cheat_vehicle == 0 || rvas.fn_has_model_loaded == 0 || job.retries_left == 0 {
        release_str_request(base, rvas, &mut job.token);
        HAS_PENDING_SPAWN.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
        return;
    }

    // ONLY poll `has_model_loaded(&job.token)` — NEVER re-call `request_model_by_id` (which resets token)!
    let has_loaded: extern "system" fn(*const u32) -> u8 =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_has_model_loaded) as usize) };
    let loaded = has_loaded(&job.token);
    DIAG_LAST_VEH_LOADED.store(u32::from(loaded), Ordering::Relaxed);
    if loaded != 0 {
        let _ = finish_vehicle_spawn_now(
            base,
            rvas,
            job.hash64,
            job.prev_handle,
            job.keep_prev,
            job.warp_inside,
        );
        release_str_request(base, rvas, &mut job.token);
        HAS_PENDING_SPAWN.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
    } else {
        job.retries_left -= 1;
        if job.retries_left > 0 {
            if let Ok(mut g) = PENDING_SPAWN.try_lock() {
                *g = Some(job);
            } else {
                release_str_request(base, rvas, &mut job.token);
                HAS_PENDING_SPAWN.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
            }
        } else {
            release_str_request(base, rvas, &mut job.token);
            HAS_PENDING_SPAWN.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
        }
    }
}

fn run_cmd_on_main_thread(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, cmd: MainThreadCmd) {
    match cmd {
        MainThreadCmd::ReplenishAndRepair => {
            if rvas.fn_replenish_and_repair != 0 {
                // SAFETY: verified 0-arg void built-in cheat handler on main simulation thread.
                let f: extern "system" fn() =
                    unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_replenish_and_repair) as usize) };
                f();
            }
        }
        MainThreadCmd::PedReplenishSilent => {
            if rvas.fn_ped_replenish_silent != 0
                && let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas)
            {
                let f: extern "system" fn(u64) =
                    unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_ped_replenish_silent) as usize) };
                f(ped);
            }
        }
        MainThreadCmd::VehicleRepairSilent => {
            if rvas.fn_vehicle_repair_silent != 0
                && let Some(veh) = active_or_last_vehicle(base, rvas)
            {
                let f: extern "system" fn(u64) =
                    unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_vehicle_repair_silent) as usize) };
                f(veh);
            }
        }
        MainThreadCmd::SetPlayerGodMode(on) => apply_player_god_mode(base, rvas, on),
        MainThreadCmd::SetVehicleGodMode(on) => apply_vehicle_god_mode(base, rvas, on),
        MainThreadCmd::SetVehicleCustomRgb([r, g, b]) => {
            apply_vehicle_rgb_f32(
                base,
                rvas,
                [f32::from(r) / 255.0, f32::from(g) / 255.0, f32::from(b) / 255.0],
            );
        }
        MainThreadCmd::SetPedNoRagdoll(on) => apply_ped_no_ragdoll(base, rvas, on),
        MainThreadCmd::SetEntityFrozen(on) => apply_entity_freeze(base, rvas, on),
        MainThreadCmd::SetPedDensity(mult) => {
            let v = mult.clamp(0.0, 2.0);
            PED_DENSITY_BITS.store(v.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
            let _ = trainer::direct_set_ped_density(base, rvas, v);
        }
        MainThreadCmd::SetVehDensity(mult) => {
            let v = mult.clamp(0.0, 2.0);
            VEH_DENSITY_BITS.store(v.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
            let _ = trainer::direct_set_veh_density(base, rvas, v);
        }
        MainThreadCmd::WantedUp => {
            if rvas.fn_cheat_wanted_up != 0 {
                let f: extern "system" fn() =
                    unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_cheat_wanted_up) as usize) };
                f();
            }
        }
        MainThreadCmd::WantedDown => {
            if rvas.fn_cheat_wanted_down != 0 {
                let f: extern "system" fn() =
                    unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_cheat_wanted_down) as usize) };
                f();
            }
        }
        MainThreadCmd::SetWantedLevel(stars) => {
            apply_set_wanted_level_6star(base, rvas, stars);
        }
        MainThreadCmd::CycleWeather => {
            if rvas.fn_cheat_cycle_weather != 0 {
                let f: extern "system" fn() =
                    unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_cheat_cycle_weather) as usize) };
                f();
            }
        }
        MainThreadCmd::ForceWeather { prev, next, interp, lock } => {
            if rvas.fn_force_weather != 0 {
                let f: extern "system" fn(i32, i32, f32, u8) =
                    unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_force_weather) as usize) };
                f(prev, next, interp, u8::from(lock));
            }
        }
        MainThreadCmd::SpawnVehicleHash64 {
            hash64,
            keep_prev,
            warp_inside,
        } => {
            start_vehicle_spawn(base, rvas, hash64, keep_prev, warp_inside);
        }
        MainThreadCmd::SetClockTime { hour, minute, second } => {
            if rvas.fn_clock_set_time != 0 {
                let f: extern "system" fn(i32, i32, i32) =
                    unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_clock_set_time) as usize) };
                f(hour.rem_euclid(24), minute.rem_euclid(60), second.rem_euclid(60));
            } else {
                let _ = trainer::direct_set_clock_time(base, rvas, hour, minute, second);
            }
        }
        MainThreadCmd::SetClockPaused(paused) => {
            let _ = trainer::direct_set_clock_paused(base, rvas, paused);
        }
        MainThreadCmd::SetClockMsPerMinute(ms) => {
            if rvas.fn_clock_set_ms_per_minute != 0 && ms > 0 {
                let f: extern "system" fn(u32) =
                    unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_clock_set_ms_per_minute) as usize) };
                f(ms);
            }
        }
        MainThreadCmd::ToggleBuiltInCheatFlag(idx) => {
            if rvas.cheat_flags_base != 0 && idx < 32 {
                let addr = (base + rvas.cheat_flags_base + idx as u64) as usize;
                if let Some(cur) = trainer::safe_read::<u8>(addr) {
                    let _ = trainer::safe_write::<u8>(addr, cur ^ 1);
                }
            }
        }
        MainThreadCmd::Teleport(pos) => write_entity_pos(base, rvas, pos, true),
        MainThreadCmd::SetPlayerInvisible(on) => apply_player_invisible(base, rvas, on),
        MainThreadCmd::SetSeatbelt(on) => {
            let loops = LOOP_MASK.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
            apply_seatbelt(base, rvas, on, loops);
        }
        MainThreadCmd::SetIgnoredByAll(on) => apply_ignored_by_all(base, rvas, on),
        MainThreadCmd::GiveWeapon {
            hash32,
            award_hash32,
            ammo_award_hash32,
            equip,
        } => {
            give_single_weapon(base, rvas, hash32, award_hash32, ammo_award_hash32, equip);
        }
        MainThreadCmd::GiveLoadout(loadout_hash32) => {
            give_weapon_loadout(base, rvas, loadout_hash32);
        }
        MainThreadCmd::SetWeaponInfAmmo(on) => apply_weapon_inf_ammo(base, rvas, on),
        MainThreadCmd::SetWeaponNoReload(on) => apply_weapon_no_reload(base, rvas, on),
        MainThreadCmd::SetDamageMult(mult) => apply_weapon_damage_mult(base, rvas, mult),
        MainThreadCmd::SpawnExplosionAhead { tag } => {
            if let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas)
                && let Some((_r, fwd, _u, pos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ped, rvas)
            {
                let len = fwd[0].hypot(fwd[1]).max(0.001);
                let target = [
                    pos[0] + (fwd[0] / len) * 16.0,
                    pos[1] + (fwd[1] / len) * 16.0,
                    pos[2] + 0.4,
                ];
                spawn_explosion_at(base, rvas, tag, target);
            }
        }
        MainThreadCmd::SpoonerSpawnProp {
            hash64,
            dynamic,
            invincible,
        } => {
            start_prop_spawn(base, rvas, hash64, dynamic, invincible);
        }
        MainThreadCmd::SpoonerSelectDelta(delta) => spooner_select_delta(rvas, delta),
        MainThreadCmd::SpoonerGrabNearest => spooner_grab_nearest(base, rvas),
        MainThreadCmd::SpoonerNudge {
            dx,
            dy,
            dz,
            dyaw_deg,
        } => spooner_nudge_selected(base, rvas, dx, dy, dz, dyaw_deg),
        MainThreadCmd::SpoonerToggleFreeze => spooner_toggle_freeze(base, rvas),
        MainThreadCmd::SpoonerToggleGod => spooner_toggle_god(base, rvas),
        MainThreadCmd::SpoonerDeleteSelected => spooner_delete_selected(base, rvas),
        MainThreadCmd::SpoonerClearAll => spooner_clear_all(base, rvas),
        MainThreadCmd::SetWorldGravity(scale) => apply_world_gravity(base, rvas, scale),
        MainThreadCmd::RemoveAllWeapons => apply_remove_all_weapons(base, rvas),
        MainThreadCmd::RefillAllAmmo => apply_refill_all_ammo(base, rvas),
        MainThreadCmd::ClearArea {
            vehicles,
            peds,
            props,
            radius,
        } => apply_clear_area(base, rvas, vehicles, peds, props, radius),
        MainThreadCmd::ExplodeNearbyVehicles { radius } => {
            apply_explode_nearby_vehicles(base, rvas, radius);
        }
        MainThreadCmd::LaunchNearbyPeds { radius } => apply_launch_nearby_peds(base, rvas, radius),
        MainThreadCmd::TeleportIntoNearestVehicle => {
            apply_teleport_into_nearest_vehicle(base, rvas);
        }
        MainThreadCmd::WarpIntoLastSpawnedVehicle => {
            let veh = DIAG_LAST_SPAWNED_VEH.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
            if veh > 0x10000 {
                let _ = warp_local_ped_into_vehicle(base, rvas, veh, 0);
            }
        }
        MainThreadCmd::FlipVehicleUpright => apply_flip_vehicle_upright(base, rvas),
        MainThreadCmd::DeleteCurrentVehicle => apply_delete_current_vehicle(base, rvas),
        MainThreadCmd::SetVehicleSecondaryRgb([r, g, b]) => {
            apply_vehicle_rgb_slot_f32(
                base,
                rvas,
                [f32::from(r) / 255.0, f32::from(g) / 255.0, f32::from(b) / 255.0],
                true,
            );
        }
        MainThreadCmd::SetVehicleDirtLevel(dirt) => apply_vehicle_dirt_level(base, rvas, dirt),
        MainThreadCmd::SetVehicleModKit(kit_id) => apply_vehicle_mod_kit(base, rvas, kit_id),
        MainThreadCmd::ToggleVehicleEngine => apply_toggle_vehicle_engine(base, rvas),
        MainThreadCmd::VehicleDoors { mode, door_idx } => {
            apply_vehicle_doors(base, rvas, mode, door_idx);

        MainThreadCmd::SetPlayerDamageProofFlag { flag, enable } => {
            apply_player_single_proof(base, rvas, flag, enable);
        }
        MainThreadCmd::ForcePlayerSkyfall => apply_player_skyfall(base, rvas),
        MainThreadCmd::RandomizePlayerWardrobe => apply_randomize_player_wardrobe(base, rvas),
        MainThreadCmd::SpawnPed {
            hash64,
            bodyguard,
            add_to_spooner,
        } => {
            let def_wep = DEFAULT_PED_WEAPON_HASH.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
            start_ped_spawn_ex(
                base,
                rvas,
                hash64,
                if bodyguard { 1 } else { 0 },
                if bodyguard { def_wep } else { 0 },
                bodyguard,
                add_to_spooner,
                None,
            );
        }
        MainThreadCmd::SpawnPedEx {
            hash64,
            role,
            weapon_hash32,
            invincible,
            add_to_spooner,
        } => start_ped_spawn_ex(
            base,
            rvas,
            hash64,
            role,
            weapon_hash32,
            invincible,
            add_to_spooner,
            None,
        ),
        MainThreadCmd::ClonePlayerPed {
            role,
            weapon_hash32,
            invincible,
        } => apply_clone_player_ped(base, rvas, role, weapon_hash32, invincible),
        MainThreadCmd::SpawnGangWarSquad {
            hash64,
            weapon_hash32,
            defenders,
            attackers,
        } => apply_spawn_gang_war_squad(base, rvas, hash64, weapon_hash32, defenders, attackers),
        MainThreadCmd::CommandDefenders { mode } => apply_command_defenders(base, rvas, mode),
        MainThreadCmd::ArmAllBodyguards { weapon_hash32 } => {
            apply_arm_all_bodyguards(base, rvas, weapon_hash32);
        }
        MainThreadCmd::ClearAttackers => apply_clear_attackers(base, rvas),
        MainThreadCmd::ForcePlayerRagdoll => apply_force_player_ragdoll(base, rvas),
        MainThreadCmd::ClearPlayerTasks => apply_clear_player_tasks(base, rvas),
        MainThreadCmd::SetVehicleInvisible(on) => apply_vehicle_invisible(base, rvas, on),
        MainThreadCmd::SetVehicleFrozen(on) => apply_vehicle_frozen(base, rvas, on),
        MainThreadCmd::SetVehicleBulletproofTires(on) => {
            apply_vehicle_bulletproof_tires(base, rvas, on);
        }
        MainThreadCmd::SetVehicleDriftMode(on) => apply_vehicle_drift_mode(base, rvas, on),
        MainThreadCmd::SetVehicleGripMult(mult) => apply_vehicle_grip_mult(base, rvas, mult),
        MainThreadCmd::VehicleStunt { kind } => apply_vehicle_stunt(base, rvas, kind),
        MainThreadCmd::ForcePushShockwave { radius, strength } => {
            apply_force_push_shockwave(base, rvas, radius, strength);
        }
        MainThreadCmd::FreezeNearbyVehicles { radius, freeze } => {
            apply_freeze_nearby_vehicles(base, rvas, radius, freeze);
        }
        MainThreadCmd::FreezeNearbyPeds { radius, freeze } => {
            apply_freeze_nearby_peds(base, rvas, radius, freeze);
        }
        MainThreadCmd::LaunchNearbyVehicles { radius, upward } => {
            apply_launch_nearby_vehicles(base, rvas, radius, upward);
        }
        MainThreadCmd::MakeNearbyPedsSurrender { radius } => {
            apply_make_nearby_peds_surrender(base, rvas, radius);

        MainThreadCmd::SpoonerSelectIndex(idx) => spooner_select_index(rvas, idx),
        MainThreadCmd::SpoonerTeleportToSelected => spooner_teleport_to_selected(base, rvas),
        MainThreadCmd::SpoonerBringSelected => spooner_bring_selected(base, rvas),
        MainThreadCmd::SpoonerTaskSelectedPed {

            spooner_adjust_attach_offset(dx, dy, dz);

            dpitch_deg,

            dyaw_deg,

        MainThreadCmd::SpoonerCloneSelected => spooner_clone_selected(base, rvas),
        MainThreadCmd::SpoonerToggleAttachPlayer => spooner_toggle_attach_player(rvas),
        MainThreadCmd::SpoonerTrackLastVehicle => spooner_track_last_vehicle(base, rvas),
        MainThreadCmd::SpoonerSpawnPlacedProp {

            apply_ped_clean_damage(base, rvas);

            apply_clear_bounty_and_heat(base, rvas);

                set_ped_config_flag(base, rvas, ped, flag, enable);
            }

            apply_refill_vehicle_fuel(base, rvas);

        MainThreadCmd::SetVehicleHeadlights(on) => {
            apply_vehicle_light_channel(base, rvas, 0, on);
        }
        MainThreadCmd::SetVehicleHighBeams(on) => {
            apply_vehicle_light_channel(base, rvas, 1, on);

/// Refreshes all read-only component pointers & inventory/weapon counters for `probe.rs`.
fn refresh_probe_diag(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, check_weapon_hash: u32) {
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some(ent_id) = trainer::safe_read::<u32>((ped + rvas.ped_entity_id) as usize) else {
        return;
    };
    if rvas.fn_get_wanted_comp_ex != 0 {
        let f: extern "system" fn(u32) -> u64 =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_wanted_comp_ex) as usize) };
        let wc = f(ent_id);
        if wc > 0x10000 {
            DIAG_WANTED_COMP.store(wc, Ordering::Relaxed);
        }
    }
    if rvas.fn_get_player_info != 0 {
        let f: extern "system" fn(u64) -> u64 =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_player_info) as usize) };
        let pi = f(ped);
        if pi > 0x10000 {
            DIAG_PLAYER_INFO.store(pi, Ordering::Relaxed);
        }
    }
    if rvas.fn_get_ped_ragdoll_comp != 0 {
        let f: extern "system" fn(u32) -> u64 =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_ped_ragdoll_comp) as usize) };
        let rc = f(ent_id);
        if rc > 0x10000 {
            DIAG_RAGDOLL_COMP.store(rc, Ordering::Relaxed);
        }
    }
    if let Some((_p, _id, inv)) = read_local_ped_inventory_alt(base, rvas) {
        update_inv_item_count_diag(inv);
    }
    if let Some((_mgr, cur)) = get_active_weapon_mgr_and_cur(base, rvas)
        && cur > 0x10000
    {
        let _ = read_weapon_clip_counts(cur, rvas);
    }
    if check_weapon_hash != 0 && has_ped_got_weapon_native(base, rvas, ped, check_weapon_hash) {
        DIAG_HAS_WEP_HITS.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
    refresh_cash_balances(base, rvas);
}

// Schema v5 Main-Thread Trainer Helpers (All 10 New Features)

fn apply_player_invisible(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, invisible: bool) {
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    if invisible {
        if rvas.fn_set_entity_alpha != 0 {
            let f: extern "system" fn(u64, u32, u8) =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_set_entity_alpha) as usize) };
            f(ped, 0, 0);
        }
    } else if rvas.fn_reset_entity_alpha != 0 {
        let f: extern "system" fn(u64) =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_reset_entity_alpha) as usize) };
        f(ped);
    }
}

fn set_ped_config_flag(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, ped: u64, flag: u32, enable: bool) {
    if rvas.fn_get_ped_config_flags_comp == 0 || flag >= 1120 {
        return;
    }
    let Some(ent_id) = trainer::safe_read::<u32>((ped + rvas.ped_entity_id) as usize) else {
        return;
    };
    let get_comp: extern "system" fn(u32) -> u64 =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_ped_config_flags_comp) as usize) };
    let comp = get_comp(ent_id);
    if comp < 0x10000 {
        return;
    }
    DIAG_CONFIG_FLAGS_COMP.store(comp, Ordering::Relaxed);
    let word_off = u64::from(flag >> 5) * 4;
    let bit = 1u32 << (flag & 31);
    for table_off in [rvas.ped_config_flags_base, rvas.ped_config_flags_override] {
        let addr = (comp + table_off + word_off) as usize;
        if let Some(cur) = trainer::safe_read::<u32>(addr) {
            let next = if enable { cur | bit } else { cur & !bit };
            let _ = trainer::safe_write::<u32>(addr, next);
        }
    }
}

fn apply_seatbelt(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, on: bool, loops: u64) {
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    // Verified `ePedScriptConfigFlags`:
    // 3=DontAllowToBeDraggedOutOfVehicle, 21=FallsOutOfVehicleWhenKilled,
    // 37=CanActivateRagdollWhenVehicleUpsideDown, 90=DisableJumpingFromVehiclesAfterLeader,
    // 125=DisableDragDamage.
    set_ped_config_flag(base, rvas, ped, 3, on);
    set_ped_config_flag(base, rvas, ped, 21, !on);
    set_ped_config_flag(base, rvas, ped, 37, !on);
    set_ped_config_flag(base, rvas, ped, 90, on);
    set_ped_config_flag(base, rvas, ped, 125, on);
    if on && read_current_vehicle(base, rvas).is_some() {
        apply_ped_no_ragdoll(base, rvas, true);
    } else if !on && (loops & LOOP_NO_RAGDOLL) == 0 {
        apply_ped_no_ragdoll(base, rvas, false);
    }
}

fn resolve_local_net_player(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) -> u64 {
    // 1. Primary Story Mode path: `get_ped_net_player(ped_ent_id, 0, 0)` (same helper used by `SetWantedLevel`).
    if rvas.fn_get_ped_net_player != 0
        && let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas)
        && let Some(ent_id) = trainer::safe_read::<u32>((ped + rvas.ped_entity_id) as usize)
    {
        let f: extern "system" fn(u32, u32, u32) -> u64 =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_ped_net_player) as usize) };
        let np = f(ent_id, 0, 0);
        if np > 0x10000 {
            return np;
        }
    }
    // 2. Fallback: walk `g_NetPlayerPool` for the active local player entry (`[entry + 0x2b58] == 1`).
    if let Some(np) = trainer::find_local_net_player_in_pool(base, rvas) {
        return np;
    }
    // 3. Last-resort fallback: `get_net_player(0)`.
    if rvas.fn_get_net_player != 0 {
        let get_np: extern "system" fn(u32) -> u64 =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_net_player) as usize) };
        let np = get_np(0);
        if np > 0x10000 {
            return np;
        }
    }
    0
}

fn apply_ignored_by_all(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, ignore: bool) {
    let np = resolve_local_net_player(base, rvas);
    if np > 0x10000 {
        DIAG_NET_PLAYER.store(np, Ordering::Relaxed);
        if rvas.fn_set_police_ignore_player != 0 {
            let f: extern "system" fn(u64, u8) = unsafe {
                std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_set_police_ignore_player) as usize)
            };
            f(np, u8::from(ignore));
        }
        if rvas.fn_set_everyone_ignore_player != 0 {
            let f: extern "system" fn(u64, u8) = unsafe {
                std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_set_everyone_ignore_player) as usize)
            };
            f(np, u8::from(ignore));
        }
    }
    if let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) {
        // Verified `ePedScriptConfigFlags`: 7=DontInfluenceWantedLevel,
        // 57=Avoidance_Ignored_by_All, 97=DisablePoliceInvestigatingBody,
        // 193=DontAttackPlayerWithoutWantedLevel.
        set_ped_config_flag(base, rvas, ped, 7, ignore);
        set_ped_config_flag(base, rvas, ped, 57, ignore);
        set_ped_config_flag(base, rvas, ped, 97, ignore);
        set_ped_config_flag(base, rvas, ped, 193, ignore);
        if ignore && rvas.fn_set_wanted_level != 0 {
            let f: extern "system" fn(u64, i32, u8, u8, u8) =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_set_wanted_level) as usize) };
            f(ped, 0, 1, 1, 1);
        }
    }
}

/// Counts real occupied `CInventoryItem*` slots inside `[inv + 0x10]`'s SwissTable
/// (`+0x60` group count, `+0x68` group array, stride `0x190`: 16 control bytes where
/// `(ctrl & 0x80) == 0` means occupied; `0x80` = empty, `0xfe` = deleted, `0xff` = sentinel).
fn update_inv_item_count_diag(inv: u64) -> u32 {
    if inv < 0x10000 {
        return 0;
    }
    let Some(inner) = trainer::safe_read::<u64>((inv + 0x10) as usize) else {
        return 0;
    };
    if inner < 0x10000 {
        return 0;
    }
    let Some(groups) = trainer::safe_read::<u32>((inner + 0x60) as usize) else {
        return 0;
    };
    let Some(table) = trainer::safe_read::<u64>((inner + 0x68) as usize) else {
        return 0;
    };
    if groups == 0 || groups > 4096 || table < 0x10000 {
        return 0;
    }
    let mut occupied = 0u32;
    for g in 0..u64::from(groups) {
        let g_addr = table + g * 0x190;
        let Some(ctrl) = trainer::safe_read::<[u8; 16]>(g_addr as usize) else {
            break;
        };
        for (s, &c) in ctrl.iter().enumerate() {
            if (c & 0x80) == 0 {
                let item_ptr_addr = g_addr + 0x10 + (s as u64) * 0x18 + 0x10;
                if let Some(p) = trainer::safe_read::<u64>(item_ptr_addr as usize)
                    && p > 0x10000
                {
                    occupied += 1;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    DIAG_INV_ITEM_COUNT.store(occupied, Ordering::Relaxed);
    occupied
}

fn has_ped_got_weapon_native(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, ped: u64, hash32: u32) -> bool {
    if ped < 0x10000 || hash32 == 0 || rvas.fn_has_ped_got_weapon == 0 {
        return false;
    }
    let f: extern "system" fn(u64, u32) -> u64 =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_has_ped_got_weapon) as usize) };
    f(ped, hash32) > 0x10000
}

fn read_local_ped_inventory_alt(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) -> Option<(u64, u32, u64)> {
    let ped = read_local_ped(base, rvas)?;
    let ent_id = trainer::safe_read::<u32>((ped + rvas.ped_entity_id) as usize)?;
    let fn_rva = if rvas.fn_get_ped_inv_alt != 0 {
        rvas.fn_get_ped_inv_alt
    } else {
        rvas.fn_get_ped_inventory
    };
    if fn_rva == 0 {
        return None;
    }
    let get_inv: extern "system" fn(u32) -> u64 =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + fn_rva) as usize) };
    let inv = get_inv(ent_id);
    if inv < 0x10000 {
        return None;
    }
    DIAG_INV_PTR.store(inv, Ordering::Relaxed);
    let _ = update_inv_item_count_diag(inv);
    Some((ped, ent_id, inv))
}

/// Adds a single weapon or ammo item directly into Story Mode `CPedInventory` via `inv_add_item_direct`
/// (bypassing online shop catalog gating), with `inv_add_item_by_hash` fallback.
fn add_inventory_item_by_hash(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, inv: u64, item_hash32: u32) -> u32 {
