    if item_hash32 == 0 || inv < 0x10000 || rvas.inv_add_item_req_vtable == 0 {
        return 0;
    }
    let mut req = trainer::InvAddItemRequest::default();
    let vtable_ptr = base + rvas.inv_add_item_req_vtable;
    req.raw[0x00..0x08].copy_from_slice(&vtable_ptr.to_le_bytes());
    req.raw[0x10..0x14].copy_from_slice(&rvas.add_item_reason.to_le_bytes());
    req.raw[0x18..0x20].copy_from_slice(&u64::from(item_hash32).to_le_bytes());
    let mut out_tx_id: u32 = 0;

    if rvas.fn_inv_add_item_direct != 0 {
        // SAFETY: verified 4-arg direct Story Mode add `AddItemDirect(inv, &out_tx, &req, flags=2)`.
        let add_direct: extern "system" fn(u64, *mut u32, *const trainer::InvAddItemRequest, u8) =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_inv_add_item_direct) as usize) };
        add_direct(inv, &mut out_tx_id, &req, 2);
    } else if rvas.fn_inv_add_item_by_hash != 0 {
        let zero_cb = trainer::InvZeroCallback::default();
        let add_fn: extern "system" fn(
            *mut u32,
            u64,
            *const trainer::InvAddItemRequest,
            *const trainer::InvZeroCallback,
        ) = unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_inv_add_item_by_hash) as usize) };
        add_fn(&mut out_tx_id, inv, &req, &zero_cb);
    }
    if out_tx_id != 0 {
        DIAG_LAST_GIVE_TX.store(out_tx_id, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
    let _ = update_inv_item_count_diag(inv);
    out_tx_id
}

fn force_equip_weapon_in_hand(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, ped: u64, hash32: u32) -> bool {
    if ped < 0x10000 || hash32 == 0 || rvas.fn_equip_ped_weapon == 0 {
        return false;
    }
    if !has_ped_got_weapon_native(base, rvas, ped, hash32) {
        return false;
    }
    DIAG_HAS_WEP_HITS.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
    // SAFETY: verified 7-arg `EquipPedWeapon(ped, hash32, bEquipNow=1, attachPoint=0, bForceInHand=1, bSkipCheck=1, reason=0)`.
    let equip_fn: extern "system" fn(u64, u32, u8, i32, u8, u8, u32) =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_equip_ped_weapon) as usize) };
    equip_fn(ped, hash32, 1, 0, 1, 1, 0);
    if let Some((_mgr, cur)) = get_active_weapon_mgr_and_cur(base, rvas)
        && cur > 0x10000
    {
        let (cur_clip, max_clip) = read_weapon_clip_counts(cur, rvas);
        if max_clip > 0 && cur_clip == 0 && rvas.fn_set_ammo_in_clip != 0 {
            let set_clip: extern "system" fn(u64, i32, i32) =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_set_ammo_in_clip) as usize) };
            set_clip(cur, max_clip, -1);
            let _ = read_weapon_clip_counts(cur, rvas);
        }
    }
    true
}

fn record_inv_diag(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, inv: u64) -> u32 {
    if inv < 0x10000 {
        return 0;
    }
    let mut inv_id = 0u32;
    if let Some(vt) = trainer::safe_read::<u64>(inv as usize)
        && vt > 0x10000
        && let Some(get_id_addr) = trainer::safe_read::<u64>((vt + 8) as usize)
        && get_id_addr > 0x10000
    {
        let get_id: extern "system" fn(u64) -> u32 =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute(get_id_addr as usize) };
        inv_id = get_id(inv);
        DIAG_INV_ID.store(inv_id, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
    if let Some(inner) = trainer::safe_read::<u64>((inv + 0x10) as usize)
        && inner > 0x10000
        && let Some(p70) = trainer::safe_read::<u64>((inner + 0x70) as usize)
    {
        DIAG_INV_INNER_PTR70.store(p70, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
    if rvas.inv_system_mgr != 0
        && let Some(st) = trainer::safe_read::<u32>((base + rvas.inv_system_mgr + 4) as usize)
    {
        DIAG_INV_SYS_STATE.store(st, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
    inv_id
}

/// Directly grants a single weapon + reserve ammo into Story Mode `CPedInventory` using the
/// title's own `CWeaponInventory::AddWeapon` (populating full `CWeaponItemMetadata` + weapon
/// wheel slot placement via `desc+0x64` item-info hash, with ordered overflow/table fallbacks)
/// + `CWeaponInventory::AddWeaponAmmo`.
fn add_weapon_via_wep_inv(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, inv: u64, weapon_hash32: u32) -> u32 {
    if weapon_hash32 == 0 || inv < 0x10000 || rvas.fn_inv_add_weapon == 0 {
        return 0;
    }
    let inv_id = record_inv_diag(base, rvas, inv);
    let reason = if rvas.weapon_add_reason != 0 {
        rvas.weapon_add_reason
    } else if rvas.give_loadout_reason != 0 {
        rvas.give_loadout_reason
    } else {
        rvas.add_item_reason
    };
    let zero_cb = trainer::InvZeroCallback::default();
    // SAFETY: verified 4-arg `CWeaponInventory::AddWeapon(inv+0x190, &mut out_tx, &desc, &zero_cb)`.
    let add_wep: extern "system" fn(
        u64,
        *mut u32,
        *const trainer::WeaponAddDesc,
        *const trainer::InvZeroCallback,
    ) = unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_inv_add_weapon) as usize) };

    // Ordered `WeaponAddDesc` attempts matching native engine callers:
    //  1: `desc+0x64` (item-info table hash) -> player on-person weapon wheel (`target_inv_id = inv_id`, `bypass = 0`)
    //  2: `desc+0x64` -> secondary/overflow weapon slots (`target_inv_id = 0`, `bypass = 0`) when holsters are full
    //  3: `desc+0x64` -> on-person wheel with carry-limit check bypassed (`desc+0x81 = 1`)
    //  4: `desc+0x64` -> secondary slots with carry-limit check bypassed
    //  5: `desc+0x60` (weapon-info table hash) -> on-person wheel fallback
    let attempts: [(u32, usize, u32, u8); 5] = [
        (1, 0x64, inv_id, 0),
        (2, 0x64, 0, 0),
        (3, 0x64, inv_id, 1),
        (4, 0x64, 0, 1),
        (5, 0x60, inv_id, 0),
    ];

    let mut out_tx_id: u32 = 0;
    let mut matched_mode: u32 = 0;
    for (mode, hash_off, target_inv_id, bypass_limit) in attempts {
        let mut desc = trainer::WeaponAddDesc::default();
        // `+0x28..+0x30 = (1, 1)` (use explicit qty = 1), `+0x60` OR `+0x64 = weapon_hash32`,
        // `+0x6c = target_inv_id`, `+0x70 = reason`, `+0x74 = 0` (ammo added cleanly via `AddWeaponAmmo`),
        // `+0x78 = default_slot_hash` (auto-picks free slot), `+0x7c = 2` (allow overflow fallback),
        // `+0x81 = bypass_limit`.
        desc.raw[0x28..0x2c].copy_from_slice(&1u32.to_le_bytes());
        desc.raw[0x2c..0x30].copy_from_slice(&1u32.to_le_bytes());
        desc.raw[hash_off..hash_off + 4].copy_from_slice(&weapon_hash32.to_le_bytes());
        desc.raw[0x6c..0x70].copy_from_slice(&target_inv_id.to_le_bytes());
        desc.raw[0x70..0x74].copy_from_slice(&reason.to_le_bytes());
        desc.raw[0x78..0x7c].copy_from_slice(&rvas.default_slot_hash.to_le_bytes());
        desc.raw[0x7c..0x80].copy_from_slice(&2u32.to_le_bytes());
        desc.raw[0x81] = bypass_limit;

        let mut tx: u32 = 0;
        add_wep(inv + 0x190, &mut tx, &desc, &zero_cb);
        if tx != 0 {
            out_tx_id = tx;
            matched_mode = mode;
            break;
        }
    }
    WEAPONS_GIVEN.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
    if let Ok(mut hist) = GRANTED_WEP_HASHES.try_lock()
        && !hist.contains(&weapon_hash32)
        && hist.len() < 128
    {
        hist.push(weapon_hash32);
    }
    if out_tx_id != 0 {
        DIAG_LAST_WEP_ADD_TX.store(out_tx_id, Ordering::Relaxed);
        DIAG_LAST_WEP_ADD_MODE.store(matched_mode, Ordering::Relaxed);
        DIAG_LAST_GIVE_TX.store(out_tx_id, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }

    if rvas.fn_inv_add_weapon_ammo != 0 {
        let ammo_reason = if rvas.give_loadout_reason != 0 {
            rvas.give_loadout_reason
        } else {
            reason
        };
        let mut ammo_tx_id: u32 = 0;
        // SAFETY: verified 5-arg `CWeaponInventory::AddWeaponAmmo(inv+0x190, &mut tx, weapon_hash32, 999i64, reason)`.
        let add_ammo: extern "system" fn(u64, *mut u32, u32, i64, u32) =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_inv_add_weapon_ammo) as usize) };
        add_ammo(inv + 0x190, &mut ammo_tx_id, weapon_hash32, 999, ammo_reason);
        if ammo_tx_id != 0 {
            DIAG_LAST_AMMO_ADD_TX.store(ammo_tx_id, Ordering::Relaxed);
        }
    }
    let _ = update_inv_item_count_diag(inv);
    out_tx_id
}

/// Directly adds one or more weapons (with max ammo via `flags = 4`) into Story Mode `CPedInventory`
/// using Engine's own `CInventory::CreateBatchTx` -> `CLoadOutWeapon::AddToTx` -> `CInventory::SubmitBatchTx`
/// pipeline — completely bypassing `CInventoryAwardDatabase` shop/entitlement gating!
fn give_weapons_batch_native(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, weapon_hashes: &[u32]) -> u32 {
    if weapon_hashes.is_empty()
        || rvas.fn_inv_create_batch_tx == 0
        || rvas.fn_loadout_weapon_add_to_tx == 0
        || rvas.fn_inv_submit_batch_tx == 0
    {
        return 0;
    }
    let Some((ped, _ent_id, inv)) = read_local_ped_inventory_alt(base, rvas) else {
        return 0;
    };
    record_inv_diag(base, rvas, inv);
    let reason = if rvas.give_loadout_reason != 0 {
        rvas.give_loadout_reason
    } else {
        rvas.add_item_reason
    };
    // SAFETY: verified 4-arg `CInventory::CreateBatchTx(inv, reason, 0, 0) -> CInventoryBatchTransaction*`.
    let create_batch: extern "system" fn(u64, u32, u8, u8) -> u64 =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_inv_create_batch_tx) as usize) };
    let mut batch_tx = create_batch(inv, reason, 0, 0);
    DIAG_LAST_BATCH_PTR.store(batch_tx, Ordering::Relaxed);
    if batch_tx < 0x10000 {
        DIAG_LAST_BATCH_CNT.store(0, Ordering::Relaxed);
        return 0;
    }
    // SAFETY: verified 7-arg `CLoadOutWeapon::AddToTx(&LoadOutWeapon, ped, 0, &mut out_entry, batch_tx, bEquip=1, reason)`.
    let add_wep: extern "system" fn(
        *const trainer::LoadOutWeapon,
        u64,
        u64,
        *mut [u8; 0x20],
        u64,
        u8,
        u32,
    ) = unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_loadout_weapon_add_to_tx) as usize) };
    for &h in weapon_hashes {
        if h == 0 {
            continue;
        }
        let lo = trainer::LoadOutWeapon {
            weapon_hash32: h,
            ammo: 0,
            flags: 0,
            ..Default::default()
        };
        let mut out_entry = [0u8; 0x20];
        add_wep(&lo, ped, 0, &mut out_entry, batch_tx, 1, reason);
        WEAPONS_GIVEN.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
    let batch_cnt = trainer::safe_read::<u32>((batch_tx + 0x16c) as usize).unwrap_or(0);
    DIAG_LAST_BATCH_CNT.store(batch_cnt, Ordering::Relaxed);
    let mut out_tx_id: u32 = 0;
    // SAFETY: verified 3-arg `CInventory::SubmitBatchTx(inv, &mut out_tx_id, &mut batch_tx)`.
    // Automatically frees empty batches cleanly if no items qualified.
    let submit_batch: extern "system" fn(u64, *mut u32, *mut u64) =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_inv_submit_batch_tx) as usize) };
    submit_batch(inv, &mut out_tx_id, &mut batch_tx);
    if out_tx_id != 0 {
        DIAG_LAST_GIVE_TX.store(out_tx_id, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
    let _ = update_inv_item_count_diag(inv);
    out_tx_id
}

fn schedule_deferred_weapon_equip(hashes: &[u32]) {
    let mut arr = [0u32; 8];
    let mut count = 0usize;
    for &h in hashes {
        if h != 0 && count < arr.len() && !arr[..count].contains(&h) {
            arr[count] = h;
            count += 1;
        }
    }
    if count == 0 {
        return;
    }
    if let Ok(mut slot) = PENDING_WEP_EQUIP.try_lock() {
        *slot = Some(PendingWeaponEquip {
            hashes: arr,
            count,
            ticks_left: 24,
        });
        HAS_PENDING_WEP_EQUIP.store(true, Ordering::Release);
    }
}

fn step_pending_weapon_equip(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let mut job = match PENDING_WEP_EQUIP.try_lock() {
        Ok(mut g) => match g.take() {
            Some(j) => j,
            None => {
                HAS_PENDING_WEP_EQUIP.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
                return;
            }
        },
        Err(_) => return,
    };
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        HAS_PENDING_WEP_EQUIP.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
        return;
    };
    for &h in &job.hashes[..job.count] {
        if force_equip_weapon_in_hand(base, rvas, ped, h) {
            HAS_PENDING_WEP_EQUIP.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
            return;
        }
    }
    if job.ticks_left > 1 {
        job.ticks_left -= 1;
        if let Ok(mut g) = PENDING_WEP_EQUIP.try_lock() {
            *g = Some(job);
        } else {
            HAS_PENDING_WEP_EQUIP.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
        }
    } else {
        HAS_PENDING_WEP_EQUIP.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
}

fn give_single_weapon(
    base: u64,
    rvas: &RvaTable,
    hash32: u32,
    award_hash32: u32,
    ammo_award_hash32: u32,
    equip: bool,
) {
    if hash32 == 0 {
        return;
    }
    let Some((ped, _ent_id, inv)) = read_local_ped_inventory_alt(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    if rvas.fn_inv_add_weapon != 0 {
        let tx = add_weapon_via_wep_inv(base, rvas, inv, hash32);
        if tx == 0
            && rvas.fn_loadout_weapon_add_to_tx != 0
            && rvas.fn_inv_create_batch_tx != 0
            && rvas.fn_inv_submit_batch_tx != 0
        {
            let _ = give_weapons_batch_native(base, rvas, &[hash32]);
        }
    } else if rvas.fn_loadout_weapon_add_to_tx != 0
        && rvas.fn_inv_create_batch_tx != 0
        && rvas.fn_inv_submit_batch_tx != 0
    {
        let _tx = give_weapons_batch_native(base, rvas, &[hash32]);
    } else {
        let grant_hash = if award_hash32 != 0 {
            award_hash32
        } else {
            hash32
        };
        let _tx = add_inventory_item_by_hash(base, rvas, inv, grant_hash);
        if ammo_award_hash32 != 0 && ammo_award_hash32 != grant_hash {
            let _ammo_tx = add_inventory_item_by_hash(base, rvas, inv, ammo_award_hash32);
        }
        WEAPONS_GIVEN.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
    if equip && !force_equip_weapon_in_hand(base, rvas, ped, hash32) {
        // Inventory transaction commits asynchronously 1-3 ticks later — retry hand equip smoothly!
        schedule_deferred_weapon_equip(&[hash32]);
    }
}

/// Grants an entire built-in engine weapon loadout from `g_LoadoutTable` via `give_weapon_inner`.
fn give_weapon_loadout(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, loadout_hash32: u32) {
    if loadout_hash32 == 0 || rvas.fn_give_weapon_inner == 0 {
        return;
    }
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let mut out_tx_id: u32 = 0;
    let cb1 = [0u64; 8];
    let cb2 = [0u64; 8];
    let give_loadout: extern "system" fn(
        *mut u32,
        u64,
        u32,
        u32,
        u8,
        *const [u64; 8],
        *const [u64; 8],
    ) = unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_give_weapon_inner) as usize) };
    give_loadout(
        &mut out_tx_id,
        ped,
        loadout_hash32,
        rvas.give_loadout_reason,
        0,
        &cb1,
        &cb2,
    );
    if out_tx_id != 0 {
        DIAG_LAST_GIVE_TX.store(out_tx_id, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
    WEAPONS_GIVEN.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
}

fn step_weapon_give_queue(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let mut batch = [(0u32, 0u32, 0u32); 6];
    let mut count = 0usize;
    let now_empty;
    if let Ok(mut q) = WEAPON_GIVE_QUEUE.try_lock() {
        while count < batch.len() {
            if let Some(triple) = q.pop_front() {
                batch[count] = triple;
                count += 1;
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
        now_empty = q.is_empty();
        if now_empty {
            HAS_WEAPON_QUEUE.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
        }
    } else {
        return;
    }
    if count == 0 {
        return;
    }
    let mut hashes = [0u32; 6];
    for i in 0..count {
        hashes[i] = batch[i].0;
    }
    if let Ok(mut cands) = WEAPON_EQUIP_CANDS.try_lock() {
        for &h in &hashes[..count] {
            if h != 0 && cands.len() < 8 && !cands.contains(&h) {
                cands.push(h);
            }
        }
    }
    if rvas.fn_inv_add_weapon != 0
        && let Some((_ped, _id, inv)) = read_local_ped_inventory_alt(base, rvas)
    {
        let mut any_ok = false;
        for &h in &hashes[..count] {
            if add_weapon_via_wep_inv(base, rvas, inv, h) != 0 {
                any_ok = true;
            }
        }
        if !any_ok
            && rvas.fn_loadout_weapon_add_to_tx != 0
            && rvas.fn_inv_create_batch_tx != 0
            && rvas.fn_inv_submit_batch_tx != 0
        {
            let _ = give_weapons_batch_native(base, rvas, &hashes[..1]);
        }
    } else if rvas.fn_loadout_weapon_add_to_tx != 0
        && rvas.fn_inv_create_batch_tx != 0
        && rvas.fn_inv_submit_batch_tx != 0
    {
        let _tx = give_weapons_batch_native(base, rvas, &hashes[..count]);
    } else {
        for &(h, aw, ammo_aw) in &batch[..count] {
            give_single_weapon(base, rvas, h, aw, ammo_aw, false);
        }
    }
    if now_empty {
        let cands: Vec<u32> = WEAPON_EQUIP_CANDS
            .try_lock()
            .map(|mut v| std::mem::take(&mut *v))
            .unwrap_or_default();
        if !cands.is_empty() {
            schedule_deferred_weapon_equip(&cands);
        }
    }
}

fn get_active_weapon_mgr_and_cur(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) -> Option<(u64, u64)> {
    if rvas.fn_get_ped_weapon_mgr == 0 {
        return None;
    }
    let ped = read_local_ped(base, rvas)?;
    let ent_id = trainer::safe_read::<u32>((ped + rvas.ped_entity_id) as usize)?;
    let get_mgr: extern "system" fn(u32) -> u64 =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_ped_weapon_mgr) as usize) };
    let mgr = get_mgr(ent_id);
    if mgr < 0x10000 {
        return None;
    }
    DIAG_WEP_MGR.store(mgr, Ordering::Relaxed);
    let cur = if rvas.fn_get_current_weapon != 0 {
        let get_cur: extern "system" fn(u64, u32) -> u64 =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_current_weapon) as usize) };
        let w = get_cur(mgr + rvas.wep_mgr_active_slot, 0);
        if w > 0x10000 { w } else { 0 }
    } else {
        0
    };
    DIAG_CUR_WEP.store(cur, Ordering::Relaxed);
    Some((mgr, cur))
}

/// Collects ALL carried `CWeapon*` instances on the local player (active hand weapon PLUS every
/// holstered/slung firearm in `CWeaponManager` `[mgr + wep_mgr_array]` via `fn_resolve_wep_from_slot`).
fn collect_all_carried_weapons(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) -> Vec<u64> {
    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(8);
    let Some((mgr, cur)) = get_active_weapon_mgr_and_cur(base, rvas) else {
        return out;
    };
    if cur > 0x10000 {
        out.push(cur);
    }
    if rvas.fn_resolve_wep_from_slot != 0
        && let (Some(arr_ptr), Some(cnt)) = (
            trainer::safe_read::<u64>((mgr + rvas.wep_mgr_array) as usize),
            trainer::safe_read::<u16>((mgr + rvas.wep_mgr_count) as usize),
        )
        && arr_ptr > 0x10000
    {
        let resolve_slot: extern "system" fn(u64) -> u64 =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_resolve_wep_from_slot) as usize) };
        for i in 0..usize::from(cnt.min(32)) {
            if let Some(slot_entry) = trainer::safe_read::<u64>((arr_ptr + (i as u64) * 8) as usize)
                && slot_entry > 0x10000
            {
                let wep = resolve_slot(slot_entry);
                if wep > 0x10000 && !out.contains(&wep) {
                    out.push(wep);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    out
}

/// Reads the live `(cur_clip, max_clip)` counts from a verified `CWeapon*` struct.
fn read_weapon_clip_counts(cur: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) -> (i32, i32) {
    if cur < 0x10000 {
        return (0, 0);
    }
    let max_clip = trainer::safe_read::<i32>((cur + rvas.wep_max_clip) as usize)
        .unwrap_or(0)
        .clamp(0, 999);
    let mut cur_clip = 0i32;
    let flags_b = trainer::safe_read::<u8>((cur + 0x11cb) as usize).unwrap_or(0);
    if (flags_b & 2) != 0
        && let (Some(slot_arr), Some(slot_cnt), Some(slot_idx)) = (
            trainer::safe_read::<u64>((cur + 0x328) as usize),
            trainer::safe_read::<u16>((cur + 0x330) as usize),
            trainer::safe_read::<u32>((cur + 0x338) as usize),
        )
        && slot_arr > 0x10000
        && slot_idx < u32::from(slot_cnt)
    {
        cur_clip = trainer::safe_read::<i32>((slot_arr + u64::from(slot_idx) * 20 + 0x0c) as usize)
            .unwrap_or(0);
    }
    DIAG_CUR_CLIP.store(cur_clip as u32, Ordering::Relaxed);
    DIAG_MAX_CLIP.store(max_clip as u32, Ordering::Relaxed);
    (cur_clip, max_clip)
}

fn apply_weapon_inf_ammo(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, enable: bool) {
    // 1. Native ped-wide `SET_PED_INFINITE_AMMO` on `CPedInventory->m_AmmoStorage (+0x190)`.
    if rvas.fn_set_ped_inf_ammo != 0
        && let Some((_ped, _ent_id, inv)) = read_local_ped_inventory_alt(base, rvas)
    {
        let set_ped_inf: extern "system" fn(u64, u8) =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_set_ped_inf_ammo) as usize) };
        set_ped_inf(inv + 0x190, u8::from(enable));
    }
    // 2. Per-weapon `CWeapon::SetInfiniteAmmo` (bit 4 on `wep_inf_ammo_byte`).
    if rvas.fn_set_weapon_infinite_ammo == 0 {
        return;
    }
    let Some((mgr, cur)) = get_active_weapon_mgr_and_cur(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let set_inf: extern "system" fn(u64, u8) =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_set_weapon_infinite_ammo) as usize) };
    if cur > 0x10000 {
        let _ = read_weapon_clip_counts(cur, rvas);
        set_inf(cur, u8::from(enable));
    }
    if rvas.fn_resolve_wep_from_slot != 0
        && let (Some(arr_ptr), Some(cnt)) = (
            trainer::safe_read::<u64>((mgr + rvas.wep_mgr_array) as usize),
            trainer::safe_read::<u16>((mgr + rvas.wep_mgr_count) as usize),
        )
        && arr_ptr > 0x10000
    {
        // SAFETY: verified 1-arg `ResolveWeaponFromSlot(slot_entry*) -> CWeapon*`.
        // Elements of `[mgr + wep_mgr_array]` are weapon-slot descriptors, NOT raw `CWeapon*`!
        let resolve_slot: extern "system" fn(u64) -> u64 =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_resolve_wep_from_slot) as usize) };
        for i in 0..usize::from(cnt.min(32)) {
            if let Some(slot_entry) = trainer::safe_read::<u64>((arr_ptr + (i as u64) * 8) as usize)
                && slot_entry > 0x10000
            {
                let wep = resolve_slot(slot_entry);
                if wep > 0x10000 && wep != cur {
                    set_inf(wep, u8::from(enable));
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

/// Native `SET_PED_INFINITE_AMMO_CLIP` + ped ammo-comp bit 11 + real `CWeapon::SetAmmoInClip`.
/// Never alters weapon ammo type, so normal reloading remains 100% intact when turned OFF!
fn apply_weapon_no_reload(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, enable: bool) {
    if let Some((_ped, ent_id, inv)) = read_local_ped_inventory_alt(base, rvas) {
        if rvas.fn_set_ped_inf_clip != 0 {
            let set_inf_clip: extern "system" fn(u64, u8) =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_set_ped_inf_clip) as usize) };
            set_inf_clip(inv + 0x190, u8::from(enable));
        }
        if rvas.fn_get_ped_ammo_comp != 0 {
            let get_comp: extern "system" fn(u32) -> u64 =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_ped_ammo_comp) as usize) };
            let comp = get_comp(ent_id);
            if comp > 0x10000 {
                DIAG_AMMO_COMP.store(comp, Ordering::Relaxed);
                let addr = (comp + 0x15d4) as usize;
                if let Some(cur_bits) = trainer::safe_read::<u32>(addr) {
                    let next = if enable {
                        cur_bits | (1u32 << 11)
                    } else {
                        cur_bits & !(1u32 << 11)
                    };
                    let _ = trainer::safe_write::<u32>(addr, next);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if !enable {
        return;
    }
    let Some((_mgr, cur)) = get_active_weapon_mgr_and_cur(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    if cur < 0x10000 {
        return;
    }
    let (cur_clip, max_clip) = read_weapon_clip_counts(cur, rvas);
    if max_clip > 0 && cur_clip < max_clip && rvas.fn_set_ammo_in_clip != 0 {
        // SAFETY: verified 3-arg `CWeapon::SetAmmoInClip(CWeapon*, i32 count, i32 slot_idx=-1)`.
        let set_clip: extern "system" fn(u64, i32, i32) =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_set_ammo_in_clip) as usize) };
        set_clip(cur, max_clip, -1);
        let _ = read_weapon_clip_counts(cur, rvas);
    }
}

fn apply_weapon_damage_mult(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, mult: f32) {
    if rvas.fn_get_ped_damage_comp == 0 {
        return;
    }
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let get_comp: extern "system" fn(u64) -> u64 =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_ped_damage_comp) as usize) };
    let comp = get_comp(ped);
    if comp < 0x10000 {
        return;
    }
    DIAG_DAMAGE_COMP.store(comp, Ordering::Relaxed);
    let v = mult.clamp(0.1, 100.0);
    let _ = trainer::safe_write::<f32>((comp + rvas.ped_damage_mult_off) as usize, v);
    let _ = trainer::safe_write::<f32>((comp + rvas.ped_veh_damage_mult_off) as usize, v);
}

fn spawn_explosion_at(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, tag: i32, pos: [f32; 3]) {
    if rvas.fn_add_explosion == 0 {
        return;
    }
    let mut args = trainer::build_explosion_args(tag, pos, base, rvas);
    // SAFETY: verified 3-arg `AddExplosion(CExplosionArgs* aligned16, CEntity* opt, u8 force)`.
    let add_expl: extern "system" fn(*mut trainer::ExplosionArgs, u64, u8) -> u8 =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_add_explosion) as usize) };
    let _ = add_expl(&mut args, 0, 0);
    METEORS_DROPPED.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
}

fn next_rand_u64() -> u64 {
    let mut s = METEOR_SEED.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
    s ^= s << 13;
    s ^= s >> 7;
    s ^= s << 17;
    METEOR_SEED.store(s, Ordering::Relaxed);
    s
}

fn step_meteor_shower(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, tick: u64) {
    if rvas.fn_add_explosion == 0 {
        return;
    }
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some((_r, _f, _u, pos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ped, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let r1 = next_rand_u64().wrapping_add(tick.wrapping_mul(0x9E37_79B9));
    let r2 = next_rand_u64();
    let angle = ((r1 & 0xFFFF) as f32 / 65536.0) * std::f32::consts::TAU;
    let dist = 14.0 + ((r2 & 0xFFFF) as f32 / 65536.0) * 36.0;
    let airburst = if (r1 >> 20) & 3 == 0 { 10.0 } else { 0.4 };
    const METEOR_TAGS: [i32; 5] = [4, 5, 18, 29, 0];
    let tag = METEOR_TAGS[((r2 >> 16) as usize) % METEOR_TAGS.len()];
    let impact = [
        pos[0] + angle.cos() * dist,
        pos[1] + angle.sin() * dist,
        pos[2] + airburst,
    ];
    spawn_explosion_at(base, rvas, tag, impact);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Object Spooner: Async Streaming Spawn, Manipulation, Freeze, God & Delete
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

fn start_prop_spawn(
    base: u64,
    rvas: &RvaTable,
    hash64: u64,
    dynamic: bool,
    invincible: bool,
) {
    if hash64 == 0
        || rvas.fn_get_model_id_from_hash64 == 0
        || rvas.fn_request_model_by_id == 0
        || rvas.fn_has_model_loaded == 0
        || rvas.fn_object_params_init == 0
        || rvas.fn_create_object_direct == 0
    {
        return;
    }
    // Release any previous pending prop streaming handle before issuing a new request.
    if let Ok(mut p) = PENDING_PROP_SPAWN.try_lock()
        && let Some(mut old) = p.take()
    {
        release_str_request(base, rvas, &mut old.token);
        HAS_PENDING_PROP.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }

    let model_id = resolve_model_id_any(base, rvas, hash64);
    DIAG_LAST_PROP_MODEL_ID.store(model_id, Ordering::Relaxed);
    if (model_id & 0x3F_FFFF) == 0x3F_FFFF {
        DIAG_LAST_PROP_LOADED.store(0, Ordering::Relaxed);
        return;
    }

    // `create_object_direct` handles its own async object model streaming internally (matching
    // native `CREATE_OBJECT`, which does NOT gate on `request_model_by_id` first!).
    DIAG_LAST_PROP_LOADED.store(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
    finish_prop_spawn(base, rvas, hash64, model_id, dynamic, invincible);
}

fn step_pending_prop_spawn(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let mut job = match PENDING_PROP_SPAWN.try_lock() {
        Ok(mut g) => match g.take() {
            Some(j) => j,
            None => {
                HAS_PENDING_PROP.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
                return;
            }
        },
        Err(_) => return,
    };
    if rvas.fn_has_model_loaded == 0 || job.retries_left == 0 {
        release_str_request(base, rvas, &mut job.token);
        HAS_PENDING_PROP.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
        if let Ok(mut s) = SPOONER_STATE.try_lock() {
            s.hud.pending_spawn = false;
        }
        return;
    }

    // ONLY poll `has_model_loaded(&job.token)` — NEVER re-call `request_model_by_id` (which zeros token)!
    let has_loaded: extern "system" fn(*const u32) -> u8 =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_has_model_loaded) as usize) };
    let loaded = has_loaded(&job.token);
    DIAG_LAST_PROP_LOADED.store(u32::from(loaded), Ordering::Relaxed);
    if loaded != 0 {
        HAS_PENDING_PROP.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
        let model_id = resolve_model_id_any(base, rvas, job.hash64);
        finish_prop_spawn(base, rvas, job.hash64, model_id, job.dynamic, job.invincible);
        release_str_request(base, rvas, &mut job.token);
    } else {
        job.retries_left -= 1;
        if job.retries_left > 0 {
            if let Ok(mut g) = PENDING_PROP_SPAWN.try_lock() {
                *g = Some(job);
            } else {
                release_str_request(base, rvas, &mut job.token);
                HAS_PENDING_PROP.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
            }
        } else {
            release_str_request(base, rvas, &mut job.token);
            HAS_PENDING_PROP.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
            if let Ok(mut s) = SPOONER_STATE.try_lock() {
                s.hud.pending_spawn = false;
            }
        }
    }
}

fn finish_prop_spawn(
    base: u64,
    rvas: &RvaTable,
    hash64: u64,
    model_id: u32,
    dynamic: bool,
    invincible: bool,
) {
    if rvas.fn_object_params_init == 0 || rvas.fn_create_object_direct == 0 {
        return;
    }
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some((_r, fwd, _u, pos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ped, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let spawn_pos = if (LOOP_MASK.load(Ordering::Relaxed) & LOOP_SPOONER_MODE) != 0
        && let Some((_cr, cf, _cu, cp)) = trainer::read_camera_mat34(base, rvas)
    {
        [
            cp[0] + cf[0] * 6.5,
            cp[1] + cf[1] * 6.5,
            (cp[2] + cf[2] * 6.5).max(pos[2] - 0.5),
        ]
    } else {
        let len = fwd[0].hypot(fwd[1]).max(0.001);
        [
            pos[0] + (fwd[0] / len) * 3.8,
            pos[1] + (fwd[1] / len) * 3.8,
            pos[2] + 0.25,
        ]
    };

    // Direct scrThread-free `CObjectCreationParams` + `CObjectPopulation::CreateObject`:
    // Zero `scrThread` TLS usage, 16-byte-aligned params, valid identity 3x4 basis matrix at
    // `+0x00..+0x40` (matching native `CREATE_OBJECT`), & zeroed 32-byte callback slots!
    let mut params = trainer::ObjectCreationParams::default();
    let init_params: extern "system" fn(*mut trainer::ObjectCreationParams, u64, u32) -> *mut u8 =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_object_params_init) as usize) };
    let _ = init_params(&mut params, hash64, 5);
    // Write identity orthonormal basis `[right=(1,0,0,0), fwd=(0,1,0,0), up=(0,0,1,0)]` at `+0x00..+0x30`
    // and world XYZ at `+0x30..+0x40`, local non-network flag `2` at `+0x40`, and resolved `model_id` at `+0x4c`.
    let one_b = 1.0f32.to_le_bytes();
    params.raw[0x00..0x30].fill(0);
    params.raw[0x00..0x04].copy_from_slice(&one_b);
    params.raw[0x14..0x18].copy_from_slice(&one_b);
    params.raw[0x28..0x2c].copy_from_slice(&one_b);
    params.raw[0x30..0x34].copy_from_slice(&spawn_pos[0].to_le_bytes());
    params.raw[0x34..0x38].copy_from_slice(&spawn_pos[1].to_le_bytes());
    params.raw[0x38..0x3c].copy_from_slice(&spawn_pos[2].to_le_bytes());
    params.raw[0x3c..0x40].copy_from_slice(&0.0f32.to_le_bytes());
    params.raw[0x40] = 2;
    if (model_id & 0x3F_FFFF) != 0x3F_FFFF {
        params.raw[0x4c..0x50].copy_from_slice(&model_id.to_le_bytes());
    }
    // Unique non-zero token at `+0x6c`.
    let tok = PROP_TOKEN_SEQ.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
    params.raw[0x6c..0x70].copy_from_slice(&tok.to_le_bytes());
    // Set dynamic/physics flag bits at `+0x91`/`+0x92`.
    params.raw[0x91] |= 1;
    let mut b92 = params.raw[0x92] & 0xf6;
    if dynamic {
        b92 |= 1;
    }
    params.raw[0x92] = b92;

    let z0 = [0u64; 4];
    let z1 = [0u64; 4];
    let z2 = [0u64; 4];
    let z3 = [0u64; 4];
    let create_direct: extern "system" fn(
        *mut trainer::ObjectCreationParams,
        *const [u64; 4],
        *const [u64; 4],
        *const [u64; 4],
        *const [u64; 4],
    ) -> i32 = unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_create_object_direct) as usize) };
    let req_id = create_direct(&mut params, &z0, &z1, &z2, &z3);
    DIAG_LAST_PROP_REQ.store(req_id as u32, Ordering::Relaxed);

    if req_id != -1 {
        // Direct async object creation accepted: locate the newly spawned `CObject*` in `g_ObjectPool`!
        if !try_attach_spawned_prop(base, rvas, hash64, spawn_pos, dynamic, invincible)
            && let Ok(mut p) = PENDING_PROP_LOCATE.try_lock()
        {
            *p = Some(PendingPropLocate {
                hash64,
                spawn_pos,
                dynamic,
                invincible,
                retries_left: 20,
            });
            HAS_PENDING_PROP_LOCATE.store(true, Ordering::Release);
        }
    } else if let Ok(mut s) = SPOONER_STATE.try_lock() {
        s.hud.pending_spawn = false;
    }
}

fn try_attach_spawned_prop(
    base: u64,
    rvas: &RvaTable,
    hash64: u64,
    spawn_pos: [f32; 3],
    dynamic: bool,
    invincible: bool,
) -> bool {
    let existing: Vec<u64> = SPOONER_STATE
        .try_lock()
        .map(|s| s.entities.iter().map(|e| e.ptr).collect())
        .unwrap_or_default();
    let Some(obj_ptr) = trainer::find_nearest_object_in_pool(base, rvas, spawn_pos, 5.5, &existing)
    else {
        return false;
    };
    PROP_SPAWN_SUCCESSES.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
    if invincible {
        call_damage_proof(base, rvas, obj_ptr, true);
    }
    let frozen = !dynamic;
    if frozen && rvas.fn_phys_freeze != 0 {
        let f: extern "system" fn(u64) =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_phys_freeze) as usize) };
        f(obj_ptr);
    }
    if let Ok(mut s) = SPOONER_STATE.try_lock() {
        s.entities.push(SpoonerEntity {
            kind: 0,
            ptr: obj_ptr,
            hash64,
            frozen,
            invincible,
            attached: false,
            attach_target: 0,
            attach_bone: 0,
            attach_offset: [0.0, 2.2, 0.6],
            attach_rot: [0.0; 3],
            alpha: 255,
            scale: 1.0,
            collision: true,
        });
        s.selected = s.entities.len() - 1;
        s.hud.pending_spawn = false;
        sync_spooner_hud_locked(&mut s, rvas.ped_pos_packed);
    }
    true
}

fn step_pending_prop_locate(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let mut job = match PENDING_PROP_LOCATE.try_lock() {
        Ok(mut g) => match g.take() {
            Some(j) => j,
            None => {
                HAS_PENDING_PROP_LOCATE.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
                return;
            }
        },
        Err(_) => return,
    };
    if try_attach_spawned_prop(
        base,
        rvas,
        job.hash64,
        job.spawn_pos,
        job.dynamic,
        job.invincible,
    ) {
        HAS_PENDING_PROP_LOCATE.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
    } else if job.retries_left > 1 {
        job.retries_left -= 1;
        if let Ok(mut g) = PENDING_PROP_LOCATE.try_lock() {
            *g = Some(job);
        }
    } else {
        HAS_PENDING_PROP_LOCATE.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
        if let Ok(mut s) = SPOONER_STATE.try_lock() {
            s.hud.pending_spawn = false;
        }
    }
}

fn sync_spooner_hud_locked(s: &mut SpoonerState, pos_off: u64) {
    s.entities
        .retain(|e| e.ptr > 0x10000 && trainer::safe_read::<u64>(e.ptr as usize).is_some_and(|v| v > 0x10000));
    if s.entities.is_empty() {
        s.selected = 0;
        s.hud.total_count = 0;
        s.hud.selected_idx = 0;
        s.hud.selected_ptr = 0;
        s.hud.selected_hash64 = 0;
        s.hud.selected_pos = [0.0; 3];
        s.hud.frozen = false;
        s.hud.invincible = false;
        s.hud.attached = false;
        return;
    }
    if s.selected >= s.entities.len() {
        s.selected = s.entities.len() - 1;
    }
    let ent = s.entities[s.selected];
    let pos = trainer::safe_read::<[u32; 4]>((ent.ptr + pos_off) as usize)
        .map(trainer::unpack_sector_pos)
        .unwrap_or([0.0; 3]);
    s.hud.total_count = s.entities.len();
    s.hud.selected_idx = s.selected;
    s.hud.selected_ptr = ent.ptr;
    s.hud.selected_hash64 = ent.hash64;
    s.hud.selected_pos = pos;
    s.hud.frozen = ent.frozen;
    s.hud.invincible = ent.invincible;
    s.hud.attached = ent.attached;
}

fn refresh_spooner_hud(pos_off: u64) {
    if let Ok(mut s) = SPOONER_STATE.try_lock() {
        sync_spooner_hud_locked(&mut s, pos_off);
    }
}

fn spooner_select_delta(rvas: &RvaTable, delta: i32) {
    if let Ok(mut s) = SPOONER_STATE.try_lock() {
        sync_spooner_hud_locked(&mut s, rvas.ped_pos_packed);
        if !s.entities.is_empty() {
            let n = s.entities.len() as i32;
            s.selected = ((s.selected as i32 + delta).rem_euclid(n)) as usize;
            sync_spooner_hud_locked(&mut s, rvas.ped_pos_packed);
        }
    }
}

fn spooner_grab_nearest(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some((_r, fwd, _u, pos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ped, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let len = fwd[0].hypot(fwd[1]).max(0.001);
    let probe = [
        pos[0] + (fwd[0] / len) * 3.5,
        pos[1] + (fwd[1] / len) * 3.5,
        pos[2],
    ];
    let Some(obj_ptr) = trainer::find_nearest_object_in_pool(base, rvas, probe, 14.0, &[]) else {
        return;
    };
    if let Ok(mut s) = SPOONER_STATE.try_lock() {
        if let Some(pos_idx) = s.entities.iter().position(|e| e.ptr == obj_ptr) {
            s.selected = pos_idx;
        } else {
            s.entities.push(SpoonerEntity {
                kind: 0,
                ptr: obj_ptr,
                hash64: 0,
                frozen: false,
                invincible: false,
                attached: false,
                attach_target: 0,
                attach_bone: 0,
                attach_offset: [0.0, 2.2, 0.6],
                attach_rot: [0.0; 3],
                alpha: 255,
                scale: 1.0,
                collision: true,
            });
            s.selected = s.entities.len() - 1;
        }
        sync_spooner_hud_locked(&mut s, rvas.ped_pos_packed);
    }
}

fn spooner_nudge_selected(
    base: u64,
    rvas: &RvaTable,
    dx: f32,
    dy: f32,
    dz: f32,
    dyaw_deg: f32,
) {
    let Ok(mut s) = SPOONER_STATE.try_lock() else {
        return;
    };
    sync_spooner_hud_locked(&mut s, rvas.ped_pos_packed);
    let Some(&ent) = s.entities.get(s.selected) else {
        return;
    };
    if let Some((right, fwd, _up, mut pos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ent.ptr, rvas) {
        pos[0] += dx;
        pos[1] += dy;
        pos[2] += dz;
        let basis = if dyaw_deg.abs() > 0.01 {
            let rad = dyaw_deg.to_radians();
            let (sin, cos) = rad.sin_cos();
            let nr = [right[0] * cos - right[1] * sin, right[0] * sin + right[1] * cos, right[2]];
            let nf = [fwd[0] * cos - fwd[1] * sin, fwd[0] * sin + fwd[1] * cos, fwd[2]];
            Some((nr, nf))
        } else {
            None
        };
        let _ = teleport_entity_native(base, rvas, ent.ptr, pos, basis, true);
    }
    sync_spooner_hud_locked(&mut s, rvas.ped_pos_packed);
}

fn spooner_toggle_freeze(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let Ok(mut s) = SPOONER_STATE.try_lock() else {
        return;
    };
    sync_spooner_hud_locked(&mut s, rvas.ped_pos_packed);
    let sel = s.selected;
    let Some(ent) = s.entities.get_mut(sel) else {
        return;
    };
    ent.frozen = !ent.frozen;
    let fn_rva = if ent.frozen {
        rvas.fn_phys_freeze
    } else {
        rvas.fn_phys_unfreeze
    };
    if fn_rva != 0 {
        let f: extern "system" fn(u64) = unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + fn_rva) as usize) };
        f(ent.ptr);
    }
    sync_spooner_hud_locked(&mut s, rvas.ped_pos_packed);
}

fn spooner_toggle_god(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let Ok(mut s) = SPOONER_STATE.try_lock() else {
        return;
    };
    sync_spooner_hud_locked(&mut s, rvas.ped_pos_packed);
    let sel = s.selected;
    let Some(ent) = s.entities.get_mut(sel) else {
        return;
    };
    ent.invincible = !ent.invincible;
    call_damage_proof(base, rvas, ent.ptr, ent.invincible);
    sync_spooner_hud_locked(&mut s, rvas.ped_pos_packed);
}

fn spooner_delete_selected(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    if rvas.fn_destroy_entity == 0 {
        return;
    }
    let Ok(mut s) = SPOONER_STATE.try_lock() else {
        return;
    };
    sync_spooner_hud_locked(&mut s, rvas.ped_pos_packed);
    if s.entities.is_empty() {
        return;
    }
    let sel = s.selected;
    let ent = s.entities.remove(sel);
    let destroy: extern "system" fn(u64, u8) =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_destroy_entity) as usize) };
    destroy(ent.ptr, 0);
    sync_spooner_hud_locked(&mut s, rvas.ped_pos_packed);
}

fn spooner_clear_all(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    if rvas.fn_destroy_entity == 0 {
        return;
    }
    let Ok(mut s) = SPOONER_STATE.try_lock() else {
        return;
    };
    let destroy: extern "system" fn(u64, u8) =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_destroy_entity) as usize) };
    for ent in s.entities.drain(..) {
        if ent.ptr > 0x10000 && trainer::safe_read::<u64>(ent.ptr as usize).is_some_and(|v| v > 0x10000) {
            destroy(ent.ptr, 0);
        }
    }
    sync_spooner_hud_locked(&mut s, rvas.ped_pos_packed);
}

/// Live Spooner placement keys when Spooner Mode is ON and menu is closed:
/// `I/K` forward/back, `J/L` left/right, `U/O` up/down, `N/M` rotate yaw, `Del` delete selected.
fn step_spooner_hotkeys(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some((right, fwd, _up, _pos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ped, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let step = if key_down(0x10) { 0.35f32 } else { 0.10f32 };
    let mut dx = 0.0f32;
    let mut dy = 0.0f32;
    let mut dz = 0.0f32;
    let mut dyaw = 0.0f32;
    if key_down(0x49) {
        // I = forward
        dx += fwd[0] * step;
        dy += fwd[1] * step;
    }
    if key_down(0x4B) {
        // K = back
        dx -= fwd[0] * step;
        dy -= fwd[1] * step;
    }
    if key_down(0x4C) {
        // L = right
        dx += right[0] * step;
        dy += right[1] * step;
    }
    if key_down(0x4A) {
        // J = left
        dx -= right[0] * step;
        dy -= right[1] * step;
    }
    if key_down(0x55) {
        // U = up
        dz += step;
    }
    if key_down(0x4F) {
        // O = down
        dz -= step;
    }
    if key_down(0x4E) {
        // N = yaw CCW
        dyaw += 2.5;
    }
    if key_down(0x4D) {
        // M = yaw CW
        dyaw -= 2.5;
    }
    if dx != 0.0 || dy != 0.0 || dz != 0.0 || dyaw != 0.0 {
        spooner_nudge_selected(base, rvas, dx, dy, dz, dyaw);
    }
    let del = key_down(0x2E); // VK_DELETE
    if del && !PREV_DEL_KEY.swap(del, Ordering::Relaxed) {
        spooner_delete_selected(base, rvas);
    } else if !del {
        PREV_DEL_KEY.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Schema v6 Live Execution Helpers (Waves 1, 2 & 3)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

/// Shared primary (`+veh_shader_rgb`) & secondary (`+veh_shader_rgb2`) vehicle paint writer.
/// Operates on the current driven vehicle, or falls back to the last spawned vehicle —
/// ALWAYS O(1)-validated against `vehicle_pool` liveness flags so a deleted/despawned vehicle
/// can NEVER be dereferenced or passed into native engine functions!
fn active_or_last_vehicle(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) -> Option<u64> {
    if let Some(v) = read_current_vehicle(base, rvas)
        && trainer::is_entity_live_in_pool(base, rvas, rvas.vehicle_pool, v)
    {
        return Some(v);
    }
    let last = DIAG_LAST_SPAWNED_VEH.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
    if last > 0x10000 {
        if trainer::is_entity_live_in_pool(base, rvas, rvas.vehicle_pool, last) {
            return Some(last);
        }
        // Vehicle was deleted or despawned — clear stale cached pointer immediately!
        DIAG_LAST_SPAWNED_VEH.store(0, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
    None
}

fn apply_vehicle_rgb_slot_f32(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, rgb: [f32; 3], secondary: bool) {
    if rvas.fn_get_veh_shader_effect == 0 || rvas.fn_commit_veh_color == 0 {
        return;
    }
    let Some(veh) = active_or_last_vehicle(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some(draw_handler) =
        trainer::safe_read::<u64>((veh + rvas.entity_draw_handler) as usize)
    else {
        return;
    };
    if draw_handler < 0x10000 {
        return;
    }
    let get_fx: extern "system" fn(u64) -> u64 =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_veh_shader_effect) as usize) };
    let fx = get_fx(draw_handler);
    if fx < 0x10000 {
        return;
    }
    DIAG_VEH_FX_PTR.store(fx, Ordering::Relaxed);
    let off = if secondary {
        rvas.veh_shader_rgb2
    } else {
        rvas.veh_shader_rgb
    };
    if off != 0 && trainer::safe_write::<[f32; 3]>((fx + off) as usize, rgb) {
        let commit: extern "system" fn(u64) =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_commit_veh_color) as usize) };
        commit(fx);
    }
}

fn apply_world_gravity(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, scale: f32) {
    let v = scale.clamp(0.02, 3.0);
    if rvas.fn_set_world_gravity != 0 {
        // SAFETY: verified 1-arg `CPhysics::SetGravityScale(f32)` updating global & physics pool.
        let set_g: extern "system" fn(f32) =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_set_world_gravity) as usize) };
        set_g(v);
    } else {
        let _ = trainer::direct_set_world_gravity(base, rvas, v);
    }
}

fn apply_remove_all_weapons(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    if let Ok(mut hist) = GRANTED_WEP_HASHES.try_lock() {
        hist.clear();
    }
    DIAG_LAST_REMOVE_TX.store(0, Ordering::Relaxed);
    DIAG_REMOVED_WEP_ITEMS.store(0, Ordering::Relaxed);
    let reason = if rvas.remove_weapon_reason != 0 {
        rvas.remove_weapon_reason
    } else if rvas.give_loadout_reason != 0 {
        rvas.give_loadout_reason
    } else {
        rvas.add_item_reason
    };
    let mut tx_out: u32 = 0;
    let mut removed_items: u32 = 0;

    if let Some((_p, _id, inv)) = read_local_ped_inventory_alt(base, rvas) {
        // 1. Collect all weapon items from `[inv + 0x10]` SwissTable FIRST (never mutate while iterating!).
        let mut to_remove: Vec<([u64; 2], u64)> = Vec::new();
        if let Some(inner) = trainer::safe_read::<u64>((inv + 0x10) as usize)
            && inner > 0x10000
            && let (Some(groups), Some(table)) = (
                trainer::safe_read::<u32>((inner + 0x60) as usize),
                trainer::safe_read::<u64>((inner + 0x68) as usize),
            )
            && groups > 0
            && groups <= 4096
            && table > 0x10000
        {
            for g in 0..u64::from(groups) {
                let g_addr = table + g * 0x190;
                let Some(ctrl) = trainer::safe_read::<[u8; 16]>(g_addr as usize) else {
                    break;
                };
                for (s, &c) in ctrl.iter().enumerate() {
                    if (c & 0x80) != 0 {
                        continue;
                    }
                    let slot = g_addr + 0x10 + (s as u64) * 0x18;
                    let (Some(guid_lo), Some(guid_hi), Some(item_ptr)) = (
                        trainer::safe_read::<u64>(slot as usize),
                        trainer::safe_read::<u64>((slot + 8) as usize),
                        trainer::safe_read::<u64>((slot + 0x10) as usize),
                    ) else {
                        continue;
                    };
                    if item_ptr < 0x10000 {
                        continue;
                    }
                    let mut is_weapon = false;
                    if let Some(vt) = trainer::safe_read::<u64>(item_ptr as usize)
                        && vt > 0x10000
                        && let Some(is_cat_addr) = trainer::safe_read::<u64>(vt as usize)
                        && is_cat_addr > 0x10000
                    {
                        // SAFETY: verified virtual `CInventoryItem::IsInCategory(item_ptr, cat_hash) -> u8`.
                        let is_cat: extern "system" fn(u64, u32) -> u8 =
                            unsafe { std::mem::transmute(is_cat_addr as usize) };
                        if rvas.weapon_category_hash2 != 0
                            && is_cat(item_ptr, rvas.weapon_category_hash2) != 0
                        {
                            is_weapon = true;
                        } else if rvas.weapon_category_hash != 0
                            && is_cat(item_ptr, rvas.weapon_category_hash) != 0
                        {
                            is_weapon = true;
                        }
                    }
                    if is_weapon && to_remove.len() < 64 {
                        to_remove.push(([guid_lo, guid_hi], item_ptr));
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // 2. Remove every collected weapon item cleanly via `CWeaponInventory::RemoveWeaponItem`
        //    with `CInventory::RemoveItemByGuid` fallback.
        for (guid, item_ptr) in &to_remove {
            let mut item_tx: u32 = 0;
            if rvas.fn_inv_remove_weapon_item != 0 {
                // SAFETY: verified 4-arg `CWeaponInventory::RemoveWeaponItem(inv+0x190, &mut tx, item_ptr, reason)`.
                let rem_wep: extern "system" fn(u64, *mut u32, u64, u32) = unsafe {
                    std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_inv_remove_weapon_item) as usize)
                };
                rem_wep(inv + 0x190, &mut item_tx, *item_ptr, reason);
            }
            if item_tx == 0 && rvas.fn_inv_remove_item_by_guid != 0 {
                // SAFETY: verified 5-arg `CInventory::RemoveItemByGuid(inv, &mut tx, &guid, count, reason)`.
                let rem_guid: extern "system" fn(u64, *mut u32, *const [u64; 2], i64, u32) = unsafe {
                    std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_inv_remove_item_by_guid) as usize)
                };
                rem_guid(inv, &mut item_tx, guid, 1, reason);
            }
            if item_tx != 0 {
                removed_items += 1;
                tx_out = item_tx;
            }
        }

        // 3. Fallback: invoke category removal if per-item removal matched zero items.
        if removed_items == 0 && rvas.fn_inv_remove_category != 0 {
            let rem_cat: extern "system" fn(u64, *mut u32, u32, u32) =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_inv_remove_category) as usize) };
            if rvas.weapon_category_hash2 != 0 {
                let mut tx2: u32 = 0;
                rem_cat(inv, &mut tx2, rvas.weapon_category_hash2, reason);
                if tx2 != 0 {
                    tx_out = tx2;
                }
            }
            if tx_out == 0 && rvas.weapon_category_hash != 0 {
                rem_cat(inv, &mut tx_out, rvas.weapon_category_hash, reason);
            }
        }
        DIAG_REMOVED_WEP_ITEMS.store(removed_items, Ordering::Relaxed);
        DIAG_LAST_REMOVE_TX.store(tx_out, Ordering::Relaxed);
        DIAG_REMOVE_WEPS_CALLS.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
        let _ = update_inv_item_count_diag(inv);
        if removed_items > 0 || tx_out != 0 {
            return;
        }
    }
    if rvas.fn_remove_all_ped_weapons != 0 {
        // SAFETY: verified 1-arg `RemoveAllPedWeapons(CPed*)` removing weapon category items.
        let rem: extern "system" fn(u64) =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_remove_all_ped_weapons) as usize) };
        rem(ped);
        DIAG_REMOVE_WEPS_CALLS.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
    if let Some((_p, _id, inv)) = read_local_ped_inventory_alt(base, rvas) {
        let _ = update_inv_item_count_diag(inv);
    }
}

fn apply_refill_all_ammo(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    DIAG_LAST_AMMO_ADD_TX.store(0, Ordering::Relaxed);
    DIAG_REFILL_CLIPS_FILLED.store(0, Ordering::Relaxed);
    let mut refill_hashes = Vec::<u32>::with_capacity(24);
    let mut direct_ammo_hashes = Vec::<u32>::with_capacity(16);
    let collect_weapon_and_ammo = |wep: u64,
                                   refill_hashes: &mut Vec<u32>,
                                   direct_ammo_hashes: &mut Vec<u32>| {
        let (_c, max_clip) = read_weapon_clip_counts(wep, rvas);
        if max_clip > 0 && rvas.fn_set_ammo_in_clip != 0 {
            let set_clip: extern "system" fn(u64, i32, i32) =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_set_ammo_in_clip) as usize) };
            set_clip(wep, max_clip, -1);
            DIAG_REFILL_CLIPS_FILLED.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
            let _ = read_weapon_clip_counts(wep, rvas);
        } else if rvas.fn_refill_weapon_clip != 0 {
            let refill_clip: extern "system" fn(u64) =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_refill_weapon_clip) as usize) };
            refill_clip(wep);
            DIAG_REFILL_CLIPS_FILLED.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
        }
        // `[CWeapon* + 0x28]` = `CItemInfo*` (`[+0x20]` = `weapon_hash32`).
        if let Some(item_info) = trainer::safe_read::<u64>((wep + 0x28) as usize)
            && item_info > 0x10000
            && let Some(h32) =
                trainer::safe_read::<u32>((item_info + rvas.item_info_hash) as usize)
            && h32 != 0
            && !refill_hashes.contains(&h32)
        {
            refill_hashes.push(h32);
        }
        // `CWeapon::GetAmmoInfo(CWeapon*, -1, 0) -> CAmmoInfo*` (`[+0x20]` = `ammo_hash32`).
        if rvas.fn_get_weapon_ammo_info != 0 {
            let get_ammo_info: extern "system" fn(u64, i32, u8) -> u64 =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_weapon_ammo_info) as usize) };
            let ammo_info = get_ammo_info(wep, -1, 0);
            if ammo_info > 0x10000
                && let Some(ammo_h) =
                    trainer::safe_read::<u32>((ammo_info + rvas.item_info_hash) as usize)
                && ammo_h != 0
                && !direct_ammo_hashes.contains(&ammo_h)
            {
                direct_ammo_hashes.push(ammo_h);
            }
        }
    };
    // 1. Refill active weapon clip immediately to `max_clip`, and resolve carried `CWeapon*` slots safely!
    if let Some((mgr, cur)) = get_active_weapon_mgr_and_cur(base, rvas) {
        if cur > 0x10000 {
            collect_weapon_and_ammo(cur, &mut refill_hashes, &mut direct_ammo_hashes);
        }
        if rvas.fn_resolve_wep_from_slot != 0
            && let (Some(arr_ptr), Some(cnt)) = (
                trainer::safe_read::<u64>((mgr + rvas.wep_mgr_array) as usize),
                trainer::safe_read::<u16>((mgr + rvas.wep_mgr_count) as usize),
            )
            && arr_ptr > 0x10000
        {
            let resolve_slot: extern "system" fn(u64) -> u64 =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_resolve_wep_from_slot) as usize) };
            for i in 0..usize::from(cnt.min(24)) {
                if let Some(slot_entry) =
                    trainer::safe_read::<u64>((arr_ptr + (i as u64) * 8) as usize)
                    && slot_entry > 0x10000
                {
                    let wep = resolve_slot(slot_entry);
                    if wep > 0x10000 && wep != cur {
                        collect_weapon_and_ammo(wep, &mut refill_hashes, &mut direct_ammo_hashes);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    // Also include every recently granted weapon hash still in inventory!
    if let Ok(hist) = GRANTED_WEP_HASHES.try_lock() {
        for &h in hist.iter() {
            if h != 0 && !refill_hashes.contains(&h) && refill_hashes.len() < 48 {
                refill_hashes.push(h);
            }
        }
    }
    // 2. Top up reserve ammo for every carried weapon via `CWeaponInventory::AddWeaponAmmo`
    //    AND direct `CAmmoInfo` item hash into the verified ammo inventory `*(inv + 0x198)`!
    if (!refill_hashes.is_empty() || !direct_ammo_hashes.is_empty())
        && let Some((_ped, _id, inv)) = read_local_ped_inventory_alt(base, rvas)
    {
        let ammo_inv = trainer::safe_read::<u64>((inv + 0x198) as usize)
            .filter(|&p| p > 0x10000)
            .unwrap_or(inv);
        let reasons = [
            rvas.give_loadout_reason,
            rvas.add_item_reason,
            rvas.weapon_add_reason,
        ];
        if rvas.fn_inv_add_weapon_ammo != 0 {
            let add_ammo: extern "system" fn(u64, *mut u32, u32, i64, u32) =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_inv_add_weapon_ammo) as usize) };
            for &h32 in &refill_hashes {
                for &reason in &reasons {
                    if reason == 0 {
                        continue;
                    }
                    let mut tx = 0u32;
                    add_ammo(inv + 0x190, &mut tx, h32, 999, reason);
                    if tx != 0 {
                        DIAG_LAST_AMMO_ADD_TX.store(tx, Ordering::Relaxed);
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if rvas.fn_inv_add_item_direct_slot != 0 {
            let add_direct_slot: extern "system" fn(u64, *mut u32, u32, i64, u32, *const u8) =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_inv_add_item_direct_slot) as usize) };
            if rvas.fn_get_weapon_info != 0 {
                let get_wep_info: extern "system" fn(u32) -> u64 =
                    unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_weapon_info) as usize) };
                for &h32 in &refill_hashes {
                    let info = get_wep_info(h32);
                    if info > 0x10000
                        && trainer::safe_read::<u16>((info + 0x118) as usize).unwrap_or(0) > 0
                        && let Some(arr) = trainer::safe_read::<u64>((info + 0x110) as usize)
                        && arr > 0x10000
                        && let Some(sub) = trainer::safe_read::<u64>(arr as usize)
                        && sub > 0x10000
                        && let Some(ammo_info) = trainer::safe_read::<u64>((sub + 0x28) as usize)
                        && ammo_info > 0x10000
                        && let Some(ammo_h) = trainer::safe_read::<u32>((ammo_info + 0x20) as usize)
                        && ammo_h != 0
                        && !direct_ammo_hashes.contains(&ammo_h)
                    {
                        direct_ammo_hashes.push(ammo_h);
                    }
                }
            }
            let zero_flags = [0u8; 16];
            for ammo_h in direct_ammo_hashes {
                for &reason in &reasons {
                    if reason == 0 {
                        continue;
                    }
                    let mut tx = 0u32;
                    add_direct_slot(ammo_inv, &mut tx, ammo_h, 999, reason, zero_flags.as_ptr());
                    if tx == 0 && ammo_inv != inv {
                        add_direct_slot(inv, &mut tx, ammo_h, 999, reason, zero_flags.as_ptr());
                    }
                    if tx != 0 {
                        DIAG_LAST_DIRECT_SLOT_TX.store(tx, Ordering::Relaxed);
                        DIAG_LAST_AMMO_ADD_TX.store(tx, Ordering::Relaxed);
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

fn warp_any_ped_into_vehicle(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, ped: u64, veh: u64, seat_idx: i32) -> bool {
    if ped < 0x10000
        || veh < 0x10000
        || rvas.fn_get_ped_seat_warp_comp == 0
        || rvas.fn_warp_ped_into_vehicle == 0
    {
        return false;
    }
    // SAFETY: verified 1-arg `GetPedSeatWarpComp(CPed*) -> CPedVehicleSeatComp*`.
    let get_comp: extern "system" fn(u64) -> u64 =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_ped_seat_warp_comp) as usize) };
    let comp = get_comp(ped);
    if comp < 0x10000 {
        return false;
    }
    // SAFETY: verified 5-arg `WarpPedIntoVehicleDirect(seat_comp, CVehicle*, seat_idx, flags=0x10, arg5=-1.0f)`.
    let warp: extern "system" fn(u64, u64, i32, u32, f32) =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_warp_ped_into_vehicle) as usize) };
    warp(comp, veh, seat_idx, 0x10, -1.0);
    DIAG_WARP_CALLS.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
    true
}

fn warp_local_ped_into_vehicle(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, veh: u64, seat_idx: i32) -> bool {
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return false;
    };
    warp_any_ped_into_vehicle(base, rvas, ped, veh, seat_idx)
}

fn apply_teleport_into_nearest_vehicle(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some((_r, _f, _u, pos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ped, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let mut excl = Vec::new();
    if let Some(cur) = read_current_vehicle(base, rvas) {
        excl.push(cur);
    }
    let nearby =
        trainer::find_nearby_entities_in_pool(base, rvas, rvas.vehicle_pool, pos, 140.0, &excl, 4);
    if let Some(&(_d, veh)) = nearby.first() {
        let _ = warp_local_ped_into_vehicle(base, rvas, veh, 0);
    }
}

fn apply_clear_area(
    base: u64,
    rvas: &RvaTable,
    vehicles: bool,
    peds: bool,
    props: bool,
    radius: f32,
) {
    if rvas.fn_destroy_entity == 0 {
        return;
    }
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some((_r, _f, _u, pos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ped, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let mut exclude = vec![ped];
    if let Some(cur_v) = read_current_vehicle(base, rvas) {
        exclude.push(cur_v);
    }
    if let Ok(bgs) = BODYGUARDS.try_lock() {
        exclude.extend(bgs.iter().copied());
    }
    let destroy: extern "system" fn(u64, u8) =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_destroy_entity) as usize) };
    let mut deleted = 0u64;
    let pools = [
        (vehicles, rvas.vehicle_pool, 32usize),
        (peds, rvas.ped_pool, 32usize),
        (props, rvas.object_pool, 32usize),
    ];
    for (enabled, pool_rva, cap) in pools {
        if !enabled || pool_rva == 0 {
            continue;
        }
        let ents =
            trainer::find_nearby_entities_in_pool(base, rvas, pool_rva, pos, radius, &exclude, cap);
        for (_d, ent) in ents {
            destroy(ent, 0);
            deleted += 1;
        }
    }
    CLEAR_AREA_DELETED.fetch_add(deleted, Ordering::Relaxed);
}

fn apply_explode_nearby_vehicles(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, radius: f32) {
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some((_r, _f, _u, pos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ped, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let mut exclude = Vec::new();
    if let Some(cur_v) = read_current_vehicle(base, rvas) {
        exclude.push(cur_v);
    }
    let vehs =
        trainer::find_nearby_entities_in_pool(base, rvas, rvas.vehicle_pool, pos, radius, &exclude, 10);
    for (_d, v) in vehs {
        if let Some((_r, _f, _u, vpos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(v, rvas) {
            spawn_explosion_at(base, rvas, 4, [vpos[0], vpos[1], vpos[2] + 0.5]);
        }
    }
}

fn apply_launch_nearby_peds(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, radius: f32) {
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some((_r, _f, _u, pos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ped, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let mut exclude = vec![ped];
    if let Ok(bgs) = BODYGUARDS.try_lock() {
        exclude.extend(bgs.iter().copied());
    }
    let peds =
        trainer::find_nearby_entities_in_pool(base, rvas, rvas.ped_pool, pos, radius, &exclude, 12);
    for (_d, p) in peds {
        set_entity_velocity_native(base, rvas, p, [0.0, 0.0, 14.0]);
    }
}

fn apply_flip_vehicle_upright(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let Some(veh) = active_or_last_vehicle(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some((_r, fwd, _u, mut pos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(veh, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let len = fwd[0].hypot(fwd[1]).max(0.001);
    let fx = fwd[0] / len;
    let fy = fwd[1] / len;
    let rx = fy;
    let ry = -fx;
    pos[2] += 0.80;
    let _ = teleport_entity_native(
        base,
        rvas,
        veh,
        pos,
        Some(([rx, ry, 0.0], [fx, fy, 0.0])),
        true,
    );
    if rvas.fn_phys_unfreeze != 0 {
        let unfreeze: extern "system" fn(u64) =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_phys_unfreeze) as usize) };
        unfreeze(veh);
    }
    set_entity_velocity_native(base, rvas, veh, [0.0, 0.0, -0.5]);
}

fn apply_delete_current_vehicle(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    if rvas.fn_destroy_entity == 0 {
        return;
    }
    let Some(veh) = active_or_last_vehicle(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    // If local ped is seated inside `veh`, step ped out safely 2m to the side first!
    if read_current_vehicle(base, rvas) == Some(veh)
        && let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas)
        && let Some((right, _f, _u, pos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(veh, rvas)
    {
        let exit_pos = [pos[0] - right[0] * 2.4, pos[1] - right[1] * 2.4, pos[2] + 0.5];
        let _ = teleport_entity_native(base, rvas, ped, exit_pos, None, true);
    }
    let destroy: extern "system" fn(u64, u8) =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_destroy_entity) as usize) };
    destroy(veh, 0);
    if DIAG_LAST_SPAWNED_VEH.load(Ordering::Relaxed) == veh {
        DIAG_LAST_SPAWNED_VEH.store(0, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
}

fn apply_vehicle_dirt_level(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, dirt: f32) {
    if rvas.fn_get_veh_dirt_comp == 0 || rvas.fn_set_veh_dirt_level == 0 {
        return;
    }
    let Some(veh) = active_or_last_vehicle(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some(ent_id) = trainer::safe_read::<u32>((veh + rvas.ped_entity_id) as usize) else {
        return;
    };
    let get_comp: extern "system" fn(u32) -> u64 =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_veh_dirt_comp) as usize) };
    let comp = get_comp(ent_id);
    if comp < 0x10000 {
        return;
    }
    DIAG_VEH_DIRT_COMP.store(comp, Ordering::Relaxed);
    // SAFETY: verified 6-arg `SetVehDirtLevel(comp, f32 0..1, 2, 0, 1u8, 0u64)`.
    let set_dirt: extern "system" fn(u64, f32, u32, u32, u8, u64) =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_set_veh_dirt_level) as usize) };
    set_dirt(comp, dirt.clamp(0.0, 1.0), 2, 0, 1, 0);
}

fn apply_vehicle_mod_kit(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, kit_id: u32) {
    if rvas.fn_get_veh_variation_comp == 0 || rvas.fn_veh_set_mod_kit == 0 {
        return;
    }
    let Some(veh) = active_or_last_vehicle(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let get_var: extern "system" fn(u64) -> u64 =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_veh_variation_comp) as usize) };
    let var_comp = get_var(veh);
    if var_comp < 0x10000 {
        return;
    }
    DIAG_VEH_VAR_COMP.store(var_comp, Ordering::Relaxed);
    let mod_comp = var_comp + rvas.veh_mod_comp_off;
    // SAFETY: verified 3-arg `CVehicleModComp::SetModKit(mod_comp, kit_id<=0x20, force=0)`.
    let set_kit: extern "system" fn(u64, u32, u8) =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_veh_set_mod_kit) as usize) };
    set_kit(mod_comp, kit_id.min(32), 0);
    if rvas.fn_veh_apply_variation != 0 {
        // SAFETY: verified 2-arg `CVehicleVariationComp::Apply(var_comp, force=1)` immediately after SetModKit.
        let apply_var: extern "system" fn(u64, u8) =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_veh_apply_variation) as usize) };
        apply_var(var_comp, 1);
    }
}

fn apply_toggle_vehicle_engine(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    if rvas.fn_get_veh_engine_comp == 0 {
        return;
    }
    let Some(veh) = active_or_last_vehicle(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some(ent_id) = trainer::safe_read::<u32>((veh + rvas.ped_entity_id) as usize) else {
        return;
    };
    let get_comp: extern "system" fn(u32) -> u64 =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_veh_engine_comp) as usize) };
    let comp = get_comp(ent_id);
    if comp < 0x10000 {
        return;
    }
    DIAG_VEH_ENGINE_COMP.store(comp, Ordering::Relaxed);
    if let Some(cur_flags) = trainer::safe_read::<u32>((comp + 0x224) as usize) {
        let next_on = (cur_flags & 2) == 0;
        if rvas.fn_set_veh_engine_flag != 0 {
            // SAFETY: verified 2-arg `SetVehEngineFlag(comp, u8 enable)` toggling `[comp+0x224] bit 1`.
            let set_eng: extern "system" fn(u64, u8) =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_set_veh_engine_flag) as usize) };
            set_eng(comp, u8::from(next_on));
        } else {
            let next = if next_on {
                cur_flags | 2
            } else {
                cur_flags & !2
            };
            let _ = trainer::safe_write::<u32>((comp + 0x224) as usize, next);
        }
    }
}

fn apply_vehicle_doors(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, mode: u8, door_idx: i32) {
    let Some(veh) = active_or_last_vehicle(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let range = if door_idx < 0 {
        0..=5
    } else {
        door_idx..=door_idx
    };
    match mode {
        0 if rvas.fn_veh_door_open != 0 => {
            let f: extern "system" fn(u64, i32, u8, u8) =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_veh_door_open) as usize) };
            for d in range {
                f(veh, d, 0, 1);
            }
        }
        1 if rvas.fn_veh_door_shut != 0 => {
            let f: extern "system" fn(u64, i32, u8) =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_veh_door_shut) as usize) };
            for d in range {
                f(veh, d, 1);
            }
        }
        2 if rvas.fn_veh_door_break != 0 => {
            let f: extern "system" fn(u64, i32, u8) =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_veh_door_break) as usize) };
            for d in range {
                f(veh, d, 0);
            }
        }
        _ => {}
    }
}

fn step_veh_power_boost(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let mult = f32::from_bits(VEH_POWER_MULT_BITS.load(Ordering::Relaxed));
    if mult <= 1.05 {
        return;
    }
    let pad = BRIDGE.pad_buttons.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
    let accel = key_down(0x57) || (pad & 0x0200 != 0); // W or RT
    if !accel {
        return;
    }
    let Some(veh) = read_current_vehicle(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some((_r, fwd, _u, _pos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(veh, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let len = fwd[0].hypot(fwd[1]);
    if len > 0.1 {
        let nx = fwd[0] / len;
        let ny = fwd[1] / len;
        let max_spd = f32::from_bits(VEH_MAX_SPEED_BITS.load(Ordering::Relaxed)).clamp(20.0, 220.0);
        let extra = (mult - 1.0).clamp(0.0, 9.0);
        let speed = (18.0 + extra * 14.0).min(max_spd);
        set_entity_velocity_native(base, rvas, veh, [nx * speed, ny * speed, 0.0]);
    }
}

fn step_veh_weapons(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let pad = BRIDGE.pad_buttons.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
    let fire = key_down(0x01) || key_down(0x45) || (pad & 0x2000 != 0);
    if !fire {
        PREV_VEH_FIRE_KEY.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
        return;
    }
    if PREV_VEH_FIRE_KEY.swap(true, Ordering::Relaxed) {
        return;
    }
    let Some(veh) = read_current_vehicle(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some((_r, fwd, _u, pos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(veh, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let len = fwd[0].hypot(fwd[1]).max(0.001);
    let target = [
        pos[0] + (fwd[0] / len) * 24.0,
        pos[1] + (fwd[1] / len) * 24.0,
        pos[2] + 0.5,
    ];
    let tag = EXPLOSION_TAG.load(Ordering::Relaxed) as i32;
    spawn_explosion_at(base, rvas, tag, target);
}

fn step_fun_gun(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let mode = FUN_GUN_MODE.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
    if mode == 0 || read_current_vehicle(base, rvas).is_some() {
        PREV_FIRE_KEY.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
        GRAVITY_GUN_TARGET.store(0, Ordering::Relaxed);
        return;
    }
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some((_pr, pfwd, _pu, ppos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ped, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    // Use real 3D rendered camera ray (`cam_mat_base`) when live, falling back to ped heading!
    let (ray_origin, ray_dir) = if let Some((_cr, cf, _cu, cp)) = trainer::read_camera_mat34(base, rvas) {
        (cp, cf)
    } else {
        let len = pfwd[0].hypot(pfwd[1]).max(0.001);
        ([ppos[0], ppos[1], ppos[2] + 0.65], [pfwd[0] / len, pfwd[1] / len, 0.0])
    };

    let fire = key_down(0x01); // Left Mouse Button

    // Mode 5: Continuous Hold-and-Launch Gravity / Magnet Gun along live 3D camera ray!
    if mode == 5 {
        let mut held = GRAVITY_GUN_TARGET.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
        if fire {
            if held == 0 {
                for pool_rva in [rvas.vehicle_pool, rvas.object_pool, rvas.ped_pool] {
                    if let Some((_, ent)) = trainer::find_entity_along_ray(
                        base, rvas, pool_rva, ray_origin, ray_dir, 65.0, 2.2, &[ped],
                    ) {
                        held = ent;
                        GRAVITY_GUN_TARGET.store(ent, Ordering::Relaxed);
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            if held > 0x10000
                && trainer::safe_read::<u64>(held as usize).is_some_and(|vt| vt > 0x10000)
            {
                let hold_pt = [
                    ray_origin[0] + ray_dir[0] * 9.0,
                    ray_origin[1] + ray_dir[1] * 9.0,
                    (ray_origin[2] + ray_dir[2] * 9.0).max(ppos[2] + 0.8),
                ];
                let _ = teleport_entity_native(base, rvas, held, hold_pt, None, true);
            } else {
                GRAVITY_GUN_TARGET.store(0, Ordering::Relaxed);
            }
        } else if held > 0x10000 {
            GRAVITY_GUN_TARGET.store(0, Ordering::Relaxed);
            if trainer::safe_read::<u64>(held as usize).is_some_and(|vt| vt > 0x10000) {
                if rvas.fn_phys_unfreeze != 0 {
                    let unfreeze: extern "system" fn(u64) =
                        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_phys_unfreeze) as usize) };
                    unfreeze(held);
                }
                set_entity_velocity_native(
                    base,
                    rvas,
                    held,
                    [ray_dir[0] * 42.0, ray_dir[1] * 42.0, (ray_dir[2] * 42.0 + 4.5).clamp(-15.0, 35.0)],
                );
            }
        }
        PREV_FIRE_KEY.store(fire, Ordering::Relaxed);
        return;
    }

    if !fire {
        PREV_FIRE_KEY.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
        return;
    }
    if PREV_FIRE_KEY.swap(true, Ordering::Relaxed) {
        return;
    }
    let aim_pt = [
        ray_origin[0] + ray_dir[0] * 24.0,
        ray_origin[1] + ray_dir[1] * 24.0,
        (ray_origin[2] + ray_dir[2] * 24.0).max(ppos[2] - 1.5),
    ];
    match mode {
        1 => {
            // Teleport Gun: warp cleanly along 3D camera ray!
            let tp_z = if ray_dir[2].abs() < 0.25 {
                trainer::probe_ground_z_near_xy(base, rvas, aim_pt[0], aim_pt[1], ppos[2] + 0.5)
            } else {
                aim_pt[2].max(ppos[2] - 2.0)
            };
            let _ = teleport_entity_native(base, rvas, ped, [aim_pt[0], aim_pt[1], tp_z], None, true);
        }
        2 => {
            // Explosive Impact Gun: uses live selectable 69-tag `eExplosionTag` along 3D crosshair ray!
            let tag = EXPLOSION_TAG.load(Ordering::Relaxed) as i32;
            spawn_explosion_at(base, rvas, tag, aim_pt);
        }
        3 => {
            // Delete Gun: true camera-ray entity picker deletes exact entity under crosshair!
            if rvas.fn_destroy_entity != 0 {
                let destroy: extern "system" fn(u64, u8) =
                    unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_destroy_entity) as usize) };
                for pool_rva in [rvas.vehicle_pool, rvas.object_pool, rvas.ped_pool] {
                    if let Some((_, ent)) = trainer::find_entity_along_ray(
                        base, rvas, pool_rva, ray_origin, ray_dir, 90.0, 2.0, &[ped],
                    ) {
                        destroy(ent, 0);
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        4 => {
            // Vehicle Launcher Gun: spawn first built-in vehicle ahead and launch it forward!
            if let Some(v) = rvas.builtin_vehicles.first() {
                start_vehicle_spawn(base, rvas, v.hash64, true, false);
            }
        }
        6 => {
            // Airstrike Gun: 4-bomb barrage along the live 3D camera crosshair ray using selected explosion tag!
            let tag = EXPLOSION_TAG.load(Ordering::Relaxed) as i32;
            for i in 0..4 {
                let d = 18.0 + (i as f32) * 8.5;
                let pt = [
                    ray_origin[0] + ray_dir[0] * d,
                    ray_origin[1] + ray_dir[1] * d,
                    (ray_origin[2] + ray_dir[2] * d).max(ppos[2] - 0.5),
                ];
                spawn_explosion_at(base, rvas, tag, pt);
            }
        }
        7 => {
            // Slingshot / Launch Gun: rockets aimed vehicle, ped, or prop at 55 m/s!
            for pool_rva in [rvas.vehicle_pool, rvas.ped_pool, rvas.object_pool] {
                if let Some((_, ent)) = trainer::find_entity_along_ray(
                    base, rvas, pool_rva, ray_origin, ray_dir, 95.0, 2.4, &[ped],
                ) {
                    if rvas.fn_phys_unfreeze != 0 {
                        let unfreeze: extern "system" fn(u64) =
                            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_phys_unfreeze) as usize) };
