                        unfreeze(ent);
                    }
                    set_entity_velocity_native(
                        base,
                        rvas,
                        ent,
                        [
                            ray_dir[0] * 55.0,
                            ray_dir[1] * 55.0,
                            (ray_dir[2] * 55.0 + 12.0).clamp(4.0, 48.0),
                        ],
                    );
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        8 | 9 => {
            // Mode 8 = Armed Defending Bodyguard Spawner Gun, Mode 9 = Armed Attacking Hitman Spawner Gun!
            let role = if mode == 8 { 1 } else { 2 };
            let mut ped_h64 = DEFAULT_PED_MODEL_HASH.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
            if ped_h64 == 0 {
                ped_h64 = trainer::safe_read::<u64>((ped + 0x20) as usize)
                    .filter(|&mi| mi > 0x10000)
                    .and_then(|mi| trainer::safe_read::<u64>((mi + 0x60) as usize))
                    .unwrap_or(0);
            }
            if ped_h64 != 0 {
                let wep = DEFAULT_PED_WEAPON_HASH.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
                let spawn_off = [
                    ray_dir[0] * 12.0,
                    ray_dir[1] * 12.0,
                    0.25,
                ];
                start_ped_spawn_ex(
                    base,
                    rvas,
                    ped_h64,
                    role,
                    wep,
                    role == 1,
                    false,
                    Some(spawn_off),
                );
            }
        }
        10 => {
            // Flame / Molotov Stream Gun: fire blasts along crosshair ray!
            for d in [10.0f32, 16.0, 22.0] {
                let pt = [
                    ray_origin[0] + ray_dir[0] * d,
                    ray_origin[1] + ray_dir[1] * d,
                    (ray_origin[2] + ray_dir[2] * d).max(ppos[2] - 0.5),
                ];
                spawn_explosion_at(base, rvas, 3, pt);
            }
        }
        11 => {
            // Grapple / Tether Hook Gun: zip player cleanly toward aimed point or entity!
            let pull_dir = [
                ray_dir[0] * 28.0,
                ray_dir[1] * 28.0,
                (ray_dir[2] * 24.0 + 7.5).clamp(2.5, 22.0),
            ];
            set_entity_velocity_native(base, rvas, ped, pull_dir);
        }
        12 => {
            // Freeze / Unfreeze Entity Gun: stops aimed car, ped, or prop in mid-air!
            if rvas.fn_phys_freeze != 0 {
                let freeze: extern "system" fn(u64) =
                    unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_phys_freeze) as usize) };
                for pool_rva in [rvas.vehicle_pool, rvas.ped_pool, rvas.object_pool] {
                    if let Some((_, ent)) = trainer::find_entity_along_ray(
                        base, rvas, pool_rva, ray_origin, ray_dir, 95.0, 2.2, &[ped],
                    ) {
                        freeze(ent);
                        set_entity_velocity_native(base, rvas, ent, [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]);
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        13 => {
            // Vehicle Hijack Gun: instantaneously warps player straight into the driver's seat of any aimed car!
            if let Some((_, veh)) = trainer::find_entity_along_ray(
                base,
                rvas,
                rvas.vehicle_pool,
                ray_origin,
                ray_dir,
                110.0,
                2.8,
                &[ped],
            ) {
                let _ = warp_local_ped_into_vehicle(base, rvas, veh, 0);
            }
        }
        14 => {
            // Soul-Switch Gun: swaps player's position & wardrobe seed with the aimed ped!
            if let Some((_, target_ped)) = trainer::find_entity_along_ray(
                base,
                rvas,
                rvas.ped_pool,
                ray_origin,
                ray_dir,
                95.0,
                2.4,
                &[ped],
            ) && let Some((_tr, _tf, _tu, tpos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(target_ped, rvas)
            {
                let _ = teleport_entity_native(base, rvas, target_ped, ppos, None, true);
                let _ = teleport_entity_native(base, rvas, ped, tpos, None, true);
                let seed = ((target_ped >> 4) & 0xFF) as u32;
                apply_ped_wardrobe_seed(base, rvas, seed);
            }
        }
        15 => {
            // Revive / Heal Gun: restores health/armor + unfreezes aimed ped, or repairs aimed vehicle!
            if let Some((_, veh)) = trainer::find_entity_along_ray(
                base, rvas, rvas.vehicle_pool, ray_origin, ray_dir, 95.0, 2.6, &[ped],
            ) {
                if rvas.fn_vehicle_repair_silent != 0 {
                    let f: extern "system" fn(u64) =
                        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_vehicle_repair_silent) as usize) };
                    f(veh);
                }
            } else if let Some((_, target_ped)) = trainer::find_entity_along_ray(
                base, rvas, rvas.ped_pool, ray_origin, ray_dir, 95.0, 2.2, &[ped],
            ) {
                if rvas.fn_ped_replenish_silent != 0 {
                    let f: extern "system" fn(u64) =
                        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_ped_replenish_silent) as usize) };
                    f(target_ped);
                }
                if rvas.fn_phys_unfreeze != 0 {
                    let u: extern "system" fn(u64) =
                        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_phys_unfreeze) as usize) };
                    u(target_ped);
                }
            }
        }
        16 => {
            // Rope / Tow Tether Gun: click entity A then entity B to tether them with live spring physics!
            let mut hit = 0u64;
            for pool_rva in [rvas.vehicle_pool, rvas.ped_pool, rvas.object_pool] {
                if let Some((_, ent)) = trainer::find_entity_along_ray(
                    base, rvas, pool_rva, ray_origin, ray_dir, 95.0, 2.4, &[ped],
                ) {
                    hit = ent;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if hit > 0x10000 {
                let a = ROPE_TETHER_A.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
                if a == 0 || ROPE_TETHER_B.load(Ordering::Relaxed) != 0 {
                    ROPE_TETHER_A.store(hit, Ordering::Relaxed);
                    ROPE_TETHER_B.store(0, Ordering::Relaxed);
                } else if hit != a {
                    ROPE_TETHER_B.store(hit, Ordering::Relaxed);
                    let cur = LOOP_MASK_EX.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
                    LOOP_MASK_EX.store(cur | LOOP_EX_ROPE_TETHER, Ordering::Release);
                }
            }
        }
        17 => {
            // Paintball Recolor Gun: splatters vivid random neon RGB onto any vehicle you shoot!
            if let Some((_, veh)) = trainer::find_entity_along_ray(
                base, rvas, rvas.vehicle_pool, ray_origin, ray_dir, 110.0, 2.6, &[ped],
            ) {
                let s = METEOR_SEED.fetch_add(0x9E37_79B9_7F4A_7C15, Ordering::Relaxed);
                let hue = ((s >> 16) % 360) as f32;
                let rgb = trainer::hsv_to_rgb_f32(hue, 1.0, 1.0);
                if rvas.fn_get_veh_shader_effect != 0
                    && rvas.fn_commit_veh_color != 0
                    && let Some(dh) = trainer::safe_read::<u64>((veh + rvas.entity_draw_handler) as usize)
                    && dh > 0x10000
                {
                    let get_fx: extern "system" fn(u64) -> u64 =
                        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_veh_shader_effect) as usize) };
                    let commit: extern "system" fn(u64) =
                        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_commit_veh_color) as usize) };
                    let fx = get_fx(dh);
                    if fx > 0x10000
                        && trainer::safe_write::<[f32; 3]>((fx + rvas.veh_shader_rgb) as usize, rgb)
                    {
                        commit(fx);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        _ => {}
    }
}

fn apply_player_single_proof(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, flag: u32, enable: bool) {
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    if rvas.fn_set_damage_proof_comp_flag != 0
        && rvas.fn_get_damage_proof_comp != 0
        && rvas.fn_get_or_create_damage_proof_comp != 0
    {
        let comp = if enable {
            let f: extern "system" fn(u64) -> u64 = unsafe {
                std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_or_create_damage_proof_comp) as usize)
            };
            f(ped)
        } else {
            let Some(ent_id) = trainer::safe_read::<u32>((ped + rvas.ped_entity_id) as usize)
            else {
                return;
            };
            let f: extern "system" fn(u32) -> u64 =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_damage_proof_comp) as usize) };
            f(ent_id)
        };
        if comp > 0x10000 {
            DIAG_PED_PROOF_COMP.store(comp, Ordering::Relaxed);
            let set_flag: extern "system" fn(u64, u32, u8) =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_set_damage_proof_comp_flag) as usize) };
            set_flag(comp, flag, u8::from(enable));
        }
    }
}

fn apply_player_skyfall(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    if rvas.fn_phys_unfreeze != 0 {
        let unfreeze: extern "system" fn(u64) =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_phys_unfreeze) as usize) };
        unfreeze(ped);
    }
    if let Some((_r, fwd, _u, mut pos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ped, rvas) {
        pos[2] += 1.5;
        let _ = teleport_entity_native(base, rvas, ped, pos, None, false);
        set_entity_velocity_native(base, rvas, ped, [fwd[0] * 10.0, fwd[1] * 10.0, 26.0]);
    }
}

fn apply_randomize_player_wardrobe(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    if rvas.fn_set_ped_random_variation == 0 {
        return;
    }
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let rand_var: extern "system" fn(u64, u32, u32) =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_set_ped_random_variation) as usize) };
    rand_var(ped, 0, 0);
}

fn apply_ped_wardrobe_seed(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, seed: u32) {
    if rvas.fn_set_ped_random_variation == 0 {
        return;
    }
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let rand_var: extern "system" fn(u64, u32, u32) =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_set_ped_random_variation) as usize) };
    rand_var(ped, seed, 0);
    DIAG_LAST_WARDROBE_SEED.store(seed, Ordering::Relaxed);
}

/// Resolves `CPedInventory*` via primary `get_ped_inventory` (used by currency readers),
/// falling back to `get_ped_inv_alt`.
fn read_local_ped_inventory_primary(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) -> Option<u64> {
    let ped = read_local_ped(base, rvas)?;
    let ent_id = trainer::safe_read::<u32>((ped + rvas.ped_entity_id) as usize)?;
    for fn_rva in [rvas.fn_get_ped_inventory, rvas.fn_get_ped_inv_alt] {
        if fn_rva == 0 {
            continue;
        }
        let get_inv: extern "system" fn(u32) -> u64 =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + fn_rva) as usize) };
        let inv = get_inv(ent_id);
        if inv > 0x10000 {
            return Some(inv);
        }
    }
    None
}

/// Reads live Story Mode Wallet, Bank & Pocket `CURRENCY_CASH` balances via `inv_get_currency_balance`.
fn refresh_cash_balances(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    if rvas.fn_inv_get_currency_balance == 0 || rvas.currency_cash_hash == 0 {
        return;
    }
    let Some(inv) = read_local_ped_inventory_primary(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    // SAFETY: verified 3-arg `CInventory::GetCurrencyBalance(inv, currency_hash32, slot_hash32) -> i64`.
    let get_bal: extern "system" fn(u64, u32, u32) -> i64 =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_inv_get_currency_balance) as usize) };
    if rvas.cash_wallet_slot != 0 {
        let w = get_bal(inv, rvas.currency_cash_hash, rvas.cash_wallet_slot);
        DIAG_CASH_WALLET.store(w, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
    if rvas.cash_bank_slot != 0 {
        let b = get_bal(inv, rvas.currency_cash_hash, rvas.cash_bank_slot);
        DIAG_CASH_BANK.store(b, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
    if rvas.cash_pocket_slot != 0 {
        let p = get_bal(inv, rvas.currency_cash_hash, rvas.cash_pocket_slot);
        DIAG_CASH_POCKET.store(p, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
}

/// Adds Story Mode cash (`CURRENCY_CASH`) directly into player inventory via `inv_add_item_direct_slot`.
fn apply_add_story_cash(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, amount: i64, _bank: bool) {
    if amount <= 0 || rvas.currency_cash_hash == 0 || rvas.fn_inv_add_item_direct_slot == 0 {
        return;
    }
    let Some(inv) = read_local_ped_inventory_primary(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let reason = if rvas.give_loadout_reason != 0 {
        rvas.give_loadout_reason
    } else {
        rvas.add_item_reason
    };
    let mut tx_out: u32 = 0;
    let zero_flags = [0u8; 16];
    // SAFETY: verified 6-arg `CInventory::AddItemDirectSlot(inv, &mut tx, item_hash32, qty_i64, reason, &flags)`.
    let add_direct: extern "system" fn(u64, *mut u32, u32, i64, u32, *const u8) =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_inv_add_item_direct_slot) as usize) };
    add_direct(
        inv,
        &mut tx_out,
        rvas.currency_cash_hash,
        amount.clamp(1, 100_000_000),
        reason,
        zero_flags.as_ptr(),
    );
    if tx_out != 0 {
        DIAG_LAST_CASH_TX.store(tx_out, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
    refresh_cash_balances(base, rvas);
}

/// Writes live Underglow Neon RGB to `[veh_shader_effect + veh_shader_neon_rgb]` (`+0x124`) & commits.
fn apply_vehicle_neon_rgb(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, rgb: [f32; 3]) {
    if rvas.fn_get_veh_shader_effect == 0
        || rvas.fn_commit_veh_color == 0
        || rvas.veh_shader_neon_rgb == 0
    {
        return;
    }
    let Some(veh) = active_or_last_vehicle(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some(draw_handler) =
        trainer::safe_read::<u64>((veh + rvas.entity_draw_handler) as usize)
    else {
        return;
    };
    if draw_handler < 0x10000 {
        return;
    }
    let get_fx: extern "system" fn(u64) -> u64 =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_veh_shader_effect) as usize) };
    let fx = get_fx(draw_handler);
    if fx < 0x10000 {
        return;
    }
    DIAG_VEH_FX_PTR.store(fx, Ordering::Relaxed);
    if trainer::safe_write::<[f32; 3]>((fx + rvas.veh_shader_neon_rgb) as usize, rgb) {
        let commit: extern "system" fn(u64) =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_commit_veh_color) as usize) };
        commit(fx);
        DIAG_LAST_NEON_APPLIED.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
}

/// Enables/disables all 4 vehicle underglow neon channels (Left/Right/Front/Back) via `veh_set_neon_flags`.
fn apply_vehicle_neon_enabled(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, enable: bool) {
    if rvas.fn_get_veh_engine_comp == 0 || rvas.fn_veh_set_neon_flags == 0 {
        return;
    }
    let Some(veh) = active_or_last_vehicle(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some(ent_id) = trainer::safe_read::<u32>((veh + rvas.ped_entity_id) as usize) else {
        return;
    };
    let get_comp: extern "system" fn(u32) -> u64 =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_veh_engine_comp) as usize) };
    let comp = get_comp(ent_id);
    if comp < 0x10000 {
        return;
    }
    DIAG_VEH_ENGINE_COMP.store(comp, Ordering::Relaxed);
    let Some(head32) = trainer::safe_read::<[u8; 32]>((comp + 0x278) as usize) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some(tail4) = trainer::safe_read::<[u8; 4]>((comp + 0x298) as usize) else {
        return;
    };
    #[repr(C, align(16))]
    struct NeonStateBuf([u8; 48]);
    let mut buf = NeonStateBuf([0u8; 48]);
    buf.0[0..32].copy_from_slice(&head32);
    buf.0[32..36].copy_from_slice(&tail4);
    let flag = u8::from(enable);
    buf.0[8] = flag;
    buf.0[9] = flag;
    buf.0[10] = flag;
    buf.0[11] = flag;
    // SAFETY: verified 2-arg `CVehicleNeonComp::SetFlags(comp, &state_36b)`.
    let set_neon: extern "system" fn(u64, *const u8) =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_veh_set_neon_flags) as usize) };
    set_neon(comp, buf.0.as_ptr());
    DIAG_LAST_NEON_APPLIED.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
}

/// Crosshair camera-ray entity picker for Object Spooner (picks aimed prop, vehicle, or ped up to 85m!).
fn spooner_grab_aimed(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let (origin, dir) = if let Some((_cr, cf, _cu, cp)) = trainer::read_camera_mat34(base, rvas) {
        (cp, cf)
    } else if let Some((_r, f, _u, p)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ped, rvas) {
        ([p[0], p[1], p[2] + 0.65], f)
    } else {
        return;
    };
    let mut exclude = vec![ped];
    if let Some(cur_v) = read_current_vehicle(base, rvas) {
        exclude.push(cur_v);
    }
    let mut picked: Option<(u8, u64)> = None;
    for (kind, pool_rva) in [
        (0u8, rvas.object_pool),
        (1u8, rvas.vehicle_pool),
        (2u8, rvas.ped_pool),
    ] {
        if let Some((_, ent)) =
            trainer::find_entity_along_ray(base, rvas, pool_rva, origin, dir, 85.0, 2.2, &exclude)
        {
            picked = Some((kind, ent));
            break;
        }
    }
    let Some((kind, ent_ptr)) = picked else {
        return;
    };
    let hash64 = trainer::safe_read::<u64>((ent_ptr + 0x20) as usize)
        .filter(|&mi| mi > 0x10000)
        .and_then(|mi| trainer::safe_read::<u64>((mi + 0x60) as usize))
        .unwrap_or(0);
    if let Ok(mut s) = SPOONER_STATE.try_lock() {
        if let Some(pos_idx) = s.entities.iter().position(|e| e.ptr == ent_ptr) {
            s.selected = pos_idx;
        } else {
            s.entities.push(SpoonerEntity {
                kind,
                ptr: ent_ptr,
                hash64,
                frozen: false,
                invincible: false,
                attached: false,
                attach_target: 0,
                attach_bone: 0,
                attach_offset: [0.0, 2.2, 0.6],
                attach_rot: [0.0; 3],
                alpha: 255,
                scale: 1.0,
                collision: true,
            });
            s.selected = s.entities.len() - 1;
        }
        sync_spooner_hud_locked(&mut s, rvas.ped_pos_packed);
    }
}

/// Resolves a 16-byte-aligned engine `ScriptHandle` for any `CPed*`, `CVehicle*`, or `CObject*`.
fn get_entity_script_handle(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, ent: u64) -> Option<trainer::ScriptHandle> {
    if ent < 0x10000 || rvas.fn_get_script_handle_for_entity == 0 {
        return None;
    }
    let mut handle = trainer::ScriptHandle::default();
    // SAFETY: verified 3-arg `GetScriptHandleForEntity(CEntity*, *mut ScriptHandle, mode=2)`.
    let get_h: extern "system" fn(u64, *mut trainer::ScriptHandle, u32) =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_script_handle_for_entity) as usize) };
    get_h(ent, &mut handle, 2);
    handle.is_valid().then_some(handle)
}

/// Arms ANY `CPed*` (bodyguard, attacker, or riot NPC) with a firearm + ammo & equips it in hand!
fn arm_ped_with_weapon(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, npc: u64, weapon_hash32: u32) -> bool {
    if npc < 0x10000 {
        return false;
    }
    let hash32 = if weapon_hash32 != 0 {
        weapon_hash32
    } else {
        DEFAULT_PED_WEAPON_HASH.load(Ordering::Relaxed)
    };
    if hash32 == 0 {
        return false;
    }
    let Some(ent_id) = trainer::safe_read::<u32>((npc + rvas.ped_entity_id) as usize) else {
        return false;
    };
    let mut granted = false;
    // 1. Direct `CWeaponInventory::AddWeapon` on the NPC's own `CPedInventory`!
    for fn_inv in [rvas.fn_get_ped_inv_alt, rvas.fn_get_ped_inventory] {
        if fn_inv == 0 {
            continue;
        }
        let get_inv: extern "system" fn(u32) -> u64 =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + fn_inv) as usize) };
        let inv = get_inv(ent_id);
        if inv > 0x10000 {
            if rvas.fn_inv_add_weapon != 0 && add_weapon_via_wep_inv(base, rvas, inv, hash32) != 0 {
                granted = true;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    // 2. Fallback: native `GIVE_WEAPON_TO_PED` (`give_weapon_to_ped(ped, hash, 999, 0, 1)`).
    if !granted && rvas.fn_give_weapon_to_ped != 0 {
        let give_wep: extern "system" fn(u64, u32, i32, u32, u32) =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_give_weapon_to_ped) as usize) };
        give_wep(npc, hash32, 999, 0, 1);
        granted = true;
    }
    // 3. Force-equip firearm directly in the NPC's hand!
    if rvas.fn_equip_ped_weapon != 0 {
        let equip: extern "system" fn(u64, u32, u8, u8, u8, u8, u8) =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_equip_ped_weapon) as usize) };
        equip(npc, hash32, 1, 0, 1, 1, 0);
    }
    if granted {
        DIAG_LAST_PED_ARMED_OK.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
    granted
}

/// Issues native `SCRIPT_TASK_COMBAT` (`TASK_COMBAT_PED`) from `ped` onto `target`.
fn issue_task_combat_ped(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, ped: u64, target: u64) -> bool {
    if rvas.fn_task_combat_ped == 0 || ped < 0x10000 || target < 0x10000 || ped == target {
        return false;
    }
    let (Some(ped_h), Some(tgt_h)) = (
        get_entity_script_handle(base, rvas, ped),
        get_entity_script_handle(base, rvas, target),
    ) else {
        return false;
    };
    // SAFETY: verified 6-arg `TASK_COMBAT_PED(&ped_h, &tgt_h, combat_flags=0, threat_flags=16, duration_ms=120000, extra=0)`.
    let task_combat: extern "system" fn(
        *const trainer::ScriptHandle,
        *const trainer::ScriptHandle,
        u32,
        u32,
        i32,
        u32,
    ) = unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_task_combat_ped) as usize) };
    task_combat(&ped_h, &tgt_h, 0, 16, 120_000, 0);
    DIAG_COMBAT_TASKS_ISSUED.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
    true
}

/// Issues native `SCRIPT_TASK_FOLLOW_TO_OFFSET_OF_ENTITY` so bodyguards jog/run alongside the player!
fn issue_task_follow_offset(
    base: u64,
    rvas: &RvaTable,
    ped: u64,
    leader: u64,
    offset: [f32; 3],
) -> bool {
    if rvas.fn_task_follow_to_offset == 0 || ped < 0x10000 || leader < 0x10000 || ped == leader {
        return false;
    }
    let (Some(ped_h), Some(ldr_h)) = (
        get_entity_script_handle(base, rvas, ped),
        get_entity_script_handle(base, rvas, leader),
    ) else {
        return false;
    };
    let off_v = trainer::Vec4A([offset[0], offset[1], offset[2], 0.0]);
    // SAFETY: verified 8-arg `TASK_FOLLOW_TO_OFFSET_OF_ENTITY(&ped_h, &ldr_h, &Vec4A, mbr=2.5, timeout=-1, stop_range=2.2, persist=1, unk=0)`.
    let task_follow: extern "system" fn(
        *const trainer::ScriptHandle,
        *const trainer::ScriptHandle,
        *const trainer::Vec4A,
        f32,
        i32,
        f32,
        u8,
        u8,
    ) = unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_task_follow_to_offset) as usize) };
    task_follow(&ped_h, &ldr_h, &off_v, 2.5, -1, 2.2, 1, 0);
    true
}

/// Issues native `SCRIPT_TASK_HANDS_UP` onto any NPC ped.
fn issue_task_hands_up(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, ped: u64, facing: u64, duration_ms: i32) -> bool {
    if rvas.fn_task_hands_up == 0 || ped < 0x10000 {
        return false;
    }
    let Some(ped_h) = get_entity_script_handle(base, rvas, ped) else {
        return false;
    };
    let face_h = get_entity_script_handle(base, rvas, facing).unwrap_or_default();
    // SAFETY: verified 5-arg `TASK_HANDS_UP(&ped_h, duration_ms, &face_h, time_to_face=-1, flags=0)`.
    let task_hu: extern "system" fn(
        *const trainer::ScriptHandle,
        i32,
        *const trainer::ScriptHandle,
        i32,
        u32,
    ) = unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_task_hands_up) as usize) };
    task_hu(&ped_h, duration_ms, &face_h, -1, 0);
    true
}

/// Configures real GTA Ped AI, Relationship Group, Player Group membership, Config Flags,
/// Weapons, and initial Combat/Follow Task for a spawned or selected NPC (`role`: 0=Neutral, 1=Defender, 2=Attacker).
fn configure_ped_role(
    base: u64,
    rvas: &RvaTable,
    npc: u64,
    role: u8,
    weapon_hash32: u32,
    invincible: bool,
) {
    let Some(player) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    if npc < 0x10000 || npc == player {
        return;
    }
    if let Some(ent_id) = trainer::safe_read::<u32>((npc + rvas.ped_entity_id) as usize)
        && rvas.fn_get_ped_task_comp != 0
    {
        let get_tc: extern "system" fn(u32) -> u64 =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_ped_task_comp) as usize) };
        let tc = get_tc(ent_id);
        if tc > 0x10000 {
            DIAG_PED_TASK_COMP.store(tc, Ordering::Relaxed);
        }
    }
    if role == 0 {
        if invincible {
            call_damage_proof(base, rvas, npc, true);
        }
        return;
    }

    // Combat-readiness flags for both Defenders and Attackers
    set_ped_config_flag(base, rvas, npc, 150, false); // PCF_DisableShootingAt = false
    set_ped_config_flag(base, rvas, npc, 280, true); // PCF_IsSanctionedShooter = true
    set_ped_config_flag(base, rvas, npc, 347, true); // PCF_AllowDoorBargingUnderCombat = true
    set_ped_config_flag(base, rvas, npc, 19, false); // PCF_KeepWeaponHolsteredUnlessFired = false

    let _ = arm_ped_with_weapon(base, rvas, npc, weapon_hash32);
    let npc_h = get_entity_script_handle(base, rvas, npc);

    if role == 1 {
        // ARMED DEFENDING BODYGUARD
        call_damage_proof(base, rvas, npc, invincible);
        set_ped_config_flag(base, rvas, npc, 222, true); // PCF_NeverLeavesGroup
        set_ped_config_flag(base, rvas, npc, 443, true); // PCF_FollowLeaderRunToEnterTransport
        set_ped_config_flag(base, rvas, npc, 224, true); // PCF_BlockGroupPedAimedAtResponse
        set_ped_config_flag(base, rvas, npc, 193, true); // PCF_DontAttackPlayerWithoutWantedLevel
        set_ped_config_flag(base, rvas, npc, 464, false); // PCF_CanBeAttackedByFriendlyPed = false
        set_ped_config_flag(base, rvas, npc, 183, false); // PCF_PedIsEnemyToPlayer = false
        set_ped_config_flag(base, rvas, npc, 232, true); // PCF_TreatDislikeAsHateWhenInCombat
        if let Some(h) = npc_h {
            let grp = if rvas.rel_group_companion != 0 {
                rvas.rel_group_companion
            } else {
                rvas.rel_group_player
            };
            if grp != 0 {
                if rvas.fn_set_ped_rel_group_hash != 0 {
                    let set_rel: extern "system" fn(*const trainer::ScriptHandle, u32) =
                        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_set_ped_rel_group_hash) as usize) };
                    set_rel(&h, grp);
                }
                if rvas.fn_set_ped_rel_group_default != 0 {
                    let set_def: extern "system" fn(*const trainer::ScriptHandle, u32) =
                        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_set_ped_rel_group_default) as usize) };
                    set_def(&h, grp);
                }
            }
        }
        if rvas.fn_add_ped_to_player_group != 0 {
            // SAFETY: verified 4-arg `AddPedToPlayerGroup(player_ped, npc_ped, flag1=1, flag2=0)`.
            let add_grp: extern "system" fn(u64, u64, u8, u8) =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_add_ped_to_player_group) as usize) };
            add_grp(player, npc, 1, 0);
        }
        if let Ok(mut atks) = ATTACKERS.try_lock() {
            atks.retain(|&p| p != npc);
        }
        let bg_idx = if let Ok(mut bgs) = BODYGUARDS.try_lock() {
            if !bgs.contains(&npc) && bgs.len() < 16 {
                bgs.push(npc);
            }
            bgs.len().saturating_sub(1)
        } else {
            0
        };
        DIAG_LAST_DEFENDER_PTR.store(npc, Ordering::Relaxed);
        let first_atk = ATTACKERS
            .try_lock()
            .ok()
            .and_then(|v| v.first().copied())
            .filter(|&p| p > 0x10000);
        if let Some(atk) = first_atk {
            let _ = issue_task_combat_ped(base, rvas, npc, atk);
        } else {
            let side = if bg_idx % 2 == 0 { 1.8 } else { -1.8 } * (1.0 + (bg_idx / 2) as f32 * 0.6);
            let _ = issue_task_follow_offset(base, rvas, npc, player, [side, -2.2, 0.0]);
        }
    } else if role == 2 {
        // ARMED HOSTILE ATTACKER
        call_damage_proof(base, rvas, npc, invincible);
        set_ped_config_flag(base, rvas, npc, 183, true); // PCF_PedIsEnemyToPlayer
        set_ped_config_flag(base, rvas, npc, 77, true); // PCF_CanAttackNonWantedPlayerAsLaw
        set_ped_config_flag(base, rvas, npc, 193, false); // PCF_DontAttackPlayerWithoutWantedLevel = false
        set_ped_config_flag(base, rvas, npc, 232, true); // PCF_TreatDislikeAsHateWhenInCombat
        set_ped_config_flag(base, rvas, npc, 233, true); // PCF_TreatNonFriendlyAsHateWhenInCombat
        set_ped_config_flag(base, rvas, npc, 33, true); // PCF_CanAttackFriendly
        if let Some(h) = npc_h
            && rvas.rel_group_hates_player != 0
        {
            if rvas.fn_set_ped_rel_group_hash != 0 {
                let set_rel: extern "system" fn(*const trainer::ScriptHandle, u32) =
                    unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_set_ped_rel_group_hash) as usize) };
                set_rel(&h, rvas.rel_group_hates_player);
            }
            if rvas.fn_set_ped_rel_group_default != 0 {
                let set_def: extern "system" fn(*const trainer::ScriptHandle, u32) =
                    unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_set_ped_rel_group_default) as usize) };
                set_def(&h, rvas.rel_group_hates_player);
            }
        }
        if let Ok(mut bgs) = BODYGUARDS.try_lock() {
            bgs.retain(|&p| p != npc);
        }
        if let Ok(mut atks) = ATTACKERS.try_lock()
            && !atks.contains(&npc)
            && atks.len() < 16
        {
            atks.push(npc);
        }
        DIAG_LAST_ATTACKER_PTR.store(npc, Ordering::Relaxed);
        let _ = issue_task_combat_ped(base, rvas, npc, player);
        // Alert any active Defending Bodyguards to immediately engage this new threat!
        let defenders: Vec<u64> = BODYGUARDS
            .try_lock()
            .map(|v| v.clone())
            .unwrap_or_default();
        for bg in defenders {
            if bg > 0x10000
                && trainer::safe_read::<u64>(bg as usize).is_some_and(|vt| vt > 0x10000)
            {
                let _ = issue_task_combat_ped(base, rvas, bg, npc);
            }
        }
    }
    // Keep continuous Squad AI loop engaged whenever any Defenders or Attackers exist!
    let cur = LOOP_MASK.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
    if (cur & LOOP_PED_SQUAD_AI) == 0 {
        LOOP_MASK.store(cur | LOOP_PED_SQUAD_AI, Ordering::Release);
    }
}

fn start_ped_spawn_ex(
    base: u64,
    rvas: &RvaTable,
    hash64: u64,
    role: u8,
    weapon_hash32: u32,
    invincible: bool,
    add_to_spooner: bool,
    offset_override: Option<[f32; 3]>,
) {
    start_ped_spawn_full(
        base,
        rvas,
        hash64,
        role,
        weapon_hash32,
        invincible,
        add_to_spooner,
        offset_override,
        None,
    );
}

#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
fn start_ped_spawn_full(
    base: u64,
    rvas: &RvaTable,
    hash64: u64,
    role: u8,
    weapon_hash32: u32,
    invincible: bool,
    add_to_spooner: bool,
    offset_override: Option<[f32; 3]>,
    escort_seat: Option<(u64, i32)>,
) {
    if hash64 == 0
        || rvas.fn_ped_params_ctor == 0
        || rvas.fn_create_ped_direct == 0
        || rvas.fn_add_ped_to_world == 0
    {
        return;
    }
    if let Ok(mut p) = PENDING_PED_SPAWN.try_lock()
        && let Some(mut old) = p.take()
    {
        release_str_request(base, rvas, &mut old.token);
        HAS_PENDING_PED.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
    let model_id = resolve_model_id_any(base, rvas, hash64);
    if (model_id & 0x3F_FFFF) == 0x3F_FFFF {
        return;
    }
    if rvas.fn_request_model_by_id != 0 && rvas.fn_has_model_loaded != 0 {
        let mut token: u32 = 0;
        let req: extern "system" fn(*mut u32, u32) -> *mut u32 =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_request_model_by_id) as usize) };
        req(&mut token, model_id);
        let has_loaded: extern "system" fn(*const u32) -> u8 =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_has_model_loaded) as usize) };
        if has_loaded(&token) != 0 {
            finish_ped_spawn_now(
                base,
                rvas,
                hash64,
                model_id,
                role,
                weapon_hash32,
                invincible,
                add_to_spooner,
                offset_override,
                escort_seat,
            );
            release_str_request(base, rvas, &mut token);
        } else if let Ok(mut p) = PENDING_PED_SPAWN.try_lock() {
            *p = Some(PendingPedSpawn {
                hash64,
                token,
                role,
                weapon_hash32,
                invincible,
                add_to_spooner,
                offset_override,
                escort_seat,
                retries_left: 60,
            });
            HAS_PENDING_PED.store(true, Ordering::Release);
        } else {
            release_str_request(base, rvas, &mut token);
        }
    } else {
        finish_ped_spawn_now(
            base,
            rvas,
            hash64,
            model_id,
            role,
            weapon_hash32,
            invincible,
            add_to_spooner,
            offset_override,
            escort_seat,
        );
    }
}

fn step_ped_spawn_queue(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let next = match PED_SPAWN_QUEUE.try_lock() {
        Ok(mut q) => {
            let item = q.pop_front();
            if q.is_empty() {
                HAS_PED_SPAWN_QUEUE.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
            }
            item
        }
        Err(_) => return,
    };
    if let Some(j) = next {
        start_ped_spawn_full(
            base,
            rvas,
            j.hash64,
            j.role,
            j.weapon_hash32,
            j.invincible,
            j.add_to_spooner,
            j.offset_override,
            j.escort_seat,
        );
    }
}

fn step_pending_ped_spawn(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let mut job = match PENDING_PED_SPAWN.try_lock() {
        Ok(mut g) => match g.take() {
            Some(j) => j,
            None => {
                HAS_PENDING_PED.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
                return;
            }
        },
        Err(_) => return,
    };
    if rvas.fn_has_model_loaded == 0 || job.retries_left == 0 {
        release_str_request(base, rvas, &mut job.token);
        HAS_PENDING_PED.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
        return;
    }
    let has_loaded: extern "system" fn(*const u32) -> u8 =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_has_model_loaded) as usize) };
    if has_loaded(&job.token) != 0 {
        let model_id = resolve_model_id_any(base, rvas, job.hash64);
        finish_ped_spawn_now(
            base,
            rvas,
            job.hash64,
            model_id,
            job.role,
            job.weapon_hash32,
            job.invincible,
            job.add_to_spooner,
            job.offset_override,
            job.escort_seat,
        );
        release_str_request(base, rvas, &mut job.token);
        HAS_PENDING_PED.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
    } else {
        job.retries_left -= 1;
        if job.retries_left > 0 {
            if let Ok(mut g) = PENDING_PED_SPAWN.try_lock() {
                *g = Some(job);
            } else {
                release_str_request(base, rvas, &mut job.token);
                HAS_PENDING_PED.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
            }
        } else {
            release_str_request(base, rvas, &mut job.token);
            HAS_PENDING_PED.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
        }
    }
}

#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
fn finish_ped_spawn_now(
    base: u64,
    rvas: &RvaTable,
    hash64: u64,
    model_id: u32,
    role: u8,
    weapon_hash32: u32,
    invincible: bool,
    add_to_spooner: bool,
    offset_override: Option<[f32; 3]>,
    escort_seat: Option<(u64, i32)>,
) {
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some((right, fwd, up, pos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ped, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let len = fwd[0].hypot(fwd[1]).max(0.001);
    let fx = fwd[0] / len;
    let fy = fwd[1] / len;
    let rlen = right[0].hypot(right[1]).max(0.001);
    let rx = right[0] / rlen;
    let ry = right[1] / rlen;
    let spawn_pos = if let Some([ox, oy, oz]) = offset_override {
        [pos[0] + ox, pos[1] + oy, pos[2] + oz]
    } else if role == 2 {
        // Spawn hostile Attackers 11m ahead facing you for instant dramatic gunfight!
        [pos[0] + fx * 11.0 + rx * 1.5, pos[1] + fy * 11.0 + ry * 1.5, pos[2] + 0.15]
    } else {
        // Spawn Defenders/Neutrals 3.2m ahead/flank
        [pos[0] + fx * 3.2, pos[1] + fy * 3.2, pos[2] + 0.15]
    };
    #[repr(C, align(16))]
    struct Mat44([f32; 16]);
    let mat = Mat44([
        right[0], right[1], right[2], 0.0,
        fwd[0], fwd[1], fwd[2], 0.0,
        up[0], up[1], up[2], 0.0,
        spawn_pos[0], spawn_pos[1], spawn_pos[2], 0.0,
    ]);
    let mut params = trainer::PedCreationParams::default();
    let ctor: extern "system" fn(*mut trainer::PedCreationParams, *const u32, *const Mat44) -> *mut u8 =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_ped_params_ctor) as usize) };
    let _ = ctor(&mut params, &model_id, &mat);
    params.raw[0x00..0x02].copy_from_slice(&1u16.to_le_bytes());
    params.raw[0x04..0x08].copy_from_slice(&7u32.to_le_bytes());
    params.raw[0x08..0x0a].copy_from_slice(&6u16.to_le_bytes());
    params.raw[0x60] = 0;
    params.raw[0x64] = 1;
    params.raw[0x69] = 1;

    let create: extern "system" fn(*mut trainer::PedCreationParams) -> u64 =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_create_ped_direct) as usize) };
    let new_ped = create(&mut params);
    if new_ped < 0x10000 {
        return;
    }
    if rvas.fn_set_ped_random_variation != 0 {
        let rand_var: extern "system" fn(u64, u32, u32) =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_set_ped_random_variation) as usize) };
        rand_var(new_ped, 0, 0);
    }
    let add_world: extern "system" fn(u64, u32, u32, u32, u64, u8) =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_add_ped_to_world) as usize) };
    add_world(new_ped, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0);

    DIAG_LAST_SPAWNED_PED.store(new_ped, Ordering::Relaxed);
    PED_SPAWN_SUCCESSES.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);

    configure_ped_role(base, rvas, new_ped, role, weapon_hash32, invincible);

    if let Some((escort_veh, seat_idx)) = escort_seat
        && escort_veh > 0x10000
        && trainer::safe_read::<u64>(escort_veh as usize).is_some_and(|vt| vt > 0x10000)
    {
        if warp_any_ped_into_vehicle(base, rvas, new_ped, escort_veh, seat_idx) {
            DIAG_ESCORT_SPAWNED.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
            if seat_idx == 0 {
                // Driver of escort convoy: chase/escort the local player cleanly!
                let _ = issue_task_vehicle_chase(base, rvas, new_ped, ped);
            }
        }
    }

    if add_to_spooner {
        if let Ok(mut s) = SPOONER_STATE.try_lock() {
            s.entities.push(SpoonerEntity {
                kind: 2,
                ptr: new_ped,
                hash64,
                frozen: false,
                invincible,
                attached: false,
                attach_target: 0,
                attach_bone: 0,
                attach_offset: [0.0, 2.2, 0.6],
                attach_rot: [0.0; 3],
                alpha: 255,
                scale: 1.0,
                collision: true,
            });
            s.selected = s.entities.len() - 1;
            sync_spooner_hud_locked(&mut s, rvas.ped_pos_packed);
        }
    }
}

fn step_bodyguards_follow(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some((right, fwd, _u, pos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ped, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Ok(mut bgs) = BODYGUARDS.try_lock() else {
        return;
    };
    bgs.retain(|&p| p > 0x10000 && trainer::safe_read::<u64>(p as usize).is_some_and(|vt| vt > 0x10000));
    for (idx, &bg) in bgs.iter().enumerate() {
        if let Some((_r, _f, _u, bpos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(bg, rvas) {
            let d = (bpos[0] - pos[0]).hypot(bpos[1] - pos[1]);
            if d > 35.0 {
                let side = if idx % 2 == 0 { 1.0 } else { -1.0 } * (2.0 + (idx / 2) as f32 * 1.5);
                let target = [
                    pos[0] - fwd[0] * 2.5 + right[0] * side,
                    pos[1] - fwd[1] * 2.5 + right[1] * side,
                    pos[2] + 0.15,
                ];
                let _ = teleport_entity_native(base, rvas, bg, target, None, true);
            }
        }
    }
}

/// Periodic (~1.5s) Squad AI director: keeps Defenders fighting active threats or jogging in formation,
/// and keeps Attackers aggressively hunting the player & defending squad!
fn step_ped_squad_ai(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, follow_player: bool) {
    let Some(player) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some((_r, _f, _u, ppos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(player, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let bgs: Vec<u64> = if let Ok(mut v) = BODYGUARDS.try_lock() {
        v.retain(|&p| p > 0x10000 && trainer::safe_read::<u64>(p as usize).is_some_and(|vt| vt > 0x10000));
        v.clone()
    } else {
        Vec::new()
    };
    let atks: Vec<u64> = if let Ok(mut v) = ATTACKERS.try_lock() {
        v.retain(|&p| p > 0x10000 && trainer::safe_read::<u64>(p as usize).is_some_and(|vt| vt > 0x10000));
        v.clone()
    } else {
        Vec::new()
    };
    if bgs.is_empty() && atks.is_empty() {
        let cur = LOOP_MASK.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
        LOOP_MASK.store(cur & !LOOP_PED_SQUAD_AI, Ordering::Release);
        return;
    }
    // 1. Keep Attackers actively engaging Player (or closest Defender within 45m).
    for &atk in &atks {
        let mut target = player;
        if let Some((_, _, _, apos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(atk, rvas) {
            let mut best_d = (apos[0] - ppos[0]).hypot(apos[1] - ppos[1]);
            for &bg in &bgs {
                if let Some((_, _, _, bpos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(bg, rvas) {
                    let d = (apos[0] - bpos[0]).hypot(apos[1] - bpos[1]);
                    if d < best_d && d < 45.0 {
                        best_d = d;
                        target = bg;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        let _ = issue_task_combat_ped(base, rvas, atk, target);
    }
    // 2. Keep Defenders engaging active Attackers, or jogging cleanly alongside Player!
    for (idx, &bg) in bgs.iter().enumerate() {
        if let Some((_, _, _, bpos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(bg, rvas) {
            let mut nearest_atk: Option<(f32, u64)> = None;
            for &atk in &atks {
                if let Some((_, _, _, apos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(atk, rvas) {
                    let d = (apos[0] - bpos[0]).hypot(apos[1] - bpos[1]);
                    if d < 75.0 && nearest_atk.is_none_or(|(bd, _)| d < bd) {
                        nearest_atk = Some((d, atk));
                    }
                }
            }
            if let Some((_, atk)) = nearest_atk {
                let _ = issue_task_combat_ped(base, rvas, bg, atk);
            } else if follow_player {
                let dp = (bpos[0] - ppos[0]).hypot(bpos[1] - ppos[1]);
                if dp > 6.5 && dp <= 35.0 {
                    let side = if idx % 2 == 0 { 1.8 } else { -1.8 } * (1.0 + (idx / 2) as f32 * 0.6);
                    let _ = issue_task_follow_offset(base, rvas, bg, player, [side, -2.2, 0.0]);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

/// Classic Menyoo Ped Riot Mode: nearby NPCs turn hostile to everyone, get armed & brawl each other!
fn step_ped_riot(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let Some(player) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some((_r, _f, _u, ppos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(player, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let mut exclude = vec![player];
    if let Ok(bgs) = BODYGUARDS.try_lock() {
        exclude.extend(bgs.iter().copied());
    }
    let nearby =
        trainer::find_nearby_entities_in_pool(base, rvas, rvas.ped_pool, ppos, 65.0, &exclude, 12);
    if nearby.len() < 2 {
        return;
    }
    for (i, &(_d, npc)) in nearby.iter().enumerate() {
        set_ped_config_flag(base, rvas, npc, 233, true); // PCF_TreatNonFriendlyAsHateWhenInCombat
        set_ped_config_flag(base, rvas, npc, 33, true); // PCF_CanAttackFriendly
        set_ped_config_flag(base, rvas, npc, 232, true); // PCF_TreatDislikeAsHateWhenInCombat
        set_ped_config_flag(base, rvas, npc, 150, false); // PCF_DisableShootingAt = false
        let opp = nearby[(i + 1) % nearby.len()].1;
        let _ = issue_task_combat_ped(base, rvas, npc, opp);
    }
}

fn apply_clone_player_ped(
    base: u64,
    rvas: &RvaTable,
    role: u8,
    weapon_hash32: u32,
    invincible: bool,
) {
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let hash64 = trainer::safe_read::<u64>((ped + 0x20) as usize)
        .filter(|&mi| mi > 0x10000)
        .and_then(|mi| trainer::safe_read::<u64>((mi + 0x60) as usize))
        .unwrap_or(0);
    if hash64 == 0 {
        return;
    }
    start_ped_spawn_ex(base, rvas, hash64, role, weapon_hash32, invincible, false, None);
}

fn apply_spawn_gang_war_squad(
    base: u64,
    rvas: &RvaTable,
    hash64: u64,
    weapon_hash32: u32,
    defenders: u8,
    attackers: u8,
) {
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some((right, fwd, _up, _pos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ped, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let flen = fwd[0].hypot(fwd[1]).max(0.001);
    let fx = fwd[0] / flen;
    let fy = fwd[1] / flen;
    let rlen = right[0].hypot(right[1]).max(0.001);
    let rx = right[0] / rlen;
    let ry = right[1] / rlen;
    let use_hash = if hash64 != 0 {
        hash64
    } else {
        trainer::safe_read::<u64>((ped + 0x20) as usize)
            .filter(|&mi| mi > 0x10000)
            .and_then(|mi| trainer::safe_read::<u64>((mi + 0x60) as usize))
            .unwrap_or(0)
    };
    if use_hash == 0 {
        return;
    }
    if let Ok(mut q) = PED_SPAWN_QUEUE.try_lock() {
        for i in 0..defenders.min(4) {
            let spread = (f32::from(i) - 1.0) * 2.2;
            q.push_back(QueuedPedSpawn {
                hash64: use_hash,
                role: 1,
                weapon_hash32,
                invincible: true,
                add_to_spooner: false,
                offset_override: Some([fx * 3.5 + rx * spread, fy * 3.5 + ry * spread, 0.15]),
                escort_seat: None,
            });
        }
        for i in 0..attackers.min(4) {
            let spread = (f32::from(i) - 1.0) * 2.8;
            q.push_back(QueuedPedSpawn {
                hash64: use_hash,
                role: 2,
                weapon_hash32,
                invincible: false,
                add_to_spooner: false,
                offset_override: Some([fx * 15.0 + rx * spread, fy * 15.0 + ry * spread, 0.15]),
                escort_seat: None,
            });
        }
        if !q.is_empty() {
            HAS_PED_SPAWN_QUEUE.store(true, Ordering::Release);
        }
    }
}

fn apply_command_defenders(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, mode: u8) {
    let Some(player) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some((_r, _f, _u, ppos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(player, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let bgs: Vec<u64> = BODYGUARDS
        .try_lock()
        .map(|v| v.clone())
        .unwrap_or_default();
    if bgs.is_empty() {
        return;
    }
    // Find nearest threat (preferring tracked Attackers, else nearest world NPC).
    let threat = ATTACKERS
        .try_lock()
        .ok()
        .and_then(|v| v.first().copied())
        .filter(|&p| p > 0x10000 && trainer::safe_read::<u64>(p as usize).is_some_and(|vt| vt > 0x10000))
        .or_else(|| {
            let mut excl = vec![player];
            excl.extend(bgs.iter().copied());
            trainer::find_nearby_entities_in_pool(base, rvas, rvas.ped_pool, ppos, 75.0, &excl, 1)
                .first()
                .map(|&(_, p)| p)
        });
    for (idx, bg) in bgs.into_iter().enumerate() {
        if bg < 0x10000 || trainer::safe_read::<u64>(bg as usize).is_none_or(|vt| vt < 0x10000) {
            continue;
        }
        if rvas.fn_clear_ped_tasks != 0 {
            let clr: extern "system" fn(u64) =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_clear_ped_tasks) as usize) };
            clr(bg);
        }
        match mode {
            0 => {
                if let Some(t) = threat {
                    let _ = issue_task_combat_ped(base, rvas, bg, t);
                }
            }
            1 => {
                let side = if idx % 2 == 0 { 1.8 } else { -1.8 } * (1.0 + (idx / 2) as f32 * 0.6);
                let _ = issue_task_follow_offset(base, rvas, bg, player, [side, -2.2, 0.0]);
            }
            2 => {
                if rvas.fn_task_guard_pos != 0
                    && let Some(h) = get_entity_script_handle(base, rvas, bg)
                {
                    let guard: extern "system" fn(*const trainer::ScriptHandle, f32, f32, u8) =
                        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_task_guard_pos) as usize) };
                    guard(&h, 15.0, 20.0, 1);
                }
            }
            3 => {
                let _ = issue_task_hands_up(base, rvas, bg, player, 12_000);
            }
            _ => {}
        }
    }
}

fn apply_arm_all_bodyguards(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, weapon_hash32: u32) {
    let bgs: Vec<u64> = BODYGUARDS
        .try_lock()
        .map(|v| v.clone())
        .unwrap_or_default();
    for bg in bgs {
        if bg > 0x10000 && trainer::safe_read::<u64>(bg as usize).is_some_and(|vt| vt > 0x10000) {
            let _ = arm_ped_with_weapon(base, rvas, bg, weapon_hash32);
        }
    }
}

fn apply_clear_bodyguards(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let Ok(mut bgs) = BODYGUARDS.try_lock() else {
        return;
    };
    if rvas.fn_destroy_entity != 0 {
        let destroy: extern "system" fn(u64, u8) =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_destroy_entity) as usize) };
        for bg in bgs.drain(..) {
            if bg > 0x10000 && trainer::safe_read::<u64>(bg as usize).is_some_and(|vt| vt > 0x10000) {
                destroy(bg, 0);
            }
        }
    } else {
        bgs.clear();
    }
}

fn apply_clear_attackers(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let Ok(mut atks) = ATTACKERS.try_lock() else {
        return;
    };
    if rvas.fn_destroy_entity != 0 {
        let destroy: extern "system" fn(u64, u8) =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_destroy_entity) as usize) };
        for atk in atks.drain(..) {
            if atk > 0x10000 && trainer::safe_read::<u64>(atk as usize).is_some_and(|vt| vt > 0x10000) {
                destroy(atk, 0);
            }
        }
    } else {
        atks.clear();
    }
}

fn apply_force_player_ragdoll(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    apply_ped_no_ragdoll(base, rvas, false);
    if let Some((_r, fwd, _u, _pos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ped, rvas) {
        let len = fwd[0].hypot(fwd[1]).max(0.001);
        set_entity_velocity_native(
            base,
            rvas,
            ped,
            [(fwd[0] / len) * 6.5, (fwd[1] / len) * 6.5, 5.5],
        );
    }
}

fn apply_clear_player_tasks(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    if rvas.fn_clear_ped_tasks == 0 {
        return;
    }
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let clr: extern "system" fn(u64) =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_clear_ped_tasks) as usize) };
    clr(ped);
}

fn spooner_rotate_3d(
    base: u64,
    rvas: &RvaTable,
    dpitch_deg: f32,
    droll_deg: f32,
    dyaw_deg: f32,
) {
    let Ok(mut s) = SPOONER_STATE.try_lock() else {
        return;
    };
    sync_spooner_hud_locked(&mut s, rvas.ped_pos_packed);
    let Some(&ent) = s.entities.get(s.selected) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some((mut r, mut f, mut u, pos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ent.ptr, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let rot_pair = |a: [f32; 3], b: [f32; 3], deg: f32| -> ([f32; 3], [f32; 3]) {
        let (sn, cs) = deg.to_radians().sin_cos();
        (
            [a[0] * cs + b[0] * sn, a[1] * cs + b[1] * sn, a[2] * cs + b[2] * sn],
            [b[0] * cs - a[0] * sn, b[1] * cs - a[1] * sn, b[2] * cs - a[2] * sn],
        )
    };
    if dyaw_deg.abs() > 0.01 {
        let (nr, nf) = rot_pair(r, f, dyaw_deg);
        r = nr;
        f = nf;
    }
    if dpitch_deg.abs() > 0.01 {
        let (nf, nu) = rot_pair(f, u, dpitch_deg);
        f = nf;
        u = nu;
    }
    if droll_deg.abs() > 0.01 {
        let (nr, nu) = rot_pair(r, u, droll_deg);
        r = nr;
        u = nu;
    }
    let mat = trainer::Mat34V {
        right: [r[0], r[1], r[2], 0.0],
        forward: [f[0], f[1], f[2], 0.0],
        up: [u[0], u[1], u[2], 0.0],
        pos_packed: trainer::pack_sector_pos(pos),
    };
    if let Some(vtable) = trainer::safe_read::<u64>(ent.ptr as usize)
        && vtable > 0x10000
        && let Some(set_mat_addr) = trainer::safe_read::<u64>((vtable + 0x170) as usize)
        && set_mat_addr > 0x10000
    {
        let set_mat: extern "system" fn(u64, *const trainer::Mat34V, u8, u8, u8) =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute(set_mat_addr as usize) };
        set_mat(ent.ptr, &mat, 1, 1, 1);
    }
    if rvas.fn_get_phys_sync_comp != 0
        && rvas.fn_commit_phys_sync != 0
        && let Some(ent_id) = trainer::safe_read::<u32>((ent.ptr + rvas.ped_entity_id) as usize)
    {
        let get_sync: extern "system" fn(u32) -> u64 =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_phys_sync_comp) as usize) };
        let sync_comp = get_sync(ent_id);
        if sync_comp > 0x10000 {
            let commit: extern "system" fn(u64) =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_commit_phys_sync) as usize) };
            commit(sync_comp);
        }
    }
    set_entity_velocity_native(base, rvas, ent.ptr, [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]);
    sync_spooner_hud_locked(&mut s, rvas.ped_pos_packed);
}

fn spooner_clone_selected(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let info = {
        let Ok(mut s) = SPOONER_STATE.try_lock() else {
            return;
        };
        sync_spooner_hud_locked(&mut s, rvas.ped_pos_packed);
        s.entities.get(s.selected).copied()
    };
    let Some(ent) = info else {
        return;
    };
    let hash64 = if ent.hash64 != 0 {
        ent.hash64
    } else if let Some(mi) = trainer::safe_read::<u64>((ent.ptr + 0x20) as usize)
        && mi > 0x10000
    {
        trainer::safe_read::<u64>((mi + 0x60) as usize).unwrap_or(0)
    } else {
        0
    };
    if hash64 == 0 {
        return;
    }
    match ent.kind {
        1 => start_vehicle_spawn(base, rvas, hash64, true, false),
        2 => start_ped_spawn_ex(
            base,
            rvas,
            hash64,
            if ent.invincible { 1 } else { 0 },
            DEFAULT_PED_WEAPON_HASH.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
            ent.invincible,
            true,
            None,
        ),
        _ => start_prop_spawn(base, rvas, hash64, !ent.frozen, ent.invincible),
    }
}

fn spooner_toggle_attach_player(rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let Ok(mut s) = SPOONER_STATE.try_lock() else {
        return;
    };
    sync_spooner_hud_locked(&mut s, rvas.ped_pos_packed);
    let sel = s.selected;
    if let Some(ent) = s.entities.get_mut(sel) {
        ent.attached = !ent.attached;
        let any_attached = s.entities.iter().any(|e| e.attached);
        let cur = LOOP_MASK.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
        let next = if any_attached {
            cur | LOOP_SPOONER_ATTACH
        } else {
            cur & !LOOP_SPOONER_ATTACH
        };
        LOOP_MASK.store(next, Ordering::Release);
    }
    sync_spooner_hud_locked(&mut s, rvas.ped_pos_packed);
}

fn bone_preset_offset(bone: u8) -> [f32; 3] {
    match bone {
        1 => [0.0, 0.0, 0.72],    // Head
        2 => [0.38, 0.35, 0.10],  // Right Hand
        3 => [-0.38, 0.35, 0.10], // Left Hand
        4 => [0.0, -0.32, 0.25],  // Spine / Back
        5 => [0.0, 0.0, 1.35],    // Vehicle Roof
        6 => [0.0, 1.85, 0.55],   // Vehicle Hood / Bonnet
        7 => [0.0, 2.55, -0.05],  // Vehicle Front Bumper / Ramp
        8 => [0.0, -2.35, 0.35],  // Vehicle Trunk / Boot
        _ => [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],     // Root / Center
    }
}

fn step_spooner_attached(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let items: Vec<(u64, u32, u8, [f32; 3], [f32; 3], f32, u64)> = SPOONER_STATE
        .try_lock()
        .map(|s| {
            s.entities
                .iter()
                .enumerate()
                .filter(|(_, e)| e.attached && e.attach_target != 0)
                .map(|(idx, e)| {
                    let prev = if idx > 0 {
                        s.entities.get(idx - 1).map(|p| p.ptr).unwrap_or(0)
                    } else {
                        s.entities.iter().find(|p| !p.attached).map(|p| p.ptr).unwrap_or(0)
                    };
                    (
                        e.ptr,
                        e.attach_target,
                        e.attach_bone,
                        e.attach_offset,
                        e.attach_rot,
                        e.scale.clamp(0.25, 4.0),
                        prev,
                    )
                })
                .collect()
        })
        .unwrap_or_default();
    if items.is_empty() {
        return;
    }
    let rot_pair = |a: [f32; 3], b: [f32; 3], deg: f32| -> ([f32; 3], [f32; 3]) {
        let (sn, cs) = deg.to_radians().sin_cos();
        (
            [a[0] * cs + b[0] * sn, a[1] * cs + b[1] * sn, a[2] * cs + b[2] * sn],
            [b[0] * cs - a[0] * sn, b[1] * cs - a[1] * sn, b[2] * cs - a[2] * sn],
        )
    };
    for (ptr, target_mode, bone, off, rot, sc, prev_ent_ptr) in items {
        if ptr < 0x10000 {
            continue;
        }
        let parent_ent = match target_mode {
            2 => active_or_last_vehicle(base, rvas).or_else(|| read_local_ped(base, rvas)),
            3 if prev_ent_ptr > 0x10000 => Some(prev_ent_ptr),
            _ => read_local_ped(base, rvas),
        };
        let Some(parent) = parent_ent else {
            continue;
        };
        if ptr == parent {
            continue;
        }
        let Some((mut right, mut fwd, mut up, pos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(parent, rvas)
        else {
            continue;
        };
        let b_off = bone_preset_offset(bone);
        let ax = off[0] + b_off[0];
        let ay = off[1] + b_off[1];
        let az = off[2] + b_off[2];
        let target = [
            pos[0] + right[0] * ax + fwd[0] * ay + up[0] * az,
            pos[1] + right[1] * ax + fwd[1] * ay + up[1] * az,
            pos[2] + right[2] * ax + fwd[2] * ay + up[2] * az,
        ];
        if rot[2].abs() > 0.01 {
            let (nr, nf) = rot_pair(right, fwd, rot[2]);
            right = nr;
            fwd = nf;
        }
        if rot[0].abs() > 0.01 {
            let (nf, nu) = rot_pair(fwd, up, rot[0]);
            fwd = nf;
            up = nu;
        }
        if rot[1].abs() > 0.01 {
            let (nr, nu) = rot_pair(right, up, rot[1]);
            right = nr;
            up = nu;
        }
        let mat = trainer::Mat34V {
            right: [right[0] * sc, right[1] * sc, right[2] * sc, 0.0],
            forward: [fwd[0] * sc, fwd[1] * sc, fwd[2] * sc, 0.0],
            up: [up[0] * sc, up[1] * sc, up[2] * sc, 0.0],
            pos_packed: trainer::pack_sector_pos(target),
        };
        if let Some(vtable) = trainer::safe_read::<u64>(ptr as usize)
            && vtable > 0x10000
            && let Some(set_mat_addr) = trainer::safe_read::<u64>((vtable + 0x170) as usize)
            && set_mat_addr > 0x10000
        {
            let set_mat: extern "system" fn(u64, *const trainer::Mat34V, u8, u8, u8) =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute(set_mat_addr as usize) };
            set_mat(ptr, &mat, 1, 1, 1);
        }
        set_entity_velocity_native(base, rvas, ptr, [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]);
    }
}

fn spooner_select_index(rvas: &RvaTable, idx: usize) {
    if let Ok(mut s) = SPOONER_STATE.try_lock() {
        sync_spooner_hud_locked(&mut s, rvas.ped_pos_packed);
        if idx < s.entities.len() {
            s.selected = idx;
            sync_spooner_hud_locked(&mut s, rvas.ped_pos_packed);
        }
    }
}

fn spooner_teleport_to_selected(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let target_ptr = SPOONER_STATE
        .try_lock()
        .ok()
        .and_then(|s| s.entities.get(s.selected).map(|e| e.ptr))
        .unwrap_or(0);
    if target_ptr < 0x10000 {
        return;
    }
    if let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas)
        && let Some((_r, fwd, _u, epos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(target_ptr, rvas)
    {
        let dest = [epos[0] - fwd[0] * 2.5, epos[1] - fwd[1] * 2.5, epos[2] + 0.5];
        let _ = teleport_entity_native(base, rvas, ped, dest, None, true);
    }
}

fn spooner_bring_selected(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let target_ptr = SPOONER_STATE
        .try_lock()
        .ok()
        .and_then(|s| s.entities.get(s.selected).map(|e| e.ptr))
        .unwrap_or(0);
    if target_ptr < 0x10000 {
        return;
    }
    if let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas)
        && let Some((_r, fwd, _u, ppos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ped, rvas)
    {
        let len = fwd[0].hypot(fwd[1]).max(0.001);
        let dest = [
            ppos[0] + (fwd[0] / len) * 3.5,
            ppos[1] + (fwd[1] / len) * 3.5,
            ppos[2] + 0.25,
        ];
        let _ = teleport_entity_native(base, rvas, target_ptr, dest, None, true);
    }
}

fn spooner_task_selected_ped(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, role: u8, weapon_hash32: u32) {
    let info = SPOONER_STATE
        .try_lock()
        .ok()
        .and_then(|s| s.entities.get(s.selected).copied());
    let Some(ent) = info else {
        return;
    };
    if ent.kind != 2 || ent.ptr < 0x10000 {
        return;
    }
    match role {
        1 | 2 => configure_ped_role(base, rvas, ent.ptr, role, weapon_hash32, role == 1),
        3 => {
            if let Some(player) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) {
                let _ = issue_task_hands_up(base, rvas, ent.ptr, player, 15_000);
            }
        }
        4 => {
            if rvas.fn_clear_ped_tasks != 0 {
                let clr: extern "system" fn(u64) =
                    unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_clear_ped_tasks) as usize) };
                clr(ent.ptr);
            }
        }
        5 => {
            let _ = issue_task_use_nearest_scenario(base, rvas, ent.ptr, 35.0);
        }
        6 => {
            if let Some(veh) = active_or_last_vehicle(base, rvas) {
                let _ = warp_any_ped_into_vehicle(base, rvas, ent.ptr, veh, 0);
                let _ = issue_task_vehicle_drive_wander(base, rvas, ent.ptr, veh, 24.0, 786_603);
            }
        }
        7 => {
            if let Some(player) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) {
                if let Some(veh) = active_or_last_vehicle(base, rvas) {
                    let _ = warp_any_ped_into_vehicle(base, rvas, ent.ptr, veh, 0);
                }
                let _ = issue_task_vehicle_chase(base, rvas, ent.ptr, player);
            }
        }
        _ => {}
    }
}

fn spooner_adjust_attach_offset(dx: f32, dy: f32, dz: f32) {
    let x = (f32::from_bits(SPOONER_ATTACH_X_BITS.load(Ordering::Relaxed)) + dx).clamp(-10.0, 10.0);
    let y = (f32::from_bits(SPOONER_ATTACH_Y_BITS.load(Ordering::Relaxed)) + dy).clamp(-10.0, 15.0);
    let z = (f32::from_bits(SPOONER_ATTACH_Z_BITS.load(Ordering::Relaxed)) + dz).clamp(-5.0, 10.0);
    SPOONER_ATTACH_X_BITS.store(x.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
    SPOONER_ATTACH_Y_BITS.store(y.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
    SPOONER_ATTACH_Z_BITS.store(z.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
    if let Ok(mut s) = SPOONER_STATE.try_lock() {
        let sel = s.selected;
        if let Some(ent) = s.entities.get_mut(sel) {
            ent.attach_offset = [x, y, z];
        }
    }
}

fn spooner_track_last_vehicle(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let Some(veh) = active_or_last_vehicle(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let hash64 = trainer::safe_read::<u64>((veh + 0x20) as usize)
        .filter(|&mi| mi > 0x10000)
        .and_then(|mi| trainer::safe_read::<u64>((mi + 0x60) as usize))
        .unwrap_or(0);
    if let Ok(mut s) = SPOONER_STATE.try_lock() {
        if let Some(pos_idx) = s.entities.iter().position(|e| e.ptr == veh) {
            s.selected = pos_idx;
        } else {
            s.entities.push(SpoonerEntity {
                kind: 1,
                ptr: veh,
                hash64,
                frozen: false,
                invincible: false,
                attached: false,
                attach_target: 0,
                attach_bone: 0,
                attach_offset: [0.0, 2.2, 0.6],
                attach_rot: [0.0; 3],
                alpha: 255,
                scale: 1.0,
                collision: true,
            });
            s.selected = s.entities.len() - 1;
        }
        sync_spooner_hud_locked(&mut s, rvas.ped_pos_packed);
    }
}

/// Opt-in live 3D studio photo-booth staging helper: poses a spawned vehicle (`kind=0`),
/// ped (`kind=1`), Spooner prop (`kind=2`), or player profile (`kind=3`) cleanly dead-center
/// in front of the live 3D camera, or cleans up the last spawned vehicle (`kind=4`).
fn apply_photobooth_stage(
    base: u64,
    rvas: &RvaTable,
    kind: u8,
    dist: f32,
    z_off: f32,
    yaw_deg: f32,
    freeze: bool,
) {
    if kind == 4 {
        let veh = DIAG_LAST_SPAWNED_VEH.swap(0, Ordering::Relaxed);
        if veh > 0x10000 && rvas.fn_destroy_entity != 0 {
            let destroy: extern "system" fn(u64, u8) =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_destroy_entity) as usize) };
            destroy(veh, 0);
        }
        return;
    }
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some((_pr, pfwd, _pu, ppos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ped, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let (origin, cam_fwd) = if let Some((_cr, cf, _cu, cp)) = trainer::read_camera_mat34(base, rvas)
    {
        (cp, cf)
    } else {
        (ppos, pfwd)
    };
    let flen = cam_fwd[0].hypot(cam_fwd[1]).max(0.001);
    let nx = cam_fwd[0] / flen;
    let ny = cam_fwd[1] / flen;
    let rad = yaw_deg.to_radians();
    let (s, c) = rad.sin_cos();
    let efwd = [nx * c - ny * s, nx * s + ny * c, 0.0];
    let eright = [efwd[1], -efwd[0], 0.0];

    let target_ent = match kind {
        0 => DIAG_LAST_SPAWNED_VEH.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
        1 => DIAG_LAST_SPAWNED_PED.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
        2 => SPOONER_STATE
            .try_lock()
            .ok()
            .and_then(|s| s.entities.get(s.selected).map(|e| e.ptr))
            .unwrap_or(0),
        3 => ped,
        _ => 0,
    };
    if target_ent < 0x10000 {
        return;
    }
    let target_pos = if kind == 3 {
        ppos
    } else {
        [
            origin[0] + nx * dist,
            origin[1] + ny * dist,
            ppos[2] + z_off,
        ]
    };
    let _ = teleport_entity_native(
        base,
        rvas,
        target_ent,
        target_pos,
        Some((eright, efwd)),
        false,
    );
    if freeze {
        if rvas.fn_phys_freeze != 0 {
            let f: extern "system" fn(u64) =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_phys_freeze) as usize) };
            f(target_ent);
        }
    } else {
        if rvas.fn_phys_unfreeze != 0 {
            let u: extern "system" fn(u64) =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_phys_unfreeze) as usize) };
            u(target_ent);
        }
        if kind == 0 {
            set_entity_velocity_native(base, rvas, target_ent, [0.0, 0.0, -1.5]);
        }
    }
}

fn spawn_placed_prop(
    base: u64,
    rvas: &RvaTable,
    hash64: u64,
    spawn_pos: [f32; 3],
    dynamic: bool,
    invincible: bool,
) {
    if hash64 == 0 || rvas.fn_object_params_init == 0 || rvas.fn_create_object_direct == 0 {
        return;
    }
    let model_id = resolve_model_id_any(base, rvas, hash64);
    let mut params = trainer::ObjectCreationParams::default();
    let init_params: extern "system" fn(*mut trainer::ObjectCreationParams, u64, u32) -> *mut u8 =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_object_params_init) as usize) };
    let _ = init_params(&mut params, hash64, 5);
    let one_b = 1.0f32.to_le_bytes();
    params.raw[0x00..0x30].fill(0);
    params.raw[0x00..0x04].copy_from_slice(&one_b);
    params.raw[0x14..0x18].copy_from_slice(&one_b);
    params.raw[0x28..0x2c].copy_from_slice(&one_b);
    params.raw[0x30..0x34].copy_from_slice(&spawn_pos[0].to_le_bytes());
    params.raw[0x34..0x38].copy_from_slice(&spawn_pos[1].to_le_bytes());
    params.raw[0x38..0x3c].copy_from_slice(&spawn_pos[2].to_le_bytes());
    params.raw[0x40] = 2;
    if (model_id & 0x3F_FFFF) != 0x3F_FFFF {
        params.raw[0x4c..0x50].copy_from_slice(&model_id.to_le_bytes());
    }
    let tok = PROP_TOKEN_SEQ.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
    params.raw[0x6c..0x70].copy_from_slice(&tok.to_le_bytes());
    params.raw[0x91] |= 1;
    let mut b92 = params.raw[0x92] & 0xf6;
    if dynamic {
        b92 |= 1;
    }
    params.raw[0x92] = b92;
    let z = [0u64; 4];
    let create_direct: extern "system" fn(
        *mut trainer::ObjectCreationParams,
        *const [u64; 4],
        *const [u64; 4],
        *const [u64; 4],
        *const [u64; 4],
    ) -> i32 = unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_create_object_direct) as usize) };
    let req_id = create_direct(&mut params, &z, &z, &z, &z);
    if req_id != -1 {
        let _ = try_attach_spawned_prop(base, rvas, hash64, spawn_pos, dynamic, invincible);
    }
}

/// Replenishes player stamina & health silently (uses real `CPedStaminaComp` when mapped).
fn apply_ped_replenish_stamina_only(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    if let Some(ent_id) = trainer::safe_read::<u32>((ped + rvas.ped_entity_id) as usize)
        && rvas.fn_get_ped_stamina_comp != 0
        && rvas.fn_ped_replenish_stamina != 0
    {
        let get_st: extern "system" fn(u32) -> u64 =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_ped_stamina_comp) as usize) };
        let comp = get_st(ent_id);
        if comp > 0x10000 {
            DIAG_PED_STAMINA_COMP.store(comp, Ordering::Relaxed);
            let rep_st: extern "system" fn(u64) =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_ped_replenish_stamina) as usize) };
            rep_st(comp);
        }
    }
    if rvas.fn_ped_replenish_silent != 0 {
        let f: extern "system" fn(u64) =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_ped_replenish_silent) as usize) };
        f(ped);
    }
}

/// Full Survival & Cores Replenish: Health, Armor, Metabolism Exhaustion Reset, Stamina,
/// Survival/Hunger Cores, Special Cores, and Special Ability Bar!
fn apply_ped_replenish_all_cores(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some(ent_id) = trainer::safe_read::<u32>((ped + rvas.ped_entity_id) as usize) else {
        return;
    };
    if rvas.fn_ped_replenish_silent != 0 {
        let f: extern "system" fn(u64) =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_ped_replenish_silent) as usize) };
        f(ped);
    }
    if rvas.fn_ped_replenish_armor != 0 {
        let f: extern "system" fn(u64) =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_ped_replenish_armor) as usize) };
        f(ped);
    }
    // 1. Metabolism / fatigue timer reset (verified from engine replenish helper)
    if rvas.fn_get_ped_metabolism_comp != 0 {
        let get_m: extern "system" fn(u32) -> u64 =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_ped_metabolism_comp) as usize) };
        let comp = get_m(ent_id);
        if comp > 0x10000 {
            DIAG_PED_METAB_COMP.store(comp, Ordering::Relaxed);
            let f1d8 = trainer::safe_read::<u8>((comp + 0x1d8) as usize).unwrap_or(1);
            let f348 = trainer::safe_read::<u8>((comp + 0x348) as usize).unwrap_or(1);
            let f290 = trainer::safe_read::<u8>((comp + 0x290) as usize).unwrap_or(1);
            let f349 = trainer::safe_read::<u8>((comp + 0x349) as usize).unwrap_or(1);
            if f1d8 == 0 && f348 == 0 {
                let _ = trainer::safe_write::<u32>((comp + 0x154) as usize, 0);
            }
            if f290 == 0 && f349 == 0 {
                let _ = trainer::safe_write::<u32>((comp + 0x20c) as usize, 0);
            }
            if f1d8 == 0 {
                let _ = trainer::safe_write::<u32>((comp + 0x158) as usize, 0);
            }
        }
    }
    // 2. Stamina / breath replenishment
    if rvas.fn_get_ped_stamina_comp != 0 && rvas.fn_ped_replenish_stamina != 0 {
        let get_st: extern "system" fn(u32) -> u64 =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_ped_stamina_comp) as usize) };
        let comp = get_st(ent_id);
        if comp > 0x10000 {
            DIAG_PED_STAMINA_COMP.store(comp, Ordering::Relaxed);
            let rep: extern "system" fn(u64) =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_ped_replenish_stamina) as usize) };
            rep(comp);
        }
    }
    // 3. Survival / hunger core full replenish
    if rvas.fn_get_ped_cores_comp != 0 && rvas.fn_replenish_core_full != 0 {
        let get_c: extern "system" fn(u32) -> u64 =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_ped_cores_comp) as usize) };
        let comp = get_c(ent_id);
        if comp > 0x10000 {
            DIAG_PED_CORES_COMP.store(comp, Ordering::Relaxed);
            let core_sub = comp + 0x10d30;
            if trainer::safe_read::<u64>(core_sub as usize).is_some() {
                let rep_core: extern "system" fn(u64) =
                    unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_replenish_core_full) as usize) };
                rep_core(core_sub);
            }
        }
    }
    // 4. Special dual cores replenish
    if rvas.fn_ped_replenish_special_cores != 0 {
        let rep_spec: extern "system" fn(u64) =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_ped_replenish_special_cores) as usize) };
        rep_spec(ped);
    }
    // 5. Special ability / focus bar refill
    if rvas.fn_get_ped_special_comp != 0 && rvas.fn_ped_refill_special_bar != 0 {
        let get_sp: extern "system" fn(u32) -> u64 =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_ped_special_comp) as usize) };
        let comp = get_sp(ent_id);
        if comp > 0x10000 {
            DIAG_PED_SPECIAL_COMP.store(comp, Ordering::Relaxed);
            if let Some(slot_idx) = trainer::safe_read::<u8>((comp + 0x10) as usize)
                && slot_idx < 16
            {
                let refill_bar: extern "system" fn(u8) =
                    unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_ped_refill_special_bar) as usize) };
                refill_bar(slot_idx);
            }
        }
    }
}

    if rvas.fn_ped_clean_damage == 0 {

    }

        return;
