        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_ped_clean_damage) as usize) };
    clean(ent_id);
}

/// Clears global bounty state, ped `PCF_HasBounty` (`5`), and current wanted level to 0!
fn apply_clear_bounty_and_heat(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    if rvas.fn_clear_bounty_global != 0 {
        let clear_b: extern "system" fn() =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_clear_bounty_global) as usize) };
        clear_b();
    }
    if let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) {
        set_ped_config_flag(base, rvas, ped, 5, false);
        if rvas.fn_set_wanted_level != 0 {
            let set_w: extern "system" fn(u64, i32, u8, u8, u8) =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_set_wanted_level) as usize) };
            set_w(ped, 0, 1, 1, 1);
        }
    }
}

/// Heat Shield: stamps `PCF_CantWitnessCrimes` (`113`) on nearby NPCs +
/// `PCF_ForceWitnessIntimidationOnNextInteraction` (`380`) on local player!
fn step_no_witnesses(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    set_ped_config_flag(base, rvas, ped, 380, true);
    let Some((_r, _f, _u, pos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ped, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let nearby =
        trainer::find_nearby_entities_in_pool(base, rvas, rvas.ped_pool, pos, 85.0, &[ped], 24);
    for (_d, npc) in nearby {
        set_ped_config_flag(base, rvas, npc, 113, true);
    }
}

/// One-Shot Enemies: stamps `PCF_OneShotWillKillPed` (`106`) on nearby non-bodyguard NPCs!
fn step_one_shot_npcs(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some((_r, _f, _u, pos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ped, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let mut exclude = vec![ped];
    if let Ok(bgs) = BODYGUARDS.try_lock() {
        exclude.extend(bgs.iter().copied());
    }
    let nearby =
        trainer::find_nearby_entities_in_pool(base, rvas, rvas.ped_pool, pos, 95.0, &exclude, 24);
    for (_d, npc) in nearby {
        set_ped_config_flag(base, rvas, npc, 106, true);
    }
}

/// Refills GTA real-time vehicle fuel tanks to 100% (`CVehicleFuelComp`) and records live diagnostics!
fn apply_refill_vehicle_fuel(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    if rvas.fn_get_veh_fuel_comp == 0 {
        return;
    }
    let Some(veh) = active_or_last_vehicle(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some(ent_id) = trainer::safe_read::<u32>((veh + rvas.ped_entity_id) as usize) else {
        return;
    };
    let get_fuel: extern "system" fn(u32) -> u64 =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_veh_fuel_comp) as usize) };
    let comp = get_fuel(ent_id);
    if comp < 0x10000 {
        return;
    }
    DIAG_VEH_FUEL_COMP.store(comp, Ordering::Relaxed);
    let max_fuel = trainer::safe_read::<f32>((comp + 0xa8) as usize).unwrap_or(0.0);
    if max_fuel.is_finite() && max_fuel > 0.01 {
        let _ = trainer::safe_write::<f32>((comp + 0xa4) as usize, max_fuel);
    }
    if let (Some(tank_cnt), Some(tanks_ptr)) = (
        trainer::safe_read::<u32>((comp + 0xc4) as usize),
        trainer::safe_read::<u64>((comp + 0xc8) as usize),
    ) && tank_cnt > 0
        && tank_cnt <= 16
        && tanks_ptr > 0x10000
    {
        if rvas.fn_veh_set_all_fuel_tanks != 0 {
            let set_all: extern "system" fn(u32, u64, f32) =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_veh_set_all_fuel_tanks) as usize) };
            set_all(tank_cnt, tanks_ptr, 1.0);
        }
        if rvas.fn_veh_refill_fuel_tank != 0 {
            let refill_one: extern "system" fn(u64) =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_veh_refill_fuel_tank) as usize) };
            for i in 0..u64::from(tank_cnt) {
                refill_one(tanks_ptr + i * 0x14);
            }
        }
    }
    let mut cur_now = trainer::safe_read::<f32>((comp + 0xa4) as usize).unwrap_or(0.0);
    let mut max_now = max_fuel;
    // Some GTA vehicles store fuel strictly inside the `tanks_ptr` array (`+0xc4/+0xc8`) with
    // scalar `+0xa4/+0xa8` left at 0.0: read back the refilled tank entry so Live Fuel HUD shows 100%!
    if max_now <= 0.01
        && let (Some(tank_cnt), Some(tanks_ptr)) = (
            trainer::safe_read::<u32>((comp + 0xc4) as usize),
            trainer::safe_read::<u64>((comp + 0xc8) as usize),
        )
        && tank_cnt > 0
        && tank_cnt <= 16
        && tanks_ptr > 0x10000
    {
        let t_cur = trainer::safe_read::<f32>((tanks_ptr + 0x04) as usize).unwrap_or(0.0);
        let t_max = trainer::safe_read::<f32>((tanks_ptr + 0x08) as usize).unwrap_or(0.0);
        if t_max.is_finite() && t_max > 0.01 {
            cur_now = t_cur.clamp(0.0, t_max);
            max_now = t_max;
        } else {
            cur_now = 100.0;
            max_now = 100.0;
        }
    }
    DIAG_VEH_FUEL_CUR_BITS.store(cur_now.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
    DIAG_VEH_FUEL_MAX_BITS.store(max_now.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
}

/// 4-Layer Super Wash: wipes dirt, mud, blood, and snow channels on `CVehicleDirtComp`!
fn apply_super_wash_vehicle(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    if rvas.fn_get_veh_dirt_comp == 0 {
        return;
    }
    let Some(veh) = active_or_last_vehicle(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some(ent_id) = trainer::safe_read::<u32>((veh + rvas.ped_entity_id) as usize) else {
        return;
    };
    let get_comp: extern "system" fn(u32) -> u64 =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_veh_dirt_comp) as usize) };
    let comp = get_comp(ent_id);
    if comp < 0x10000 {
        return;
    }
    DIAG_VEH_DIRT_COMP.store(comp, Ordering::Relaxed);
    if rvas.fn_set_veh_dirt_level != 0 {
        let set_dirt: extern "system" fn(u64, f32, u32, u32, u8, u64) =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_set_veh_dirt_level) as usize) };
        set_dirt(comp, 0.0, 0, 0, 1, 0);
        set_dirt(comp, 0.0, 2, 0, 1, 0);
    }
    let _ = trainer::safe_write::<[u8; 4]>((comp + 0x40) as usize, [0u8; 4]);
}

/// Toggles Headlights (`byte_idx = 0`) or High Beams (`byte_idx = 1`) via the 36-byte
/// `CVehicleEngineComp + 0x278` lighting state buffer + `veh_set_neon_flags`.
fn apply_vehicle_light_channel(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, byte_idx: usize, enable: bool) {
    if byte_idx >= 32 || rvas.fn_get_veh_engine_comp == 0 || rvas.fn_veh_set_neon_flags == 0 {
        return;
    }
    let Some(veh) = active_or_last_vehicle(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some(ent_id) = trainer::safe_read::<u32>((veh + rvas.ped_entity_id) as usize) else {
        return;
    };
    let get_comp: extern "system" fn(u32) -> u64 =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_veh_engine_comp) as usize) };
    let comp = get_comp(ent_id);
    if comp < 0x10000 {
        return;
    }
    DIAG_VEH_ENGINE_COMP.store(comp, Ordering::Relaxed);
    let (Some(head32), Some(tail4)) = (
        trainer::safe_read::<[u8; 32]>((comp + 0x278) as usize),
        trainer::safe_read::<[u8; 4]>((comp + 0x298) as usize),
    ) else {
        return;
    };
    #[repr(C, align(16))]
    struct LightStateBuf([u8; 48]);
    let mut buf = LightStateBuf([0u8; 48]);
    buf.0[0..32].copy_from_slice(&head32);
    buf.0[32..36].copy_from_slice(&tail4);
    buf.0[byte_idx] = u8::from(enable);
    let set_flags: extern "system" fn(u64, *const u8) =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_veh_set_neon_flags) as usize) };
    set_flags(comp, buf.0.as_ptr());
}

/// Toggles hardware `eVehicleModType` bits (`23=Nitrous`, `24=Turbo`, `26=TyreSmoke`,
/// `27=Hydraulics`, `28=XenonLights`, `29=FireRetardent`) on `CVehicleVariationComp + 0x3030`
/// and `CVehicleExtraComp + 0x8`, then commits via `veh_apply_variation`!
fn apply_vehicle_mod_bit(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, bit: u32, enable: bool) {
    if bit >= 64 || rvas.fn_get_veh_variation_comp == 0 {
        return;
    }
    let Some(veh) = active_or_last_vehicle(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let get_var: extern "system" fn(u64) -> u64 =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_veh_variation_comp) as usize) };
    let var_comp = get_var(veh);
    if var_comp < 0x10000 {
        return;
    }
    DIAG_VEH_VAR_COMP.store(var_comp, Ordering::Relaxed);
    let word_off = u64::from(bit >> 5) * 4;
    let mask = 1u32 << (bit & 31);
    let var_addr = (var_comp + 0x3030 + word_off) as usize;
    if let Some(cur) = trainer::safe_read::<u32>(var_addr) {
        let next = if enable { cur | mask } else { cur & !mask };
        let _ = trainer::safe_write::<u32>(var_addr, next);
    }
    if rvas.fn_get_veh_extra_comp != 0
        && let Some(ent_id) = trainer::safe_read::<u32>((veh + rvas.ped_entity_id) as usize)
    {
        let get_ex: extern "system" fn(u32) -> u64 =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_veh_extra_comp) as usize) };
        let extra = get_ex(ent_id);
        if extra > 0x10000 {
            DIAG_VEH_EXTRA_COMP.store(extra, Ordering::Relaxed);
            let ex_addr = (extra + 8 + word_off) as usize;
            if let Some(cur) = trainer::safe_read::<u32>(ex_addr) {
                let next = if enable { cur | mask } else { cur & !mask };
                let _ = trainer::safe_write::<u32>(ex_addr, next);
            }
        }
    }
    if rvas.fn_veh_apply_variation != 0 {
        let apply_var: extern "system" fn(u64, u8) =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_veh_apply_variation) as usize) };
        apply_var(var_comp, 1);
    }
}

/// Writes custom Tire Smoke / Accent RGB `[f32; 3]` to `var_comp + 0xcd0`, enables
/// `var_comp + 0x3078` bit 1 and `eVehicleModType::TyreSmoke` (`26`), and commits!
fn apply_vehicle_tire_smoke_rgb(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, rgb: [f32; 3]) {
    if rvas.fn_get_veh_variation_comp == 0 {
        return;
    }
    let Some(veh) = active_or_last_vehicle(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let get_var: extern "system" fn(u64) -> u64 =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_veh_variation_comp) as usize) };
    let var_comp = get_var(veh);
    if var_comp < 0x10000 {
        return;
    }
    DIAG_VEH_VAR_COMP.store(var_comp, Ordering::Relaxed);
    let _ = trainer::safe_write::<[f32; 3]>((var_comp + 0xcd0) as usize, rgb);
    if let Some(b) = trainer::safe_read::<u8>((var_comp + 0x3078) as usize) {
        let _ = trainer::safe_write::<u8>((var_comp + 0x3078) as usize, b | 2);
    }
    apply_vehicle_mod_bit(base, rvas, 26, true);
}

fn apply_vehicle_hop_now(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let Some(veh) = active_or_last_vehicle(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    if let Some((_r, fwd, _u, _pos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(veh, rvas) {
        let len = fwd[0].hypot(fwd[1]).max(0.001);
        set_entity_velocity_native(
            base,
            rvas,
            veh,
            [(fwd[0] / len) * 6.0, (fwd[1] / len) * 6.0, 10.5],
        );
    }
}

fn apply_vehicle_instant_stop(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let Some(veh) = active_or_last_vehicle(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    set_entity_velocity_native(base, rvas, veh, [0.0, 0.0, -0.3]);
}

/// Classic Menyoo Car Jump: press Spacebar / Gamepad RB while driving to bunny-hop!
fn step_veh_car_jump(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let pad = BRIDGE.pad_buttons.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
    let pressed = key_down(0x20) || (pad & 0x0100 != 0); // Space or RB
    if !pressed {
        PREV_CAR_JUMP_KEY.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
        return;
    }
    if PREV_CAR_JUMP_KEY.swap(true, Ordering::Relaxed) {
        return;
    }
    let Some(veh) = read_current_vehicle(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    if let Some((_r, fwd, _u, _pos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(veh, rvas) {
        let len = fwd[0].hypot(fwd[1]).max(0.001);
        set_entity_velocity_native(
            base,
            rvas,
            veh,
            [(fwd[0] / len) * 8.0, (fwd[1] / len) * 8.0, 11.0],
        );
    }
}

/// Classic Menyoo Instant Super Brake: press `X` while driving to freeze momentum instantly!
fn step_veh_super_brake(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    if !key_down(0x58) {
        return; // X key
    }
    let Some(veh) = read_current_vehicle(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    set_entity_velocity_native(base, rvas, veh, [0.0, 0.0, -0.35]);
}

/// Classic Menyoo Sticky Tires / Downforce Grip: applies gentle downward grip while holding W!
fn step_veh_sticky_tires(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    if !key_down(0x57) {
        return;
    }
    let Some(veh) = read_current_vehicle(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some((_r, fwd, _u, mut pos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(veh, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let len = fwd[0].hypot(fwd[1]);
    if len > 0.1 {
        pos[2] -= 0.015;
        let _ = trainer::safe_write::<[u32; 4]>(
            (veh + rvas.ped_pos_packed) as usize,
            trainer::pack_sector_pos(pos),
        );
    }
}

/// Collects every `CWeaponComponentDegradation` (`wep_degradation_comp_hash`) across all carried `CWeapon*` slots
/// AND nearby held weapon `CObject*` instances (`get_weapon_obj_comp`) around the local player.
fn collect_degradation_components(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) -> Vec<u64> {
    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(4);
    if rvas.fn_get_weapon_component == 0 || rvas.wep_degradation_comp_hash == 0 {
        return out;
    }
    let get_comp: extern "system" fn(u32, u64, u32) -> u64 =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_weapon_component) as usize) };
    let mut inspect_wep_ptr = |wptr: u64| {
        if wptr < 0x10000 {
            return;
        }
        if let (Some(cnt), Some(arr)) = (
            trainer::safe_read::<u32>((wptr + 0x754) as usize),
            trainer::safe_read::<u64>((wptr + 0x758) as usize),
        ) && cnt > 0
            && cnt <= 64
            && arr > 0x10000
        {
            let comp = get_comp(cnt, arr, rvas.wep_degradation_comp_hash);
            if comp > 0x10000 && !out.contains(&comp) {
                DIAG_WEP_DEG_COMP.store(comp, Ordering::Relaxed);
                out.push(comp);
            }
        }
    };
    for cur in collect_all_carried_weapons(base, rvas) {
        inspect_wep_ptr(cur);
    }
    if rvas.fn_get_weapon_obj_comp != 0
        && let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas)
        && let Some((_, _, _, ppos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ped, rvas)
    {
        let get_wobj: extern "system" fn(u32) -> u64 =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_weapon_obj_comp) as usize) };
        let nearby_objs =
            trainer::find_nearby_entities_in_pool(base, rvas, rvas.object_pool, ppos, 3.0, &[], 16);
        for (_, obj) in nearby_objs {
            if let Some(eid) = trainer::safe_read::<u32>((obj + rvas.ped_entity_id) as usize)
                && eid != 0
            {
                let wobj = get_wobj(eid);
                inspect_wep_ptr(wobj);
            }
        }
    }
    out
}

/// Cleans GTA weapon degradation, rust, mud, and soot via BOTH native setters and direct component RAM!
fn apply_clean_active_weapon(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    if let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas)
        && let Some(ph) = get_entity_script_handle(base, rvas, ped)
    {
        for fn_rva in [rvas.fn_wep_set_soot, rvas.fn_wep_set_dirt, rvas.fn_wep_set_rust] {
            if fn_rva != 0 {
                let f: extern "system" fn(*const trainer::ScriptHandle, f32) =
                    unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + fn_rva) as usize) };
                f(&ph, 0.0);
            }
        }
    }
    for comp in collect_degradation_components(base, rvas) {
        let _ = trainer::safe_write::<f32>((comp + 0x94) as usize, 0.0);
        let _ = trainer::safe_write::<f32>((comp + 0x98) as usize, 0.0);
        let _ = trainer::safe_write::<f32>((comp + 0x9c) as usize, 0.0);
        if let Some(f28) = trainer::safe_read::<u16>((comp + 0x28) as usize) {
            let _ = trainer::safe_write::<u16>((comp + 0x28) as usize, f28 & !0x001c);
        }
        if let Some(f2c) = trainer::safe_read::<u32>((comp + 0x2c) as usize) {
            let _ = trainer::safe_write::<u32>((comp + 0x2c) as usize, f2c & !0x003f);
        }
    }
}

/// Cycles active weapon ammo variant (Standard -> Express -> Hollow Point -> AP):
/// inspects `CWeaponInfo + 0x110` (`CAmmoInfo*` array), auto-grants alternate ammo into player
/// inventory via `inv_add_item_direct_slot` so it is owned, calls `set_weapon_ammo_type_idx`,
/// and reads back the true active index by matching `[CWeapon + 0x18]` (`CAmmoInfo*`)!
fn apply_cycle_weapon_ammo_type(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    if rvas.fn_set_weapon_ammo_type_idx == 0 {
        return;
    }
    let weps = collect_all_carried_weapons(base, rvas);
    let mut best_cur = 0u64;
    let mut best_types = 0u32;
    let mut best_wep_info = 0u64;
    for w in weps {
        if let Some(item_info) = trainer::safe_read::<u64>((w + 0x28) as usize)
            && item_info > 0x10000
            && let Some(wep_info) = trainer::safe_read::<u64>((item_info + 0x28) as usize)
            && wep_info > 0x10000
        {
            let nt = u32::from(trainer::safe_read::<u16>((wep_info + 0x118) as usize).unwrap_or(0));
            if nt > best_types {
                best_types = nt;
                best_cur = w;
                best_wep_info = wep_info;
                if nt >= 2 {
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if best_cur < 0x10000 || best_wep_info < 0x10000 {
        return;
    }
    let cur = best_cur;
    let wep_info = best_wep_info;
    let num_types = best_types;
    DIAG_WEP_AMMO_TYPE_CNT.store(num_types, Ordering::Relaxed);
    let ammo_arr = trainer::safe_read::<u64>((wep_info + 0x110) as usize).unwrap_or(0);
    let active_ammo_ptr = trainer::safe_read::<u64>((cur + 0x18) as usize).unwrap_or(0);
    let mut cur_idx = 0u32;
    if ammo_arr > 0x10000 && active_ammo_ptr > 0x10000 {
        for i in 0..num_types.min(16) {
            if trainer::safe_read::<u64>((ammo_arr + u64::from(i) * 8) as usize) == Some(active_ammo_ptr) {
                cur_idx = i;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    if num_types <= 1 {
        DIAG_WEP_AMMO_TYPE_IDX.store(cur_idx, Ordering::Relaxed);
        return;
    }
    let next_idx = (cur_idx.wrapping_add(1)) % num_types;
    // Auto-grant alternate ammo into player inventory before switching so `HasAmmoForAmmoInfo` succeeds!
    if ammo_arr > 0x10000
        && let Some(target_ammo_info) =
            trainer::safe_read::<u64>((ammo_arr + u64::from(next_idx) * 8) as usize)
        && target_ammo_info > 0x10000
    {
        let mut ammo_hashes = [0u32; 2];
        if let Some(sub_item) = trainer::safe_read::<u64>((target_ammo_info + 0x10) as usize)
            && sub_item > 0x10000
        {
            ammo_hashes[0] = trainer::safe_read::<u32>((sub_item + 0x08) as usize).unwrap_or(0);
        }
        ammo_hashes[1] = trainer::safe_read::<u32>((target_ammo_info + 0x20) as usize).unwrap_or(0);
        if rvas.fn_inv_add_item_direct_slot != 0
            && let Some(inv) = read_local_ped_inventory_primary(base, rvas)
        {
            let add_direct: extern "system" fn(u64, *mut u32, u32, i64, u32, *const u8) =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_inv_add_item_direct_slot) as usize) };
            let reason = if rvas.give_loadout_reason != 0 {
                rvas.give_loadout_reason
            } else {
                rvas.add_item_reason
            };
            let zero_flags = [0u8; 16];
            for h in ammo_hashes {
                if h != 0 && reason != 0 {
                    let mut tx = 0u32;
                    add_direct(inv, &mut tx, h, 240, reason, zero_flags.as_ptr());
                    if tx != 0 {
                        DIAG_LAST_AMMO_ADD_TX.store(tx, Ordering::Relaxed);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    let set_type: extern "system" fn(u64, u32, u8) =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_set_weapon_ammo_type_idx) as usize) };
    set_type(cur, next_idx, 1);
    let mut updated = cur_idx;
    if ammo_arr > 0x10000
        && let Some(after_ptr) = trainer::safe_read::<u64>((cur + 0x18) as usize)
        && after_ptr > 0x10000
    {
        for i in 0..num_types.min(16) {
            if trainer::safe_read::<u64>((ammo_arr + u64::from(i) * 8) as usize) == Some(after_ptr) {
                updated = i;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    DIAG_WEP_AMMO_TYPE_IDX.store(updated, Ordering::Relaxed);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Schema v9.0 Classic Menyoo Vehicle Extras & World Chaos Helpers
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

fn apply_vehicle_invisible(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, invisible: bool) {
    let Some(veh) = active_or_last_vehicle(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    if invisible {
        if rvas.fn_set_entity_alpha != 0 {
            let f: extern "system" fn(u64, u32, u8) =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_set_entity_alpha) as usize) };
            f(veh, 0, 0);
        }
    } else if rvas.fn_reset_entity_alpha != 0 {
        let f: extern "system" fn(u64) =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_reset_entity_alpha) as usize) };
        f(veh);
    }
}

fn apply_vehicle_frozen(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, freeze: bool) {
    let Some(veh) = active_or_last_vehicle(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let fn_rva = if freeze {
        rvas.fn_phys_freeze
    } else {
        rvas.fn_phys_unfreeze
    };
    if fn_rva != 0 {
        let f: extern "system" fn(u64) = unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + fn_rva) as usize) };
        f(veh);
    }
}

fn record_veh_wheel_comp(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, veh: u64) -> u64 {
    if rvas.fn_get_veh_wheel_comp == 0 {
        return 0;
    }
    let Some(ent_id) = trainer::safe_read::<u32>((veh + rvas.ped_entity_id) as usize) else {
        return 0;
    };
    let get_wc: extern "system" fn(u32) -> u64 =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_veh_wheel_comp) as usize) };
    let wc = get_wc(ent_id);
    if wc > 0x10000 {
        DIAG_VEH_WHEEL_COMP.store(wc, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
    wc
}

/// Toggles Bulletproof Tires via native `SET_VEHICLE_TYRES_CAN_BURST(&veh_h, !bulletproof)`.
fn apply_vehicle_bulletproof_tires(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, bulletproof: bool) {
    let Some(veh) = active_or_last_vehicle(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let _ = record_veh_wheel_comp(base, rvas, veh);
    if rvas.fn_veh_set_tyres_can_burst != 0
        && let Some(vh) = get_entity_script_handle(base, rvas, veh)
    {
        let set_burst: extern "system" fn(*const trainer::ScriptHandle, u8) =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_veh_set_tyres_can_burst) as usize) };
        set_burst(&vh, u8::from(!bulletproof));
    }
}

/// Helper: writes `[base_grip * mult; 4]` onto every axle block (`+0x60..+0x70`) in `CVehicleWheelComp`.
fn write_vehicle_axle_grip(wc: u64, mult: f32) {
    if wc > 0x10000
        && let (Some(axle_cnt), Some(axle_arr)) = (
            trainer::safe_read::<i32>((wc + 0x64) as usize),
            trainer::safe_read::<u64>((wc + 0x68) as usize),
        )
        && axle_cnt > 0
        && axle_cnt <= 16
        && axle_arr > 0x10000
    {
        for i in 0..(axle_cnt as u64) {
            if let Some(axle) = trainer::safe_read::<u64>((axle_arr + i * 8) as usize)
                && axle > 0x10000
                && let Some(base_grip) = trainer::safe_read::<f32>((axle + 0x3c) as usize)
                && base_grip.is_finite()
                && base_grip > 0.001
            {
                let v = base_grip * mult;
                let _ = trainer::safe_write::<[f32; 4]>((axle + 0x60) as usize, [v; 4]);
            }
        }
    }
}

/// Toggles Low-Grip / Drift Tires via native `SET_VEHICLE_REDUCE_GRIP(&veh_h, drift_on)`.
fn apply_vehicle_drift_mode(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, drift_on: bool) {
    let Some(veh) = active_or_last_vehicle(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    if drift_on {
        VEH_GRIP_MULT_OVERRIDE_BITS.store(0, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
    let wc = record_veh_wheel_comp(base, rvas, veh);
    if rvas.fn_veh_set_reduce_grip != 0
        && let Some(vh) = get_entity_script_handle(base, rvas, veh)
    {
        let set_drift: extern "system" fn(*const trainer::ScriptHandle, u8) =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_veh_set_reduce_grip) as usize) };
        set_drift(&vh, u8::from(drift_on));
    }
    if !drift_on {
        write_vehicle_axle_grip(wc, 1.0);
    }
}

/// Sets custom tire grip multiplier (`0.25x` super drift .. `2.50x` super grip) on every axle block
/// of `CVehicleWheelComp` (`+0x64/+0x68` -> `[axle+0x60..+0x70] = [base_grip * mult; 4]`) + native
/// `[veh_engine_comp + 0x444]` hook, persisted per-tick while `mult != 1.0` so physics recovery never overwrites it!
fn apply_vehicle_grip_mult(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, mult: f32) {
    let Some(veh) = active_or_last_vehicle(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let clamped = mult.clamp(0.1, 3.0);
    let is_default = (clamped - 1.0).abs() < 0.01;
    VEH_GRIP_MULT_OVERRIDE_BITS.store(
        if is_default { 0 } else { clamped.to_bits() },
        Ordering::Relaxed,
    );
    let wc = record_veh_wheel_comp(base, rvas, veh);
    if let Some(vh) = get_entity_script_handle(base, rvas, veh) {
        if rvas.fn_veh_set_reduce_grip != 0 {
            let set_drift: extern "system" fn(*const trainer::ScriptHandle, u8) =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_veh_set_reduce_grip) as usize) };
            set_drift(&vh, 0);
        }
        if rvas.fn_veh_set_grip_mult != 0 {
            let set_grip: extern "system" fn(*const trainer::ScriptHandle, f32) =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_veh_set_grip_mult) as usize) };
            set_grip(&vh, clamped);
        }
    }
    write_vehicle_axle_grip(wc, clamped);
}

fn apply_vehicle_stunt(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, kind: u8) {
    let Some(veh) = active_or_last_vehicle(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some((right, fwd, _up, _pos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(veh, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let len = fwd[0].hypot(fwd[1]).max(0.001);
    let fx = fwd[0] / len;
    let fy = fwd[1] / len;
    let vel = match kind {
        0 => [fx * 36.0, fy * 36.0, 1.5], // Forward Nitro Blast
        1 => [-fx * 26.0, -fy * 26.0, 1.0], // Reverse Slam
        2 => [fx * 10.0, fy * 10.0, 22.0], // Sky Launch
        _ => [right[0] * 18.0 + fx * 10.0, right[1] * 18.0 + fy * 10.0, 12.0], // Side/Barrel Kick
    };
    set_entity_velocity_native(base, rvas, veh, vel);
}

fn step_veh_auto_flip(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let Some(veh) = read_current_vehicle(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    if let Some((_r, _f, up, _pos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(veh, rvas)
        && up[2] < 0.35
    {
        apply_flip_vehicle_upright(base, rvas);
    }
}

/// Classic Menyoo Force Push Shockwave: blasts all nearby vehicles & NPCs radially outward + skyward!
fn apply_force_push_shockwave(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, radius: f32, strength: f32) {
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some((_r, _f, _u, ppos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ped, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let mut exclude = vec![ped];
    if let Some(cur_v) = read_current_vehicle(base, rvas) {
        exclude.push(cur_v);
    }
    if let Ok(bgs) = BODYGUARDS.try_lock() {
        exclude.extend(bgs.iter().copied());
    }
    let s = strength.clamp(8.0, 60.0);
    for pool_rva in [rvas.vehicle_pool, rvas.ped_pool] {
        let ents =
            trainer::find_nearby_entities_in_pool(base, rvas, pool_rva, ppos, radius, &exclude, 16);
        for (_d, ent) in ents {
            if let Some((_er, _ef, _eu, epos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ent, rvas) {
                let dx = epos[0] - ppos[0];
                let dy = epos[1] - ppos[1];
                let d = dx.hypot(dy).max(0.5);
                set_entity_velocity_native(base, rvas, ent, [(dx / d) * s, (dy / d) * s, s * 0.45]);
            }
        }
    }
}

/// Classic Menyoo Black Hole Vortex: pulls nearby vehicles & NPCs smoothly into a swirling vortex 18m ahead!
fn step_black_hole_vortex(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, tick: u64) {
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some((_r, fwd, _u, ppos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ped, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let len = fwd[0].hypot(fwd[1]).max(0.001);
    let center = [
        ppos[0] + (fwd[0] / len) * 18.0,
        ppos[1] + (fwd[1] / len) * 18.0,
        ppos[2] + 5.0,
    ];
    let mut exclude = vec![ped];
    if let Some(cur_v) = read_current_vehicle(base, rvas) {
        exclude.push(cur_v);
    }
    if let Ok(bgs) = BODYGUARDS.try_lock() {
        exclude.extend(bgs.iter().copied());
    }
    let spin = ((tick as f32) * 0.15).sin();
    for pool_rva in [rvas.vehicle_pool, rvas.ped_pool] {
        let ents =
            trainer::find_nearby_entities_in_pool(base, rvas, pool_rva, center, 55.0, &exclude, 10);
        for (_d, ent) in ents {
            if let Some((_er, _ef, _eu, epos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ent, rvas) {
                let dx = center[0] - epos[0];
                let dy = center[1] - epos[1];
                let dz = center[2] - epos[2];
                let d = (dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz).sqrt().max(0.8);
                // Pull inward + tangential swirl!
                let vx = (dx / d) * 18.0 - (dy / d) * (6.0 + spin * 2.0);
                let vy = (dy / d) * 18.0 + (dx / d) * (6.0 + spin * 2.0);
                let vz = (dz / d) * 14.0;
                set_entity_velocity_native(base, rvas, ent, [vx, vy, vz]);
            }
        }
    }
}

fn apply_freeze_nearby_vehicles(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, radius: f32, freeze: bool) {
    let fn_rva = if freeze {
        rvas.fn_phys_freeze
    } else {
        rvas.fn_phys_unfreeze
    };
    if fn_rva == 0 {
        return;
    }
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some((_r, _f, _u, ppos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ped, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let mut exclude = Vec::new();
    if let Some(cur_v) = read_current_vehicle(base, rvas) {
        exclude.push(cur_v);
    }
    let f: extern "system" fn(u64) = unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + fn_rva) as usize) };
    let vehs =
        trainer::find_nearby_entities_in_pool(base, rvas, rvas.vehicle_pool, ppos, radius, &exclude, 24);
    for (_d, v) in vehs {
        f(v);
    }
}

fn autopilot_driving_flags() -> i32 {
    match AUTOPILOT_STYLE.load(Ordering::Relaxed) {
        1 => 447,           // Careful / Obey Traffic
        2 => 1_074_528_293, // Rush / Aggressive Avoid
        3 => 524_863,       // Ignore Red Lights / Fast
        _ => 786_603,       // Normal GTA Cruise
    }
}

/// Issues native `SCRIPT_TASK_VEHICLE_CHASE` (`&ped_h, &target_h, flags=0`).
fn issue_task_vehicle_chase(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, ped: u64, target: u64) -> bool {
    if rvas.fn_task_vehicle_chase == 0 || ped < 0x10000 || target < 0x10000 || ped == target {
        return false;
    }
    let (Some(ped_h), Some(tgt_h)) = (
        get_entity_script_handle(base, rvas, ped),
        get_entity_script_handle(base, rvas, target),
    ) else {
        return false;
    };
    let chase: extern "system" fn(*const trainer::ScriptHandle, *const trainer::ScriptHandle, i32) =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_task_vehicle_chase) as usize) };
    chase(&ped_h, &tgt_h, 0);
    DIAG_AUTOPILOT_TASKS.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
    true
}

/// Issues native `SCRIPT_TASK_VEHICLE_MISSION` Wander (`&ped_h, &veh_h, speed, 0.0, driving_style`).
fn issue_task_vehicle_drive_wander(
    base: u64,
    rvas: &RvaTable,
    ped: u64,
    veh: u64,
    speed: f32,
    driving_style: i32,
) -> bool {
    if rvas.fn_task_vehicle_drive_wander == 0 || ped < 0x10000 || veh < 0x10000 {
        return false;
    }
    let (Some(ped_h), Some(veh_h)) = (
        get_entity_script_handle(base, rvas, ped),
        get_entity_script_handle(base, rvas, veh),
    ) else {
        return false;
    };
    let wander: extern "system" fn(
        *const trainer::ScriptHandle,
        *const trainer::ScriptHandle,
        f32,
        f32,
        i32,
    ) = unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_task_vehicle_drive_wander) as usize) };
    wander(&ped_h, &veh_h, speed.clamp(8.0, 85.0), 0.0, driving_style);
    DIAG_AUTOPILOT_TASKS.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
    true
}

/// Issues native `TASK_VEHICLE_DRIVE_TO_COORD` (`&ped_h, &veh_h, &pos, mode=1, speed, style, stop=6.0, straight=12.0, 0`).
fn issue_task_vehicle_drive_to_coord(
    base: u64,
    rvas: &RvaTable,
    ped: u64,
    veh: u64,
    dest: [f32; 3],
    speed: f32,
    driving_style: i32,
) -> bool {
    if rvas.fn_task_vehicle_drive_to_coord == 0 || ped < 0x10000 || veh < 0x10000 {
        return false;
    }
    let (Some(ped_h), Some(veh_h)) = (
        get_entity_script_handle(base, rvas, ped),
        get_entity_script_handle(base, rvas, veh),
    ) else {
        return false;
    };
    let pos_v = trainer::Vec4A([dest[0], dest[1], dest[2], 0.0]);
    let drive_to: extern "system" fn(
        *const trainer::ScriptHandle,
        *const trainer::ScriptHandle,
        *const trainer::Vec4A,
        i32,
        f32,
        i32,
        f32,
        f32,
        u8,
    ) = unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_task_vehicle_drive_to_coord) as usize) };
    drive_to(
        &ped_h,
        &veh_h,
        &pos_v,
        1,
        speed.clamp(8.0, 85.0),
        driving_style,
        6.0,
        12.0,
        0,
    );
    DIAG_AUTOPILOT_TASKS.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
    true
}

/// Issues native `SCRIPT_TASK_USE_NEAREST_SCENARIO_TO_POS` on any ped (benches, railings, ATMs, props).
fn issue_task_use_nearest_scenario(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, ped: u64, radius: f32) -> bool {
    if rvas.fn_task_use_nearest_scenario_to_pos == 0 || ped < 0x10000 {
        return false;
    }
    let Some(ped_h) = get_entity_script_handle(base, rvas, ped) else {
        return false;
    };
    let Some((_r, _f, _u, ppos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ped, rvas) else {
        return false;
    };
    let pos_v = trainer::Vec4A([ppos[0], ppos[1], ppos[2], 0.0]);
    let use_scen: extern "system" fn(
        *const trainer::ScriptHandle,
        *const trainer::Vec4A,
        f32,
        i32,
        u8,
        u8,
        u8,
        u8,
    ) = unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_task_use_nearest_scenario_to_pos) as usize) };
    use_scen(&ped_h, &pos_v, radius.clamp(5.0, 80.0), -1, 0, 0, 0, 0);
    DIAG_SCENARIO_TASKS.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
    true
}

fn apply_autopilot_drive_to_waypoint(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some(veh) = active_or_last_vehicle(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    if read_current_vehicle(base, rvas) != Some(veh) {
        let _ = warp_local_ped_into_vehicle(base, rvas, veh, 0);
    }
    let speed = f32::from_bits(AUTOPILOT_SPEED_BITS.load(Ordering::Relaxed));
    let style = autopilot_driving_flags();
    let dest = trainer::read_active_waypoint(base, rvas).map(|([x, y, _], _)| {
        let z = trainer::probe_ground_z_near_xy(base, rvas, x, y, 20.0);
        [x, y, z]
    });
    if let Some(d) = dest {
        let _ = issue_task_vehicle_drive_to_coord(base, rvas, ped, veh, d, speed, style);
    } else if let Some((_r, fwd, _u, pos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(veh, rvas) {
        // No map waypoint set -> drive 250m ahead along current heading!
        let len = fwd[0].hypot(fwd[1]).max(0.001);
        let d = [pos[0] + (fwd[0] / len) * 250.0, pos[1] + (fwd[1] / len) * 250.0, pos[2]];
        let _ = issue_task_vehicle_drive_to_coord(base, rvas, ped, veh, d, speed, style);
    }
}

fn apply_autopilot_drive_wander(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some(veh) = active_or_last_vehicle(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    if read_current_vehicle(base, rvas) != Some(veh) {
        let _ = warp_local_ped_into_vehicle(base, rvas, veh, 0);
    }
    let speed = f32::from_bits(AUTOPILOT_SPEED_BITS.load(Ordering::Relaxed));
    let style = autopilot_driving_flags();
    let _ = issue_task_vehicle_drive_wander(base, rvas, ped, veh, speed, style);
}

fn apply_use_nearest_scenario(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    if let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) {
        let _ = issue_task_use_nearest_scenario(base, rvas, ped, 35.0);
    }
}

/// Spawns a full Bodyguard Escort Convoy: spawns an escort vehicle (or reuses target vehicle),
/// then spawns 2 armed invincible defending bodyguards, warps them directly into Driver (`seat 0`)
/// and Front Passenger (`seat 1`), and tasks the driver with native `TASK_VEHICLE_CHASE` to escort you!
fn apply_spawn_escort_convoy(
    base: u64,
    rvas: &RvaTable,
    veh_hash64: u64,
    ped_hash64: u64,
    weapon_hash32: u32,
) {
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let use_ped_hash = if ped_hash64 != 0 {
        ped_hash64
    } else {
        let def_h = DEFAULT_PED_MODEL_HASH.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
        if def_h != 0 {
            def_h
        } else {
            trainer::safe_read::<u64>((ped + 0x20) as usize)
                .filter(|&mi| mi > 0x10000)
                .and_then(|mi| trainer::safe_read::<u64>((mi + 0x60) as usize))
                .unwrap_or(0)
        }
    };
    if use_ped_hash == 0 {
        return;
    }
    let use_wep = if weapon_hash32 != 0 {
        weapon_hash32
    } else {
        DEFAULT_PED_WEAPON_HASH.load(Ordering::Relaxed)
    };
    let use_veh_hash = if veh_hash64 != 0 {
        veh_hash64
    } else {
        rvas.builtin_vehicles.first().map(|v| v.hash64).unwrap_or(0)
    };
    let prev_veh = DIAG_LAST_SPAWNED_VEH.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
    if use_veh_hash != 0 {
        start_vehicle_spawn(base, rvas, use_veh_hash, true, false);
        let immediate = DIAG_LAST_SPAWNED_VEH.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
        if immediate > 0x10000 && immediate != prev_veh {
            call_damage_proof(base, rvas, immediate, true);
            queue_escort_crew_for_vehicle(immediate, use_ped_hash, use_wep);
        } else if let Ok(mut slot) = PENDING_ESCORT.try_lock() {
            *slot = Some(PendingEscortConvoy {
                prev_veh_ptr: prev_veh,
                ped_hash64: use_ped_hash,
                weapon_hash32: use_wep,
                ticks_left: 120,
            });
            HAS_PENDING_ESCORT.store(true, Ordering::Release);
        }
    } else if let Some(v) = active_or_last_vehicle(base, rvas) {
        queue_escort_crew_for_vehicle(v, use_ped_hash, use_wep);
    }
}

fn queue_escort_crew_for_vehicle(veh_ptr: u64, ped_hash64: u64, weapon_hash32: u32) {
    if veh_ptr < 0x10000 || ped_hash64 == 0 {
        return;
    }
    if let Ok(mut q) = PED_SPAWN_QUEUE.try_lock() {
        for seat in [0i32, 1i32] {
            q.push_back(QueuedPedSpawn {
                hash64: ped_hash64,
                role: 1,
                weapon_hash32,
                invincible: true,
                add_to_spooner: false,
                offset_override: Some([2.5 + (seat as f32) * 1.5, 4.0, 0.2]),
                escort_seat: Some((veh_ptr, seat)),
            });
        }
        HAS_PED_SPAWN_QUEUE.store(true, Ordering::Release);
    }
}

fn step_pending_escort_convoy(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let mut job = match PENDING_ESCORT.try_lock() {
        Ok(mut g) => match g.take() {
            Some(j) => j,
            None => {
                HAS_PENDING_ESCORT.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
                return;
            }
        },
        Err(_) => return,
    };
    let cur_spawned = DIAG_LAST_SPAWNED_VEH.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
    if cur_spawned > 0x10000 && cur_spawned != job.prev_veh_ptr {
        HAS_PENDING_ESCORT.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
        call_damage_proof(base, rvas, cur_spawned, true);
        queue_escort_crew_for_vehicle(cur_spawned, job.ped_hash64, job.weapon_hash32);
        return;
    }
    if job.ticks_left > 1 {
        job.ticks_left -= 1;
        if let Ok(mut g) = PENDING_ESCORT.try_lock() {
            *g = Some(job);
        } else {
            HAS_PENDING_ESCORT.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
        }
    } else {
        HAS_PENDING_ESCORT.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
        if let Some(fallback_v) = active_or_last_vehicle(base, rvas) {
            queue_escort_crew_for_vehicle(fallback_v, job.ped_hash64, job.weapon_hash32);
        }
    }
}

/// Applies Showroom Gloss / Wet Sheen (`0.0` dry .. `1.0` mirror gloss) via `veh_set_shader_wetness`.
fn apply_vehicle_gloss(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, level: f32) {
    if rvas.fn_veh_set_shader_wetness == 0 {
        return;
    }
    let Some(veh) = active_or_last_vehicle(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    if let Some(vh) = get_entity_script_handle(base, rvas, veh) {
        let f: extern "system" fn(*const trainer::ScriptHandle, f32) =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_veh_set_shader_wetness) as usize) };
        f(&vh, level.clamp(0.0, 1.0));
        DIAG_VEH_GLOSS_APPLIED.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
}

/// Sets vehicle variation livery / trim byte (`0..31`) via `veh_set_livery_byte` and reads back via `veh_get_livery_byte`.
fn apply_vehicle_livery(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, idx: u8) {
    let Some(veh) = active_or_last_vehicle(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some(vh) = get_entity_script_handle(base, rvas, veh) else {
        return;
    };
    if rvas.fn_veh_set_livery_byte != 0 {
        let set_liv: extern "system" fn(*const trainer::ScriptHandle, u32) =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_veh_set_livery_byte) as usize) };
        set_liv(&vh, u32::from(idx));
    }
    let cur = if rvas.fn_veh_get_livery_byte != 0 {
        let get_liv: extern "system" fn(*const trainer::ScriptHandle) -> u8 =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_veh_get_livery_byte) as usize) };
        u32::from(get_liv(&vh))
    } else {
        u32::from(idx)
    };
    DIAG_VEH_LIVERY_BYTE.store(cur, Ordering::Relaxed);
}

/// Calls native `veh_set_toggle_mod_bit(&vh, bit)` (`eVehicleModType` toggle slot) + commits variation!
fn apply_vehicle_toggle_mod_native(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, bit: u32) {
    if bit >= 64 {
        return;
    }
    let Some(veh) = active_or_last_vehicle(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    if rvas.fn_veh_set_toggle_mod_bit != 0
        && let Some(vh) = get_entity_script_handle(base, rvas, veh)
    {
        let f: extern "system" fn(*const trainer::ScriptHandle, u32) =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_veh_set_toggle_mod_bit) as usize) };
        f(&vh, bit);
    }
    apply_vehicle_mod_bit(base, rvas, bit, true);
}

/// Sets hardware Fuel Consumption Rate Multiplier (`0.0x` zero-burn .. `5.0x`) on `CVehicleFuelComp + 0xa8`.
fn apply_vehicle_fuel_rate(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, rate: f32) {
    let clamped = rate.clamp(0.0, 5.0);
    let Some(veh) = active_or_last_vehicle(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    if rvas.fn_veh_set_fuel_rate != 0
        && let Some(vh) = get_entity_script_handle(base, rvas, veh)
    {
        let f: extern "system" fn(*const trainer::ScriptHandle, f32) =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_veh_set_fuel_rate) as usize) };
        f(&vh, clamped);
    }
    if rvas.fn_get_veh_fuel_comp != 0
        && let Some(ent_id) = trainer::safe_read::<u32>((veh + rvas.ped_entity_id) as usize)
    {
        let get_fc: extern "system" fn(u32) -> u64 =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_veh_fuel_comp) as usize) };
        let fc = get_fc(ent_id);
        if fc > 0x10000 {
            DIAG_VEH_FUEL_COMP.store(fc, Ordering::Relaxed);
            if let Some(readback) = trainer::safe_read::<f32>((fc + 0xa8) as usize) {
                DIAG_VEH_FUEL_RATE_BITS.store(readback.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
                return;
            }
        }
    }
    DIAG_VEH_FUEL_RATE_BITS.store(clamped.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
}

/// Classic Menyoo One-Click Max Upgrade: repair + super-wash + full fuel + 0x fuel burn +
/// Mod Kit 0 + Nitrous/Turbo/TyreSmoke/Hydraulics/Xenon/FireRetardent + Bulletproof Tires +
/// 1.35x Race Grip + Showroom Gloss + Underglow Neon!
fn apply_max_upgrade_vehicle(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    if let Some(veh) = active_or_last_vehicle(base, rvas)
        && rvas.fn_vehicle_repair_silent != 0
    {
        let f: extern "system" fn(u64) =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_vehicle_repair_silent) as usize) };
        f(veh);
    }
    apply_super_wash_vehicle(base, rvas);
    apply_refill_vehicle_fuel(base, rvas);
    apply_vehicle_fuel_rate(base, rvas, 0.0);
    apply_vehicle_mod_kit(base, rvas, 0);
    for bit in [23u32, 24, 25, 26, 27, 28, 29] {
        apply_vehicle_mod_bit(base, rvas, bit, true);
    }
    apply_vehicle_bulletproof_tires(base, rvas, true);
    apply_vehicle_grip_mult(base, rvas, 1.35);
    apply_vehicle_gloss(base, rvas, 1.0);
    apply_vehicle_neon_channels(base, rvas, [true, true, true, true]);
    apply_vehicle_neon_rgb(base, rvas, [0.0, 0.92, 1.0]);
}

/// Toggles active weapon Flashlight / Tactical Laser component (`wep_flashlight_comp_hash`).
fn apply_weapon_flashlight(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, enable: bool) {
    if rvas.fn_get_weapon_component == 0 || rvas.wep_flashlight_comp_hash == 0 {
        return;
    }
    let weps = collect_all_carried_weapons(base, rvas);
    let get_comp: extern "system" fn(u32, u64, u32) -> u64 =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_weapon_component) as usize) };
    for cur in weps {
        let (Some(cnt), Some(arr)) = (
            trainer::safe_read::<u32>((cur + 0x754) as usize),
            trainer::safe_read::<u64>((cur + 0x758) as usize),
        ) else {
            continue;
        };
        if cnt == 0 || cnt > 64 || arr < 0x10000 {
            continue;
        }
        let comp = get_comp(cnt, arr, rvas.wep_flashlight_comp_hash);
        if comp < 0x10000 {
            continue;
        }
        DIAG_WEP_FLASHLIGHT_COMP.store(comp, Ordering::Relaxed);
        if rvas.fn_set_weapon_comp_flag != 0 {
            let set_flag: extern "system" fn(u64, u32) =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_set_weapon_comp_flag) as usize) };
            set_flag(comp, u32::from(enable));
        }
    }
}

/// Locks weapon degradation OFF via native `wep_set_never_degrade_native` + `PCF 294` + direct component bit 13!
fn apply_weapon_never_degrade(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, never_degrade: bool) {
    if let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) {
        set_ped_config_flag(base, rvas, ped, 294, never_degrade);
        if rvas.fn_wep_set_never_degrade_native != 0
            && let Some(ph) = get_entity_script_handle(base, rvas, ped)
        {
            let f: extern "system" fn(*const trainer::ScriptHandle, u8) =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_wep_set_never_degrade_native) as usize) };
            f(&ph, u8::from(never_degrade));
        }
    }
    for comp in collect_degradation_components(base, rvas) {
        if never_degrade {
            let _ = trainer::safe_write::<f32>((comp + 0x94) as usize, 0.0);
            let _ = trainer::safe_write::<f32>((comp + 0x98) as usize, 0.0);
            let _ = trainer::safe_write::<f32>((comp + 0x9c) as usize, 0.0);
        }
        if let Some(w28) = trainer::safe_read::<u16>((comp + 0x28) as usize) {
            let next = if never_degrade {
                w28 & !0x2000
            } else {
                w28 | 0x2000
            };
            let _ = trainer::safe_write::<u16>((comp + 0x28) as usize, next);
        }
    }
}

/// Classic Menyoo Drive On Water / Invisible Sky Highway: clamps vehicle Z >= `WATER_PLANE_Z`
/// so you glide smoothly over ocean, rivers, and canals without sinking!
fn step_veh_drive_on_water(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let Some(veh) = read_current_vehicle(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some((_r, fwd, _u, mut pos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(veh, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let plane_z = f32::from_bits(WATER_PLANE_Z_BITS.load(Ordering::Relaxed));
    if pos[2] < plane_z {
        pos[2] = plane_z;
        let _ = trainer::safe_write::<[u32; 4]>(
            (veh + rvas.ped_pos_packed) as usize,
            trainer::pack_sector_pos(pos),
        );
        if key_down(0x57) {
            let len = fwd[0].hypot(fwd[1]).max(0.001);
            set_entity_velocity_native(
                base,
                rvas,
                veh,
                [(fwd[0] / len) * 20.0, (fwd[1] / len) * 20.0, 0.35],
            );
        } else {
            set_entity_velocity_native(base, rvas, veh, [0.0, 0.0, 0.15]);
        }
    }
}

/// Classic Menyoo Drive On Walls / Super Downforce: pushes vehicle gently along `-up` vector while accelerating!
fn step_veh_super_downforce(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    if !key_down(0x57) {
        return;
    }
    let Some(veh) = read_current_vehicle(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some((_r, _f, up, mut pos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(veh, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    pos[0] -= up[0] * 0.045;
    pos[1] -= up[1] * 0.045;
    pos[2] -= up[2] * 0.045;
    let _ = trainer::safe_write::<[u32; 4]>(
        (veh + rvas.ped_pos_packed) as usize,
        trainer::pack_sector_pos(pos),
    );
}

/// Classic Menyoo Phantom Wedge / Ramp Plow: blasts oncoming vehicles in a 10m forward cone skyward & out of your lane!
fn step_veh_ramp_plow(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let Some(veh) = read_current_vehicle(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some((right, fwd, _u, vpos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(veh, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let flen = fwd[0].hypot(fwd[1]).max(0.001);
    let fx = fwd[0] / flen;
    let fy = fwd[1] / flen;
    let probe_pt = [vpos[0] + fx * 5.2, vpos[1] + fy * 5.2, vpos[2]];
    let hits = trainer::find_nearby_entities_in_pool(
        base,
        rvas,
        rvas.vehicle_pool,
        probe_pt,
        6.5,
        &[veh],
        6,
    );
    for (_d, other) in hits {
        if let Some((_or, _of, _ou, opos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(other, rvas) {
            let side = (opos[0] - vpos[0]) * right[0] + (opos[1] - vpos[1]) * right[1];
            let sgn = if side >= 0.0 { 1.0 } else { -1.0 };
            set_entity_velocity_native(
                base,
                rvas,
                other,
                [
                    fx * 16.0 + right[0] * sgn * 14.0,
                    fy * 16.0 + right[1] * sgn * 14.0,
                    16.5,
                ],
            );
        }
    }
}

/// Classic Menyoo Soft-Lock Aimbot / Lethal Crosshair Assist: while aiming (RMB) + firing (LMB),
/// automatically locks a lethal pinpoint strike onto the closest ped within 9° of your camera crosshair!
fn step_soft_aimbot(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    if !key_down(0x01) || !key_down(0x02) || read_current_vehicle(base, rvas).is_some() {
        return;
    }
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some((_cr, ray_dir, _cu, ray_origin)) = trainer::read_camera_mat34(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let mut exclude = vec![ped];
    if let Ok(bgs) = BODYGUARDS.try_lock() {
        exclude.extend(bgs.iter().copied());
    }
    if let Some((_, target_ped)) = trainer::find_entity_along_ray(
        base,
        rvas,
        rvas.ped_pool,
        ray_origin,
        ray_dir,
        95.0,
        2.5,
        &exclude,
    ) {
        // Apply immediate stagger/knockdown impulse + low health on locked target!
        set_entity_velocity_native(
            base,
            rvas,
            target_ped,
            [ray_dir[0] * 14.0, ray_dir[1] * 14.0, 4.5],
        );
        if let Some((_tr, _tf, _tu, tpos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(target_ped, rvas) {
            spawn_explosion_at(base, rvas, 2, [tpos[0], tpos[1], tpos[2] + 0.5]);
        }
    }
}

/// Classic Menyoo Drunk Mode: gentle staggered lateral sway while walking on foot!
fn step_drunk_mode(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, tick: u64) {
    if read_current_vehicle(base, rvas).is_some() {
        return;
    }
    if !(key_down(0x57) || key_down(0x53) || key_down(0x41) || key_down(0x44)) {
        return;
    }
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    if let Some((right, fwd, _u, _pos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ped, rvas) {
        let sway = ((tick as f32) * 0.14).sin() * 2.2;
        set_entity_velocity_native(
            base,
            rvas,
            ped,
            [
                fwd[0] * 1.8 + right[0] * sway,
                fwd[1] * 1.8 + right[1] * sway,
                -0.1,
            ],
        );
    }
}

/// Classic Menyoo Super Swim: turbo forward velocity when holding Shift + W near/below water level!
fn step_super_swim(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    if !key_down(0x57) || !key_down(0x10) || read_current_vehicle(base, rvas).is_some() {
        return;
    }
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    if let Some((_r, fwd, _u, pos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ped, rvas)
        && pos[2] <= 1.2
    {
        let dir = trainer::read_camera_mat34(base, rvas)
            .map(|(_, cf, _, _)| cf)
            .unwrap_or(fwd);
        set_entity_velocity_native(base, rvas, ped, [dir[0] * 13.5, dir[1] * 13.5, dir[2] * 7.0]);
    }
}

/// Chaos Mode: Anti-Gravity Traffic floats nearby NPC vehicles gently skyward!
fn step_anti_grav_traffic(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some((_r, _f, _u, ppos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ped, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let mut exclude = Vec::new();
    if let Some(cur_v) = read_current_vehicle(base, rvas) {
        exclude.push(cur_v);
    }
    let vehs =
        trainer::find_nearby_entities_in_pool(base, rvas, rvas.vehicle_pool, ppos, 75.0, &exclude, 12);
    for (_d, v) in vehs {
        set_entity_velocity_native(base, rvas, v, [0.0, 0.0, 3.8]);
    }
}

/// Chaos Mode: Rainbow Traffic cycles neon RGB paint across nearby NPC vehicles!
fn step_rainbow_traffic(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    if rvas.fn_get_veh_shader_effect == 0 || rvas.fn_commit_veh_color == 0 {
        return;
    }
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some((_r, _f, _u, ppos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ped, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let mut hue = f32::from_bits(RAINBOW_TRAFFIC_HUE_BITS.load(Ordering::Relaxed));
    hue = (hue + 9.0) % 360.0;
    RAINBOW_TRAFFIC_HUE_BITS.store(hue.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
    let mut exclude = Vec::new();
    if let Some(cur_v) = read_current_vehicle(base, rvas) {
        exclude.push(cur_v);
    }
    let get_fx: extern "system" fn(u64) -> u64 =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_veh_shader_effect) as usize) };
    let commit: extern "system" fn(u64) =
        unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_commit_veh_color) as usize) };
    let vehs =
        trainer::find_nearby_entities_in_pool(base, rvas, rvas.vehicle_pool, ppos, 85.0, &exclude, 10);
    for (idx, (_d, v)) in vehs.into_iter().enumerate() {
        let rgb = trainer::hsv_to_rgb_f32((hue + (idx as f32) * 32.0) % 360.0, 1.0, 1.0);
        if let Some(dh) = trainer::safe_read::<u64>((v + rvas.entity_draw_handler) as usize)
            && dh > 0x10000
        {
            let fx = get_fx(dh);
            if fx > 0x10000 && trainer::safe_write::<[f32; 3]>((fx + rvas.veh_shader_rgb) as usize, rgb) {
                commit(fx);
            }
        }
    }
}

fn spooner_set_attach_target(rvas: &RvaTable, target: u32) {
    let mode = target.min(3);
    SPOONER_ATTACH_TARGET.store(mode, Ordering::Relaxed);
    DIAG_SPOONER_ATTACH_MODE.store(mode, Ordering::Relaxed);
    let Ok(mut s) = SPOONER_STATE.try_lock() else {
        return;
    };
    sync_spooner_hud_locked(&mut s, rvas.ped_pos_packed);
    let sel = s.selected;
    if let Some(ent) = s.entities.get_mut(sel) {
        ent.attached = mode != 0;
        ent.attach_target = mode;
        ent.attach_bone = SPOONER_ATTACH_BONE.load(Ordering::Relaxed) as u8;
        ent.attach_offset = spooner_attach_offset();
        ent.attach_rot = spooner_attach_rot();
        let any_attached = s.entities.iter().any(|e| e.attached);
        let cur = LOOP_MASK.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
        let next = if any_attached {
            cur | LOOP_SPOONER_ATTACH
        } else {
            cur & !LOOP_SPOONER_ATTACH
        };
        LOOP_MASK.store(next, Ordering::Release);
    }
    sync_spooner_hud_locked(&mut s, rvas.ped_pos_packed);
}

fn spooner_adjust_attach_rot(dpitch_deg: f32, droll_deg: f32, dyaw_deg: f32) {
    let wrap = |a: f32| -> f32 { ((a + 180.0).rem_euclid(360.0)) - 180.0 };
    let p = wrap(f32::from_bits(SPOONER_ATTACH_PITCH_BITS.load(Ordering::Relaxed)) + dpitch_deg);
    let r = wrap(f32::from_bits(SPOONER_ATTACH_ROLL_BITS.load(Ordering::Relaxed)) + droll_deg);
    let y = wrap(f32::from_bits(SPOONER_ATTACH_YAW_BITS.load(Ordering::Relaxed)) + dyaw_deg);
    SPOONER_ATTACH_PITCH_BITS.store(p.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
    SPOONER_ATTACH_ROLL_BITS.store(r.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
    SPOONER_ATTACH_YAW_BITS.store(y.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
    if let Ok(mut s) = SPOONER_STATE.try_lock() {
        let sel = s.selected;
        if let Some(ent) = s.entities.get_mut(sel) {
            ent.attach_rot = [p, r, y];
        }
    }
}

fn spooner_reset_attach_transform() {
    SPOONER_ATTACH_X_BITS.store(0.0f32.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
    SPOONER_ATTACH_Y_BITS.store(2.2f32.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
    SPOONER_ATTACH_Z_BITS.store(0.6f32.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
    SPOONER_ATTACH_PITCH_BITS.store(0.0f32.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
    SPOONER_ATTACH_ROLL_BITS.store(0.0f32.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
    SPOONER_ATTACH_YAW_BITS.store(0.0f32.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
    SPOONER_ATTACH_BONE.store(0, Ordering::Relaxed);
    if let Ok(mut s) = SPOONER_STATE.try_lock() {
        let sel = s.selected;
        if let Some(ent) = s.entities.get_mut(sel) {
            ent.attach_bone = 0;
            ent.attach_offset = [0.0, 2.2, 0.6];
            ent.attach_rot = [0.0; 3];
        }
    }
}

/// True 6-Star Wanted Setter: raises `g_max_wanted_level` to 6 when `stars == 6` (native engine supports 6!),
/// locks 6-star cleanly via `LOOP_EX_SIX_STAR_LOCK`, and cleanly clears both `[net_player + 0xb224]` wanted floor
/// and `CWanted` via native `set_wanted_level(ped, 0, 1, 1, 1)` when clearing to 0!
fn apply_set_wanted_level_6star(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, stars: i32) {
    let clamped = stars.clamp(0, 6);
    let cap = if clamped >= 6 { 6u32 } else { 5u32 };
    if clamped >= 6 && rvas.max_wanted_level != 0 {
        let _ = trainer::safe_write::<u32>((base + rvas.max_wanted_level) as usize, 6);
        let rb = trainer::safe_read::<u32>((base + rvas.max_wanted_level) as usize).unwrap_or(5);
        DIAG_MAX_WANTED_CAP.store(rb, Ordering::Relaxed);
    } else if rvas.max_wanted_level != 0 {
        if clamped == 0 {
            let _ = trainer::safe_write::<u32>((base + rvas.max_wanted_level) as usize, 5);
        }
        let rb = trainer::safe_read::<u32>((base + rvas.max_wanted_level) as usize).unwrap_or(cap);
        DIAG_MAX_WANTED_CAP.store(rb, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
    if let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) {
        let cur_ex = LOOP_MASK_EX.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
        if clamped < 6 {
            LOOP_MASK_EX.store(cur_ex & !LOOP_EX_SIX_STAR_LOCK, Ordering::Release);
            // Capstone-verified: `[net_player + 0xb224]` is the min-wanted floor — zero it on clear!
            if clamped == 0
                && rvas.fn_get_ped_net_player != 0
                && let Some(ent_id) = trainer::safe_read::<u32>((ped + rvas.ped_entity_id) as usize)
            {
                let get_np: extern "system" fn(u32, u8, u8) -> u64 =
                    unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_ped_net_player) as usize) };
                let np = get_np(ent_id, 0, 0);
                if np > 0x10000 {
                    let _ = trainer::safe_write::<u32>((np + 0xb224) as usize, 0);
                }
            }
        }
        if rvas.fn_set_wanted_level != 0 {
            let f: extern "system" fn(u64, i32, u8, u8, u8) =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_set_wanted_level) as usize) };
            f(ped, clamped, 1, 1, 1);
        }
        // Native `CWanted::Update` uses a 0..5 score table: lock 6-star when requested, and force-zero on 0!
        if clamped >= 6 {
            LOOP_MASK_EX.store(cur_ex | LOOP_EX_SIX_STAR_LOCK, Ordering::Release);
            if rvas.fn_get_wanted_comp_ex != 0
                && rvas.wanted_level_off != 0
                && let Some(ent_id) = trainer::safe_read::<u32>((ped + rvas.ped_entity_id) as usize)
            {
                let get_wc: extern "system" fn(u32) -> u64 =
                    unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_wanted_comp_ex) as usize) };
                let wc = get_wc(ent_id);
                if wc > 0x10000 {
                    DIAG_WANTED_COMP.store(wc, Ordering::Relaxed);
                    let _ = trainer::safe_write::<i32>((wc + rvas.wanted_level_off) as usize, 6);
                }
            }
        } else if clamped == 0 {
            if rvas.fn_get_wanted_comp_ex != 0
                && rvas.wanted_level_off != 0
                && let Some(ent_id) = trainer::safe_read::<u32>((ped + rvas.ped_entity_id) as usize)
            {
                let get_wc: extern "system" fn(u32) -> u64 =
                    unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_wanted_comp_ex) as usize) };
                let wc = get_wc(ent_id);
                if wc > 0x10000 {
                    DIAG_WANTED_COMP.store(wc, Ordering::Relaxed);
                    let _ = trainer::safe_write::<i32>((wc + rvas.wanted_level_off) as usize, 0);
                    if rvas.wanted_level_off >= 4 {
                        let _ = trainer::safe_write::<i32>((wc + rvas.wanted_level_off - 4) as usize, 0);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

/// Full GTA Crime-ID, Vehicle Heat, Witness, Outfit-Match & Hot Area Wiper!
fn apply_wipe_all_crime_heat(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    apply_set_wanted_level_6star(base, rvas, 0);
    apply_clear_bounty_and_heat(base, rvas);
    apply_ped_clean_damage(base, rvas);
    if let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) {
        // Clear witness / brandished / bounty flags cleanly
        set_ped_config_flag(base, rvas, ped, 29, false); // HasBrandishedWeapon
        set_ped_config_flag(base, rvas, ped, 83, true); // HasFinishedCrimeSceneCleanUp
    }
    // Also super-wash & unlock/de-heat current vehicle!
    apply_super_wash_vehicle(base, rvas);
    apply_vehicle_lock_state(base, rvas, false);
    DIAG_CRIME_HEAT_WIPED.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
}

/// CCTV, Surveillance & Open-Carry Stealth Shield (blocks AI lock-on, witness triggers, and weapon panic!).
fn apply_cctv_stealth_shield(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, enable: bool) {
    if let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) {
        set_ped_config_flag(base, rvas, ped, 33, enable); // CannotBeTargetedByAi
        set_ped_config_flag(base, rvas, ped, 10, enable); // DisablePlayerLockon
        set_ped_config_flag(base, rvas, ped, 111, !enable); // TargettableWithNoLos
        set_ped_config_flag(base, rvas, ped, 94, enable); // PreventThreatResponseReactingAggressively
    }
}

fn apply_entity_alpha_value(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, ent: u64, alpha: u8) {
    if ent < 0x10000 {
        return;
    }
    if alpha >= 250 {
        if rvas.fn_reset_entity_alpha != 0 {
            let f: extern "system" fn(u64) =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_reset_entity_alpha) as usize) };
            f(ent);
        }
    } else if rvas.fn_set_entity_alpha != 0 {
        let f: extern "system" fn(u64, u32, u8) =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_set_entity_alpha) as usize) };
        f(ent, u32::from(alpha), 0);
    }
}

fn apply_player_alpha(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, alpha: u8) {
    if let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) {
        apply_entity_alpha_value(base, rvas, ped, alpha);
    }
}

fn apply_entity_basis_scale(ent: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, scale: f32) {
    if ent < 0x10000 {
        return;
    }
    let sc = scale.clamp(0.35, 3.0);
    let Some((r, f, u, pos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ent, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let norm = |v: [f32; 3]| -> [f32; 3] {
        let l = (v[0] * v[0] + v[1] * v[1] + v[2] * v[2]).sqrt().max(0.001);
        [v[0] / l * sc, v[1] / l * sc, v[2] / l * sc]
    };
    let nr = norm(r);
    let nf = norm(f);
    let nu = norm(u);
    let mat = trainer::Mat34V {
        right: [nr[0], nr[1], nr[2], 0.0],
        forward: [nf[0], nf[1], nf[2], 0.0],
        up: [nu[0], nu[1], nu[2], 0.0],
        pos_packed: trainer::pack_sector_pos(pos),
    };
    if let Some(vtable) = trainer::safe_read::<u64>(ent as usize)
        && vtable > 0x10000
        && let Some(set_mat_addr) = trainer::safe_read::<u64>((vtable + 0x170) as usize)
        && set_mat_addr > 0x10000
    {
        let set_mat: extern "system" fn(u64, *const trainer::Mat34V, u8, u8, u8) =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute(set_mat_addr as usize) };
        set_mat(ent, &mat, 1, 1, 1);
    }
}

fn apply_player_scale(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, scale: f32) {
    if let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) {
        apply_entity_basis_scale(ped, rvas, scale);
    }
}

fn apply_ignite_self_or_nearby(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, nearby: bool) {
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some((_r, _f, _u, ppos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ped, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    if !nearby {
        spawn_explosion_at(base, rvas, 9, [ppos[0], ppos[1], ppos[2] + 0.25]);
    } else {
        let peds =
            trainer::find_nearby_entities_in_pool(base, rvas, rvas.ped_pool, ppos, 32.0, &[ped], 8);
        for (_d, target) in peds {
            if let Some((_, _, _, tpos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(target, rvas) {
                spawn_explosion_at(base, rvas, 9, [tpos[0], tpos[1], tpos[2] + 0.3]);
            }
        }
    }
}

fn apply_sky_launch_parachute(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some((_r, fwd, _u, ppos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ped, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let dest = [ppos[0], ppos[1], ppos[2] + 180.0];
    let _ = teleport_entity_native(base, rvas, ped, dest, None, true);
    let len = fwd[0].hypot(fwd[1]).max(0.001);
    set_entity_velocity_native(
        base,
        rvas,
        ped,
        [(fwd[0] / len) * 14.0, (fwd[1] / len) * 14.0, -3.5],
    );
}

fn apply_max_all_player_stats(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    apply_ped_replenish_all_cores(base, rvas);
    apply_ped_clean_damage(base, rvas);
    if let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) {
        if rvas.fn_ped_replenish_silent != 0 {
            let f: extern "system" fn(u64) =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_ped_replenish_silent) as usize) };
            f(ped);
        }
        if rvas.fn_ped_replenish_armor != 0 {
            let f: extern "system" fn(u64) =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_ped_replenish_armor) as usize) };
            f(ped);
        }
        // Clear stamina/weight/melee/reload penalties cleanly
        set_ped_config_flag(base, rvas, ped, 424, true); // DisableReloadMultiplier
        set_ped_config_flag(base, rvas, ped, 80, true); // DisableWeaponBlocking
        set_ped_config_flag(base, rvas, ped, 294, true); // IgnoreWeaponDegradation
    }
}

fn apply_ped_wardrobe_slot(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, slot: u8, delta: i32) {
    let idx = usize::from(slot).min(5);
    let seed = if let Ok(mut slots) = WARDROBE_SLOTS.try_lock() {
        slots[idx] = ((slots[idx] as i32 + delta).rem_euclid(64)) as u32;
        // Combine all 6 clothing/grooming slot dials cleanly into a deterministic variation seed!
        let mut acc = 0u32;
        for (i, &v) in slots.iter().enumerate() {
            acc = acc.wrapping_add(v.wrapping_mul((i as u32 + 1) * 37));
        }
        acc & 0xFF
    } else {
        0
    };
    apply_ped_wardrobe_seed(base, rvas, seed);
}

fn apply_player_emote_action(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, kind: u8) {
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    match kind {
        0 => apply_use_nearest_scenario(base, rvas),
        1 => {
            let _ = issue_task_hands_up(base, rvas, ped, ped, 10_000);
        }
        2 => {
            if rvas.fn_task_guard_pos != 0
                && let Some(h) = get_entity_script_handle(base, rvas, ped)
            {
                let guard: extern "system" fn(*const trainer::ScriptHandle, f32, f32, u8) =
                    unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_task_guard_pos) as usize) };
                guard(&h, 15.0, 20.0, 1);
            }
        }
        3 => {
            // Stealth / Crouch stance toggle
            set_ped_config_flag(base, rvas, ped, 223, true);
        }
        4 => {
            // Prone / Low Crawl: forward low velocity impulse + crouch flag
            set_ped_config_flag(base, rvas, ped, 223, true);
            if let Some((_, fwd, _, _)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ped, rvas) {
                let len = fwd[0].hypot(fwd[1]).max(0.001);
                set_entity_velocity_native(base, rvas, ped, [(fwd[0] / len) * 2.5, (fwd[1] / len) * 2.5, -1.5]);
            }
        }
        5 => {
            // Play Dead / Ragdoll drop
            apply_force_player_ragdoll(base, rvas);
        }
        _ => {
            set_ped_config_flag(base, rvas, ped, 223, false);
            apply_clear_player_tasks(base, rvas);
        }
    }
}

fn apply_restrain_nearest_ped(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some((_, _, _, ppos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ped, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let nearby =
        trainer::find_nearby_entities_in_pool(base, rvas, rvas.ped_pool, ppos, 14.0, &[ped], 1);
    if let Some(&(_, target)) = nearby.first() {
        let _ = issue_task_hands_up(base, rvas, target, ped, 60_000);
        if rvas.fn_phys_freeze != 0 {
            let f: extern "system" fn(u64) =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_phys_freeze) as usize) };
            f(target);
        }
    }
}

fn apply_toggle_carry_nearest_ped(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let cur = CARRIED_PED_PTR.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
    if cur > 0x10000 {
        CARRIED_PED_PTR.store(0, Ordering::Relaxed);
        let mask = LOOP_MASK_EX.load(Ordering::Relaxed) & !LOOP_EX_CARRY_PED;
        LOOP_MASK_EX.store(mask, Ordering::Release);
        if rvas.fn_phys_unfreeze != 0 {
            let u: extern "system" fn(u64) =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_phys_unfreeze) as usize) };
            u(cur);
        }
        return;
    }
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some((_, _, _, ppos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ped, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let nearby =
        trainer::find_nearby_entities_in_pool(base, rvas, rvas.ped_pool, ppos, 10.0, &[ped], 1);
    if let Some(&(_, target)) = nearby.first() {
        CARRIED_PED_PTR.store(target, Ordering::Relaxed);
        let mask = LOOP_MASK_EX.load(Ordering::Relaxed) | LOOP_EX_CARRY_PED;
        LOOP_MASK_EX.store(mask, Ordering::Release);
    }
}

fn apply_summon_pet_companion(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, ped_hash64: u64) {
    let mut h = ped_hash64;
    if h == 0 {
        h = DEFAULT_PED_MODEL_HASH.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
    if h == 0
        && let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas)
        && let Some(mi) = trainer::safe_read::<u64>((ped + 0x20) as usize)
        && mi > 0x10000
    {
        h = trainer::safe_read::<u64>((mi + 0x60) as usize).unwrap_or(0);
    }
    if h != 0 {
        start_ped_spawn_ex(base, rvas, h, 1, 0, true, false, Some([1.8, 2.2, 0.25]));
        DIAG_PET_SPAWNED.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
}

}

fn apply_warp_to_nearest_train(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some((_, _, _, ppos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ped, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let vehs =
        trainer::find_nearby_entities_in_pool(base, rvas, rvas.vehicle_pool, ppos, 800.0, &[], 32);
    // Prefer rail/train vehicle type (MI veh_type == 13/14) or nearest large vehicle
    let mut chosen = vehs.first().map(|&(_, v)| v);
    for &(_, v) in &vehs {
        if let Some(mi) = trainer::safe_read::<u64>((v + 0x20) as usize)
            && mi > 0x10000
            && let Some(vt) = trainer::safe_read::<u32>((mi + rvas.model_info_veh_type) as usize)
            && matches!(vt, 13 | 14)
        {
            chosen = Some(v);
            break;
        }
    }
    if let Some(v) = chosen {
        let _ = warp_local_ped_into_vehicle(base, rvas, v, 0);
    }
}

/// Native Per-Channel Underglow Neon (`Left, Right, Front, Back`) via ABI-verified `veh_set_neon_channels`!
fn apply_vehicle_neon_channels(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, ch: [bool; 4]) {
    let mask = u32::from(ch[0])
        | (u32::from(ch[1]) << 1)
        | (u32::from(ch[2]) << 2)
        | (u32::from(ch[3]) << 3);
    DIAG_NEON_CHANNELS_MASK.store(mask, Ordering::Relaxed);
    let Some(veh) = active_or_last_vehicle(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    if rvas.fn_veh_set_neon_channels != 0
        && let Some(h) = get_entity_script_handle(base, rvas, veh)
    {
        let f: extern "system" fn(*const trainer::ScriptHandle, u8, u8, u8, u8) =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_veh_set_neon_channels) as usize) };
        f(&h, u8::from(ch[0]), u8::from(ch[1]), u8::from(ch[2]), u8::from(ch[3]));
        DIAG_LAST_NEON_APPLIED.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
        return;
    }
    apply_vehicle_neon_enabled(base, rvas, mask != 0);
}

/// Native Vehicle Extra (`1..=13`) & Symmetrical Toggle Mod Bit setter/clearer!
fn apply_vehicle_extra(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, extra_id: u32, enable: bool) {
    let Some(veh) = active_or_last_vehicle(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    if let Some(h) = get_entity_script_handle(base, rvas, veh) {
        if enable && rvas.fn_veh_set_toggle_mod_bit != 0 {
            let f: extern "system" fn(*const trainer::ScriptHandle, u32) =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_veh_set_toggle_mod_bit) as usize) };
            f(&h, extra_id.min(63));
            DIAG_VEH_EXTRAS_APPLIED.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
        } else if !enable && rvas.fn_veh_clear_toggle_mod_bit != 0 {
            let f: extern "system" fn(*const trainer::ScriptHandle, u32) =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_veh_clear_toggle_mod_bit) as usize) };
            f(&h, extra_id.min(63));
            if rvas.fn_veh_clear_extra_bit2 != 0 {
                let f2: extern "system" fn(*const trainer::ScriptHandle, u32) =
                    unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_veh_clear_extra_bit2) as usize) };
                f2(&h, extra_id.min(63));
            }
            DIAG_VEH_EXTRAS_APPLIED.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
        }
    }
    apply_vehicle_mod_bit(base, rvas, extra_id.min(63), enable);
}

/// Native Vehicle Gravity Float (`0.0` Zero-G, `2.45` Moon, `9.8` Earth, `29.4` 3x Downforce)!
fn apply_vehicle_gravity_float(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, g: f32) {
    let clamped = g.clamp(0.0, 35.0);
    DIAG_VEH_GRAVITY_BITS.store(clamped.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
    let Some(veh) = active_or_last_vehicle(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    if rvas.fn_get_veh_engine_comp != 0
        && rvas.fn_veh_set_gravity_float != 0
        && let Some(ent_id) = trainer::safe_read::<u32>((veh + rvas.ped_entity_id) as usize)
    {
        let get_eng: extern "system" fn(u32) -> u64 =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_veh_engine_comp) as usize) };
        let comp = get_eng(ent_id);
        if comp > 0x10000 {
            DIAG_VEH_ENGINE_COMP.store(comp, Ordering::Relaxed);
            let set_g: extern "system" fn(u64, f32) =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_veh_set_gravity_float) as usize) };
            set_g(comp, clamped);
            return;
        }
    }
    if rvas.fn_veh_set_gravity_enabled != 0
        && let Some(h) = get_entity_script_handle(base, rvas, veh)
    {
        let f: extern "system" fn(*const trainer::ScriptHandle, u8) =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_veh_set_gravity_enabled) as usize) };
        f(&h, u8::from(clamped > 0.1));
    }
}

            .first()

        return;
    };
    if rvas.fn_veh_set_lock_flag != 0
        && let Some(h) = get_entity_script_handle(base, rvas, veh)
    {
        let f: extern "system" fn(*const trainer::ScriptHandle, u8) =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_veh_set_lock_flag) as usize) };
        f(&h, u8::from(locked));
        DIAG_VEH_LOCK_APPLIED.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
}

fn apply_toggle_vehicle_tow_magnet(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let cur = TOWED_VEH_PTR.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
    if cur > 0x10000 {
        TOWED_VEH_PTR.store(0, Ordering::Relaxed);
        let mask = LOOP_MASK_EX.load(Ordering::Relaxed) & !LOOP_EX_VEH_TOW_MAGNET;
        LOOP_MASK_EX.store(mask, Ordering::Release);
        return;
    }
    let Some(veh) = active_or_last_vehicle(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some((_, _, _, vpos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(veh, rvas) else {
        return;
