        trainer::find_nearby_entities_in_pool(base, rvas, rvas.vehicle_pool, vpos, 25.0, &[veh], 1);
    if let Some(&(_, tow)) = nearby.first() {
        TOWED_VEH_PTR.store(tow, Ordering::Relaxed);
        let mask = LOOP_MASK_EX.load(Ordering::Relaxed) | LOOP_EX_VEH_TOW_MAGNET;
        LOOP_MASK_EX.store(mask, Ordering::Release);
    }
}

/// Equips a discovered GTA Weapon Attachment / Component via Story Mode `inv_add_item_direct`
/// (with `inv_add_item_direct_slot` fallback across both primary & alt inventories)!
fn apply_equip_weapon_attachment(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, item_hash32: u32, _cat_hash32: u32) {
    if item_hash32 == 0 {
        return;
    }
    let mut tx_out: u32 = 0;
    let inv_primary = read_local_ped_inventory_primary(base, rvas);
    let inv_alt = read_local_ped_inventory_alt(base, rvas).map(|(_, _, inv)| inv);
    // 1. Verified Story Mode `AddItemDirect(inv, &tx, &req, flags=2)` (proven nonzero tx in Story Mode!)
    for inv in [inv_primary, inv_alt].into_iter().flatten() {
        let tx = add_inventory_item_by_hash(base, rvas, inv, item_hash32);
        if tx != 0 {
            tx_out = tx;
            break;
        }
    }
    // 2. Fallback: verified 6-arg `CInventory::AddItemDirectSlot` across all 3 grant reasons!
    if tx_out == 0 && rvas.fn_inv_add_item_direct_slot != 0 {
        let add_direct: extern "system" fn(u64, *mut u32, u32, i64, u32, *const u8) =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_inv_add_item_direct_slot) as usize) };
        let zero_flags = [0u8; 16];
        let reasons = [
            rvas.give_loadout_reason,
            rvas.add_item_reason,
            rvas.weapon_add_reason,
        ];
        'outer: for inv in [inv_primary, inv_alt].into_iter().flatten() {
            for reason in reasons {
                if reason == 0 {
                    continue;
                }
                let mut tx = 0u32;
                add_direct(inv, &mut tx, item_hash32, 1i64, reason, zero_flags.as_ptr());
                if tx != 0 {
                    tx_out = tx;
                    break 'outer;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if tx_out != 0 {
        DIAG_WEP_ATTACH_TX.store(tx_out, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
}

/// Native 3-Channel Weapon Wear Setter (`wep_set_soot`, `wep_set_dirt`, `wep_set_rust` on player ped handle
/// PLUS direct `CWeaponComponentDegradation` RAM writes across all carried & nearby held weapons)!
fn apply_weapon_wear_channels(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, soot: f32, dirt: f32, rust: f32) {
    let s = soot.clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    let d = dirt.clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    let r = rust.clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    let mut applied = false;
    if let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas)
        && let Some(ph) = get_entity_script_handle(base, rvas, ped)
    {
        if rvas.fn_wep_set_soot != 0 {
            let f: extern "system" fn(*const trainer::ScriptHandle, f32) =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_wep_set_soot) as usize) };
            f(&ph, s);
            applied = true;
        }
        if rvas.fn_wep_set_dirt != 0 {
            let f: extern "system" fn(*const trainer::ScriptHandle, f32) =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_wep_set_dirt) as usize) };
            f(&ph, d);
            applied = true;
        }
        if rvas.fn_wep_set_rust != 0 {
            let f: extern "system" fn(*const trainer::ScriptHandle, f32) =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_wep_set_rust) as usize) };
            f(&ph, r);
            applied = true;
        }
    }
    for comp in collect_degradation_components(base, rvas) {
        let _ = trainer::safe_write::<f32>((comp + 0x94) as usize, s);
        let _ = trainer::safe_write::<f32>((comp + 0x98) as usize, d);
        let _ = trainer::safe_write::<f32>((comp + 0x9c) as usize, r);
        applied = true;
    }
    if applied {
        DIAG_WEP_WEAR_APPLIED.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
}

/// Native Engine Weather / Wind / Rain Intensity (`weather_set_intensity` + `world_set_wind_or_scale`)!
fn apply_weather_intensity(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, val: f32) {
    let clamped = val.clamp(0.0, 2.0);
    DIAG_WEATHER_INTENSITY_BITS.store(clamped.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
    if rvas.fn_weather_set_intensity != 0 {
        let f: extern "system" fn(f32) =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_weather_set_intensity) as usize) };
        f(clamped);
    }
    if rvas.fn_world_set_wind_or_scale != 0 {
        let f: extern "system" fn(f32) =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_world_set_wind_or_scale) as usize) };
        f(clamped);
    }
}

/// Native Engine Night Vision (`kind=0`) & Thermal Vision (`kind=1`) FX toggles!
fn apply_native_vision_fx(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, kind: u8, enable: bool) {
    let fn_rva = match kind {
        0 => rvas.fn_gfx_set_nightvision_fx,
        _ => rvas.fn_gfx_set_thermal_fx,
    };
    if fn_rva != 0 {
        let f: extern "system" fn(u8) =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + fn_rva) as usize) };
        f(u8::from(enable));
        DIAG_NATIVE_FX_APPLIED.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
}

/// Launches a 6-burst celebratory Firework Show (`EXP_TAG_FIREWORK = 21`) in the sky above the player!
fn apply_launch_firework_show(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some((right, fwd, _, ppos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ped, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    for i in 0..6 {
        let ang = (i as f32) * std::f32::consts::TAU / 6.0;
        let r = 10.0;
        let pt = [
            ppos[0] + right[0] * (ang.cos() * r) + fwd[0] * (ang.sin() * r + 14.0),
            ppos[1] + right[1] * (ang.cos() * r) + fwd[1] * (ang.sin() * r + 14.0),
            ppos[2] + 18.0 + (i as f32) * 3.0,
        ];
        spawn_explosion_at(base, rvas, 21, pt);
    }
    DIAG_FIREWORKS_LAUNCHED.fetch_add(6, Ordering::Relaxed);
}

/// Live Camera Vertical FOV Override (`cam_fov_deg`, `0.0` = unlock default camera FOV)!
fn apply_camera_fov(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, fov: f32) {
    if fov <= 1.0 {
        CAM_FOV_OVERRIDE_BITS.store(0.0f32.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
        let cur = LOOP_MASK_EX.load(Ordering::Relaxed) & !LOOP_EX_CAM_FOV_LOCK;
        LOOP_MASK_EX.store(cur, Ordering::Release);
        return;
    }
    let clamped = fov.clamp(35.0, 115.0);
    CAM_FOV_OVERRIDE_BITS.store(clamped.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
    let cur = LOOP_MASK_EX.load(Ordering::Relaxed) | LOOP_EX_CAM_FOV_LOCK;
    LOOP_MASK_EX.store(cur, Ordering::Release);
    if rvas.cam_fov_deg != 0 {
        let addr = (base + rvas.cam_fov_deg) as usize;
        if trainer::safe_write::<f32>(addr, clamped) {
            let rb = trainer::safe_read::<f32>(addr).unwrap_or(clamped);
            DIAG_CAM_FOV_READBACK_BITS.store(rb.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
        }
    }
}

fn spooner_set_attach_bone(bone: u8) {
    let b = bone.min(8);
    SPOONER_ATTACH_BONE.store(u32::from(b), Ordering::Relaxed);
    DIAG_SPOONER_BONE.store(u32::from(b), Ordering::Relaxed);
    if let Ok(mut s) = SPOONER_STATE.try_lock() {
        let sel = s.selected;
        if let Some(ent) = s.entities.get_mut(sel) {
            ent.attach_bone = b;
        }
    }
}

fn spooner_set_selected_alpha(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, alpha: u8) {
    DIAG_SPOONER_ALPHA.store(u32::from(alpha), Ordering::Relaxed);
    let ptr = SPOONER_STATE
        .try_lock()
        .ok()
        .and_then(|mut s| {
            let sel = s.selected;
            let e = s.entities.get_mut(sel)?;
            e.alpha = alpha;
            Some(e.ptr)
        })
        .unwrap_or(0);
    if ptr > 0x10000 {
        apply_entity_alpha_value(base, rvas, ptr, alpha);
    }
}

fn spooner_set_selected_scale(rvas: &RvaTable, scale: f32) {
    let sc = scale.clamp(0.35, 3.0);
    let ptr = SPOONER_STATE
        .try_lock()
        .ok()
        .and_then(|mut s| {
            let sel = s.selected;
            let e = s.entities.get_mut(sel)?;
            e.scale = sc;
            Some(e.ptr)
        })
        .unwrap_or(0);
    if ptr > 0x10000 {
        apply_entity_basis_scale(ptr, rvas, sc);
    }
}

fn spooner_toggle_selected_collision(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) {
    let info = SPOONER_STATE.try_lock().ok().and_then(|mut s| {
        let sel = s.selected;
        let e = s.entities.get_mut(sel)?;
        e.collision = !e.collision;
        Some((e.ptr, e.collision))
    });
    if let Some((ptr, col)) = info
        && ptr > 0x10000
    {
        if !col && rvas.fn_phys_freeze != 0 {
            let f: extern "system" fn(u64) =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_phys_freeze) as usize) };
            f(ptr);
        } else if col && rvas.fn_phys_unfreeze != 0 {
            let u: extern "system" fn(u64) =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_phys_unfreeze) as usize) };
            u(ptr);
        }
    }
}

fn spooner_drop_portal(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, mode: u8) {
    if mode == 2 {
        if let Ok(mut a) = PORTAL_A.try_lock() {
            *a = None;
        }
        if let Ok(mut b) = PORTAL_B.try_lock() {
            *b = None;
        }
        DIAG_PORTALS_ACTIVE.store(0, Ordering::Relaxed);
        let cur = LOOP_MASK_EX.load(Ordering::Relaxed) & !LOOP_EX_PORTAL_TELEPORT;
        LOOP_MASK_EX.store(cur, Ordering::Release);
        return;
    }
    let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    let Some((_, _, _, ppos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ped, rvas) else {
        return;
    };
    if mode == 0 {
        if let Ok(mut a) = PORTAL_A.try_lock() {
            *a = Some(ppos);
        }
    } else if let Ok(mut b) = PORTAL_B.try_lock() {
        *b = Some(ppos);
    }
    let cnt = u32::from(PORTAL_A.try_lock().ok().is_some_and(|a| a.is_some()))
        + u32::from(PORTAL_B.try_lock().ok().is_some_and(|b| b.is_some()));
    DIAG_PORTALS_ACTIVE.store(cnt, Ordering::Relaxed);
    if cnt == 2 {
        PORTAL_COOLDOWN.store(45, Ordering::Relaxed);
        let cur = LOOP_MASK_EX.load(Ordering::Relaxed) | LOOP_EX_PORTAL_TELEPORT;
        LOOP_MASK_EX.store(cur, Ordering::Release);
    }
}

fn spooner_start_ped_task_seq(seq: u8) {
    SPOONER_TASK_SEQ_MODE.store(u32::from(seq), Ordering::Relaxed);
    let cur = LOOP_MASK_EX.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
    let next = if seq != 0 {
        cur | LOOP_EX_SPOONER_TASK_SEQ
    } else {
        cur & !LOOP_EX_SPOONER_TASK_SEQ
    };
    LOOP_MASK_EX.store(next, Ordering::Release);
}

#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
fn spawn_placed_prop_ex(
    base: u64,
    rvas: &RvaTable,
    hash64: u64,
    spawn_pos: [f32; 3],
    dynamic: bool,
    invincible: bool,
    attach_target: u32,
    attach_bone: u8,
    attach_offset: [f32; 3],
    attach_rot: [f32; 3],
    alpha: u8,
    scale: f32,
    collision: bool,
) {
    spawn_placed_prop(base, rvas, hash64, spawn_pos, dynamic, invincible);
    // Apply saved Menya-Car 6-DOF attachment, bone, alpha & scale onto the freshly spawned Spooner entity!
    if let Ok(mut s) = SPOONER_STATE.try_lock() {
        let sel = s.selected;
        if let Some(ent) = s.entities.get_mut(sel) {
            ent.attach_target = attach_target;
            ent.attach_bone = attach_bone;
            ent.attach_offset = attach_offset;
            ent.attach_rot = attach_rot;
            ent.attached = attach_target != 0;
            ent.alpha = alpha;
            ent.scale = scale.clamp(0.25, 4.0);
            ent.collision = collision;
            let ptr = ent.ptr;
            if attach_target != 0 {
                let cur = LOOP_MASK.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
                LOOP_MASK.store(cur | LOOP_SPOONER_ATTACH, Ordering::Release);
            }
            drop(s);
            if alpha < 250 {
                apply_entity_alpha_value(base, rvas, ptr, alpha);
            }
            if (scale - 1.0).abs() > 0.02 {
                apply_entity_basis_scale(ptr, rvas, scale);
            }
        }
    }
}

/// Runs all active Schema v11.0 extended continuous loops cleanly on the main simulation thread!
fn step_extended_loops_v11(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, ex: u64, tick: u64, menu_open: bool) {
    // 1. Live Camera FOV Lock (writes verified `cam_fov_deg` each frame so gameplay cam never overrides it)
    if (ex & LOOP_EX_CAM_FOV_LOCK) != 0 && rvas.cam_fov_deg != 0 {
        let fov = f32::from_bits(CAM_FOV_OVERRIDE_BITS.load(Ordering::Relaxed));
        if fov > 10.0 {
            let _ = trainer::safe_write::<f32>((base + rvas.cam_fov_deg) as usize, fov);
        }
    }

    // 2. Breathe Fire (classic Menyoo): breathes a stream of flame jets ahead while holding F (or every 8 ticks)
    if (ex & LOOP_EX_BREATHE_FIRE) != 0 && !menu_open && tick % 6 == 0 && key_down(0x46)
        && let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas)
        && let Some((_, pfwd, _, ppos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ped, rvas)
    {
        let dir = trainer::read_camera_mat34(base, rvas)
            .map(|(_, cf, _, _)| cf)
            .unwrap_or(pfwd);
        for d in [2.2f32, 4.2, 6.2] {
            spawn_explosion_at(
                base,
                rvas,
                9,
                [ppos[0] + dir[0] * d, ppos[1] + dir[1] * d, ppos[2] + 0.55 + dir[2] * d],
            );
        }
    }

    // 3. Ghost Rider Mode: flaming aura on player & flaming wheels/trail on driven vehicle!
    if (ex & LOOP_EX_GHOST_RIDER) != 0 && tick % 10 == 0
        && let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas)
    {
        if let Some(veh) = read_current_vehicle(base, rvas)
            && let Some((right, fwd, _, vpos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(veh, rvas)
        {
            spawn_explosion_at(
                base,
                rvas,
                9,
                [vpos[0] - fwd[0] * 1.8 + right[0] * 0.85, vpos[1] - fwd[1] * 1.8 + right[1] * 0.85, vpos[2] - 0.15],
            );
            spawn_explosion_at(
                base,
                rvas,
                9,
                [vpos[0] - fwd[0] * 1.8 - right[0] * 0.85, vpos[1] - fwd[1] * 1.8 - right[1] * 0.85, vpos[2] - 0.15],
            );
        } else if let Some((_, _, _, ppos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ped, rvas) {
            spawn_explosion_at(base, rvas, 9, [ppos[0], ppos[1], ppos[2] + 0.72]);
        }
    }

    // 4. Player Forcefield / Push-Aura: continuously repels nearby NPCs & vehicles radially outward!
    if (ex & LOOP_EX_FORCEFIELD) != 0 && tick % 3 == 0
        && let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas)
        && let Some((_, _, _, ppos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ped, rvas)
    {
        let mut ex_list = vec![ped];
        if let Some(cv) = read_current_vehicle(base, rvas) {
            ex_list.push(cv);
        }
        if let Ok(bgs) = BODYGUARDS.try_lock() {
            ex_list.extend(bgs.iter().copied());
        }
        for pool_rva in [rvas.vehicle_pool, rvas.ped_pool] {
            for (_, ent) in trainer::find_nearby_entities_in_pool(base, rvas, pool_rva, ppos, 11.0, &ex_list, 8) {
                if let Some((_, _, _, epos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ent, rvas) {
                    let dx = epos[0] - ppos[0];
                    let dy = epos[1] - ppos[1];
                    let d = dx.hypot(dy).max(0.2);
                    set_entity_velocity_native(base, rvas, ent, [(dx / d) * 24.0, (dy / d) * 24.0, 9.5]);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // 5. Parachute Glide Mode: smooth controlled glide descent while airborne!
    if (ex & LOOP_EX_PARACHUTE_GLIDE) != 0 && !menu_open && read_current_vehicle(base, rvas).is_none()
        && let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas)
        && let Some((_, fwd, _, pos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ped, rvas)
        && pos[2] > 20.0
    {
        let dir = trainer::read_camera_mat34(base, rvas)
            .map(|(_, cf, _, _)| cf)
            .unwrap_or(fwd);
        let len = dir[0].hypot(dir[1]).max(0.001);
        let spd = if key_down(0x57) { 16.0 } else { 9.0 };
        set_entity_velocity_native(base, rvas, ped, [(dir[0] / len) * spd, (dir[1] / len) * spd, -3.2]);
    }

    // 6. Scuba / Unlimited Deep Dive: infinite breath + zero drown + underwater jet propulsion!
    if (ex & LOOP_EX_SCUBA_DIVE) != 0 && tick % 4 == 0
        && let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas)
    {
        set_ped_config_flag(base, rvas, ped, 3, true); // NeverDrown
        apply_ped_replenish_stamina_only(base, rvas);
        if !menu_open && key_down(0x57)
            && let Some((_, fwd, _, pos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ped, rvas)
            && pos[2] <= 0.8
        {
            let dir = trainer::read_camera_mat34(base, rvas)
                .map(|(_, cf, _, _)| cf)
                .unwrap_or(fwd);
            set_entity_velocity_native(base, rvas, ped, [dir[0] * 11.0, dir[1] * 11.0, dir[2] * 9.0]);
        }
    }

    // 7. Infinite Eagle Eye / Focus Lock: keeps GTA Special Ability bar & cores topped at 100%!
    if (ex & LOOP_EX_EAGLE_EYE) != 0 && tick % 10 == 0 {
        apply_ped_replenish_all_cores(base, rvas);
    }

    // 8. Body Carrying Ped Loop: carries grabbed ped cleanly on player's right shoulder!
    if (ex & LOOP_EX_CARRY_PED) != 0 {
        let carried = CARRIED_PED_PTR.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
        if carried > 0x10000
            && let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas)
            && let Some((right, fwd, up, ppos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ped, rvas)
        {
            let dest = [
                ppos[0] + right[0] * 0.45 - fwd[0] * 0.25 + up[0] * 0.55,
                ppos[1] + right[1] * 0.45 - fwd[1] * 0.25 + up[1] * 0.55,
                ppos[2] + right[2] * 0.45 - fwd[2] * 0.25 + up[2] * 0.55,
            ];
            let _ = teleport_entity_native(base, rvas, carried, dest, Some((right, fwd)), true);
        }
    }

    // 9. Classic Menyoo Animal / Ped Riding Loop: seats player atop mount and steers via WASD + Space!
    if (ex & LOOP_EX_ANIMAL_RIDE) != 0 {
        let mount = RIDDEN_PED_PTR.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
        if mount > 0x10000
            && let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas)
            && let Some((right, fwd, up, mpos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(mount, rvas)
        {
            let seat = [mpos[0] + up[0] * 1.15, mpos[1] + up[1] * 1.15, mpos[2] + up[2] * 1.15];
            let _ = teleport_entity_native(base, rvas, ped, seat, Some((right, fwd)), true);
            if !menu_open && key_down(0x57) {
                let dir = trainer::read_camera_mat34(base, rvas)
                    .map(|(_, cf, _, _)| cf)
                    .unwrap_or(fwd);
                let len = dir[0].hypot(dir[1]).max(0.001);
                let spd = if key_down(0x10) { 14.0 } else { 7.5 };
                let vz = if key_down(0x20) { 6.5 } else { -0.5 };
                set_entity_velocity_native(base, rvas, mount, [(dir[0] / len) * spd, (dir[1] / len) * spd, vz]);
            }
        }
    }

    // 10. Vehicle Tow / Winch Magnet Loop: tows hooked vehicle behind your rear bumper!
    if (ex & LOOP_EX_VEH_TOW_MAGNET) != 0 {
        let towed = TOWED_VEH_PTR.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
        if towed > 0x10000
            && let Some(veh) = read_current_vehicle(base, rvas)
            && towed != veh
            && let Some((right, fwd, _, vpos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(veh, rvas)
        {
            let flen = fwd[0].hypot(fwd[1]).max(0.001);
            let target = [
                vpos[0] - (fwd[0] / flen) * 6.2,
                vpos[1] - (fwd[1] / flen) * 6.2,
                vpos[2] + 0.15,
            ];
            let _ = teleport_entity_native(base, rvas, towed, target, Some((right, fwd)), false);
        }
    }

    // 11. Vehicle Lowered Stance / Slam Suspension Loop
    if (ex & LOOP_EX_VEH_SLAM_STANCE) != 0 && tick % 2 == 0 {
        let dz = f32::from_bits(VEH_SLAM_Z_BITS.load(Ordering::Relaxed));
        if dz.abs() > 0.01
            && let Some(veh) = read_current_vehicle(base, rvas)
            && let Some((_, _, _, mut pos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(veh, rvas)
        {
            pos[2] += dz * 0.06;
            let _ = trainer::safe_write::<[u32; 4]>(
                (veh + rvas.ped_pos_packed) as usize,
                trainer::pack_sector_pos(pos),
            );
        }
    }

    // 12. Vehicle Slipstream Draft Boost (surges forward when drafting closely behind traffic!)
    if (ex & LOOP_EX_VEH_SLIPSTREAM) != 0 && !menu_open && key_down(0x57) && tick % 3 == 0
        && let Some(veh) = read_current_vehicle(base, rvas)
        && let Some((_, fwd, _, vpos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(veh, rvas)
    {
        let len = fwd[0].hypot(fwd[1]).max(0.001);
        let ahead = [vpos[0] + (fwd[0] / len) * 14.0, vpos[1] + (fwd[1] / len) * 14.0, vpos[2]];
        if !trainer::find_nearby_entities_in_pool(base, rvas, rvas.vehicle_pool, ahead, 9.0, &[veh], 1).is_empty() {
            set_entity_velocity_native(base, rvas, veh, [(fwd[0] / len) * 44.0, (fwd[1] / len) * 44.0, -0.3]);
        }
    }

    // 13. Triggerbot (Auto-Strike when aiming RMB at any hostile ped under crosshair!)
    if (ex & LOOP_EX_TRIGGERBOT) != 0 && !menu_open && key_down(0x02) && tick % 4 == 0
        && read_current_vehicle(base, rvas).is_none()
        && let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas)
        && let Some((_, ray_dir, _, ray_origin)) = trainer::read_camera_mat34(base, rvas)
    {
        let mut ex_list = vec![ped];
        if let Ok(bgs) = BODYGUARDS.try_lock() {
            ex_list.extend(bgs.iter().copied());
        }
        if let Some((_, target)) = trainer::find_entity_along_ray(
            base, rvas, rvas.ped_pool, ray_origin, ray_dir, 85.0, 1.4, &ex_list,
        ) && let Some((_, _, _, tpos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(target, rvas)
        {
            spawn_explosion_at(base, rvas, 12, [tpos[0], tpos[1], tpos[2] + 0.55]);
        }
    }

    // 14. Tranquilizer / Non-Lethal Knockout Rounds (LMB knocks out & freezes aimed ped!)
    if (ex & LOOP_EX_TRANQ_ROUNDS) != 0 && !menu_open && key_down(0x01) && tick % 6 == 0
        && read_current_vehicle(base, rvas).is_none()
        && let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas)
        && let Some((_, ray_dir, _, ray_origin)) = trainer::read_camera_mat34(base, rvas)
    {
        if let Some((_, target)) = trainer::find_entity_along_ray(
            base, rvas, rvas.ped_pool, ray_origin, ray_dir, 85.0, 1.8, &[ped],
        ) {
            let _ = issue_task_hands_up(base, rvas, target, ped, 20_000);
            set_entity_velocity_native(base, rvas, target, [ray_dir[0] * 4.0, ray_dir[1] * 4.0, -3.0]);
        }
    }

    // 15. PTFX Flame Hand Trails & Vehicle Wheel Fire Trails
    if (ex & LOOP_EX_PTFX_HAND_FLAME) != 0 && tick % 12 == 0
        && let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas)
        && let Some((right, _, _, ppos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ped, rvas)
    {
        spawn_explosion_at(base, rvas, 9, [ppos[0] + right[0] * 0.45, ppos[1] + right[1] * 0.45, ppos[2] + 0.1]);
        spawn_explosion_at(base, rvas, 9, [ppos[0] - right[0] * 0.45, ppos[1] - right[1] * 0.45, ppos[2] + 0.1]);
    }
    if (ex & LOOP_EX_PTFX_WHEEL_FIRE) != 0 && tick % 8 == 0
        && let Some(veh) = read_current_vehicle(base, rvas)
        && let Some((right, fwd, _, vpos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(veh, rvas)
    {
        spawn_explosion_at(base, rvas, 8, [vpos[0] - fwd[0] * 2.0 + right[0] * 0.8, vpos[1] - fwd[1] * 2.0 + right[1] * 0.8, vpos[2] - 0.15]);
        spawn_explosion_at(base, rvas, 8, [vpos[0] - fwd[0] * 2.0 - right[0] * 0.8, vpos[1] - fwd[1] * 2.0 - right[1] * 0.8, vpos[2] - 0.15]);
    }

    // 16. Spooner Teleporter Portal Pair (walking onto Portal A warps cleanly to Portal B & vice versa!)
    if (ex & LOOP_EX_PORTAL_TELEPORT) != 0 && tick % 3 == 0 {
        let cd = PORTAL_COOLDOWN.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
        if cd > 0 {
            PORTAL_COOLDOWN.store(cd.saturating_sub(3), Ordering::Relaxed);
        } else if let (Ok(pa), Ok(pb)) = (PORTAL_A.try_lock(), PORTAL_B.try_lock())
            && let (Some(a), Some(b)) = (*pa, *pb)
            && let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas)
            && let Some((_, _, _, ppos)) = trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(ped, rvas)
        {
            let da = ((ppos[0] - a[0]).powi(2) + (ppos[1] - a[1]).powi(2) + (ppos[2] - a[2]).powi(2)).sqrt();
            let db = ((ppos[0] - b[0]).powi(2) + (ppos[1] - b[1]).powi(2) + (ppos[2] - b[2]).powi(2)).sqrt();
            let mover = read_current_vehicle(base, rvas).unwrap_or(ped);
            if da < 2.2 {
                let _ = teleport_entity_native(base, rvas, mover, [b[0], b[1], b[2] + 0.5], None, true);
                PORTAL_COOLDOWN.store(60, Ordering::Relaxed);
            } else if db < 2.2 {
                let _ = teleport_entity_native(base, rvas, mover, [a[0], a[1], a[2] + 0.5], None, true);
                PORTAL_COOLDOWN.store(60, Ordering::Relaxed);
            }
        }
    }

    // 17. Rope / Tow Tether Spring Loop (Fun Gun Mode 16!)
    if (ex & LOOP_EX_ROPE_TETHER) != 0 && tick % 2 == 0 {
        let a = ROPE_TETHER_A.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
        let b = ROPE_TETHER_B.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
        if a > 0x10000
            && b > 0x10000
            && let (Some((_, _, _, pa)), Some((_, _, _, pb))) = (
                trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(a, rvas),
                trainer::read_entity_basis_and_pos(b, rvas),
            )
        {
            let dx = pa[0] - pb[0];
            let dy = pa[1] - pb[1];
            let dz = pa[2] - pb[2];
            let dist = (dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz).sqrt();
            if dist > 6.0 && dist < 120.0 {
                let pull = ((dist - 6.0) * 1.4).min(28.0);
                set_entity_velocity_native(
                    base,
                    rvas,
                    b,
                    [(dx / dist) * pull, (dy / dist) * pull, ((dz / dist) * pull + 1.2).clamp(-10.0, 18.0)],
                );
            }
        }
    }

    // 18. Spooner Ped Task Sequence Runner (cycles multi-step AI tasks every ~5 seconds!)
    if (ex & LOOP_EX_SPOONER_TASK_SEQ) != 0 && tick % 180 == 0 {
        let mode = SPOONER_TASK_SEQ_MODE.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
        let phase = ((tick / 180) % 3) as u8;
        let wep = DEFAULT_PED_WEAPON_HASH.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
        match (mode, phase) {
            (1, 0) => spooner_task_selected_ped(base, rvas, 1, wep),
            (1, 1) => spooner_task_selected_ped(base, rvas, 5, wep),
            (1, _) => spooner_task_selected_ped(base, rvas, 3, wep),
            (2, _) => spooner_task_selected_ped(base, rvas, 1, wep),
            (3, _) => spooner_task_selected_ped(base, rvas, 6, wep),
            (4, 0) => spooner_task_selected_ped(base, rvas, 5, wep),
            (4, _) => spooner_task_selected_ped(base, rvas, 3, wep),
            _ => {}
        }
    }

    // 19. No Open-Carry Civilian Panic (keeps brandish flag cleared every 15 ticks!)
    if (ex & LOOP_EX_NO_OPEN_CARRY_PANIC) != 0 && tick % 15 == 0
        && let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas)
    {
        set_ped_config_flag(base, rvas, ped, 29, false); // HasBrandishedWeapon
        set_ped_config_flag(base, rvas, ped, 94, true); // PreventThreatResponseReactingAggressively
    }

    // 20. True 6-Star Wanted Scale Lock (maintains uncapped 6-star wanted level every tick until lowered/wiped!)
    if (ex & LOOP_EX_SIX_STAR_LOCK) != 0 {
        if rvas.max_wanted_level != 0 {
            let _ = trainer::safe_write::<u32>((base + rvas.max_wanted_level) as usize, 6);
        }
        if rvas.fn_get_wanted_comp_ex != 0
            && rvas.wanted_level_off != 0
            && let Some(ped) = read_local_ped(base, rvas)
            && let Some(ent_id) = trainer::safe_read::<u32>((ped + rvas.ped_entity_id) as usize)
        {
            let get_wc: extern "system" fn(u32) -> u64 =
                unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_get_wanted_comp_ex) as usize) };
            let wc = get_wc(ent_id);
            if wc > 0x10000 {
                DIAG_WANTED_COMP.store(wc, Ordering::Relaxed);
                let _ = trainer::safe_write::<i32>((wc + rvas.wanted_level_off) as usize, 6);
            }
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    static ORIG_HITS: AtomicU32 = AtomicU32::new(0);
    static CB_HITS: AtomicU32 = AtomicU32::new(0);

    extern "system" fn dummy_orig() {
        ORIG_HITS.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }

    extern "system" fn dummy_cb() {
        CB_HITS.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }

    /// Real x64 execution test: synthesizes an authentic `CALL rel32` caller in executable
    /// memory, patches it with our 5-byte call-site hook, proves BOTH `dummy_orig` and
    /// `dummy_cb` fire cleanly with valid stack alignment, then restores the exact original bytes!
    #[test]
    fn five_byte_callsite_hook_executes_and_restores_cleanly() {
        ORIG_HITS.store(0, Ordering::Relaxed);
        CB_HITS.store(0, Ordering::Relaxed);

        let page = unsafe {
            VirtualAlloc(
                std::ptr::null(),
                4096,
                MEM_COMMIT | MEM_RESERVE,
                PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE,
            ) as *mut u8
        };
        assert!(!page.is_null());

        let callsite = page as usize + 4;
        let orig_target = page as usize + 0x14;
        let orig_rel32 = (orig_target as isize - (callsite + 5) as isize) as i32;
        assert_eq!(orig_rel32, 0x0B);

        let mut buf = [0x90u8; 0x30];
        buf[0..4].copy_from_slice(&[0x48, 0x83, 0xEC, 0x28]);
        buf[4] = 0xE8;
        buf[5..9].copy_from_slice(&orig_rel32.to_le_bytes());
        buf[9..13].copy_from_slice(&[0x48, 0x83, 0xC4, 0x28]);
        buf[13] = 0xC3;
        buf[0x14..0x16].copy_from_slice(&[0x48, 0xB8]);
        buf[0x16..0x1E].copy_from_slice(&(dummy_orig as *const () as u64).to_le_bytes());
        buf[0x1E..0x20].copy_from_slice(&[0xFF, 0xE0]); // jmp rax

        unsafe {
            std::ptr::copy_nonoverlapping(buf.as_ptr(), page, buf.len());
            let _ = FlushInstructionCache(GetCurrentProcess(), page.cast(), buf.len());
        }

        let caller: extern "system" fn() = unsafe { std::mem::transmute(page) };

        caller();
        assert_eq!(ORIG_HITS.load(Ordering::Relaxed), 1);
        assert_eq!(CB_HITS.load(Ordering::Relaxed), 0);

        let mut slot = None;
        install_raw_callsite(
            callsite,
            orig_rel32,
            orig_target,
            0,
            RvaTable::default(),
            dummy_cb as *const () as usize,
            &mut slot,
        )
        .expect("install_raw_callsite");
        let h = slot.expect("active hook");

        caller();
        assert_eq!(ORIG_HITS.load(Ordering::Relaxed), 2);
        assert_eq!(CB_HITS.load(Ordering::Relaxed), 1);

        unsafe {
            std::ptr::write_unaligned((h.callsite + 1) as *mut i32, h.orig_rel32);
            let _ = FlushInstructionCache(GetCurrentProcess(), h.callsite as *const _, 5);
        }
        caller();
        assert_eq!(ORIG_HITS.load(Ordering::Relaxed), 3);
        assert_eq!(CB_HITS.load(Ordering::Relaxed), 1);

        unsafe {
            let _ = VirtualFree(h.stub_mem.cast(), 0, MEM_RELEASE);
            let _ = VirtualFree(page.cast(), 0, MEM_RELEASE);
        }
    }
}

`src/host_bridge.rs`:

```rs
//! Generic DX12 host bridge for FPS/frametime telemetry and mouse-look state.
//!
//! Host DX12 applications or overlay injectors push live frame telemetry once per frame
//! via [`update_perf`] and read or mirror cursor-lock state via [`set_mouse_look_active`].

use std::sync::Mutex;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering};

/// Snapshot of live host render telemetry displayed in the top-right HUD and Tools submenu.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default)]
pub struct HostPerfSnapshot {
    pub fps: f32,
    pub frame_ms: f32,
    pub gpu_ms: f32,
    pub draws: u32,
    pub card_busy_pct: f32,
    pub vram_used_mb: u32,
    pub vram_budget_mb: u32,
    pub ram_ws_mb: u32,
    pub tex_uploaded_mb: u32,
}

static PERF: Mutex<HostPerfSnapshot> = Mutex::new(HostPerfSnapshot {
    fps: 60.0,
    frame_ms: 16.67,
    gpu_ms: 9.8,
    draws: 0,
    card_busy_pct: 62.0,
    vram_used_mb: 0,
    vram_budget_mb: 0,
    ram_ws_mb: 0,
    tex_uploaded_mb: 0,
});

static MOUSE_LOOK: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);

/// Updates live host frame telemetry consumed by the Menyoo HUD and Engine Tools page.
pub fn update_perf(snapshot: HostPerfSnapshot) {
    if let Ok(mut g) = PERF.lock() {
        *g = snapshot;
    }
}

/// Reads the most recent host frame telemetry snapshot.
pub fn latest_perf() -> HostPerfSnapshot {
    PERF.lock().map(|g| *g).unwrap_or_default()
}

/// Updates the host cursor-locked mouse-look indicator.
pub fn set_mouse_look_active(active: bool) {
    MOUSE_LOOK.store(active, Ordering::Relaxed);
}

/// Returns whether host cursor-locked mouse-look is currently active.
pub fn mouse_look_indicator() -> bool {
    MOUSE_LOOK.load(Ordering::Relaxed)
}
```

```rs
//! Menyoo DX12 — Universal DirectX 12 Overlay (integrated into DX12 Host).
//!
//! Opt-in behind `MENYOO_DX12=1` (default OFF so automated A/B benchmarks
//! remain 100% untouched). Provides:
//! - Pixel-faithful Menyoo DX12 UI (`Menu.cpp` geometry, gradients, rank-globe
//!   ON/OFF orbs, Pricedown outlined titlebox, animated `MP_MENU_GLARE`,
//!   `"REVAMPED FOR DirectX 12"` ribbon, 16 themes, colour swatch previews,
//!   bottom-left overlay feed toasts, and bottom-right instructional buttons).
//! - Authentic polyphonic frontend audio (`FocusIn`, `NAV_UP_DOWN`,
//!   `NAV_LEFT_RIGHT`, `SELECT`, `BACK`, `Text_Arrive_Tone`, `ERROR`) + drop-in
//!   custom `menyooStuff/Sounds/*.wav` support.

//!   Controller (`RB + D-Pad Left`, D-Pad, A, B) controls with exact 630 ms
//!   `MenuPressTimer` hold-repeat and real `Menu::DisableControls()` suppression.
//! - Live DirectX 12 / DX12 Host engine hooks (`ambient.rs` real-time GI/SSAO/tint,
//!   Vision Hax filters, FPS cap, PerfMon toggle, shader+RT capture, live PC
//!   KB+M sensitivity/deadzone/invert, auto-sprint, auto-drive, rapid-fire,

pub(crate) fn push_mouse_wheel(delta: i32) {
    PENDING_WHEEL.fetch_add(delta, Ordering::Relaxed);

/// Opt-in gate: `MENYOO_DX12=1` (default OFF).
pub fn enabled() -> bool {
    if PREVIEW_FORCED.load(Ordering::Relaxed) {
        return true;
    }
    static ON: OnceLock<bool> = OnceLock::new();
    *ON.get_or_init(|| {
        std::env::var("MENYOO_DX12")
            .ok()
            .is_some_and(|v| {
                let t = v.trim();
                t == "1" || t.eq_ignore_ascii_case("true") || t.eq_ignore_ascii_case("yes")
            })
    })
}

pub(crate) fn force_enable_for_preview() {
    PREVIEW_FORCED.store(true, Ordering::Release);
    let mut rt = runtime().lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    rt.state.open_menu();
}

/// Exact Menyoo `MenuPressTimer` (`Menu.cpp` lines 54-113):
/// 630 ms initial hold delay before rapid scroll repeats every 55 ms.
#[derive(Default)]
struct PressTimer {
    prev_open: bool,
    prev_up: bool,
    prev_down: bool,
    prev_left: bool,
    prev_right: bool,
    prev_select: bool,
    prev_back: bool,
    held_dir: u8, // 0=none, 1=up, 2=down, 3=left, 4=right
    hold_started: Option<Instant>,
    last_repeat: Option<Instant>,
}

impl PressTimer {
    const INITIAL_DELAY: Duration = Duration::from_millis(630);
    const REPEAT_INTERVAL: Duration = Duration::from_millis(55);

    fn step(
        &mut self,
        open: bool,
        up: bool,
        down: bool,
        left: bool,
        right: bool,
        select: bool,
        back: bool,
        via_controller: bool,
        state: &mut MenyooState,
    ) {
        let now = Instant::now();

        if open && !self.prev_open {
            state.toggle_open(via_controller);
        }
        self.prev_open = open;

        if !state.is_open {
            self.prev_up = up;
            self.prev_down = down;
            self.prev_left = left;
            self.prev_right = right;
            self.prev_select = select;
            self.prev_back = back;
            self.held_dir = 0;
            self.hold_started = None;
            return;
        }

        // Edge taps
        if up && !self.prev_up {
            state.nav_up(via_controller);
            self.held_dir = 1;
            self.hold_started = Some(now);
            self.last_repeat = Some(now);
        } else if down && !self.prev_down {
            state.nav_down(via_controller);
            self.held_dir = 2;
            self.hold_started = Some(now);
            self.last_repeat = Some(now);
        } else if left && !self.prev_left {
            state.nav_left_right(-1, via_controller);
            self.held_dir = 3;
            self.hold_started = Some(now);
            self.last_repeat = Some(now);
        } else if right && !self.prev_right {
            state.nav_left_right(1, via_controller);
            self.held_dir = 4;
            self.hold_started = Some(now);
            self.last_repeat = Some(now);
        }

        // Hold repeat after 630 ms
        let still_held = match self.held_dir {
            1 => up,
            2 => down,
            3 => left,
            4 => right,
            _ => false,
        };
        if !still_held {
            self.held_dir = 0;
            self.hold_started = None;
        } else if let (Some(started), Some(last)) = (self.hold_started, self.last_repeat)
            && now.duration_since(started) >= Self::INITIAL_DELAY
            && now.duration_since(last) >= Self::REPEAT_INTERVAL
        {
            self.last_repeat = Some(now);
            match self.held_dir {
                1 => state.nav_up(via_controller),
                2 => state.nav_down(via_controller),
                3 => state.nav_left_right(-1, via_controller),
                4 => state.nav_left_right(1, via_controller),
                _ => {}
            }
        }

        if select && !self.prev_select {
            state.nav_select(via_controller);
        }
        if back && !self.prev_back {
            state.nav_back(via_controller);
        }

        self.prev_up = up;
        self.prev_down = down;
        self.prev_left = left;
        self.prev_right = right;
        self.prev_select = select;
        self.prev_back = back;
    }
}

struct Runtime {
    state: MenyooState,
    renderer: MenyooRenderer,
    timer: PressTimer,
    last_render: Instant,
}

static RUNTIME: OnceLock<Mutex<Runtime>> = OnceLock::new();

fn runtime() -> &'static Mutex<Runtime> {
    RUNTIME.get_or_init(|| {
        Mutex::new(Runtime {
            state: MenyooState::new(),
            renderer: MenyooRenderer::new(),
            timer: PressTimer::default(),
            last_render: Instant::now() - Duration::from_secs(1),
        })
    })
}

#[inline]
fn key_down(vk: i32) -> bool {
    // SAFETY: plain Win32 async key state query.
    unsafe { GetAsyncKeyState(vk) < 0 }
}

/// Starts a lightweight 120 Hz keyboard poller so Menyoo responds instantaneously
/// even if DirectX 12 is currently loading or running at low FPS.
fn ensure_input_thread() {
    static STARTED: std::sync::Once = std::sync::Once::new();
    STARTED.call_once(|| {
        let _ = std::thread::Builder::new()
            .name("menyoo-dx12-input".into())
            .spawn(|| {
                loop {
                    poll_keyboard_now();
                    std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(8));
                }
            });
    });
}

/// Polls keyboard & mouse controls when our window is focused.
fn poll_keyboard_now() {
    if !enabled() {
        return;
    }
    let hwnd = unsafe { GetForegroundWindow() };
    let mut pid = 0u32;
    unsafe { GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd, Some(&mut pid)) };
    if pid != std::process::id() {
        return;
    }
    let open_vk = BRIDGE.open_vk.load(Ordering::Relaxed) as i32;
    let ctrl = key_down(0x11); // VK_CONTROL
    let open_raw = key_down(open_vk);

    // Hot-reload `menyooConfig.ini`, `rvas.json`, `Favourites.ini`, and `Sounds/*.wav` on Ctrl + OpenKey!
    static PREV_RELOAD: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);
    let reload_chord = ctrl && open_raw;
    let trigger_reload = reload_chord && !PREV_RELOAD.swap(reload_chord, Ordering::Relaxed);

    let open = open_raw && !ctrl;
    let up = key_down(0x26) || key_down(0x68); // Up Arrow / Numpad 8
    let down = key_down(0x28) || key_down(0x62); // Down Arrow / Numpad 2
    let left = key_down(0x25) || key_down(0x64); // Left Arrow / Numpad 4
    let right = key_down(0x27) || key_down(0x66); // Right Arrow / Numpad 6
    let select = key_down(0x0D) || key_down(0x65); // Enter / Numpad 5
    let back = key_down(0x08) || key_down(0x60); // Backspace / Numpad 0

    let mut rt = runtime().lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    if trigger_reload {
        rt.state.hot_reload_all();
        rt.renderer.clear_preview_cache();
    }

    // 1. If an in-menu keyboard text prompt is open, capture typing cleanly!
    if rt.state.text_prompt.is_some() {
        static PREV_KEYS: Mutex<[bool; 256]> = Mutex::new([false; 256]);
        let mut prev = PREV_KEYS.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
        let edge = |vk: usize, p: &mut [bool; 256]| -> bool {
            let down = key_down(vk as i32);
            let fired = down && !p[vk];
            p[vk] = down;
            fired
        };
        let shift = key_down(0x10);
        if edge(0x1B, &mut prev) {
            rt.state.handle_text_input(None, false, false, true);
        } else if edge(0x0D, &mut prev) {
            rt.state.handle_text_input(None, false, true, false);
        } else if edge(0x08, &mut prev) {
            rt.state.handle_text_input(None, true, false, false);
        } else {
            // A-Z
            for vk in 0x41usize..=0x5A {
                if edge(vk, &mut prev) {
                    let c = if shift { vk as u8 as char } else { (vk as u8 + 32) as char };
                    rt.state.handle_text_input(Some(c), false, false, false);
                }
            }
            // 0-9 top row & numpad
            for vk in 0x30usize..=0x39 {
                if edge(vk, &mut prev) {
                    rt.state.handle_text_input(Some(vk as u8 as char), false, false, false);
                }
            }
            for vk in 0x60usize..=0x69 {
                if edge(vk, &mut prev) {
                    let c = (b'0' + (vk - 0x60) as u8) as char;
                    rt.state.handle_text_input(Some(c), false, false, false);
                }
            }
            // Space, -, ., ,, _
            for (vk, normal, shifted) in [
                (0x20usize, ' ', ' '),
                (0xBDusize, '-', '_'),
                (0xBEusize, '.', '.'),
                (0xBCusize, ',', ','),
                (0x6Dusize, '-', '-'),
                (0x6Eusize, '.', '.'),
            ] {
                if edge(vk, &mut prev) {
                    rt.state
                        .handle_text_input(Some(if shift { shifted } else { normal }), false, false, false);
                }
            }
        }
        return;
    }

    // 2. Quick Hotkeys when menu is closed (`Alt+H/B/V/T`, toggleable in Settings).
    let alt = key_down(0x12);
    if alt && !rt.state.is_open && rt.state.cfg.quick_hotkeys {
        static PREV_QUICK: Mutex<[bool; 4]> = Mutex::new([false; 4]);
        let mut pq = PREV_QUICK.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
        for (i, vk) in [(0usize, 0x48), (1, 0x42), (2, 0x56), (3, 0x54)] {
            let down = key_down(vk);
            if down && !pq[i] {
                rt.state.run_quick_hotkey(i as u8);
            }
            pq[i] = down;
        }
    }

    let Runtime { state, timer, .. } = &mut *rt;
    timer.step(open, up, down, left, right, select, back, false, state);

    // Classic Menyoo Mouse Support (`Menu::bit_mouse`) while menu is open.
    if state.is_open && state.cfg.mouse_support {
        static PREV_LMB: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);
        static PREV_RMB: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);
        let lmb = key_down(0x01);
        let rmb = key_down(0x02);
        let left_click = lmb && !PREV_LMB.swap(lmb, Ordering::Relaxed);
        let right_click = rmb && !PREV_RMB.swap(rmb, Ordering::Relaxed);
        let wheel = PENDING_WHEEL.swap(0, Ordering::Relaxed);

        let mut pt = POINT::default();
        let mut rc = RECT::default();
        // SAFETY: querying cursor + client rect of our own foreground window.
        let ok = unsafe {
            GetCursorPos(&mut pt).is_ok()
                && ScreenToClient(hwnd, &mut pt).as_bool()
                && GetClientRect(hwnd, &mut rc).is_ok()
        };
        let cw = (rc.right - rc.left).max(1);
        let ch = (rc.bottom - rc.top).max(1);
        if ok && pt.x >= 0 && pt.y >= 0 && pt.x < cw && pt.y < ch {
            let cx = ((pt.x as f32 / cw as f32) * CANVAS_W as f32) as i32;
            let cy = ((pt.y as f32 / ch as f32) * CANVAS_H as f32) as i32;
            state.handle_mouse(cx, cy, left_click, right_click, wheel);
        } else if wheel != 0 || right_click {
            state.handle_mouse(-1, -1, false, right_click, wheel);
        }
    } else {
        PENDING_WHEEL.store(0, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Public hooks called by `host-input` (`gameinput.rs`, `pc_kbm.rs`) & `run.rs`
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

pub(crate) fn with_state_mut<R>(f: impl FnOnce(&mut MenyooState) -> R) -> R {
    let mut rt = runtime().lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    f(&mut rt.state)
}

/// Records the mapped title PE base address for Menyoo's Engine Inspector &
/// optionally installs the self-validating 5-byte main-thread cheat dispatcher
/// when `MENYOO_DX12_LIVE_HOOKS=1`.
pub fn set_title_image_base(base: usize) {
    BRIDGE.title_image_base.store(base as u64, Ordering::Relaxed);
    if enabled() && base != 0 {
        let stuff_dir = config::resolve_stuff_dir();
        let rvas = trainer::RvaTable::load(&stuff_dir);
        let _hook_res = if hook::auto_install_env() {
            let res = hook::install(base as u64, &rvas);
            match res {
                Ok(()) => tracing::info!(
                    base = format_args!("{base:#x}"),
                    callsite = format_args!("{:#x}", rvas.main_tick_callsite),
                    "Menyoo 5-byte main-thread cheat dispatcher installed"
                ),
                Err(e) => tracing::warn!(reason = e, "Menyoo main-thread cheat hook not installed"),
            }
            res
        } else {
            Err("MENYOO_DX12_LIVE_HOOKS not enabled")
        };
    }
}

/// Feeds real Gamepad controller button bitmask (from `gameinput.rs`) into Menyoo!
/// Exact classic Menyoo combo: `RB (0x800) + D-Pad Left (0x100)` toggles open/close.
/// Returns `true` if Menyoo is currently open and the caller should suppress menu buttons.
pub fn feed_gamepad_buttons(buttons: u32, pad_connected: bool) -> bool {
    BRIDGE.pad_connected.store(pad_connected, Ordering::Relaxed);
    BRIDGE.pad_buttons.store(buttons, Ordering::Relaxed);
    if !enabled() {
        return false;
    }
    ensure_input_thread();
    const A: u32 = 0x4;
    const B: u32 = 0x8;
    const UP: u32 = 0x40;
    const DOWN: u32 = 0x80;
    const LEFT: u32 = 0x100;
    const RIGHT: u32 = 0x200;
    const RB: u32 = 0x800;

    let open = (buttons & RB != 0) && (buttons & LEFT != 0);
    let up = buttons & UP != 0;
    let down = buttons & DOWN != 0;
    let left = (buttons & LEFT != 0) && (buttons & RB == 0);
    let right = buttons & RIGHT != 0;
    let select = buttons & A != 0;
    let back = buttons & B != 0;

    static PAD_TIMER: Mutex<PressTimer> = Mutex::new(PressTimer {
        prev_open: false,
        prev_up: false,
        prev_down: false,
        prev_left: false,
        prev_right: false,
        prev_select: false,
        prev_back: false,
        held_dir: 0,
        hold_started: None,
        last_repeat: None,
    });
    if open || BRIDGE.menu_open.load(Ordering::Relaxed) {
        let mut pt = PAD_TIMER.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
        let mut rt = runtime().lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
        pt.step(open, up, down, left, right, select, back, true, &mut rt.state);
    }
    BRIDGE.menu_open.load(Ordering::Relaxed)
}

/// True while Menyoo is open (used by `gameinput.rs` for `Menu::DisableControls()`).
pub fn is_open() -> bool {
    enabled() && BRIDGE.menu_open.load(Ordering::Relaxed)
}

/// Returns whether a Win32 virtual key belongs to Menyoo navigation while open.
pub fn blocks_key(vk: u8) -> bool {
    if !enabled() {
        return false;
    }
    if u32::from(vk) == BRIDGE.open_vk.load(Ordering::Relaxed) {
        return true;
    }
    if !BRIDGE.menu_open.load(Ordering::Relaxed) {
        return false;
    }
    matches!(
        vk,
        0x08 | 0x0D | 0x25 | 0x26 | 0x27 | 0x28 | 0x60 | 0x62 | 0x64 | 0x65 | 0x66 | 0x68
    )
}

/// Live PC KB+M overrides set from Menyoo -> Player Options -> Controls & Camera.
pub fn live_kbm_overrides() -> Option<(f32, f32, bool)> {
    if !enabled() || !BRIDGE.kbm_override.load(Ordering::Acquire) {
        return None;
    }
    Some((
        f32::from_bits(BRIDGE.mouse_sens_bits.load(Ordering::Relaxed)),
        f32::from_bits(BRIDGE.mouse_deadzone_bits.load(Ordering::Relaxed)),
        BRIDGE.mouse_invert_y.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
    ))
}

}

pub fn live_input_assists() -> (bool, bool, bool, u32) {
    if !enabled() {
        return (false, false, false, 12);
    }
    (
        BRIDGE.auto_sprint.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
        BRIDGE.auto_drive.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
        BRIDGE.rapid_fire.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
        BRIDGE.rapid_fire_hz.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
    )
}

pub fn rumble_disabled() -> bool {
    enabled() && BRIDGE.disable_rumble.load(Ordering::Relaxed)
}

pub fn take_test_rumble_tick() -> bool {
    if !enabled() {
        return false;
    }
    let cur = BRIDGE.test_rumble_ticks.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
    if cur > 0 {
        BRIDGE.test_rumble_ticks.store(cur - 1, Ordering::Relaxed);
        true
    } else {
        false
    }
}

/// Live ambient GI lighting overrides read directly by `ambient.rs` every frame!
/// Returns `(level, [r, g, b], ssao_strength, ssao_radius, hemi)`.
pub fn live_ambient_override() -> Option<(f32, [f32; 3], f32, f32, bool)> {
    if !enabled() || !BRIDGE.ambient_override.load(Ordering::Acquire) {
        return None;
    }
    let level = if BRIDGE.emp_blackout.load(Ordering::Relaxed) {
        0.0
    } else {
        f32::from_bits(BRIDGE.ambient_level_bits.load(Ordering::Relaxed))
    };
    let tint = [
        f32::from_bits(BRIDGE.ambient_r_bits.load(Ordering::Relaxed)),
        f32::from_bits(BRIDGE.ambient_g_bits.load(Ordering::Relaxed)),
        f32::from_bits(BRIDGE.ambient_b_bits.load(Ordering::Relaxed)),
    ];
    let strength = f32::from_bits(BRIDGE.ssao_strength_bits.load(Ordering::Relaxed));
    let radius = f32::from_bits(BRIDGE.ssao_radius_bits.load(Ordering::Relaxed));
    let hemi = BRIDGE.ambient_hemi.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
    Some((level, tint, strength, radius, hemi))
}

pub fn perfmon_override_mode() -> u32 {
    if !enabled() {
        return 0;
    }
    BRIDGE.perfmon_mode.load(Ordering::Relaxed)
}

}

    if !enabled() {
        return 0;

    BRIDGE.fps_cap.load(Ordering::Relaxed)
}

/// True once the user has enabled Game Speed or Bullet Time (zero-overhead check on QPC!).
pub fn timescale_engaged() -> bool {
    enabled() && BRIDGE.timescale_engaged.load(Ordering::Relaxed)
}

/// Live monotonic `QueryPerformanceCounter` multiplier (`0.15..=3.00`, or Bullet Time on aim).
pub fn live_timescale() -> f32 {
    if !enabled() {
        return 1.0;
    }
    if BRIDGE.bullet_time_on_aim.load(Ordering::Relaxed) && BRIDGE.aim_held.load(Ordering::Relaxed) {
        return f32::from_bits(BRIDGE.bullet_time_scale_bits.load(Ordering::Relaxed)).clamp(0.15, 0.75);
    }
    f32::from_bits(BRIDGE.timescale_bits.load(Ordering::Relaxed)).clamp(0.15, 3.0)
}

/// Updated from `host-input/src/modules/gameinput.rs` for live Bullet Time on Aim.
pub fn set_aim_held(held: bool) {
    BRIDGE.aim_held.store(held, Ordering::Relaxed);
}

/// Lock-free Vision Hax / Color Grading parameters for `over::record_postfx`.
/// Returns `None` when stock (zero GPU pass overhead!).
pub fn live_postfx_params() -> Option<PostFxParams> {
    if !enabled() {
        return None;
    }
    let params = PostFxParams {
        mode: BRIDGE.vision_preset.load(Ordering::Relaxed) as u32,
        strength: f32::from_bits(BRIDGE.vision_strength_bits.load(Ordering::Relaxed)),
        exposure: f32::from_bits(BRIDGE.postfx_exposure_bits.load(Ordering::Relaxed)),
        contrast: f32::from_bits(BRIDGE.postfx_contrast_bits.load(Ordering::Relaxed)),
        saturation: f32::from_bits(BRIDGE.postfx_saturation_bits.load(Ordering::Relaxed)),
        time_sec: START_INSTANT
            .get_or_init(Instant::now)
            .elapsed()
            .as_secs_f32(),
        _pad0: 0.0,
        _pad1: 0.0,
    };
    params.is_active().then_some(params)
}

/// True if Menyoo has anything to composite on top of this frame.
/// Uses a single lock-free `AtomicBool` so closed-state overhead is ~0.5 ns (`0.00 ms` GPU!).
pub fn has_overlay_to_draw() -> bool {
    if !enabled() {
        return false;
    }
    ensure_input_thread();
    BRIDGE.overlay_active.load(Ordering::Acquire)
}

/// Called inside `host.rs::present_now()` right before `Present()` while `back` is
/// in `D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET`!
pub fn record_present_overlay(
    device: &ID3D12Device,
    list: &ID3D12GraphicsCommandList,
    back: &ID3D12Resource,
    format: DXGI_FORMAT,
    size: (u32, u32),
) -> bool {
    if !enabled() {
        return false;
    }
    ensure_input_thread();
    BRIDGE.frame_count.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);

    let mut rt = runtime().lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    let now = Instant::now();
    rt.state.tick_animations(now);
    if !rt.state.has_visible_hud() {
        return false;
    }
    // Re-rasterize on dirty flag, throttled to ~30 Hz for continuous glare/clock animations.
    let should_render = rt.state.dirty && now.duration_since(rt.last_render) >= Duration::from_millis(32);
    if should_render {
        rt.state.dirty = false;
        rt.last_render = now;
        let Runtime { state, renderer, .. } = &mut *rt;
        renderer.render(state);
    }
    let dirty_pixels = should_render.then_some(rt.renderer.canvas.pixels.as_slice());
    gpu::record_overlay(device, list, back, format, size, dirty_pixels)
}

/// Cached optional real DirectX 12 3D gameplay backdrop PNG (`frame-3655.png` / `backdrop.png`)
/// so `menyoo-preview` showcases Menyoo + real Vision Hax shaders offline!
fn cached_preview_backdrop(stuff_dir: &std::path::Path) -> Option<&'static [u32]> {
    static BACKDROP: OnceLock<Option<Vec<u32>>> = OnceLock::new();
    BACKDROP
        .get_or_init(|| {
            let p = postfx::find_default_backdrop(stuff_dir)?;
            postfx::load_png_backdrop(&p, CANVAS_W, CANVAS_H)
        })
        .as_deref()
}

/// Renders one composited preview frame over a real DirectX 12 backdrop (if found on disk)
/// with live Vision Hax CPU Post-FX shaders applied, or a neon sunset gradient fallback.
/// Launches the standalone interactive Win32 preview window.
pub fn run_preview_window() {
    gpu::run_interactive_preview();
}

pub(crate) fn render_preview_frame() -> Option<Vec<u32>> {
    poll_keyboard_now();
    let mut rt = runtime().lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    let now = Instant::now();
    rt.state.tick_animations(now);
    let postfx = rt.state.current_postfx();
    let stuff_dir = rt.state.stuff_dir.clone();
    let Runtime { state, renderer, .. } = &mut *rt;
    renderer.render(state);

    let mut out = if let Some(bg) = cached_preview_backdrop(&stuff_dir) {
        bg.to_vec()
    } else {
        let mut grad = vec![0u32; CANVAS_W * CANVAS_H];
        for y in 0..CANVAS_H {
            let vf = y as f32 / CANVAS_H as f32;
            let bg_r = (24.0 + 108.0 * (1.0 - (vf - 0.56).abs() * 1.9).max(0.0)) as u32;
            let bg_g = (18.0 + 44.0 * (1.0 - vf)) as u32;
            let bg_b = (52.0 + 76.0 * (1.0 - vf * 0.65)) as u32;
            let px = 0xFF00_0000 | (bg_r << 16) | (bg_g << 8) | bg_b;
            grad[y * CANVAS_W..(y + 1) * CANVAS_W].fill(px);
        }
        grad
    };

    if postfx.is_active() {
        postfx::apply_cpu_postfx(&mut out, CANVAS_W, CANVAS_H, postfx);
    }

    for i in 0..(CANVAS_W * CANVAS_H) {
        let bg_px = out[i];
        let bg_r = (bg_px >> 16) & 0xFF;
        let bg_g = (bg_px >> 8) & 0xFF;
        let bg_b = bg_px & 0xFF;

        let p = renderer.canvas.pixels[i];
        let sa = (p >> 24) & 0xFF;
        if sa == 0 {
            continue;
        }
        let sr = (p >> 16) & 0xFF;
        let sg = (p >> 8) & 0xFF;
        let sb = p & 0xFF;
        let inv = 255 - sa;
        let r = (sr + (bg_r * inv + 127) / 255).min(255);
        let g = (sg + (bg_g * inv + 127) / 255).min(255);
        let b = (sb + (bg_b * inv + 127) / 255).min(255);
        out[i] = 0xFF00_0000 | (r << 16) | (g << 8) | b;
    }
    Some(out)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn renders_menyoo_main_postfx_banners_and_mouse_cleanly() {
        let mut state = MenyooState::new();
        state.open_menu();
        let mut renderer = MenyooRenderer::new();
        renderer.render(&state);
        let non_zero = renderer.canvas.pixels.iter().filter(|&&p| p != 0).count();
        assert!(non_zero > 50_000, "expected substantial Menyoo UI coverage, got {non_zero}");

        // Verify mouse hit-testing moves selection onto row 4 (Weapon Options) cleanly.
        let menu_x = ((0.06 + state.cfg.menu_pos_x) * CANVAS_W as f32).round() as i32;
        let list_y = ((0.159 + state.cfg.menu_pos_y) * CANVAS_H as f32).round() as i32;
        state.handle_mouse(menu_x + 120, list_y + 4 * 38 + 15, false, false, 0);
        assert_eq!(state.current_op, 4);

        // Verify PostFxParams bypass when stock and active when thermal/graded.
        assert!(!PostFxParams::default().is_active());
        let thermal = PostFxParams {
            mode: 2,
            strength: 0.90,
            ..PostFxParams::default()
        };
        assert!(thermal.is_active());

        // Verify exact native engine 9 32m sector-packed world XYZ pack/unpack round-trip!
        for sample in [
            [1420.4f32, -1840.2, 12.5],
            [-3150.75, 3920.25, 310.0],
            [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
            [-15.25, -31.9, -4.5],
        ] {
            let packed = trainer::pack_sector_pos(sample);
            let unpacked = trainer::unpack_sector_pos(packed);
            assert!((unpacked[0] - sample[0]).abs() < 1e-3, "X mismatch: {unpacked:?} vs {sample:?}");
            assert!((unpacked[1] - sample[1]).abs() < 1e-3, "Y mismatch: {unpacked:?} vs {sample:?}");
            assert!((unpacked[2] - sample[2]).abs() < 1e-3, "Z mismatch: {unpacked:?} vs {sample:?}");
        }

        // Verify cleanroom RVA JSON loader (Schema v4) against an ephemeral temp file.
        let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().expect("tempdir");
        std::fs::write(
            tmp.path().join("rvas.json"),
            r#"{ "schema_version": 4,
                 "globals": { "local_player_ped": "0x1234", "weather_struct": "0x5678",
                              "model_info_buckets": "0x9000", "ped_density_mult_1": "0xA000" },
                 "functions": { "set_entity_damage_proof": "0xB000", "commit_veh_color": "0xC000" },
                 "builtin_cheat_vehicles": [{ "name": "TestCar", "hash64": "0xAABBCCDD11223344" }] }"#,
        )
        .expect("write rvas");
        let tbl = trainer::RvaTable::load(tmp.path());
        assert!(tbl.loaded);
        assert_eq!(tbl.local_player_ped, 0x1234);
        assert_eq!(tbl.weather_struct, 0x5678);
        assert_eq!(tbl.model_info_buckets, 0x9000);
        assert_eq!(tbl.ped_density_mult_1, 0xA000);
        assert_eq!(tbl.fn_set_entity_damage_proof, 0xB000);
        assert_eq!(tbl.fn_commit_veh_color, 0xC000);
        assert_eq!(tbl.builtin_vehicles.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(tbl.builtin_vehicles[0].hash64, 0xAABB_CCDD_1122_3344);

        // Verify Rainbow HSV -> normalized RGB conversion for live vehicle paint.
        let red = trainer::hsv_to_rgb_f32(0.0, 1.0, 1.0);
        let green = trainer::hsv_to_rgb_f32(120.0, 1.0, 1.0);
        let cyan = trainer::hsv_to_rgb_f32(180.0, 1.0, 1.0);
        assert!((red[0] - 1.0).abs() < 1e-4 && red[1].abs() < 1e-4 && red[2].abs() < 1e-4);
        assert!(green[0].abs() < 1e-4 && (green[1] - 1.0).abs() < 1e-4 && green[2].abs() < 1e-4);
        assert!(cyan[0].abs() < 1e-4 && (cyan[1] - 1.0).abs() < 1e-4 && (cyan[2] - 1.0).abs() < 1e-4);

        // Verify Favourites.ini round-trip persistence.
        let favs = vec![menu::SavedCoord {
            name: "Harbor Pier".into(),
            coords: [12.5, -34.0, 9.25],
        }];
        trainer::save_favourites(tmp.path(), &favs).expect("save favs");
        let loaded = trainer::load_favourites(tmp.path());
        assert_eq!(loaded.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(loaded[0].name, "Harbor Pier");

        // Verify custom theme save/list/load & text prompt coordinate parsing.
        trainer::save_custom_theme(tmp.path(), "Neon Gold", &state.cfg).expect("save custom theme");
        let listed = trainer::list_custom_themes(tmp.path());
        assert_eq!(listed, vec!["Neon Gold".to_owned()]);
        let mut cfg_copy = config::MenyooConfig::default();
        assert!(trainer::load_custom_theme(tmp.path(), "Neon Gold", &mut cfg_copy));

        state.open_text_prompt(menu::TextPromptKind::CustomCoords);
        if let Some(p) = state.text_prompt.as_mut() {
            p.buffer = "420.5, -910.0, 33.2".into();
        }
        state.handle_text_input(None, false, true, false);
        assert!((state.custom_coords[0] - 420.5).abs() < 0.01);
        assert!((state.custom_coords[1] + 910.0).abs() < 0.01);

        // Verify Schema v5 RVA JSON loader, ExplosionArgs 16-byte layout, and all 10 live features!
        std::fs::write(
            tmp.path().join("rvas.json"),
            r#"{ "schema_version": 5,
                 "globals": {
                   "object_pool": "0x1111", "waypoint_active": "0x2222", "waypoint_pos": "0x2230",
                   "gps_waypoint_active": "0x3333", "gps_waypoint_pos": "0x3340",
                   "item_info_table": "0x4444", "weapon_info_table": "0x5555", "item_info_base": "0x6666"
                 },
                 "offsets": { "ped_damage_mult_off": "0xcb8", "ped_config_flags_override": "0x9c" },
                 "functions": {
                   "set_entity_alpha": "0x7000", "reset_entity_alpha": "0x7010",
                   "get_ped_config_flags_comp": "0x7020", "get_ped_damage_comp": "0x7030",
                   "get_net_player": "0x7040", "set_police_ignore_player": "0x7050",
                   "set_everyone_ignore_player": "0x7060", "create_object": "0x7070",
                   "object_params_init": "0x7072", "create_object_direct": "0x7074",
                   "destroy_entity": "0x7080", "request_model_by_id": "0x7090",
                   "has_model_loaded": "0x70a0", "add_explosion": "0x70b0",
                   "expl_substruct_ctor": "0x70c0", "give_weapon_to_ped": "0x70d0",
                   "give_weapon_inner": "0x70d4",
                   "equip_ped_weapon": "0x70e0", "set_weapon_infinite_ammo": "0x70f0",
                   "set_weapon_ammo_in_clip": "0x7100", "refill_weapon_clip": "0x7110"
                 } }"#,
        )
        .expect("write v5 rvas");
        let v5 = trainer::RvaTable::load(tmp.path());
        assert!(v5.loaded);
        assert_eq!(v5.object_pool, 0x1111);
        assert_eq!(v5.waypoint_active, 0x2222);
        assert_eq!(v5.weapon_info_table, 0x5555);
        assert_eq!(v5.fn_give_weapon_to_ped, 0x70d0);
        assert_eq!(v5.fn_give_weapon_inner, 0x70d4);
        assert_eq!(v5.fn_object_params_init, 0x7072);
        assert_eq!(v5.fn_create_object_direct, 0x7074);
        assert_eq!(v5.fn_set_weapon_infinite_ammo, 0x70f0);
        assert_eq!(v5.fn_add_explosion, 0x70b0);
        assert_eq!(v5.fn_create_object, 0x7070);
        assert_eq!(v5.fn_get_ped_damage_comp, 0x7030);
        assert_eq!(v5.ped_damage_mult_off, 0xcb8);
        assert!(v5.populated_count() >= 27);

        // Verify 16-byte-aligned CExplosionArgs & CObjectCreationParams invariants
        assert_eq!(size_of::<trainer::ExplosionArgs>(), 0x160);
        assert_eq!(align_of::<trainer::ExplosionArgs>(), 16);
        assert_eq!(size_of::<trainer::ObjectCreationParams>(), 0x100);
        assert_eq!(align_of::<trainer::ObjectCreationParams>(), 16);
        assert_eq!(align_of::<trainer::Vec4A>(), 16);
        let expl = trainer::build_explosion_args(4, [10.0, -20.0, 5.5], 0, &v5);
        assert_eq!(i32::from_le_bytes(expl.raw[0..4].try_into().unwrap()), 4);
        assert!((f32::from_le_bytes(expl.raw[0x10..0x14].try_into().unwrap()) - 10.0).abs() < 1e-4);
        assert!((f32::from_le_bytes(expl.raw[0x18..0x1c].try_into().unwrap()) - 5.5).abs() < 1e-4);
        assert_eq!(u64::from_le_bytes(expl.raw[0x50..0x58].try_into().unwrap()), 0x1_0000_0000);
        assert_eq!(u32::from_le_bytes(expl.raw[0xa8..0xac].try_into().unwrap()), 0xFFFC_FFFF);
        assert_eq!(u32::from_le_bytes(expl.raw[0xc4..0xc8].try_into().unwrap()), 8);
        assert_eq!(expl.raw[0x128], 0xFF);
        assert_eq!(u32::from_le_bytes(expl.raw[0x13c..0x140].try_into().unwrap()), 0xFFFF_FFFF);

        // Verify all 10 newly wired features are marked LIVE (`is_live == true`) in the menu tree!
        let check_live = |s: &mut MenyooState, sub: menu::SubmenuId, label: &str| {
            s.current_sub = sub;
            let items = s.build_items();
            let found = items.iter().find(|it| it.label == label);
            assert!(
                found.is_some_and(|it| it.is_live),
                "expected '{label}' in {sub:?} to be LIVE (is_live == true)"
            );
        };
        check_live(&mut state, menu::SubmenuId::MainMenu, "Object Spooner");
        check_live(&mut state, menu::SubmenuId::PlayerOptions, "Invisibility");
        check_live(&mut state, menu::SubmenuId::PlayerOptions, "Seatbelt");
        check_live(&mut state, menu::SubmenuId::PlayerOptions, "Ignored By Everyone");
        check_live(&mut state, menu::SubmenuId::VehicleOptions, "Seatbelt");
        check_live(&mut state, menu::SubmenuId::TeleportOptions, "Waypoint");
        check_live(&mut state, menu::SubmenuId::WeaponOptions, "Give All Weapons");
        check_live(&mut state, menu::SubmenuId::WeaponOptions, "Infinite Ammo");
        check_live(&mut state, menu::SubmenuId::WeaponOptions, "No Reload");
        check_live(&mut state, menu::SubmenuId::WeaponOptions, "One-Hit Kill");
        check_live(&mut state, menu::SubmenuId::WeaponOptions, "Damage Multiplier");
        check_live(&mut state, menu::SubmenuId::ObjectSpooner, "Spooner Mode");
        check_live(&mut state, menu::SubmenuId::MiscOptions, "Meteor Shower Mode");

        // Verify new loop bitmask propagation via sync_hook_loops()
        state.player_invisible = true;
        state.player_seatbelt = true;
        state.player_ignored = true;
        state.wep_inf_ammo = true;
        state.wep_no_reload = true;
        state.wep_one_hit = true;
        state.meteor_shower = true;
        state.spooner_mode = true;
        state.sync_hook_loops();
        let m = hook::active_loop_mask();
        assert_ne!(m & hook::LOOP_INVISIBLE, 0);
        assert_ne!(m & hook::LOOP_SEATBELT, 0);
        assert_ne!(m & hook::LOOP_IGNORED_BY_ALL, 0);
        assert_ne!(m & hook::LOOP_INF_AMMO, 0);
        assert_ne!(m & hook::LOOP_NO_RELOAD, 0);
        assert_ne!(m & hook::LOOP_ONE_HIT_KILL, 0);
        assert_ne!(m & hook::LOOP_METEOR_SHOWER, 0);
        assert_ne!(m & hook::LOOP_SPOONER_MODE, 0);
        // Also verify Spooner HUD renders cleanly without panics when Spooner Mode is active
        renderer.render(&state);
        state.spooner_mode = false;
        state.sync_hook_loops();

        // Optional visual verification dump over real DirectX 12 `frame-3655.png` when `MENYOO_DUMP_DIR` is set!
        if let Ok(dir) = std::env::var("MENYOO_DUMP_DIR") {
            let dir = std::path::PathBuf::from(dir);
            let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir);
            let bg = postfx::find_default_backdrop(&state.stuff_dir)
                .and_then(|p| postfx::load_png_backdrop(&p, CANVAS_W, CANVAS_H));

            // 1. Pure 1:1 MAFINS Menyoo Classic Cyan Main Menu over real DirectX 12 3D frame!
            state.cfg = config::MenyooConfig::default();
            state.current_sub = menu::SubmenuId::MainMenu;
            state.current_op = 0;
            renderer.render(&state);
            let _ = render::write_preview_bmp_over(
                &renderer.canvas,
                bg.as_deref(),
                PostFxParams::default(),
                &dir.join("menyoo_1to1_main.bmp"),
            );

            // 2. Classic Armory shop banner + rankglobe_21x21_colour green/red toggles!
            state.current_sub = menu::SubmenuId::WeaponOptions;
            state.rapid_fire = true;
            state.wep_inf_ammo = true;
            state.current_op = 1;
            renderer.render(&state);
            let _ = render::write_preview_bmp_over(
                &renderer.canvas,
                bg.as_deref(),
                PostFxParams::default(),
                &dir.join("menyoo_1to1_weapons.bmp"),
            );

            // 3. Studio Presets submenu + Golden Hour 2.39:1 + Breaking News Live Feed ticker + Delay Badge!
            state.current_sub = menu::SubmenuId::StudioPresets;
            state.current_op = 1;
            state.ankle_monitor_mode = false;
            state.cfg.uptime_badge = true;
            state.cfg.cinematic_bars = true;
            state.toasts.clear();
            state.push_toast(
                "Live Feed",
                "LIVE",
                "BREAKING: Modders ported Menyoo to DirectX 12 before target engine announced PC.",
                Duration::from_secs(8),
                false,
            );
            renderer.render(&state);
            let _ = render::write_preview_bmp_over(
                &renderer.canvas,
                bg.as_deref(),
                PostFxParams { mode: 4, strength: 0.80, ..PostFxParams::default() },
                &dir.join("menyoo_1to1_quirks_trailer1.bmp"),
            );

            // 4. Vehicle Spawner with Metro Garage shop banner + scrolling footer arrows!
            state.cfg.uptime_badge = false;
            state.cfg.cinematic_bars = false;
            state.toasts.clear();
            state.current_sub = menu::SubmenuId::VehicleSpawner;
            state.current_op = 0;
            renderer.render(&state);
            let _ = render::write_preview_bmp_over(
                &renderer.canvas,
                bg.as_deref(),
                PostFxParams::default(),
                &dir.join("menyoo_1to1_vehicles.bmp"),
            );
        }
    }
}
```

`src/menu.rs`:

```rs
//! Complete Menyoo DX12 — Native DirectX 12 Overlay for GTA menu tree, submenu stack,
//! rainbow fader, bottom-left feed notifications, and live Host runtime bridge.
//!
//! Menu layout, navigation rules (`GTA_MAXOP = 14`, `GTA_SCROLLOP = 8`,
//! `GTA_BETOP = 6`, `LOOCsub`, auto-skip breaks, wrap-around scrolling), and
//! option taxonomy follow MAFINS's original MenyooSP (GPL-3.0).

use std::path::PathBuf;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, AtomicU32, AtomicU64, AtomicUsize, Ordering};
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

use super::config::{MenuFont, MenyooConfig, OPEN_KEYS, PRESET_COLOURS, Rgba, THEMES, resolve_stuff_dir};
use super::hook::{self, MainThreadCmd};
use super::postfx::PostFxParams;
use super::previews::{
    PreviewKind, PreviewSpec, slugify, vehicle_category_slug, weapon_category_slug,
    weather_category_slug,
};
use super::sound::{self, MenuSound};
use super::trainer::{
    self, CheatVehicleEntry, MemScanner, PedCatalogEntry, PropCatalogEntry, RvaTable, ScanFilter,
    ScanType, WEAPON_CATEGORIES, WeaponAttachmentEntry, WeaponCatalogEntry, WeatherCatalogEntry,
    WorldTelemetry,
};

/// Original MenyooSP viewport scroll constants (`Menu.h` lines 45-47).
pub const GTA_SCROLLOP: usize = 8;
pub const GTA_BETOP: usize = 6;
pub const GTA_MAXOP: usize = 14;

/// Global live controls read on hot paths by `ambient.rs`, `host.rs`, `perfmon.rs`,
/// `gameinput.rs`, and `pc_kbm.rs` with zero lock contention.
pub struct LiveBridge {
    /// True while Menyoo is open (tells `gameinput.rs` to suppress menu keys/buttons).
    pub menu_open: AtomicBool,
    /// Active open/close virtual key (`VK_F8` = 0x77 by default).
    pub open_vk: AtomicU32,
    /// Ambient lighting override active.
    pub ambient_override: AtomicBool,
    pub ambient_level_bits: AtomicU32,
    pub ambient_r_bits: AtomicU32,
    pub ambient_g_bits: AtomicU32,
    pub ambient_b_bits: AtomicU32,
    pub ssao_strength_bits: AtomicU32,
    pub ssao_radius_bits: AtomicU32,
    pub ambient_hemi: AtomicBool,
    pub emp_blackout: AtomicBool,

    /// Live PC KB+M & Controller input hooks.
    pub kbm_override: AtomicBool,
    pub mouse_sens_bits: AtomicU32,
    pub mouse_deadzone_bits: AtomicU32,
    pub mouse_invert_y: AtomicBool,
    pub disable_rumble: AtomicBool,
    pub test_rumble_ticks: AtomicU32,
    pub auto_sprint: AtomicBool,
    pub auto_drive: AtomicBool,
    pub rapid_fire: AtomicBool,
    pub rapid_fire_hz: AtomicU32,
    pub toggle_mouse_look_req: AtomicBool,

    /// Live PerfMon visibility override (0 = env default, 1 = force on, 2 = force off).
    pub perfmon_mode: AtomicU32,
    /// Live FPS cap (0 = uncapped, else 30/45/60/90/120).
    pub fps_cap: AtomicU32,
    /// Title PE base address (set from `run.rs`) for live Engine Inspector.
    pub title_image_base: AtomicU64,
    /// Title total presented frame counter.
    pub frame_count: AtomicU64,
    /// Connected gamepad flag & live button bitmask (updated by `gameinput.rs`).
    pub pad_connected: AtomicBool,
    pub pad_buttons: AtomicU32,
    /// Pending frame capture request from Menyoo.
    pub capture_requested: AtomicBool,
    /// Lock-free visibility bit (`0.00 ms` bypass in `host.rs` when false!).
    pub overlay_active: AtomicBool,
    /// Vision Hax preset, strength & color grading for D3D12 HLSL post-FX pass.
    pub vision_preset: AtomicUsize,
    pub vision_strength_bits: AtomicU32,
    pub postfx_exposure_bits: AtomicU32,
    pub postfx_contrast_bits: AtomicU32,
    pub postfx_saturation_bits: AtomicU32,
    /// Live `QueryPerformanceCounter` Game Speed & Bullet Time on Aim hooks.
    pub timescale_engaged: AtomicBool,
    pub timescale_bits: AtomicU32,
    pub bullet_time_on_aim: AtomicBool,
    pub bullet_time_scale_bits: AtomicU32,
    pub aim_held: AtomicBool,
}

impl LiveBridge {
    pub const fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            menu_open: AtomicBool::new(false),
            open_vk: AtomicU32::new(0x76), // VK_F7
            ambient_override: AtomicBool::new(false),
            ambient_level_bits: AtomicU32::new(0.22f32.to_bits()),
            ambient_r_bits: AtomicU32::new(0.84f32.to_bits()),
            ambient_g_bits: AtomicU32::new(0.90f32.to_bits()),
            ambient_b_bits: AtomicU32::new(1.00f32.to_bits()),
            ssao_strength_bits: AtomicU32::new(1.10f32.to_bits()),
            ssao_radius_bits: AtomicU32::new(0.70f32.to_bits()),
            ambient_hemi: AtomicBool::new(true),
            emp_blackout: AtomicBool::new(false),
            kbm_override: AtomicBool::new(false),
            mouse_sens_bits: AtomicU32::new(1.0f32.to_bits()),
            mouse_deadzone_bits: AtomicU32::new(0.22f32.to_bits()),
            mouse_invert_y: AtomicBool::new(false),
            disable_rumble: AtomicBool::new(false),
            test_rumble_ticks: AtomicU32::new(0),
            auto_sprint: AtomicBool::new(false),
            auto_drive: AtomicBool::new(false),
            rapid_fire: AtomicBool::new(false),
            rapid_fire_hz: AtomicU32::new(12),
            toggle_mouse_look_req: AtomicBool::new(false),
            perfmon_mode: AtomicU32::new(0),
            fps_cap: AtomicU32::new(0),
            title_image_base: AtomicU64::new(0),
            frame_count: AtomicU64::new(0),
            pad_connected: AtomicBool::new(false),
            pad_buttons: AtomicU32::new(0),
            capture_requested: AtomicBool::new(false),
            overlay_active: AtomicBool::new(true),
            vision_preset: AtomicUsize::new(0),
            vision_strength_bits: AtomicU32::new(0.75f32.to_bits()),
            postfx_exposure_bits: AtomicU32::new(0.0f32.to_bits()),
            postfx_contrast_bits: AtomicU32::new(1.0f32.to_bits()),
            postfx_saturation_bits: AtomicU32::new(1.0f32.to_bits()),
            timescale_engaged: AtomicBool::new(false),
            timescale_bits: AtomicU32::new(1.0f32.to_bits()),
            bullet_time_on_aim: AtomicBool::new(false),
            bullet_time_scale_bits: AtomicU32::new(0.35f32.to_bits()),
            aim_held: AtomicBool::new(false),
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum ColourTarget {
    TitleBox,
    Background,
    TitleText,
    OptionText,
    SelectedText,
    OptionBreaks,
    OptionCount,
    SelectionBox,
    Accent,
}

impl ColourTarget {
    pub const fn title(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            Self::TitleBox => "Title Box",
            Self::Background => "Background",
            Self::TitleText => "Title Text",
            Self::OptionText => "Option Text",
            Self::SelectedText => "Selected Text",
            Self::OptionBreaks => "Option Breaks",
            Self::OptionCount => "Option Count",
            Self::SelectionBox => "Selection Box",
            Self::Accent => "GTA Accent",
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum FontTarget {
    Title,
    Options,
    Selection,
    Breaks,
}

impl FontTarget {
    pub const fn title(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            Self::Title => "Title Font",
            Self::Options => "Options Font",
            Self::Selection => "Selected Font",
            Self::Breaks => "Breaks Font",
        }
    }
}
```
