#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct MenuItem {
    pub label: String,
    pub is_break: bool,
    pub right: ItemRight,
    pub description: String,
    pub is_live: bool,
    pub preview_colour: Option<Rgba>,
    pub preview_spec: Option<PreviewSpec>,
    pub action: Action,
}

impl MenuItem {
    fn submenu(label: &str, sub: SubmenuId, desc: &str, is_live: bool) -> Self {
        Self {
            label: label.to_owned(),
            is_break: false,
            right: ItemRight::SubmenuArrow,
            description: desc.to_owned(),
            is_live,
            preview_colour: None,
            preview_spec: None,
            action: Action::OpenSub(sub),
        }
    }

    fn option(label: &str, action: Action, desc: &str, is_live: bool) -> Self {
        Self {
            label: label.to_owned(),
            is_break: false,
            right: ItemRight::None,
            description: desc.to_owned(),
            is_live,
            preview_colour: None,
            preview_spec: None,
            action,
        }
    }

    fn toggle(label: &str, on: bool, action: Action, desc: &str, is_live: bool) -> Self {
        Self {
            label: label.to_owned(),
            is_break: false,
            right: ItemRight::ToggleGlobe(on),
            description: desc.to_owned(),
            is_live,
            preview_colour: None,
            preview_spec: None,
            action,
        }
    }

    fn tick(label: &str, active: bool, action: Action, desc: &str, is_live: bool) -> Self {
        Self {
            label: label.to_owned(),
            is_break: false,
            right: ItemRight::Tick(active),
            description: desc.to_owned(),
            is_live,
            preview_colour: None,
            preview_spec: None,
            action,
        }
    }

    fn slider(label: &str, value: String, action: Action, desc: &str, is_live: bool) -> Self {
        Self {
            label: label.to_owned(),
            is_break: false,
            right: ItemRight::Slider {
                text: value,
                adjustable: true,
            },
            description: desc.to_owned(),
            is_live,
            preview_colour: None,
            preview_spec: None,
            action,
        }
    }

    fn tag(label: &str, tag: String, desc: &str, is_live: bool) -> Self {
        Self {
            label: label.to_owned(),
            is_break: false,
            right: ItemRight::Tag(tag),
            description: desc.to_owned(),
            is_live,
            preview_colour: None,
            preview_spec: None,
            action: Action::None,
        }
    }

    fn sep(label: &str) -> Self {
        Self {
            label: label.to_owned(),
            is_break: true,
            right: ItemRight::None,
            description: String::new(),
            is_live: false,
            preview_colour: None,
            preview_spec: None,
            action: Action::None,
        }
    }

    fn with_preview(mut self, c: Rgba) -> Self {
        self.preview_colour = Some(c);
        self
    }

    fn with_preview_spec(mut self, spec: PreviewSpec) -> Self {
        self.preview_spec = Some(spec);
        self
    }
}

/// Bottom-left GTA feed notification toast (`Game::Print::PrintBottomLeft`).
#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct FeedToast {
    pub sender: String,
    pub subtitle: String,
    pub body: String,
    pub created_at: Instant,
    pub duration: Duration,
}

impl FeedToast {
    pub fn alpha(&self, now: Instant) -> f32 {
        let elapsed = now.saturating_duration_since(self.created_at).as_secs_f32();
        let total = self.duration.as_secs_f32();
        if elapsed >= total {
            return 0.0;
        }
        let fade_in = (0.85 + elapsed / 0.08).min(1.0);
        let fade_out = ((total - elapsed) / 0.45).min(1.0);
        fade_in.min(fade_out).clamp(0.0, 1.0)
    }
}

            .ok()

            .filter(|v| v.is_finite() && *v >= 0.0)
            .unwrap_or(0.22);
        let ambient_tint = parse_env_tint().unwrap_or([214, 230, 255]);
        let (ssao_strength, ssao_radius) = parse_env_shade().unwrap_or((1.10, 0.70));

            .ok()

    pub fn sync_bridge(&self) {
        BRIDGE.menu_open.store(self.is_open, Ordering::Release);
        BRIDGE
            .open_vk
            .store(u32::from(self.cfg.open_key_vk), Ordering::Relaxed);
        BRIDGE
            .ambient_level_bits
            .store(self.ambient_level.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
        BRIDGE.ambient_r_bits.store(
            (f32::from(self.ambient_tint[0]) / 255.0).to_bits(),
            Ordering::Relaxed,
        );
        BRIDGE.ambient_g_bits.store(
            (f32::from(self.ambient_tint[1]) / 255.0).to_bits(),
            Ordering::Relaxed,
        );
        BRIDGE.ambient_b_bits.store(
            (f32::from(self.ambient_tint[2]) / 255.0).to_bits(),
            Ordering::Relaxed,
        );
        BRIDGE
            .ssao_strength_bits
            .store(self.ssao_strength.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
        BRIDGE
            .ssao_radius_bits
            .store(self.ssao_radius.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
        BRIDGE
            .ambient_hemi
            .store(self.ambient_hemi, Ordering::Relaxed);
        BRIDGE
            .emp_blackout
            .store(self.emp_blackout, Ordering::Relaxed);

        BRIDGE
            .mouse_sens_bits
            .store(self.mouse_sens.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
        BRIDGE
            .mouse_deadzone_bits
            .store(self.mouse_deadzone.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
        BRIDGE
            .mouse_invert_y
            .store(self.mouse_invert_y, Ordering::Relaxed);
        BRIDGE
            .disable_rumble
            .store(self.disable_rumble, Ordering::Relaxed);
        BRIDGE
            .auto_sprint
            .store(self.auto_sprint, Ordering::Relaxed);
        BRIDGE
            .auto_drive
            .store(self.auto_drive, Ordering::Relaxed);
        BRIDGE
            .rapid_fire
            .store(self.rapid_fire, Ordering::Relaxed);
        BRIDGE
            .rapid_fire_hz
            .store(self.rapid_fire_hz, Ordering::Relaxed);

        BRIDGE
            .perfmon_mode
            .store(self.perfmon_mode, Ordering::Relaxed);
        let cap = FPS_CAPS
            .get(self.cfg.fps_cap_idx)
            .map_or(0, |&(fps, _)| fps);
        BRIDGE.fps_cap.store(cap, Ordering::Relaxed);
        BRIDGE
            .vision_preset
            .store(self.cfg.vision_preset, Ordering::Relaxed);
        BRIDGE
            .vision_strength_bits
            .store(self.cfg.vision_strength.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
        BRIDGE
            .postfx_exposure_bits
            .store(self.cfg.vision_exposure.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
        BRIDGE
            .postfx_contrast_bits
            .store(self.cfg.vision_contrast.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
        BRIDGE
            .postfx_saturation_bits
            .store(self.cfg.vision_saturation.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
        BRIDGE
            .timescale_bits
            .store(self.timescale.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
        BRIDGE
            .bullet_time_on_aim
            .store(self.bullet_time_on_aim, Ordering::Relaxed);
        BRIDGE
            .bullet_time_scale_bits
            .store(self.bullet_time_scale.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
        if (self.timescale - 1.0).abs() > 0.005 || self.bullet_time_on_aim {
            BRIDGE.timescale_engaged.store(true, Ordering::Release);
        }
        BRIDGE
            .overlay_active
            .store(self.has_visible_hud(), Ordering::Release);
    }

    pub fn current_postfx(&self) -> PostFxParams {
        PostFxParams {
            mode: self.cfg.vision_preset as u32,
            strength: self.cfg.vision_strength,
            exposure: self.cfg.vision_exposure,
            contrast: self.cfg.vision_contrast,
            saturation: self.cfg.vision_saturation,
            time_sec: self.start_time.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
            _pad0: 0.0,
            _pad1: 0.0,
        }
    }

    /// Hot-reloads `menyooConfig.ini`, `rvas.json`, `Favourites.ini`, and `Sounds/*.wav`
    /// without restarting the game (`Ctrl+F7`).
    pub fn hot_reload_all(&mut self) {
        self.cfg = MenyooConfig::load(&self.stuff_dir);
        self.rvas = RvaTable::load(&self.stuff_dir);
        hook::refresh_rvas(&self.rvas);
        self.live_vehicles_scanned = false;
        self.live_vehicles_named = false;
        self.live_props_scanned = false;
        self.live_peds_scanned = false;
        self.live_weapons_scanned = false;
        self.live_weapons_named = false;
        self.live_attachments_scanned = false;
        self.live_weathers_scanned = false;
        self.favourite_coords = trainer::load_favourites(&self.stuff_dir);
        self.custom_themes = trainer::list_custom_themes(&self.stuff_dir);
        self.saved_vehicles = trainer::list_saved_vehicles(&self.stuff_dir);
        self.spooner_scenes = trainer::list_spooner_scenes(&self.stuff_dir);
        self.saved_outfits = trainer::list_saved_outfits(&self.stuff_dir);
        sound::set_enabled(self.cfg.sound_enabled);
        sound::set_volume(self.cfg.sound_volume);
        sound::load_custom_bank(&self.stuff_dir.join("Sounds"));
        self.sync_bridge();
        self.sync_hook_loops();
        let n = self.rvas.populated_count();
        self.push_toast(
            "Menyoo Hot-Reload",
            "Ctrl+F7 Live Reload",
            &format!("Reloaded INI, Favourites, Themes & {n} RVAs."),
            Duration::from_secs(4),
            true,
        );
    }

    /// Synchronizes all active continuous main-thread trainer loops into a single lock-free `u64` mask.
    pub fn sync_hook_loops(&self) {
        let mut mask = 0u64;
        if self.player_invincible { mask |= hook::LOOP_PLAYER_GOD; }
        if self.player_never_wanted { mask |= hook::LOOP_NEVER_WANTED; }
        if self.veh_auto_repair { mask |= hook::LOOP_VEH_AUTO_REPAIR; }
        if self.veh_invincible { mask |= hook::LOOP_VEH_GOD; }
        if self.veh_rainbow { mask |= hook::LOOP_VEH_RAINBOW; }
        if self.wep_explosive { mask |= hook::LOOP_EXPLOSIVE_AMMO; }
        if self.wep_fire { mask |= hook::LOOP_FIRE_AMMO; }
        if self.wep_explosive_melee { mask |= hook::LOOP_EXPLOSIVE_MELEE; }
        if self.player_super_jump { mask |= hook::LOOP_SUPER_JUMP; }
        if self.player_no_ragdoll { mask |= hook::LOOP_NO_RAGDOLL; }
        if self.freecam_enabled { mask |= hook::LOOP_FREECAM_NOCLIP; }
        if self.player_super_run { mask |= hook::LOOP_SUPER_RUN; }
        if self.veh_horn_boost { mask |= hook::LOOP_VEH_HORN_BOOST; }
        if self.veh_fly { mask |= hook::LOOP_VEH_FLY; }
        if self.player_auto_clean { mask |= hook::LOOP_AUTO_CLEAN; }
        if self.jump_around { mask |= hook::LOOP_JUMP_AROUND; }
        if self.player_invisible { mask |= hook::LOOP_INVISIBLE; }
        if self.player_seatbelt { mask |= hook::LOOP_SEATBELT; }
        if self.player_ignored { mask |= hook::LOOP_IGNORED_BY_ALL; }
        if self.wep_inf_ammo { mask |= hook::LOOP_INF_AMMO; }
        if self.wep_no_reload { mask |= hook::LOOP_NO_RELOAD; }
        if self.wep_one_hit { mask |= hook::LOOP_ONE_HIT_KILL; }
        if (self.wep_damage_mult - 1.0).abs() > 0.05 { mask |= hook::LOOP_DAMAGE_MULT; }
        if self.meteor_shower { mask |= hook::LOOP_METEOR_SHOWER; }
        if self.spooner_mode { mask |= hook::LOOP_SPOONER_MODE; }
        if self.player_inf_stamina { mask |= hook::LOOP_INF_STAMINA; }
        if self.veh_weapons { mask |= hook::LOOP_VEH_WEAPONS; }
        if self.veh_power_mult > 1.05 { mask |= hook::LOOP_VEH_POWER; }
        if self.fun_gun_mode != 0 { mask |= hook::LOOP_FUN_GUN; }
        if self.bodyguard_follow && hook::bodyguard_count() > 0 { mask |= hook::LOOP_BODYGUARD_FOLLOW; }
        if hook::spooner_hud_snapshot().attached { mask |= hook::LOOP_SPOONER_ATTACH; }
        if self.player_inf_cores_special { mask |= hook::LOOP_INF_CORES_SPECIAL; }
        if self.veh_inf_fuel { mask |= hook::LOOP_VEH_INF_FUEL; }
        if self.player_no_witnesses { mask |= hook::LOOP_NO_WITNESSES; }
        if self.player_one_shot_npcs { mask |= hook::LOOP_ONE_SHOT_NPCS; }
        if self.wep_no_degradation { mask |= hook::LOOP_NO_WEP_DEGRADATION; }
        if self.player_never_drown { mask |= hook::LOOP_NEVER_DROWN; }
        if self.player_bulletproof_in_veh { mask |= hook::LOOP_BULLETPROOF_IN_VEH; }
        if self.veh_car_jump { mask |= hook::LOOP_VEH_CAR_JUMP; }
        if self.veh_super_brake { mask |= hook::LOOP_VEH_SUPER_BRAKE; }
        if self.veh_sticky_tires { mask |= hook::LOOP_VEH_STICKY_TIRES; }
        if self.veh_rainbow_neon { mask |= hook::LOOP_VEH_RAINBOW_NEON; }
        if self.veh_auto_flip { mask |= hook::LOOP_VEH_AUTO_FLIP; }
        if self.veh_invisible { mask |= hook::LOOP_VEH_INVISIBLE; }
        if hook::bodyguard_count() > 0 || hook::attacker_count() > 0 { mask |= hook::LOOP_PED_SQUAD_AI; }
        if self.ped_riot_mode { mask |= hook::LOOP_PED_RIOT; }
        if self.black_hole_mode { mask |= hook::LOOP_BLACK_HOLE; }
        if self.veh_drive_on_water { mask |= hook::LOOP_VEH_DRIVE_ON_WATER; }
        if self.veh_super_downforce { mask |= hook::LOOP_VEH_SUPER_DOWNFORCE; }
        if self.veh_ramp_plow { mask |= hook::LOOP_VEH_RAMP_PLOW; }
        if self.wep_aimbot { mask |= hook::LOOP_AIMBOT; }
        if self.player_drunk_mode { mask |= hook::LOOP_DRUNK_MODE; }
        if self.player_super_swim { mask |= hook::LOOP_SUPER_SWIM; }
        if self.anti_grav_traffic { mask |= hook::LOOP_ANTI_GRAV_TRAFFIC; }
        if self.rainbow_traffic { mask |= hook::LOOP_RAINBOW_TRAFFIC; }
        hook::set_loop_mask(mask);

        // Preserve runtime-toggled dynamic extended bits (Carry/Ride/Tow/Portal/FOV/Rope/TaskSeq) while syncing UI bits!
        const DYNAMIC_EX_BITS: u64 = hook::LOOP_EX_CARRY_PED
            | hook::LOOP_EX_ANIMAL_RIDE
            | hook::LOOP_EX_VEH_TOW_MAGNET
            | hook::LOOP_EX_PORTAL_TELEPORT
            | hook::LOOP_EX_CAM_FOV_LOCK
            | hook::LOOP_EX_ROPE_TETHER
            | hook::LOOP_EX_SPOONER_TASK_SEQ
            | hook::LOOP_EX_SIX_STAR_LOCK;
        let mut mask_ex = hook::active_loop_mask_ex() & DYNAMIC_EX_BITS;
        if self.player_breathe_fire { mask_ex |= hook::LOOP_EX_BREATHE_FIRE; }
        if self.player_ghost_rider { mask_ex |= hook::LOOP_EX_GHOST_RIDER; }
        if self.player_forcefield { mask_ex |= hook::LOOP_EX_FORCEFIELD; }
        if self.player_parachute_glide { mask_ex |= hook::LOOP_EX_PARACHUTE_GLIDE; }
        if self.player_scuba_dive { mask_ex |= hook::LOOP_EX_SCUBA_DIVE; }
        if self.player_eagle_eye { mask_ex |= hook::LOOP_EX_EAGLE_EYE; }
        if self.veh_slam_z.abs() > 0.01 { mask_ex |= hook::LOOP_EX_VEH_SLAM_STANCE; }
        if self.wep_triggerbot { mask_ex |= hook::LOOP_EX_TRIGGERBOT; }
        if self.wep_tranq_rounds { mask_ex |= hook::LOOP_EX_TRANQ_ROUNDS; }
        if self.player_hand_flame_ptfx { mask_ex |= hook::LOOP_EX_PTFX_HAND_FLAME; }
        if self.veh_wheel_fire_ptfx { mask_ex |= hook::LOOP_EX_PTFX_WHEEL_FIRE; }
        if self.veh_slipstream { mask_ex |= hook::LOOP_EX_VEH_SLIPSTREAM; }
        if self.player_no_open_carry_panic { mask_ex |= hook::LOOP_EX_NO_OPEN_CARRY_PANIC; }
        if self.cam_fov_deg > 10.0 { mask_ex |= hook::LOOP_EX_CAM_FOV_LOCK; }
        hook::set_loop_mask_ex(mask_ex);

        hook::set_explosion_tag(EXPLOSION_TAGS[self.explosion_tag_idx % EXPLOSION_TAGS.len()].0);
        hook::set_veh_max_speed(self.veh_max_speed);
        hook::set_veh_slam_z(self.veh_slam_z);
        hook::set_noclip_speed(self.noclip_speed);
        hook::set_weapon_damage_mult(self.wep_damage_mult);
        hook::set_veh_power_mult(self.veh_power_mult);
        hook::set_fun_gun_mode(self.fun_gun_mode as u32);
        hook::set_water_plane_z(self.water_plane_z);
        hook::set_autopilot_speed(self.autopilot_speed);
        hook::set_autopilot_style(self.autopilot_style);
        self.sync_default_ped_gear();
    }

    fn rescan_live_attachments(&mut self, silent: bool) {
        let base = BRIDGE.title_image_base.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
        if base == 0 {
            if !silent {
                self.push_toast("Weapon Attachments", "Preview Mode", "Launch game to scan live GTA attachments.", Duration::from_secs(3), false);
            }
            return;
        }
        static ATT_SCAN_IN_FLIGHT: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);
        if ATT_SCAN_IN_FLIGHT.swap(true, Ordering::AcqRel) {
            return;
        }
        self.live_attachments_scanned = true;
        let rvas = self.rvas.clone();
        let _ = std::thread::Builder::new()
            .name("menyoo-dx12-att-scan".into())
            .spawn(move || {
                let scanned = trainer::scan_live_weapon_attachments(base, &rvas);
                let n = scanned.len();
                ATT_SCAN_IN_FLIGHT.store(false, Ordering::Release);
                super::with_state_mut(|s| {
                    s.live_attachments = scanned;
                    s.live_attachments_scanned = n > 0;
                    if !silent {
                        s.push_toast(
                            "Ammu-Nation",
                            "LIVE Attachments",
                            &format!("Discovered {n} weapon attachments & components from RAM!"),
                            Duration::from_secs(4),
                            n > 0,
                        );
                    }
                    s.dirty = true;
                });
            });
    }

    /// Returns `(hash32, name)` for the currently selected firearm used to arm Defenders, Attackers & Gang Wars.
    pub fn selected_ped_weapon(&self) -> (u32, String) {
        let mut firearms: Vec<&WeaponCatalogEntry> = self
            .live_weapons
            .iter()
            .filter(|w| w.is_firearm && w.cat_direct_ok)
            .collect();
        if firearms.is_empty() {
            firearms = self.live_weapons.iter().filter(|w| w.is_firearm).collect();
        }
        if firearms.is_empty() {
            firearms = self.live_weapons.iter().collect();
        }
        if let Some(w) = firearms.get(self.ped_weapon_idx % firearms.len().max(1)) {
            (w.hash32, w.name.clone())
        } else {
            (0, "Default Firearm".into())
        }
    }

    /// Syncs the active default NPC weapon & ped model hash into `hook.rs` (for Fun Gun Ped Spawners!).
    pub fn sync_default_ped_gear(&self) {
        let (wep_hash, _) = self.selected_ped_weapon();
        if wep_hash != 0 {
            hook::set_default_ped_weapon(wep_hash);
        }
        if let Some(p) = self.live_peds.first() {
            hook::set_default_ped_model(p.hash64);
        }
    }

    fn rescan_live_weapons(&mut self, silent: bool, give_all_after: bool) {
        let base = BRIDGE.title_image_base.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
        if base == 0 {
            if !silent {
                self.push_toast("Weapon Options", "Preview Mode", "Launch game to scan live GTA arsenal.", Duration::from_secs(3), false);
            }
            return;
        }
        static WEP_SCAN_IN_FLIGHT: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);
        if WEP_SCAN_IN_FLIGHT.swap(true, Ordering::AcqRel) {
            return;
        }
        self.live_weapons_scanned = true;
        let rvas = self.rvas.clone();
        let _ = std::thread::Builder::new()
            .name("menyoo-dx12-wep-scan".into())
            .spawn(move || {
                let scanned = trainer::scan_live_weapon_catalog(base, &rvas);
                let n = scanned.len();
                let direct_items: Vec<(u32, u32, u32)> = scanned
                    .iter()
                    .filter(|w| w.cat_direct_ok)
                    .map(|w| (w.hash32, w.award_hash32, w.ammo_award_hash32))
                    .collect();
                let items: Vec<(u32, u32, u32)> = if !direct_items.is_empty() {
                    direct_items
                } else {
                    scanned
                        .iter()
                        .filter(|w| w.in_inv_db)
                        .map(|w| (w.hash32, w.award_hash32, w.ammo_award_hash32))
                        .collect()
                };
                WEP_SCAN_IN_FLIGHT.store(false, Ordering::Release);
                super::with_state_mut(|s| {
                    let named = scanned.iter().any(|w| !w.name.contains("[0x"));
                    s.live_weapons = scanned;
                    s.live_weapons_scanned = n > 0;
                    s.live_weapons_named = named;
                    s.sync_default_ped_gear();
                    if give_all_after && !items.is_empty() {
                        if hook::enqueue_give_weapon_list(&items) {
                            s.push_toast(
                                "Ammu-Nation",
                                "Give All Weapons",
                                &format!("Granting {n} discovered GTA weapons smoothly!"),
                                Duration::from_secs(4),
                                true,
                            );
                        } else {
                            s.push_toast("Weapon Options", "Hook Off", "Enable Main-Thread Hook in RVA Inspector first.", Duration::from_secs(4), false);
                        }
                    } else if !silent {
                        s.push_toast(
                            "Ammu-Nation",
                            "LIVE Weapon Catalog",
                            &format!("Discovered {n} GTA weapons directly from RAM!"),
                            Duration::from_secs(4),
                            n > 0,
                        );
                    }
                    s.dirty = true;
                });
            });
    }

    /// Cross-names `rvas.builtin_vehicles` from resolved `live_vehicles` by `hash64`
    /// so Built-In Cheat Vehicles display their real localized GTA Make + Model names!
    pub fn sync_builtin_vehicle_names(&mut self) {
        if self.live_vehicles.is_empty() || self.rvas.builtin_vehicles.is_empty() {
            return;
        }
        for b in &mut self.rvas.builtin_vehicles {
            if let Some(live) = self.live_vehicles.iter().find(|v| v.hash64 == b.hash64)
                && !live.name.contains("[0x")
            {
                b.name = live.name.clone();
            }
        }
    }

    /// Applies pre-scanned catalogs (e.g. from live verification probe) directly into UI state.
    pub fn apply_probed_catalogs(
        &mut self,
        vehs: Vec<CheatVehicleEntry>,
        props: Vec<PropCatalogEntry>,
        weps: Vec<WeaponCatalogEntry>,
        weathers: Vec<WeatherCatalogEntry>,
        peds: Vec<PedCatalogEntry>,
    ) {
        if !vehs.is_empty() {
            self.live_vehicles_named = vehs.iter().any(|v| !v.name.contains("[0x"));
            self.live_vehicles = vehs;
            self.live_vehicles_scanned = true;
            self.sync_builtin_vehicle_names();
        }
        if !props.is_empty() {
            self.live_props = props;
            self.live_props_scanned = true;
        }
        if !weps.is_empty() {
            self.live_weapons_named = weps.iter().any(|w| !w.name.contains("[0x"));
            self.live_weapons = weps;
            self.live_weapons_scanned = true;
        }
        if !weathers.is_empty() {
            self.live_weathers = weathers;
            self.live_weathers_scanned = true;
        }
        if !peds.is_empty() {
            self.live_peds = peds;
            self.live_peds_scanned = true;
        }
        self.sync_default_ped_gear();
        self.dirty = true;
    }

    }

    pub fn open_text_prompt(&mut self, kind: TextPromptKind) {
        let (title, hint, initial) = match kind {
            TextPromptKind::VehicleSearch => (
                "Search Vehicle Spawner",
                "Type partial vehicle name (leave blank to show all)",
                self.vehicle_search.clone(),
            ),
            TextPromptKind::WeaponSearch => (
                "Search Weapon Arsenal",
                "Type partial weapon name or hash (leave blank to show all)",
                self.weapon_search.clone(),
            ),
            TextPromptKind::PropSearch => (
                "Search Object Spooner Props",
                "Type partial prop name or hash (leave blank to show all)",
                self.prop_search.clone(),
            ),
            TextPromptKind::PedSearch => (
                "Search Ped & Bodyguard Models",
                "Type partial ped name or hash (leave blank to show all)",
                self.ped_search.clone(),
            ),
            TextPromptKind::SpawnHash64 => (
                "Spawn Custom 64-Bit Model Hash",
                "Enter hex hash64 (e.g. 0x1122334455667788)",
                "0x".into(),
            ),
            TextPromptKind::SpoonerPropHash64 => (
                "Spooner: Spawn Custom Prop Hash64",
                "Enter hex 64-bit prop model hash (auto-streams & places ahead)",
                "0x".into(),
            ),
            TextPromptKind::CustomCoords => (
                "Enter Custom X, Y, Z Coordinates",
                "Comma-separated floats (e.g. 1420.0, -1840.0, 12.5)",
                format!(
                    "{:.1}, {:.1}, {:.1}",
                    self.custom_coords[0], self.custom_coords[1], self.custom_coords[2]
                ),
            ),
            TextPromptKind::FavouriteName => (
                "Save Location to Favourites.ini",
                "Enter bookmark name for current custom XYZ",
                format!("Saved Spot #{}", self.favourite_coords.len() + 1),
            ),
            TextPromptKind::SaveCustomTheme => (
                "Save Custom Theme (.ini)",
                "Saved to menyooStuff/Themes/<name>.ini",
                "My Custom Theme".into(),
            ),
            TextPromptKind::SaveCustomVehicle => (
                "Save Custom Vehicle Preset (.json)",
                "Saved to menyooStuff/Vehicles/<name>.json",
                format!("Custom Ride #{}", self.saved_vehicles.len() + 1),
            ),
            TextPromptKind::SaveSpoonerScene => (
                "Save Object Spooner Scene (.json)",
                "Saved to menyooStuff/Spooner/<name>.json",
                format!("GTA Map #{}", self.spooner_scenes.len() + 1),
            ),
            TextPromptKind::SaveOutfit => (

            ),

            kind,

        });
        BRIDGE.overlay_active.store(true, Ordering::Release);
        self.dirty = true;
    }

    /// Processes keyboard typing while a `TextPrompt` modal is active.
    pub fn handle_text_input(
        &mut self,
        ch: Option<char>,
        backspace: bool,
        confirm: bool,
        cancel: bool,
    ) {
        if cancel {
            self.text_prompt = None;
            sound::play(MenuSound::Back);
            self.dirty = true;
            return;
        }
        if confirm {
            if let Some(prompt) = self.text_prompt.take() {
                self.commit_text_prompt(prompt);
                self.dirty = true;
            }
            return;
        }
        if let Some(p) = self.text_prompt.as_mut() {
            if backspace {
                if p.buffer.pop().is_some() {
                    sound::play(MenuSound::NavLeftRight);
                    self.dirty = true;
                }
            } else if let Some(c) = ch
                && p.buffer.len() < 48
            {
                p.buffer.push(c);
                sound::play(MenuSound::NavUpDown);
                self.dirty = true;
            }
        }
    }

    fn commit_text_prompt(&mut self, prompt: TextPrompt) {
        let val = prompt.buffer.trim();
        match prompt.kind {
            TextPromptKind::VehicleSearch => {
                self.vehicle_search = val.to_owned();
                self.current_op = 0;
                self.clamp_selection(true);
                sound::play(MenuSound::Select);
                self.push_toast(
                    "Vehicle Search",
                    "Filter Updated",
                    if val.is_empty() { "Showing all vehicles." } else { val },
                    Duration::from_secs(3),
                    false,
                );
            }
            TextPromptKind::WeaponSearch => {
                self.weapon_search = val.to_owned();
                self.current_op = 0;
                self.clamp_selection(true);
                sound::play(MenuSound::Select);
                self.push_toast(
                    "Weapon Search",
                    "Filter Updated",
                    if val.is_empty() { "Showing all weapons." } else { val },
                    Duration::from_secs(3),
                    false,
                );
            }
            TextPromptKind::PropSearch => {
                self.prop_search = val.to_owned();
                self.current_op = 0;
                self.clamp_selection(true);
                sound::play(MenuSound::Select);
                self.push_toast(
                    "Spooner Search",
                    "Filter Updated",
                    if val.is_empty() { "Showing all props." } else { val },
                    Duration::from_secs(3),
                    false,
                );
            }
            TextPromptKind::PedSearch => {
                self.ped_search = val.to_owned();
                self.current_op = 0;
                self.clamp_selection(true);
                sound::play(MenuSound::Select);
                self.push_toast(
                    "Ped Search",
                    "Filter Updated",
                    if val.is_empty() { "Showing all peds." } else { val },
                    Duration::from_secs(3),
                    false,
                );
            }
            TextPromptKind::SpawnHash64 => {
                let hex = val.strip_prefix("0x").or_else(|| val.strip_prefix("0X")).unwrap_or(val);
                if let Ok(h) = u64::from_str_radix(hex, 16) {
                    if hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::SpawnVehicleHash64 {
                        hash64: h,
                        keep_prev: self.cfg.keep_spawned_vehicles,
                        warp_inside: self.cfg.spawn_inside_vehicle,
                    }) {
                        sound::play(MenuSound::Select);
                        self.push_toast("", "", &format!("Special delivery from Menyoo Customs: 0x{h:016X}"), Duration::from_secs(3), true);
                    } else {
                        sound::play(MenuSound::Error);
                        self.push_toast("Vehicle Spawner", "Hook Off", "Enable Main-Thread Hook in RVA Inspector first.", Duration::from_secs(4), false);
                    }
                } else {
                    sound::play(MenuSound::Error);
                    self.push_toast("Vehicle Spawner", "Invalid Hash", "Use 64-bit hex like 0x1122334455667788.", Duration::from_secs(3), false);
                }
            }
            TextPromptKind::SpoonerPropHash64 => {
                let hex = val.strip_prefix("0x").or_else(|| val.strip_prefix("0X")).unwrap_or(val);
                if let Ok(h) = u64::from_str_radix(hex, 16) {
                    if hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::SpoonerSpawnProp {
                        hash64: h,
                        dynamic: self.spooner_dynamic,
                        invincible: self.spooner_invincible,
                    }) {
                        sound::play(MenuSound::Select);
                        self.push_toast("Object Spooner", "LIVE Prop", &format!("Streaming & placing prop 0x{h:016X}"), Duration::from_secs(3), true);
                    } else {
                        sound::play(MenuSound::Error);
                        self.push_toast("Object Spooner", "Hook Off", "Enable Main-Thread Hook in RVA Inspector first.", Duration::from_secs(4), false);
                    }
                } else {
                    sound::play(MenuSound::Error);
                    self.push_toast("Object Spooner", "Invalid Hash", "Enter a 64-bit hex model hash.", Duration::from_secs(3), false);
                }
            }
            TextPromptKind::CustomCoords => {
                let nums: Vec<f32> = val
                    .split(|c: char| c == ',' || c.is_whitespace())
                    .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())
                    .filter_map(|s| s.parse::<f32>().ok())
                    .collect();
                if let [x, y, z] = nums[..] && x.is_finite() && y.is_finite() && z.is_finite() {
                    self.custom_coords = [x, y, z];
                    sound::play(MenuSound::Select);
                    self.push_toast("Menyoo Teleport", "Coordinates Set", &format!("{x:.1}, {y:.1}, {z:.1}"), Duration::from_secs(3), false);
                } else {
                    sound::play(MenuSound::Error);
                    self.push_toast("Menyoo Teleport", "Parse Error", "Enter 3 numbers: X, Y, Z", Duration::from_secs(3), false);
                }
            }
            TextPromptKind::FavouriteName => {
                if !val.is_empty() {
                    self.favourite_coords.push(SavedCoord {
                        name: val.to_owned(),
                        coords: self.custom_coords,
                    });
                    let _ = trainer::save_favourites(&self.stuff_dir, &self.favourite_coords);
                    sound::play(MenuSound::Select);
                    self.push_toast("Favourites.ini", "Bookmark Saved", val, Duration::from_secs(3), true);
                }
            }
            TextPromptKind::SaveCustomTheme => {
                match trainer::save_custom_theme(&self.stuff_dir, val, &self.cfg) {
                    Ok(()) => {
                        self.custom_themes = trainer::list_custom_themes(&self.stuff_dir);
                        sound::play(MenuSound::Select);
                        self.push_toast("Menyoo Themes", "Saved Custom Theme", val, Duration::from_secs(4), true);
                    }
                    Err(_) => sound::play(MenuSound::Error),
                }
            }
            TextPromptKind::SaveCustomVehicle => {
                let cur_veh = self.world.current_veh_ptr;
                let live_hash = if cur_veh > 0x10000
                    && let Some(mi) = trainer::safe_read::<u64>((cur_veh + 0x20) as usize)
                    && mi > 0x10000
                {
                    trainer::safe_read::<u64>((mi + 0x60) as usize).unwrap_or(0)
                } else {
                    self.live_vehicles
                        .first()
                        .map(|v| v.hash64)
                        .or_else(|| self.rvas.builtin_vehicles.first().map(|v| v.hash64))
                        .unwrap_or(0)
                };
                let neon_mask = u8::from(self.veh_neon_channels[0])
                    | (u8::from(self.veh_neon_channels[1]) << 1)
                    | (u8::from(self.veh_neon_channels[2]) << 2)
                    | (u8::from(self.veh_neon_channels[3]) << 3);
                let preset = trainer::SavedCustomVehicle {
                    name: val.to_owned(),
                    hash64: live_hash,
                    primary_rgb: self.veh_custom_rgb,
                    secondary_rgb: self.veh_sec_rgb,
                    mod_kit: self.veh_mod_kit,
                    dirt_level: self.veh_dirt_level,
                    invincible: self.veh_invincible,
                    power_mult: self.veh_power_mult,
                    plate_text: self.veh_plate_text.clone(),
                    neon_channels: if neon_mask != 0 { neon_mask } else if self.veh_neon_enabled { 0x0F } else { 0 },
                    extras_mask: self.veh_extras_mask,
                    gloss: self.veh_gloss,
                    livery: self.veh_livery,
                    fuel_rate: self.veh_fuel_rate,
                };
                match trainer::save_custom_vehicle(&self.stuff_dir, &preset) {
                    Ok(()) => {
                        self.saved_vehicles = trainer::list_saved_vehicles(&self.stuff_dir);
                        sound::play(MenuSound::Select);
                        self.push_toast("Menyoo Customs", "Saved Vehicle", val, Duration::from_secs(4), true);
                    }
                    Err(_) => sound::play(MenuSound::Error),
                }
            }
            TextPromptKind::SaveSpoonerScene => {
                let scene = hook::export_spooner_scene(val, &self.rvas);
                let count = scene.entities.len();
                match trainer::save_spooner_scene(&self.stuff_dir, &scene) {
                    Ok(()) => {
                        self.spooner_scenes = trainer::list_spooner_scenes(&self.stuff_dir);
                        sound::play(MenuSound::Select);
                        self.push_toast(
                            "Object Spooner",
                            "Scene Saved",
                            &format!("Saved \"{val}\" ({count} entities) to menyooStuff/Spooner/"),
                            Duration::from_secs(4),
                            true,
                        );
                    }
                    Err(_) => sound::play(MenuSound::Error),
                }
            }
            TextPromptKind::SaveOutfit => {
                let outfit = trainer::SavedOutfit {
                    name: val.to_owned(),
                    seed: self.wardrobe_seed,
                };
                match trainer::save_outfit(&self.stuff_dir, &outfit) {
                    Ok(()) => {
                        self.saved_outfits = trainer::list_saved_outfits(&self.stuff_dir);
                        sound::play(MenuSound::Select);
                        self.push_toast(
                            "Wardrobe",
                            "Outfit Saved",
                            &format!("Saved \"{val}\" (Seed #{}) to menyooStuff/Outfits/", self.wardrobe_seed),
                            Duration::from_secs(4),
                            true,
                        );
                    }
                    Err(_) => sound::play(MenuSound::Error),
                }
            }
            TextPromptKind::CustomPlate => {
                let clean: String = val
                    .chars()
                    .filter(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || *c == ' ' || *c == '-')
                    .take(8)
                    .collect::<String>()
                    .to_ascii_uppercase();
                if !clean.is_empty() {
                    self.veh_plate_text = clean.clone();
                    sound::play(MenuSound::Select);
                    self.push_toast("Menyoo Customs", "License Plate Tag", &format!("Plate set to \"{clean}\" (saved with custom builds)!"), Duration::from_secs(3), true);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /// Quick hotkeys usable even while Menyoo is closed (`Alt+H/B/V/T`).
    pub fn run_quick_hotkey(&mut self, code: u8) {
        if !self.cfg.quick_hotkeys {
            return;
        }
        match code {
            0 => {
                // Alt+H: Instant Heal + Repair Vehicle!
                self.execute(Action::ReplenishPlayer, 0);
            }
            1 => {
                // Alt+B: Toggle Bullet Time (0.35x <-> 1.00x)
                if (self.timescale - 1.0).abs() < 0.05 {
                    self.timescale = self.bullet_time_scale;
                    self.sync_bridge();
                    self.push_toast("Quick Hotkey (Alt+B)", "Bullet Time ON", &format!("{:.2}x Speed", self.timescale), Duration::from_secs(2), false);
                } else {
                    self.timescale = 1.0;
                    self.sync_bridge();
                    self.push_toast("Quick Hotkey (Alt+B)", "Bullet Time OFF", "1.00x Real-Time", Duration::from_secs(2), false);
                }
                sound::play(MenuSound::Select);
            }
            2 => {
                // Alt+V: Cycle Vision Hax Shader
                let next = (self.cfg.vision_preset + 1) % VISION_PRESETS.len();
                self.execute(Action::SelectVisionPreset(next), 0);
                sound::play(MenuSound::NavLeftRight);
            }
            3 => {
                // Alt+T: Teleport Forward +5m
                self.execute(Action::TeleportForward, 0);
                sound::play(MenuSound::Select);
            }
            _ => {}
        }
        self.dirty = true;
    }

    /// Handles classic Menyoo Mouse Support (`Menu::bit_mouse`) in `1920x1080` canvas coords.
    pub fn handle_mouse(
        &mut self,
        cx: i32,
        cy: i32,
        left_click: bool,
        right_click: bool,
        wheel_delta: i32,
    ) {
        if !self.is_open || !self.cfg.mouse_support {
            return;
        }
        if wheel_delta > 0 {
            self.nav_up(false);
        } else if wheel_delta < 0 {
            self.nav_down(false);
        }
        if right_click {
            self.nav_back(false);
            return;
        }

        let items = self.build_items();
        let total = items.len();
        if total == 0 {
            return;
        }
        let menu_w = 384i32;
        let menu_x = ((0.06 + self.cfg.menu_pos_x) * 1920.0).round() as i32;
        let list_y = ((0.159 + self.cfg.menu_pos_y) * 1080.0).round() as i32;
        let row_h = 38i32;

        let cur_1 = self.current_op + 1;
        let start_idx = if total <= GTA_MAXOP || cur_1 < GTA_SCROLLOP {
            0
        } else if cur_1 > total.saturating_sub(GTA_BETOP) {
            total.saturating_sub(GTA_MAXOP)
        } else {
            cur_1 - GTA_SCROLLOP
        };
        let end_idx = (start_idx + GTA_MAXOP).min(total);
        let vis_count = (end_idx - start_idx) as i32;

        if cx < menu_x || cx >= menu_x + menu_w || cy < list_y || cy >= list_y + vis_count * row_h {
            return;
        }
        let vis_i = ((cy - list_y) / row_h) as usize;
        let idx = start_idx + vis_i;
        if idx >= total || items[idx].is_break {
            return;
        }
        if self.current_op != idx {
            self.current_op = idx;
            sound::play(MenuSound::NavUpDown);
            self.dirty = true;
        }
        if left_click {
            if matches!(items[idx].right, ItemRight::Slider { adjustable: true, .. }) {
                let dir = if cx < menu_x + menu_w - 75 { -1 } else { 1 };
                self.nav_left_right(dir, false);
            } else {
                self.nav_select(false);
            }
        }
    }

    pub fn push_toast(
        &mut self,
        sender: &str,
        subtitle: &str,
        body: &str,
        duration: Duration,
        play_chime: bool,
    ) {
        if !self.cfg.show_notifications {
            return;
        }
        if self.toasts.len() >= 3 {
            self.toasts.remove(0);
        }
        self.toasts.push(FeedToast {
            sender: sender.to_owned(),
            subtitle: subtitle.to_owned(),
            body: body.to_owned(),
            created_at: Instant::now(),
            duration,
        });
        if play_chime {
            sound::play(MenuSound::TextArrive);
        }
        BRIDGE.overlay_active.store(true, Ordering::Release);
        self.dirty = true;
    }

    pub fn has_visible_hud(&self) -> bool {
        self.is_open
            || self.spooner_mode
            || self.text_prompt.is_some()
            || !self.toasts.is_empty()
            || self.cfg.display_fps
            || self.cfg.display_telemetry
            || self.cfg.display_clock
            || self.cfg.display_analogue_clock
            || self.cfg.display_speedo
            || self.cfg.display_compass
            || self.cfg.display_xyzh
            || self.cfg.cinematic_bars
            || self.cfg.uptime_badge
            || self.cfg.crosshair_style != 0
    }

    /// Periodic animation tick (rainbow fader, toast expiration, world poll, speedo/heading, auto-save).
    pub fn tick_animations(&mut self, now: Instant) {
        let before = self.toasts.len();
        self.toasts.retain(|t| t.alpha(now) > 0.005);
        if self.toasts.len() != before || !self.toasts.is_empty() {
            self.dirty = true;
        }

        // Poll read-only live world telemetry (~8 Hz when speedo/compass/xyzh active, ~4 Hz otherwise).
        let need_world = self.is_open
            || self.cfg.display_telemetry
            || self.cfg.display_speedo
            || self.cfg.display_compass
            || self.cfg.display_xyzh
            || self.cfg.display_clock
            || self.cfg.display_analogue_clock;
        let poll_ms = if self.cfg.display_speedo || self.cfg.display_compass || self.cfg.display_xyzh {
            120
        } else {
            250
        };
        if need_world && now.duration_since(self.last_world_poll) >= Duration::from_millis(poll_ms) {
            self.last_world_poll = now;
            let base = BRIDGE.title_image_base.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
            if base != 0 && self.rvas.loaded {
                let mut w = trainer::poll_world_telemetry(base, &self.rvas);
                if let Some(pos) = w.player_xyz {
                    if let Some((prev, pt)) = self.prev_world_xyz {
                        let dt = now.duration_since(pt).as_secs_f32();
                        if dt > 0.02 && dt < 2.0 {
                            let dx = pos[0] - prev[0];
                            let dy = pos[1] - prev[1];
                            let dist = dx.hypot(dy);
                            if dist < 250.0 {
                                let raw_mps = dist / dt;
                                w.speed_mps = self.world.speed_mps * 0.45 + raw_mps * 0.55;
                                if w.forward_xy.is_none() {
                                    if dist > 0.15 {
                                        w.heading_deg = (dx.atan2(dy).to_degrees()).rem_euclid(360.0);
                                    } else {
                                        w.heading_deg = self.world.heading_deg;
                                    }
                                }
                            } else {
                                w.speed_mps = 0.0;
                                if w.forward_xy.is_none() {
                                    w.heading_deg = self.world.heading_deg;
                                }
                            }
                        } else {
                            w.speed_mps = self.world.speed_mps;
                            if w.forward_xy.is_none() {
                                w.heading_deg = self.world.heading_deg;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    self.prev_world_xyz = Some((pos, now));
                }
                if let Some((h, m, _)) = w.clock_hms
                    && !self.time_sync_system
                {
                    self.time_hour = h;
                    self.time_minute = m;
                }
                self.time_paused = w.clock_paused;
                self.world = w;
                let hook_ready = hook::is_installed() && hook::tick_count() >= 15;
                let allow_initial_scan = !hook::auto_install_env() || hook_ready;
                if w.ped_ptr != 0
                    && ((allow_initial_scan && !self.live_vehicles_scanned)
                        || (hook_ready && !self.live_vehicles_named))
                {
                    self.live_vehicles_named = hook_ready;
                    self.rescan_live_vehicles(true);
                }
                if w.ped_ptr != 0 && allow_initial_scan && !self.live_props_scanned {
                    self.rescan_live_props(true);
                }
                if w.ped_ptr != 0 && allow_initial_scan && !self.live_peds_scanned {
                    self.rescan_live_peds(true);
                }
                if !self.live_weathers_scanned {
                    self.rescan_live_weathers(true);
                }
                if w.ped_ptr != 0
                    && ((allow_initial_scan && !self.live_weapons_scanned)
                        || (hook_ready && !self.live_weapons_named))
                {
                    self.live_weapons_named = hook_ready;
                    self.rescan_live_weapons(true, false);
                }
                if w.ped_ptr != 0 && hook_ready && !self.live_attachments_scanned {
                    self.rescan_live_attachments(true);
                }
                self.dirty = true;
            }
        }

        // Periodic live Sync With System Time (every 5 seconds while enabled!)
        if self.time_sync_system && now.duration_since(self.last_clock_sync) >= Duration::from_secs(5) {
            self.last_clock_sync = now;
            let (h, m, s) = local_hms();
            self.time_hour = h;
            self.time_minute = m;
            self.push_live_clock_time(h, m, s);
        }

        if self.cfg.display_analogue_clock
            || self.cfg.display_speedo
            || self.cfg.display_compass
            || self.cfg.display_xyzh
            || self.spooner_mode
            || self.text_prompt.is_some()
        {
            self.dirty = true;
        }

        BRIDGE
            .overlay_active
            .store(self.has_visible_hud(), Ordering::Release);

        // Authentic Menyoo 20 ms Rainbow Fader (`TickRainbowFader` in Routine.cpp).
        if self.cfg.rainbow_mode
            && self.is_open
            && now.duration_since(self.last_rainbow_tick) >= Duration::from_millis(20)
        {
            self.last_rainbow_tick = now;
            self.rainbow_hue = (self.rainbow_hue + 1.8) % 360.0;
            let (r, g, b) = hsv_to_rgb(self.rainbow_hue, 0.92, 1.0);
            self.cfg.titlebox.r = r;
            self.cfg.titlebox.g = g;
            self.cfg.titlebox.b = b;
            self.dirty = true;
        }

        // Glare sweep animation while open + globe enabled (~25 Hz refresh).
        if self.is_open && self.cfg.titlebox_globe {
            self.dirty = true;
        }
        // Live FPS/Telemetry/Clock HUD updates.
        if self.cfg.display_fps || self.cfg.display_telemetry || self.cfg.display_clock {
            self.dirty = true;
        }
        // Periodic config sync every 30s (matching `TickMenyooConfig` in Routine.cpp).
        if self.cfg.sync_with_config
            && now.duration_since(self.last_auto_save) >= Duration::from_secs(30)
        {
            self.last_auto_save = now;
            let _ = self.cfg.save(&self.stuff_dir);
        }
    }

    pub fn toggle_open(&mut self, via_controller: bool) {
        self.using_controller = via_controller;
        if self.is_open {
            self.close_menu();
        } else {
            self.open_menu();
        }
    }

    pub fn open_menu(&mut self) {
        self.is_open = true;
        self.current_sub = self.looc_sub;
        if self.current_sub == SubmenuId::MainMenu {
            self.current_op = 0;
        }
        self.clamp_selection(true);
        sound::play(MenuSound::FocusIn);
        if !self.first_open_done {
            self.first_open_done = true;
            // Exact MAFINS Routine.cpp line 94 homage with a cheeky GTA PC joke!
            self.push_toast(
                "",
                "",
                "Menyoo DX12 — Pure-Rust DirectX 12 Mod Menu Overlay for GTA",
                Duration::from_secs(7),
                true,
            );
        }
        self.sync_bridge();
        self.dirty = true;
    }

    pub fn close_menu(&mut self) {
        self.looc_sub = self.current_sub;
        self.is_open = false;
        sound::play(MenuSound::Back);
        self.sync_bridge();
        self.dirty = true;
    }

    pub fn nav_up(&mut self, via_controller: bool) {
        self.using_controller = via_controller;
        let items = self.build_items();
        if items.is_empty() {
            return;
        }
        let n = items.len();
        for _ in 0..n {
            if self.current_op == 0 {
                self.current_op = n - 1;
            } else {
                self.current_op -= 1;
            }
            if !items[self.current_op].is_break {
                break;
            }
        }
        sound::play(MenuSound::NavUpDown);
        self.dirty = true;
    }

    pub fn nav_down(&mut self, via_controller: bool) {
        self.using_controller = via_controller;
        let items = self.build_items();
        if items.is_empty() {
            return;
        }
        let n = items.len();
        for _ in 0..n {
            self.current_op = (self.current_op + 1) % n;
            if !items[self.current_op].is_break {
                break;
            }
        }
        sound::play(MenuSound::NavUpDown);
        self.dirty = true;
    }

    pub fn nav_back(&mut self, via_controller: bool) {
        self.using_controller = via_controller;
        if let Some((prev_sub, prev_op)) = self.stack.pop() {
            self.current_sub = prev_sub;
            self.current_op = prev_op;
            self.clamp_selection(true);
            sound::play(MenuSound::Back);
            self.dirty = true;
        } else {
            self.close_menu();
        }
    }

    pub fn nav_select(&mut self, via_controller: bool) {
        self.using_controller = via_controller;
        let items = self.build_items();
        let Some(item) = items.get(self.current_op) else {
            return;
        };
        if item.is_break {
            return;
        }
        let action = item.action;
        if matches!(action, Action::None) {
            sound::play(MenuSound::Error);
            return;
        }
        if !matches!(action, Action::TestSound(_)) {
            sound::play(MenuSound::Select);
        }
        self.execute(action, 0);
        self.dirty = true;
    }

    pub fn nav_left_right(&mut self, dir: i32, via_controller: bool) {
        self.using_controller = via_controller;
        let items = self.build_items();
        let Some(item) = items.get(self.current_op) else {
            return;
        };
        if !matches!(item.right, ItemRight::Slider { adjustable: true, .. }) {
            return;
        }
        sound::play(MenuSound::NavLeftRight);
        self.execute(item.action, dir);
        self.dirty = true;
    }

    fn enter_sub(&mut self, next: SubmenuId) {
        if self.stack.len() < 100 {
            self.stack.push((self.current_sub, self.current_op));
        }
        self.current_sub = next;
        self.current_op = 0;
        if next == SubmenuId::CashEditor {
            let _ = hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::RefreshCashBalances);
        }
        self.clamp_selection(true);
    }

    fn clamp_selection(&mut self, forward: bool) {
        let items = self.build_items();
        if items.is_empty() {
            self.current_op = 0;
            return;
        }
        if self.current_op >= items.len() {
            self.current_op = items.len() - 1;
        }
        if items[self.current_op].is_break {
            let n = items.len();
            for _ in 0..n {
                self.current_op = if forward {
                    (self.current_op + 1) % n
                } else if self.current_op == 0 {
                    n - 1
                } else {
                    self.current_op - 1
                };
                if !items[self.current_op].is_break {
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /// Builds the full item list for the active submenu (1:1 MAFINS MenyooSP structure!).
    pub fn build_items(&self) -> Vec<MenuItem> {
        let mut items = Vec::with_capacity(24);
        match self.current_sub {
            // Exact 1:1 original `MainMenu.cpp` order & labels!
            SubmenuId::MainMenu => {
                items.push(MenuItem::submenu("Players", SubmenuId::Players, "Active GTA session & hardware status", true));
                items.push(MenuItem::submenu("Player Options", SubmenuId::PlayerOptions, "God Mode, Invisibility, Seatbelt, Ignored, Wanted, No-Clip & Super Run", true));
                items.push(MenuItem::submenu("Vehicle Options", SubmenuId::VehicleOptions, "All-Vehicles Spawner, Rainbow/RGB Customs, Seatbelt, Horn Boost & Fly", true));
                items.push(MenuItem::submenu("Teleport Options", SubmenuId::TeleportOptions, "Waypoint Teleport, GTA landmarks, custom XYZ & favourites", true));
                items.push(MenuItem::submenu("Weapon Options", SubmenuId::WeaponOptions, "Give All Weapons, Infinite Ammo, No Reload, One-Hit Kill & Explosive", true));
                items.push(MenuItem::submenu("Weather Options", SubmenuId::WeatherLighting, "Engine weather, real-time ambient GI & SSAO", true));
                items.push(MenuItem::submenu("Time Options", SubmenuId::TimeOptions, "World clock, Game speed, bullet time & clock HUD", true));
                items.push(MenuItem::submenu("Object Spooner", SubmenuId::ObjectSpooner, "LIVE world prop spawner, move/rotate/freeze/god-mode & deletion", true));
                items.push(MenuItem::submenu("Misc Options", SubmenuId::MiscOptions, "Meteor Shower, Studio Presets, Vision Hax, Population Density & Tools", true));
                items.push(MenuItem::submenu("Settings", SubmenuId::Settings, "Themes, colours, fonts, sounds & INI config", true));
            }

            SubmenuId::Players => {
                let base = BRIDGE.title_image_base.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
                let pad = BRIDGE.pad_connected.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
                items.push(MenuItem::tag("Active Player", "GTA SP (Host)".into(), "Offline single-player session (SCARLETT_OFFLINE=1)", true));
                items.push(MenuItem::tag("Input Mode", if pad { "Gamepad Pad + KB/M" } else { "PC Keyboard & Mouse" }.into(), "Detected active input controller", true));
                items.push(MenuItem::tag("Title Image Base", if base != 0 { format!("0x{base:X}") } else { "Preview Mode".into() }, "Mapped virtual base of game executable in Host", true));
                items.push(MenuItem::tag("Presented Frames", format!("{}", BRIDGE.frame_count.load(Ordering::Relaxed)), "Live frames presented through Host swapchain", true));
                items.push(MenuItem::sep("---Live World (rvas.json)---"));
                let xyz_str = self.world.player_xyz.map_or_else(
                    || if base == 0 { "Preview Mode".into() } else { "Waiting for ped".into() },
                    |[x, y, z]| format!("{x:.1}, {y:.1}, {z:.1}"),
                );
                items.push(MenuItem::tag("Player XYZ", xyz_str, "Live CPed position read via hot-reloadable rvas.json", true));
                let clk_str = self.world.clock_hms.map_or_else(
                    || format!("{:02}:{:02} (Preview)", self.time_hour, self.time_minute),
                    |(h, m, s)| format!("{h:02}:{m:02}:{s:02}{}", if self.world.clock_paused { " [PAUSED]" } else { "" }),
                );

                };
                let val_lbl = match self.scanner.scan_type {

                    ScanType::Int32 => format!("{}", self.scanner.target_int),
                };
                items.push(MenuItem::slider("Value Type", ty_lbl.into(), Action::ScanCycleType, "Toggle between 32-bit Float and 32-bit Integer scan", true));
                items.push(MenuItem::slider("Target Value", val_lbl, Action::ScanAdjustTarget, "Adjust target value (Left/Right) for scan or write", true));
                items.push(MenuItem::option("First Scan (Writable Title RAM)", Action::ScanFirst, &self.scanner.last_status, true));
                items.push(MenuItem::option("Next Scan: Equal to Target", Action::ScanRefine(ScanFilter::Equal), "Filter hits matching current Target Value", true));
                items.push(MenuItem::option("Next Scan: Changed", Action::ScanRefine(ScanFilter::Changed), "Keep only addresses whose value changed", true));
                items.push(MenuItem::option("Next Scan: Unchanged", Action::ScanRefine(ScanFilter::Unchanged), "Keep only addresses whose value stayed identical", true));
                items.push(MenuItem::option("Next Scan: Increased", Action::ScanRefine(ScanFilter::Increased), "Keep only addresses whose value increased", true));
                items.push(MenuItem::option("Next Scan: Decreased", Action::ScanRefine(ScanFilter::Decreased), "Keep only addresses whose value decreased", true));
                items.push(MenuItem::option("Clear Scan Results", Action::ScanClear, "Reset live memory scanner hits", true));
                if !self.scanner.hits.is_empty() {
                    items.push(MenuItem::sep(&format!("---Hits ({}) | Select=Write---", self.scanner.hits.len())));
                    let base = BRIDGE.title_image_base.load(Ordering::Relaxed) as usize;
                    for (idx, &hit) in self.scanner.hits.iter().take(12).enumerate() {
                        let rva_lbl = if base != 0 && hit.addr >= base {
                            format!("+0x{:X}", hit.addr - base)
                        } else {
                            format!("0x{:X}", hit.addr)
                        };
                        let cur_v = self.scanner.format_hit_value(hit);
                        items.push(MenuItem::option(
                            &format!("{rva_lbl}  =  {cur_v}"),
                            Action::ScanWriteHit(idx),
                            "Press Select to safely write Target Value to this address",
                            true,
                        ));
                    }
                }
            }
