```rs
                    MenuSound::Error,
                ] {
                    items.push(MenuItem::option(
                        cue.display_name(),
                        Action::TestSound(cue),
                        "Press Select to audition sound cue",
                        true,
                    ));
                }
            }
        }
        items
    }

    fn colour_ref(&self, target: ColourTarget) -> Rgba {
        match target {
            ColourTarget::TitleBox => self.cfg.titlebox,
            ColourTarget::Background => self.cfg.bg,
            ColourTarget::TitleText => self.cfg.titletext,
            ColourTarget::OptionText => self.cfg.optiontext,
            ColourTarget::SelectedText => self.cfg.selectedtext,
            ColourTarget::OptionBreaks => self.cfg.optionbreaks,
            ColourTarget::OptionCount => self.cfg.optioncount,
            ColourTarget::SelectionBox => self.cfg.selectionhi,
            ColourTarget::Accent => self.cfg.accent,
        }
    }

    fn colour_mut(&mut self, target: ColourTarget) -> &mut Rgba {
        match target {
            ColourTarget::TitleBox => &mut self.cfg.titlebox,
            ColourTarget::Background => &mut self.cfg.bg,
            ColourTarget::TitleText => &mut self.cfg.titletext,
            ColourTarget::OptionText => &mut self.cfg.optiontext,
            ColourTarget::SelectedText => &mut self.cfg.selectedtext,
            ColourTarget::OptionBreaks => &mut self.cfg.optionbreaks,
            ColourTarget::OptionCount => &mut self.cfg.optioncount,
            ColourTarget::SelectionBox => &mut self.cfg.selectionhi,
            ColourTarget::Accent => &mut self.cfg.accent,
        }
    }

    fn font_ref(&self, target: FontTarget) -> MenuFont {
        match target {
            FontTarget::Title => self.cfg.font_title,
            FontTarget::Options => self.cfg.font_options,
            FontTarget::Selection => self.cfg.font_selection,
            FontTarget::Breaks => self.cfg.font_breaks,
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn execute(&mut self, action: Action, dir: i32) {
        let step_dir = if dir == 0 { 1 } else { dir };
        match action {
            Action::None => {}
            Action::OpenSub(sub) => self.enter_sub(sub),
            Action::OpenTextPrompt(kind) => self.open_text_prompt(kind),

            // --- Player & LIVE Controls ---
            Action::ReplenishPlayer => {
                if hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::ReplenishAndRepair) {
                    self.push_toast("", "", "Chugged a Sprunk & patched your ankle monitor. Health & car restored!", Duration::from_secs(4), true);
                } else {
                    self.push_toast("Menyoo", "Hook Off", "Enable Main-Thread Cheat Hook in RVA Inspector first.", Duration::from_secs(4), false);
                }
            }
            Action::TogglePlayerInvincible => {
                self.player_invincible = !self.player_invincible;
                self.sync_hook_loops();
                let _ = hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::SetPlayerGodMode(self.player_invincible));
                self.push_toast(
                    "",
                    "",
                    if self.player_invincible {
                        "God Mode ON — Native DPF_NotDamagedByAnything + health/armor lock."
                    } else {
                        "God Mode OFF — Back to regular Local Resident mortality."
                    },
                    Duration::from_secs(4),
                    false,
                );
            }
            Action::TogglePlayerInvisible => {
                self.player_invisible = !self.player_invisible;
                self.sync_hook_loops();
                let _ = hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::SetPlayerInvisible(self.player_invisible));
                self.push_toast(
                    "",
                    "",
                    if self.player_invisible {
                        "Invisibility ON — SetEntityAlpha(0) active!"
                    } else {
                        "Invisibility OFF — ResetEntityAlpha restored visibility."
                    },
                    Duration::from_secs(3),
                    false,
                );
            }
            Action::ToggleNoRagdoll => {
                self.player_no_ragdoll = !self.player_no_ragdoll;
                self.sync_hook_loops();
                let _ = hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::SetPedNoRagdoll(self.player_no_ragdoll));
                self.push_toast(
                    "",
                    "",
                    if self.player_no_ragdoll {
                        "No Ragdoll ON — Rock-solid stance enabled."
                    } else {
                        "No Ragdoll OFF — Ragdoll physics restored."
                    },
                    Duration::from_secs(3),
                    false,
                );
            }
            Action::ToggleSeatbelt => {
                self.player_seatbelt = !self.player_seatbelt;
                self.sync_hook_loops();
                let _ = hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::SetSeatbelt(self.player_seatbelt));
                self.push_toast(
                    "",
                    "",
                    if self.player_seatbelt {
                        "Seatbelt ON — Buckle up! Anti-eject & in-vehicle ragdoll protection active."
                    } else {
                        "Seatbelt OFF — Windshield physics restored."
                    },
                    Duration::from_secs(3),
                    false,
                );
            }
            Action::ToggleSuperRun => {
                self.player_super_run = !self.player_super_run;
                self.sync_hook_loops();
                self.push_toast(
                    "",
                    "",
                    if self.player_super_run {
                        "Super Run ON — Hold W + Shift on foot for GTA Flash speed!"
                    } else {
                        "Super Run OFF."
                    },
                    Duration::from_secs(4),
                    false,
                );
            }
            Action::ToggleSuperJump => {
                self.player_super_jump = !self.player_super_jump;
                self.sync_hook_loops();
                self.push_toast(
                    "",
                    "",
                    if self.player_super_jump {
                        "Super Jump ON — Native PLAYER_RESET_FLAG_SUPER_JUMP_ON active!"
                    } else {
                        "Super Jump OFF."
                    },
                    Duration::from_secs(3),
                    false,
                );
            }
            Action::ToggleNeverWanted => {
                self.player_never_wanted = !self.player_never_wanted;
                if self.player_never_wanted {
                    self.player_wanted_level = 0;
                    let _ = hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::SetWantedLevel(0));
                }
                self.sync_hook_loops();
                self.push_toast(
                    "",
                    "",
                    if self.player_never_wanted {
                        "Never Wanted ON — City PD mysteriously lost your license plate."
                    } else {
                        "Never Wanted OFF — City PD remembers who you are."
                    },
                    Duration::from_secs(4),
                    false,
                );
            }
            Action::AdjustWantedLevel => {
                self.player_wanted_level = (self.player_wanted_level + step_dir).clamp(0, 6);
                if self.player_wanted_level > 0 {
                    self.player_never_wanted = false;
                    self.sync_hook_loops();
                }
                let _ = hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::SetWantedLevel(self.player_wanted_level));
                if self.player_wanted_level == 5 {
                    self.push_toast("City PD", "5 STARS", "Every state trooper and tactical gator in GTA is en route.", Duration::from_secs(4), false);
                } else if self.player_wanted_level == 6 {
                    self.push_toast("GTA National Guard", "6 STARS (UNCAPPED!)", "Maximum 6-Star military alert engaged across GTA!", Duration::from_secs(5), true);
                }
            }
            Action::ToggleBuiltInCheatFlag(idx) => {
                if hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::ToggleBuiltInCheatFlag(idx)) {
                    self.push_toast("Built-In Cheat", "LIVE Toggle", &format!("Toggled g_CheatFlags[{idx}]"), Duration::from_secs(3), false);
                } else {
                    // Direct safe byte toggle even without main-thread hook!
                    let base = BRIDGE.title_image_base.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
                    if base != 0 && self.rvas.cheat_flags_base != 0 {
                        let addr = (base + self.rvas.cheat_flags_base + idx as u64) as usize;
                        if let Some(cur) = trainer::safe_read::<u8>(addr) {
                            let _ = trainer::safe_write::<u8>(addr, cur ^ 1);
                            self.push_toast("Built-In Cheat", "Direct RAM Toggle", &format!("g_CheatFlags[{idx}] = {}", cur ^ 1), Duration::from_secs(3), false);
                        }
                    } else {
                        self.push_toast("Built-In Cheat", "Preview Mode", &format!("g_CheatFlags[{idx}] ready for live title."), Duration::from_secs(3), false);
                    }
                }
            }
            Action::TogglePlayerProof(flag) => {
                let bit = 1u32 << flag;
                let next_on = (self.player_proofs_mask & bit) == 0;
                if next_on {
                    self.player_proofs_mask |= bit;
                } else {
                    self.player_proofs_mask &= !bit;
                }
                let _ = hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::SetPlayerDamageProofFlag {
                    flag,
                    enable: next_on,
                });
                self.push_toast(
                    "Damage Proofs",
                    if next_on { "Enabled" } else { "Disabled" },
                    &format!("eDamageProofFlags[{flag}] = {next_on}"),
                    Duration::from_secs(3),
                    false,
                );
            }
            Action::ToggleInfStamina => {
                self.player_inf_stamina = !self.player_inf_stamina;
                self.sync_hook_loops();
                self.push_toast(
                    "Player Options",
                    "Infinite Stamina",
                    if self.player_inf_stamina { "Infinite Stamina ON." } else { "Infinite Stamina OFF." },
                    Duration::from_secs(3),
                    false,
                );
            }
            Action::ForcePlayerSkyfall => {
                if hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::ForcePlayerSkyfall) {
                    self.push_toast("Player Options", "Skyfall!", "Launched +26 m/s skyward!", Duration::from_secs(3), true);
                }
            }
            Action::RandomizeWardrobe => {
                if hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::RandomizePlayerWardrobe) {
                    self.push_toast("Player Options", "Wardrobe", "Applied native SetPedRandomVariation!", Duration::from_secs(3), true);
                }
            }
            Action::AddStoryCash { amount, bank } => {
                if hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::AddStoryCash { amount, bank }) {
                    self.push_toast(
                        "Cash & Bank",
                        "CURRENCY_CASH",
                        &format!("Added +${amount} directly to Story Mode inventory!"),
                        Duration::from_secs(4),
                        true,
                    );
                } else {
                    self.push_toast("Cash & Bank", "Hook Off", "Enable Main-Thread Hook in RVA Inspector first.", Duration::from_secs(4), false);
                }
            }
            Action::RefreshCashBalances => {
                let _ = hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::RefreshCashBalances);
                self.push_toast("Cash & Bank", "Refreshed", "Queried live Story Mode Wallet & Bank balances.", Duration::from_secs(2), false);
            }
            Action::AdjustWardrobeSeed => {
                self.wardrobe_seed = ((self.wardrobe_seed as i32 + step_dir).rem_euclid(256)) as u32;
                let _ = hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::SetPedWardrobeSeed(self.wardrobe_seed));
            }
            Action::ApplyWardrobeSeed => {
                if hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::SetPedWardrobeSeed(self.wardrobe_seed)) {
                    self.push_toast(
                        "Wardrobe",
                        "Outfit Applied",
                        &format!("Applied deterministic outfit Seed #{}!", self.wardrobe_seed),
                        Duration::from_secs(3),
                        true,
                    );
                }
            }
            Action::LoadSavedOutfit(idx) => {
                if let Some(name) = self.saved_outfits.get(idx).cloned()
                    && let Some(o) = trainer::load_outfit(&self.stuff_dir, &name)
                {
                    self.wardrobe_seed = o.seed;
                    let _ = hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::SetPedWardrobeSeed(o.seed));
                    self.push_toast(
                        "Wardrobe",
                        "Loaded Outfit",
                        &format!("Applied \"{}\" (Seed #{})!", o.name, o.seed),
                        Duration::from_secs(3),
                        true,
                    );
                }
            }
            Action::ScanLivePeds => {
                self.rescan_live_peds(false);
                self.current_op = 0;
                self.clamp_selection(true);
            }
            Action::ClearPedSearch => {
                self.ped_search.clear();
                self.current_op = 0;
                self.clamp_selection(true);
            }
            Action::SpawnLivePed { idx, bodyguard } => {
                if self.live_peds.is_empty() {
                    self.rescan_live_peds(false);
                }
                if let Some(p) = self.live_peds.get(idx).cloned() {
                    let role = if bodyguard { self.ped_spawn_role } else { 0 };
                    let (wep_hash, wep_name) = self.selected_ped_weapon();
                    let inv = role == 1 && self.ped_spawn_invincible;
                    if hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::SpawnPedEx {
                        hash64: p.hash64,
                        role,
                        weapon_hash32: if role == 0 { 0 } else { wep_hash },
                        invincible: inv,
                        add_to_spooner: true,
                    }) {
                        self.sync_hook_loops();
                        let role_lbl = PED_SPAWN_ROLES[(role as usize) % PED_SPAWN_ROLES.len()];
                        self.push_toast(
                            "Peds & Squad AI",
                            role_lbl,
                            &format!("Spawning {} armed with {}!", p.name, wep_name),
                            Duration::from_secs(3),
                            true,
                        );
                    } else {
                        self.push_toast("Ped Spawner", "Hook Off", "Enable Main-Thread Hook in RVA Inspector first.", Duration::from_secs(4), false);
                    }
                }
            }
            Action::ToggleBodyguardFollow => {
                self.bodyguard_follow = !self.bodyguard_follow;
                self.sync_hook_loops();
            }
            Action::ClearBodyguards => {
                let _ = hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::ClearBodyguards);
                self.sync_hook_loops();
                self.push_toast("Peds & Bodyguards", "Cleared", "Dismissed all spawned bodyguards.", Duration::from_secs(3), false);
            }
            Action::ToggleAutoClean => {
                self.player_auto_clean = !self.player_auto_clean;
                self.sync_hook_loops();
                self.push_toast("", "", if self.player_auto_clean { "Auto-Clean ON." } else { "Auto-Clean OFF." }, Duration::from_secs(3), false);
            }
            Action::ToggleIgnored => {
                self.player_ignored = !self.player_ignored;
                if self.player_ignored {
                    self.player_wanted_level = 0;
                }
                self.sync_hook_loops();
                let _ = hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::SetIgnoredByAll(self.player_ignored));
                self.push_toast(
                    "",
                    "",
                    if self.player_ignored {
                        "Ignored By Everyone ON — Police & World NPCs completely ignore you!"
                    } else {
                        "Ignored By Everyone OFF — NPC & police awareness restored."
                    },
                    Duration::from_secs(4),
                    false,
                );
            }
            Action::ToggleFreeCam => {
                self.freecam_enabled = !self.freecam_enabled;
                self.sync_hook_loops();
                let _ = hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::SetEntityFrozen(self.freecam_enabled));
                self.push_toast(
                    "",
                    "",
                    if self.freecam_enabled {
                        "FreeCam No-Clip ON — Close menu & fly with WASD + Space/Ctrl + Shift!"
                    } else {
                        "FreeCam No-Clip OFF — Gravity & physics restored."
                    },
                    Duration::from_secs(5),
                    true,
                );
            }
            Action::AdjustNoclipSpeed => {
                self.noclip_speed = ((self.noclip_speed + step_dir as f32 * 0.25) * 4.0).round() / 4.0;
                self.noclip_speed = self.noclip_speed.clamp(0.25, 5.0);
                self.sync_hook_loops();
            }

            Action::ToggleMouseLookLive => {
                BRIDGE.toggle_mouse_look_req.store(true, Ordering::Release);
            }
            Action::AdjustMouseSens => {
                self.mouse_sens = ((self.mouse_sens + step_dir as f32 * 0.05) * 20.0).round() / 20.0;
                self.mouse_sens = self.mouse_sens.clamp(0.10, 4.00);
                BRIDGE.kbm_override.store(true, Ordering::Release);
                self.sync_bridge();
            }
            Action::AdjustMouseDeadzone => {
                self.mouse_deadzone = ((self.mouse_deadzone + step_dir as f32 * 0.02) * 50.0).round() / 50.0;
                self.mouse_deadzone = self.mouse_deadzone.clamp(0.0, 0.50);
                BRIDGE.kbm_override.store(true, Ordering::Release);
                self.sync_bridge();
            }
            Action::ToggleMouseInvertY => {
                self.mouse_invert_y = !self.mouse_invert_y;
                BRIDGE.kbm_override.store(true, Ordering::Release);
                self.sync_bridge();
            }
            Action::ToggleAutoSprint => {
                self.auto_sprint = !self.auto_sprint;
                self.sync_bridge();
                self.push_toast(
                    "Menyoo Controls",
                    "LIVE Input Assist",
                    if self.auto_sprint { "Auto-Sprint ON" } else { "Auto-Sprint OFF" },
                    Duration::from_secs(3),
                    false,
                );
            }
            Action::ToggleDisableRumble => {
                self.disable_rumble = !self.disable_rumble;
                self.sync_bridge();
            }
            Action::TestRumble => {
                BRIDGE.test_rumble_ticks.store(32, Ordering::Release);
                self.push_toast("Menyoo Controls", "Haptics", "Sent rumble pulse to Slot 0 pad.", Duration::from_secs(2), false);
            }

            // --- Vehicle ---
            Action::SpawnVehicle(idx) => {
                if let Some((name, _)) = VEHICLE_CATALOG.get(idx) {
                    self.push_toast("Vehicle Spawner", "Preview Mode", &format!("{name}: launch GTA to auto-scan all real models."), Duration::from_secs(3), false);
                }
            }
            Action::SpawnBuiltInVehicle(idx) => {
                if let Some(v) = self.rvas.builtin_vehicles.get(idx).cloned() {
                    if hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::SpawnVehicleHash64 {
                        hash64: v.hash64,
                        keep_prev: self.cfg.keep_spawned_vehicles,
                        warp_inside: self.cfg.spawn_inside_vehicle,
                    }) {
                        self.push_toast(
                            "",
                            "",
                            &format!("Streaming & spawning {} from Menyoo Customs (auto-retry active)!", v.name),
                            Duration::from_secs(3),
                            true,
                        );
                    } else {
                        self.push_toast(
                            "Vehicle Spawner",
                            "Hook Off",
                            "Enable Main-Thread Cheat Hook in RVA Inspector first.",
                            Duration::from_secs(4),
                            false,
                        );
                    }
                }
            }
            Action::SpawnLiveVehicle(idx) => {
                if let Some(v) = self.live_vehicles.get(idx).cloned() {
                    if hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::SpawnVehicleHash64 {
                        hash64: v.hash64,
                        keep_prev: self.cfg.keep_spawned_vehicles,
                        warp_inside: self.cfg.spawn_inside_vehicle,
                    }) {
                        self.push_toast(
                            "",
                            "",
                            &format!("Streaming & spawning {} [{}] (auto-retry active)!", v.name, v.category),
                            Duration::from_secs(3),
                            true,
                        );
                    } else {
                        self.push_toast(
                            "Vehicle Spawner",
                            "Hook Off",
                            "Enable Main-Thread Cheat Hook in RVA Inspector first.",
                            Duration::from_secs(4),
                            false,
                        );
                    }
                }
            }
            Action::ScanLiveVehicles => {
                self.rescan_live_vehicles(false);
                self.current_op = 0;
                self.clamp_selection(true);
            }
            Action::CycleVehicleCategory => {
                self.veh_category_idx = ((self.veh_category_idx as i32 + step_dir)
                    .rem_euclid(VEHICLE_CATEGORIES.len() as i32)) as usize;
                self.clamp_selection(true);
            }
            Action::ToggleKeepSpawnedVehicles => {
                self.cfg.keep_spawned_vehicles = !self.cfg.keep_spawned_vehicles;
            }
            Action::ToggleSpawnInsideVehicle => {
                self.cfg.spawn_inside_vehicle = !self.cfg.spawn_inside_vehicle;
                self.push_toast(
                    "Vehicle Spawner",
                    "Spawn Inside",
                    if self.cfg.spawn_inside_vehicle {
                        "Auto-warp into driver's seat ON!"
                    } else {
                        "Spawn in front of player (ground-drop) mode."
                    },
                    Duration::from_secs(3),
                    false,
                );
            }
            Action::WarpIntoLastVehicle => {
                if hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::WarpIntoLastSpawnedVehicle) {
                    self.push_toast("Menyoo Vehicle", "Driver Seat", "Warped into last spawned vehicle!", Duration::from_secs(3), true);
                }
            }
            Action::ClearVehicleSearch => {
                self.vehicle_search.clear();
                self.current_op = 0;
                self.clamp_selection(true);
            }
            Action::VehicleRepair => {
                self.veh_dirt_level = 0.0;
                let _ = hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::SetVehicleDirtLevel(0.0));
                if hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::VehicleRepairSilent) {
                    self.push_toast("Menyoo Vehicle", "LIVE Repair", "Repaired & washed vehicle on main thread!", Duration::from_secs(3), true);
                } else {
                    self.push_toast("Menyoo Vehicle", "Hook Off", "Enable Main-Thread Hook in RVA Inspector first.", Duration::from_secs(4), false);
                }
            }
            Action::FlipVehicleUpright => {
                if hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::FlipVehicleUpright) {
                    self.push_toast("Menyoo Vehicle", "Flip Upright", "Leveled vehicle upright onto road!", Duration::from_secs(3), true);
                }
            }
            Action::DeleteCurrentVehicle => {
                if hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::DeleteCurrentVehicle) {
                    self.push_toast("Menyoo Vehicle", "Deleted", "Removed vehicle via DestroyEntity!", Duration::from_secs(3), true);
                }
            }
            Action::ToggleVehicleEngine => {
                if hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::ToggleVehicleEngine) {
                    self.push_toast("Menyoo Vehicle", "Engine", "Toggled vehicle engine state!", Duration::from_secs(3), false);
                }
            }
            Action::VehicleDoorsAll(mode) => {
                let _ = hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::VehicleDoors { mode, door_idx: -1 });
                let lbl = match mode {
                    0 => "Opened all doors!",
                    1 => "Shut all doors!",
                    _ => "Popped all doors!",
                };
                self.push_toast("Vehicle Doors", "LIVE", lbl, Duration::from_secs(3), false);
            }
            Action::VehicleDoorSingle(mode, door_idx) => {
                let _ = hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::VehicleDoors { mode, door_idx });

            Action::ToggleVehWeapons => {
                self.veh_weapons = !self.veh_weapons;
                self.sync_hook_loops();
                self.push_toast(
                    "Menyoo Vehicle",
                    "Vehicle Weapons",
                    if self.veh_weapons { "Vehicle Rockets ON — Press LMB / E / L3 while driving!" } else { "Vehicle Weapons OFF." },
                    Duration::from_secs(3),
                    false,
                );
            }
            Action::AdjustVehPowerMult => {
                self.veh_power_mult = ((self.veh_power_mult + step_dir as f32 * 0.25) * 4.0).round() / 4.0;

                self.sync_hook_loops();
            }

                self.veh_sec_rgb[0] = (self.veh_sec_rgb[0] as i32 + step_dir * 5).clamp(0, 255) as u8;
                let _ = hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::SetVehicleSecondaryRgb(self.veh_sec_rgb));
            }
            Action::AdjustVehSecG => {
                self.veh_sec_rgb[1] = (self.veh_sec_rgb[1] as i32 + step_dir * 5).clamp(0, 255) as u8;
                let _ = hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::SetVehicleSecondaryRgb(self.veh_sec_rgb));
            }
            Action::AdjustVehSecB => {
                self.veh_sec_rgb[2] = (self.veh_sec_rgb[2] as i32 + step_dir * 5).clamp(0, 255) as u8;
                let _ = hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::SetVehicleSecondaryRgb(self.veh_sec_rgb));
            }
            Action::ApplyVehSecPreset(idx) => {
                if let Some((name, rgb)) = PRESET_COLOURS.get(idx) {
                    self.veh_sec_rgb = *rgb;
                    let _ = hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::SetVehicleSecondaryRgb(*rgb));
                    self.push_toast("Menyoo Customs", "Secondary Paint", &format!("Applied 2nd color: {name}"), Duration::from_secs(3), true);
                }
            }
            Action::ToggleVehNeon => {
                self.veh_neon_enabled = !self.veh_neon_enabled;
                self.veh_neon_channels = [self.veh_neon_enabled; 4];
                let _ = hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::SetVehicleNeonChannels(self.veh_neon_channels));
                if self.veh_neon_enabled {
                    let _ = hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::SetVehicleNeonRgb(self.veh_neon_rgb));
                }
                self.push_toast(
                    "Menyoo Customs",
                    "Underglow Neon",
                    if self.veh_neon_enabled { "All 4 neon underglow tubes ON!" } else { "Underglow neon OFF." },
                    Duration::from_secs(3),
                    self.veh_neon_enabled,
                );
            }
            Action::AdjustVehNeonR => {
                self.veh_neon_rgb[0] = (self.veh_neon_rgb[0] as i32 + step_dir * 5).clamp(0, 255) as u8;
                let _ = hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::SetVehicleNeonRgb(self.veh_neon_rgb));
            }
            Action::AdjustVehNeonG => {
                self.veh_neon_rgb[1] = (self.veh_neon_rgb[1] as i32 + step_dir * 5).clamp(0, 255) as u8;

                    let _ = hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::SetVehicleNeonRgb(*rgb));
                    self.push_toast("Menyoo Customs", "Neon Kit", &format!("Applied {name} underglow neon!"), Duration::from_secs(3), true);
                }

            Action::AdjustVehDirtLevel => {
                self.veh_dirt_level = ((self.veh_dirt_level + step_dir as f32 * 0.1) * 10.0).round() / 10.0;
                self.veh_dirt_level = self.veh_dirt_level.clamp(0.0, 1.0);
                let _ = hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::SetVehicleDirtLevel(self.veh_dirt_level));
            }
            Action::AdjustVehModKit => {
                self.veh_mod_kit = ((self.veh_mod_kit as i32 + step_dir).rem_euclid(33)) as u32;
                let _ = hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::SetVehicleModKit(self.veh_mod_kit));
            }
            Action::MaxUpgradeVehicle => {
                self.veh_dirt_level = 0.0;
                self.veh_power_mult = self.veh_power_mult.max(2.0);
                self.veh_invincible = true;
                self.veh_bulletproof_tires = true;
                self.veh_grip_mult = 1.35;
                self.veh_gloss = 1.0;
                self.veh_fuel_rate = 0.0;
                self.veh_neon_enabled = true;
                self.veh_neon_channels = [true; 4];
                self.veh_mod_bits_mask |=
                    (1 << 23) | (1 << 24) | (1 << 25) | (1 << 26) | (1 << 27) | (1 << 28) | (1 << 29);
                self.sync_hook_loops();
                let _ = hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::SetVehicleGodMode(true));
                let _ = hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::MaxUpgradeVehicle);
                self.push_toast("Menyoo Customs", "MAX UPGRADE", "Full Turbo/Nitrous/Subwoofer/Xenon/Neon/Bulletproof/Gloss/0x Fuel!", Duration::from_secs(4), true);
            }
            Action::LoadSavedVehicle(idx) => {
                if let Some(name) = self.saved_vehicles.get(idx).cloned()
                    && let Some(v) = trainer::load_custom_vehicle(&self.stuff_dir, &name)
                {
                    self.veh_custom_rgb = v.primary_rgb;
                    self.veh_sec_rgb = v.secondary_rgb;
                    self.veh_mod_kit = v.mod_kit;
                    self.veh_dirt_level = v.dirt_level;
                    self.veh_invincible = v.invincible;
                    self.veh_power_mult = v.power_mult;
                    self.veh_plate_text = v.plate_text.clone();
                    self.veh_neon_channels = [
                        (v.neon_channels & 1) != 0,
                        (v.neon_channels & 2) != 0,
                        (v.neon_channels & 4) != 0,
                        (v.neon_channels & 8) != 0,
                    ];
                    self.veh_neon_enabled = v.neon_channels != 0;
                    self.veh_extras_mask = v.extras_mask;
                    self.veh_gloss = v.gloss;
                    self.veh_livery = v.livery;
                    self.veh_fuel_rate = v.fuel_rate;
                    self.veh_rainbow = false;
                    self.sync_hook_loops();
                    if v.hash64 != 0 {
                        let _ = hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::SpawnVehicleHash64 {
                            hash64: v.hash64,
                            keep_prev: self.cfg.keep_spawned_vehicles,
                            warp_inside: self.cfg.spawn_inside_vehicle,
                        });
                    }
                    let _ = hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::SetVehicleCustomRgb(v.primary_rgb));
                    let _ = hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::SetVehicleSecondaryRgb(v.secondary_rgb));
                    let _ = hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::SetVehicleModKit(v.mod_kit));
                    let _ = hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::SetVehicleDirtLevel(v.dirt_level));
                    let _ = hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::SetVehicleGodMode(v.invincible));
                    let _ = hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::SetVehicleNeonChannels(self.veh_neon_channels));
                    let _ = hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::SetVehicleGloss(v.gloss));
                    let _ = hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::SetVehicleLivery(v.livery));
                    let _ = hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::SetVehicleFuelRate(v.fuel_rate));
                    for extra_id in 1..=13u32 {
                        if (v.extras_mask & (1u32 << extra_id)) != 0 {
                            let _ = hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::SetVehicleExtra { extra_id, enable: true });
                        }
                    }
                    self.push_toast("Menyoo Customs", "Loaded Ride", &format!("Loaded custom build: {} [{}]", v.name, v.plate_text), Duration::from_secs(4), true);
                }
            }
            Action::ToggleVehInvincible => {
                self.veh_invincible = !self.veh_invincible;

            Action::AdjustVehCustomR => {

            // --- Teleport (Real Main-Thread `CEntity::SetMatrix` + `UpdateWorldPosition` — Zero Snap-Back!) ---
            Action::TeleportForward => {
                if let Some([x, y, z]) = self.world.player_xyz {
                    let [fx, fy] = self.world.forward_xy.unwrap_or([1.0, 0.0]);
                    let target = [x + fx * 5.0, y + fy * 5.0, z + 0.35];
                    let base = BRIDGE.title_image_base.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
                    let res = if hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::Teleport(target)) {
                        Ok(())
                    } else {
                        trainer::direct_teleport(base, &self.rvas, target)
                    };
                    match res {
                        Ok(()) => {
                            if self.ankle_monitor_mode {
                                sound::play(MenuSound::Error);
                                self.push_toast("GTA DOC", "BEEP BEEP", "Ankle monitor boundary alert! (Warped +5m anyway.)", Duration::from_secs(4), false);
                            } else {
                                self.push_toast("", "", "Teleported +5.0m forward along facing heading.", Duration::from_secs(3), false);
                            }
                        }
                        Err(e) => self.push_toast("Menyoo Teleport", "Status", e, Duration::from_secs(3), false),
                    }
                } else {
                    self.push_toast("Menyoo Teleport", "Preview", "Waiting for live player ped pointer.", Duration::from_secs(3), false);
                }
            }
            Action::TeleportWaypoint => {
                let base = BRIDGE.title_image_base.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
                if base == 0 {
                    self.push_toast("Menyoo Teleport", "Preview Mode", "Launch game & drop a map waypoint to warp live.", Duration::from_secs(3), false);
                } else if let Some((wp, is_map)) = trainer::read_active_waypoint(base, &self.rvas) {
                    let fallback_z = self
                        .world
                        .player_xyz
                        .map_or(20.0, |p| (p[2] + 1.5).clamp(12.0, 45.0));
                    let safe_z = if wp[2].abs() >= 0.5 {
                        wp[2] + 1.0
                    } else {
                        trainer::probe_ground_z_near_xy(base, &self.rvas, wp[0], wp[1], fallback_z)
                    };
                    let target = [wp[0], wp[1], safe_z];
                    self.custom_coords = target;
                    let res = if hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::Teleport(target)) {
                        Ok(())
                    } else {
                        trainer::direct_teleport(base, &self.rvas, target)
                    };
                    match res {
                        Ok(()) => {
                            if self.ankle_monitor_mode {
                                sound::play(MenuSound::Error);
                                self.push_toast("GTA DOC", "BEEP BEEP", "Ankle monitor alert! (Warped to waypoint anyway.)", Duration::from_secs(4), false);
                            } else {
                                let src = if is_map { "Map Waypoint" } else { "GPS Objective" };
                                self.push_toast(
                                    "Menyoo Teleport",
                                    src,
                                    &format!("Warped to {:.0}, {:.0}, {:.0}!", target[0], target[1], target[2]),
                                    Duration::from_secs(4),
                                    true,
                                );
                            }
                        }
                        Err(e) => self.push_toast("Menyoo Teleport", "Waypoint", e, Duration::from_secs(3), false),
                    }
                } else {
                    sound::play(MenuSound::Error);
                    self.push_toast("Menyoo Teleport", "No Waypoint", "Set a purple waypoint on the GTA pause map first!", Duration::from_secs(4), false);
                }
            }
            Action::TeleportNearestVehicle => {
                if hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::TeleportIntoNearestVehicle) {
                    self.push_toast("Menyoo Teleport", "Nearest Vehicle", "Warped into closest vehicle's driver seat!", Duration::from_secs(3), true);
                } else {
                    self.push_toast("Menyoo Teleport", "Hook Off", "Enable Main-Thread Hook in RVA Inspector first.", Duration::from_secs(4), false);
                }
            }
            Action::TeleportPreset(idx) => {
                if let Some((name, c)) = WORLD_LOCATIONS.get(idx) {
                    self.custom_coords = *c;
                    let base = BRIDGE.title_image_base.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
                    let res = if hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::Teleport(*c)) {
                        Ok(())
                    } else {
                        trainer::direct_teleport(base, &self.rvas, *c)
                    };
                    match res {
                        Ok(()) => self.push_toast("Menyoo Teleport", "LIVE Warp", &format!("Warped -> {name}"), Duration::from_secs(3), true),
                        Err(e) => self.push_toast("Menyoo Teleport", name, e, Duration::from_secs(3), false),
                    }
                }
            }
            Action::AdjustCoordX => self.custom_coords[0] += step_dir as f32 * 10.0,
            Action::AdjustCoordY => self.custom_coords[1] += step_dir as f32 * 10.0,
            Action::AdjustCoordZ => self.custom_coords[2] += step_dir as f32 * 5.0,
            Action::GrabLiveCoords => {
                if let Some(pos) = self.world.player_xyz {
                    self.custom_coords = pos;
                    self.push_toast(

                    self.push_toast("Menyoo Teleport", "Live Coordinates", "No live player ped pointer yet.", Duration::from_secs(3), false);

            Action::ApplyCustomCoords => {
                let base = BRIDGE.title_image_base.load(Ordering::Relaxed);

                        "Menyoo Teleport",
                        "LIVE Direct Teleport",
                        &format!(
                            "Warped to {:.1}, {:.1}, {:.1}",
                            self.custom_coords[0], self.custom_coords[1], self.custom_coords[2]
                        ),
                        Duration::from_secs(3),
                        true,
                    ),
                    Err(e) => self.push_toast("Menyoo Teleport", "Status", e, Duration::from_secs(3), false),
                }

            Action::SaveFavouriteCoord => {
                let idx = self.favourite_coords.len() + 1;
                self.favourite_coords.push(SavedCoord {

                self.push_toast("Menyoo Teleport", "Favourites.ini", "Saved spot to menyooStuff/Favourites.ini.", Duration::from_secs(3), true);

            // --- Weapon (Schema v6.0 LIVE!) ---
            Action::GiveTacticalLoadout => {
                if self.live_weapons.is_empty() {
                    self.rescan_live_weapons(false, false);

                let firearms = trainer::select_balanced_loadout(&self.live_weapons, 12);
                if !firearms.is_empty() && hook::enqueue_give_weapon_list(&firearms) {

                } else {

            Action::GiveAllWeapons => {
                if !self.live_weapons.is_empty() {
                    let direct_valid: Vec<(u32, u32, u32)> = self
                        .live_weapons
                        .iter()
                        .filter(|w| w.cat_direct_ok)
                        .map(|w| (w.hash32, w.award_hash32, w.ammo_award_hash32))
                        .collect();
                    let items: Vec<(u32, u32, u32)> = if !direct_valid.is_empty() {
                        direct_valid
                    } else {
                        let inv_valid: Vec<(u32, u32, u32)> = self
                            .live_weapons
                            .iter()
                            .filter(|w| w.in_inv_db)
                            .map(|w| (w.hash32, w.award_hash32, w.ammo_award_hash32))
                            .collect();
                        if !inv_valid.is_empty() {
                            inv_valid
                        } else {
                            self.live_weapons
                                .iter()
                                .map(|w| (w.hash32, w.award_hash32, w.ammo_award_hash32))
                                .collect()
                        }
                    };
                    if hook::enqueue_give_weapon_list(&items) {
                        self.push_toast(
                            "Ammu-Nation",
                            "Give All Weapons",
                            &format!("Granting {} inventory-valid GTA weapons + ammo via CPedInventory!", items.len()),
                            Duration::from_secs(4),
                            true,
                        );
                    } else {
                        self.push_toast("Weapon Options", "Hook Off", "Enable Main-Thread Hook in RVA Inspector first.", Duration::from_secs(4), false);
                    }
                } else {
                    self.rescan_live_weapons(false, true);
                }
            }
            Action::ScanLiveWeapons => {

            Action::LoadSpoonerScene(idx) => {
                if let Some(name) = self.spooner_scenes.get(idx).cloned()
                    && let Some(scene) = trainer::load_spooner_scene(&self.stuff_dir, &name)
                {
                    let n = scene.entities.len();
                    for ent in scene.entities {
                        match ent.kind {
                            1 => {
                                let _ = hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::SpawnVehicleHash64 {
                                    hash64: ent.hash64,
                                    keep_prev: true,
                                    warp_inside: false,
                                });
                            }
                            2 => {
                                let _ = hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::SpawnPed {
                                    hash64: ent.hash64,
                                    bodyguard: ent.invincible,
                                    add_to_spooner: true,
                                });
                            }
                            _ => {
                                let _ = hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::SpoonerSpawnPlacedProp {
                                    hash64: ent.hash64,
                                    pos: ent.pos,
                                    right: ent.right,
                                    forward: ent.forward,
                                    up: ent.up,
                                    frozen: ent.frozen,
                                    invincible: ent.invincible,
                                    attach_target: ent.attach_target,
                                    attach_bone: ent.attach_bone,
                                    attach_offset: ent.attach_offset,
                                    attach_rot: ent.attach_rot,
                                    alpha: ent.alpha,
                                    scale: ent.scale,
                                    collision: ent.collision,
                                });
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    self.push_toast("Object Spooner", "Scene Loaded", &format!("Spawning {n} entities from \"{}\"", scene.name), Duration::from_secs(4), true);
                }
            }

                }
            }
            Action::ToggleRainbow => {
                self.cfg.rainbow_mode = !self.cfg.rainbow_mode;
            }
            Action::SetFont(target, font) => match target {
                FontTarget::Title => self.cfg.font_title = font,
                FontTarget::Options => self.cfg.font_options = font,

                FontTarget::Breaks => self.cfg.font_breaks = font,
            },
            Action::AdjustMenuPosX => {

            }
            Action::AdjustMenuPosY => {

            }
            Action::ResetMenuPos => {

                self.cfg.menu_pos_y = 0.0;

            Action::ToggleGradients => self.cfg.gradients = !self.cfg.gradients,
            Action::ToggleTitleboxGlobe => self.cfg.titlebox_globe = !self.cfg.titlebox_globe,
            Action::ToggleThinLine => self.cfg.thin_line_over_footer = !self.cfg.thin_line_over_footer,

            Action::ToggleCentreOptions => self.cfg.centre_options = !self.cfg.centre_options,
            Action::ToggleCentreBreaks => self.cfg.centre_breaks = !self.cfg.centre_breaks,
            Action::ToggleMouseSupport => self.cfg.mouse_support = !self.cfg.mouse_support,
            Action::ToggleCategoryBanners => self.cfg.category_banners = !self.cfg.category_banners,
            Action::ToggleShowPreviews => {

            }
            Action::SnapLivePreview => {

                    _ => ("vehicles", "live_snap".into()),

                    .unwrap_or(0);

                self.cfg.open_key_vk = OPEN_KEYS[next].1;

            }
        }
    }
    fn push_live_clock_time(&self, h: i32, m: i32, s: i32) {
        if !hook::enqueue(MainThreadCmd::SetClockTime {
            hour: h,
            minute: m,
            second: s,
        }) {

            let _ = trainer::direct_set_clock_time(base, &self.rvas, h, m, s);
        }
    }
}

/// Returns current local wall-clock `(hour, minute, second)` via Win32 `GetLocalTime`.
fn local_hms() -> (i32, i32, i32) {
    #[repr(C)]
    #[derive(Default)]
    struct SystemTimeWin {
        year: u16,
        month: u16,
        dow: u16,
        day: u16,
        hour: u16,
        minute: u16,
        second: u16,
        ms: u16,
    }
    unsafe extern "system" {
        fn GetLocalTime(st: *mut SystemTimeWin);
    }
    let mut st = SystemTimeWin::default();
    // SAFETY: plain Win32 local-time struct fill.
    unsafe { GetLocalTime(&mut st) };
    (i32::from(st.hour), i32::from(st.minute), i32::from(st.second))
}

fn parse_env_tint() -> Option<[u8; 3]> {
    let raw = std::env::var("MENYOO_DX12_AMBIENT_TINT").ok()?;
    let v: Vec<f32> = raw
        .split(',')
        .filter_map(|s| s.trim().parse::<f32>().ok())
        .collect();
    if let [r, g, b] = v[..] {
        Some([
            (r.clamp(0.0, 1.0) * 255.0).round() as u8,
            (g.clamp(0.0, 1.0) * 255.0).round() as u8,
            (b.clamp(0.0, 1.0) * 255.0).round() as u8,
        ])
    } else {
        None
    }
}

fn parse_env_shade() -> Option<(f32, f32)> {
    let raw = std::env::var("MENYOO_DX12_AMBIENT_SHADE").ok()?;
    let mut parts = raw.split(',').filter_map(|s| s.trim().parse::<f32>().ok());
    let s = parts.next()?;
    let r = parts.next()?;
    Some((s.clamp(0.0, 2.5), r.clamp(0.1, 3.0)))
}

fn hsv_to_rgb(h: f32, s: f32, v: f32) -> (u8, u8, u8) {
    let c = v * s;
    let x = c * (1.0 - ((h / 60.0) % 2.0 - 1.0).abs());
    let m = v - c;
    let (r, g, b) = match (h as i32).rem_euclid(360) {
        0..=59 => (c, x, 0.0),
        60..=119 => (x, c, 0.0),
        120..=179 => (0.0, c, x),
        180..=239 => (0.0, x, c),
        240..=299 => (x, 0.0, c),
        _ => (c, 0.0, x),
    };
    (
        ((r + m) * 255.0).round() as u8,
        ((g + m) * 255.0).round() as u8,
        ((b + m) * 255.0).round() as u8,
    )
}

```

`src/postfx.rs`:

```rs
//! Real Vision Hax & Color Grading Post-FX shared between D3D12 HLSL (`over.rs`)
//! and the offline CPU previewer (`menyoo-preview` + visual PNG tests).
//!
//! Includes a zero-dependency PNG backdrop loader (using `zlib-rs`) so offline
//! previews and shaders can be verified directly against captured DirectX 12 3D frames.

use std::path::Path;

/// 32-byte root-constant block passed to `over::record_postfx` (8 × 32-bit values).
#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub struct PostFxParams {
    /// 0=None, 1=NVG, 2=FLIR Thermal, 3=Retro 80s Neon, 4=Metro Golden Hour,
    /// 5=Miami Noir B&W, 6=Cyberpunk Magenta, 7=EMP Darken, 8=Drunk Warp.
    pub mode: u32,
    /// Filter blend strength `0.0..=1.0`.
    pub strength: f32,
    /// Exposure stops `-1.0..=1.5` (0.0 = neutral).
    pub exposure: f32,
    /// Contrast multiplier `0.5..=2.0` (1.0 = neutral).
    pub contrast: f32,
    /// Saturation multiplier `0.0..=2.0` (1.0 = neutral).
    pub saturation: f32,
    /// Elapsed seconds for animated NVG grain / Drunk warp.
    pub time_sec: f32,
    pub _pad0: f32,
    pub _pad1: f32,
}

impl Default for PostFxParams {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            mode: 0,
            strength: 0.75,
            exposure: 0.0,
            contrast: 1.0,
            saturation: 1.0,
            time_sec: 0.0,
            _pad0: 0.0,
            _pad1: 0.0,
        }
    }
}

impl PostFxParams {
    #[inline]
    pub fn is_active(self) -> bool {
        self.mode != 0
            || self.exposure.abs() > 0.005
            || (self.contrast - 1.0).abs() > 0.005
            || (self.saturation - 1.0).abs() > 0.005
    }
}

#[inline]
fn lerp(a: f32, b: f32, t: f32) -> f32 {
    a + (b - a) * t
}

#[inline]
fn lerp3(a: [f32; 3], b: [f32; 3], t: f32) -> [f32; 3] {
    [lerp(a[0], b[0], t), lerp(a[1], b[1], t), lerp(a[2], b[2], t)]
}

#[inline]
fn smoothstep(e0: f32, e1: f32, x: f32) -> f32 {
    let t = ((x - e0) / (e1 - e0)).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    t * t * (3.0 - 2.0 * t)
}

#[inline]
fn hash12(x: f32, y: f32, t: f32) -> f32 {
    let n = (x * 12.9898 + y * 78.233 + t * 37.719).sin() * 43_758.547;
    n - n.floor()
}

/// Real FLIR Ironbow thermal color ramp (matching `over.rs::POSTFX_SOURCE`).
#[inline]
fn flir_ironbow(l: f32) -> [f32; 3] {
    let l = l.clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    if l < 0.25 {
        lerp3([0.04, 0.03, 0.22], [0.36, 0.04, 0.56], l / 0.25)
    } else if l < 0.55 {
        lerp3([0.36, 0.04, 0.56], [0.88, 0.14, 0.20], (l - 0.25) / 0.30)
    } else if l < 0.82 {
        lerp3([0.88, 0.14, 0.20], [1.00, 0.72, 0.08], (l - 0.55) / 0.27)
    } else {
        lerp3([1.00, 0.72, 0.08], [1.00, 0.99, 0.90], (l - 0.82) / 0.18)
    }
}

/// Applies the exact same Vision Hax & Color Grading math as `over.rs::POSTFX_SOURCE`
/// on a `0xFFRRGGBB` CPU framebuffer (for offline `menyoo-preview` & visual tests).
pub fn apply_cpu_postfx(pixels: &mut [u32], w: usize, h: usize, p: PostFxParams) {
    if !p.is_active() || pixels.len() < w * h {
        return;
    }
    let src = if p.mode == 8 { Some(pixels.to_vec()) } else { None };
    let exp_mul = 2.0f32.powf(p.exposure);
    let str_clamped = p.strength.clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    let wf = w.max(1) as f32;
    let hf = h.max(1) as f32;

    let sample_src = |buf: &[u32], u: f32, v: f32| -> [f32; 3] {
        let sx = (u.clamp(0.0, 0.9999) * wf) as usize;
        let sy = (v.clamp(0.0, 0.9999) * hf) as usize;
        let px = buf[sy * w + sx];
        [
            ((px >> 16) & 0xFF) as f32 / 255.0,
            ((px >> 8) & 0xFF) as f32 / 255.0,
            (px & 0xFF) as f32 / 255.0,
        ]
    };

    for y in 0..h {
        let v = (y as f32 + 0.5) / hf;
        let row = y * w;
        for x in 0..w {
            let u = (x as f32 + 0.5) / wf;
            let mut c = if let Some(ref buf) = src {
                // Mode 8: Drunk Warp + RGB chromatic split
                let amp = 0.014 * str_clamped;
                let du = (v * 11.0 + p.time_sec * 2.4).sin() * amp
                    + (u * 5.0 - p.time_sec * 1.6).cos() * (amp * 0.45);
                let dv = (u * 9.0 + p.time_sec * 2.1).cos() * amp;
                let ca = 0.005 * str_clamped;
                let cr = sample_src(buf, u + du + ca, v + dv)[0];
                let cg = sample_src(buf, u + du, v + dv)[1];
                let cb = sample_src(buf, u + du - ca, v + dv)[2];
                [cr, cg, cb]
            } else {
                let px = pixels[row + x];
                [
                    ((px >> 16) & 0xFF) as f32 / 255.0,
                    ((px >> 8) & 0xFF) as f32 / 255.0,
                    (px & 0xFF) as f32 / 255.0,
                ]
            };

            // Base Exposure / Contrast / Saturation grading
            c = [
                ((c[0] * exp_mul - 0.5) * p.contrast + 0.5).clamp(0.0, 1.0),
                ((c[1] * exp_mul - 0.5) * p.contrast + 0.5).clamp(0.0, 1.0),
                ((c[2] * exp_mul - 0.5) * p.contrast + 0.5).clamp(0.0, 1.0),
            ];
            let luma = (c[0] * 0.2126 + c[1] * 0.7152 + c[2] * 0.0722).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
            c = [
                lerp(luma, c[0], p.saturation).clamp(0.0, 1.0),
                lerp(luma, c[1], p.saturation).clamp(0.0, 1.0),
                lerp(luma, c[2], p.saturation).clamp(0.0, 1.0),
            ];

            let dx = (u - 0.5) * 2.0;
            let dy = (v - 0.5) * 2.0;
            let r2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;

            let graded = match p.mode {
                1 => {
                    // Night Vision (NVG): phosphor green amplification + scanlines + grain + vignette
                    let boosted = (luma.powf(0.62) * 1.48).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
                    let scan = if (y & 3) == 0 { 0.86 } else { 1.0 };
                    let grain = (hash12(x as f32, y as f32, p.time_sec) - 0.5) * 0.11;
                    let vig = (1.0 - smoothstep(0.65, 1.65, r2) * 0.72).clamp(0.22, 1.0);
                    let g = ((boosted + grain) * scan * vig).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
                    [g * 0.12, (g * 1.05).min(1.0), g * 0.26]
                }
                2 => {
                    // FLIR Thermal / Heat Vision: ironbow heat map + contrast pop + subtle scan grid
                    let heat = smoothstep(0.04, 0.92, luma * 1.12);
                    let mut col = flir_ironbow(heat);
                    if (y % 6) == 0 {
                        col = [col[0] * 0.93, col[1] * 0.93, col[2] * 0.93];
                    }
                    col
                }
                3 => {
                    // Retro 80s Neon: split-tone cyan shadows -> hot neon pink/magenta highlights
                    let hi = smoothstep(0.32, 0.86, luma);
                    let shadow_tint = [c[0] * 0.72 + 0.04, c[1] * 1.12 + 0.08, c[2] * 1.28 + 0.14];
                    let high_tint = [c[0] * 1.26 + 0.14, c[1] * 0.76 + 0.02, c[2] * 1.16 + 0.10];
                    let vig = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.75, 1.85, r2) * 0.28;
                    let m = lerp3(shadow_tint, high_tint, hi);
                    [m[0] * vig, m[1] * vig, m[2] * vig]
                }
                4 => {
                    // Metro Golden Hour: warm amber-coral highlights + coastal teal shadows
                    let hi = smoothstep(0.25, 0.85, luma);
                    let sh = [c[0] * 0.88, c[1] * 1.02 + 0.03, c[2] * 1.10 + 0.04];
                    let hl = [c[0] * 1.24 + 0.10, c[1] * 1.05 + 0.04, c[2] * 0.74];
                    lerp3(sh, hl, hi)
                }
                5 => {
                    // Miami Noir: crisp silver-halide high-contrast B&W + deep vignette
                    let bw = smoothstep(0.08, 0.90, luma);
                    let vig = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.50, 1.65, r2) * 0.58;
                    let v0 = bw * vig;
                    [v0 * 0.94, v0 * 0.98, (v0 * 1.06).min(1.0)]
                }
                6 => {
                    // Cyberpunk Magenta: electric violet-magenta mids + cyan speculars
                    let hi = smoothstep(0.58, 0.96, luma);
                    let base = [c[0] * 1.18 + 0.10, c[1] * 0.62, c[2] * 1.32 + 0.14];
                    let spec = [c[0] * 0.65, c[1] * 1.22 + 0.12, c[2] * 1.30 + 0.14];
                    lerp3(base, spec, hi)
                }
                7 => {
                    // EMP Darken: heavy nocturnal blackout grade
                    let vig = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.35, 1.50, r2) * 0.55;
                    [c[0] * 0.22 * vig, c[1] * 0.26 * vig, c[2] * 0.36 * vig]
                }
                8 => {
                    // Drunk Warp already displaced UV; add warm woozy vignette
                    let vig = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.65, 1.75, r2) * 0.35;
                    [c[0] * 1.08 * vig, c[1] * 1.01 * vig, c[2] * 0.92 * vig]
                }
                _ => c,
            };

            let out = if p.mode == 0 || p.mode == 8 {
                graded
            } else {
                lerp3(c, graded, str_clamped)
            };
            let r = (out[0].clamp(0.0, 1.0) * 255.0) as u32;
            let g = (out[1].clamp(0.0, 1.0) * 255.0) as u32;
            let b = (out[2].clamp(0.0, 1.0) * 255.0) as u32;
            pixels[row + x] = 0xFF00_0000 | (r << 16) | (g << 8) | b;
        }
    }
}

/// Decodes a standard 8-bit RGB or RGBA PNG into a `1920x1080` `0xFFRRGGBB` backdrop
/// using the workspace's existing `zlib-rs` dependency (zero `Cargo.lock` changes).
pub fn load_png_backdrop(path: &Path, dst_w: usize, dst_h: usize) -> Option<Vec<u32>> {
    let data = std::fs::read(path).ok()?;
    if data.len() < 33 || &data[..8] != b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n" {
        return None;
    }
    let mut pos = 8usize;
    let mut src_w = 0usize;
    let mut src_h = 0usize;
    let mut bit_depth = 0u8;
    let mut color_type = 0u8;
    let mut idat = Vec::new();

    while pos + 12 <= data.len() {
        let len = u32::from_be_bytes(data[pos..pos + 4].try_into().ok()?) as usize;
        let kind = &data[pos + 4..pos + 8];
        let payload_start = pos + 8;
        let payload_end = payload_start.checked_add(len)?;
        if payload_end + 4 > data.len() {
            break;
        }
        let payload = &data[payload_start..payload_end];
        match kind {
            b"IHDR" if payload.len() >= 13 => {
                src_w = u32::from_be_bytes(payload[0..4].try_into().ok()?) as usize;
                src_h = u32::from_be_bytes(payload[4..8].try_into().ok()?) as usize;
                bit_depth = payload[8];
                color_type = payload[9];
            }
            b"IDAT" => idat.extend_from_slice(payload),
            b"IEND" => break,
            _ => {}
        }
        pos = payload_end + 4;
    }

    if src_w == 0 || src_h == 0 || bit_depth != 8 || (color_type != 2 && color_type != 6) {
        return None;
    }
    let bpp = if color_type == 6 { 4 } else { 3 };
    let stride = src_w * bpp;
    let expected = (stride + 1).checked_mul(src_h)?;
    let mut raw = vec![0u8; expected];

    let mut inflate = zlib_rs::Inflate::new(true, 15);
    let mut in_pos = 0usize;
    let mut out_pos = 0usize;
    loop {
        match inflate.decompress(
            &idat[in_pos..],
            &mut raw[out_pos..],
            zlib_rs::InflateFlush::NoFlush,
        ) {
            Ok(zlib_rs::Status::StreamEnd) => {
                out_pos = inflate.total_out() as usize;
                break;
            }
            Ok(zlib_rs::Status::Ok) => {
                let ni = inflate.total_in() as usize;
                let no = inflate.total_out() as usize;
                if ni == in_pos && no == out_pos {
                    return None;
                }
                in_pos = ni;
                out_pos = no;
            }
            _ => return None,
        }
    }
    if out_pos < expected {
        return None;
    }

    // Unfilter PNG scanlines (None, Sub, Up, Average, Paeth)
    let mut rgb = vec![0u8; src_h * stride];
    for y in 0..src_h {
        let f = raw[y * (stride + 1)];
        let src_row = &raw[y * (stride + 1) + 1..(y + 1) * (stride + 1)];
        let row_off = y * stride;
        for i in 0..stride {
            let x = src_row[i];
            let a = if i >= bpp { rgb[row_off + i - bpp] } else { 0 };
            let b = if y > 0 { rgb[row_off - stride + i] } else { 0 };
            let c = if y > 0 && i >= bpp {
                rgb[row_off - stride + i - bpp]
            } else {
                0
            };
            let recon = match f {
                0 => x,
                1 => x.wrapping_add(a),
                2 => x.wrapping_add(b),
                3 => x.wrapping_add(((u16::from(a) + u16::from(b)) / 2) as u8),
                4 => x.wrapping_add(paeth(a, b, c)),
                _ => return None,
            };
            rgb[row_off + i] = recon;
        }
    }

    // Bilinear scale into `dst_w x dst_h` packed `0xFFRRGGBB`
    let mut out = vec![0u32; dst_w * dst_h];
    let sx_scale = src_w as f32 / dst_w as f32;
    let sy_scale = src_h as f32 / dst_h as f32;
    for y in 0..dst_h {
        let fy = (y as f32 + 0.5) * sy_scale - 0.5;
        let y0 = (fy.floor() as isize).clamp(0, src_h as isize - 1) as usize;
        let y1 = (y0 + 1).min(src_h - 1);
        let wy = (fy - fy.floor()).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
        let r0 = y0 * stride;
        let r1 = y1 * stride;
        let out_row = y * dst_w;
        for x in 0..dst_w {
            let fx = (x as f32 + 0.5) * sx_scale - 0.5;
            let x0 = (fx.floor() as isize).clamp(0, src_w as isize - 1) as usize;
            let x1 = (x0 + 1).min(src_w - 1);
            let wx = (fx - fx.floor()).clamp(0.0, 1.0);

            let i00 = r0 + x0 * bpp;
            let i10 = r0 + x1 * bpp;
            let i01 = r1 + x0 * bpp;
            let i11 = r1 + x1 * bpp;

            let ch = |o: usize| -> u32 {
                let top = lerp(f32::from(rgb[i00 + o]), f32::from(rgb[i10 + o]), wx);
                let bot = lerp(f32::from(rgb[i01 + o]), f32::from(rgb[i11 + o]), wx);
                lerp(top, bot, wy).clamp(0.0, 255.0) as u32
            };
            out[out_row + x] = 0xFF00_0000 | (ch(0) << 16) | (ch(1) << 8) | ch(2);
        }
    }
    Some(out)
}

#[inline]
fn paeth(a: u8, b: u8, c: u8) -> u8 {
    let a = i32::from(a);
    let b = i32::from(b);
    let c = i32::from(c);
    let p = a + b - c;
    let pa = (p - a).abs();
    let pb = (p - b).abs();
    let pc = (p - c).abs();
    if pa <= pb && pa <= pc {
        a as u8
    } else if pb <= pc {
        b as u8
    } else {
        c as u8
    }
}

/// Locates an optional offline DirectX 12 gameplay backdrop PNG for `menyoo-preview`.
pub fn find_default_backdrop(stuff_dir: &Path) -> Option<std::path::PathBuf> {
    if let Some(p) = std::env::var_os("MENYOO_DX12_BACKDROP").filter(|v| !v.is_empty()) {
        let pb = std::path::PathBuf::from(p);
        if pb.is_file() {
            return Some(pb);
        }
    }
    let candidates = [
        stuff_dir.join("backdrop.png"),
        stuff_dir.parent().map(|p| p.join("snapshots").join("frame-3655.png")).unwrap_or_default(),
        std::path::PathBuf::from(r"backdrop.png"),
    ];
    candidates.into_iter().find(|p| !p.as_os_str().is_empty() && p.is_file())
}
```

```rs
/// Normalizes any display name (`"Apex '95 Bison 900"`, `"Bikes & Cycles"`) into a clean
/// lowercase filesystem slug (`"apex_gtr_coupe"`).
pub fn slugify(s: &str) -> String {
    let mut out = String::with_capacity(s.len());
    let mut prev_us = true;
    for ch in s.chars() {
        if ch.is_ascii_alphanumeric() {
            out.push(ch.to_ascii_lowercase());
            prev_us = false;
        } else if !prev_us {
            out.push('_');
            prev_us = true;
        }
    }
    while out.ends_with('_') {
        out.pop();
    }
    out
}

/// Bounded in-memory RGBA (`0xFFRRGGBB`) thumbnail cache for `menyooStuff/Previews/*.png`.
#[derive(Default)]
pub struct PreviewCache {
    entries: HashMap<PathBuf, Option<Vec<u32>>>,
}

impl PreviewCache {
    const MAX_ENTRIES: usize = 64;

    pub fn clear(&mut self) {
        self.entries.clear();
    }

    /// Resolves the highest-priority existing PNG for `spec`:
    /// 1. `Previews/<folder>/<exact_slug>.png`
    /// 2. `Previews/<folder>/<hash_hex>.png`
    /// 3. `Previews/<folder>/<category_slug>.png`
    /// 4. `Previews/<folder>/default.png`
    pub fn resolve(&mut self, stuff_dir: &Path, spec: &PreviewSpec) -> Option<&[u32]> {
        let base = stuff_dir.join("Previews").join(spec.kind.folder());
        let mut candidates = Vec::<PathBuf>::with_capacity(4);
        if !spec.exact_slug.is_empty() {
            candidates.push(base.join(format!("{}.png", spec.exact_slug)));
        }
        if !spec.hash_hex.is_empty() {
            candidates.push(base.join(format!("{}.png", spec.hash_hex)));
        }
        if !spec.category_slug.is_empty() {
            candidates.push(base.join(format!("{}.png", spec.category_slug)));
        }
        candidates.push(base.join("default.png"));

        let chosen = candidates.into_iter().find(|p| {
            if let Some(cached) = self.entries.get(p) {
                cached.is_some()
            } else {
                p.is_file()
            }
        })?;

        if !self.entries.contains_key(&chosen) {
            if self.entries.len() >= Self::MAX_ENTRIES {
                self.entries.clear();
            }
            let decoded = load_png_backdrop(&chosen, PREVIEW_W, PREVIEW_H);
            self.entries.insert(chosen.clone(), decoded);
        }
        self.entries.get(&chosen)?.as_deref()
    }
}

/// Encodes an RGBA8 image (`w * h * 4` bytes) to a valid compressed `.png` file using `zlib-rs`
/// (zero extra crate dependencies!). Used by live preview snapping.
pub fn write_rgba_png(path: &Path, w: u32, h: u32, rgba: &[u8]) -> std::io::Result<()> {
    if rgba.len() < (w as usize) * (h as usize) * 4 {
        return Err(std::io::Error::new(
            std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidInput,
            "RGBA buffer smaller than w*h*4",
        ));
    }
    if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
        std::fs::create_dir_all(parent)?;
    }

    let stride = (w as usize) * 4;
    let mut raw = Vec::with_capacity((stride + 1) * (h as usize));
    for y in 0..h as usize {
        raw.push(0u8); // Filter type 0 (None)
        raw.extend_from_slice(&rgba[y * stride..(y + 1) * stride]);
    }

    let mut compressed = vec![0u8; zlib_rs::compress_bound(raw.len())];
    let (idat, _rc) = zlib_rs::compress_slice(&mut compressed, &raw, zlib_rs::DeflateConfig::new(6));

    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(idat.len() + 128);
    out.extend_from_slice(b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n");

    let mut ihdr = [0u8; 13];
    ihdr[0..4].copy_from_slice(&w.to_be_bytes());
    ihdr[4..8].copy_from_slice(&h.to_be_bytes());
    ihdr[8] = 8; // 8-bit
    ihdr[9] = 6; // RGBA
    push_png_chunk(&mut out, b"IHDR", &ihdr);
    push_png_chunk(&mut out, b"IDAT", idat);
    push_png_chunk(&mut out, b"IEND", &[]);
    std::fs::write(path, out)
}

fn push_png_chunk(out: &mut Vec<u8>, kind: &[u8; 4], payload: &[u8]) {
    out.extend_from_slice(&(payload.len() as u32).to_be_bytes());
    out.extend_from_slice(kind);
    out.extend_from_slice(payload);
    let mut crc = 0xFFFF_FFFFu32;
    for &b in kind.iter().chain(payload.iter()) {
        crc ^= u32::from(b);
        for _ in 0..8 {
            crc = if (crc & 1) != 0 {
                (crc >> 1) ^ 0xEDB8_8320
            } else {
                crc >> 1
            };
        }
    }
    out.extend_from_slice(&(!crc).to_be_bytes());
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn png_encode_decode_and_preview_cache_roundtrip() {
        let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().expect("tempdir");
        let dir = tmp.path().join("Previews").join("vehicles");
        let path = dir.join("apex_truck.png");
        let mut rgba = vec![0u8; 32 * 18 * 4];
        for i in 0..(32 * 18) {
            rgba[i * 4] = 20;
            rgba[i * 4 + 1] = 220;
            rgba[i * 4 + 2] = 245;
            rgba[i * 4 + 3] = 255;
        }
        write_rgba_png(&path, 32, 18, &rgba).expect("write png");

        let mut cache = PreviewCache::default();
        let spec = PreviewSpec {
            kind: PreviewKind::Vehicle,
            title: "Apex Truck".into(),
            subtitle: "Trucks".into(),
            badge: "TRUCKS".into(),
            exact_slug: slugify("Apex Truck"),
            hash_hex: "deadbeef".into(),
            category_slug: vehicle_category_slug("Cars", "Apex Truck").into(),
        };
        assert_eq!(spec.exact_slug, "apex_truck");
        assert_eq!(spec.category_slug, "trucks");
        let px = cache.resolve(tmp.path(), &spec).expect("decoded preview");
        assert_eq!(px.len(), PREVIEW_W * PREVIEW_H);
        let center = px[(PREVIEW_H / 2) * PREVIEW_W + (PREVIEW_W / 2)];
        assert_eq!((center >> 16) & 0xFF, 20);
        assert_eq!((center >> 8) & 0xFF, 220);
        assert_eq!(center & 0xFF, 245);
    }
}
```
