//! Pixel-faithful Menyoo DX12 — Native DirectX 12 Overlay for GTA 1080p premultiplied-BGRA UI renderer.
//!
//! Geometry, proportions, gradients, rank-globe toggle indicators, footer chevrons,
//! color swatch previews, feed notifications, and instructional buttons follow
//! MAFINS's original `Menu.cpp` (GPL-3.0), enhanced with crisp anti-aliased GDI
//! typography, smooth Pricedown-style outlining, animated `MP_MENU_GLARE` sheen,
//! and "NATIVE DIRECTX 12 FOR GTA" visual styling.

use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::time::{Instant, SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH};

use windows::Win32::Foundation::{COLORREF, RECT, SIZE};
use windows::Win32::Graphics::Gdi::{
    ANTIALIASED_QUALITY, BI_RGB, BITMAPINFO, BITMAPINFOHEADER, CreateCompatibleDC,
    CreateDIBSection, CreateFontW, DIB_RGB_COLORS, DT_LEFT, DT_NOCLIP, DT_NOPREFIX, DT_SINGLELINE,
    DeleteDC, DeleteObject, DrawTextW, FONT_CHARSET, FONT_CLIP_PRECISION, FONT_OUTPUT_PRECISION,
    FONT_QUALITY, FW_HEAVY, FW_NORMAL, FW_SEMIBOLD, GetTextExtentPoint32W, HBITMAP, HDC,
    HFONT, HGDIOBJ, SelectObject, SetBkMode, SetTextColor, TRANSPARENT,
};
use windows::core::PCWSTR;

use super::config::{MenuFont, Rgba};
use super::menu::{GTA_BETOP, GTA_MAXOP, GTA_SCROLLOP, ItemRight, MenuItem, MenyooState, SubmenuId};
use super::postfx::{PostFxParams, apply_cpu_postfx};
use super::previews::{PREVIEW_H, PREVIEW_W, PreviewCache, PreviewSpec};

pub const CANVAS_W: usize = 1920;
pub const CANVAS_H: usize = 1080;

const TEXT_SCRATCH_W: usize = 720;
const TEXT_SCRATCH_H: usize = 128;

/// Premultiplied BGRA pixel packed as `0xAA_RR_GG_BB` (little-endian `[B, G, R, A]`).
#[inline(always)]
fn pack_premul(r: u8, g: u8, b: u8, a: u8) -> u32 {
    let af = u32::from(a);
    let pr = (u32::from(r) * af + 127) / 255;
    let pg = (u32::from(g) * af + 127) / 255;
    let pb = (u32::from(b) * af + 127) / 255;
    (af << 24) | (pr << 16) | (pg << 8) | pb
}

#[inline(always)]
fn blend_premul(dst: u32, r: u8, g: u8, b: u8, a: u8) -> u32 {
    if a == 0 {
        return dst;
    }
    if a == 255 {
        return pack_premul(r, g, b, 255);
    }
    let sa = u32::from(a);
    let inv = 255 - sa;
    let sr = (u32::from(r) * sa + 127) / 255;
    let sg = (u32::from(g) * sa + 127) / 255;
    let sb = (u32::from(b) * sa + 127) / 255;

    let da = (dst >> 24) & 0xFF;
    let dr = (dst >> 16) & 0xFF;
    let dg = (dst >> 8) & 0xFF;
    let db = dst & 0xFF;

    let oa = (sa + (da * inv + 127) / 255).min(255);
    let or = (sr + (dr * inv + 127) / 255).min(255);
    let og = (sg + (dg * inv + 127) / 255).min(255);
    let ob = (sb + (db * inv + 127) / 255).min(255);
    (oa << 24) | (or << 16) | (og << 8) | ob
}

/// Reusable Win32 GDI anti-aliased text rasterizer into a black scratch DIB.
struct TextRasterizer {
    hdc: HDC,
    hbmp: HBITMAP,
    old_bmp: HGDIOBJ,
    bits: *mut u32,
    fonts: HashMap<(u8, i32, bool), HFONT>,
    mask: Vec<u8>,
    outline: Vec<u8>,
}

// SAFETY: accessed only under the renderer's single mutex.
unsafe impl Send for TextRasterizer {}

impl Drop for TextRasterizer {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        // SAFETY: freeing GDI resources owned by this struct.
        unsafe {
            for (_, f) in self.fonts.drain() {
                let _ = DeleteObject(f.into());
            }
            if !self.hdc.is_invalid() {
                if !self.old_bmp.is_invalid() {
                    SelectObject(self.hdc, self.old_bmp);
                }
                if !self.hbmp.is_invalid() {
                    let _ = DeleteObject(self.hbmp.into());
                }
                let _ = DeleteDC(self.hdc);
            }
        }
    }
}

impl TextRasterizer {
    fn new() -> Self {
        let bmi = BITMAPINFO {
            bmiHeader: BITMAPINFOHEADER {
                biSize: size_of::<BITMAPINFOHEADER>() as u32,
                biWidth: TEXT_SCRATCH_W as i32,
                biHeight: -(TEXT_SCRATCH_H as i32), // top-down DIB
                biPlanes: 1,
                biBitCount: 32,
                biCompression: BI_RGB.0,
                ..Default::default()
            },
            ..Default::default()
        };
        let mut bits: *mut std::ffi::c_void = std::ptr::null_mut();
        // SAFETY: creating a private offscreen memory DC + 32-bit DIB section.
        let (hdc, hbmp, old_bmp) = unsafe {
            let hdc = CreateCompatibleDC(None);
            let hbmp = CreateDIBSection(Some(hdc), &bmi, DIB_RGB_COLORS, &mut bits, None, 0)
                .unwrap_or_default();
            let old_bmp = if !hdc.is_invalid() && !hbmp.is_invalid() {
                SetBkMode(hdc, TRANSPARENT);
                SetTextColor(hdc, COLORREF(0x00FF_FFFF));
                SelectObject(hdc, hbmp.into())
            } else {
                HGDIOBJ::default()
            };
            (hdc, hbmp, old_bmp)
        };
        Self {
            hdc,
            hbmp,
            old_bmp,
            bits: bits.cast::<u32>(),
            fonts: HashMap::new(),
            mask: vec![0u8; TEXT_SCRATCH_W * TEXT_SCRATCH_H],
            outline: vec![0u8; TEXT_SCRATCH_W * TEXT_SCRATCH_H],
        }
    }

    fn font(&mut self, style: MenuFont, px_h: i32, bold: bool) -> HFONT {
        let key = (style as u8, px_h, bold);
        if let Some(&f) = self.fonts.get(&key) {
            return f;
        }
        let (face, weight, italic) = match style {
            MenuFont::Pricedown => ("Impact\0", FW_HEAVY.0 as i32, 0u32),
            MenuFont::Impact => (
                "Bahnschrift SemiCondensed\0",
                if bold { FW_SEMIBOLD.0 } else { FW_NORMAL.0 } as i32,
                0u32,
            ),
            MenuFont::Italic => ("Segoe Script\0", FW_NORMAL.0 as i32, 1u32),
            MenuFont::Caps => ("Bahnschrift SemiCondensed\0", FW_SEMIBOLD.0 as i32, 0u32),
            MenuFont::Arial => (
                "Segoe UI\0",
                if bold { FW_SEMIBOLD.0 } else { FW_NORMAL.0 } as i32,
                0u32,
            ),
        };
        let wide: Vec<u16> = face.encode_utf16().collect();
        // SAFETY: creating a cached Win32 logical font.
        let hfont = unsafe {
            CreateFontW(
                -px_h,
                0,
                0,
                0,
                weight,
                italic,
                0,
                0,
                FONT_CHARSET(0),
                FONT_OUTPUT_PRECISION(0),
                FONT_CLIP_PRECISION(0),
                FONT_QUALITY(ANTIALIASED_QUALITY.0),
                0,
                PCWSTR(wide.as_ptr()),
            )
        };
        self.fonts.insert(key, hfont);
        hfont
    }

    fn measure(&mut self, text: &str, style: MenuFont, px_h: i32, bold: bool) -> (i32, i32) {
        if self.hdc.is_invalid() || text.is_empty() {
            return (0, px_h);
        }
        let f = self.font(style, px_h, bold);
        let wide: Vec<u16> = text.encode_utf16().collect();
        let mut sz = SIZE::default();
        // SAFETY: measuring text into stack `SIZE` using our private memory DC.
        unsafe {
            let old = SelectObject(self.hdc, f.into());
            let _ = GetTextExtentPoint32W(self.hdc, &wide, &mut sz);
            SelectObject(self.hdc, old);
        }
        (sz.cx, sz.cy.max(px_h))
    }

    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    fn draw(
        &mut self,
        canvas: &mut Canvas,
        text: &str,
        x: i32,
        y: i32,
        style: MenuFont,
        px_h: i32,
        bold: bool,
        color: Rgba,
        outline: Option<(Rgba, i32)>,
    ) -> i32 {
        if self.hdc.is_invalid() || self.bits.is_null() || text.is_empty() || color.a == 0 {
            return 0;
        }
        let pad = outline.map_or(2, |(_, r)| r + 2);
        let f = self.font(style, px_h, bold);
        let display: String = if matches!(style, MenuFont::Caps) {
            text.to_uppercase()
        } else {
            text.to_owned()
        };
        let mut wide: Vec<u16> = display.encode_utf16().collect();

        let mut sz = SIZE::default();
        // SAFETY: private offscreen DC and DIB section sized `TEXT_SCRATCH_W x TEXT_SCRATCH_H`.
        let (bw, bh) = unsafe {
            let old = SelectObject(self.hdc, f.into());
            let _ = GetTextExtentPoint32W(self.hdc, &wide, &mut sz);
            let bw = ((sz.cx + pad * 2 + 8) as usize).min(TEXT_SCRATCH_W);
            let bh = ((sz.cy + pad * 2 + 6) as usize).min(TEXT_SCRATCH_H);
            // Clear only the active bounding rows of our scratch DIB.
            for row in 0..bh {
                std::ptr::write_bytes(self.bits.add(row * TEXT_SCRATCH_W), 0, bw);
            }
            let mut rc = RECT {
                left: pad,
                top: pad,
                right: bw as i32,
                bottom: bh as i32,
            };
            SetTextColor(self.hdc, COLORREF(0x00FF_FFFF));
            DrawTextW(
                self.hdc,
                &mut wide,
                &mut rc,
                DT_LEFT | DT_SINGLELINE | DT_NOPREFIX | DT_NOCLIP,
            );
            SelectObject(self.hdc, old);
            (bw, bh)
        };

        // Extract clean 0..255 anti-aliased luminance coverage mask.
        for row in 0..bh {
            let src_off = row * TEXT_SCRATCH_W;
            for col in 0..bw {
                // SAFETY: within `TEXT_SCRATCH_W * TEXT_SCRATCH_H`.
                let px = unsafe { *self.bits.add(src_off + col) };
                let r = ((px >> 16) & 0xFF) as u8;
                let g = ((px >> 8) & 0xFF) as u8;
                let b = (px & 0xFF) as u8;
                self.mask[src_off + col] = r.max(g).max(b);
            }
        }

        let ox = x - pad;
        let oy = y - pad;

        // Optional silky anti-aliased dark outline (`SET_TEXT_OUTLINE()` for Pricedown titles!).
        if let Some((oc, rad)) = outline {
            let r2 = rad * rad + 1;
            for row in 0..bh {
                let row_off = row * TEXT_SCRATCH_W;
                let y0 = row.saturating_sub(rad as usize);
                let y1 = (row + rad as usize).min(bh - 1);
                for col in 0..bw {
                    let mut best = 0u8;
                    let x0 = col.saturating_sub(rad as usize);
                    let x1 = (col + rad as usize).min(bw - 1);
                    for sy in y0..=y1 {
                        let dy = sy as i32 - row as i32;
                        let sy_off = sy * TEXT_SCRATCH_W;
                        for sx in x0..=x1 {
                            let dx = sx as i32 - col as i32;
                            if dx * dx + dy * dy <= r2 {
                                let v = self.mask[sy_off + sx];
                                if v > best {
                                    best = v;
                                    if best == 255 {
                                        break;
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        if best == 255 {
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    self.outline[row_off + col] = best;
                }
            }
            for row in 0..bh {
                let py = oy + row as i32;
                if py < 0 || py >= CANVAS_H as i32 {
                    continue;
                }
                let row_off = row * TEXT_SCRATCH_W;
                let dst_row = py as usize * CANVAS_W;
                for col in 0..bw {
                    let m = self.outline[row_off + col];
                    if m == 0 {
                        continue;
                    }
                    let px = ox + col as i32;
                    if px < 0 || px >= CANVAS_W as i32 {
                        continue;
                    }
                    let a = ((u32::from(oc.a) * u32::from(m) + 127) / 255) as u8;
                    let idx = dst_row + px as usize;
                    canvas.pixels[idx] = blend_premul(canvas.pixels[idx], oc.r, oc.g, oc.b, a);
                }
            }
        }

        // Composite main anti-aliased glyph coverage.
        for row in 0..bh {
            let py = oy + row as i32;
            if py < 0 || py >= CANVAS_H as i32 {
                continue;
            }
            let row_off = row * TEXT_SCRATCH_W;
            let dst_row = py as usize * CANVAS_W;
            for col in 0..bw {
                let m = self.mask[row_off + col];
                if m == 0 {
                    continue;
                }
                let px = ox + col as i32;
                if px < 0 || px >= CANVAS_W as i32 {
                    continue;
                }
                let a = ((u32::from(color.a) * u32::from(m) + 127) / 255) as u8;
                let idx = dst_row + px as usize;
                canvas.pixels[idx] = blend_premul(canvas.pixels[idx], color.r, color.g, color.b, a);
            }
        }

        sz.cx
    }
}

/// 1920x1080 premultiplied-BGRA drawing surface with smooth vector primitives.
pub struct Canvas {
    pub pixels: Vec<u32>,
}

impl Canvas {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            pixels: vec![0u32; CANVAS_W * CANVAS_H],
        }
    }

    pub fn clear(&mut self) {
        self.pixels.fill(0);
    }

    #[inline(always)]
    fn blend_px(&mut self, x: i32, y: i32, r: u8, g: u8, b: u8, a: u8) {
        if x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= CANVAS_W as i32 || y >= CANVAS_H as i32 || a == 0 {
            return;
        }
        let idx = y as usize * CANVAS_W + x as usize;
        self.pixels[idx] = blend_premul(self.pixels[idx], r, g, b, a);
    }

    pub fn fill_rect(&mut self, x: i32, y: i32, w: i32, h: i32, c: Rgba) {
        if c.a == 0 || w <= 0 || h <= 0 {
            return;
        }
        let x0 = x.max(0) as usize;
        let y0 = y.max(0) as usize;
        let x1 = (x + w).min(CANVAS_W as i32).max(0) as usize;
        let y1 = (y + h).min(CANVAS_H as i32).max(0) as usize;
        for py in y0..y1 {
            let row = &mut self.pixels[py * CANVAS_W + x0..py * CANVAS_W + x1];
            if c.a == 255 {
                row.fill(pack_premul(c.r, c.g, c.b, 255));
            } else {
                for px in row {
                    *px = blend_premul(*px, c.r, c.g, c.b, c.a);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /// Fast clipped opaque blit of a `w x h` `0xFF_RR_GG_BB` image into the canvas.
    pub fn blit_argb_opaque(&mut self, x: i32, y: i32, w: usize, h: usize, src: &[u32]) {
        if w == 0 || h == 0 || src.len() < w * h {
            return;
        }
        for sy in 0..h {
            let dy = y + sy as i32;
            if dy < 0 || dy >= CANVAS_H as i32 {
                continue;
            }
            let src_row = sy * w;
            let dst_row = dy as usize * CANVAS_W;
            for sx in 0..w {
                let dx = x + sx as i32;
                if dx < 0 || dx >= CANVAS_W as i32 {
                    continue;
                }
                self.pixels[dst_row + dx as usize] = src[src_row + sx] | 0xFF00_0000;
            }
        }
    }

    /// GTA `CommonMenu` / `Gradient_Nav` clean vertical shading (1:1 GTA V sprite profile).
    pub fn fill_gradient_nav(&mut self, x: i32, y: i32, w: i32, h: i32, base: Rgba, gradients: bool) {
        if !gradients {
            self.fill_rect(x, y, w, h, base);
            return;
        }
        let x0 = x.max(0) as usize;
        let y0 = y.max(0) as usize;
        let x1 = (x + w).min(CANVAS_W as i32).max(0) as usize;
        let y1 = (y + h).min(CANVAS_H as i32).max(0) as usize;
        let hf = h.max(1) as f32;
        for py in y0..y1 {
            let t = ((py as i32 - y) as f32 / hf).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
            // Authentic CommonMenu/Gradient_Nav: crisp top (1.03x) smoothly tapering to rich bottom (0.76x).
            let mul = 1.03 - 0.27 * t;
            let r = (f32::from(base.r) * mul).clamp(0.0, 255.0) as u8;
            let g = (f32::from(base.g) * mul).clamp(0.0, 255.0) as u8;
            let b = (f32::from(base.b) * mul).clamp(0.0, 255.0) as u8;
            let row = &mut self.pixels[py * CANVAS_W + x0..py * CANVAS_W + x1];
            for px in row {
                *px = blend_premul(*px, r, g, b, base.a);
            }
        }
    }

    /// GTA `CommonMenu` / `Gradient_Bgd` dark translucent gradient (`Menu.cpp` line 439).
    pub fn fill_gradient_bg(&mut self, x: i32, y: i32, w: i32, h: i32, base: Rgba, gradients: bool) {
        if !gradients || base.r >= 20 || base.g >= 20 || base.b >= 20 {
            self.fill_rect(x, y, w, h, base);
            return;
        }
        let x0 = x.max(0) as usize;
        let y0 = y.max(0) as usize;
        let x1 = (x + w).min(CANVAS_W as i32).max(0) as usize;
        let y1 = (y + h).min(CANVAS_H as i32).max(0) as usize;
        let hf = h.max(1) as f32;
        for py in y0..y1 {
            let t = ((py as i32 - y) as f32 / hf).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
            // Smooth top-darker to bottom-softer translucent charcoal gradient like CommonMenu/Gradient_Bgd.
            let a = (f32::from(base.a) * (1.02 - 0.16 * t)).clamp(0.0, 255.0) as u8;
            let row = &mut self.pixels[py * CANVAS_W + x0..py * CANVAS_W + x1];
            for px in row {
                *px = blend_premul(*px, 0, 0, 0, a);
            }
        }
    }

    /// Authentic GTA V Scaleform `MP_MENU_GLARE` halftone dot-matrix spinning globe + soft glare wash!
    pub fn draw_titlebox_glare(&mut self, x: i32, y: i32, w: i32, h: i32, phase: f32) {
        let x0 = x.max(0);
        let y0 = y.max(0);
        let x1 = (x + w).min(CANVAS_W as i32);
        let y1 = (y + h).min(CANVAS_H as i32);
        let wf = w.max(1) as f32;
        let hf = h.max(1) as f32;

        // Soft upper-right glare bloom + gentle sweeping light beam (Scaleform MP_MENU_GLARE).
        let sweep = ((phase * 0.14) % 2.2) - 0.6;
        let gx = x as f32 + wf * 0.72;
        let gy = y as f32 + hf * 0.52;
        let gr = hf * 0.88;

        for py in y0..y1 {
            let v = (py - y) as f32 / hf;
            for px in x0..x1 {
                let u = (px - x) as f32 / wf;
                // Soft ambient diagonal glare wash
                let diag = u - v * 0.55 - sweep;
                let wash = (-diag * diag * 16.0).exp() * 0.20;
                let corner_glow = (1.0 - ((u - 0.82).hypot((v - 0.25) * 0.8) * 1.35)).max(0.0).powi(2) * 0.24;

                // Pixelated halftone dotted globe (authentic GTA Online MP_MENU_GLARE look!)
                let dx = px as f32 - gx;
                let dy = py as f32 - gy;
                let d = dx.hypot(dy);
                let mut dots = 0.0f32;
                if d <= gr {
                    let nx = dx / gr;
                    let ny = dy / gr;
                    let nz = (1.0 - (nx * nx + ny * ny)).max(0.0).sqrt();
                    let cell = 6.0f32;
                    let cx = (px as f32 / cell).fract() - 0.5;
                    let cy = (py as f32 / cell).fract() - 0.5;
                    let dot_r = cx.hypot(cy);
                    if dot_r < 0.34 {
                        let lon = nx.atan2(nz) + phase * 0.32;
                        let lat = ny.asin();
                        // Stylized rotating continent pattern in dotted halftone
                        let land = ((lon * 2.3 + 0.4).sin() * (lat * 3.1).cos()
                            + 0.45 * (lon * 5.0 - lat * 2.0).sin())
                            .clamp(0.0, 1.0);
                        let rim = ((d / gr - 0.82) * 5.5).clamp(0.0, 1.0) * 0.45;
                        let dot_cov = ((0.34 - dot_r) / 0.14).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
                        dots = dot_cov * ((0.10 + 0.32 * land + rim) * (0.35 + 0.65 * nz));
                    }
                }

                let a = ((wash + corner_glow + dots).min(0.48) * 255.0) as u8;
                if a > 2 {
                    self.blend_px(px, py, 255, 255, 255, a);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /// Anti-aliased filled circle (for Menyoo's iconic green/red rank-globe toggle & Gamepad buttons).
    pub fn fill_circle(&mut self, cx: f32, cy: f32, radius: f32, color: Rgba) {
        let x0 = (cx - radius - 1.5).floor() as i32;
        let y0 = (cy - radius - 1.5).floor() as i32;
        let x1 = (cx + radius + 1.5).ceil() as i32;
        let y1 = (cy + radius + 1.5).ceil() as i32;
        for py in y0..=y1 {
            for px in x0..=x1 {
                let d = ((px as f32 + 0.5 - cx).hypot(py as f32 + 0.5 - cy)) - radius;
                let cov = (0.5 - d).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
                if cov > 0.0 {
                    let a = (f32::from(color.a) * cov) as u8;
                    self.blend_px(px, py, color.r, color.g, color.b, a);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /// Menyoo's iconic `mprankbadge / rankglobe_21x21_colour` ON (green) / OFF (red) graphic globe!
    /// Exact `Menu.cpp` lines 1304 & 1314 colours: ON=(102,255,102,250), OFF=(255,102,102,250).
    pub fn draw_rank_globe(&mut self, cx: f32, cy: f32, radius: f32, on: bool) {
        let (r, g, b): (u8, u8, u8) = if on { (102, 255, 102) } else { (255, 102, 102) };
        let x0 = (cx - radius - 1.5).floor() as i32;
        let y0 = (cy - radius - 1.5).floor() as i32;
        let x1 = (cx + radius + 1.5).ceil() as i32;
        let y1 = (cy + radius + 1.5).ceil() as i32;
        // Subtle crisp dark edge behind the rankglobe so green ON globe pops cleanly on the white selection bar
        self.fill_circle(cx, cy, radius + 0.8, Rgba::new(0, 0, 0, 95));
        for py in y0..=y1 {
            for px in x0..=x1 {
                let dx = px as f32 + 0.5 - cx;
                let dy = py as f32 + 0.5 - cy;
                let dist = dx.hypot(dy);
                let cov = (radius - dist + 0.5).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
                if cov <= 0.0 {
                    continue;
                }
                let nx = dx / radius;
                let ny = dy / radius;
                // Flat GTA Online rankglobe_21x21_colour silhouette:
                // crisp outer ring + equator + two latitude arcs + curved meridian arcs.
                let on_rim = dist >= radius - 1.85;
                let on_eq = ny.abs() < 0.13;
                let on_lat = (ny.abs() - 0.52).abs() < 0.11;
                let on_mer0 = nx.abs() < 0.13;
                let mer_x = 0.52 * (1.0 - ny * ny).max(0.0).sqrt();
                let on_mer1 = (nx.abs() - mer_x).abs() < 0.12;
                let wire = on_rim || on_eq || on_lat || on_mer0 || on_mer1;

                // Subtle translucent fill inside the globe + bright solid wireframe strokes
                let (alpha_f, bright) = if wire {
                    (248.0, 1.0)
                } else {
                    (92.0, 0.85)
                };
                let pr = (f32::from(r) * bright).clamp(0.0, 255.0) as u8;
                let pg = (f32::from(g) * bright).clamp(0.0, 255.0) as u8;
                let pb = (f32::from(b) * bright).clamp(0.0, 255.0) as u8;
                self.blend_px(px, py, pr, pg, pb, (alpha_f * cov) as u8);
            }
        }
    }

    /// Anti-aliased solid filled triangle (exact `CommonMenu/arrowleft`, `arrowright`, `shop_arrows_upANDdown`).
    pub fn fill_triangle(&mut self, p0: (f32, f32), p1: (f32, f32), p2: (f32, f32), c: Rgba) {
        if c.a == 0 {
            return;
        }
        let min_x = p0.0.min(p1.0).min(p2.0).floor() as i32 - 1;
        let max_x = p0.0.max(p1.0).max(p2.0).ceil() as i32 + 1;
        let min_y = p0.1.min(p1.1).min(p2.1).floor() as i32 - 1;
        let max_y = p0.1.max(p1.1).max(p2.1).ceil() as i32 + 1;
        let area = (p1.0 - p0.0) * (p2.1 - p0.1) - (p2.0 - p0.0) * (p1.1 - p0.1);
        if area.abs() < 1e-4 {
            return;
        }
        let sign = if area > 0.0 { 1.0 } else { -1.0 };
        let edge_dist = |a: (f32, f32), b: (f32, f32), x: f32, y: f32| -> f32 {
            let ex = b.0 - a.0;
            let ey = b.1 - a.1;
            let len = ex.hypot(ey).max(1e-4);
            ((x - a.0) * ey - (y - a.1) * ex) * (-sign) / len
        };
        for py in min_y..=max_y {
            for px in min_x..=max_x {
                let fx = px as f32 + 0.5;
                let fy = py as f32 + 0.5;
                let d0 = edge_dist(p0, p1, fx, fy);
                let d1 = edge_dist(p1, p2, fx, fy);
                let d2 = edge_dist(p2, p0, fx, fy);
                let d = d0.min(d1).min(d2);
                let cov = (d + 0.5).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
                if cov > 0.0 {
                    self.blend_px(px, py, c.r, c.g, c.b, (f32::from(c.a) * cov) as u8);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /// Crisp checkmark (`TICKOL::TICK`) drawn with thick anti-aliased segments.
    pub fn draw_tick(&mut self, cx: f32, cy: f32, size: f32, c: Rgba) {
        self.draw_line(cx - size * 0.55, cy + size * 0.05, cx - size * 0.12, cy + size * 0.48, 2.5, c);
        self.draw_line(cx - size * 0.12, cy + size * 0.48, cx + size * 0.60, cy - size * 0.42, 2.5, c);
    }

    pub fn draw_line(&mut self, x0: f32, y0: f32, x1: f32, y1: f32, thickness: f32, c: Rgba) {
        let half = thickness * 0.5;
        let min_x = (x0.min(x1) - half - 1.5).floor() as i32;
        let max_x = (x0.max(x1) + half + 1.5).ceil() as i32;
        let min_y = (y0.min(y1) - half - 1.5).floor() as i32;
        let max_y = (y0.max(y1) + half + 1.5).ceil() as i32;
        let dx = x1 - x0;
        let dy = y1 - y0;
        let len2 = (dx * dx + dy * dy).max(1e-4);
        for py in min_y..=max_y {
            for px in min_x..=max_x {
                let fx = px as f32 + 0.5;
                let fy = py as f32 + 0.5;
                let t = (((fx - x0) * dx + (fy - y0) * dy) / len2).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
                let dist = (fx - (x0 + t * dx)).hypot(fy - (y0 + t * dy));
                let cov = (half + 0.5 - dist).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
                if cov > 0.0 {
                    self.blend_px(px, py, c.r, c.g, c.b, (f32::from(c.a) * cov) as u8);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /// Solid `CommonMenu` arrow triangle (dir: 0=up, 1=down, 2=left, 3=right).
    pub fn draw_chevron(&mut self, cx: f32, cy: f32, size: f32, dir: u8, c: Rgba) {
        match dir {
            0 => self.fill_triangle(
                (cx, cy - size * 0.55),
                (cx - size * 0.95, cy + size * 0.45),
                (cx + size * 0.95, cy + size * 0.45),
                c,
            ),
            1 => self.fill_triangle(
                (cx, cy + size * 0.55),
                (cx - size * 0.95, cy - size * 0.45),
                (cx + size * 0.95, cy - size * 0.45),
                c,
            ),
            2 => self.fill_triangle(
                (cx - size * 0.55, cy),
                (cx + size * 0.50, cy - size * 0.85),
                (cx + size * 0.50, cy + size * 0.85),
                c,
            ),
            _ => self.fill_triangle(
                (cx + size * 0.55, cy),
                (cx - size * 0.50, cy - size * 0.85),
                (cx - size * 0.50, cy + size * 0.85),
                c,
            ),
        }
    }
}

pub struct MenyooRenderer {
    pub canvas: Canvas,
    text: TextRasterizer,
    previews: PreviewCache,
}

impl MenyooRenderer {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            canvas: Canvas::new(),
            text: TextRasterizer::new(),
            previews: PreviewCache::default(),
        }
    }

    pub fn clear_preview_cache(&mut self) {
        self.previews.clear();
    }

    /// Renders the complete Menyoo PC (Revamped for GTA) frame into `self.canvas`.
    pub fn render(&mut self, state: &MenyooState) {
        if super::gpu::take_preview_cache_stale() {
            self.previews.clear();
        }
        self.canvas.clear();
        let now = Instant::now();
        let phase = now.duration_since(state.start_time).as_secs_f32();

        // Note: Vision Hax & Color Grading run as a true fullscreen HLSL pixel shader
        // (`over::record_postfx`) on the live game texture — zero CPU tint rectangle needed!

        // 1. Live Cinematic 2.39:1 letterbox bars.
        if state.cfg.cinematic_bars {
            let bar_h = 128;
            self.canvas.fill_rect(0, 0, CANVAS_W as i32, bar_h, Rgba::new(0, 0, 0, 255));
            self.canvas.fill_rect(0, CANVAS_H as i32 - bar_h, CANVAS_W as i32, bar_h, Rgba::new(0, 0, 0, 255));
        }

        // 3. Live Custom Crosshair reticle.
        if state.cfg.crosshair_style != 0 {
            self.draw_crosshair(state.cfg.crosshair_style, state.cfg.accent);
        }

        // 3. Live Top-Right HUD overlays (Menyoo FPS Counter, Telemetry Bar, Clock, Analogue Watch).
        self.draw_top_right_hud(state);

        // 3b. Live Top-Center Compass Heading Strip.
        if state.cfg.display_compass {
            self.draw_compass(state);
        }

        // 3c. Live Bottom-Right Classic Menyoo Digital Speedometer (MPH / KPH).
        if state.cfg.display_speedo {
            self.draw_speedometer(state);
        }

        // 4. Main Menyoo Menu panel (exact MAFINS `Menu.cpp` geometry!).
        if state.is_open {
            self.draw_menu_panel(state, phase);
            if state.cfg.show_instructional {
                self.draw_instructional_buttons(state);
            }
        }

        // 4b. Optional hilarious Session Status Counter badge!
        if state.cfg.uptime_badge {
            self.draw_uptime_badge(state, phase);
        }

        // 4c. Live Object Spooner HUD Card when Spooner Mode is active!
        if state.spooner_mode && state.spooner_box {
            self.draw_spooner_hud(state);
        }

        // 5. In-Menu Keyboard Search / Text Input Modal (on top of menu!).
        if let Some(ref prompt) = state.text_prompt {
            self.draw_text_prompt(prompt, &state.cfg, phase);
        }

        // 6. Classic GTA Bottom-Left Feed Notifications (`PrintBottomLeft`).
        if !state.toasts.is_empty() {
            self.draw_toasts(state, now);
        }
    }

    fn draw_menu_panel(&mut self, state: &MenyooState, phase: f32) {
        let cfg = &state.cfg;
        let items = state.build_items();
        let total = items.len();
        let visible_rows = total.min(GTA_MAXOP);

        // Exact 1:1 MAFINS `Menu.cpp` normalized geometry mapped to 1920x1080:
        // width = 0.20 (384px), center_x = 0.16 (left_x = 0.06 = 115px),
        // options top = 0.159 (172px), row_h = 0.035 (38px), footer_h = 0.0345 (37px).
        let menu_w = 384i32;
        let menu_x = ((0.06 + cfg.menu_pos_x) * CANVAS_W as f32).round() as i32;
        let list_y = ((0.159 + cfg.menu_pos_y) * CANVAS_H as f32).round() as i32;
        let banner_h = 90i32; // 0.083 * 1080 = 89.64px
        let lower_stripe_h = 22i32; // 0.020 * 1080 = 21.6px (shop-banner menus only!)
        let row_h = 38i32; // 0.035 * 1080 = 37.8px
        let footer_h = 37i32; // 0.0345 * 1080 = 37.26px

        // Exact `Menu.cpp` lines 374-425 shop-banner rule (`titletext_ALPHA_DIS_TEMP`):
        // ONLY shop submenus (Weapon Options, Vehicle Spawner, Menyoo Customs) draw a
        // graphic banner ABOVE a 22px `titlebox`-colored lower stripe; ALL other menus
        // draw one clean 90px `Gradient_Nav` titlebox flush against the options list!
        let shop_banner = if cfg.category_banners && !cfg.rainbow_mode {
            match state.current_sub {
                SubmenuId::WeaponOptions | SubmenuId::WeaponAttachments => Some(1u8), // shopui_title_gunclub (AMMU-NATION)
                SubmenuId::VehicleCustoms
                | SubmenuId::VehicleExtras
                | SubmenuId::VehicleDoors
                | SubmenuId::SavedVehicles
                | SubmenuId::VehicleTechSystems => {
                    Some(2u8)
                } // shopui_title_carmod (MENYOO CUSTOMS)
                SubmenuId::VehicleSpawner => Some(3u8),        // shopui_title_carmod2 (GARAGE)
                _ => None,
            }
        } else {
            None
        };

        let title = state.current_title();
        let header_y = if let Some(kind) = shop_banner {
            // Shop artwork sits at y_center = 0.0989 (top = list_y - 112, h = 90)
            let shop_y = list_y - banner_h - lower_stripe_h;
            self.draw_category_banner_art(menu_x, shop_y, menu_w, banner_h, kind);
            // Exact `Menu.cpp` line 421: 22px lower stripe in `titlebox` color (`Gradient_Nav`)
            let stripe_y = list_y - lower_stripe_h;
            self.canvas.fill_gradient_nav(
                menu_x,
                stripe_y,
                menu_w,
                lower_stripe_h,
                cfg.titlebox,
                cfg.gradients,
            );
            // Exact `Menu.cpp` line 1136: small crisp centered title inside lower 22px stripe
            let (tw, th) = self.text.measure(&title, cfg.font_title, 16, true);
            let outline = if cfg.titletext.r > 240 && cfg.titletext.g > 240 && cfg.titletext.b > 240 {
                Some((Rgba::new(0, 0, 0, 210), 1))
            } else {
                None
            };
            self.text.draw(
                &mut self.canvas,
                &title,
                menu_x + (menu_w - tw) / 2,
                stripe_y + (lower_stripe_h - th) / 2,
                cfg.font_title,
                16,
                true,
                cfg.titletext,
                outline,
            );
            shop_y
        } else {
            // Exact `Menu.cpp` line 410: clean 384x90 `Gradient_Nav` titlebox flush on `list_y`!
            let hy = list_y - banner_h;
            self.canvas.fill_gradient_nav(
                menu_x,
                hy,
                menu_w,
                banner_h,
                cfg.titlebox,
                cfg.gradients,
            );
            if cfg.titlebox_globe {
                self.canvas
                    .draw_titlebox_glare(menu_x, hy, menu_w, banner_h, phase);
            }
            // Exact `AddTitle` (`Menu.cpp` lines 1141-1173): Pricedown + crisp black outline when white!
            let title_px = if title.len() < 15 {
                54
            } else if title.len() < 19 {
                44
            } else if title.len() < 23 {
                36
            } else {
                28
            };
            let (tw, th) = self.text.measure(&title, cfg.font_title, title_px, true);
            let tx = if cfg.centre_title {
                menu_x + (menu_w - tw) / 2
            } else {
                menu_x + 12
            };
            let ty = hy + (banner_h - th) / 2 - 1;
            let outline = if cfg.titletext.r > 240 && cfg.titletext.g > 240 && cfg.titletext.b > 240 {
                Some((Rgba::new(0, 0, 0, 245), 2))
            } else {
                None
            };
            self.text.draw(
                &mut self.canvas,
                &title,
                tx,
                ty,
                cfg.font_title,
                title_px,
                true,
                cfg.titletext,
                outline,
            );
            hy
        };

        // --- OPTIONS BACKGROUND (`CommonMenu/Gradient_Bgd`) ---
        let list_h = (visible_rows as i32) * row_h;
        self.canvas
            .fill_gradient_bg(menu_x, list_y, menu_w, list_h, cfg.bg, cfg.gradients);

        // Exact Menyoo scroll window (`Menu.cpp` lines 1181-1201):
        let cur_1 = state.current_op + 1;
        let start_idx = if total <= GTA_MAXOP || cur_1 < GTA_SCROLLOP {
            0
        } else if cur_1 > total.saturating_sub(GTA_BETOP) {
            total.saturating_sub(GTA_MAXOP)
        } else {
            cur_1 - GTA_SCROLLOP
        };
        let end_idx = (start_idx + GTA_MAXOP).min(total);

        let mut selected_item: Option<&MenuItem> = None;
        let mut selected_row_y = list_y;

        for (vis_i, idx) in (start_idx..end_idx).enumerate() {
            let item = &items[idx];
            let ry = list_y + (vis_i as i32) * row_h;
            let is_sel = idx == state.current_op && !item.is_break;

            if is_sel {
                selected_item = Some(item);
                selected_row_y = ry;
                self.canvas.fill_gradient_nav(
                    menu_x,
                    ry,
                    menu_w,
                    row_h,
                    cfg.selectionhi,
                    cfg.gradients,
                );
            }

            if item.is_break {
                // Exact `AddBreak` (`Menu.cpp` lines 1407-1445): HouseScript italic, no heavy outline.
                let mut brk_px = 21i32;
                let (mut bw, mut bh) = self.text.measure(&item.label, cfg.font_breaks, brk_px, false);
                while bw > menu_w - 16 && brk_px > 14 {
                    brk_px -= 1;
                    let (nw, nh) = self.text.measure(&item.label, cfg.font_breaks, brk_px, false);
                    bw = nw;
                    bh = nh;
                }
                let bx = if cfg.centre_breaks {
                    menu_x + (menu_w - bw) / 2
                } else {
                    menu_x + 12
                };
                self.text.draw(
                    &mut self.canvas,
                    &item.label,
                    bx,
                    ry + (row_h - bh) / 2,
                    cfg.font_breaks,
                    brk_px,
                    false,
                    cfg.optionbreaks,
                    None,
                );
                continue;
            }

            let row_font = if is_sel { cfg.font_selection } else { cfg.font_options };
            let text_col = if is_sel { cfg.selectedtext } else { cfg.optiontext };
            // Exact `Menu.cpp` line 1210: Font 0 (`Arial`) scales slightly smaller (0.33 vs 0.40).
            let opt_px = if matches!(row_font, MenuFont::Arial) { 20 } else { 25 };
            let (lw, lh) = self.text.measure(&item.label, row_font, opt_px, false);
            let lx = if cfg.centre_options {
                menu_x + (menu_w - lw) / 2
            } else {
                menu_x + 12
            };
            let ly = ry + (row_h - lh) / 2;
            self.text.draw(
                &mut self.canvas,
                &item.label,
                lx,
                ly,
                row_font,
                opt_px,
                false,
                text_col,
                None,
            );

            // Right-side indicator (Submenu `"  ~b~>"`, `rankglobe_21x21_colour`, Tick, `< Value >`, Tag).
            let right_edge = menu_x + menu_w - 8;
            let cy = ry as f32 + row_h as f32 * 0.5;
            match &item.right {
                ItemRight::None => {}
                ItemRight::SubmenuArrow => {
                    // Exact `Menu.cpp` lines 1216-1235: `"  ~b~>"` (or `"  ~b~=="` for Pricedown/Caps)
                    // in native GTA `HUD_COLOUR_BLUE` (93, 182, 229)!
                    let glyph = if matches!(row_font, MenuFont::Pricedown | MenuFont::Caps) {
                        "=="
                    } else {
                        ">"
                    };
                    let arrow_col = Rgba::new(93, 182, 229, 255);
                    self.text.draw(
                        &mut self.canvas,
                        glyph,
                        lx + lw + 10,
                        ly,
                        row_font,
                        opt_px,
                        false,
                        arrow_col,
                        None,
                    );
                }
                ItemRight::ToggleGlobe(on) => {
                    // Exact `Menu.cpp` lines 1300-1315: right-aligned `rankglobe_21x21_colour`!
                    self.canvas
                        .draw_rank_globe((right_edge - 14) as f32, cy, 10.5, *on);
                }
                ItemRight::Tick(active) => {
                    if *active {
                        self.canvas.draw_tick(
                            (right_edge - 12) as f32,
                            cy,
                            9.5,
                            if is_sel {
                                cfg.selectedtext
                            } else {
                                cfg.optiontext
                            },
                        );
                    }
                }
                ItemRight::Slider { text, adjustable } => {
                    // Exact `AddNumber`/`AddTexter` (`Menu.cpp` lines 1455-1484):
                    // Font 0 (`ChaletLondon`) at compact scale 0.26 (~17px) + solid `arrowleft`/`arrowright`!
                    let (vw, vh) = self.text.measure(text, MenuFont::Arial, 17, false);
                    let vy = ry + (row_h - vh) / 2;
                    if is_sel && *adjustable {
                        let vx = right_edge - vw - 16;
                        self.canvas.draw_chevron((vx - 9) as f32, cy, 5.5, 2, text_col);
                        self.text.draw(
                            &mut self.canvas,
                            text,
                            vx,
                            vy,
                            MenuFont::Arial,
                            17,
                            false,
                            text_col,
                            None,
                        );
                        self.canvas.draw_chevron((right_edge - 6) as f32, cy, 5.5, 3, text_col);
                    } else {
                        self.text.draw(
                            &mut self.canvas,
                            text,
                            right_edge - vw - 4,
                            vy,
                            MenuFont::Arial,
                            17,
                            false,
                            text_col,
                            None,
                        );
                    }
                }
                ItemRight::Tag(tag) => {
                    let (vw, vh) = self.text.measure(tag, MenuFont::Arial, 17, false);
                    let col = if is_sel { cfg.selectedtext } else { cfg.optiontext };
                    self.text.draw(
                        &mut self.canvas,
                        tag,
                        right_edge - vw - 4,
                        ry + (row_h - vh) / 2,
                        MenuFont::Arial,
                        17,
                        false,
                        col,
                        None,
                    );
                }
            }
        }

        // --- THIN WHITE LINE OVER FOOTER (`Menu.cpp` lines 449-453, exact 1px white rule) ---
        let footer_y = list_y + list_h;
        if cfg.thin_line_over_footer {
            self.canvas
                .fill_rect(menu_x, footer_y, menu_w, 1, Rgba::new(255, 255, 255, 255));
        }

        // --- FOOTER / SCROLLER BAR (`Menu.cpp` lines 443-480: CLEAN! No left watermark!) ---
        self.canvas.fill_gradient_nav(
            menu_x,
            footer_y + i32::from(cfg.thin_line_over_footer),
            menu_w,
            footer_h - i32::from(cfg.thin_line_over_footer),
            cfg.titlebox,
            cfg.gradients,
        );

        // Centered solid `shop_arrows_upANDdown` double triangle ONLY when list scrolls (`total > 14`)
        if total > GTA_MAXOP {
            let fcx = (menu_x + menu_w / 2) as f32;
            let fcy = footer_y as f32 + footer_h as f32 * 0.5;
            self.canvas.draw_chevron(fcx, fcy - 5.5, 5.8, 0, cfg.optioncount);
            self.canvas.draw_chevron(fcx, fcy + 5.5, 5.8, 1, cfg.optioncount);
        }

        // Right-aligned option count (`1 / 10`) in exact `GTAfont::Arial` scale 0.26 (`17px`)!
        let count_str = format!("{} / {}", state.current_op + 1, total);
        let (cw, ch) = self.text.measure(&count_str, MenuFont::Arial, 17, false);
        self.text.draw(
            &mut self.canvas,
            &count_str,
            menu_x + menu_w - cw - 8,
            footer_y + (footer_h - ch) / 2,
            MenuFont::Arial,
            17,
            false,
            cfg.optioncount,
            None,
        );

        // --- OPTIONAL DESCRIPTION BAR (OFF by default for pure 1:1 Menyoo silhouette!) ---
        if cfg.show_description_bar
            && let Some(sel) = selected_item
            && !sel.description.is_empty()
        {
            let desc_y = footer_y + footer_h + 4;
            let max_desc_w = menu_w - 20;
            let lines = wrap_text(&mut self.text, &sel.description, MenuFont::Arial, 15, max_desc_w);
            let desc_h = 12 + (lines.len() as i32) * 18;
            self.canvas
                .fill_rect(menu_x, desc_y, menu_w, desc_h, Rgba::new(0, 0, 0, 195));
            self.canvas
                .fill_rect(menu_x, desc_y, menu_w, 2, cfg.titlebox);
            for (li, line) in lines.iter().enumerate() {
                self.text.draw(
                    &mut self.canvas,
                    line,
                    menu_x + 10,
                    desc_y + 6 + (li as i32) * 18,
                    MenuFont::Arial,
                    15,
                    false,
                    Rgba::new(240, 240, 240, 245),
                    None,
                );
            }
        }

        // --- FLOATING COLOUR PREVIEW SWATCH (`Menu.cpp` lines 1703-1717: exact 192x96 swatch!) ---
        if let Some(sel) = selected_item
            && let Some(prev) = sel.preview_colour
        {
            let sw = 192i32; // 0.10 * 1920
            let sh = 96i32;  // 0.0889 * 1080
            let sx = if menu_x + menu_w + sw + 32 < CANVAS_W as i32 {
                menu_x + menu_w + 27
            } else {
                (menu_x - sw - 27).max(12)
            };
            let sy = selected_row_y.clamp(header_y, CANVAS_H as i32 - sh - 24);
            self.canvas
                .fill_rect(sx - 3, sy - 3, sw + 6, sh + 6, Rgba::new(0, 0, 0, 212));
            self.canvas
                .fill_rect(sx, sy, sw, sh, Rgba::new(prev.r, prev.g, prev.b, 255));
        } else if cfg.show_previews
            && let Some(sel) = selected_item
            && let Some(spec) = sel.preview_spec.as_ref()
        {
            self.draw_preview_card(state, spec, menu_x, header_y, menu_w);
        }
    }

    /// Floating studio / live-snapshot PNG preview card beside the main menu panel
    /// for Vehicles, Weapons, Peds, Props, and Weathers (`menyooStuff/Previews/*/*.png`).
    fn draw_preview_card(
        &mut self,
        state: &MenyooState,
        spec: &PreviewSpec,
        menu_x: i32,
        header_y: i32,
        menu_w: i32,
    ) {
        let cfg = &state.cfg;
        let card_w = PREVIEW_W as i32 + 20;
        let card_h = 34 + PREVIEW_H as i32 + 54;
        let cx = if menu_x + menu_w + card_w + 28 < CANVAS_W as i32 {
            menu_x + menu_w + 18
        } else {
            (menu_x - card_w - 18).max(12)
        };
        let cy = header_y.clamp(24, CANVAS_H as i32 - card_h - 68);

        // Outer soft shadow & translucent dark glass frame
        self.canvas
            .fill_rect(cx - 3, cy - 3, card_w + 6, card_h + 6, Rgba::new(0, 0, 0, 165));
        self.canvas
            .fill_rect(cx, cy, card_w, card_h, Rgba::new(10, 12, 18, 228));
        self.canvas.fill_rect(cx, cy, card_w, 3, cfg.titlebox);
        self.canvas
            .fill_rect(cx, cy + card_h - 2, card_w, 2, cfg.accent);

        // Header bar: kind label left + category badge pill right
        let hdr = spec.kind.header_label();
        self.text.draw(
            &mut self.canvas,
            hdr,
            cx + 11,
            cy + 10,
            MenuFont::Caps,
            13,
            true,
            Rgba::new(210, 224, 240, 240),
            None,
        );
        if !spec.badge.is_empty() {
            let (bw, _) = self.text.measure(&spec.badge, MenuFont::Caps, 12, true);
            let pill_w = (bw + 14).min(130);
            let px = cx + card_w - pill_w - 10;
            self.canvas
                .fill_rect(px, cy + 7, pill_w, 20, Rgba::new(255, 255, 255, 22));
            self.canvas.fill_rect(px, cy + 25, pill_w, 2, cfg.accent);
            self.text.draw(
                &mut self.canvas,
                &spec.badge,
                px + 7,
                cy + 10,
                MenuFont::Caps,
                12,
                true,
                Rgba::new(245, 250, 255, 250),
                None,
            );
        }

        // 320x180 PNG artwork frame
        let ix = cx + 10;
        let iy = cy + 34;
        self.canvas.fill_rect(
            ix - 1,
            iy - 1,
            PREVIEW_W as i32 + 2,
            PREVIEW_H as i32 + 2,
            Rgba::new(255, 255, 255, 42),
        );
        if let Some(px) = self.previews.resolve(&state.stuff_dir, spec) {
            self.canvas
                .blit_argb_opaque(ix, iy, PREVIEW_W, PREVIEW_H, px);
        } else {
            self.canvas.fill_gradient_nav(
                ix,
                iy,
                PREVIEW_W as i32,
                PREVIEW_H as i32,
                Rgba::new(24, 30, 44, 255),
                true,
            );
        }

        // Bottom caption strip: title + subtitle
        let max_text_w = card_w - 22;
        let mut title = spec.title.clone();
        while title.len() > 4 && self.text.measure(&title, MenuFont::Impact, 20, true).0 > max_text_w {
            title.pop();
        }
        if title.len() < spec.title.len() && title.len() > 3 {
            title.truncate(title.len().saturating_sub(2));
            title.push_str("..");
        }
        self.text.draw(
            &mut self.canvas,
            &title,
            cx + 11,
            iy + PREVIEW_H as i32 + 7,
            MenuFont::Impact,
            20,
            true,
            Rgba::new(255, 255, 255, 255),
            Some((Rgba::new(0, 0, 0, 180), 1)),
        );
        let mut sub = spec.subtitle.clone();
        while sub.len() > 4 && self.text.measure(&sub, MenuFont::Arial, 14, false).0 > max_text_w {
            sub.pop();
        }
        self.text.draw(
            &mut self.canvas,
            &sub,
            cx + 11,
            iy + PREVIEW_H as i32 + 31,
            MenuFont::Arial,
            14,
            false,
            Rgba::new(178, 224, 245, 235),
            None,
        );
    }

    /// Classic GTA V `THEFEED` bottom-left feed notifications (`Game::Print::PrintBottomLeft`).
    fn draw_toasts(&mut self, state: &MenyooState, now: Instant) {
        let base_x = 34i32;
        let card_w = 348i32;
        let mut cur_y = CANVAS_H as i32 - 224; // Classic GTA bottom-left stack above minimap zone

        for toast in state.toasts.iter().rev() {
            let alpha = toast.alpha(now);
            if alpha <= 0.01 {
                continue;
            }
            let a_bg = (182.0 * alpha) as u8;
            let a_fg = (255.0 * alpha) as u8;

            let lines = wrap_text(&mut self.text, &toast.body, MenuFont::Arial, 16, card_w - 22);
            let has_header = !toast.sender.is_empty();
            let card_h = if has_header {
                34 + (lines.len() as i32) * 19
            } else {
                16 + (lines.len() as i32) * 19
            };
            let top_y = cur_y - card_h;

            // Authentic GTA V THEFEED dark translucent charcoal card (zero neon sidebars!)
            self.canvas
                .fill_rect(base_x, top_y, card_w, card_h, Rgba::new(0, 0, 0, a_bg));
            self.canvas
                .fill_rect(base_x, top_y, card_w, 1, Rgba::new(255, 255, 255, (32.0 * alpha) as u8));

            let body_y = if has_header {
                self.text.draw(
                    &mut self.canvas,
                    &toast.sender,
                    base_x + 11,
                    top_y + 7,
                    MenuFont::Arial,
                    16,
                    true,
                    Rgba::new(255, 255, 255, a_fg),
                    None,
                );
                if !toast.subtitle.is_empty() {
                    let (sw, _) = self.text.measure(&toast.sender, MenuFont::Arial, 16, true);
                    self.text.draw(
                        &mut self.canvas,
                        &toast.subtitle,
                        base_x + 18 + sw,
                        top_y + 8,
                        MenuFont::Arial,
                        14,
                        false,
                        Rgba::new(93, 182, 229, a_fg),
                        None,
                    );
                }
                top_y + 28
            } else {
                top_y + 8
            };

            for (li, line) in lines.iter().enumerate() {
                self.text.draw(
                    &mut self.canvas,
                    line,
                    base_x + 11,
                    body_y + (li as i32) * 19,
                    MenuFont::Arial,
                    16,
                    false,
                    Rgba::new(236, 236, 236, a_fg),
                    None,
                );
            }
            cur_y = top_y - 6;
        }
    }

    /// Authentic GTA V bottom-right `instructional_buttons` bar (`Menu::set_opened_IB` & `draw_IB`).
    fn draw_instructional_buttons(&mut self, state: &MenyooState) {
        let bar_h = 34i32;
        let bar_y = CANVAS_H as i32 - 52;
        let back_lbl = if state.current_sub == SubmenuId::MainMenu {
            "Exit"
        } else {
            "Back"
        };
        let items = state.build_items();
        let on_slider = items
            .get(state.current_op)
            .is_some_and(|i| matches!(i.right, ItemRight::Slider { adjustable: true, .. }));

        let pairs: Vec<(&str, &str, Option<Rgba>)> = if state.using_controller {
            let mut v = vec![(back_lbl, "B", Some(Rgba::new(224, 50, 50, 255)))];
            if on_slider {
                v.push(("Adjust", "◄ ►", None));
            } else {
                v.push(("Select", "A", Some(Rgba::new(114, 204, 114, 255))));
            }
            v
        } else {
            let mut v = vec![(back_lbl, "BKSP", None)];
            if on_slider {
                v.push(("Adjust", "◄ ►", None));
            } else {
                v.push(("Select", "ENTER", None));
            }
            v
        };

        let mut total_w = 18i32;
        for (lbl, key, circle) in &pairs {
            let (lw, _) = self.text.measure(lbl, MenuFont::Arial, 16, false);
            let kw = if circle.is_some() {
                24
            } else {
                self.text.measure(key, MenuFont::Caps, 13, true).0 + 14
            };
            total_w += lw + kw + 22;
        }

        // Offset cleanly left of GTA's native bottom-right `PHONE [+]` / `TV [X]` prompts!
        let bar_x = CANVAS_W as i32 - total_w - 220;
        // Exact `Menu.cpp` line 829: `RGBA(0, 0, 0, 80)` subtle dark strip!
        self.canvas
            .fill_rect(bar_x, bar_y, total_w, bar_h, Rgba::new(0, 0, 0, 108));

        let mut cx = bar_x + 12;
        for (lbl, key, circle) in pairs {
            let (lw, lh) = self.text.measure(lbl, MenuFont::Arial, 16, false);
            self.text.draw(
                &mut self.canvas,
                lbl,
                cx,
                bar_y + (bar_h - lh) / 2,
                MenuFont::Arial,
                16,
                false,
                Rgba::new(242, 242, 242, 245),
                None,
            );
            cx += lw + 8;

            if let Some(col) = circle {
                self.canvas
                    .fill_circle((cx + 11) as f32, (bar_y + bar_h / 2) as f32, 11.0, col);
                let (kw, kh) = self.text.measure(key, MenuFont::Arial, 14, true);
                self.text.draw(
                    &mut self.canvas,
                    key,
                    cx + 11 - kw / 2,
                    bar_y + (bar_h - kh) / 2,
                    MenuFont::Arial,
                    14,
                    true,
                    Rgba::new(10, 10, 14, 255),
                    None,
                );
                cx += 34;
            } else {
                let (kw, kh) = self.text.measure(key, MenuFont::Caps, 13, true);
                let bw = kw + 12;
                self.canvas.fill_rect(
                    cx,
                    bar_y + 6,
                    bw,
                    bar_h - 12,
                    Rgba::new(242, 242, 242, 235),
                );
                self.text.draw(
                    &mut self.canvas,
                    key,
                    cx + 6,
                    bar_y + (bar_h - kh) / 2,
                    MenuFont::Caps,
                    13,
                    true,
                    Rgba::new(10, 10, 14, 255),
                    None,
                );
                cx += bw + 16;
            }
        }
    }

    /// Cheeky Session Status Counter HUD badge (opt-in inside Misc -> Studio Presets!).
    fn draw_uptime_badge(&mut self, state: &MenyooState, phase: f32) {
        let messages = [
            "MENYOO DX12 FOR GTA  |  PURE RUST OVERLAY",
            "DIRECTX 12 SWAPCHAIN OVERLAY  |  PRESS F7 TO TOGGLE",
            "0.00ms GPU OVERHEAD WHEN CLOSED  |  16 BUILT-IN THEMES",
            "3D OBJECT SPOONER  •  18 FUN GUNS  •  SCHEMA v11.0",
        ];
        let idx = ((phase as usize) / 6) % messages.len();
        let text = if state.ankle_monitor_mode {
            "BOUNDARY MONITOR: ACTIVE  |  STAY INSIDE ZONE"
        } else {
            messages[idx]
        };
        let (tw, th) = self.text.measure(text, MenuFont::Arial, 15, true);
        let bw = tw + 22;
        let bh = th + 10;
        let bx = (CANVAS_W as i32 - bw) / 2;
        let by = CANVAS_H as i32 - 50;
        self.canvas
            .fill_rect(bx, by, bw, bh, Rgba::new(0, 0, 0, 165));
        let bar_col = if state.ankle_monitor_mode && ((phase * 3.0) as u32) % 2 == 0 {
            Rgba::new(255, 72, 72, 255)
        } else {
            state.cfg.titlebox
        };
        self.canvas.fill_rect(bx, by + bh - 2, bw, 2, bar_col);
        self.text.draw(
            &mut self.canvas,
            text,
            bx + 11,
            by + 5,
            MenuFont::Arial,
            15,
            true,
            Rgba::new(240, 244, 250, 245),
            None,
        );
    }

    fn draw_top_right_hud(&mut self, state: &MenyooState) {
        // Start cleanly below GTA's native top-right Wanted Stars + Cash/Bank HUD stack (`y = 24..156`)!
        let mut y = 168i32;
        let right = CANVAS_W as i32 - 32;
        let snap = crate::host_bridge::latest_perf();

        if state.cfg.display_fps {
            let text = if snap.fps > 0.05 {
                format!("{:.1} FPS  ({:.1} ms)", snap.fps, snap.frame_ms)
            } else {
                "MENYOO DX12  •  READY".to_owned()
            };
            let (w, h) = self.text.measure(&text, MenuFont::Impact, 26, true);
            self.canvas
                .fill_rect(right - w - 22, y - 4, w + 22, h + 10, Rgba::new(8, 10, 16, 175));
            self.text.draw(
                &mut self.canvas,
                &text,
                right - w - 11,
                y,
                MenuFont::Impact,
                26,
                true,
                Rgba::new(112, 255, 145, 255),
                Some((Rgba::new(0, 0, 0, 210), 1)),
            );
            y += h + 16;
        }

        if state.cfg.display_telemetry {
            let line = format!(
                "DRAWS {:.0}  |  GPU {:.0}%  |  VRAM {:.1}/{:.1} GB  |  RAM {:.1} GB",
                snap.draws,
                snap.card_busy_pct,
                snap.vram_used_mb as f64 / 1024.0,
                snap.vram_budget_mb as f64 / 1024.0,
                snap.ram_ws_mb as f64 / 1024.0,
            );
            let (w, h) = self.text.measure(&line, MenuFont::Arial, 17, true);
            self.canvas
                .fill_rect(right - w - 20, y - 4, w + 20, h + 8, Rgba::new(8, 10, 16, 185));
            self.canvas.fill_rect(right - w - 20, y - 4, 3, h + 8, state.cfg.accent);
            self.text.draw(
                &mut self.canvas,
                &line,
                right - w - 10,
                y,
                MenuFont::Arial,
                17,
                true,
                Rgba::new(225, 240, 255, 255),
                None,
            );
            y += h + 14;

            if let Some([px, py, pz]) = state.world.player_xyz {
                let wline = format!(
                    "XYZ  {px:.1}, {py:.1}, {pz:.1}  |  PEDS {}/{}  |  VEHS {}/{}",
                    state.world.peds_active,
                    state.world.peds_max,
                    state.world.vehs_active,
                    state.world.vehs_max,
                );
                let (ww, wh) = self.text.measure(&wline, MenuFont::Arial, 16, true);
                self.canvas
                    .fill_rect(right - ww - 20, y - 4, ww + 20, wh + 8, Rgba::new(8, 10, 16, 185));
                self.canvas
                    .fill_rect(right - ww - 20, y - 4, 3, wh + 8, Rgba::new(82, 245, 145, 255));
                self.text.draw(
                    &mut self.canvas,
                    &wline,
                    right - ww - 10,
                    y,
                    MenuFont::Arial,
                    16,
                    true,
                    Rgba::new(210, 255, 224, 255),
                    None,
                );
                y += wh + 14;
            }
        }

        if state.cfg.display_xyzh {
            let text = if let Some([x, y, z]) = state.world.player_xyz {
                format!(
                    "X: {x:.1}   Y: {y:.1}   Z: {z:.1}   H: {:.0}° {}",
                    state.world.heading_deg.rem_euclid(360.0),
                    state.world.compass_cardinal()
                )
            } else {
                format!(
                    "X: {:.1}   Y: {:.1}   Z: {:.1}   H: {:.0}°",
                    state.custom_coords[0],
                    state.custom_coords[1],
                    state.custom_coords[2],
                    state.world.heading_deg.rem_euclid(360.0),
                )
            };
            let (w, h) = self.text.measure(&text, MenuFont::Arial, 17, true);
            self.canvas
                .fill_rect(right - w - 20, y - 4, w + 20, h + 8, Rgba::new(0, 0, 0, 175));
            self.text.draw(
                &mut self.canvas,
                &text,
                right - w - 10,
                y,
                MenuFont::Arial,
                17,
                true,
                Rgba::new(255, 255, 255, 245),
                None,
            );
            y += h + 14;
        }

        if state.cfg.display_clock {
            let secs = SystemTime::now()
                .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
                .map_or(0, |d| d.as_secs());
            let (h24, m, s) = if let Some(hms) = state.world.clock_hms {
                hms
            } else if state.time_sync_system {
                (((secs / 3600) % 24) as i32, ((secs / 60) % 60) as i32, (secs % 60) as i32)
            } else {
                (state.time_hour, state.time_minute, (secs % 60) as i32)
            };
            let clock = if state.cfg.clock_24h {
                format!("{h24:02}:{m:02}:{s:02}")
            } else {
                let ampm = if h24 >= 12 { "PM" } else { "AM" };
                let h12 = match h24 % 12 {
                    0 => 12,
                    v => v,
                };
                format!("{h12:02}:{m:02} {ampm}")
            };
            let (w, h) = self.text.measure(&clock, MenuFont::Impact, 24, true);
            self.canvas
                .fill_rect(right - w - 20, y - 4, w + 20, h + 8, Rgba::new(8, 10, 16, 175));
            self.text.draw(
                &mut self.canvas,
                &clock,
                right - w - 10,
                y,
                MenuFont::Impact,
                24,
                true,
                Rgba::new(255, 255, 255, 245),
                Some((Rgba::new(0, 0, 0, 200), 1)),
            );
            y += h + 16;
        }

        // Classic Menyoo Circular Analogue Watch Face
        if state.cfg.display_analogue_clock {
            let secs = SystemTime::now()
                .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
                .map_or(0, |d| d.as_secs());
            let (h24, m, s) = if let Some(hms) = state.world.clock_hms {
                hms
            } else if state.time_sync_system {
                (((secs / 3600) % 24) as i32, ((secs / 60) % 60) as i32, (secs % 60) as i32)
            } else {
                (state.time_hour, state.time_minute, (secs % 60) as i32)
            };
            let r = 46.0f32;
            let cx = right as f32 - r - 6.0;
            let cy = y as f32 + r + 4.0;
            self.canvas.fill_circle(cx, cy, r + 3.0, Rgba::new(0, 0, 0, 210));
            self.canvas.fill_circle(cx, cy, r, Rgba::new(12, 16, 24, 215));
            // Outer GTA accent ring
            for i in 0..48 {
                let a0 = (i as f32 / 48.0) * std::f32::consts::TAU;
                let a1 = ((i + 1) as f32 / 48.0) * std::f32::consts::TAU;
                self.canvas.draw_line(
                    cx + a0.cos() * r,
                    cy + a0.sin() * r,
                    cx + a1.cos() * r,
                    cy + a1.sin() * r,
                    2.0,
                    state.cfg.titlebox,
                );
            }
            // 12 hour tick marks
            for i in 0..12 {
                let ang = (i as f32 / 12.0) * std::f32::consts::TAU - std::f32::consts::FRAC_PI_2;
                let inner = if i % 3 == 0 { r - 10.0 } else { r - 6.0 };
                let thick = if i % 3 == 0 { 2.4 } else { 1.4 };
                self.canvas.draw_line(
                    cx + ang.cos() * inner,
                    cy + ang.sin() * inner,
                    cx + ang.cos() * (r - 2.0),
                    cy + ang.sin() * (r - 2.0),
                    thick,
                    Rgba::new(235, 242, 252, 225),
                );
            }
            // Hour, Minute, Second hands
            let ha = (((h24 % 12) as f32 + m as f32 / 60.0) / 12.0) * std::f32::consts::TAU
                - std::f32::consts::FRAC_PI_2;
            let ma = ((m as f32 + s as f32 / 60.0) / 60.0) * std::f32::consts::TAU
                - std::f32::consts::FRAC_PI_2;
            let sa = (s as f32 / 60.0) * std::f32::consts::TAU - std::f32::consts::FRAC_PI_2;
            self.canvas.draw_line(cx, cy, cx + ha.cos() * (r * 0.50), cy + ha.sin() * (r * 0.50), 3.4, Rgba::new(255, 255, 255, 255));
            self.canvas.draw_line(cx, cy, cx + ma.cos() * (r * 0.72), cy + ma.sin() * (r * 0.72), 2.4, Rgba::new(220, 245, 255, 255));
            self.canvas.draw_line(cx, cy, cx + sa.cos() * (r * 0.80), cy + sa.sin() * (r * 0.80), 1.4, state.cfg.accent);
            self.canvas.fill_circle(cx, cy, 3.6, state.cfg.accent);
        }
    }

    /// Classic Menyoo Bottom-Right Digital Speedometer (MPH / KPH + Cyan->Magenta Bar).
    fn draw_speedometer(&mut self, state: &MenyooState) {
        let speed = if state.cfg.speedo_kph {
            state.world.speed_kph()
        } else {
            state.world.speed_mph()
        };
        let unit = if state.cfg.speedo_kph { "KPH" } else { "MPH" };
        let max_scale = if state.cfg.speedo_kph { 260.0 } else { 160.0 };
        let ratio = (speed / max_scale).clamp(0.0, 1.0);

        let card_w = 216i32;
        let card_h = 84i32;
        let x = CANVAS_W as i32 - card_w - 36;
        // Sit neatly above instructional buttons bar when menu is open!
        let y = if state.is_open && state.cfg.show_instructional {
            CANVAS_H as i32 - card_h - 74
        } else {
            CANVAS_H as i32 - card_h - 32
        };

        self.canvas.fill_rect(x, y, card_w, card_h, Rgba::new(10, 12, 18, 208));
        self.canvas.fill_rect(x, y, 4, card_h, state.cfg.titlebox);

        let num = format!("{:03}", speed.round() as u32);
        self.text.draw(
            &mut self.canvas,
            &num,
            x + 16,
            y + 6,
            MenuFont::Pricedown,
            46,
            true,
            Rgba::new(255, 255, 255, 255),
            Some((Rgba::new(0, 0, 0, 220), 2)),
        );
        self.text.draw(
            &mut self.canvas,
            unit,
            x + 114,
            y + 24,
            MenuFont::Caps,
            20,
            true,
            state.cfg.titlebox,
            None,
        );
        let dir = state.world.compass_cardinal();
        let (dw, _) = self.text.measure(dir, MenuFont::Caps, 16, true);
        self.text.draw(
            &mut self.canvas,
            dir,
            x + card_w - dw - 14,
            y + 26,
            MenuFont::Caps,
            16,
            true,
            state.cfg.accent,
            None,
        );

        // Sleek horizontal speed gauge bar
        let bar_x = x + 14;
        let bar_y = y + card_h - 18;
        let bar_w = card_w - 28;
        self.canvas.fill_rect(bar_x, bar_y, bar_w, 8, Rgba::new(255, 255, 255, 34));
        let fill_w = ((bar_w as f32) * ratio).round() as i32;
        if fill_w > 0 {
            for px in 0..fill_w {
                let t = px as f32 / bar_w.max(1) as f32;
                let r = (f32::from(state.cfg.titlebox.r) * (1.0 - t) + f32::from(state.cfg.accent.r) * t) as u8;
                let g = (f32::from(state.cfg.titlebox.g) * (1.0 - t) + f32::from(state.cfg.accent.g) * t) as u8;
                let b = (f32::from(state.cfg.titlebox.b) * (1.0 - t) + f32::from(state.cfg.accent.b) * t) as u8;
                self.canvas.fill_rect(bar_x + px, bar_y, 1, 8, Rgba::new(r, g, b, 245));
            }
        }
    }

    /// Top-Center Compass Heading Strip (`N / NE / E / SE / S / SW / W / NW` + degrees).
    fn draw_compass(&mut self, state: &MenyooState) {
        let w = 340i32;
        let h = 34i32;
        let x = (CANVAS_W as i32 - w) / 2;
        let y = 20i32;
        self.canvas.fill_rect(x, y, w, h, Rgba::new(8, 10, 16, 185));
        self.canvas.fill_rect(x, y + h - 2, w, 2, state.cfg.titlebox);

        let deg = state.world.heading_deg.rem_euclid(360.0);
        let label = format!(
            "◀   {}   {:03}°   ▶",
            state.world.compass_cardinal(),
            deg.round() as u32 % 360
        );
        let (lw, lh) = self.text.measure(&label, MenuFont::Caps, 18, true);
        self.text.draw(
            &mut self.canvas,
            &label,
            x + (w - lw) / 2,
            y + (h - lh) / 2 - 1,
            MenuFont::Caps,
            18,
            true,
            Rgba::new(240, 248, 255, 250),
            None,
        );
    }

    /// Compact Object Spooner HUD card at top-center/below-compass when Spooner Mode is ON.
    fn draw_spooner_hud(&mut self, state: &MenyooState) {
        let hud = super::hook::spooner_hud_snapshot();
        let w = 520i32;
        let h = 64i32;
        let x = (CANVAS_W as i32 - w) / 2;
        let y = if state.cfg.display_compass { 62 } else { 20 };

        self.canvas.fill_rect(x, y, w, h, Rgba::new(10, 12, 20, 212));
        self.canvas.fill_rect(x, y, w, 3, state.cfg.titlebox);
        self.canvas.fill_rect(x, y + h - 2, w, 2, state.cfg.accent);

        let status = if hud.pending_spawn {
            "OBJECT SPOONER  •  STREAMING PROP MODEL...".to_owned()
        } else if hud.total_count == 0 {
            "OBJECT SPOONER  •  NO PROP SELECTED  (SPAWN OR GRAB IN MENU)".to_owned()
        } else {
            let flags = match (hud.frozen, hud.invincible, hud.attached) {
                (_, _, true) => "ATTACHED",
                (true, true, false) => "FROZEN | GOD",
                (true, false, false) => "FROZEN",
                (false, true, false) => "GOD",
                (false, false, false) => "DYNAMIC",
            };
            format!(
                "SPOONER #{}/{}  [0x{:08X}]  XYZ {:.1}, {:.1}, {:.1}  ({})",
                hud.selected_idx + 1,
                hud.total_count,
                (hud.selected_hash64 >> 32) as u32,
                hud.selected_pos[0],
                hud.selected_pos[1],
                hud.selected_pos[2],
                flags
            )
        };
        let (sw, _) = self.text.measure(&status, MenuFont::Caps, 14, true);
        self.text.draw(
            &mut self.canvas,
            &status,
            x + (w - sw) / 2,
            y + 11,
            MenuFont::Caps,
            14,
            true,
            Rgba::new(245, 250, 255, 255),
            None,
        );
        let keys = "KEYS (MENU CLOSED):  I/J/K/L MOVE   |   U/O HEIGHT   |   N/M YAW   |   DEL DELETE";
        let (kw, _) = self.text.measure(keys, MenuFont::Caps, 12, false);
        self.text.draw(
            &mut self.canvas,
            keys,
            x + (w - kw) / 2,
            y + 38,
            MenuFont::Caps,
            12,
            false,
            state.cfg.accent,
            None,
        );
    }

    /// Centered GTA Keyboard Input / Search Modal (`TextPrompt`).
    fn draw_text_prompt(
        &mut self,
        prompt: &super::menu::TextPrompt,
        cfg: &super::config::MenyooConfig,
        phase: f32,
    ) {
        let mw = 560i32;
        let mh = 172i32;
        let mx = (CANVAS_W as i32 - mw) / 2;
        let my = (CANVAS_H as i32 - mh) / 2;

        // Soft fullscreen scrim so modal pops clearly
        self.canvas.fill_rect(0, 0, CANVAS_W as i32, CANVAS_H as i32, Rgba::new(0, 0, 0, 110));
        self.canvas.fill_rect(mx - 4, my - 4, mw + 8, mh + 8, Rgba::new(0, 0, 0, 200));
        self.canvas.fill_rect(mx, my, mw, mh, Rgba::new(12, 14, 22, 246));
        self.canvas.fill_gradient_nav(mx, my, mw, 42, cfg.titlebox, cfg.gradients);
        self.canvas.fill_rect(mx, my, mw, 3, cfg.accent);

        self.text.draw(
            &mut self.canvas,
            &prompt.title,
            mx + 16,
            my + 10,
            MenuFont::Caps,
            20,
            true,
            cfg.titletext,
            Some((Rgba::new(0, 0, 0, 200), 1)),
        );

        // Input box
        let ix = mx + 16;
        let iy = my + 58;
        let iw = mw - 32;
        let ih = 44;
        self.canvas.fill_rect(ix, iy, iw, ih, Rgba::new(6, 8, 14, 255));
        self.canvas.fill_rect(ix, iy + ih - 2, iw, 2, cfg.accent);

        let blink = ((phase * 2.5) as u32) % 2 == 0;
        let shown = if blink {
            format!("{}|", prompt.buffer)
        } else {
            prompt.buffer.clone()
        };
        self.text.draw(
            &mut self.canvas,
            &shown,
            ix + 12,
            iy + 10,
            MenuFont::Arial,
            22,
            true,
            Rgba::new(255, 255, 255, 255),
            None,
        );

        self.text.draw(
            &mut self.canvas,
            &prompt.hint,
            mx + 16,
            my + 112,
            MenuFont::Arial,
            15,
            false,
            Rgba::new(185, 198, 215, 235),
            None,
        );
        self.text.draw(
            &mut self.canvas,
            "ENTER = Confirm    |    BKSP = Delete    |    ESC = Cancel",
            mx + 16,
            my + 140,
            MenuFont::Caps,
            13,
            true,
            cfg.accent,
            None,
        );
    }

    fn draw_crosshair(&mut self, style: usize, accent: Rgba) {
        let cx = (CANVAS_W / 2) as f32;
        let cy = (CANVAS_H / 2) as f32;
        match style {
            1 => {
                // Classic dot
                self.canvas.fill_circle(cx, cy, 4.0, Rgba::new(0, 0, 0, 200));
                self.canvas.fill_circle(cx, cy, 2.5, Rgba::new(255, 255, 255, 255));
            }
            2 => {
                // Tactical cross
                let col = Rgba::new(110, 255, 130, 235);
                self.canvas.draw_line(cx - 14.0, cy, cx - 4.0, cy, 2.0, col);
                self.canvas.draw_line(cx + 4.0, cy, cx + 14.0, cy, 2.0, col);
                self.canvas.draw_line(cx, cy - 14.0, cx, cy - 4.0, 2.0, col);
                self.canvas.draw_line(cx, cy + 4.0, cx, cy + 14.0, 2.0, col);
                self.canvas.fill_circle(cx, cy, 1.8, Rgba::new(255, 255, 255, 255));
            }
            _ => {
                // Neon Target Ring
                for i in 0..36 {
                    let a0 = (i as f32 / 36.0) * std::f32::consts::TAU;
                    let a1 = ((i + 1) as f32 / 36.0) * std::f32::consts::TAU;
                    self.canvas.draw_line(
                        cx + a0.cos() * 11.0,
                        cy + a0.sin() * 11.0,
                        cx + a1.cos() * 11.0,
                        cy + a1.sin() * 11.0,
                        2.0,
                        accent,
                    );
                }
                self.canvas.fill_circle(cx, cy, 2.2, Rgba::new(0, 245, 255, 255));
            }
        }
    }

    /// Authentic GTA shop-banner artwork rendered ONLY on Menyoo's shop submenus
    /// (`shopui_title_gunclub`, `shopui_title_carmod`, `shopui_title_carmod2`, `Menu.cpp` lines 389-401).
    fn draw_category_banner_art(&mut self, x: i32, y: i32, w: i32, h: i32, kind: u8) {
        match kind {
            1 => {

                }

                let sub = "TACTICAL ARMORY & LOADOUTS";

                    y + h - 27,
                    MenuFont::Caps,
                    11,
                    true,
                    Rgba::new(235, 220, 180, 235),
                    None,
                );
            }
            2 => {
                // `shopui_title_carmod`: Los Santos / Menyoo Customs metallic chrome garage emblem!
                self.canvas.fill_gradient_nav(x, y, w, h, Rgba::new(28, 30, 38, 252), true);
                for i in 0..3 {

                        0 => Rgba::new(212, 32, 54, 220),

                );

            _ => {
                // `shopui_title_carmod2`: Exotic Garage / Spawner dark steel banner!

                    sub,
                    x + (w - sw) / 2,

                    MenuFont::Caps,
                    11,
