```rs
                    None,
                );
            }
        }
    }
}

/// Word-wraps `text` into at most 2 clean lines fitting within `max_w` pixels.
fn wrap_text(
    text_rast: &mut TextRasterizer,
    text: &str,
    style: MenuFont,
    px_h: i32,
    max_w: i32,
) -> Vec<String> {
    if text_rast.measure(text, style, px_h, false).0 <= max_w {
        return vec![text.to_owned()];
    }
    let mut lines = Vec::with_capacity(2);
    let mut cur = String::new();
    for word in text.split_whitespace() {
        let candidate = if cur.is_empty() {
            word.to_owned()
        } else {
            format!("{cur} {word}")
        };
        if !cur.is_empty() && text_rast.measure(&candidate, style, px_h, false).0 > max_w {
            lines.push(cur);
            cur = word.to_owned();
            if lines.len() == 2 {
                break;
            }
        } else {
            cur = candidate;
        }
    }
    if lines.len() < 2 && !cur.is_empty() {
        lines.push(cur);
    }
    lines
}

/// Writes a 24-bit BMP snapshot of `canvas` over either a real loaded GTA
/// backdrop frame (with live CPU `PostFxParams` applied!) or the fallback twilight sky.
pub fn write_preview_bmp_over(
    canvas: &Canvas,
    backdrop: Option<&[u32]>,
    postfx: PostFxParams,
    path: &std::path::Path,
) -> std::io::Result<()> {
    let w = CANVAS_W as u32;
    let h = CANVAS_H as u32;
    let row_bytes = (w * 3) as usize;
    let mut bg = if let Some(b) = backdrop
        && b.len() == CANVAS_W * CANVAS_H
    {
        b.to_vec()
    } else {
        let mut grad = vec![0u32; CANVAS_W * CANVAS_H];
        for y in 0..CANVAS_H {
            let vf = y as f32 / CANVAS_H as f32;
            let bg_r = (26.0 + 95.0 * (1.0 - (vf - 0.55).abs() * 1.8).max(0.0)) as u32;
            let bg_g = (18.0 + 38.0 * (1.0 - vf)) as u32;
            let bg_b = (48.0 + 68.0 * (1.0 - vf * 0.7)) as u32;
            let px = 0xFF00_0000 | (bg_r << 16) | (bg_g << 8) | bg_b;
            grad[y * CANVAS_W..(y + 1) * CANVAS_W].fill(px);
        }
        grad
    };
    if postfx.is_active() {
        apply_cpu_postfx(&mut bg, CANVAS_W, CANVAS_H, postfx);
    }

    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(54 + row_bytes * CANVAS_H);
    let file_size = (54 + row_bytes * CANVAS_H) as u32;
    out.extend_from_slice(b"BM");
    out.extend_from_slice(&file_size.to_le_bytes());
    out.extend_from_slice(&0u32.to_le_bytes());
    out.extend_from_slice(&54u32.to_le_bytes());
    out.extend_from_slice(&40u32.to_le_bytes());
    out.extend_from_slice(&w.to_le_bytes());
    out.extend_from_slice(&h.to_le_bytes());
    out.extend_from_slice(&1u16.to_le_bytes());
    out.extend_from_slice(&24u16.to_le_bytes());
    out.extend_from_slice(&0u32.to_le_bytes());
    out.extend_from_slice(&((row_bytes * CANVAS_H) as u32).to_le_bytes());
    out.extend_from_slice(&2835u32.to_le_bytes());
    out.extend_from_slice(&2835u32.to_le_bytes());
    out.extend_from_slice(&0u32.to_le_bytes());
    out.extend_from_slice(&0u32.to_le_bytes());

    for y in (0..CANVAS_H).rev() {
        let row_off = y * CANVAS_W;
        for x in 0..CANVAS_W {
            let bg_px = bg[row_off + x];
            let bg_r = (bg_px >> 16) & 0xFF;
            let bg_g = (bg_px >> 8) & 0xFF;
            let bg_b = bg_px & 0xFF;
            let p = canvas.pixels[row_off + x];
            let sa = (p >> 24) & 0xFF;
            let sr = (p >> 16) & 0xFF;
            let sg = (p >> 8) & 0xFF;
            let sb = p & 0xFF;
            let inv = 255 - sa;
            let r = (sr + (bg_r * inv + 127) / 255).min(255) as u8;
            let g = (sg + (bg_g * inv + 127) / 255).min(255) as u8;
            let b = (sb + (bg_b * inv + 127) / 255).min(255) as u8;
            out.push(b);
            out.push(g);
            out.push(r);
        }
    }
    std::fs::write(path, out)
}

pub fn write_preview_bmp(canvas: &Canvas, path: &std::path::Path) -> std::io::Result<()> {
    write_preview_bmp_over(canvas, None, PostFxParams::default(), path)
}

```

`src/sound.rs`:

```rs
//! Authentic Menyoo DX12 / frontend sound engine (`HUD_FRONTEND_DEFAULT_SOUNDSET`,
//! `HintCamSounds`, `Phone_SoundSet_Default`).
//!
//! Uses a lightweight pure-Win32 `winmm.dll` (`waveOut`) polyphonic stereo mixer
//! at 44.1 kHz (zero external crate dependencies, zero audio clipping during fast
//! scrolling, sleeps with 0% CPU when idle).
//!
//! Automatically loads optional user-supplied PCM `.wav` overrides from
//! `<menyooStuff>/Sounds/{focus_in,nav_up_down,nav_left_right,select,back,text_arrive,error}.wav`
//! and falls back cleanly to a studio-tuned synthesized target engine UI sound bank.
//!
//! Menyoo DX12 design & soundset cues inspired by MAFINS's MenyooSP (GPL-3.0).

use std::f32::consts::TAU;
use std::ffi::c_void;
use std::path::Path;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, AtomicU32, Ordering};
use std::sync::{Condvar, Mutex, OnceLock};

/// All seven frontend cues used by original Menyoo DX12 (`Menu.cpp` & `Game.cpp`).
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[repr(usize)]
pub enum MenuSound {
    /// `HintCamSounds` / `"FocusIn"` — menu opened (F8 / RB+Left).
    FocusIn = 0,
    /// `HUD_FRONTEND_DEFAULT_SOUNDSET` / `"NAV_UP_DOWN"` — scroll up/down.
    NavUpDown = 1,
    /// `HUD_FRONTEND_DEFAULT_SOUNDSET` / `"NAV_LEFT_RIGHT"` — slider/texter step.
    NavLeftRight = 2,
    /// `HUD_FRONTEND_DEFAULT_SOUNDSET` / `"SELECT"` — confirm / toggle.
    Select = 3,
    /// `HUD_FRONTEND_DEFAULT_SOUNDSET` / `"BACK"` — submenu back / menu close.
    Back = 4,
    /// `Phone_SoundSet_Default` / `"Text_Arrive_Tone"` — bottom-left feed toast.
    TextArrive = 5,
    /// `HUD_FRONTEND_DEFAULT_SOUNDSET` / `"ERROR"` — invalid/locked feedback.
    Error = 6,
}

impl MenuSound {
    pub const COUNT: usize = 7;

    pub const fn file_stem(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            Self::FocusIn => "focus_in",
            Self::NavUpDown => "nav_up_down",
            Self::NavLeftRight => "nav_left_right",
            Self::Select => "select",
            Self::Back => "back",
            Self::TextArrive => "text_arrive",
            Self::Error => "error",
        }
    }

    pub const fn display_name(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            Self::FocusIn => "FocusIn (Menu Open)",
            Self::NavUpDown => "NAV_UP_DOWN (Scroll)",
            Self::NavLeftRight => "NAV_LEFT_RIGHT (Adjust)",
            Self::Select => "SELECT (Confirm)",
            Self::Back => "BACK (Cancel / Close)",
            Self::TextArrive => "Text_Arrive_Tone (Toast)",
            Self::Error => "ERROR (Denied)",
        }
    }
}

const SAMPLE_RATE: u32 = 44_100;
const CHANNELS: u16 = 2;
const CHUNK_FRAMES: usize = 512; // ~11.6 ms low-latency stereo slice
const NUM_BUFFERS: usize = 4;
const MAX_VOICES: usize = 8;

static SOUND_ENABLED: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(true);
/// Master volume scaled 0..=100.
static SOUND_VOLUME: AtomicU32 = AtomicU32::new(75);

pub fn set_enabled(on: bool) {
    SOUND_ENABLED.store(on, Ordering::Relaxed);
}

pub fn is_enabled() -> bool {
    SOUND_ENABLED.load(Ordering::Relaxed)
}

pub fn set_volume(percent: u32) {
    SOUND_VOLUME.store(percent.min(100), Ordering::Relaxed);
}

pub fn volume() -> u32 {
    SOUND_VOLUME.load(Ordering::Relaxed)
}

/// Triggers a Menyoo frontend cue asynchronously on the polyphonic mixer.
pub fn play(sound: MenuSound) {
    if !SOUND_ENABLED.load(Ordering::Relaxed) {
        return;
    }
    let vol = SOUND_VOLUME.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
    if vol == 0 {
        return;
    }
    let gain = (vol as f32 / 100.0).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    let engine = ENGINE.get_or_init(AudioEngine::start);
    engine.trigger(sound, gain);
}

/// Reloads custom `.wav` overrides from `<sounds_dir>` (e.g. `menyooStuff/Sounds/`).
pub fn load_custom_bank(sounds_dir: &Path) {
    let engine = ENGINE.get_or_init(AudioEngine::start);
    let mut bank = engine.bank.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    let mut loaded = 0usize;
    for (idx, cue) in [
        MenuSound::FocusIn,
        MenuSound::NavUpDown,
        MenuSound::NavLeftRight,
        MenuSound::Select,
        MenuSound::Back,
        MenuSound::TextArrive,
        MenuSound::Error,
    ]
    .into_iter()
    .enumerate()
    {
        let path = sounds_dir.join(format!("{}.wav", cue.file_stem()));
        if let Ok(bytes) = std::fs::read(&path)
            && let Some(pcm) = decode_wav_stereo_f32(&bytes)
        {
            bank[idx] = pcm;
            loaded += 1;
        }
    }
    if loaded > 0 {
        tracing::info!(
            dir = %sounds_dir.display(),
            count = loaded,
            "Menyoo loaded custom WAV frontend sound overrides"
        );
    }
}

struct Voice {
    cue: usize,
    pos: usize,
    gain: f32,
}

struct MixerQueue {
    voices: Vec<Voice>,
}

struct AudioEngine {
    bank: Mutex<[Vec<[f32; 2]>; MenuSound::COUNT]>,
    queue: Mutex<MixerQueue>,
    wake: Condvar,
}

static ENGINE: OnceLock<&'static AudioEngine> = OnceLock::new();

impl AudioEngine {
    fn start() -> &'static AudioEngine {
        let bank = [
            synth_focus_in(),
            synth_nav_up_down(),
            synth_nav_left_right(),
            synth_select(),
            synth_back(),
            synth_text_arrive(),
            synth_error(),
        ];
        let engine: &'static AudioEngine = Box::leak(Box::new(AudioEngine {
            bank: Mutex::new(bank),
            queue: Mutex::new(MixerQueue {
                voices: Vec::with_capacity(MAX_VOICES),
            }),
            wake: Condvar::new(),
        }));
        let _ = std::thread::Builder::new()
            .name("menyoo-dx12-audio".into())
            .spawn(move || mixer_thread(engine));
        engine
    }

    fn trigger(&self, sound: MenuSound, gain: f32) {
        let mut q = self.queue.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
        if q.voices.len() >= MAX_VOICES {
            q.voices.remove(0);
        }
        q.voices.push(Voice {
            cue: sound as usize,
            pos: 0,
            gain,
        });
        self.wake.notify_one();
    }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Studio-tuned classic sandbox / Menyoo frontend sound synthesis (44.1 kHz stereo)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

/// Deterministic xorshift PRNG for clean repeatable percussive click transients.
fn next_noise(seed: &mut u32) -> f32 {
    let mut x = *seed;
    x ^= x << 13;
    x ^= x >> 17;
    x ^= x << 5;
    *seed = x;
    ((x as i32) as f32) / (i32::MAX as f32)
}

/// `HintCamSounds` / `"FocusIn"` — soft cinematic low-mid camera focus whoosh-thump.
fn synth_focus_in() -> Vec<[f32; 2]> {
    let n = (SAMPLE_RATE as f32 * 0.195) as usize;
    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(n);
    let mut phase1 = 0.0f32;
    let mut phase2 = 0.0f32;
    let mut lp = 0.0f32;
    let mut lp2 = 0.0f32;
    let mut seed = 0x51A7_9C31u32;

    for i in 0..n {
        let t = i as f32 / SAMPLE_RATE as f32;
        let u = i as f32 / n as f32;
        // Rising warm resonant sweep (135 Hz -> 270 Hz) with smooth bell envelope.
        let freq1 = 135.0 + 135.0 * (1.0 - (-t * 18.0).exp());
        let freq2 = 310.0 + 210.0 * (1.0 - (-t * 14.0).exp());
        phase1 += TAU * freq1 / SAMPLE_RATE as f32;
        phase2 += TAU * freq2 / SAMPLE_RATE as f32;

        let attack = (t / 0.012).min(1.0);
        let decay = (-t * 17.5).exp() * (1.0 - u * u * 0.35);
        let env = attack * decay;

        // Subtle airy focus swoosh (two-pole low-passed noise).
        let raw_noise = next_noise(&mut seed);
        lp += 0.075 * (raw_noise - lp);
        lp2 += 0.095 * (lp - lp2);
        let air_env = (t / 0.025).min(1.0) * (-t * 14.0).exp();

        // Crisp initial mechanical focus lock click.
        let click = (phase2 * 2.2).sin() * (-t * 180.0).exp() * 0.14;

        let body = phase1.sin() * 0.44 + phase2.sin() * 0.16;
        let sample = (body * env + lp2 * air_env * 0.36 + click) * 0.65;
        let l = (sample * 1.02).clamp(-0.95, 0.95);
        let r = (sample * 0.98).clamp(-0.95, 0.95);
        out.push([l, r]);
    }
    out
}

/// `HUD_FRONTEND_DEFAULT_SOUNDSET` / `"NAV_UP_DOWN"` — iconic short tactile target engine scroll tick.
fn synth_nav_up_down() -> Vec<[f32; 2]> {
    let n = (SAMPLE_RATE as f32 * 0.036) as usize;
    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(n);
    let mut p_body = 0.0f32;
    let mut p_ping = 0.0f32;
    let mut seed = 0x1B87_3593u32;
    let mut hp_prev = 0.0f32;

    for i in 0..n {
        let t = i as f32 / SAMPLE_RATE as f32;
        // Quick downward-settling woody/tactile resonant body (~860 Hz -> 620 Hz).
        let f_body = 620.0 + 260.0 * (-t * 95.0).exp();
        let f_ping = 2180.0 + 420.0 * (-t * 240.0).exp();
        p_body += TAU * f_body / SAMPLE_RATE as f32;
        p_ping += TAU * f_ping / SAMPLE_RATE as f32;

        let att = (t / 0.0012).min(1.0);
        let body = p_body.sin() * (-t * 115.0).exp() * 0.46;
        let ping = p_ping.sin() * (-t * 260.0).exp() * 0.24;

        let noise = next_noise(&mut seed);
        let hp = noise - hp_prev * 0.72;
        hp_prev = noise;
        let tap = hp * (-t * 420.0).exp() * 0.16;

        let s = (body + ping + tap) * att * 0.72;
        out.push([s, s]);
    }
    out
}

/// `HUD_FRONTEND_DEFAULT_SOUNDSET` / `"NAV_LEFT_RIGHT"` — crisp slightly higher side-step tick.
fn synth_nav_left_right() -> Vec<[f32; 2]> {
    let n = (SAMPLE_RATE as f32 * 0.032) as usize;
    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(n);
    let mut p_body = 0.0f32;
    let mut p_ping = 0.0f32;
    let mut seed = 0x9E37_79B9u32;

    for i in 0..n {
        let t = i as f32 / SAMPLE_RATE as f32;
        let f_body = 880.0 + 280.0 * (-t * 110.0).exp();
        let f_ping = 2640.0 + 360.0 * (-t * 280.0).exp();
        p_body += TAU * f_body / SAMPLE_RATE as f32;
        p_ping += TAU * f_ping / SAMPLE_RATE as f32;

        let att = (t / 0.0010).min(1.0);
        let body = p_body.sin() * (-t * 130.0).exp() * 0.42;
        let ping = p_ping.sin() * (-t * 290.0).exp() * 0.26;
        let tap = next_noise(&mut seed) * (-t * 500.0).exp() * 0.10;

        let s = (body + ping + tap) * att * 0.68;
        out.push([s, s]);
    }
    out
}

/// `HUD_FRONTEND_DEFAULT_SOUNDSET` / `"SELECT"` — punchy target engine confirmation blip.
fn synth_select() -> Vec<[f32; 2]> {
    let n = (SAMPLE_RATE as f32 * 0.095) as usize;
    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(n);
    let mut p1 = 0.0f32;
    let mut p2 = 0.0f32;
    let mut p3 = 0.0f32;
    let mut seed = 0xC2B2_AE35u32;

    for i in 0..n {
        let t = i as f32 / SAMPLE_RATE as f32;
        // Subtle upward confirm lift (960 Hz -> 1180 Hz) + bright fifth harmonic.
        let f1 = 960.0 + 220.0 * (1.0 - (-t * 85.0).exp());
        let f2 = 1440.0 + 280.0 * (1.0 - (-t * 75.0).exp());
        let f3 = 2880.0;
        p1 += TAU * f1 / SAMPLE_RATE as f32;
        p2 += TAU * f2 / SAMPLE_RATE as f32;
        p3 += TAU * f3 / SAMPLE_RATE as f32;

        let att = (t / 0.0014).min(1.0);
        let main_env = (-t * 48.0).exp();
        let hi_env = (-t * 110.0).exp();
        let click = next_noise(&mut seed) * (-t * 460.0).exp() * 0.14;

        let s = (p1.sin() * 0.44 * main_env
            + p2.sin() * 0.28 * main_env
            + p3.sin() * 0.12 * hi_env
            + click)
            * att
            * 0.72;
        out.push([s, s]);
    }
    out
}

/// `HUD_FRONTEND_DEFAULT_SOUNDSET` / `"BACK"` — lower descending dismiss click.
fn synth_back() -> Vec<[f32; 2]> {
    let n = (SAMPLE_RATE as f32 * 0.082) as usize;
    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(n);
    let mut p1 = 0.0f32;
    let mut p2 = 0.0f32;
    let mut seed = 0x85EB_CA6Bu32;

    for i in 0..n {
        let t = i as f32 / SAMPLE_RATE as f32;
        // Descending pitch (710 Hz -> 425 Hz) with soft muted decay.
        let f1 = 425.0 + 285.0 * (-t * 58.0).exp();
        let f2 = 640.0 + 360.0 * (-t * 75.0).exp();
        p1 += TAU * f1 / SAMPLE_RATE as f32;
        p2 += TAU * f2 / SAMPLE_RATE as f32;

        let att = (t / 0.0018).min(1.0);
        let env = (-t * 52.0).exp();
        let click = next_noise(&mut seed) * (-t * 440.0).exp() * 0.11;

        let s = (p1.sin() * 0.50 * env + p2.sin() * 0.18 * (-t * 95.0).exp() + click) * att * 0.72;
        out.push([s, s]);
    }
    out
}

/// `Phone_SoundSet_Default` / `"Text_Arrive_Tone"` — clean two-note feed chime.
fn synth_text_arrive() -> Vec<[f32; 2]> {
    let n = (SAMPLE_RATE as f32 * 0.19) as usize;
    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(n);
    let mut p1 = 0.0f32;
    let mut p2 = 0.0f32;

    for i in 0..n {
        let t = i as f32 / SAMPLE_RATE as f32;
        // First soft bell note at t=0 (A5 = 880 Hz), second note at t=0.055s (E6 = 1318.5 Hz).
        p1 += TAU * 880.0 / SAMPLE_RATE as f32;
        p2 += TAU * 1318.5 / SAMPLE_RATE as f32;

        let n1 = (t / 0.003).min(1.0) * (-t * 28.0).exp() * (p1.sin() * 0.7 + (p1 * 2.0).sin() * 0.15);
        let t2 = (t - 0.055).max(0.0);
        let n2 = if t >= 0.055 {
            (t2 / 0.003).min(1.0) * (-t2 * 24.0).exp() * (p2.sin() * 0.75 + (p2 * 2.0).sin() * 0.16)
        } else {
            0.0
        };
        let s = (n1 * 0.34 + n2 * 0.42) * 0.72;
        out.push([s * 0.96, s * 1.04]);
    }
    out
}

/// `HUD_FRONTEND_DEFAULT_SOUNDSET` / `"ERROR"` — muted double low-buzz.
fn synth_error() -> Vec<[f32; 2]> {
    let n = (SAMPLE_RATE as f32 * 0.155) as usize;
    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(n);
    let mut p1 = 0.0f32;
    let mut p2 = 0.0f32;

    for i in 0..n {
        let t = i as f32 / SAMPLE_RATE as f32;
        p1 += TAU * 185.0 / SAMPLE_RATE as f32;
        p2 += TAU * 277.0 / SAMPLE_RATE as f32;

        // Two short bursts: [0..0.052s] and [0.070..0.145s].
        let pulse = if t < 0.052 {
            (t / 0.003).min(1.0) * (-t * 42.0).exp()
        } else if t >= 0.070 {
            let t2 = t - 0.070;
            (t2 / 0.003).min(1.0) * (-t2 * 38.0).exp()
        } else {
            0.0
        };
        let raw = (p1.sin() * 0.65 + p2.sin() * 0.35 + (p1 * 3.0).sin() * 0.20).tanh();
        let s = raw * pulse * 0.55;
        out.push([s, s]);
    }
    out
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Minimal PCM WAV decoder for optional custom `menyooStuff/Sounds/*.wav`
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

fn decode_wav_stereo_f32(bytes: &[u8]) -> Option<Vec<[f32; 2]>> {
    if bytes.len() < 44 || &bytes[0..4] != b"RIFF" || &bytes[8..12] != b"WAVE" {
        return None;
    }
    let mut pos = 12usize;
    let mut channels = 0u16;
    let mut sample_rate = 0u32;
    let mut bits_per_sample = 0u16;
    let mut audio_fmt = 0u16;
    let mut data: Option<&[u8]> = None;

    while pos + 8 <= bytes.len() {
        let id = &bytes[pos..pos + 4];
        let size = u32::from_le_bytes(bytes[pos + 4..pos + 8].try_into().ok()?) as usize;
        pos += 8;
        if pos + size > bytes.len() {
            break;
        }
        let chunk = &bytes[pos..pos + size];
        if id == b"fmt " && chunk.len() >= 16 {
            audio_fmt = u16::from_le_bytes([chunk[0], chunk[1]]);
            channels = u16::from_le_bytes([chunk[2], chunk[3]]);
            sample_rate = u32::from_le_bytes([chunk[4], chunk[5], chunk[6], chunk[7]]);
            bits_per_sample = u16::from_le_bytes([chunk[14], chunk[15]]);
        } else if id == b"data" {
            data = Some(chunk);
        }
        pos += size + (size & 1);
    }

    let raw = data?;
    if sample_rate == 0 || (channels != 1 && channels != 2) {
        return None;
    }
    let ch = channels as usize;
    let frames: Vec<[f32; 2]> = match (audio_fmt, bits_per_sample) {
        (1, 16) => {
            let step = ch * 2;
            raw.chunks_exact(step)
                .map(|f| {
                    let l = i16::from_le_bytes([f[0], f[1]]) as f32 / 32768.0;
                    let r = if ch == 2 {
                        i16::from_le_bytes([f[2], f[3]]) as f32 / 32768.0
                    } else {
                        l
                    };
                    [l, r]
                })
                .collect()
        }
        (1, 8) => raw
            .chunks_exact(ch)
            .map(|f| {
                let l = (f[0] as f32 - 128.0) / 128.0;
                let r = if ch == 2 { (f[1] as f32 - 128.0) / 128.0 } else { l };
                [l, r]
            })
            .collect(),
        (3, 32) => {
            let step = ch * 4;
            raw.chunks_exact(step)
                .map(|f| {
                    let l = f32::from_le_bytes([f[0], f[1], f[2], f[3]]).clamp(-1.0, 1.0);
                    let r = if ch == 2 {
                        f32::from_le_bytes([f[4], f[5], f[6], f[7]]).clamp(-1.0, 1.0)
                    } else {
                        l
                    };
                    [l, r]
                })
                .collect()
        }
        _ => return None,
    };

    if frames.is_empty() {
        return None;
    }
    if sample_rate == SAMPLE_RATE {
        return Some(frames);
    }
    // Linear resample to 44.1 kHz.
    let ratio = sample_rate as f64 / SAMPLE_RATE as f64;
    let out_len = ((frames.len() as f64) / ratio).round().max(1.0) as usize;
    let mut resampled = Vec::with_capacity(out_len);
    for i in 0..out_len {
        let src = i as f64 * ratio;
        let idx = (src as usize).min(frames.len() - 1);
        let next = (idx + 1).min(frames.len() - 1);
        let frac = (src - idx as f64) as f32;
        let l = frames[idx][0] + (frames[next][0] - frames[idx][0]) * frac;
        let r = frames[idx][1] + (frames[next][1] - frames[idx][1]) * frac;
        resampled.push([l, r]);
    }
    Some(resampled)
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Pure Win32 `winmm.dll` waveOut polyphonic output thread
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

type HWAVEOUT = *mut c_void;
const WAVE_MAPPER: u32 = 0xFFFF_FFFF;
const WAVE_FORMAT_PCM: u16 = 1;
const WHDR_DONE: u32 = 0x0000_0001;

#[repr(C)]
struct WaveFormatEx {
    format_tag: u16,
    channels: u16,
    samples_per_sec: u32,
    avg_bytes_per_sec: u32,
    block_align: u16,
    bits_per_sample: u16,
    cb_size: u16,
}

#[repr(C)]
struct WaveHdr {
    lp_data: *mut i16,
    dw_buffer_length: u32,
    dw_bytes_recorded: u32,
    dw_user: usize,
    dw_flags: u32,
    dw_loops: u32,
    lp_next: *mut WaveHdr,
    reserved: usize,
}

#[link(name = "winmm")]
unsafe extern "system" {
    fn waveOutOpen(
        phwo: *mut HWAVEOUT,
        device_id: u32,
        pwfx: *const WaveFormatEx,
        callback: usize,
        instance: usize,
        fdw_open: u32,
    ) -> u32;
    fn waveOutPrepareHeader(hwo: HWAVEOUT, pwh: *mut WaveHdr, cbwh: u32) -> u32;
    fn waveOutWrite(hwo: HWAVEOUT, pwh: *mut WaveHdr, cbwh: u32) -> u32;
    fn waveOutUnprepareHeader(hwo: HWAVEOUT, pwh: *mut WaveHdr, cbwh: u32) -> u32;
    fn waveOutReset(hwo: HWAVEOUT) -> u32;
    fn waveOutClose(hwo: HWAVEOUT) -> u32;
}

fn mixer_thread(engine: &'static AudioEngine) {
    let wfx = WaveFormatEx {
        format_tag: WAVE_FORMAT_PCM,
        channels: CHANNELS,
        samples_per_sec: SAMPLE_RATE,
        avg_bytes_per_sec: SAMPLE_RATE * u32::from(CHANNELS) * 2,
        block_align: CHANNELS * 2,
        bits_per_sample: 16,
        cb_size: 0,
    };

    let mut handle: HWAVEOUT = std::ptr::null_mut();
    // SAFETY: standard waveOutOpen with valid PCM format descriptor.
    let res = unsafe { waveOutOpen(&mut handle, WAVE_MAPPER, &wfx, 0, 0, 0) };
    if res != 0 || handle.is_null() {
        tracing::warn!(code = res, "Menyoo audio: waveOutOpen unavailable (silent mode)");
        return;
    }

    let mut pcm_bufs: Vec<Box<[i16; CHUNK_FRAMES * 2]>> = (0..NUM_BUFFERS)
        .map(|_| Box::new([0i16; CHUNK_FRAMES * 2]))
        .collect();
    let mut headers: Vec<Box<WaveHdr>> = pcm_bufs
        .iter_mut()
        .map(|buf| {
            Box::new(WaveHdr {
                lp_data: buf.as_mut_ptr(),
                dw_buffer_length: (CHUNK_FRAMES * 2 * size_of::<i16>()) as u32,
                dw_bytes_recorded: 0,
                dw_user: 0,
                dw_flags: WHDR_DONE,
                dw_loops: 0,
                lp_next: std::ptr::null_mut(),
                reserved: 0,
            })
        })
        .collect();
    let mut prepared = [false; NUM_BUFFERS];

    let mut next_slot = 0usize;
    let mut tail_silence = 0u8;

    loop {
        // Sleep completely when idle with 0% CPU usage.
        {
            let mut q = engine.queue.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
            while q.voices.is_empty() && tail_silence == 0 {
                q = engine.wake.wait(q).unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
            }
        }

        // Wait briefly for the ring slot to finish playback before refilling.
        let hdr = &mut *headers[next_slot];
        while prepared[next_slot] && (hdr.dw_flags & WHDR_DONE) == 0 {
            std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(3));
        }
        if prepared[next_slot] {
            // SAFETY: header finished playing (`WHDR_DONE`).
            unsafe {
                let _ = waveOutUnprepareHeader(handle, hdr, size_of::<WaveHdr>() as u32);
            }
            prepared[next_slot] = false;
        }

        // Mix active polyphonic voices into this stereo chunk.
        let mut mix = [[0.0f32; 2]; CHUNK_FRAMES];
        let active_any = {
            let bank = engine.bank.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
            let mut q = engine.queue.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
            for voice in &mut q.voices {
                let clip = &bank[voice.cue];
                let avail = clip.len().saturating_sub(voice.pos).min(CHUNK_FRAMES);
                for i in 0..avail {
                    let s = clip[voice.pos + i];
                    mix[i][0] += s[0] * voice.gain;
                    mix[i][1] += s[1] * voice.gain;
                }
                voice.pos += avail;
            }
            q.voices.retain(|v| v.pos < bank[v.cue].len());
            !q.voices.is_empty()
        };

        if active_any {
            tail_silence = 2;
        } else {
            tail_silence = tail_silence.saturating_sub(1);
        }

        let buf = &mut *pcm_bufs[next_slot];
        for i in 0..CHUNK_FRAMES {
            // Soft-limit polyphonic peaks so rapid scrolling never clips harshly.
            let l = (mix[i][0].tanh() * 32767.0) as i16;
            let r = (mix[i][1].tanh() * 32767.0) as i16;
            buf[i * 2] = l;
            buf[i * 2 + 1] = r;
        }

        hdr.dw_flags = 0;
        // SAFETY: valid device handle, pinned boxed buffer & header.
        unsafe {
            if waveOutPrepareHeader(handle, hdr, size_of::<WaveHdr>() as u32) == 0 {
                prepared[next_slot] = true;
                let _ = waveOutWrite(handle, hdr, size_of::<WaveHdr>() as u32);
            }
        }
        next_slot = (next_slot + 1) % NUM_BUFFERS;
    }

    #[allow(unreachable_code)]
    unsafe {
        let _ = waveOutReset(handle);
        let _ = waveOutClose(handle);
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn all_synthesized_cues_are_nonempty_and_bounded() {
        let clips = [
            synth_focus_in(),
            synth_nav_up_down(),
            synth_nav_left_right(),
            synth_select(),
            synth_back(),
            synth_text_arrive(),
            synth_error(),
        ];
        for (i, clip) in clips.iter().enumerate() {
            assert!(!clip.is_empty(), "clip {i} empty");
            let peak = clip
                .iter()
                .flat_map(|s| s.iter())
                .fold(0.0f32, |m, &v| m.max(v.abs()));
            assert!(peak > 0.05 && peak <= 1.0, "clip {i} peak out of range: {peak}");
        }
    }
}
```

```rs
/// Weapon categories derived dynamically from localized names & weapon properties.
pub const WEAPON_CATEGORIES: &[&str] = &[
    "All Weapons",
    "Pistols & Sidearms",
    "SMGs",
    "Rifles & Snipers",
    "Shotguns",
    "Heavy & Throwables",
    "Melee",
];

/// Classifies any discovered weapon cleanly into a Menyoo arsenal category.
pub fn classify_weapon_category(name: &str, is_firearm: bool) -> &'static str {
    let lo = name.to_ascii_lowercase();
    if !is_firearm {
        if lo.contains("grenade")
            || lo.contains("molotov")
            || lo.contains("bomb")
            || lo.contains("mine")
            || lo.contains("flare")
            || lo.contains("smoke")
            || lo.contains("gas")
            || lo.contains("c4")
            || lo.contains("snowball")
            || lo.contains("brick")
            || lo.contains("bottle")
        {
            return "Heavy & Throwables";
        }
        return "Melee";
    }
    if lo.contains("shotgun") || lo.contains("sawed") || lo.contains("musket") || lo.contains("sweeper") {
        "Shotguns"
    } else if lo.contains("rpg")
        || lo.contains("launcher")
        || lo.contains("minigun")
        || lo.contains("railgun")
        || lo.contains("cannon")
        || lo.contains("homing")
        || lo.contains("flamethrower")
        || lo.contains("grenade")
        || lo.contains("firework")
    {
        "Heavy & Throwables"
    } else if lo.contains("smg")
        || lo.contains("submachine")
        || lo.contains("uzi")
        || lo.contains("micro")
        || lo.contains("mp5")
        || lo.contains("pdw")
        || lo.contains("machine pistol")
        || lo.contains("tec")
        || lo.contains("skorpion")
    {
        "SMGs"
    } else if lo.contains("rifle")
        || lo.contains("carbine")
        || lo.contains("sniper")
        || lo.contains("marksman")
        || lo.contains("ak")
        || lo.contains("m4")
        || lo.contains("m16")
        || lo.contains("bullpup")
        || lo.contains("mg")
        || lo.contains("lmg")
        || lo.contains("combat mg")
        || lo.contains("gusenberg")
        || lo.contains("ar ")
        || lo.ends_with(" ar")
    {
        "Rifles & Snipers"
    } else if lo.contains("pistol")
        || lo.contains("revolver")
        || lo.contains("deagle")
        || lo.contains("desert")
        || lo.contains("9mm")
        || lo.contains(".45")
        || lo.contains(".50")
        || lo.contains("glock")
        || lo.contains("beretta")
        || lo.contains("stun")
        || lo.contains("taser")
        || lo.contains("flare gun")
        || lo.contains("derringer")
    {
        "Pistols & Sidearms"
    } else {
        // Default remaining firearms cleanly into Rifles & Snipers so nothing is ever lost.
        "Rifles & Snipers"
    }
}

/// Builds a balanced multi-class Weapon Wheel loadout (up to `max_count` items spanning
/// Pistols, SMGs, Rifles, Shotguns, Heavy/Throwables & Melee) instead of taking the first N alphabetically.
pub fn select_balanced_loadout(
    weapons: &[WeaponCatalogEntry],
    max_count: usize,
) -> Vec<(u32, u32, u32)> {
    if weapons.is_empty() || max_count == 0 {
        return Vec::new();
    }
    let pool: Vec<&WeaponCatalogEntry> = {
        let mut v: Vec<_> = weapons.iter().filter(|w| w.cat_direct_ok).collect();
        if v.is_empty() {
            v = weapons.iter().filter(|w| w.in_inv_db).collect();
        }
        if v.is_empty() {
            v = weapons.iter().collect();
        }
        v
    };
    const CLASS_ORDER: &[&str] = &[
        "Pistols & Sidearms",
        "SMGs",
        "Rifles & Snipers",
        "Shotguns",
        "Heavy & Throwables",
        "Melee",
    ];
    let mut out: Vec<(u32, u32, u32)> = Vec::with_capacity(max_count);
    let mut used = std::collections::HashSet::<u32>::with_capacity(max_count);
    // Round-robin 1 item per class per pass so EVERY weapon class is guaranteed representation!
    for _round in 0..3 {
        let before = out.len();
        for &cat in CLASS_ORDER {
            if out.len() >= max_count {
                break;
            }
            if let Some(w) = pool
                .iter()
                .find(|w| w.category == cat && w.hash32 != 0 && !used.contains(&w.hash32))
            {
                used.insert(w.hash32);
                out.push((w.hash32, w.award_hash32, w.ammo_award_hash32));
            }
        }
        if out.len() >= max_count || out.len() == before {
            break;
        }
    }
    // Fill any remaining slots with firearms first, then any valid weapons.
    for pass_firearm in [true, false] {
        for w in &pool {
            if out.len() >= max_count {
                break;
            }
            if (!pass_firearm || w.is_firearm) && w.hash32 != 0 && used.insert(w.hash32) {
                out.push((w.hash32, w.award_hash32, w.ammo_award_hash32));
            }
        }
    }
    out
}

/// 16-byte-aligned 4-float vector required by SSE/AVX `vmovaps` engine entrypoints.
#[repr(C, align(16))]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default)]
pub struct Vec4A(pub [f32; 4]);

/// 16-byte-aligned entity script handle (`[u64; 2]`) required by `vmovdqa` task/relationship natives.
#[repr(C, align(16))]
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default)]
pub struct ScriptHandle(pub [u64; 2]);

impl ScriptHandle {
    #[inline]
    pub fn is_valid(self) -> bool {
        self.0[0] != 0 || self.0[1] != 0
    }
}

    pub right: [f32; 4],
    pub forward: [f32; 4],
    pub up: [f32; 4],

/// 16-byte-aligned `0x160`-byte `CExplosionArgs` layout verified for `AddExplosion`.
#[repr(C, align(16))]
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub struct ExplosionArgs {
    pub raw: [u8; 0x160],
}

impl Default for ExplosionArgs {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self { raw: [0u8; 0x160] }
    }
}

impl ExplosionArgs {
    #[inline]
    fn put_u8(&mut self, off: usize, v: u8) {
        self.raw[off] = v;
    }
    #[inline]
    fn put_u32(&mut self, off: usize, v: u32) {
        self.raw[off..off + 4].copy_from_slice(&v.to_le_bytes());
    }
    #[inline]
    fn put_i32(&mut self, off: usize, v: i32) {
        self.raw[off..off + 4].copy_from_slice(&v.to_le_bytes());
    }
    #[inline]
    fn put_u64(&mut self, off: usize, v: u64) {
        self.raw[off..off + 8].copy_from_slice(&v.to_le_bytes());
    }
    #[inline]
    fn put_f32(&mut self, off: usize, v: f32) {
        self.raw[off..off + 4].copy_from_slice(&v.to_le_bytes());
    }
}

/// Builds a verified 16-byte-aligned `CExplosionArgs` payload for `AddExplosion`.
/// When `base != 0` and `rvas.fn_expl_substruct_ctor != 0`, initializes the sub-struct at `+0x90`.
pub fn build_explosion_args(tag: i32, pos: [f32; 3], base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) -> ExplosionArgs {
    let mut a = ExplosionArgs::default();
    a.put_i32(0x00, tag);
    a.put_f32(0x10, pos[0]);
    a.put_f32(0x14, pos[1]);
    a.put_f32(0x18, pos[2]);
    a.put_f32(0x1c, 0.0);
    // Damage scale & camera shake
    a.put_f32(0x3c, 1.0);
    a.put_f32(0x40, 0.75);
    a.put_f32(0x48, -1.0);
    a.put_f32(0x4c, -1.0);
    // isAudible = 1, isInvisible = 0
    a.put_u64(0x50, 0x0000_0001_0000_0000);
    // Upward normal vector at +0x60
    a.put_f32(0x60, 0.0);
    a.put_f32(0x64, 0.0);
    a.put_f32(0x68, 1.0);
    a.put_f32(0x6c, 0.0);
    a.put_u64(0x84, 0x0000_0000_FFFF_FFFF);

    if base != 0 && rvas.fn_expl_substruct_ctor != 0 {
        // SAFETY: verified 1-arg initializer for `CExplosionArgs + 0x90` on main simulation thread.
        let ctor: extern "system" fn(*mut u8) =
            unsafe { std::mem::transmute((base + rvas.fn_expl_substruct_ctor) as usize) };
        unsafe { ctor(a.raw.as_mut_ptr().add(0x90)) };
    }

    a.put_u32(0xa8, 0xFFFC_FFFF);
    a.put_u32(0xb0, 0);
    a.put_u32(0xb4, 0xFFFF_FFFF);
    a.put_u32(0xb8, 0xFFFF_FFFF);
    a.put_u32(0xbc, 0xFFFF_FFFF);
    a.put_u32(0xc0, 0xFFFF_FFFF);
    a.put_u32(0xc4, 8);
    a.put_f32(0x10c, 1.0);
    a.put_f32(0x110, 1.0);
    a.put_f32(0x114, 1.0);
    a.put_u64(0x120, 0);
    a.put_u8(0x128, 0xFF);
    a.put_u32(0x13c, 0xFFFF_FFFF);
    a
}

impl RvaTable {
    pub fn load(stuff_dir: &Path) -> Self {
        let path = stuff_dir.join("rvas.json");
        let Ok(text) = std::fs::read_to_string(&path) else {
            return Self::default();
        };
        let mut t = Self {
            loaded: true,
            source_label: path
                .file_name()
                .map_or_else(|| "rvas.json".into(), |f| f.to_string_lossy().into_owned()),
            ..Self::default()
        };
        t.local_player_ped = parse_json_hex(&text, "local_player_ped").unwrap_or(0);
        t.current_vehicle = parse_json_hex(&text, "current_vehicle").unwrap_or(0);
        t.cam_mat_base = parse_json_hex(&text, "cam_mat_base").unwrap_or(0);
        t.ped_pool = parse_json_hex(&text, "ped_pool").unwrap_or(0);
        t.vehicle_pool = parse_json_hex(&text, "vehicle_pool").unwrap_or(0);
        t.object_pool = parse_json_hex(&text, "object_pool").unwrap_or(0);
        t.net_player_pool = parse_json_hex(&text, "net_player_pool").unwrap_or(0);
        t.weather_struct = parse_json_hex(&text, "weather_struct").unwrap_or(0);
        t.world_gravity_scale = parse_json_hex(&text, "world_gravity_scale").unwrap_or(0);
        t.clock_datetime = parse_json_hex(&text, "clock_datetime").unwrap_or(0);
        t.clock_pause_flag = parse_json_hex(&text, "clock_pause_flag").unwrap_or(0);
        t.clock_ms_per_minute = parse_json_hex(&text, "clock_ms_per_minute").unwrap_or(0);
        t.cheat_table = parse_json_hex(&text, "cheat_table").unwrap_or(0);
        t.cheat_vehicle_handle = parse_json_hex(&text, "cheat_vehicle_handle").unwrap_or(0);
        t.cheat_flags_base = parse_json_hex(&text, "cheat_flags_base").unwrap_or(0);
        t.par_player_tunables_desc = parse_json_hex(&text, "par_player_tunables_desc").unwrap_or(0);
        t.par_cam_debug_director_desc =
            parse_json_hex(&text, "par_cam_debug_director_desc").unwrap_or(0);

        t.model_info_bitset = parse_json_hex(&text, "model_info_bitset").unwrap_or(0);
        t.model_info_array = parse_json_hex(&text, "model_info_array").unwrap_or(0);
        t.model_info_stride = parse_json_hex(&text, "model_info_stride").unwrap_or(0);
        t.model_info_buckets = parse_json_hex(&text, "model_info_buckets").unwrap_or(0);
        t.model_info_bucket_count = parse_json_hex(&text, "model_info_bucket_count").unwrap_or(0);
        t.ped_density_mult_1 = parse_json_hex(&text, "ped_density_mult_1").unwrap_or(0);
        t.ped_density_mult_2 = parse_json_hex(&text, "ped_density_mult_2").unwrap_or(0);

fn parse_json_hex(text: &str, key: &str) -> Option<u64> {
    let needle = format!("\"{key}\"");
    let pos = text.find(&needle)?;
    let rest = &text[pos + needle.len()..];
    let colon = rest.find(':')?;
    let val_str = rest[colon + 1..].trim_start();
    let tok = if let Some(s) = val_str.strip_prefix('"') {
        let end = s.find('"')?;
        s[..end].trim()
    } else {
        val_str
            .split(|c: char| c == ',' || c == '}' || c == '\n' || c == '\r')
            .next()?
            .trim()
    };
    if let Some(hex) = tok.strip_prefix("0x").or_else(|| tok.strip_prefix("0X")) {
        u64::from_str_radix(hex, 16).ok()
    } else {
        tok.parse::<u64>().ok()
    }
}

fn parse_builtin_vehicles(text: &str) -> Vec<CheatVehicleEntry> {
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    let Some(arr_start) = text.find("\"builtin_cheat_vehicles\"") else {
        return out;
    };
    let rest = &text[arr_start..];
    let Some(open) = rest.find('[') else { return out };
    let Some(close) = rest[open..].find(']') else { return out };
    let slice = &rest[open + 1..open + close];
    for entry in slice.split('{').skip(1) {
        let Some(body) = entry.split('}').next() else { continue };
        let name = extract_json_str(body, "name").unwrap_or_else(|| "Vehicle".into());
        let category = extract_json_str(body, "category").unwrap_or_else(|| "Built-In Cheats".into());
        if let Some(hash64) = parse_json_hex(body, "hash64") {
            out.push(CheatVehicleEntry { name, category, hash64 });
        }
    }
    out
}

fn extract_json_str(body: &str, key: &str) -> Option<String> {
    let needle = format!("\"{key}\"");
    let pos = body.find(&needle)?;
    let rest = &body[pos + needle.len()..];
    let colon = rest.find(':')?;
    let s = rest[colon + 1..].trim_start().strip_prefix('"')?;
    let end = s.find('"')?;
    Some(s[..end].to_owned())
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Persistent `menyooStuff/Favourites.ini`
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

pub fn load_favourites(stuff_dir: &Path) -> Vec<SavedCoord> {
    let path = stuff_dir.join("Favourites.ini");
    let Ok(text) = std::fs::read_to_string(&path) else {
        return vec![SavedCoord {
            name: "Oceanfront Beach Sunset Spot".into(),
            coords: [1420.0, -1840.0, 12.5],
        }];
    };
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    for raw in text.lines() {
        let line = raw.trim();
        if line.is_empty() || line.starts_with(';') || line.starts_with('#') || line.starts_with('[') {
            continue;
        }
        let Some((name, val)) = line.split_once('=') else {
            continue;
        };
        let parts: Vec<f32> = val
            .split(',')
            .filter_map(|s| s.trim().parse::<f32>().ok())
            .collect();
        if let [x, y, z] = parts[..]
            && x.is_finite()
            && y.is_finite()
            && z.is_finite()
        {
            out.push(SavedCoord {
                name: name.trim().to_owned(),
                coords: [x, y, z],
            });
        }
    }
    if out.is_empty() {
        out.push(SavedCoord {
            name: "Oceanfront Beach Sunset Spot".into(),
            coords: [1420.0, -1840.0, 12.5],
        });
    }
    out
}

pub fn save_favourites(stuff_dir: &Path, favs: &[SavedCoord]) -> std::io::Result<()> {
    std::fs::create_dir_all(stuff_dir)?;
    let mut text = String::from("; Menyoo PC — Saved Teleport Favourites\n[favourites]\n");
    for fav in favs {
        let clean_name = fav.name.replace('=', "-").replace('\n', " ");
        text.push_str(&format!(
            "{clean_name} = {:.2}, {:.2}, {:.2}\n",
            fav.coords[0], fav.coords[1], fav.coords[2]
        ));
    }
    std::fs::write(stuff_dir.join("Favourites.ini"), text)
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Custom Theme Presets (`menyooStuff/Themes/*.ini`)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

pub fn list_custom_themes(stuff_dir: &Path) -> Vec<String> {
    let dir = stuff_dir.join("Themes");
    let Ok(rd) = std::fs::read_dir(&dir) else {
        return Vec::new();
    };
    let mut names: Vec<String> = rd
        .filter_map(|e| e.ok())
        .filter_map(|e| {
            let p = e.path();
            if p.extension()?.eq_ignore_ascii_case("ini") {
                Some(p.file_stem()?.to_string_lossy().into_owned())
            } else {
                None
            }
        })
        .collect();
    names.sort();
    names
}

pub fn save_custom_theme(stuff_dir: &Path, name: &str, cfg: &MenyooConfig) -> std::io::Result<()> {
    let dir = stuff_dir.join("Themes");
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir)?;
    let safe: String = name
        .chars()
        .filter(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(c, ' ' | '-' | '_'))
        .collect();
    let stem = safe.trim();
    if stem.is_empty() {
        return Err(std::io::Error::new(
            std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidInput,
            "empty theme name",
        ));
    }
    // Reuse `MenyooConfig::save` format into `<Themes>/<name>.ini`!
    let tmp = dir.join(format!("{stem}.ini"));
    let backup_dir = dir.join("_tmp_theme");
    let saved = cfg.save(&backup_dir)?;
    let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&saved)?;
    let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&backup_dir);
    std::fs::write(&tmp, content)
}

pub fn load_custom_theme(stuff_dir: &Path, name: &str, cfg: &mut MenyooConfig) -> bool {
    let path = stuff_dir.join("Themes").join(format!("{name}.ini"));
    let Ok(text) = std::fs::read_to_string(&path) else {
        return false;
    };
    let tmp_dir = stuff_dir.join("Themes").join("_tmp_load");
    if std::fs::create_dir_all(&tmp_dir).is_err() {
        return false;
    }
    if std::fs::write(tmp_dir.join("menyooConfig.ini"), text).is_err() {
        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&tmp_dir);
        return false;
    }
    let loaded = MenyooConfig::load(&tmp_dir);
    let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&tmp_dir);
    // Apply only visual appearance fields (preserving user's keybind & HUD toggles!)
    cfg.gradients = loaded.gradients;
    cfg.rainbow_mode = loaded.rainbow_mode;
    cfg.thin_line_over_footer = loaded.thin_line_over_footer;
    cfg.titlebox = loaded.titlebox;
    cfg.bg = loaded.bg;
    cfg.titletext = loaded.titletext;
    cfg.optiontext = loaded.optiontext;
    cfg.selectedtext = loaded.selectedtext;
    cfg.optionbreaks = loaded.optionbreaks;
    cfg.optioncount = loaded.optioncount;
    cfg.selectionhi = loaded.selectionhi;
    cfg.accent = loaded.accent;
    cfg.font_title = loaded.font_title;
    cfg.font_options = loaded.font_options;
    cfg.font_selection = loaded.font_selection;
    cfg.font_breaks = loaded.font_breaks;
    cfg.category_banners = loaded.category_banners;
    true
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Safe Win32 `VirtualQuery`-guarded guest memory inspection & writes
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

fn is_readable_range(addr: usize, len: usize) -> bool {
    if addr < 0x10000 || len == 0 {
        return false;
    }
    let Some(end) = addr.checked_add(len) else {
        return false;
    };
    let mut cur = addr;
    while cur < end {
        let mut mbi = MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION::default();
        // SAFETY: `VirtualQuery` only inspects VM page metadata without dereferencing `cur`.
        let n = unsafe {
            VirtualQuery(
                cur as *const _,
                &mut mbi,
                size_of::<MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION>(),
            )
        };
        if n == 0 || mbi.State != MEM_COMMIT {
            return false;
        }
        let prot = mbi.Protect;
        if prot & (PAGE_NOACCESS | PAGE_GUARD) != 0 {
            return false;
        }
        let ok = prot
            & (PAGE_READONLY
                | PAGE_READWRITE
                | PAGE_WRITECOPY
                | PAGE_EXECUTE_READ
                | PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE
                | PAGE_EXECUTE_WRITECOPY)
            != 0;
        if !ok {
            return false;
        }
        let reg_end = (mbi.BaseAddress as usize).saturating_add(mbi.RegionSize);
        if reg_end <= cur {
            return false;
        }
        cur = reg_end;
    }
    true
}

fn is_writable_range(addr: usize, len: usize) -> bool {
    if addr < 0x10000 || len == 0 {
        return false;
    }
    let Some(end) = addr.checked_add(len) else {
        return false;
    };
    let mut cur = addr;
    while cur < end {
        let mut mbi = MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION::default();
        // SAFETY: `VirtualQuery` inspects VM page metadata without dereferencing `cur`.
        let n = unsafe {
            VirtualQuery(
                cur as *const _,
                &mut mbi,
                size_of::<MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION>(),
            )
        };
        if n == 0 || mbi.State != MEM_COMMIT {
            return false;
        }
        let prot = mbi.Protect;
        if prot & (PAGE_NOACCESS | PAGE_GUARD) != 0 {
            return false;
        }
        let ok = prot
            & (PAGE_READWRITE | PAGE_WRITECOPY | PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE | PAGE_EXECUTE_WRITECOPY)
            != 0;
        if !ok {
            return false;
        }
        let reg_end = (mbi.BaseAddress as usize).saturating_add(mbi.RegionSize);
        if reg_end <= cur {
            return false;
        }
        cur = reg_end;
    }
    true
}

pub fn safe_read<T: Copy>(addr: usize) -> Option<T> {
    if !is_readable_range(addr, size_of::<T>()) {
        return None;
    }
    // SAFETY: verified committed + readable across `[addr, addr + size_of::<T>())`.
    Some(unsafe { std::ptr::read_unaligned(addr as *const T) })
}

pub fn safe_write<T: Copy>(addr: usize, val: T) -> bool {
    if !is_writable_range(addr, size_of::<T>()) {
        return false;
    }
    // SAFETY: verified committed + writable across `[addr, addr + size_of::<T>())`.
    unsafe { std::ptr::write_unaligned(addr as *mut T, val) };
    true
}

/// Unpacks an engine 16-byte sector-packed world position (`entity + 0x70`):
/// `[f32 local_x, f32 local_y, f32 world_z, i16 sector_x, i16 sector_y]` ->
/// `[local_x + sector_x * 32.0, local_y + sector_y * 32.0, world_z]`.
pub fn unpack_sector_pos(raw: [u32; 4]) -> [f32; 3] {
    let lx = f32::from_bits(raw[0]);
    let ly = f32::from_bits(raw[1]);
    let z = f32::from_bits(raw[2]);
    let sec_x = (raw[3] & 0xFFFF) as u16 as i16;
    let sec_y = ((raw[3] >> 16) & 0xFFFF) as u16 as i16;
    [lx + f32::from(sec_x) * 32.0, ly + f32::from(sec_y) * 32.0, z]
}

/// Packs `[world_x, world_y, world_z]` into the exact 16-byte 32m sector format.
pub fn pack_sector_pos(world: [f32; 3]) -> [u32; 4] {
    let sec_x = (world[0] / 32.0).floor().clamp(-32000.0, 32000.0) as i16;
    let sec_y = (world[1] / 32.0).floor().clamp(-32000.0, 32000.0) as i16;
    let lx = world[0] - f32::from(sec_x) * 32.0;
    let ly = world[1] - f32::from(sec_y) * 32.0;
    let packed_sec = u32::from(sec_x as u16) | (u32::from(sec_y as u16) << 16);
    [lx.to_bits(), ly.to_bits(), world[2].to_bits(), packed_sec]
}

/// Live world telemetry safely polled from guest memory via `rvas.json`.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default)]
pub struct WorldTelemetry {
    pub ped_ptr: u64,
    pub player_xyz: Option<[f32; 3]>,
    pub forward_xy: Option<[f32; 2]>,
    pub speed_mps: f32,
    pub heading_deg: f32,
    pub in_vehicle: bool,
    pub current_veh_ptr: u64,
    pub gravity_scale: Option<f32>,
    pub peds_active: u32,
    pub peds_max: u32,
    pub vehs_active: u32,
    pub vehs_max: u32,
    pub objs_active: u32,
    pub objs_max: u32,
    pub waypoint_xyz: Option<[f32; 3]>,
    pub weather_prev: Option<i32>,
    pub weather_next: Option<i32>,
    pub weather_locked: bool,
    pub clock_hms: Option<(i32, i32, i32)>,
    pub clock_paused: bool,
    pub clock_ms_per_min: u32,
}

impl WorldTelemetry {
    pub fn speed_mph(&self) -> f32 {
        self.speed_mps * 2.236_936
    }

    pub fn speed_kph(&self) -> f32 {
        self.speed_mps * 3.6
    }

    pub fn compass_cardinal(&self) -> &'static str {
        let deg = self.heading_deg.rem_euclid(360.0);
        const DIRS: [&str; 8] = ["N", "NE", "E", "SE", "S", "SW", "W", "NW"];
        DIRS[((deg + 22.5) / 45.0) as usize % 8]
    }
}

/// Polls safe read-only world telemetry when running inside Host (`base != 0`).
pub fn poll_world_telemetry(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) -> WorldTelemetry {
    let mut out = WorldTelemetry::default();
    if base == 0 || !rvas.loaded {
        return out;
    }
    if rvas.local_player_ped != 0
        && let Some(ped) = safe_read::<u64>((base + rvas.local_player_ped) as usize)
        && ped > 0x10000
    {
        out.ped_ptr = ped;
        if let Some(raw_pos) = safe_read::<[u32; 4]>((ped + rvas.ped_pos_packed) as usize) {
            let pos = unpack_sector_pos(raw_pos);
            if pos.iter().all(|v| v.is_finite() && v.abs() < 100_000.0) {
                out.player_xyz = Some(pos);
            }
        }
        if let Some(fwd) = safe_read::<[f32; 3]>((ped + rvas.ped_forward_vec) as usize) {
            let len = fwd[0].hypot(fwd[1]);
            if fwd[0].is_finite() && fwd[1].is_finite() && len > 0.05 && len < 2.0 {
                let fx = fwd[0] / len;
                let fy = fwd[1] / len;
                out.forward_xy = Some([fx, fy]);
                out.heading_deg = fx.atan2(fy).to_degrees().rem_euclid(360.0);
            }
        }
    }
    if rvas.current_vehicle != 0
        && let Some(veh) = safe_read::<u64>((base + rvas.current_vehicle) as usize)
    {
        out.in_vehicle = veh > 0x10000;
        if veh > 0x10000 {
            out.current_veh_ptr = veh;
        }
    }
    if rvas.world_gravity_scale != 0
        && let Some(g) = safe_read::<f32>((base + rvas.world_gravity_scale) as usize)
        && g.is_finite()
        && (-10.0..=10.0).contains(&g)
    {
        out.gravity_scale = Some(g);
    }
    if rvas.ped_pool != 0
        && let Some(pool) = safe_read::<u64>((base + rvas.ped_pool) as usize)
        && pool > 0x10000
    {
        out.peds_max = safe_read::<u32>((pool + rvas.pool_max_count) as usize).unwrap_or(0);
        out.peds_active = safe_read::<u32>((pool + rvas.pool_active_count) as usize).unwrap_or(0);
    }
    if rvas.vehicle_pool != 0
        && let Some(pool) = safe_read::<u64>((base + rvas.vehicle_pool) as usize)
        && pool > 0x10000
    {
        out.vehs_max = safe_read::<u32>((pool + rvas.pool_max_count) as usize).unwrap_or(0);
        out.vehs_active = safe_read::<u32>((pool + rvas.pool_active_count) as usize).unwrap_or(0);
    }
    if rvas.object_pool != 0
        && let Some(pool) = safe_read::<u64>((base + rvas.object_pool) as usize)
        && pool > 0x10000
    {
        out.objs_max = safe_read::<u32>((pool + rvas.pool_max_count) as usize).unwrap_or(0);
        out.objs_active = safe_read::<u32>((pool + rvas.pool_active_count) as usize).unwrap_or(0);
    }
    if let Some((wp, _)) = read_active_waypoint(base, rvas) {
        out.waypoint_xyz = Some(wp);
    }
    if rvas.weather_struct != 0 {
        let wb = base + rvas.weather_struct;
        if let Some(prev) = safe_read::<i32>((wb + rvas.weather_prev_type) as usize)
            && (0..96).contains(&prev)
        {
            out.weather_prev = Some(prev);
        }
        if let Some(next) = safe_read::<i32>((wb + rvas.weather_next_type) as usize)
            && (0..96).contains(&next)
        {
            out.weather_next = Some(next);
        }
        out.weather_locked =
            safe_read::<u8>((wb + rvas.weather_force_lock) as usize).unwrap_or(0) != 0;
    }
    if rvas.clock_datetime != 0 {
        let cb = base + rvas.clock_datetime;
        if let (Some(h), Some(m), Some(s)) = (
            safe_read::<i32>((cb + rvas.clock_hour) as usize),
            safe_read::<i32>((cb + rvas.clock_minute) as usize),
            safe_read::<i32>((cb + rvas.clock_second) as usize),
        ) && (0..24).contains(&h)
            && (0..60).contains(&m)
            && (0..60).contains(&s)
        {
            out.clock_hms = Some((h, m, s));
        }
    }
    if rvas.clock_pause_flag != 0 {
        out.clock_paused =
            (safe_read::<u8>((base + rvas.clock_pause_flag) as usize).unwrap_or(0) & 1) != 0;
    }
    if rvas.clock_ms_per_minute != 0 {
        out.clock_ms_per_min =
            safe_read::<u32>((base + rvas.clock_ms_per_minute) as usize).unwrap_or(0);
    }
    out
}

/// Safely teleports the local player ped (and active vehicle if inside one!) by writing
/// the exact 32m sector-packed `[lx, ly, z, sec_x, sec_y]` to `entity + ped_pos_packed`.
pub fn direct_teleport(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, coords: [f32; 3]) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
    if base == 0 {
        return Err("Offline preview mode (launch game to teleport)");
    }
    if !rvas.loaded || rvas.local_player_ped == 0 {
        return Err("local_player_ped RVA missing in rvas.json");
    }
    let Some(ped) = safe_read::<u64>((base + rvas.local_player_ped) as usize) else {
        return Err("Player pointer unreadable");
    };
    if ped < 0x10000 {
        return Err("Local player ped not spawned yet");
    }
    let packed = pack_sector_pos(coords);
    // If player is inside a vehicle, move the vehicle alongside the ped!
    if rvas.current_vehicle != 0
        && let Some(veh) = safe_read::<u64>((base + rvas.current_vehicle) as usize)
        && veh > 0x10000
    {
        let _ = safe_write::<[u32; 4]>((veh + rvas.ped_pos_packed) as usize, packed);
    }
    if safe_write::<[u32; 4]>((ped + rvas.ped_pos_packed) as usize, packed) {
        Ok(())
    } else {
        Err("Player position page not writable")
    }
}

/// Safely writes hour/minute/second directly into `g_Clock::ms_dateTime` (fallback if hook off).
pub fn direct_set_clock_time(
    base: u64,
    rvas: &RvaTable,
    hour: i32,
    minute: i32,
    second: i32,
) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
    if base == 0 {
        return Err("Offline preview mode");
    }
    if !rvas.loaded || rvas.clock_datetime == 0 {
        return Err("clock_datetime RVA missing in rvas.json");
    }
    let cb = base + rvas.clock_datetime;
    let ok1 = safe_write::<i32>((cb + rvas.clock_hour) as usize, hour.rem_euclid(24));
    let ok2 = safe_write::<i32>((cb + rvas.clock_minute) as usize, minute.rem_euclid(60));
    let ok3 = safe_write::<i32>((cb + rvas.clock_second) as usize, second.rem_euclid(60));
    if ok1 && ok2 && ok3 {
        Ok(())
    } else {
        Err("Clock memory not writable")
    }
}

/// Safely pauses or resumes the world clock via `clock_pause_flag` (bit 0).
pub fn direct_set_clock_paused(
    base: u64,
    rvas: &RvaTable,
    paused: bool,
) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
    if base == 0 {
        return Err("Offline preview mode");
    }
    if !rvas.loaded || rvas.clock_pause_flag == 0 {
        return Err("clock_pause_flag RVA missing in rvas.json");
    }
    let addr = (base + rvas.clock_pause_flag) as usize;
    let cur = safe_read::<u8>(addr).unwrap_or(0);
    let next = if paused { cur | 1 } else { cur & !1 };
    if safe_write::<u8>(addr, next) {
        Ok(())
    } else {
        Err("Clock pause flag not writable")
    }
}

/// Detaches the tracked last spawned cheat vehicle handle (`|= 0x1FFFF`) so spawning
/// another vehicle will NOT despawn your previously spawned car!
pub fn detach_last_spawned_vehicle(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
    if base == 0 {
        return Err("Offline preview mode");
    }
    if !rvas.loaded || rvas.cheat_vehicle_handle == 0 {
        return Err("cheat_vehicle_handle RVA missing in rvas.json");
    }
    let addr = (base + rvas.cheat_vehicle_handle) as usize;
    let cur = safe_read::<u32>(addr).ok_or("Vehicle handle unreadable")?;
    if safe_write::<u32>(addr, cur | 0x1_FFFF) {
        Ok(())
    } else {
        Err("Vehicle handle not writable")
    }
}

/// Safely writes a weather type override directly into `g_Weather` (`CWeather`).
pub fn direct_set_weather(
    base: u64,
    rvas: &RvaTable,
    weather_id: i32,
    lock: bool,
) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
    if base == 0 {
        return Err("Offline preview mode (launch game for engine weather)");
    }
    if !rvas.loaded || rvas.weather_struct == 0 {
        return Err("weather_struct RVA missing in rvas.json");
    }
    let wb = base + rvas.weather_struct;
    let ok1 = safe_write::<i32>((wb + rvas.weather_prev_type) as usize, weather_id);
    let ok2 = safe_write::<i32>((wb + rvas.weather_next_type) as usize, weather_id);
    let ok3 = safe_write::<f32>((wb + rvas.weather_interp) as usize, 0.0);
    let ok4 = safe_write::<u8>((wb + rvas.weather_force_lock) as usize, u8::from(lock));
    if ok1 && ok2 && ok3 && ok4 {
        Ok(())
    } else {
        Err("Weather struct memory not writable")
    }
}

/// Detaches the last tracked spawned vehicle handle (alias kept for Inspector button).
pub fn unlock_builtin_cheats(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
    detach_last_spawned_vehicle(base, rvas)
}

/// Safely reads an entity's `Mat34V` `[right, forward, up, world_pos]` via `VirtualQuery`.
pub fn read_entity_basis_and_pos(
    entity: u64,
    rvas: &RvaTable,
) -> Option<([f32; 3], [f32; 3], [f32; 3], [f32; 3])> {
    if entity < 0x10000 {
        return None;
    }
    let right = safe_read::<[f32; 3]>((entity + rvas.ped_right_vec) as usize)?;
    let fwd = safe_read::<[f32; 3]>((entity + rvas.ped_forward_vec) as usize)?;
    let up = safe_read::<[f32; 3]>((entity + rvas.ped_up_vec) as usize)?;
    let raw_pos = safe_read::<[u32; 4]>((entity + rvas.ped_pos_packed) as usize)?;
    let pos = unpack_sector_pos(raw_pos);
    if !pos.iter().all(|v| v.is_finite() && v.abs() < 100_000.0)
        || !fwd.iter().all(|v| v.is_finite() && v.abs() <= 2.0)
        || !right.iter().all(|v| v.is_finite() && v.abs() <= 2.0)
    {
        return None;
    }
    Some((right, fwd, up, pos))
}

/// Safely updates all live pedestrian population density multiplier globals (`0.0..=2.0`).
pub fn direct_set_ped_density(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, mult: f32) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
    if base == 0 {
        return Err("Offline preview mode");
    }
    if !rvas.loaded {
        return Err("rvas.json not loaded");
    }
    let v = mult.clamp(0.0, 2.0);
    let mut wrote = 0usize;
    for rva in [rvas.ped_density_mult_1, rvas.ped_density_mult_2, rvas.ped_density_mult_3] {
        if rva != 0 && safe_write::<f32>((base + rva) as usize, v) {
            wrote += 1;
        }
    }
    if wrote > 0 {
        Ok(())
    } else {
        Err("Ped density globals missing or not writable")
    }
}

/// Safely updates all live vehicle / traffic density multiplier globals (`0.0..=2.0`).
pub fn direct_set_veh_density(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, mult: f32) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
    if base == 0 {
        return Err("Offline preview mode");
    }
    if !rvas.loaded {
        return Err("rvas.json not loaded");
    }
    let v = mult.clamp(0.0, 2.0);
    let mut wrote = 0usize;
    for rva in [rvas.veh_density_mult_1, rvas.veh_density_mult_2] {
        if rva != 0 && safe_write::<f32>((base + rva) as usize, v) {
            wrote += 1;
        }
    }
    if wrote > 0 {
        Ok(())
    } else {
        Err("Vehicle density globals missing or not writable")
    }
}

/// Converts `(hue_deg: 0..360, s: 0..1, v: 0..1)` to normalized `[r, g, b]` in `0.0..=1.0`.
pub fn hsv_to_rgb_f32(h: f32, s: f32, v: f32) -> [f32; 3] {
    let c = v * s;
    let h_mod = h.rem_euclid(360.0);
    let x = c * (1.0 - ((h_mod / 60.0) % 2.0 - 1.0).abs());
    let m = v - c;
    let (r, g, b) = match (h_mod as i32) / 60 {
        0 => (c, x, 0.0),
        1 => (x, c, 0.0),
        2 => (0.0, c, x),
        3 => (0.0, x, c),
        4 => (x, 0.0, c),
        _ => (c, 0.0, x),
    };
    [
        (r + m).clamp(0.0, 1.0),
        (g + m).clamp(0.0, 1.0),
        (b + m).clamp(0.0, 1.0),
    ]
}

fn vehicle_type_category(vt: u8) -> &'static str {
    match vt {
        0 => "Cars",
        1 => "Planes",
        2 | 7 | 8 => "Bikes & Cycles",
        5 | 6 => "Helicopters & Blimps",
        9 | 10 | 11 => "Boats & Watercraft",
        12 | 13 | 14 => "Trains",
        _ => "Special Vehicles",
    }
}

/// Fast page-cached `VirtualQuery` reader for bulk read-only table walks
/// (collapses 100,000+ `VirtualQuery` syscalls into ~20 cached page lookups -> `< 2 ms`!).
struct FastSafeReader {
    cache: [(usize, usize); 8],
    next_slot: usize,
}

impl FastSafeReader {
    fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            cache: [(0, 0); 8],
            next_slot: 0,
        }
    }

    #[inline]
    fn ensure_readable(&mut self, addr: usize, len: usize) -> bool {
        if addr < 0x10000 || len == 0 {
            return false;
        }
        let Some(end) = addr.checked_add(len) else {
            return false;
        };
        for &(lo, hi) in &self.cache {
            if addr >= lo && end <= hi {
                return true;
            }
        }
        if !is_readable_range(addr, len) {
            return false;
        }
        let mut mbi = MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION::default();
        // SAFETY: querying VM metadata only.
        let n = unsafe {
            VirtualQuery(
                addr as *const _,
                &mut mbi,
                size_of::<MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION>(),
            )
        };
        if n != 0 && mbi.State == MEM_COMMIT && mbi.RegionSize > 0 {
            let lo = mbi.BaseAddress as usize;
            let hi = lo.saturating_add(mbi.RegionSize);
            if addr >= lo && end <= hi {
                self.cache[self.next_slot] = (lo, hi);
                self.next_slot = (self.next_slot + 1) & 7;
            }
        }
        true
    }

    #[inline]
    fn read<T: Copy>(&mut self, addr: usize) -> Option<T> {
        if !self.ensure_readable(addr, size_of::<T>()) {
            return None;
        }
        // SAFETY: `[addr, addr + size_of::<T>())` verified committed + readable.
        Some(unsafe { std::ptr::read_unaligned(addr as *const T) })
    }
}

/// Probes a `CVehicleModelInfo` struct safely (read-only) for an inline null-terminated
/// ASCII vehicle identifier (e.g. `CHEETAH`, `POLICE`, `SEASHARK`), returning a nicely
/// title-cased display name if found.
fn try_read_inline_vehicle_name(reader: &mut FastSafeReader, mi: u64) -> Option<String> {
    let buf = reader.read::<[u8; 0x140]>((mi + 0x100) as usize)?;
    // Scan 4-byte-aligned slots inside `mi + 0x100..+0x230` for a clean ASCII vehicle name.
    for off in (0..0x120usize).step_by(4) {
        let first = buf[off];
        if !first.is_ascii_alphabetic() {
            continue;
        }
        let mut len = 0usize;
        let mut ok = true;
        let mut has_alpha = false;
        while off + len < buf.len() && len < 22 {
            let b = buf[off + len];
            if b == 0 {
                break;
            }
            if b.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || b == b'_' || b == b' ' || b == b'-' {
                if b.is_ascii_alphabetic() {
                    has_alpha = true;
                }
                len += 1;
            } else {
                ok = false;
                break;
            }
        }
        if ok && has_alpha && (3..=20).contains(&len) && off + len < buf.len() && buf[off + len] == 0
        {
            let raw = std::str::from_utf8(&buf[off..off + len]).ok()?.trim();
            if raw.len() >= 3 && !raw.eq_ignore_ascii_case("null") {
                return Some(title_case_vehicle_name(raw));
            }
        }
    }
    None
}

fn title_case_vehicle_name(raw: &str) -> String {
    let mut out = String::with_capacity(raw.len());
    let mut cap_next = true;
    for ch in raw.chars() {
        if ch == '_' || ch == '-' {
            out.push(' ');
            cap_next = true;
        } else if ch == ' ' {
            out.push(' ');
            cap_next = true;
        } else if cap_next {
            out.push(ch.to_ascii_uppercase());
            cap_next = false;
        } else {
            out.push(ch.to_ascii_lowercase());
        }
    }
    out
}

/// Safely reads a null-terminated localized display name from guest memory (up to 64 bytes),
/// strips Engine `~...~` color/control tags, and filters out placeholders or printf format strings.
pub fn read_clean_cstr_name(ptr: u64) -> Option<String> {
    if ptr < 0x10000 {
        return None;
    }
    let mut raw = [0u8; 64];
    let mut len = 0usize;
    if let Some(chunk) = safe_read::<[u8; 64]>(ptr as usize) {
        while len < chunk.len() && chunk[len] != 0 {
            raw[len] = chunk[len];
            len += 1;
        }
    } else {
        while len < raw.len() {
            let b = safe_read::<u8>((ptr as usize).wrapping_add(len))?;
            if b == 0 {
                break;
            }
            raw[len] = b;
            len += 1;
        }
    }
    if len == 0 {
        return None;
    }
    let text = std::str::from_utf8(&raw[..len]).ok()?;
    // Strip Engine `~x~` / `~HUD_COLOUR_...~` inline formatting tags cleanly.
    let mut stripped = String::with_capacity(text.len());
    let mut in_tag = false;
    for ch in text.chars() {
        if ch == '~' {
            in_tag = !in_tag;
            continue;
        }
        if !in_tag {
            stripped.push(ch);
        }
    }
    let cleaned: String = stripped
        .split_whitespace()
        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
        .join(" ");
    let trimmed = cleaned.trim();
    if !(2..=40).contains(&trimmed.len()) {
        return None;
    }
    let mut alpha_count = 0usize;
    for ch in trimmed.chars() {
        if ch.is_control()
            || matches!(ch, '%' | '{' | '}' | '|' | '\\' | '<' | '>' | '[' | ']' | '$' | '^')
        {
            return None;
        }
        if ch.is_ascii_alphabetic() {
            alpha_count += 1;
        }
    }
    if alpha_count < 2 {
        return None;
    }
    let lo = trimmed.to_ascii_lowercase();
    if matches!(
        lo.as_str(),
        "null"
            | "none"
            | "invalid"
            | "default"
            | "blank"
            | "unknown"
            | "empty"
            | "n/a"
            | "error"
            | "yes"
            | "no"
            | "on"
            | "off"
            | "ok"
            | "carnotfound"
    ) {
        return None;
    }
    Some(trimmed.to_owned())
}

#[inline]
fn is_plausible_text_hash(h: u32) -> bool {
    if h < 0x0001_0000 || h == 0xFFFF_FFFF {
        return false;
    }
    // Skip common IEEE-754 positive/negative small floats (0.01 .. 1000.0) & ASCII tag patterns.
    let top = h & 0x7F80_0000;
    if (0x3B80_0000..=0x4480_0000).contains(&top) && (h & 0x0000_FFFF) == 0 {
        return false;
    }
    true
}

static LAST_NAME_SCAN_DIAG: std::sync::Mutex<String> = std::sync::Mutex::new(String::new());

pub fn last_name_scan_diag() -> String {
    LAST_NAME_SCAN_DIAG
        .lock()
        .map(|s| s.clone())
        .unwrap_or_default()
}

fn append_name_scan_diag(part: &str) {
    if let Ok(mut s) = LAST_NAME_SCAN_DIAG.lock() {
        if !s.is_empty() {
            s.push_str(" | ");
        }
        s.push_str(part);
        if s.len() > 600 {
            let keep = s.len() - 600;
            s.drain(..keep);
        }
    }
}

/// Auto-calibrates which 4-byte-aligned field offsets within a repeating engine struct (such as
/// `CVehicleModelInfo`, `CInventoryItemCatalog`, or `CItemInfo`) store live `.gxt2` display-name
/// hashes, returning up to 2 offsets sorted by `(more_distinct_names_first)` along with hit counts.
fn calibrate_struct_text_offsets(
    reader: &mut FastSafeReader,
    ptrs: &[u64],
    byte_len: usize,
) -> Vec<(usize, usize, usize)> {
    if ptrs.is_empty() || byte_len < 4 || !super::hook::is_installed() {
        return Vec::new();
    }
    let sample_n = ptrs.len().min(16);
    let mut probe_hashes: Vec<u32> = Vec::with_capacity(sample_n * (byte_len / 4));
    let mut per_obj: Vec<Vec<(usize, u32)>> = Vec::with_capacity(sample_n);
    for &p in &ptrs[..sample_n] {
        let mut fields = Vec::new();
        for off in (0..byte_len).step_by(4) {
            if let Some(h) = reader.read::<u32>((p + off as u64) as usize)
                && is_plausible_text_hash(h)
            {
                fields.push((off, h));
                probe_hashes.push(h);
            }
        }
        per_obj.push(fields);
    }
    let resolved = super::hook::resolve_text_hashes_blocking(&probe_hashes);
    if resolved.is_empty() {
        return Vec::new();
    }
    let mut hits_by_off = std::collections::HashMap::<usize, (usize, std::collections::HashSet<String>)>::new();
    for fields in &per_obj {
        for &(off, h) in fields {
            if let Some(name) = resolved.get(&h) {
                let entry = hits_by_off.entry(off).or_default();
                entry.0 += 1;
                entry.1.insert(name.clone());
            }
        }
    }
    let mut ranked: Vec<(usize, usize, usize)> = hits_by_off
        .into_iter()
        .map(|(off, (hits, uniq))| (off, hits, uniq.len()))
        .filter(|&(_, hits, uniq)| hits >= 2 || (sample_n <= 4 && uniq >= 1))
        .collect();
    ranked.sort_by(|a, b| b.2.cmp(&a.2).then_with(|| b.1.cmp(&a.1)).then_with(|| a.0.cmp(&b.0)));
    ranked.truncate(3);
    ranked
}

/// 100% safe, read-only, page-cached `VirtualQuery` walk of the live `g_ModelInfoHashTable`
/// to discover every registered vehicle in memory (`< 2 ms`), grouped by real `VehicleType`
/// and dynamically named via the title's live `.gxt2` localization table (`theText::GetByHash`)!
pub fn scan_live_vehicle_catalog(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) -> Vec<CheatVehicleEntry> {
    if base == 0
        || !rvas.loaded
        || rvas.model_info_bitset == 0
        || rvas.model_info_array == 0
        || rvas.model_info_stride == 0
        || rvas.model_info_buckets == 0
        || rvas.model_info_bucket_count == 0
    {
        return Vec::new();
    }

    let mut reader = FastSafeReader::new();
    let Some(bucket_count) = reader.read::<u32>((base + rvas.model_info_bucket_count) as usize)
    else {
        return Vec::new();
    };
    let Some(bitset_ptr) = reader.read::<u64>((base + rvas.model_info_bitset) as usize) else {
        return Vec::new();
    };
    let Some(array_ptr) = reader.read::<u64>((base + rvas.model_info_array) as usize) else {
        return Vec::new();
    };
    let Some(stride) = reader.read::<u32>((base + rvas.model_info_stride) as usize) else {
        return Vec::new();
    };
    if bucket_count == 0
        || bucket_count > 16_384
        || bitset_ptr < 0x10000
        || array_ptr < 0x10000
        || !(8..=128).contains(&stride)
    {
        return Vec::new();
    }

    let mut seen_hashes = std::collections::HashSet::<u64>::with_capacity(1024);
    let mut raw_vehs: Vec<(u64, u64, u8)> = Vec::with_capacity(512);
    let buckets_base = base + rvas.model_info_buckets;
    let mut visited = 0usize;

    for b in 0..bucket_count as u64 {
        let b_addr = buckets_base + b * 0x58;
        let Some(cnt) = reader.read::<u32>((b_addr + 0x0c) as usize) else {
            continue;
        };
        if cnt == 0 || cnt > 65_536 {
            continue;
        }
        let Some(hashes_ptr) = reader.read::<u64>((b_addr + 0x10) as usize) else {
            continue;
        };
        let Some(ids_ptr) = reader.read::<u64>((b_addr + 0x20) as usize) else {
            continue;
        };
        if hashes_ptr < 0x10000 || ids_ptr < 0x10000 {
            continue;
        }

        for i in 0..cnt as u64 {
            visited += 1;
            if visited > 250_000 {
                break;
            }
            let Some(hash64) = reader.read::<u64>((hashes_ptr + i * 8) as usize) else {
                break;
            };
            if hash64 == 0 || !seen_hashes.insert(hash64) {
                continue;
            }
            let Some(raw_id) = reader.read::<u32>((ids_ptr + i * 4) as usize) else {
                break;
            };
            let idx = raw_id & 0x3F_FFFF;
            if idx == 0x3F_FFFF {
                continue;
            }
            let Some(bbyte) = reader.read::<u8>((bitset_ptr + u64::from(idx >> 3)) as usize) else {
                continue;
            };
            if (bbyte & (1u8 << (idx & 7))) == 0 {
                continue;
            }
            let Some(mi) =
                reader.read::<u64>((array_ptr + u64::from(idx) * u64::from(stride)) as usize)
            else {
                continue;
            };
            if mi < 0x10000 {
                continue;
            }
            let Some(type_byte) = reader.read::<u8>((mi + rvas.model_info_type_byte) as usize)
            else {
                continue;
            };
            // `MI_TYPE_VEHICLE == 5` (low 3 bits of `CBaseModelInfo + 0x99`).
            if (type_byte & 7) != 5 {
                continue;
            }
            let veh_type = reader
                .read::<u8>((mi + rvas.model_info_veh_type) as usize)
                .unwrap_or(0);
            raw_vehs.push((mi, hash64, veh_type));
            if raw_vehs.len() >= 1024 {
                break;
            }
        }
        if raw_vehs.len() >= 1024 || visited > 250_000 {
            break;
        }
    }

    // Dynamically resolve real vehicle Make + Model names via live `theText::GetByHash`!
    let mut text_map = std::collections::HashMap::<u32, String>::new();
    let mut cal_offs: Vec<(usize, usize, usize)> = Vec::new();
    if rvas.fn_get_text_by_hash != 0 && super::hook::is_installed() && !raw_vehs.is_empty() {
        let sample_ptrs: Vec<u64> = raw_vehs.iter().take(16).map(|&(mi, _, _)| mi).collect();
        cal_offs = calibrate_struct_text_offsets(&mut reader, &sample_ptrs, 0x380);
        let mut batch_hashes: Vec<u32> = Vec::with_capacity(raw_vehs.len() * 4);
        for &(mi, hash64, _) in &raw_vehs {
            let lo32 = hash64 as u32;
            let hi32 = (hash64 >> 32) as u32;
            if is_plausible_text_hash(lo32) {
                batch_hashes.push(lo32);
            }
            if is_plausible_text_hash(hi32) {
                batch_hashes.push(hi32);
            }
            for &(off, _, _) in &cal_offs {
                if let Some(h) = reader.read::<u32>((mi + off as u64) as usize)
                    && is_plausible_text_hash(h)
                {
                    batch_hashes.push(h);
                }
            }
        }
        text_map = super::hook::resolve_text_hashes_blocking(&batch_hashes);
    }

    let mut named_count = 0usize;
    let mut out = Vec::<CheatVehicleEntry>::with_capacity(raw_vehs.len());
    for (mi, hash64, veh_type) in raw_vehs {
        let category = vehicle_type_category(veh_type).to_owned();
        let builtin_match = rvas
            .builtin_vehicles
            .iter()
            .find(|v| v.hash64 == hash64)
            .map(|v| v.name.clone());

        // Prefer calibrated `(model, make)` text hashes from `CVehicleModelInfo`, then hash64 halves!
        let mut resolved_parts: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
        for &(off, _, _) in &cal_offs {
            if let Some(h) = reader.read::<u32>((mi + off as u64) as usize)
                && let Some(s) = text_map.get(&h)
                && !resolved_parts.iter().any(|p| p.eq_ignore_ascii_case(s))
            {
                resolved_parts.push(s.clone());
            }
        }
        let live_name = if resolved_parts.len() >= 2 {
            // Put shorter/manufacturer name first (`Make Model`), keeping model name prominent.
            let model = &resolved_parts[0];
            let make = &resolved_parts[1];
            if model.to_ascii_lowercase().contains(&make.to_ascii_lowercase()) {
                Some(model.clone())
            } else if make.to_ascii_lowercase().contains(&model.to_ascii_lowercase()) {
                Some(make.clone())
            } else {
                Some(format!("{make} {model}"))
            }
        } else if let Some(single) = resolved_parts.into_iter().next() {
            Some(single)
        } else {
            text_map
                .get(&(hash64 as u32))
                .or_else(|| text_map.get(&((hash64 >> 32) as u32)))
                .cloned()
        };

        let name = if let Some(real_name) = live_name {
            named_count += 1;
            real_name
        } else if let Some(inline) = try_read_inline_vehicle_name(&mut reader, mi) {
            named_count += 1;
            inline
        } else if let Some(bname) = builtin_match {
            bname
        } else {
            let short = match veh_type {
                0 => "Car",
                1 => "Plane",
                2 => "Quad",
                5 => "Heli",
                6 => "Blimp",
                7 => "Bike",
                8 => "Cycle",
```
