                9..=11 => "Boat",
                12..=14 => "Train",
                _ => "Vehicle",
            };
            format!("{short} #{:03} [0x{:08X}]", out.len() + 1, (hash64 >> 32) as u32)
        };
        out.push(CheatVehicleEntry {
            name,
            category,
            hash64,
        });
    }

    let offs_desc: Vec<String> = cal_offs
        .iter()
        .map(|&(o, h, u)| format!("+0x{o:x}({h}h/{u}u)"))
        .collect();
    append_name_scan_diag(&format!(
        "veh_named={named_count}/{} offs=[{}]",
        out.len(),
        offs_desc.join(",")
    ));

    out.sort_by(|a, b| a.category.cmp(&b.category).then_with(|| a.name.cmp(&b.name)));
    out
}

/// Safely reads the player's active GTA map waypoint (or scripted GPS fallback).
/// Returns `(world_xyz, is_player_map_waypoint)`.
pub fn read_active_waypoint(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) -> Option<([f32; 3], bool)> {
    if base == 0 || !rvas.loaded {
        return None;
    }
    if rvas.waypoint_active != 0
        && rvas.waypoint_pos != 0
        && safe_read::<u8>((base + rvas.waypoint_active) as usize).unwrap_or(0) != 0
        && let Some(v) = safe_read::<[f32; 4]>((base + rvas.waypoint_pos) as usize)
        && v[0].is_finite()
        && v[1].is_finite()
        && v[2].is_finite()
        && v[0].abs() < 60_000.0
        && v[1].abs() < 60_000.0
        && (v[0].abs() + v[1].abs()) > 1.0
    {
        return Some(([v[0], v[1], v[2]], true));
    }
    if rvas.gps_waypoint_active != 0
        && rvas.gps_waypoint_pos != 0
        && safe_read::<u8>((base + rvas.gps_waypoint_active) as usize).unwrap_or(0) != 0
        && let Some(v) = safe_read::<[f32; 4]>((base + rvas.gps_waypoint_pos) as usize)
        && v[0].is_finite()
        && v[1].is_finite()
        && v[2].is_finite()
        && v[0].abs() < 60_000.0
        && v[1].abs() < 60_000.0
        && (v[0].abs() + v[1].abs()) > 1.0
    {
        return Some(([v[0], v[1], v[2]], false));
    }
    None
}

/// 100% safe, read-only, page-cached `VirtualQuery` walk of `g_ModelInfoHashTable` to discover
/// real `MI_TYPE_BASE` (`(type_byte & 7) == 1`) props for the live Object Spooner!
pub fn scan_live_prop_catalog(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) -> Vec<PropCatalogEntry> {
    if base == 0
        || !rvas.loaded
        || rvas.model_info_bitset == 0
        || rvas.model_info_array == 0
        || rvas.model_info_stride == 0
        || rvas.model_info_buckets == 0
        || rvas.model_info_bucket_count == 0
    {
        return Vec::new();
    }
    let mut reader = FastSafeReader::new();
    let Some(bucket_count) = reader.read::<u32>((base + rvas.model_info_bucket_count) as usize)
    else {
        return Vec::new();
    };
    let Some(bitset_ptr) = reader.read::<u64>((base + rvas.model_info_bitset) as usize) else {
        return Vec::new();
    };
    let Some(array_ptr) = reader.read::<u64>((base + rvas.model_info_array) as usize) else {
        return Vec::new();
    };
    let Some(stride) = reader.read::<u32>((base + rvas.model_info_stride) as usize) else {
        return Vec::new();
    };
    if bucket_count == 0
        || bucket_count > 16_384
        || bitset_ptr < 0x10000
        || array_ptr < 0x10000
        || !(8..=128).contains(&stride)
    {
        return Vec::new();
    }

    let mut seen = std::collections::HashSet::<u64>::with_capacity(512);
    let mut loaded_world = Vec::<PropCatalogEntry>::with_capacity(64);
    let mut out = Vec::<PropCatalogEntry>::with_capacity(256);

    // 1. Prioritize ALREADY-LOADED live `CObject*` models from `g_ObjectPool` (`[obj+0x20] -> CBaseModelInfo* -> [+0x60] = hash64`).
    // These are guaranteed valid, stream-ready dynamic/world props rather than static map buildings!
    if rvas.object_pool != 0
        && let Some(pool) = reader.read::<u64>((base + rvas.object_pool) as usize)
        && pool > 0x10000
        && let (Some(storage), Some(elem_size), Some(max_count), Some(flags_ptr)) = (
            reader.read::<u64>((pool + rvas.pool_storage) as usize),
            reader.read::<u32>((pool + rvas.pool_elem_size) as usize),
            reader.read::<u32>((pool + rvas.pool_max_count) as usize),
            reader.read::<u64>((pool + rvas.pool_flags) as usize),
        )
        && storage > 0x10000
        && flags_ptr > 0x10000
        && (64..=8192).contains(&elem_size)
        && (1..=32_768).contains(&max_count)
    {
        let valid_mask = reader.read::<u32>((pool + 0x30) as usize).unwrap_or(0);
        for i in 0..max_count as u64 {
            let Some(fl) = reader.read::<u32>((flags_ptr + i * 4) as usize) else {
                break;
            };
            if valid_mask != 0 {
                if (fl & valid_mask) != valid_mask {
                    continue;
                }
            } else if fl == 0 {
                continue;
            }
            let obj = storage + i * u64::from(elem_size);
            let Some(mi) = reader.read::<u64>((obj + 0x20) as usize) else {
                continue;
            };
            if mi < 0x10000 {
                continue;
            }
            let Some(type_byte) = reader.read::<u8>((mi + rvas.model_info_type_byte) as usize)
            else {
                continue;
            };
            if (type_byte & 7) != 1 {
                continue;
            }
            let Some(hash64) = reader.read::<u64>((mi + 0x60) as usize) else {
                continue;
            };
            if hash64 == 0 || !seen.insert(hash64) {
                continue;
            }
            let name = try_read_inline_vehicle_name(&mut reader, mi)
                .map(|n| format!("{n} [World]"))
                .unwrap_or_else(|| {
                    format!(
                        "World Prop #{:02} [0x{:08X}]",
                        loaded_world.len() + 1,
                        (hash64 >> 32) as u32
                    )
                });
            loaded_world.push(PropCatalogEntry { name, hash64 });
            if loaded_world.len() >= 48 {
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    let buckets_base = base + rvas.model_info_buckets;
    let mut visited = 0usize;

    for b in 0..bucket_count as u64 {
        let b_addr = buckets_base + b * 0x58;
        let Some(cnt) = reader.read::<u32>((b_addr + 0x0c) as usize) else {
            continue;
        };
        if cnt == 0 || cnt > 65_536 {
            continue;
        }
        let Some(hashes_ptr) = reader.read::<u64>((b_addr + 0x10) as usize) else {
            continue;
        };
        let Some(ids_ptr) = reader.read::<u64>((b_addr + 0x20) as usize) else {
            continue;
        };
        if hashes_ptr < 0x10000 || ids_ptr < 0x10000 {
            continue;
        }

        for i in 0..cnt as u64 {
            visited += 1;
            if visited > 250_000 {
                break;
            }
            let Some(hash64) = reader.read::<u64>((hashes_ptr + i * 8) as usize) else {
                break;
            };
            if hash64 == 0 || !seen.insert(hash64) {
                continue;
            }
            let Some(raw_id) = reader.read::<u32>((ids_ptr + i * 4) as usize) else {
                break;
            };
            let idx = raw_id & 0x3F_FFFF;
            if idx == 0x3F_FFFF {
                continue;
            }
            let Some(bbyte) = reader.read::<u8>((bitset_ptr + u64::from(idx >> 3)) as usize) else {
                continue;
            };
            if (bbyte & (1u8 << (idx & 7))) == 0 {
                continue;
            }
            let Some(mi) =
                reader.read::<u64>((array_ptr + u64::from(idx) * u64::from(stride)) as usize)
            else {
                continue;
            };
            if mi < 0x10000 {
                continue;
            }
            let Some(type_byte) = reader.read::<u8>((mi + rvas.model_info_type_byte) as usize)
            else {
                continue;
            };
            // `MI_TYPE_BASE == 1` (low 3 bits of `CBaseModelInfo + 0x99`).
            if (type_byte & 7) != 1 {
                continue;
            }
            let name = try_read_inline_vehicle_name(&mut reader, mi)
                .filter(|s| {
                    let lo = s.to_ascii_lowercase();
                    s.len() >= 6
                        && (lo.starts_with("prop")
                            || lo.starts_with("p ")
                            || lo.starts_with("v ")
                            || lo.starts_with("xm ")
                            || lo.starts_with("hei ")
                            || lo.starts_with("stt ")
                            || lo.contains(' '))
                })
                .unwrap_or_else(|| {
                    format!("Prop #{:03} [0x{:08X}]", out.len() + 1, (hash64 >> 32) as u32)
                });
            out.push(PropCatalogEntry { name, hash64 });
            if out.len() >= 256 {
                break;
            }
        }
        if out.len() >= 256 || visited > 250_000 {
            break;
        }
    }

    out.sort_by(|a, b| a.name.cmp(&b.name));
    loaded_world.extend(out);
    loaded_world.truncate(256);

    // Resolve any prop hashes present in live `.gxt2` localization text via `theText::GetByHash`!
    if rvas.fn_get_text_by_hash != 0 && super::hook::is_installed() && !loaded_world.is_empty() {
        let mut hashes = Vec::with_capacity(loaded_world.len() * 2);
        for p in &loaded_world {
            let lo = p.hash64 as u32;
            let hi = (p.hash64 >> 32) as u32;
            if is_plausible_text_hash(lo) {
                hashes.push(lo);
            }
            if is_plausible_text_hash(hi) {
                hashes.push(hi);
            }
        }
        let text_map = super::hook::resolve_text_hashes_blocking(&hashes);
        let mut prop_named = 0usize;
        for p in &mut loaded_world {
            if let Some(real) = text_map
                .get(&(p.hash64 as u32))
                .or_else(|| text_map.get(&((p.hash64 >> 32) as u32)))
            {
                let suffix = if p.name.contains("World") { " [World]" } else { "" };
                p.name = format!("{real}{suffix}");
                prop_named += 1;
            }
        }
        append_name_scan_diag(&format!("prop_named={prop_named}/{}", loaded_world.len()));
    }
    loaded_world
}

/// Probes a `CItemInfo` / `CWeaponInfo` block for an inline ASCII identifier name if present.
fn try_read_inline_weapon_name(reader: &mut FastSafeReader, ptr: u64) -> Option<String> {
    let buf = reader.read::<[u8; 0x90]>(ptr as usize)?;
    for off in (0..0x78usize).step_by(4) {
        if !buf[off].is_ascii_alphabetic() {
            continue;
        }
        let mut len = 0usize;
        let mut ok = true;
        while off + len < buf.len() && len < 26 {
            let b = buf[off + len];
            if b == 0 {
                break;
            }
            if b.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || b == b'_' || b == b'-' {
                len += 1;
            } else {
                ok = false;
                break;
            }
        }
        if ok && (4..=24).contains(&len) && off + len < buf.len() && buf[off + len] == 0 {
            let s = std::str::from_utf8(&buf[off..off + len]).ok()?;
            if s.to_ascii_uppercase().starts_with("WEAPON_")
                || s.to_ascii_uppercase().starts_with("W_")
            {
                return Some(title_case_vehicle_name(s.trim_start_matches("WEAPON_")));
            }
        }
    }
    None
}

/// Safely walks `CInventoryItemCatalog` (`inv_catalog_db`, stride `0x68`) +
/// `CInventoryAwardDatabase` (`inv_item_db`, stride `0x70`) to build a map from
/// `CItemInfo`/`CWeaponInfo` `hash32` -> `(award_hash32, is_free_unconditional)` (`< 2 ms`).
/// Strictly ranks FREE, zero-prerequisite, unconditional, positive-quantity Story Mode awards
/// ahead of paid shop-purchase awards (`cost_cnt > 0` or `prereq_cnt > 0`)!
/// Returns `(award_db_count, catalog_db_count, item_info_hash_to_award)`.
pub fn scan_inv_award_map(
    base: u64,
    rvas: &RvaTable,
) -> (usize, usize, std::collections::HashMap<u32, (u32, bool)>) {
    // Score tuple (lower is better!): (prereq_cnt>0, cost_cnt>0, cond!=0, qty<=0, sub_cnt)
    let mut map = std::collections::HashMap::<u32, (u32, (u8, u8, u8, u8, u16))>::new();
    if base == 0 || !rvas.loaded || rvas.inv_item_db == 0 {
        return (0, 0, std::collections::HashMap::new());
    }
    let mut reader = FastSafeReader::new();

    // 1. Walk `CInventoryItemCatalog` (`[inv_catalog_db]`: array at `+0x58`, count u16 at `+0x60`, stride `0x68`):
    //    `+0x00` = catalog item hash32, `+0x10` = `CItemInfo`/`CWeaponInfo` hash32!
    let mut cat_direct_ok = std::collections::HashSet::<u32>::new();
    let mut item_to_cat_addr = std::collections::HashMap::<u32, u64>::new();
    let mut cat_to_item = std::collections::HashMap::<u32, u32>::new();
    if rvas.inv_catalog_db != 0
        && let Some(cat_db) = reader.read::<u64>((base + rvas.inv_catalog_db) as usize)
        && cat_db > 0x10000
        && let (Some(cat_arr), Some(cat_cnt)) = (
            reader.read::<u64>((cat_db + 0x58) as usize),
            reader.read::<u16>((cat_db + 0x60) as usize),
        )
        && cat_arr > 0x10000
        && cat_cnt > 0
    {
        cat_to_item.reserve(usize::from(cat_cnt));
        for i in 0..u64::from(cat_cnt) {
            let entry = cat_arr + i * 0x68;
            let Some(cat_hash) = reader.read::<u32>(entry as usize) else {
                break;
            };
            let Some(item_info_hash) = reader.read::<u32>((entry + 0x10) as usize) else {
                break;
            };
            let flags18 = reader.read::<u8>((entry + 0x18) as usize).unwrap_or(1);
            if cat_hash != 0 {
                if (flags18 & 1) == 0 {
                    cat_direct_ok.insert(cat_hash);
                }
                item_to_cat_addr.entry(cat_hash).or_insert(entry);
            }
            if cat_hash != 0 && item_info_hash != 0 {
                cat_to_item.insert(cat_hash, item_info_hash);
                item_to_cat_addr.entry(item_info_hash).or_insert(entry);
            }
        }
    }
    let _ = (&cat_direct_ok, &item_to_cat_addr);

    // 2. Walk `CInventoryAwardDatabase` (`[inv_item_db]`: array at `+0x18`, count u16 at `+0x20`, stride `0x70`):
    //    `+0x00` = `award_hash32`, `+0x20` = `sub_records*` (stride `0x30`), `+0x28` = `u16 sub_count`,
    //    `+0x38` = `u16 cost_count`, `+0x58` = `u16 prereq_count`.
    //    Inside each `sub_record`: `+0x00` = `cat_item_hash32`, `+0x08` = `i32 qty`, `+0x0c` = `u32 cond_hash`.
    let mut award_db_count = 0usize;
    if let Some(db_ptr) = reader.read::<u64>((base + rvas.inv_item_db) as usize)
        && db_ptr > 0x10000
        && let (Some(arr_ptr), Some(count)) = (
            reader.read::<u64>((db_ptr + 0x18) as usize),
            reader.read::<u16>((db_ptr + 0x20) as usize),
        )
        && arr_ptr > 0x10000
        && count > 0
    {
        award_db_count = usize::from(count);
        for i in 0..u64::from(count) {
            let entry = arr_ptr + i * 0x70;
            let Some(award_hash) = reader.read::<u32>(entry as usize) else {
                break;
            };
            if award_hash == 0 {
                continue;
            }
            let sub_ptr = reader.read::<u64>((entry + 0x20) as usize).unwrap_or(0);
            let sub_cnt = reader.read::<u16>((entry + 0x28) as usize).unwrap_or(0);
            let cost_cnt = reader.read::<u16>((entry + 0x38) as usize).unwrap_or(0);
            let prereq_cnt = reader.read::<u16>((entry + 0x58) as usize).unwrap_or(0);
            if sub_ptr > 0x10000 && sub_cnt > 0 && sub_cnt <= 32 {
                for j in 0..u64::from(sub_cnt) {
                    let sub_addr = sub_ptr + j * 0x30;
                    let Some(sub_hash) = reader.read::<u32>(sub_addr as usize) else {
                        break;
                    };
                    if sub_hash == 0 {
                        continue;
                    }
                    let sub_qty = reader.read::<i32>((sub_addr + 0x08) as usize).unwrap_or(0);
                    let sub_cond = reader.read::<u32>((sub_addr + 0x0c) as usize).unwrap_or(0);
                    let score = (
                        u8::from(prereq_cnt != 0),
                        u8::from(cost_cnt != 0),
                        u8::from(sub_cond != 0),
                        u8::from(sub_qty <= 0),
                        sub_cnt,
                    );
                    let target_hash = cat_to_item.get(&sub_hash).copied().unwrap_or(sub_hash);
                    let replace = match map.get(&target_hash) {
                        None => true,
                        Some(&(_, prev_score)) => score < prev_score,
                    };
                    if replace {
                        map.insert(target_hash, (award_hash, score));
                    }
                }
            }
            // Low-priority fallback for direct hash match.
            map.entry(award_hash)
                .or_insert((award_hash, (1, 1, 1, 1, u16::MAX)));
        }
    }

    let out: std::collections::HashMap<u32, (u32, bool)> = map
        .into_iter()
        .map(|(k, (award, sc))| {
            let free_uncond = sc.0 == 0 && sc.1 == 0 && sc.2 == 0 && sc.3 == 0;
            (k, (award, free_uncond))
        })
        .collect();
    (award_db_count, cat_to_item.len(), out)
}

/// 100% safe, read-only, page-cached walk of `g_ItemInfoTable` & `g_WeaponInfoTable`
/// cross-referenced against `CInventoryItemCatalog` (`inv_catalog_db`) + `CInventoryAwardDatabase` (`inv_item_db`)
/// and dynamically named via the title's live `.gxt2` localization table (`theText::GetByHash`)!
pub fn scan_live_weapon_catalog(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) -> Vec<WeaponCatalogEntry> {
    if base == 0 || !rvas.loaded || rvas.item_info_base == 0 {
        return Vec::new();
    }
    let (_award_cnt, _cat_cnt, award_map) = scan_inv_award_map(base, rvas);
    let mut reader = FastSafeReader::new();

    // Build direct catalog lookup (`cat_entry + 0x00`, `(cat_entry + 0x18 & 1) == 0`, matching `CLoadOutWeapon::AddToTx`!)
    // plus `hash32 -> cat_entry_ptr` so we can extract real UI weapon display names from `CInventoryItemCatalog`!
    let mut cat_direct_ok = std::collections::HashSet::<u32>::new();
    let mut hash_to_cat_ptr = std::collections::HashMap::<u32, u64>::new();
    if rvas.inv_catalog_db != 0
        && let Some(cat_db) = reader.read::<u64>((base + rvas.inv_catalog_db) as usize)
        && cat_db > 0x10000
        && let (Some(cat_arr), Some(cat_cnt)) = (
            reader.read::<u64>((cat_db + 0x58) as usize),
            reader.read::<u16>((cat_db + 0x60) as usize),
        )
        && cat_arr > 0x10000
        && cat_cnt > 0
    {
        for i in 0..u64::from(cat_cnt) {
            let entry = cat_arr + i * 0x68;
            let Some(cat_hash) = reader.read::<u32>(entry as usize) else {
                break;
            };
            let item_hash = reader.read::<u32>((entry + 0x10) as usize).unwrap_or(0);
            let flags18 = reader.read::<u8>((entry + 0x18) as usize).unwrap_or(1);
            if cat_hash != 0 {
                if (flags18 & 1) == 0 {
                    cat_direct_ok.insert(cat_hash);
                }
                hash_to_cat_ptr.entry(cat_hash).or_insert(entry);
            }
            if item_hash != 0 {
                hash_to_cat_ptr.entry(item_hash).or_insert(entry);
            }
        }
    }

    let Some(rel_base) = reader.read::<u64>((base + rvas.item_info_base) as usize) else {
        return Vec::new();
    };
    if rel_base < 0x10000 {
        return Vec::new();
    }

    struct RawWep {
        item_info: u64,
        wep_ptr: u64,
        cat_ptr: u64,
        hash32: u32,
        award_hash32: u32,
        ammo_hash32: u32,
        ammo_award_hash32: u32,
        ammo_types: u16,
        is_firearm: bool,
        in_inv_db: bool,
        free_award: bool,
        cat_direct_ok: bool,
    }

    let mut seen = std::collections::HashSet::<u32>::with_capacity(256);
    let mut raw_weps = Vec::<RawWep>::with_capacity(160);

    // Walk `weapon_info_table` FIRST (checked directly by `CLoadOutWeapon::AddToTx`!), then `item_info_table`.
    for table_rva in [rvas.weapon_info_table, rvas.item_info_table] {
        if table_rva == 0 {
            continue;
        }
        let Some(tbl_ptr) = reader.read::<u64>((base + table_rva) as usize) else {
            continue;
        };
        if tbl_ptr < 0x10000 {
            continue;
        }
        let Some(count) = reader.read::<u32>((tbl_ptr + 0x14) as usize) else {
            continue;
        };
        let Some(offsets_ptr) = reader.read::<u64>((tbl_ptr + 0x18) as usize) else {
            continue;
        };
        if count == 0 || count > 32_768 || offsets_ptr < 0x10000 {
            continue;
        }

        for i in 0..count as u64 {
            let Some(off) = reader.read::<u32>((offsets_ptr + i * 4) as usize) else {
                break;
            };
            if off == 0 {
                continue;
            }
            let item_info = rel_base.wrapping_add(u64::from(off));
            if item_info < 0x10000 {
                continue;
            }
            let Some(hash32) = reader.read::<u32>((item_info + rvas.item_info_hash) as usize)
            else {
                continue;
            };
            if hash32 == 0 || !seen.insert(hash32) {
                continue;
            }
            let wep_ptr = reader
                .read::<u64>((item_info + rvas.item_info_wep_ptr) as usize)
                .unwrap_or(0);
            if wep_ptr < 0x10000 {
                continue;
            }
            let ammo_types = reader.read::<u16>((wep_ptr + 0x118) as usize).unwrap_or(0);
            let mut ammo_hash32 = 0u32;
            let mut is_firearm = false;
            if (1..=32).contains(&ammo_types)
                && let Some(arr_ptr) = reader.read::<u64>((wep_ptr + 0x110) as usize)
                && arr_ptr > 0x10000
                && let Some(slot0) = reader.read::<u64>(arr_ptr as usize)
                && slot0 > 0x10000
                && let Some(ammo_info) = reader.read::<u64>((slot0 + 0x30) as usize)
                && ammo_info > 0x10000
                && let Some(ah) = reader.read::<u32>((ammo_info + 0x20) as usize)
                && ah != 0
            {
                ammo_hash32 = ah;
                is_firearm = true;
            }
            if !is_firearm {
                let sub = reader.read::<u64>((wep_ptr + 0x10) as usize).unwrap_or(0);
                if sub < 0x10000 {
                    continue;
                }
                let dmg_type = reader.read::<u32>((sub + 0x28) as usize).unwrap_or(0);
                if dmg_type == 0 || dmg_type > 24 {
                    continue;
                }
            }
            let (award_hash32, free_award) = award_map.get(&hash32).copied().unwrap_or((0, false));
            let ammo_award_hash32 = if ammo_hash32 != 0 {
                award_map.get(&ammo_hash32).map(|&(a, _)| a).unwrap_or(0)
            } else {
                0
            };
            let direct_ok = cat_direct_ok.contains(&hash32);
            let in_inv_db = direct_ok || award_hash32 != 0;
            let cat_ptr = hash_to_cat_ptr.get(&hash32).copied().unwrap_or(0);
            raw_weps.push(RawWep {
                item_info,
                wep_ptr,
                cat_ptr,
                hash32,
                award_hash32,
                ammo_hash32,
                ammo_award_hash32,
                ammo_types,
                is_firearm,
                in_inv_db,
                free_award,
                cat_direct_ok: direct_ok,
            });
            if raw_weps.len() >= 256 {
                break;
            }
        }
        if raw_weps.len() >= 256 {
            break;
        }
    }

    // Dynamically resolve real weapon display names via live `theText::GetByHash`!
    let mut text_map = std::collections::HashMap::<u32, String>::new();
    let mut cat_offs: Vec<(usize, usize, usize)> = Vec::new();
    let mut item_offs: Vec<(usize, usize, usize)> = Vec::new();
    let mut wep_offs: Vec<(usize, usize, usize)> = Vec::new();
    if rvas.fn_get_text_by_hash != 0 && super::hook::is_installed() && !raw_weps.is_empty() {
        let cat_ptrs: Vec<u64> = raw_weps
            .iter()
            .filter(|w| w.cat_ptr > 0x10000)
            .take(16)
            .map(|w| w.cat_ptr)
            .collect();
        let item_ptrs: Vec<u64> = raw_weps.iter().take(16).map(|w| w.item_info).collect();
        let wep_ptrs: Vec<u64> = raw_weps.iter().take(16).map(|w| w.wep_ptr).collect();
        cat_offs = calibrate_struct_text_offsets(&mut reader, &cat_ptrs, 0x68);
        item_offs = calibrate_struct_text_offsets(&mut reader, &item_ptrs, 0xa0);
        wep_offs = calibrate_struct_text_offsets(&mut reader, &wep_ptrs, 0xa0);

        let mut batch_hashes: Vec<u32> = Vec::with_capacity(raw_weps.len() * 6);
        for w in &raw_weps {
            if is_plausible_text_hash(w.hash32) {
                batch_hashes.push(w.hash32);
            }
            if w.cat_ptr > 0x10000 {
                for &(off, _, _) in &cat_offs {
                    if let Some(h) = reader.read::<u32>((w.cat_ptr + off as u64) as usize)
                        && is_plausible_text_hash(h)
                    {
                        batch_hashes.push(h);
                    }
                }
            }
            for &(off, _, _) in &item_offs {
                if let Some(h) = reader.read::<u32>((w.item_info + off as u64) as usize)
                    && is_plausible_text_hash(h)
                {
                    batch_hashes.push(h);
                }
            }
            for &(off, _, _) in &wep_offs {
                if let Some(h) = reader.read::<u32>((w.wep_ptr + off as u64) as usize)
                    && is_plausible_text_hash(h)
                {
                    batch_hashes.push(h);
                }
            }
        }
        text_map = super::hook::resolve_text_hashes_blocking(&batch_hashes);
    }

    let mut named_count = 0usize;
    let mut out = Vec::<WeaponCatalogEntry>::with_capacity(raw_weps.len());
    for w in raw_weps {
        let mut live_name: Option<String> = None;
        if w.cat_ptr > 0x10000 {
            for &(off, _, _) in &cat_offs {
                if let Some(h) = reader.read::<u32>((w.cat_ptr + off as u64) as usize)
                    && let Some(s) = text_map.get(&h)
                {
                    live_name = Some(s.clone());
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        if live_name.is_none() {
            for &(off, _, _) in &item_offs {
                if let Some(h) = reader.read::<u32>((w.item_info + off as u64) as usize)
                    && let Some(s) = text_map.get(&h)
                {
                    live_name = Some(s.clone());
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        if live_name.is_none() {
            for &(off, _, _) in &wep_offs {
                if let Some(h) = reader.read::<u32>((w.wep_ptr + off as u64) as usize)
                    && let Some(s) = text_map.get(&h)
                {
                    live_name = Some(s.clone());
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        if live_name.is_none() {
            live_name = text_map.get(&w.hash32).cloned();
        }

        let name = if let Some(real) = live_name {
            named_count += 1;
            real
        } else if let Some(inline) = try_read_inline_weapon_name(&mut reader, w.item_info)
            .or_else(|| try_read_inline_weapon_name(&mut reader, w.wep_ptr))
        {
            named_count += 1;
            inline
        } else {
            let kind = match (w.cat_direct_ok, w.free_award, w.in_inv_db, w.is_firearm) {
                (true, _, _, true) => "Gun [Wheel]",
                (true, _, _, false) => "Weapon [Wheel]",
                (false, true, _, true) => "Gun [Free]",
                (false, true, _, false) => "Weapon [Free]",
                (false, false, true, true) => "Gun [Inv]",
                (false, false, true, false) => "Weapon [Inv]",
                (false, false, false, true) => "Firearm",
                (false, false, false, false) => "Weapon",
            };
            format!("{kind} #{:02} [0x{:08X}]", out.len() + 1, w.hash32)
        };
        let category = classify_weapon_category(&name, w.is_firearm).to_owned();
        out.push(WeaponCatalogEntry {
            name,
            category,
            hash32: w.hash32,
            award_hash32: w.award_hash32,
            ammo_hash32: w.ammo_hash32,
            ammo_award_hash32: w.ammo_award_hash32,
            ammo_types: w.ammo_types,
            is_firearm: w.is_firearm,
            in_inv_db: w.in_inv_db,
            free_award: w.free_award,
            cat_direct_ok: w.cat_direct_ok,
        });
    }

    let fmt_offs = |v: &[(usize, usize, usize)]| -> String {
        v.iter()
            .map(|&(o, h, u)| format!("+0x{o:x}({h}h/{u}u)"))
            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
            .join(",")
    };
    append_name_scan_diag(&format!(
        "wep_named={named_count}/{} cat_offs=[{}] item_offs=[{}] wep_offs=[{}]",
        out.len(),
        fmt_offs(&cat_offs),
        fmt_offs(&item_offs),
        fmt_offs(&wep_offs)
    ));

    // Prioritize directly grantable `CInventoryItemCatalog` firearms FIRST!
    out.sort_by(|a, b| {
        b.cat_direct_ok
            .cmp(&a.cat_direct_ok)
            .then_with(|| b.is_firearm.cmp(&a.is_firearm))
            .then_with(|| b.free_award.cmp(&a.free_award))
            .then_with(|| b.in_inv_db.cmp(&a.in_inv_db))
            .then_with(|| a.name.cmp(&b.name))
    });
    out
}

/// Safely scans `CInventoryItemCatalog` (`inv_catalog_db`, text hash at `+0x10`/`+0x00`) and
/// `g_ItemInfoTable` (`+0x20`) for grantable weapon attachments, optics, suppressors, magazines,
/// grips, barrels & finishes with live localized `.gxt2` names.
pub fn scan_live_weapon_attachments(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) -> Vec<WeaponAttachmentEntry> {
    if base == 0 || !rvas.loaded || rvas.fn_get_text_by_hash == 0 || !super::hook::is_installed() {
        return Vec::new();
    }
    let mut reader = FastSafeReader::new();

    // Collect full weapon hashes from `weapon_info_table` so we don't list base guns as attachments.
    let mut base_weapon_hashes = std::collections::HashSet::<u32>::new();
    if rvas.weapon_info_table != 0
        && rvas.item_info_base != 0
        && let Some(rel_base) = reader.read::<u64>((base + rvas.item_info_base) as usize)
        && rel_base > 0x10000
        && let Some(tbl_ptr) = reader.read::<u64>((base + rvas.weapon_info_table) as usize)
        && tbl_ptr > 0x10000
        && let (Some(cnt), Some(offs_ptr)) = (
            reader.read::<u32>((tbl_ptr + 0x14) as usize),
            reader.read::<u64>((tbl_ptr + 0x18) as usize),
        )
        && offs_ptr > 0x10000
    {
        for i in 0..cnt.min(4096) as u64 {
            if let Some(off) = reader.read::<u32>((offs_ptr + i * 4) as usize)
                && off != 0
                && let Some(h) = reader.read::<u32>((rel_base.wrapping_add(u64::from(off)) + rvas.item_info_hash) as usize)
                && h != 0
            {
                base_weapon_hashes.insert(h);
            }
        }
    }

    // 1. Walk `CInventoryItemCatalog` (`[inv_catalog_db]`: array at `+0x58`, count u16 at `+0x60`, stride `0x68`):
    //    verified layout: `+0x00 = cat_hash`, `+0x10 = item_info_hash` (also primary `.gxt2` text hash!), `+0x18 = flags`.
    let mut raw: Vec<(u32, u32)> = Vec::new();
    let mut text_hashes: Vec<u32> = Vec::new();
    let mut seen_cand = std::collections::HashSet::<u32>::new();
    if rvas.inv_catalog_db != 0
        && let Some(cat_db) = reader.read::<u64>((base + rvas.inv_catalog_db) as usize)
        && cat_db > 0x10000
        && let (Some(cat_arr), Some(cat_cnt)) = (
            reader.read::<u64>((cat_db + 0x58) as usize),
            reader.read::<u16>((cat_db + 0x60) as usize),
        )
        && cat_arr > 0x10000
        && cat_cnt > 0
    {
        let cap = usize::from(cat_cnt).min(12_000);
        for i in 0..cap {
            let entry = cat_arr + (i as u64) * 0x68;
            let (Some(cat_h), Some(item_h)) = (
                reader.read::<u32>(entry as usize),
                reader.read::<u32>((entry + 0x10) as usize),
            ) else {
                break;
            };
            let flags = reader.read::<u8>((entry + 0x18) as usize).unwrap_or(1);
            if cat_h == 0 || (flags & 1) != 0 || base_weapon_hashes.contains(&cat_h) || base_weapon_hashes.contains(&item_h) {
                continue;
            }
            if seen_cand.insert(cat_h) {
                raw.push((cat_h, item_h));
                if is_plausible_text_hash(cat_h) {
                    text_hashes.push(cat_h);
                }
                if item_h != 0 && item_h != cat_h && is_plausible_text_hash(item_h) {
                    text_hashes.push(item_h);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // 2. Also walk `g_ItemInfoTable` (`item_info + 0x20`) for any weapon components not yet in `raw`.
    if rvas.item_info_table != 0
        && rvas.item_info_base != 0
        && let Some(rel_base) = reader.read::<u64>((base + rvas.item_info_base) as usize)
        && rel_base > 0x10000
        && let Some(tbl_ptr) = reader.read::<u64>((base + rvas.item_info_table) as usize)
        && tbl_ptr > 0x10000
        && let (Some(cnt), Some(offs_ptr)) = (
            reader.read::<u32>((tbl_ptr + 0x14) as usize),
            reader.read::<u64>((tbl_ptr + 0x18) as usize),
        )
        && offs_ptr > 0x10000
    {
        for i in 0..cnt.min(12_000) as u64 {
            let Some(off) = reader.read::<u32>((offs_ptr + i * 4) as usize) else {
                break;
            };
            if off == 0 {
                continue;
            }
            let item_info = rel_base.wrapping_add(u64::from(off));
            let Some(h) = reader.read::<u32>((item_info + rvas.item_info_hash) as usize) else {
                continue;
            };
            if h == 0 || base_weapon_hashes.contains(&h) || !seen_cand.insert(h) {
                continue;
            }
            raw.push((h, h));
            if is_plausible_text_hash(h) {
                text_hashes.push(h);
            }
        }
    }

    if raw.is_empty() || text_hashes.is_empty() {
        return Vec::new();
    }
    let text_map = super::hook::resolve_text_hashes_blocking(&text_hashes);
    let mut seen = std::collections::HashSet::<u32>::new();
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    for (cat_h, item_h) in raw {
        let Some(name) = text_map.get(&item_h).or_else(|| text_map.get(&cat_h)) else {
            continue;
        };
        let lo = name.to_ascii_lowercase();
        // Exclude wildlife, collectibles, clothing & jewelry so ONLY real weapon attachments/ammo/mods appear!
        if lo.contains("goldfinch")
            || lo.contains("pristine")
            || lo.contains("ruined")
            || lo.contains("(good)")
            || lo.contains("(poor)")
            || lo.contains("card")
            || lo.contains("balls")
            || lo.contains("fish")
            || lo.contains("bird")
            || lo.contains("pelt")
            || lo.contains("feather")
            || lo.contains("meat")
            || lo.contains("watch")
            || lo.contains("ring")
            || lo.contains("necklace")
            || lo.contains("bracelet")
            || lo.contains("earring")
            || lo.contains("pendant")
            || lo.contains("shirt")
            || lo.contains("pants")
            || lo.contains("jacket")
            || lo.contains("shorts")
            || lo.contains("shoe")
            || lo.contains("boot")
            || lo.contains("hat")
            || lo.contains("glasses")
            || lo.contains("bikini")
            || lo.contains("dress")
            || lo.contains("hoodie")
            || lo.contains("bottle")
            || lo.contains("cigar")
            || lo.contains("trailer")
            || lo.contains("stockade")
            || lo.contains("truck")
            || lo.contains("boat")
            || lo.contains("van")
            || lo.contains("sedan")
            || lo.contains("coupe")
            || lo.contains("clipboard")
            || lo.contains(" - gold")
            || lo.contains(" - silver")
        {
            continue;
        }
        let slot_kind = if lo.contains("suppressor") || lo.contains("silencer") || lo.contains("muzzle") || lo.contains("compensator") || lo.contains("flash hider") || lo.contains("choke") {
            "Suppressor / Muzzle"
        } else if lo.contains("scope") || lo.contains("optic") || lo.contains("holo") || lo.contains("reflex") || lo.contains("red dot") || lo.contains("iron sight") || lo.contains("sight") {
            "Scope / Optic"
        } else if lo.contains("extended") || lo.contains("drum") || lo.contains("magazine") || lo.contains("ammo clip") || lo.contains("weapon clip") || lo.contains("speedloader") {
            "Magazine / Clip"
        } else if lo.contains("foregrip") || lo.contains("vertical grip") || lo.contains("angled grip") || lo.contains("bipod") || lo.contains("heavy barrel") || lo.contains("rifled barrel") || lo.contains("barrel") || lo.contains("picatinny") || lo.contains("sling") {
            "Grip / Barrel"
        } else if lo.contains("flashlight") || lo.contains("laser") || lo.contains("tactical light") || lo.contains("weapon light") {
            "Flashlight / Laser"
        } else if lo.contains("tint") || lo.contains("finish") || lo.contains("camo") || lo.contains("engraving") {
            "Finish / Tint"
        } else if lo.contains("ammo") || lo.contains("rounds") || lo.contains("shells") || lo.contains("slug") || lo.contains("buckshot") || lo.contains("hollow point") || lo.contains("armor piercing") || lo.contains("incendiary") || lo.contains("tracer") {
            "Special Ammo / Mod"
        } else {
            continue;
        };
        let grant_h = if cat_h != 0 { cat_h } else { item_h };
        if seen.insert(grant_h) {
            out.push(WeaponAttachmentEntry {
                name: name.clone(),
                slot_kind: slot_kind.to_owned(),
                item_hash32: grant_h,
                cat_hash32: item_h,
            });
            if out.len() >= 120 {
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    out.sort_by(|a, b| a.slot_kind.cmp(&b.slot_kind).then_with(|| a.name.cmp(&b.name)));
    out
}

/// 100% safe, read-only walk of `g_LoadoutTable` (`loadout_table_ptr` / `loadout_table_count`)
/// to discover built-in weapon loadouts (stride 24 bytes: `+0x00 hash32`, `+0x08 items_ptr`, `+0x10 u16 count`).
pub fn scan_live_loadout_catalog(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) -> Vec<LoadoutCatalogEntry> {
    if base == 0 || !rvas.loaded || rvas.loadout_table_ptr == 0 || rvas.loadout_table_count == 0 {
        return Vec::new();
    }
    let mut reader = FastSafeReader::new();
    let Some(arr_ptr) = reader.read::<u64>((base + rvas.loadout_table_ptr) as usize) else {
        return Vec::new();
    };
    let Some(cnt) = reader.read::<u16>((base + rvas.loadout_table_count) as usize) else {
        return Vec::new();
    };
    if arr_ptr < 0x10000 || cnt == 0 {
        return Vec::new();
    }
    let mut raw: Vec<(u32, u16, Vec<u32>)> = Vec::with_capacity(usize::from(cnt.min(512)));
    for i in 0..u64::from(cnt.min(512)) {
        let entry = arr_ptr + i * 24;
        let Some(hash32) = reader.read::<u32>(entry as usize) else {
            break;
        };
        let Some(items_ptr) = reader.read::<u64>((entry + 8) as usize) else {
            break;
        };
        let Some(item_count) = reader.read::<u16>((entry + 16) as usize) else {
            break;
        };
        if hash32 != 0 && items_ptr > 0x10000 && item_count > 0 && item_count <= 64 {
            let mut wep_cands = Vec::new();
            for j in 0..u64::from(item_count.min(12)) {
                let Some(item_p) = reader.read::<u64>((items_ptr + j * 8) as usize) else {
                    break;
                };
                if item_p < 0x10000 {
                    continue;
                }
                for off in [0x18u64, 0x1c, 0x20] {
                    if let Some(h) = reader.read::<u32>((item_p + off) as usize)
                        && is_plausible_text_hash(h)
                        && !wep_cands.contains(&h)
                    {
                        wep_cands.push(h);
                        if wep_cands.len() >= 6 {
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
                if wep_cands.len() >= 6 {
                    break;
                }
            }
            raw.push((hash32, item_count, wep_cands));
        }
    }
    let mut text_map = std::collections::HashMap::<u32, String>::new();
    if rvas.fn_get_text_by_hash != 0 && super::hook::is_installed() && !raw.is_empty() {
        let mut hashes = Vec::with_capacity(raw.len() * 4);
        for (lh, _, cands) in &raw {
            if is_plausible_text_hash(*lh) {
                hashes.push(*lh);
            }
            for &ch in cands {
                hashes.push(ch);
            }
        }
        text_map = super::hook::resolve_text_hashes_blocking(&hashes);
    }
    let mut named_cnt = 0usize;
    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(raw.len());
    for (hash32, item_count, cands) in raw {
        let name = if let Some(s) = text_map.get(&hash32) {
            named_cnt += 1;
            format!("{s} ({item_count} items)")
        } else {
            let mut hit_names: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
            for ch in cands {
                if let Some(w) = text_map.get(&ch)
                    && !hit_names.iter().any(|p| p.eq_ignore_ascii_case(w))
                {
                    hit_names.push(w.clone());
                    if hit_names.len() >= 2 {
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            if hit_names.len() == 2 {
                named_cnt += 1;
                format!("{} + {} ({item_count} items)", hit_names[0], hit_names[1])
            } else if let Some(w) = hit_names.into_iter().next() {
                named_cnt += 1;
                format!("{w} Loadout ({item_count} items)")
            } else {
                format!("Loadout [0x{hash32:08X}] ({item_count} items)")
            }
        };
        out.push(LoadoutCatalogEntry {
            name,
            hash32,
            item_count,
        });
    }
    append_name_scan_diag(&format!("loadout_named={named_cnt}/{}", out.len()));
    out.sort_by(|a, b| b.item_count.cmp(&a.item_count));
    out
}

/// Safely walks `g_ObjectPool` (read-only) to find the closest live `CObject*` to `target`
/// within `max_dist` metres. Used for Spooner prop grabbing & spawn pointer verification.
pub fn find_nearest_object_in_pool(
    base: u64,
    rvas: &RvaTable,
    target: [f32; 3],
    max_dist: f32,
    exclude: &[u64],
) -> Option<u64> {
    if base == 0 || !rvas.loaded || rvas.object_pool == 0 {
        return None;
    }
    let mut reader = FastSafeReader::new();
    let pool = reader.read::<u64>((base + rvas.object_pool) as usize)?;
    if pool < 0x10000 {
        return None;
    }
    let storage = reader.read::<u64>((pool + rvas.pool_storage) as usize)?;
    let elem_size = reader.read::<u32>((pool + rvas.pool_elem_size) as usize)?;
    let max_count = reader.read::<u32>((pool + rvas.pool_max_count) as usize)?;
    let flags_ptr = reader.read::<u64>((pool + rvas.pool_flags) as usize)?;
    let valid_mask = reader.read::<u32>((pool + 0x30) as usize).unwrap_or(0);
    if storage < 0x10000
        || flags_ptr < 0x10000
        || !(64..=8192).contains(&elem_size)
        || max_count == 0
        || max_count > 32_768
    {
        return None;
    }

    let mut best: Option<(f32, u64)> = None;
    let max_d2 = max_dist * max_dist;
    for i in 0..max_count as u64 {
        let Some(fl) = reader.read::<u32>((flags_ptr + i * 4) as usize) else {
            break;
        };
        // Verified Engine 9 `fwBasePool` slot validity (`andn r10d, fl, [pool+0x30]; jne invalid`):
        // a live slot has every bit of `valid_mask` set!
        if valid_mask != 0 {
            if (fl & valid_mask) != valid_mask {
                continue;
            }
        } else if fl == 0 {
            continue;
        }
        let ent = storage + i * u64::from(elem_size);
        if exclude.contains(&ent) {
            continue;
        }
        let Some(vtable) = reader.read::<u64>(ent as usize) else {
            continue;
        };
        if vtable < 0x10000 {
            continue;
        }
        let Some(raw_pos) = reader.read::<[u32; 4]>((ent + rvas.ped_pos_packed) as usize) else {
            continue;
        };
        let pos = unpack_sector_pos(raw_pos);
        if !pos.iter().all(|v| v.is_finite() && v.abs() < 80_000.0) {
            continue;
        }
        let dx = pos[0] - target[0];
        let dy = pos[1] - target[1];
        let dz = pos[2] - target[2];
        let d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz;
        if d2 <= max_d2 && best.is_none_or(|(bd2, _)| d2 < bd2) {
            best = Some((d2, ent));
        }
    }
    best.map(|(_, ptr)| ptr)
}

/// Safely walks `g_NetPlayerPool` (read-only) to locate the active local `CNetGamePlayer*`
/// entry (`[entry + 0x2b58] == 1`) in Story Mode even when its player index isn't 0.
pub fn find_local_net_player_in_pool(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) -> Option<u64> {
    if base == 0 || !rvas.loaded || rvas.net_player_pool == 0 {
        return None;
    }
    let mut reader = FastSafeReader::new();
    let pool = reader.read::<u64>((base + rvas.net_player_pool) as usize)?;
    if pool < 0x10000 {
        return None;
    }
    let storage = reader.read::<u64>((pool + rvas.pool_storage) as usize)?;
    let elem_size = reader.read::<u32>((pool + rvas.pool_elem_size) as usize)?;
    let max_count = reader.read::<u32>((pool + rvas.pool_max_count) as usize)?;
    let flags_ptr = reader.read::<u64>((pool + rvas.pool_flags) as usize)?;
    let valid_mask = reader.read::<u32>((pool + 0x30) as usize).unwrap_or(0);
    if storage < 0x10000
        || flags_ptr < 0x10000
        || !(0x3000..=0x40000).contains(&elem_size)
        || max_count == 0
        || max_count > 1024
    {
        return None;
    }
    let mut fallback = None;
    for i in 0..max_count as u64 {
        let Some(fl) = reader.read::<u32>((flags_ptr + i * 4) as usize) else {
            break;
        };
        if valid_mask != 0 {
            if (fl & valid_mask) != valid_mask {
                continue;
            }
        } else if fl == 0 {
            continue;
        }
        let ent = storage + i * u64::from(elem_size);
        let Some(vtable) = reader.read::<u64>(ent as usize) else {
            continue;
        };
        if vtable < 0x10000 {
            continue;
        }
        if fallback.is_none() {
            fallback = Some(ent);
        }
        if reader.read::<u32>((ent + 0x2b58) as usize) == Some(1) {
            return Some(ent);
        }
    }
    fallback
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Built-in Live Memory Scanner (bounded, safe, zero stall)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum ScanType {
    Float32,
    Int32,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum ScanFilter {
    Equal,
    Changed,
    Unchanged,
    Increased,
    Decreased,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub struct ScanHit {
    pub addr: usize,
    pub prev_bits: u32,
}

pub struct MemScanner {
    pub scan_type: ScanType,
    pub target_float: f32,
    pub target_int: i32,
    pub hits: Vec<ScanHit>,
    pub last_status: String,
}

impl Default for MemScanner {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            scan_type: ScanType::Float32,
            target_float: 100.0,
            target_int: 100,
            hits: Vec::new(),
            last_status: "Ready (scan .data/BSS around title image)".into(),
        }
    }
}

impl MemScanner {
    const MAX_HITS: usize = 256;
    /// Scans writable committed `.data`/`.bss` pages inside `[base + 0x500_0000 .. base + 0xB80_0000]`
    /// (bounded to <= 48 MB total read so it completes in <25 ms).
    pub fn first_scan(&mut self, base: u64) {
        self.hits.clear();
        if base == 0 {
            self.last_status = "Preview mode: launch title to scan live RAM".into();
            return;
        }
        let start = (base as usize).saturating_add(0x0670_0000);
        let limit = (base as usize).saturating_add(0x0B00_0000);
        let mut cur = start;
        let mut scanned_bytes = 0usize;
        const MAX_SCAN_BYTES: usize = 48 * 1024 * 1024;

        while cur < limit && scanned_bytes < MAX_SCAN_BYTES && self.hits.len() < Self::MAX_HITS {
            let mut mbi = MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION::default();
            // SAFETY: VM region query only.
            let n = unsafe {
                VirtualQuery(
                    cur as *const _,
                    &mut mbi,
                    size_of::<MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION>(),
                )
            };
            if n == 0 || mbi.RegionSize == 0 {
                break;
            }
            let reg_end = (mbi.BaseAddress as usize)
                .saturating_add(mbi.RegionSize)
                .min(limit);
            let writable = mbi.State == MEM_COMMIT
                && (mbi.Protect & (PAGE_NOACCESS | PAGE_GUARD) == 0)
                && (mbi.Protect & (PAGE_READWRITE | PAGE_WRITECOPY | PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE) != 0);
            if writable && reg_end > cur {
                let len = (reg_end - cur).min(MAX_SCAN_BYTES - scanned_bytes);
                let words = len / 4;
                // SAFETY: verified committed + readable/writable for `words * 4` bytes.
                let slice = unsafe { std::slice::from_raw_parts(cur as *const u32, words) };
                for (i, &bits) in slice.iter().enumerate() {
                    let matched = match self.scan_type {
                        ScanType::Float32 => {
                            let v = f32::from_bits(bits);
                            v.is_finite() && (v - self.target_float).abs() < 0.05
                        }
                        ScanType::Int32 => (bits as i32) == self.target_int,
                    };
                    if matched {
                        self.hits.push(ScanHit {
                            addr: cur + i * 4,
                            prev_bits: bits,
                        });
                        if self.hits.len() >= Self::MAX_HITS {
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
                scanned_bytes += len;
            }
            if reg_end <= cur {
                break;
            }
            cur = reg_end;
        }
        self.last_status = format!(
            "First scan: {} hits ({:.1} MB scanned)",
            self.hits.len(),
            scanned_bytes as f64 / (1024.0 * 1024.0)
        );
    }

    pub fn refine(&mut self, filter: ScanFilter) {
        if self.hits.is_empty() {
            self.last_status = "No hits to refine (run First Scan first)".into();
            return;
        }
        let ty = self.scan_type;
        let tf = self.target_float;
        let ti = self.target_int;
        self.hits.retain_mut(|h| {
            let Some(cur_bits) = safe_read::<u32>(h.addr) else {
                return false;
            };
            let keep = match (ty, filter) {
                (ScanType::Float32, ScanFilter::Equal) => {
                    let v = f32::from_bits(cur_bits);
                    v.is_finite() && (v - tf).abs() < 0.05
                }
                (ScanType::Int32, ScanFilter::Equal) => (cur_bits as i32) == ti,
                (_, ScanFilter::Changed) => cur_bits != h.prev_bits,
                (_, ScanFilter::Unchanged) => cur_bits == h.prev_bits,
                (ScanType::Float32, ScanFilter::Increased) => {
                    f32::from_bits(cur_bits) > f32::from_bits(h.prev_bits)
                }
                (ScanType::Float32, ScanFilter::Decreased) => {
                    f32::from_bits(cur_bits) < f32::from_bits(h.prev_bits)
                }
                (ScanType::Int32, ScanFilter::Increased) => {
                    (cur_bits as i32) > (h.prev_bits as i32)
                }
                (ScanType::Int32, ScanFilter::Decreased) => {
                    (cur_bits as i32) < (h.prev_bits as i32)
                }
            };
            h.prev_bits = cur_bits;
            keep
        });
        self.last_status = format!("Refined ({filter:?}): {} hits remaining", self.hits.len());
    }

    pub fn format_hit_value(&self, hit: ScanHit) -> String {
        let bits = safe_read::<u32>(hit.addr).unwrap_or(hit.prev_bits);
        match self.scan_type {
            ScanType::Float32 => format!("{:.2}", f32::from_bits(bits)),
            ScanType::Int32 => format!("{}", bits as i32),
        }
    }

    pub fn write_hit_target(&self, idx: usize) -> bool {
        let Some(hit) = self.hits.get(idx) else {
            return false;
        };
        let bits = match self.scan_type {
            ScanType::Float32 => self.target_float.to_bits(),
            ScanType::Int32 => self.target_int as u32,
        };
        safe_write::<u32>(hit.addr, bits)
    }
}

// Schema v6 Live Catalogs, Universal Pool Queries & Save/Load Persistence

/// Safely writes the global world gravity scale (`1.0` = normal, `0.25` = Moon Gravity).
pub fn direct_set_world_gravity(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, scale: f32) -> Result<(), &'static str> {
    if base == 0 {
        return Err("Offline preview mode");
    }
    if !rvas.loaded || rvas.world_gravity_scale == 0 {
        return Err("world_gravity_scale RVA missing in rvas.json");
    }
    let v = scale.clamp(0.02, 3.0);
    if safe_write::<f32>((base + rvas.world_gravity_scale) as usize, v) {
        Ok(())
    } else {
        Err("World gravity global not writable")
    }
}

/// Lowercase Jenkins one-at-a-time 32-bit hash for matching generic English weather labels.
fn joaat32_lower(s: &str) -> u32 {
    let mut h = 0u32;
    for b in s.bytes() {
        let c = if b.is_ascii_uppercase() { b + 32 } else { b };
        h = h.wrapping_add(u32::from(c));
        h = h.wrapping_add(h.wrapping_shl(10));
        h ^= h.wrapping_shr(6);
    }
    h = h.wrapping_add(h.wrapping_shl(3));
    h ^= h.wrapping_shr(11);
    h = h.wrapping_add(h.wrapping_shl(15));
    h
}

/// Safely walks `g_Weather` (`+0x00 u32 count`, `+weather_types_ptr_off u64 array`, stride `0x38`,
