        ("WARM", "Warm"),
        ("HOT", "Hot"),
        ("MILD", "Mild"),
        ("COOL", "Cool"),
        ("COLD", "Cold"),
        ("TROPICAL", "Tropical"),
        ("COASTAL", "Coastal"),
        ("OCEAN", "Ocean"),
        ("BEACH", "Beach"),
        ("SWAMP", "Swamp"),
        ("MARSH", "Marsh"),
        ("BAYOU", "Bayou"),
        ("CITY", "City"),
        ("URBAN", "Urban"),
        ("MORNING", "Morning"),
        ("AFTERNOON", "Afternoon"),
        ("EVENING", "Evening"),
        ("NIGHT", "Night"),
        ("MIDNIGHT", "Midnight"),
        ("TWILIGHT", "Twilight"),
        ("GOLDEN", "Golden Hour"),
        ("GOLDENHOUR", "Golden Hour"),
        ("SUNSHINE", "Sunshine"),
        ("DOWNPOUR", "Downpour"),
        ("DELUGE", "Deluge"),
        ("SPRINKLE", "Sprinkle"),
        ("GALE", "Gale"),
        ("CYCLONE", "Cyclone"),
        ("TYPHOON", "Typhoon"),
        ("TORNADO", "Tornado"),
        ("WATERSPOUT", "Waterspout"),
        ("SCATTERED", "Scattered Clouds"),
        ("BROKEN", "Broken Clouds"),
        ("CUMULUS", "Cumulus"),
        ("CIRRUS", "Cirrus"),
        ("STRATUS", "Stratus"),
        ("NIMBUS", "Nimbus"),
        ("CLEAR_NIGHT", "Clear Night"),
        ("CLOUDY_NIGHT", "Cloudy Night"),
        ("RAINY_NIGHT", "Rainy Night"),
        ("FOGGY_NIGHT", "Foggy Night"),
        ("STORMY_NIGHT", "Stormy Night"),
        ("HEAT_HAZE", "Heat Haze"),
        ("SMOGGY", "Smoggy"),
        ("DUST", "Dust"),
        ("DUSTSTORM", "Dust Storm"),
        ("INTERIOR", "Interior"),
        ("CUTSCENE", "Cutscene"),
        ("CINEMATIC", "Cinematic"),
        ("TRANSITION", "Transition"),
        ("DEFAULT", "Default"),
        ("DEBUG", "Debug"),
    ];
    let mut vocab_map = std::collections::HashMap::<u32, (&'static str, &'static str)>::with_capacity(
        VOCAB.len(),
    );
    for &(key, label) in VOCAB {
        vocab_map.insert(joaat32_lower(key), (key, label));
    }

    let mut hashes = Vec::with_capacity(count as usize);
    for i in 0..count as u64 {
        let entry = arr_ptr + i * 0x38;
        let h = reader.read::<u32>(entry as usize).unwrap_or(0);
        hashes.push(h);
    }
    let resolved_text = super::hook::resolve_text_hashes_blocking(&hashes);

    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(count as usize);
    for (idx, h) in hashes.into_iter().enumerate() {
        let (name, short_name) = if let Some(&(key, label)) = vocab_map.get(&h) {
            (label.to_owned(), key.to_owned())
        } else if let Some(txt) = resolved_text.get(&h) {
            let clean = title_case_vehicle_name(txt);
            (clean, format!("W{idx}"))
        } else {
            (format!("Weather #{idx}"), format!("W{idx}"))
        };
        out.push(WeatherCatalogEntry {
            id: idx as i32,
            name,
            short_name,
        });
    }
    out
}

/// Safely walks `g_PedPool` + `g_ModelInfoHashTable` (`MI_TYPE_PED == 6`) to discover
/// live Story Mode peds for the Ped / Bodyguard Spawner.
pub fn scan_live_ped_catalog(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable) -> Vec<PedCatalogEntry> {
    if base == 0
        || !rvas.loaded
        || rvas.model_info_bitset == 0
        || rvas.model_info_array == 0
        || rvas.model_info_stride == 0
        || rvas.model_info_buckets == 0
        || rvas.model_info_bucket_count == 0
    {
        return Vec::new();
    }
    let mut reader = FastSafeReader::new();
    let mut seen = std::collections::HashSet::<u64>::with_capacity(512);
    let mut world_peds = Vec::<PedCatalogEntry>::with_capacity(64);
    let mut out = Vec::<PedCatalogEntry>::with_capacity(256);

    // 1. Prioritize already-loaded live world peds from `g_PedPool` (stream-ready & guaranteed valid!).
    if rvas.ped_pool != 0
        && let Some(pool) = reader.read::<u64>((base + rvas.ped_pool) as usize)
        && pool > 0x10000
        && let (Some(storage), Some(elem_size), Some(max_count), Some(flags_ptr)) = (
            reader.read::<u64>((pool + rvas.pool_storage) as usize),
            reader.read::<u32>((pool + rvas.pool_elem_size) as usize),
            reader.read::<u32>((pool + rvas.pool_max_count) as usize),
            reader.read::<u64>((pool + rvas.pool_flags) as usize),
        )
        && storage > 0x10000
        && flags_ptr > 0x10000
        && (64..=16_384).contains(&elem_size)
        && (1..=8192).contains(&max_count)
    {
        let valid_mask = reader.read::<u32>((pool + 0x30) as usize).unwrap_or(0);
        for i in 0..max_count as u64 {
            let Some(fl) = reader.read::<u32>((flags_ptr + i * 4) as usize) else {
                break;
            };
            if valid_mask != 0 {
                if (fl & valid_mask) != valid_mask {
                    continue;
                }
            } else if fl == 0 {
                continue;
            }
            let ped = storage + i * u64::from(elem_size);
            let Some(mi) = reader.read::<u64>((ped + 0x20) as usize) else {
                continue;
            };
            if mi < 0x10000 {
                continue;
            }
            let Some(tb) = reader.read::<u8>((mi + rvas.model_info_type_byte) as usize) else {
                continue;
            };
            if (tb & 7) != 6 {
                continue;
            }
            let Some(hash64) = reader.read::<u64>((mi + 0x60) as usize) else {
                continue;
            };
            if hash64 == 0 || !seen.insert(hash64) {
                continue;
            }
            let name = try_read_inline_vehicle_name(&mut reader, mi)
                .map(|n| format!("{n} [Loaded]"))
                .unwrap_or_else(|| {
                    format!(
                        "World NPC #{:02} [0x{:08X}]",
                        world_peds.len() + 1,
                        (hash64 >> 32) as u32
                    )
                });
            world_peds.push(PedCatalogEntry { name, hash64 });
            if world_peds.len() >= 48 {
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    // 2. Walk `g_ModelInfoHashTable` for additional `MI_TYPE_PED == 6` entries.
    if let (Some(bucket_count), Some(bitset_ptr), Some(array_ptr), Some(stride)) = (
        reader.read::<u32>((base + rvas.model_info_bucket_count) as usize),
        reader.read::<u64>((base + rvas.model_info_bitset) as usize),
        reader.read::<u64>((base + rvas.model_info_array) as usize),
        reader.read::<u32>((base + rvas.model_info_stride) as usize),
    ) && (1..=16_384).contains(&bucket_count)
        && bitset_ptr > 0x10000
        && array_ptr > 0x10000
        && (8..=128).contains(&stride)
    {
        let buckets_base = base + rvas.model_info_buckets;
        let mut visited = 0usize;
        for b in 0..bucket_count as u64 {
            let b_addr = buckets_base + b * 0x58;
            let Some(cnt) = reader.read::<u32>((b_addr + 0x0c) as usize) else {
                continue;
            };
            if cnt == 0 || cnt > 65_536 {
                continue;
            }
            let (Some(hashes_ptr), Some(ids_ptr)) = (
                reader.read::<u64>((b_addr + 0x10) as usize),
                reader.read::<u64>((b_addr + 0x20) as usize),
            ) else {
                continue;
            };
            if hashes_ptr < 0x10000 || ids_ptr < 0x10000 {
                continue;
            }
            for i in 0..cnt as u64 {
                visited += 1;
                if visited > 250_000 || out.len() >= 256 {
                    break;
                }
                let Some(hash64) = reader.read::<u64>((hashes_ptr + i * 8) as usize) else {
                    break;
                };
                if hash64 == 0 || !seen.insert(hash64) {
                    continue;
                }
                let Some(raw_id) = reader.read::<u32>((ids_ptr + i * 4) as usize) else {
                    break;
                };
                let idx = raw_id & 0x3F_FFFF;
                if idx == 0x3F_FFFF {
                    continue;
                }
                let Some(bbyte) = reader.read::<u8>((bitset_ptr + u64::from(idx >> 3)) as usize)
                else {
                    continue;
                };
                if (bbyte & (1u8 << (idx & 7))) == 0 {
                    continue;
                }
                let Some(mi) =
                    reader.read::<u64>((array_ptr + u64::from(idx) * u64::from(stride)) as usize)
                else {
                    continue;
                };
                if mi < 0x10000 {
                    continue;
                }
                let Some(tb) = reader.read::<u8>((mi + rvas.model_info_type_byte) as usize) else {
                    continue;
                };
                if (tb & 7) != 6 {
                    continue;
                }
                let name = try_read_inline_vehicle_name(&mut reader, mi).unwrap_or_else(|| {
                    format!("Ped #{:03} [0x{:08X}]", out.len() + 1, (hash64 >> 32) as u32)
                });
                out.push(PedCatalogEntry { name, hash64 });
            }
            if out.len() >= 256 || visited > 250_000 {
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    out.sort_by(|a, b| a.name.cmp(&b.name));
    world_peds.extend(out);
    world_peds.truncate(256);
    world_peds
}

/// Safely reads the live rendered 3D camera `Mat34V` (`[right, forward, up, world_pos]`)
/// from `base + rvas.cam_mat_base` (`+0x00` right, `+0x10` fwd, `+0x20` up, `+0x30` sector-packed pos).
pub fn read_camera_mat34(
    base: u64,
    rvas: &RvaTable,
) -> Option<([f32; 3], [f32; 3], [f32; 3], [f32; 3])> {
    if base == 0 || !rvas.loaded || rvas.cam_mat_base == 0 {
        return None;
    }
    let addr = (base + rvas.cam_mat_base) as usize;
    let r = safe_read::<[f32; 4]>(addr)?;
    let f = safe_read::<[f32; 4]>(addr + 0x10)?;
    let u = safe_read::<[f32; 4]>(addr + 0x20)?;
    let p_raw = safe_read::<[u32; 4]>(addr + 0x30)?;
    let pos = unpack_sector_pos(p_raw);
    let flen = (f[0] * f[0] + f[1] * f[1] + f[2] * f[2]).sqrt();
    if !(0.5..=1.5).contains(&flen)
        || !pos.iter().all(|v| v.is_finite() && v.abs() < 80_000.0)
        || !r[..3].iter().all(|v| v.is_finite())
        || !u[..3].iter().all(|v| v.is_finite())
    {
        return None;
    }
    Some((
        [r[0], r[1], r[2]],
        [f[0] / flen, f[1] / flen, f[2] / flen],
        [u[0], u[1], u[2]],
        pos,
    ))
}

/// Safe read-only 3D camera-ray entity picker across any pool (`vehicle_pool`, `object_pool`, `ped_pool`).
/// Returns the best matching `(forward_dist_m, entity_ptr)` closest to the crosshair ray `(origin, dir)`.
pub fn find_entity_along_ray(
    base: u64,
    rvas: &RvaTable,
    pool_rva: u64,
    origin: [f32; 3],
    dir: [f32; 3],
    max_dist: f32,
    max_perp_dist: f32,
    exclude: &[u64],
) -> Option<(f32, u64)> {
    if base == 0 || !rvas.loaded || pool_rva == 0 {
        return None;
    }
    let dlen = (dir[0] * dir[0] + dir[1] * dir[1] + dir[2] * dir[2]).sqrt();
    if dlen < 0.001 {
        return None;
    }
    let dn = [dir[0] / dlen, dir[1] / dlen, dir[2] / dlen];
    let mut reader = FastSafeReader::new();
    let pool = reader.read::<u64>((base + pool_rva) as usize)?;
    if pool < 0x10000 {
        return None;
    }
    let (storage, elem_size, max_count, flags_ptr) = (
        reader.read::<u64>((pool + rvas.pool_storage) as usize)?,
        reader.read::<u32>((pool + rvas.pool_elem_size) as usize)?,
        reader.read::<u32>((pool + rvas.pool_max_count) as usize)?,
        reader.read::<u64>((pool + rvas.pool_flags) as usize)?,
    );
    let valid_mask = reader.read::<u32>((pool + 0x30) as usize).unwrap_or(0);
    if storage < 0x10000
        || flags_ptr < 0x10000
        || !(64..=32_768).contains(&elem_size)
        || max_count == 0
        || max_count > 32_768
    {
        return None;
    }
    let mut best: Option<(f32, f32, u64)> = None; // (score, t, ent)
    for i in 0..max_count as u64 {
        let Some(fl) = reader.read::<u32>((flags_ptr + i * 4) as usize) else {
            break;
        };
        if valid_mask != 0 {
            if (fl & valid_mask) != valid_mask {
                continue;
            }
        } else if fl == 0 {
            continue;
        }
        let ent = storage + i * u64::from(elem_size);
        if exclude.contains(&ent) {
            continue;
        }
        let Some(vtable) = reader.read::<u64>(ent as usize) else {
            continue;
        };
        if vtable < 0x10000 {
            continue;
        }
        let Some(raw_pos) = reader.read::<[u32; 4]>((ent + rvas.ped_pos_packed) as usize) else {
            continue;
        };
        let pos = unpack_sector_pos(raw_pos);
        if !pos.iter().all(|v| v.is_finite() && v.abs() < 80_000.0) {
            continue;
        }
        let vx = pos[0] - origin[0];
        let vy = pos[1] - origin[1];
        let vz = pos[2] - origin[2];
        let t = vx * dn[0] + vy * dn[1] + vz * dn[2];
        if !(1.5..=max_dist).contains(&t) {
            continue;
        }
        let v2 = vx * vx + vy * vy + vz * vz;
        let perp2 = (v2 - t * t).max(0.0);
        let allowed = max_perp_dist + t * 0.045;
        if perp2 <= allowed * allowed {
            let score = perp2.sqrt() + t * 0.03;
            if best.is_none_or(|b| score < b.0) {
                best = Some((score, t, ent));
            }
        }
    }
    best.map(|(_, t, ent)| (t, ent))
}

/// O(1) live-slot check verifying `ent` is still an active, non-freed entity inside `pool_rva`.
/// Prevents ever passing a despawned or deleted cached pointer (e.g. `LAST_SPAWNED_VEH`) into native hooks!
pub fn is_entity_live_in_pool(base: u64, rvas: &RvaTable, pool_rva: u64, ent: u64) -> bool {
    if base == 0 || !rvas.loaded || pool_rva == 0 || ent < 0x10000 {
        return false;
    }
    let Some(pool) = safe_read::<u64>((base + pool_rva) as usize) else {
        return false;
    };
    if pool < 0x10000 {
        return false;
    }
    let (Some(storage), Some(elem_size), Some(max_count), Some(flags_ptr)) = (
        safe_read::<u64>((pool + rvas.pool_storage) as usize),
        safe_read::<u32>((pool + rvas.pool_elem_size) as usize),
        safe_read::<u32>((pool + rvas.pool_max_count) as usize),
        safe_read::<u64>((pool + rvas.pool_flags) as usize),
    ) else {
        return false;
    };
    let elem = u64::from(elem_size);
    if storage < 0x10000
        || flags_ptr < 0x10000
        || !(64..=32_768).contains(&elem_size)
        || max_count == 0
        || max_count > 32_768
        || ent < storage
    {
        return false;
    }
    let off = ent - storage;
    if off % elem != 0 {
        return false;
    }
    let idx = off / elem;
    if idx >= u64::from(max_count) {
        return false;
    }
    let valid_mask = safe_read::<u32>((pool + 0x30) as usize).unwrap_or(0);
    let Some(fl) = safe_read::<u32>((flags_ptr + idx * 4) as usize) else {
        return false;
    };
    let slot_live = if valid_mask != 0 {
        (fl & valid_mask) == valid_mask
    } else {
        fl != 0
    };
    if !slot_live {
        return false;
    }
    safe_read::<u64>(ent as usize).is_some_and(|vt| vt > 0x10000)
}

/// Universal safe read-only pool query returning active `(dist_m, entity_ptr)` sorted nearest-first.
/// Works identically across `vehicle_pool`, `ped_pool`, and `object_pool`.
pub fn find_nearby_entities_in_pool(
    base: u64,
    rvas: &RvaTable,
    pool_rva: u64,
    center: [f32; 3],
    max_dist: f32,
    exclude: &[u64],
    limit: usize,
) -> Vec<(f32, u64)> {
    if base == 0 || !rvas.loaded || pool_rva == 0 || limit == 0 {
        return Vec::new();
    }
    let mut reader = FastSafeReader::new();
    let Some(pool) = reader.read::<u64>((base + pool_rva) as usize) else {
        return Vec::new();
    };
    if pool < 0x10000 {
        return Vec::new();
    }
    let (Some(storage), Some(elem_size), Some(max_count), Some(flags_ptr)) = (
        reader.read::<u64>((pool + rvas.pool_storage) as usize),
        reader.read::<u32>((pool + rvas.pool_elem_size) as usize),
        reader.read::<u32>((pool + rvas.pool_max_count) as usize),
        reader.read::<u64>((pool + rvas.pool_flags) as usize),
    ) else {
        return Vec::new();
    };
    let valid_mask = reader.read::<u32>((pool + 0x30) as usize).unwrap_or(0);
    if storage < 0x10000
        || flags_ptr < 0x10000
        || !(64..=32_768).contains(&elem_size)
        || max_count == 0
        || max_count > 32_768
    {
        return Vec::new();
    }
    let max_d2 = max_dist * max_dist;
    let mut hits = Vec::<(f32, u64)>::new();
    for i in 0..max_count as u64 {
        let Some(fl) = reader.read::<u32>((flags_ptr + i * 4) as usize) else {
            break;
        };
        if valid_mask != 0 {
            if (fl & valid_mask) != valid_mask {
                continue;
            }
        } else if fl == 0 {
            continue;
        }
        let ent = storage + i * u64::from(elem_size);
        if exclude.contains(&ent) {
            continue;
        }
        let Some(vtable) = reader.read::<u64>(ent as usize) else {
            continue;
        };
        if vtable < 0x10000 {
            continue;
        }
        let Some(raw_pos) = reader.read::<[u32; 4]>((ent + rvas.ped_pos_packed) as usize) else {
            continue;
        };
        let pos = unpack_sector_pos(raw_pos);
        if !pos.iter().all(|v| v.is_finite() && v.abs() < 80_000.0) {
            continue;
        }
        let dx = pos[0] - center[0];
        let dy = pos[1] - center[1];
        let dz = pos[2] - center[2];
        let d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz;
        if d2 <= max_d2 {
            hits.push((d2.sqrt(), ent));
        }
    }
    hits.sort_by(|a, b| a.0.total_cmp(&b.0));
    hits.truncate(limit);
    hits
}

/// Estimates safe ground Z near `(x, y)` by checking active world vehicles/peds/objects within 120m
/// of `(x, y)` before falling back to `fallback_z`.
pub fn probe_ground_z_near_xy(
    base: u64,
    rvas: &RvaTable,
    x: f32,
    y: f32,
    fallback_z: f32,
) -> f32 {
    if base == 0 || !rvas.loaded {
        return fallback_z;
    }
    let mut best_d2 = 120.0f32 * 120.0;
    let mut best_z = None;
    for pool_rva in [rvas.vehicle_pool, rvas.ped_pool, rvas.object_pool] {
        for &(_d, ent) in &find_nearby_entities_in_pool(
            base,
            rvas,
            pool_rva,
            [x, y, fallback_z],
            250.0,
            &[],
            12,
        ) {
            if let Some(raw) = safe_read::<[u32; 4]>((ent + rvas.ped_pos_packed) as usize) {
                let p = unpack_sector_pos(raw);
                let d2 = (p[0] - x) * (p[0] - x) + (p[1] - y) * (p[1] - y);
                if d2 < best_d2 && p[2].is_finite() && (-50.0..=1500.0).contains(&p[2]) {
                    best_d2 = d2;
                    best_z = Some(p[2] + 1.2);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    best_z.unwrap_or(fallback_z)
}

fn sanitize_filename(name: &str) -> String {
    let clean: String = name
        .chars()
        .filter(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(c, ' ' | '-' | '_'))
        .collect();
    clean.trim().to_owned()
}

fn list_json_stems(dir: &Path) -> Vec<String> {
    let Ok(rd) = std::fs::read_dir(dir) else {
        return Vec::new();
    };
    let mut names: Vec<String> = rd
        .filter_map(|e| e.ok())
        .filter_map(|e| {
            let p = e.path();
            if p.extension()?.eq_ignore_ascii_case("json") {
                Some(p.file_stem()?.to_string_lossy().into_owned())
            } else {
                None
            }
        })
        .collect();
    names.sort();
    names
}

fn parse_json_f32(body: &str, key: &str) -> Option<f32> {
    let needle = format!("\"{key}\"");
    let pos = body.find(&needle)?;
    let rest = &body[pos + needle.len()..];
    let colon = rest.find(':')?;
    let tok = rest[colon + 1..]
        .trim_start()
        .split(|c: char| c == ',' || c == '}' || c == '\n' || c == '\r')
        .next()?
        .trim();
    tok.parse::<f32>().ok().filter(|v| v.is_finite())
}

fn parse_json_bool(body: &str, key: &str) -> Option<bool> {
    let needle = format!("\"{key}\"");
    let pos = body.find(&needle)?;
    let rest = &body[pos + needle.len()..];
    let colon = rest.find(':')?;
    let tok = rest[colon + 1..]
        .trim_start()
        .split(|c: char| c == ',' || c == '}' || c == '\n' || c == '\r')
        .next()?
        .trim();
    match tok {
        "true" => Some(true),
        "false" => Some(false),
        _ => None,
    }
}

fn parse_json_vec3(body: &str, key: &str) -> Option<[f32; 3]> {
    let needle = format!("\"{key}\"");
    let pos = body.find(&needle)?;
    let rest = &body[pos + needle.len()..];
    let open = rest.find('[')?;
    let close = rest[open..].find(']')?;
    let nums: Vec<f32> = rest[open + 1..open + close]
        .split(',')
        .filter_map(|s| s.trim().parse::<f32>().ok())
        .collect();
    if let [a, b, c] = nums[..]
        && a.is_finite()
        && b.is_finite()
        && c.is_finite()
    {
        Some([a, b, c])
    } else {
        None
    }
}

fn parse_json_rgb(body: &str, key: &str) -> Option<[u8; 3]> {
    let v = parse_json_vec3(body, key)?;
    Some([
        v[0].clamp(0.0, 255.0).round() as u8,
        v[1].clamp(0.0, 255.0).round() as u8,
        v[2].clamp(0.0, 255.0).round() as u8,
    ])
}

/// Lists saved custom vehicle preset names in `menyooStuff/Vehicles/*.json`.
pub fn list_saved_vehicles(stuff_dir: &Path) -> Vec<String> {
    list_json_stems(&stuff_dir.join("Vehicles"))
}

/// Saves a custom vehicle preset cleanly to `menyooStuff/Vehicles/<name>.json`.
pub fn save_custom_vehicle(stuff_dir: &Path, veh: &SavedCustomVehicle) -> std::io::Result<()> {
    let stem = sanitize_filename(&veh.name);
    if stem.is_empty() {
        return Err(std::io::Error::new(
            std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidInput,
            "empty vehicle preset name",
        ));
    }
    let dir = stuff_dir.join("Vehicles");
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir)?;
    let plate: String = veh
        .plate_text
        .chars()
        .filter(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || *c == ' ' || *c == '-')
        .take(8)
        .collect();
    let json = format!(
        "{{\n  \"name\": \"{}\",\n  \"hash64\": \"0x{:016x}\",\n  \"primary_rgb\": [{}, {}, {}],\n  \"secondary_rgb\": [{}, {}, {}],\n  \"mod_kit\": {},\n  \"dirt_level\": {:.3},\n  \"invincible\": {},\n  \"power_mult\": {:.2},\n  \"plate_text\": \"{}\",\n  \"neon_channels\": {},\n  \"extras_mask\": \"0x{:08x}\",\n  \"gloss\": {:.2},\n  \"livery\": {},\n  \"fuel_rate\": {:.2}\n}}\n",
        stem,
        veh.hash64,
        veh.primary_rgb[0],
        veh.primary_rgb[1],
        veh.primary_rgb[2],
        veh.secondary_rgb[0],
        veh.secondary_rgb[1],
        veh.secondary_rgb[2],
        veh.mod_kit,
        veh.dirt_level.clamp(0.0, 1.0),
        veh.invincible,
        veh.power_mult.clamp(0.5, 10.0),
        plate,
        veh.neon_channels,
        veh.extras_mask,
        veh.gloss.clamp(0.0, 1.0),
        veh.livery,
        veh.fuel_rate.clamp(0.0, 5.0),
    );
    std::fs::write(dir.join(format!("{stem}.json")), json)
}

/// Loads a custom vehicle preset from `menyooStuff/Vehicles/<name>.json`.
pub fn load_custom_vehicle(stuff_dir: &Path, name: &str) -> Option<SavedCustomVehicle> {
    let text = std::fs::read_to_string(stuff_dir.join("Vehicles").join(format!("{name}.json"))).ok()?;
    Some(SavedCustomVehicle {
        name: extract_json_str(&text, "name").unwrap_or_else(|| name.to_owned()),
        hash64: parse_json_hex(&text, "hash64").unwrap_or(0),
        primary_rgb: parse_json_rgb(&text, "primary_rgb").unwrap_or([0, 210, 255]),
        secondary_rgb: parse_json_rgb(&text, "secondary_rgb").unwrap_or([255, 68, 168]),
        mod_kit: parse_json_hex(&text, "mod_kit").unwrap_or(0) as u32,
        dirt_level: parse_json_f32(&text, "dirt_level").unwrap_or(0.0).clamp(0.0, 1.0),
        invincible: parse_json_bool(&text, "invincible").unwrap_or(false),
        power_mult: parse_json_f32(&text, "power_mult").unwrap_or(1.0).clamp(0.5, 10.0),
        plate_text: extract_json_str(&text, "plate_text").unwrap_or_else(|| "MENYOO".into()),
        neon_channels: parse_json_hex(&text, "neon_channels").unwrap_or(0x0F) as u8,
        extras_mask: parse_json_hex(&text, "extras_mask").unwrap_or(0) as u32,
        gloss: parse_json_f32(&text, "gloss").unwrap_or(0.5).clamp(0.0, 1.0),
        livery: parse_json_hex(&text, "livery").unwrap_or(0) as u8,
        fuel_rate: parse_json_f32(&text, "fuel_rate").unwrap_or(1.0).clamp(0.0, 5.0),
    })
}

/// Lists saved Object Spooner scene names in `menyooStuff/Spooner/*.json`.
pub fn list_spooner_scenes(stuff_dir: &Path) -> Vec<String> {
    list_json_stems(&stuff_dir.join("Spooner"))
}

/// Saves an Object Spooner scene (including 6-DOF Menya-Car attachments, bones, alpha & scale) to `menyooStuff/Spooner/<name>.json`.
pub fn save_spooner_scene(stuff_dir: &Path, scene: &SavedSpoonerScene) -> std::io::Result<()> {
    let stem = sanitize_filename(&scene.name);
    if stem.is_empty() {
        return Err(std::io::Error::new(
            std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidInput,
            "empty scene name",
        ));
    }
    let dir = stuff_dir.join("Spooner");
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir)?;
    let mut json = format!("{{\n  \"name\": \"{stem}\",\n  \"entities\": [\n");
    for (i, e) in scene.entities.iter().enumerate() {
        let comma = if i + 1 < scene.entities.len() { "," } else { "" };
        json.push_str(&format!(
            "    {{\"kind\": {}, \"hash64\": \"0x{:016x}\", \"pos\": [{:.3}, {:.3}, {:.3}], \"right\": [{:.4}, {:.4}, {:.4}], \"forward\": [{:.4}, {:.4}, {:.4}], \"up\": [{:.4}, {:.4}, {:.4}], \"frozen\": {}, \"invincible\": {}, \"attach_target\": {}, \"attach_bone\": {}, \"attach_offset\": [{:.3}, {:.3}, {:.3}], \"attach_rot\": [{:.2}, {:.2}, {:.2}], \"alpha\": {}, \"scale\": {:.3}, \"collision\": {}}}{comma}\n",
            e.kind,
            e.hash64,
            e.pos[0], e.pos[1], e.pos[2],
            e.right[0], e.right[1], e.right[2],
            e.forward[0], e.forward[1], e.forward[2],
            e.up[0], e.up[1], e.up[2],
            e.frozen,
            e.invincible,
            e.attach_target,
            e.attach_bone,
            e.attach_offset[0], e.attach_offset[1], e.attach_offset[2],
            e.attach_rot[0], e.attach_rot[1], e.attach_rot[2],
            e.alpha,
            e.scale.clamp(0.2, 5.0),
            e.collision,
        ));
    }
    json.push_str("  ]\n}\n");
    std::fs::write(dir.join(format!("{stem}.json")), json)
}

/// Loads an Object Spooner scene (including 6-DOF Menya-Car attachments) from `menyooStuff/Spooner/<name>.json`.
pub fn load_spooner_scene(stuff_dir: &Path, name: &str) -> Option<SavedSpoonerScene> {
    let text = std::fs::read_to_string(stuff_dir.join("Spooner").join(format!("{name}.json"))).ok()?;
    let scene_name = extract_json_str(&text, "name").unwrap_or_else(|| name.to_owned());
    let arr_pos = text.find("\"entities\"")?;
    let rest = &text[arr_pos..];
    let open = rest.find('[')?;
    let close = rest.rfind(']')?;
    let slice = &rest[open + 1..close];
    let mut entities = Vec::new();
    for entry in slice.split('{').skip(1) {
        let Some(body) = entry.split('}').next() else {
            continue;
        };
        let hash64 = parse_json_hex(body, "hash64").unwrap_or(0);
        let pos = parse_json_vec3(body, "pos").unwrap_or([0.0; 3]);
        if hash64 == 0 {
            continue;
        }
        entities.push(SavedSpoonerEntity {
            kind: parse_json_hex(body, "kind").unwrap_or(0) as u8,
            hash64,
            pos,
            right: parse_json_vec3(body, "right").unwrap_or([1.0, 0.0, 0.0]),
            forward: parse_json_vec3(body, "forward").unwrap_or([0.0, 1.0, 0.0]),
            up: parse_json_vec3(body, "up").unwrap_or([0.0, 0.0, 1.0]),
            frozen: parse_json_bool(body, "frozen").unwrap_or(false),
            invincible: parse_json_bool(body, "invincible").unwrap_or(false),
            attach_target: parse_json_hex(body, "attach_target").unwrap_or(0) as u32,
            attach_bone: parse_json_hex(body, "attach_bone").unwrap_or(0) as u8,
            attach_offset: parse_json_vec3(body, "attach_offset").unwrap_or([0.0, 1.8, 0.5]),
            attach_rot: parse_json_vec3(body, "attach_rot").unwrap_or([0.0; 3]),
            alpha: parse_json_hex(body, "alpha").unwrap_or(255) as u8,
            scale: parse_json_f32(body, "scale").unwrap_or(1.0).clamp(0.2, 5.0),
            collision: parse_json_bool(body, "collision").unwrap_or(true),
        });
    }
    Some(SavedSpoonerScene {
        name: scene_name,
        entities,
    })
}

/// Lists saved deterministic Wardrobe outfit names in `menyooStuff/Outfits/*.json`.
pub fn list_saved_outfits(stuff_dir: &Path) -> Vec<String> {
    list_json_stems(&stuff_dir.join("Outfits"))
}

/// Saves a deterministic Wardrobe outfit preset to `menyooStuff/Outfits/<name>.json`.
pub fn save_outfit(stuff_dir: &Path, outfit: &SavedOutfit) -> std::io::Result<()> {
    let stem = sanitize_filename(&outfit.name);
    if stem.is_empty() {
        return Err(std::io::Error::new(
            std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidInput,
            "empty outfit name",
        ));
    }
    let dir = stuff_dir.join("Outfits");
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir)?;
    let json = format!(
        "{{\n  \"name\": \"{stem}\",\n  \"seed\": {}\n}}\n",
        outfit.seed
    );
    std::fs::write(dir.join(format!("{stem}.json")), json)
}

/// Loads a saved deterministic Wardrobe outfit preset from `menyooStuff/Outfits/<name>.json`.
pub fn load_outfit(stuff_dir: &Path, name: &str) -> Option<SavedOutfit> {
    let text = std::fs::read_to_string(stuff_dir.join("Outfits").join(format!("{name}.json"))).ok()?;
    Some(SavedOutfit {
        name: extract_json_str(&text, "name").unwrap_or_else(|| name.to_owned()),
        seed: parse_json_hex(&text, "seed").unwrap_or(0) as u32,
    })
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn weapon_categories_and_balanced_loadout() {
        let mk = |name: &str, h: u32, firearm: bool| WeaponCatalogEntry {
            name: name.to_owned(),
            category: classify_weapon_category(name, firearm).to_owned(),
            hash32: h,
            award_hash32: 0,
            ammo_hash32: 0,
            ammo_award_hash32: 0,
            ammo_types: u16::from(firearm),
            is_firearm: firearm,
            in_inv_db: true,
            free_award: true,
            cat_direct_ok: true,
        };
        let catalog = vec![
            mk("Combat Pistol", 0x1001, true),
            mk("Heavy Revolver", 0x1002, true),
            mk("Micro SMG", 0x2001, true),
            mk("Carbine Rifle", 0x3001, true),
            mk("Heavy Sniper", 0x3002, true),
            mk("Pump Shotgun", 0x4001, true),
            mk("RPG Launcher", 0x5001, true),
            mk("Frag Grenade", 0x5002, false),
            mk("Baseball Bat", 0x6001, false),
        ];
        assert_eq!(catalog[0].category, "Pistols & Sidearms");
        assert_eq!(catalog[2].category, "SMGs");
        assert_eq!(catalog[3].category, "Rifles & Snipers");
        assert_eq!(catalog[5].category, "Shotguns");
        assert_eq!(catalog[6].category, "Heavy & Throwables");
        assert_eq!(catalog[7].category, "Heavy & Throwables");
        assert_eq!(catalog[8].category, "Melee");

        let loadout = select_balanced_loadout(&catalog, 8);
        assert_eq!(loadout.len(), 8);
        // Must span pistols, SMGs, rifles, shotguns, heavy/throwables, and melee!
        let hashes: Vec<u32> = loadout.iter().map(|&(h, _, _)| h).collect();
        assert!(hashes.contains(&0x1001));
        assert!(hashes.contains(&0x2001));
        assert!(hashes.contains(&0x3001));
        assert!(hashes.contains(&0x4001));
        assert!(hashes.contains(&0x5001));
        assert!(hashes.contains(&0x6001));
    }

    #[test]
    fn custom_vehicle_and_spooner_scene_roundtrip() {
        let dir = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("victory_menyoo_v6_test_{}", std::process::id()));
        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&dir);

        let veh = SavedCustomVehicle {
            name: "Neon GT Banshee".into(),
            hash64: 0x1122_3344_5566_7788,
            primary_rgb: [0, 240, 255],
            secondary_rgb: [255, 64, 180],
            mod_kit: 3,
            dirt_level: 0.125,
            invincible: true,
            power_mult: 2.25,
            plate_text: "VICE666".into(),
            neon_channels: 0x0F,
            extras_mask: 0x05,
            gloss: 0.9,
            livery: 2,
            fuel_rate: 0.0,
        };
        save_custom_vehicle(&dir, &veh).expect("save custom vehicle");
        assert_eq!(list_saved_vehicles(&dir), vec!["Neon GT Banshee"]);
        let loaded_v = load_custom_vehicle(&dir, "Neon GT Banshee").expect("load custom vehicle");
        assert_eq!(loaded_v.hash64, veh.hash64);
        assert_eq!(loaded_v.primary_rgb, veh.primary_rgb);
        assert_eq!(loaded_v.secondary_rgb, veh.secondary_rgb);
        assert_eq!(loaded_v.mod_kit, 3);
        assert!((loaded_v.dirt_level - 0.125).abs() < 0.005);
        assert!(loaded_v.invincible);
        assert!((loaded_v.power_mult - 2.25).abs() < 0.01);
        assert_eq!(loaded_v.plate_text, "VICE666");
        assert_eq!(loaded_v.neon_channels, 0x0F);
        assert_eq!(loaded_v.extras_mask, 0x05);

        let scene = SavedSpoonerScene {
            name: "GTA Stunt Park".into(),
            entities: vec![
                SavedSpoonerEntity {
                    kind: 0,
                    hash64: 0xAAAA_BBBB_CCCC_DDDD,
                    pos: [1420.5, -1840.25, 13.0],
                    right: [1.0, 0.0, 0.0],
                    forward: [0.0, 1.0, 0.0],
                    up: [0.0, 0.0, 1.0],
                    frozen: true,
                    invincible: true,
                    attach_target: 2,
                    attach_bone: 5,
                    attach_offset: [0.0, 1.2, 1.4],
                    attach_rot: [0.0, 0.0, 90.0],
                    alpha: 220,
                    scale: 1.25,
                    collision: true,
                },
                SavedSpoonerEntity {
                    kind: 1,
                    hash64: 0x1234_5678_9ABC_DEF0,
                    pos: [1425.0, -1835.0, 12.5],
                    right: [0.0, 1.0, 0.0],
                    forward: [-1.0, 0.0, 0.0],
                    up: [0.0, 0.0, 1.0],
                    frozen: false,
                    invincible: true,
                    attach_target: 0,
                    attach_bone: 0,
                    attach_offset: [0.0, 1.8, 0.5],
                    attach_rot: [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
                    alpha: 255,
                    scale: 1.0,
                    collision: true,
                },
            ],
        };
        save_spooner_scene(&dir, &scene).expect("save spooner scene");
        assert_eq!(list_spooner_scenes(&dir), vec!["GTA Stunt Park"]);
        let loaded_s = load_spooner_scene(&dir, "GTA Stunt Park").expect("load spooner scene");
        assert_eq!(loaded_s.entities.len(), 2);
        assert_eq!(loaded_s.entities[0].hash64, 0xAAAA_BBBB_CCCC_DDDD);
        assert_eq!(loaded_s.entities[0].attach_target, 2);
        assert_eq!(loaded_s.entities[0].attach_bone, 5);
        assert_eq!(loaded_s.entities[0].alpha, 220);
        assert_eq!(loaded_s.entities[1].kind, 1);
        assert!((loaded_s.entities[1].pos[0] - 1425.0).abs() < 0.01);
        assert!(loaded_s.entities[0].frozen);

        let outfit = SavedOutfit {
            name: "Oceanfront Beach Linen".into(),
            seed: 42,
        };
        save_outfit(&dir, &outfit).expect("save outfit");
        assert_eq!(list_saved_outfits(&dir), vec!["Oceanfront Beach Linen"]);
        let loaded_o = load_outfit(&dir, "Oceanfront Beach Linen").expect("load outfit");
        assert_eq!(loaded_o, outfit);

        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&dir);
    }
}
